papers.title: Learning When to Trust via Selective Context Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Language models increasingly condition their answers on external signals, and a single misleading one can turn a correct answer wrong. The obvious remedy, training models to resist such signals, hides a failure mode: a model that ignores all context looks robust yet is useless when the context is worth trusting. We recast the problem as selective trust and introduce MIST, a human-annotated benchmark that renders each reasoning item under four matched conditions (clean, misleading, correct-context, and irrelevant-context), together with SC2W, a paired metric counting how often a misleading signal flips a clean-correct answer to wrong. Across a comprehensive benchmark study, we observe that such a susceptibility is universal. We then propose SCOPE, which mines clean-correct/misleading-wrong failures and optimizes a standard Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) objective over matched preference pairs balanced equally across all four conditions, rather than over misleading items alone. Our approach substantially reduces SC2W on popular open-sourced models while preserving accuracy when the added context is clean, correct, or irrelevant. With this work, we argue that models should be judged on selective trust, not on resistance alone.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把语言模型对上下文信号的依赖重新定义为选择性信任 (selective trust) 问题，并指出单纯训练模型抵抗误导信号会导致其对任何上下文都不加利用。作者提出人类标注基准 MIST，将每个推理问题放在干净、误导、正确上下文和无关上下文四种匹配条件下评估，并引入成对指标 SC2W 来度量误导信号把原本正确的答案翻转为错误的频率。在此基础上提出 SCOPE，通过挖掘干净正确/误导错误样本对，并在四种条件上均衡地优化标准 DPO 目标，显著降低开源模型的 SC2W 同时保持干净或正确上下文下的准确率。
Motivation: 语言模型越来越依赖外部信号，但一个误导性信号就可能让原本正确的答案出错；现有训练方法若只让模型抵抗这种信号，会退化为忽略一切上下文，在上下文值得信任时变得无用，因此需要以选择性信任而非单纯抵抗作为评测与训练目标。
Method: 构建 MIST 基准，使每道推理题在干净、误导、正确上下文和无关上下文四种匹配条件下呈现；提出 SC2W 成对指标统计误导信号使干净正确答案变错的频率。提出 SCOPE，挖掘干净正确/误导错误的失败样本，并在所有四种条件上均衡构造匹配偏好对，使用标准 Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) 目标优化，而不是只对误导样本进行优化。
Result: 在多种主流开源模型上进行基准研究发现，误导信号导致正确答案翻转的现象具有普遍性；SCOPE 能大幅降低 SC2W，同时保持上下文干净、正确或无关时模型的准确率。
Conclusion: 作者主张模型应依据选择性信任来评判，而非只看对误导信号的抵抗能力；平衡多种上下文条件下的偏好优化是改善选择性信任的有效途径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Tracing the Heart: An Evidence-Linked Pipeline for Heart-Failure Feature Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Electronic health record (EHR) feature engineering is a major bottleneck in clinical research and AI, accounting for 39-45% of data scientists' workload. This is especially pronounced in heart failure, which affects an estimated 6.7 million U.S. adults and requires integrating fragmented EHR data with disease-specific, guideline-based clinical reasoning. Existing rule-based and large language model (LLM)-based approaches offer only partial automation with limited maintainability and evidence traceability. We developed the Nimblemind Multi-Agent System (nMAS), an evidence-linked, rubric-grounded pipeline for automated heart-failure feature engineering, and evaluated it on 500 dummy patient records from nine EHR source tables. nMAS generated 132 structured and 70 rubric-scored aggregated features, verified for structural integrity, rubric compliance, and provenance, and audited by a restricted LLM. Adding the aggregated features improved held-out AUROC from 0.895 to 0.963 for HFrEF and 0.870 to 0.910 for HFpEF phenotyping, and an independent LLM-based rubric assessment of evidence support and methodological soundness scored the features at 81.5% of maximum points. These results demonstrate the feasibility of automated, auditable feature engineering for complex cardiovascular EHR data, though evaluation was limited to a single-institution cohort and external validation is needed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Nimblemind Multi-Agent System (nMAS)，一个基于证据链接和评分标准 (rubric-grounded) 的自动化心衰特征工程流水线。在 500 条虚拟患者记录（来自 9 个 EHR 源表）上生成 132 个结构化特征和 70 个按 rubric 评分的聚合特征，并通过受限 LLM 审计。加入聚合特征后，HFrEF 表型分类的 held-out AUROC 从 0.895 提升到 0.963，HFpEF 从 0.870 提升到 0.910；独立 LLM rubric 评估得分为最高分的 81.5%。
Motivation: EHR 特征工程占用数据科学家 39-45% 的工作量，是临床研究和 AI 的主要瓶颈；心衰尤其严重，需要整合碎片化 EHR 数据与指南驱动的临床推理。现有基于规则和 LLM 的方法只提供部分自动化，可维护性和证据可追溯性有限。
Method: 提出 nMAS 多智能体系统，以证据链接和 rubric 为依据，自动化心衰特征工程；在 500 条虚拟患者记录、9 个 EHR 源表上生成结构化与聚合特征，并用受限 LLM 进行结构完整性、rubric 合规性和来源审计。
Result: 加入聚合特征后，HFrEF 表型 AUROC 从 0.895 升至 0.963，HFpEF 从 0.870 升至 0.910；独立 LLM 的 rubric 评估在证据支持和方法学合理性上得分为最高分的 81.5%。
Conclusion: 结果表明自动化、可审计的心血管 EHR 特征工程可行，但评估局限于单一机构队列，需要外部验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Investigating Artificial Intelligence Digital Sovereignty in Mobile Shopping Apps: A Case Study of Nigeria
papers.abstract_en: The use of e-commerce mobile applications is expanding in Nigeria, creating both opportunities and risks, including fraud and reduced user control over digital technologies, raising concerns about digital sovereignty. This research examines how Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Nigerian mobile applications affects digital sovereignty, examined through platform transparency as a key indicator of user awareness and control. Using an interpretive approach, the research combines the forensic analysis of selected Android applications with contextual document analysis to identify AI features and evaluate disclosure practices. The findings show that AI is widely implemented in the applications, yet transparency about its use remains limited. A socio-economic analysis of Nigeria further shows an increasing dependence on consumer digital platforms, moderate AI awareness, and uneven patterns of interaction. By providing empirical evidence on AI transparency and platform practices, this study advances understanding of individual digital sovereignty and highlights challenges for protecting user control in AI-driven digital environments.
papers.comment: Paper presented at Thirty-second Americas Conference on Information Systems, Reno, USA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以尼日利亚为案例，考察移动购物应用中的AI如何影响个人数字主权（digital sovereignty），并以平台透明度作为用户意识与控制的关键指标。研究采用解释性路径，结合对选定Android应用的取证分析与情境化文档分析。摘要报告称，AI在这些应用中广泛部署，但透明度有限，且 socio-economic 分析显示对消费者数字平台的依赖在增加。
Motivation: 尼日利亚电子商务移动应用快速扩张，带来欺诈与用户对数字技术控制力减弱等风险，引发对数字主权的担忧；现有研究对AI透明度与个人数字主权之间关系的实证证据不足。
Method: 采用解释性研究方法，将对选定Android应用的取证分析（forensic analysis）与情境化文档分析（contextual document analysis）相结合，用于识别AI功能并评估其披露实践。
Result: 摘要报告发现AI在所选应用中广泛实施，但其使用透明度有限；对尼日利亚的社会经济分析显示对消费者数字平台的依赖增加、AI意识中等，且交互模式不均衡。
Conclusion: 研究通过提供关于AI透明度与平台实践的实证证据，增进对个体数字主权的理解，并强调在AI驱动的数字环境中保护用户控制所面临的挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An Optimal Agnostic PAC Algorithm
papers.abstract_en: Let $H\subseteq\{-1,+1\}^X$ be a class of finite VC dimension $d\ge1$. Writing $L$ for the binary risk and $L^*=\min_{h\in H}L(h)$, we construct a learner achieving the statistically optimal risk bound: from an i.i.d.\ sample of size $n$, for every $0<δ\le 1/2$, with probability at least $1-δ$, \[ L(\widehat h) \le L^*+ 7\cdot10^8\left( \sqrt{\frac{L^*(d+\log(1/δ))}{n}} +\frac{d+\log(1/δ)}{n} \right). \] This settles the sample complexity of agnostic PAC learning up to universal constants at every fixed $L^*$, matching the lower bounds of Devroye, Györfi, and Lugosi [A Probabilistic Theory of Pattern Recognition, Springer, 1996].
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个针对有限 VC 维类别 H 的 agnostic PAC 学习算法，并从 i.i.d. 样本中达到统计最优的风险界：以至少 1-δ 的概率满足 L(ĥ) ≤ L* + O(√(L*(d+log(1/δ))/n) + (d+log(1/δ))/n)。该界在每个固定 L* 处与 Devroye、Györfi 和 Lugosi 的下界匹配到万用常数，从而在样本复杂度意义上解决 agnostic PAC 学习的最优性问题。
Motivation: 此前 agnostic PAC 学习虽已有多种算法，但在固定最优风险 L* 下达到精确统计最优样本复杂度（匹配已知下界）的问题尚未解决；本文目标是在万用常数意义下补齐这一缺口。
Method: 作者构造了一个学习器，使其经验风险界显式包含 L*，并以常数 7·10^8 给出 7·10^8(√(L*(d+log(1/δ))/n) + (d+log(1/δ))/n) 的附加项；摘要未详述具体构造细节。
Result: 摘要报告该学习器对任意 0<δ≤1/2，以至少 1-δ 概率达到 L(ĥ) ≤ L* + 7·10^8(√(L*(d+log(1/δ))/n) + (d+log(1/δ))/n)，与 Devroye、Györfi 和 Lugosi（1996）的下界在万用常数内匹配。
Conclusion: 作者认为这解决了 agnostic PAC 学习在固定 L* 处的样本复杂度问题，即达到了统计最优风险界（精度到万用常数）。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: AV-AIVAT: 74x Cheaper Agent Evaluation with Certified Anytime-Valid Stopping in Imperfect-Information Games
papers.abstract_en: Deciding which of two agents is stronger means playing games until skill outweighs luck, and every game costs money, model inference, or expert time. Since the number of games needed is unknown, fixed-budget evaluations either keep paying after the result is settled or stop before the agents can be told apart, while naive optional stopping with an ordinary confidence interval invalidates the stated level. We make such an evaluation stop as soon as its evidence suffices, with the guarantee intact. The Action-Informed Value Assessment Tool (AIVAT) reduces variance in imperfect-information games through conditional mean-zero corrections, by a median $54\times$ across 15 LLM agent configurations spanning 71,439 paired Heads-Up No-Limit Hold'em (HUNL) hands, but does not say when to stop. We combine AIVAT with continuously monitored Confidence Sequences (CSs) into anytime-valid AIVAT (AV-AIVAT), whose online value model learns only from past games so that no game scores its own correction. At the nominal 95\% level and a target precision of $\pm1$ Big Blind, raw outcomes need a median $74\times$ as many hands as AIVAT-corrected outcomes to stop under the Asymptotic CS (AsympCS). Exact finite-sample certification uses the Empirical-Bernstein CS (EB-CS), which needs an independently justified bound on corrected payoffs. We establish such a bound structurally for Leduc hold'em and characterize a width floor set by the CS's bet cap and that bound, which governs how much of a variance gain becomes earlier stopping; the descriptive HUNL EB-CS runs show a median $1.37\times$ stopping-time ratio. AV-AIVAT turns variance reduction into efficient, auditable early stopping while separating asymptotic screening from exact certification, so an evaluation can stop the moment its evidence suffices and hand a third party everything needed to recheck the verdict at that very stopping time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AV-AIVAT，将 AIVAT 的方差缩减技术与连续监测的置信序列 (Confidence Sequences) 结合，在不完美信息博弈中实现对两个智能体强弱比较的 anytime-valid 早期停止。在 15 个 LLM agent 配置、共 71,439 手 Heads-Up No-Limit Hold'em (HUNL) 配对对局中，AIVAT 校正带来中位数 54 倍方差缩减；在名义 95% 水平、目标精度 ±1 Big Blind 下，原始结果用 Asymptotic CS (AsympCS) 停止所需手数中位数为 AIVAT 校正结果的 74 倍。EB-CS 提供有限样本精确认证，HUNL 描述性运行显示中位数 1.37 倍停止时间比。
Motivation: 固定预算的博弈评估要么在结果已定后仍继续付费，要么在无法区分两个 agent 时提前停止；而使用普通置信区间的朴素可选停止会破坏所声称的置信水平。因此需要一种在证据充分时立即停止、同时保持统计保证完整的评估方法。
Method: 将 AIVAT (Action-Informed Value Assessment Tool) 的条件均值零校正与持续监测的置信序列结合为 AV-AIVAT；其在线价值模型只从过去对局中学习，避免任何对局对自己的校正计分。方法上分离渐近筛选与精确认证：AsympCS 用于渐近停止，Empirical-Bernstein CS (EB-CS) 用于有限样本精确认证，并对 Leduc hold'em 结构化地建立了校正收益的独立界，同时刻画由 CS 的 bet cap 与该界决定的宽度下限。
Result: 摘要报告 AIVAT 在 15 个 LLM agent 配置、71,439 手 HUNL 配对对局上实现中位数 54 倍方差缩减；在名义 95% 水平和 ±1 Big Blind 目标精度下，原始结果需要中位数 74 倍于 AIVAT 校正结果的手数才能由 AsympCS 触发停止；描述性的 HUNL EB-CS 运行显示中位数 1.37 倍停止时间比。
Conclusion: AV-AIVAT 将方差缩减转化为高效且可审计的早期停止，并分离渐近筛选与精确认证，使评估能在证据充分时立即停止，并向第三方提供在该停止时刻重新核查结论所需的全部信息。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 AV-AIVAT，将 AIVAT 的方差缩减技术与连续监测的置信序列 (Confidence Sequences) 结合，在不完美信息博弈中实现对两个智能体强弱比较的 anytime-valid 早期停止。在 15 个 LLM agent 配置、共 71,439 手 Heads-Up No-Limit Hold'em (HUNL) 配对对局中，AIVAT 校正带来中位数 54 倍方差缩减；在名义 95% 水平、目标精度 ±1 Big Blind 下，原始结果用 Asymptotic CS (AsympCS) 停止所需手数中位数为 AIVAT 校正结果的 74 倍。EB-CS 提供有限样本精确认证，HUNL 描述性运行显示中位数 1.37 倍停止时间比。
summary_sections.motivation: 固定预算的博弈评估要么在结果已定后仍继续付费，要么在无法区分两个 agent 时提前停止；而使用普通置信区间的朴素可选停止会破坏所声称的置信水平。因此需要一种在证据充分时立即停止、同时保持统计保证完整的评估方法。
summary_sections.method: 将 AIVAT (Action-Informed Value Assessment Tool) 的条件均值零校正与持续监测的置信序列结合为 AV-AIVAT；其在线价值模型只从过去对局中学习，避免任何对局对自己的校正计分。方法上分离渐近筛选与精确认证：AsympCS 用于渐近停止，Empirical-Bernstein CS (EB-CS) 用于有限样本精确认证，并对 Leduc hold'em 结构化地建立了校正收益的独立界，同时刻画由 CS 的 bet cap 与该界决定的宽度下限。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 AIVAT 在 15 个 LLM agent 配置、71,439 手 HUNL 配对对局上实现中位数 54 倍方差缩减；在名义 95% 水平和 ±1 Big Blind 目标精度下，原始结果需要中位数 74 倍于 AIVAT 校正结果的手数才能由 AsympCS 触发停止；描述性的 HUNL EB-CS 运行显示中位数 1.37 倍停止时间比。
summary_sections.conclusion: AV-AIVAT 将方差缩减转化为高效且可审计的早期停止，并分离渐近筛选与精确认证，使评估能在证据充分时立即停止，并向第三方提供在该停止时刻重新核查结论所需的全部信息。

papers.title: The Low Frequency Trap: Video Language Models Fail at Simple Event Bookkeeping
papers.abstract_en: Real-world video benchmarks provide broad coverage, but their fixed clips entangle event count, rate, duration, and visual complexity, making failure modes hard to isolate. While existing programmatic benchmarks offer better control, they score only the final answer rather than auditing reported events against executable ground truth. To bridge this gap, we introduce trace-grounded parametric profiling for event counting in three controlled video tasks: bouncing-ball wall contacts, visual blinks, and categorical state transitions. Across 2,190 videos, we vary event count N and frequency F while holding rendering fixed. Each video includes an executable event trace for capability-surface estimation and timestamp-level evaluation. Our results reveal a staged temporal failure. At an 80% reliability threshold, Gemini 3.6 Flash reliably counts persistent state transitions up to 12 events at 0.5 and 1.0 Hz, yet demonstrates no reliable positive-count region for transient blinking events. Thus, event representation dictates whether a model initially accesses evidence -- a limitation that compounds as count and frequency increase. In the high-count, high-frequency regime, only 0.2% of final counts are correct and the model recovers just 18.1% of true events. To test if visual access is the primary bottleneck, we increase sampling rate. Although this boosts Bounce Ball accuracy from 19.6% to 29.3%, the reported sequence agrees with ground truth only 3.7% of the time. Extra frames can therefore inflate final scores without producing faithful event recovery. Different prompting strategies yield similarly limited gains, and real-world video evaluations show the same concentration of success at low event counts. Ultimately, trace-grounded profiling shifts video evaluation from aggregate accuracy metrics to a detailed diagnostic of where temporal reasoning fails.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视频语言模型在事件计数上的失败模式，提出基于可执行事件轨迹的轨迹锚定参数化剖析（trace-grounded parametric profiling），在弹球墙接触、视觉眨眼和类别状态转换三个受控视频任务中系统变化事件数量N与频率F。摘要报告模型存在分阶段的时间失败：状态持久事件在低频率下可计数到12个，而瞬态眨眼事件几乎无可靠计数区域；在高计数高频率时最终计数正确率仅0.2%，事件召回率为18.1%。提高采样率虽能抬高最终得分，但报告序列与真值的一致性仍然很低。
Motivation: 真实世界视频基准的固定片段将事件数量、速率、持续时间和视觉复杂度纠缠在一起，难以隔离失败原因；现有程序化基准只对最终答案打分，不审计模型报告的事件是否与可执行地面真值一致。
Method: 引入轨迹锚定的参数化剖析，在2190个视频中保持渲染固定的同时改变事件数量N和频率F，每个视频附带可执行事件轨迹，用于能力表面估计（capability-surface estimation）和时间戳级评估。
Result: 在80%可靠性阈值下，Gemini 3.6 Flash能可靠计数0.5与1.0 Hz下最多12个持久状态转换事件，但对瞬态眨眼事件没有可靠的正计数区域；高计数高频率下仅0.2%最终计数正确，事件召回率为18.1%。提高采样率将弹球任务准确率从19.6%提升到29.3%，但报告序列与真值只有3.7%一致。
Conclusion: 摘要认为额外帧可以抬高最终分数而不产生忠实的按时间顺序的事件恢复，说明需要从聚合准确率转向细粒度的时间推理诊断；事件表示方式决定了模型能否初始获取证据，且该限制会随计数和频率增加而加剧。

papers.title: Resourced Authority A Mechanism-Design Model for Participatory Governance of Deployed AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: We give a formal mechanism design model for the continuous participatory governance of a deployed AI agent. The mechanism is built on the principle that governance should control an AI agent through resource allocation so as to make authorization self enforcing via compute budgets. The mechanism seeks to establish the Safe AI paradigm that compute is an effective governance lever. We situate our work as a compliance or commons overlay on a deployer. One governance period is an extensive form game in which verified human stakeholders arrive sequentially and contribute, on a provision or a rejection market, in a governance currency that is deliberately distinct from the agents compute. A funding aggregator turns raw contributions into breadth weighted effective supports - a two threshold gate with hysteresis converts net support into a binary authorization that, through a coupling map bounded by an exogenously certified safety ceiling, releases a metered compute budget - realized in hardware as a signed compute license so that the decision is self-enforcing. We characterize the class of agents the mechanism can govern and isolate manipulation of the governing electorate by the governed agent as the central open problem. We also introduce several challenges addressing manipulation of governing electorate by the governed agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为已部署 AI 智能体的持续参与式治理提出一个正式的机制设计模型，核心思想是通过计算预算 (compute budgets) 的资源分配使授权自强制执行，从而落实“计算是有效治理杠杆”的 Safe AI 范式。治理周期被建模为一个扩展形式博弈，经核验的人类利益相关者以独立于智能体计算的治理货币在供给或拒绝市场上顺序贡献，资金聚合器将贡献转化为带广度权重的有效支持度，再经带滞回的双阈值门输出二值授权，并通过受外部认证安全上限约束的耦合映射释放计量计算预算，最终以硬件签名的计算许可证实现自执行。
Motivation: 现有对已部署 AI 智能体的治理缺乏形式化机制，作者希望建立基于资源分配的控制原则，使授权通过计算预算自我强制执行，从而回应 Safe AI 范式中计算作为治理杠杆的可行性问题。
Method: 提出一个合规/公共资源 (commons overlay) 机制：治理周期为序贯到达的验证利益相关者在供给或拒绝市场上用专门治理货币贡献的扩展形式博弈；聚合器计算广度加权有效支持，带滞回的双阈值门将净支持转为二值授权；该授权通过受外生认证安全上限约束的耦合映射释放计量计算预算，并在硬件层面实现为签名计算许可证以保证自执行。
Result: 摘要给出机制可治理的智能体类别刻画，并将“被治理智能体操纵治理选民”识别为核心开放问题，同时提出若干应对该操纵问题的挑战。
Conclusion: 作者将工作定位为部署方之上的合规或公共资源覆盖层，强调计算预算作为授权自执行手段的有效性，并明确指出治理选民被被治理智能体操纵是尚待解决的中心难题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CalibForge: Adversarial Solver Calibration for Scaling Learnable Terminal Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Training terminal agents requires executable and verifiable tasks that are not merely solvable, but appropriately challenging for learning. Executable validation establishes feasibility, yet does not reveal how a task behaves relative to a given solver setting. In this paper, we present CalibForge, an autonomous terminal-task synthesis system that uses verified solver behavior to revise candidate tasks through adversarial solver calibration. Multi-solver calibration targets disagreement within a heterogeneous solver pool, whereas contrastive solver calibration targets a designated strong-pass/weak-fail relation; both operationalize a solver-relative learnable zone anchored in demonstrated solvability. Using CalibForge, we construct 5,431 calibrated terminal tasks. Our ablations show that both strategies yield more effective supervision than authoring and validation alone or ordinary single-solver feedback. Models trained on the full collection achieve 32.58% and 47.57% on Terminal-Bench 2.0. The largest improvements over the corresponding base model reach 24.71 percentage points on Terminal-Bench 2.0, 27.68 points on SWE-bench Pro, and 30.04 points on Doc2Repo. Together, these results support solver-relative learnability as a practical target for constructing effective and transferable agent training data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CalibForge，一个自主的终端任务（terminal task）合成系统，通过对抗性求解器校准（adversarial solver calibration）利用已验证的求解器行为来修订候选任务。多求解器校准针对异构求解器池内的分歧，对比求解器校准针对指定的强过/弱失败（strong-pass/weak-fail）关系；两者都以已证可解性为锚，定义求解器相对的可学习区间（learnable zone）。摘要报告构建了 5,431 个校准终端任务，并用其在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上取得 32.58% 和 47.57% 的结果。
Motivation: 训练终端智能体需要可执行且可验证的任务，不仅要求可解，还要求难度适合学习；可执行验证只能确立可行性，无法揭示任务相对给定求解器设置的行为难度，因此需要一种基于求解器反馈的任务校准机制。
Method: CalibForge 以已验证的求解器行为为反馈来迭代修订候选任务：多求解器校准（multi-solver calibration）最小化异构求解器池内对任务的分歧，对比求解器校准（contrastive solver calibration）构造指定的强过/弱失败关系，二者共同把求解器相对的可学习目标锚定在可解性之上。
Result: 消融实验显示两种校准策略都比仅靠人工编写加验证或普通单求解器反馈提供更有效的监督。基于全量集合训练的模型在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上达到 32.58% 和 47.57%；相对对应基线的最大提升分别为 Terminal-Bench 2.0 提升 24.71 个百分点、SWE-bench Pro 提升 27.68 个百分点、Doc2Repo 提升 30.04 个百分点。
Conclusion: 结果表明求解器相对可学习性（solver-relative learnability）可以作为构造有效且可迁移的智能体训练数据的实用目标。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Challenges in Evaluating Explanation Methods for Static and Evolving Data
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses the limitations of Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) with respect to insufficient evaluation. They are illustrated through the DetoxAI image recognition system for bias detection and concept unlearning. Then, an example of a human-grounded evaluation of methods for explaining image classification is presented. The paper further explores methods for adapting explanations to evolving data streams with concept drift. Experiences with adapting counterfactuals for this problem are discussed. Finally it is related to the challenges of tracking the co-evolution of data, models, and explanations.\footnote{This paper has been accepted for a publication in J.Nalepa (ed) Explainable AI in Space. Proceedings of EASi 2026 Workshop at IJCAI-ECAI 2026 Bremen, Springer CCIS vol 3107 (2016).}
papers.comment: 13 pages, 1 figure = this paper is a preprint of the workshop [Explainable AI in Space] paper for IJCAI ECAI 2026 conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文讨论可解释人工智能（XAI）在评估方面的不足，并以 DetoxAI 图像识别系统在偏差检测与概念遗忘（concept unlearning）中的应用为例进行说明。随后介绍一种对图像分类解释方法进行人类基础评估（human-grounded evaluation）的示例，并探讨在具有概念漂移（concept drift）的演化数据流中适配解释方法（包括反事实解释）的经验，最后关联到数据、模型与解释共同演化（co-evolution）的追踪挑战。
Motivation: XAI 方法普遍缺乏充分的评估，这在静态与演化数据场景下都会削弱可解释方法的可信度，而现有研究对评估方法论本身关注不足。
Method: 通过 DetoxAI 图像识别系统的案例说明 XAI 评估的局限性，给出一个面向图像分类解释的人类基础评估示例，并讨论将反事实解释（counterfactuals）适配到概念漂移数据流的经验，进而提出关注数据、模型与解释共同演化的视角。
Result: 摘要未提供定量实验结果，主要贡献在于分析 XAI 评估的局限、展示人类基础评估的示例，以及分享演化数据流下解释方法适配的实践经验。
Conclusion: 作者强调 XAI 需要更完善的评估方式，并指出在动态数据流中解释方法应随概念漂移而调整，同时应重视数据、模型与解释之间的协同演化。

summary_sections.motivation: XAI 方法普遍缺乏充分的评估，这在静态与演化数据场景下都会削弱可解释方法的可信度，而现有研究对评估方法论本身关注不足。
summary_sections.method: 通过 DetoxAI 图像识别系统的案例说明 XAI 评估的局限性，给出一个面向图像分类解释的人类基础评估示例，并讨论将反事实解释（counterfactuals）适配到概念漂移数据流的经验，进而提出关注数据、模型与解释共同演化的视角。
summary_sections.result: 摘要未提供定量实验结果，主要贡献在于分析 XAI 评估的局限、展示人类基础评估的示例，以及分享演化数据流下解释方法适配的实践经验。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调 XAI 需要更完善的评估方式，并指出在动态数据流中解释方法应随概念漂移而调整，同时应重视数据、模型与解释之间的协同演化。

papers.title: TRAJDEBUG: Tracing Error Lifecycle to Identify Critical Failures in Long-Horizon Agent Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agentic systems have shown remarkable capabilities in complex domains, while suffering from cascading errors and difficulty in debugging. Critical error detection aims to locate the earliest error step in a failed trajectory that is responsible for the final failure. However, progress faces two main challenges. First, long trajectories make it difficult to identify individual errors, since the evidence for judging a step may be scattered across distant instructions, observations, and prior context. Second, failed trajectories often contain multiple local errors with different downstream effects, only some of which remain responsible for the final failure. In this work, we propose TrajDebug, an error-lifecycle tracing framework that addresses long-trajectory error discovery with multi-granularity history compression and evidence-based error identification, and supports critical attribution by tracing each error's resolution status and terminal impact. We further construct TrajErrBench, a benchmark of 486 manually annotated failed trajectories from Tau2Bench and SWE-Bench Pro, covering realistic tool-use and coding scenarios. Experiments across diverse agent benchmarks show that TrajDebug achieves the best overall performance over existing baselines, and application studies further demonstrate that its diagnoses provide actionable feedback for improving downstream agent success. We will release the codes and data to facilitate further research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TrajDebug，一个面向长周期智能体轨迹的错误生命周期追踪框架，用于定位导致最终失败的最早关键错误步骤。作者同时构建了包含 486 条人工标注失败轨迹的 TrajErrBench 基准，覆盖工具使用与代码生成场景，实验表明 TrajDebug 在多个智能体基准上取得最佳综合性能，且其诊断结果能为下游智能体改进提供可操作反馈。
Motivation: 基于 LLM 的智能体系统存在级联错误且难以调试，关键错误检测旨在定位失败轨迹中导致最终失败的最早错误步骤；但长轨迹使得分散的跨步骤证据难以整合，且失败轨迹中多个局部错误的下游影响各异，只有部分错误对最终失败负责。
Method: 提出 TrajDebug 错误生命周期追踪框架，采用多粒度历史压缩 (multi-granularity history compression) 与基于证据的错误识别来处理长轨迹错误发现，并通过追踪每个错误的解析状态与最终影响 (terminal impact) 实现关键归因；另构建 TrajErrBench 基准，包含 486 条来自 Tau2Bench 和 SWE-Bench Pro 的人工标注失败轨迹。
Result: 在多个多样化的智能体基准上，TrajDebug 相比现有基线取得最佳综合性能；应用研究进一步表明其诊断可为改善下游智能体成功率提供可操作反馈。
Conclusion: 作者认为错误生命周期追踪能够有效识别长轨迹中的关键失败，并计划公开代码与数据以促进后续研究。

papers.title: Scalable estimation of VARMA models
papers.abstract_en: Vector autoregressive moving-average (VARMA) models have long been considered impractical beyond moderate dimensions: the likelihood is non-convex, the parametrization is identified only up to equivalence, and every evaluation costs a pass over the entire series. Yet their moving-average term captures with a few parameters what a pure autoregression matches only with many lags. We introduce an estimation framework that removes this computational barrier: each optimization iteration is independent of the series length $T$. The framework combines a partial-autocorrelation reparametrization that guarantees stationarity and invertibility by construction, Gaussian priors on the reparametrized coefficients with separate scales for diagonal and off-diagonal entries, and losses that depend on the data only through fixed-size sufficient statistics, evaluated by a Parseval (Fourier) identity at near-linear cost in the truncation length. This yields two point estimators: a regularized least-squares fit and a covariance-marginalized maximum-a-posteriori estimator. We prove that both recover the infinite-autoregressive representation of the true process at a near-parametric rate in fixed dimension, so the truncation introduces no asymptotic bias. The same machinery extends, at the same leading cost, to seasonal dynamics, exogenous regressors (VARMAX), and rolling-window refits. Empirically, the estimators stay close to the oracle forecast error from $d=10$ to $d=40$ (where classical conditional MLE returns non-invertible fits whose forecasts diverge) and match or beat VAR, Bayesian-VAR, component-wise ARMA, and sparse-VARMA baselines on retail-demand, meteorological, and air-quality data. This brings likelihood-based VARMA estimation, at a per-iteration cost independent of the series length, to the problem sizes where practitioners have so far relied on VAR models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可扩展的 VARMA 模型估计框架，使每次优化迭代的计算量与序列长度 T 无关。框架结合保证平稳性与可逆性的偏自相关重新参数化、对系数分量分尺度的高斯先验，以及仅依赖固定大小充分统计量的损失，并用 Parseval（傅里叶）恒等式在接近线性的截断长度成本下求值。作者给出两种点估计器，并证明它们在固定维度下以近参数速率恢复真实过程的无限自回归表示。实验显示估计器在 d=10 到 d=40 时接近 oracle 预测误差，在多个基准上匹配或超过 VAR、Bayesian-VAR、component-wise ARMA 和 sparse-VARMA。
Motivation: VARMA 模型虽有移动平均项、可用较少参数捕捉纯自回归需要很多滞后才能匹配的动态，但似然非凸、参数化仅在等价类下可识别，且每次评估都需遍历整条序列，导致中等维度以上就难以实用。
Method: 引入偏自相关重新参数化以构造性保证平稳性和可逆性，对重新参数化系数设置对角与非对角分量不同尺度的高斯先验；损失函数仅通过固定大小的充分统计量依赖数据，由 Parseval（傅里叶）恒等式在截断长度上以近线性成本计算。基于此得到正则化最小二乘和协方差边缘化最大后验两种点估计器，并可扩展到季节性、外生回归项（VARMAX）与滚动窗口重估。
Result: 理论上证明两种估计器在固定维度下以近参数速率恢复真实过程的无限自回归表示，截断不引入渐近偏差。经验上，在 d=10 到 d=40 的维数范围内估计器预测误差接近 oracle（经典条件 MLE 此时给出非可逆拟合且预测发散），并在零售需求、气象和空气质量数据上匹配或优于 VAR、Bayesian-VAR、component-wise ARMA 与 sparse-VARMA 基线。
Conclusion: 该框架使基于似然的 VARMA 估计在每次迭代成本与序列长度无关的前提下，扩展到实践者以往只能依赖 VAR 模型的问题规模。摘要强调消除了 VARMA 估计的计算障碍，并展示了广泛的适用性。

papers.title: Optimal Rates for Learning with Monotone Adversaries
papers.abstract_en: A monotone adversary observes an i.i.d. labeled sample and appends a finite number of further examples of its choice, every one of them labeled correctly by the target hypothesis. The learner sees a uniform shuffle of the combined sample and is scored on the original distribution. Every example is correctly labeled, but the insertions depend on the clean sample, so the combined sample is not exchangeable. Larsen, Pabbaraju, and Shetty, who introduced this model, showed that empirical risk minimization attains expected error $O((d/n)\log(n/d))$ for classes of VC dimension $d$, and that every known optimal learner can be pushed away from the $Θ(d/n)$ rate, optimal for PAC learning. They asked whether the extra logarithm is an artifact of those particular algorithms or an inherent consequence of the lack of exchangeability. We show that this additional cost is inherent beyond VC dimension one. In the worst case over classes of VC dimension $d$ and over known finite insertion budgets, the minimax expected error is $Θ(1/n)$ at $d=1$ and $Θ((d/n)\log(n/d))$ for $d\geq 2$. The same rates hold with Littlestone dimension $d_{\mathrm L}$ in place of $d$, so the clean online-to-batch rate $O(d_{\mathrm L}/n)$ is unattainable as well. Thus, somewhat counterintuitively, adding correctly labeled examples can make learning harder by a logarithmic factor, even for classes that admit finite mistake bounds in online learning. The dimension-one upper bound is achieved by a simple improper learner whose analysis adapts the leave-one-out argument underlying the one-inclusion graph. All of our lower bounds are elementary and come from a single construction: an explicit class and prior on which two target hypothesis, which differ a point of nonnegligible mass, produce the same sample.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究带"单调对抗者"(monotone adversary)的分布学习模型：对抗者观察 i.i.d. 标记样本并追加有限个正确标记的自选样本，学习器看到混合样本的均匀洗牌并在原分布上评估。作者证明该模型中额外对数代价是内在的：对 VC 维 d≥2 的类别，最坏情形 minimax 期望误差为 Θ((d/n)log(n/d))，d=1 时为 Θ(1/n)；用 Littlestone 维 d_L 替代 d 时结论同样成立。维度一的上界由一个改编 one-inclusion graph 留一论证的简单 improper learner 实现，所有下界来自一个统一的显式构造。
Motivation: Larsen、Pabbaraju 和 Shetty 引入该模型并证明 ERM 达到 O((d/n)log(n/d))，且所有已知最优学习器都可能被推离 PAC 学习最优的 Θ(d/n) 速率；他们追问多余对数因子是特定算法的假象，还是缺乏可交换性带来的内在后果。本文对此给出否定回答。
Method: 下界来自单一构造：给定一个显式类别与先验，其中两个在非零质量点上不同的目标假设会产生相同的样本，从而证明对抗性插入造成的困难。维度一的上界由一个简单的不当学习器(improper learner)实现，其分析改编自 one-inclusion graph 的留一(leave-one-out)论证。
Result: 在已知有限插入预算的最坏情形下，minimax 期望误差在 d=1 时为 Θ(1/n)，在 d≥2 时为 Θ((d/n)log(n/d))；将 VC 维替换为 Littlestone 维后同样的速率成立，因此干净的在线到批量速率 O(d_L/n) 也不可达。摘要还指出，添加正确标记的样本反而可能使学习难一个对数因子，即使该类别在在线学习中具有有限错误界。
Conclusion: 额外的对数成本是缺乏可交换性的内在后果，而非特定算法的缺陷；这同时排除了在线到批量学习中 O(d_L/n) 速率在该对抗模型下的可达性。摘要未讨论实际应用或实验验证。

papers.title: Tytan: Interactive Neurosymbolic Construction of Analytic Semantic Schemas from Relational Data
papers.abstract_en: From natural-language query interfaces to automated report generation, data analysis tools need a description of the data: the real-world entities it contains, which columns function as measures or identifiers, and how tables connect into units of analysis. Today, this semantic layer is usually written by hand. This is a knowledge-acquisition bottleneck that limits the scalability of analytic systems, keeps non-technical users dependent on experts, and is itself error-prone. We present TYTAN, a system for automatically constructing an analytic semantic schema from a relational database and, when available, a short user-provided description. TYTAN combines symbolic analysis of the database with LLM-based semantic inference for entity proposal, role assignment, and naming. When the evidence leaves a decision ambiguous, TYTAN asks the user a targeted natural-language question. We evaluate TYTAN on eight databases spanning real-world and benchmark domains along the three axes that define a schema's functional utility: (i) coverage, are all important entities and features captured?; (ii) retrieval correctness, do the schema's instructions actually reach the data; and (iii) characterization accuracy, are semantic types correct? Across the seven reference domains, TYTAN reaches every entity, attribute, and aggregable feature of the expert-corrected reference schemas (100% coverage). Additionally, 100% of its retrieval instructions execute correctly (1,678 of 1,678 self-generated claims), and semantic roles agree with the reference on 92-100% of matched attributes. Checking the underlying data showed the small disagreement is in the reference, not in TYTAN. On a held-out blind test (a live, ten-table database with no declared keys), TYTAN recovers the full entity structure with verified keys and satisfies 100% of the satisfiable expectations of five independent blind annotators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TYTAN，一个从关系数据库自动构造分析语义模式 (analytic semantic schema) 的系统。它结合数据库的符号分析与基于 LLM 的语义推断，负责实体提议、角色分配与命名，并在证据不足以决策时向用户提出有针对性的自然语言问题。作者在八个数据库上评估，结果显示覆盖率为 100%、1,678 条自生成检索指令全部正确执行、语义角色与专家参考在匹配属性上 92-100% 一致，并在一个十表活数据库盲测中完整恢复实体结构。
Motivation: 数据管道依赖对数据的语义描述（实体、度量/标识列、表间连接），但这一语义层目前通常由人工编写，造成知识获取瓶颈，限制分析系统的可扩展性、使非技术用户依赖专家，且本身容易出错。
Method: TYTAN 将数据库的结构符号分析与 LLM 语义推断相结合，用于实体提议、角色分配和命名；当证据不足以消除歧义时，系统主动向用户提出目标明确的自然语言问题来补全信息。
Result: 在七个参考领域上，TYTAN 达到专家修正参考模式的全部实体、属性和可聚合特征（100% 覆盖）；1,678 条自生成检索指令全部执行正确；语义角色在匹配属性上与参考一致率为 92-100%。在保留的盲测中，面对一个无声明键的十表活数据库，TYTAN 恢复了完整实体结构并满足五位独立盲注者 100% 的可满足期望。

papers.title: Benchmarking the Benchmarks: Evaluating Benchmarks for Conversational Agents
papers.abstract_en: Task-oriented conversational agents are evaluated using curated or automatically generated benchmarks, yet benchmark quality is rarely assessed. Poor benchmarks may contain inconsistent tasks, simplistic scenarios, or limited policy coverage, leading to unreliable evaluations. We introduce a reference-free framework that uses LLM judges to assess benchmark consistency, complexity, and policy coverage, while providing actionable diagnostics of weaknesses. We validate the framework by demonstrating agreement with independent human annotations and by evaluating benchmarks generated by LLMs of varying capabilities, as well as benchmarks subjected to controlled quality-degrading perturbations. Across domains and judge models, the proposed metrics consistently distinguish between benchmark quality levels. We further demonstrate the framework's applicability to manually curated benchmarks. Our framework offers a practical approach for evaluating synthetic and manually curated conversational-agent benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个无参考 (reference-free) 的评测框架，用 LLM 裁判 (LLM judges) 评估面向任务的对话智能体 (task-oriented conversational agents) 基准测试的质量，包括一致性、复杂度和策略覆盖度，并给出可操作的缺陷诊断。作者通过独立人工标注的吻合度以及对不同能力 LLM 生成的基准和受控质量退化扰动基准的验证，表明该框架能区分基准质量水平。摘要还展示框架适用于人工整理的基准。
Motivation: 标准化的对话智能体基准测试质量很少被评估；低质量基准可能包含不一致任务、过于简化的场景或有限的策略覆盖，导致评测不可靠。
Method: 引入一个无参考框架，使用 LLM 裁判从一致性、复杂度、策略覆盖三个维度评估基准，并提供针对弱点的可操作诊断。
Result: 框架与独立人工标注结果一致，并能跨领域、跨裁判模型区分不同基准质量水平；同时适用于 LLM 生成的和人工整理的基准。
Conclusion: 该框架为评估合成及人工整理的对话智能体基准提供了实用手段。

papers.title: Does FLAIR super-resolution erase or hallucinate small white-matter lesions?
papers.abstract_en: White matter hyperintensities (WMH), bright regions on Fluid-attenuated Inversion Recovery (FLAIR) scans are associated with cerebrovascular pathology and neurodegeneration. FLAIR is usually acquired with thick slices in clinical settings, giving it poor through-plane resolution. Super-resolution (SR) is a widely used method for recovering an isotropic volume from an anisotropic scan. Yet whether applying it prior to WMH segmentation preserves lesion content remains unknown: a model may erase small real lesions or hallucinate absent ones. We used 1-mm isotropic high-resolution (HR) FLAIR scans from 29 individuals in the ADNI cohort, each manually segmented for WMH by an expert. Then, we degraded each to simulated 3 and 5 mm through-plane acquisitions. Multi-contrast implicit neural representation (INR), a single-contrast self-supervised model (ECLARE), and cubic interpolation were used to upsample them onto the HR grid. WMH segmentation from a simulated thick slice and the original HR FLAIR set the floor and ceiling, respectively, for the per-lesion analysis. Of four WMH segmentation methods (WMH-SynthSeg, segcsvd, MARS-WMH, TrUE-Net), we ran the analysis under the most sensitive one to small lesions on HR (MARS-WMH) with the evaluation metrics of detection sensitivity, erasure rate (HR-detected lesions lost after reconstruction), and hallucination rate (predicted components absent from both the manual and HR segmentation). The dominant effect of SR was erasure of small real lesions, not hallucination, and it increased with slice thickness, though every reconstruction still improved lesion detection over the raw thick slice. ECLARE recovered small lesion signal best at both thicknesses, while the INR was no better than cubic interpolation.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the 11th International Workshop on Simulation and Synthesis in Medical Imaging (SASHIMI 2026), held in conjunction with MICCAI 2026. This is the version submitted for review; the final authenticated version will appear in the Springer LNCS proceedings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在 FLAIR 影像上先做超分辨率（super-resolution, SR）再分割白质高信号（WMH）是否会丢失或虚造小病灶。作者利用 ADNI 队列 29 例 1-mm 各向同性高分辨率 FLAIR 及专家分割，模拟 3 mm 和 5 mm 层厚退化，比较多对比隐式神经表示（INR）、单对比自监督模型 ECLARE 和三次插值的重建效果。基于对小结节最敏感的 MARS-WMH 分割，按检测灵敏度、擦除率和幻觉率分析，发现 SR 的主要效应是擦除真实小病灶而非幻觉，且层厚越厚擦除越严重；所有重建仍优于原始厚层切片，ECLARE 表现最好，而 INR 不优于三次插值。
Motivation: 临床 FLAIR 常为厚层采集，面内分辨率差；SR 被广泛用于恢复各向同性体积，但在 WMH 分割前使用 SR 是否会保留病灶内容还不清楚，模型可能擦除小的真实病灶或幻觉出不存在的病灶。
Method: 用 ADNI 中 29 例 1-mm 各向同性高分辨率 FLAIR 和专家 WMH 分割作为参考，将其退化为模拟 3 mm 和 5 mm 厚层采集；再用多对比隐式神经表示（INR）、单对比自监督模型 ECLARE 和三次插值上采样到高分辨率网格。在四种 WMH 分割方法中选择对 HR 小病灶最敏感的 MARS-WMH，以检测灵敏度、擦除率（HR 检出病灶在重建后丢失的比例）和幻觉率（预测成分既不在人工分割也不在 HR 分割中）作为指标进行逐病灶分析。
Result: SR 的主导效应是擦除小的真实病灶而非幻觉，且随切片厚度增加而加重；尽管如此，每种重建都较原始厚层切片改善了病灶检测。ECLARE 在 3 mm 和 5 mm 两种厚度下恢复小病灶信号最好，而 INR 的表现不优于三次插值。
Conclusion: 在 FLAIR 上对厚层数据做超分辨率存在擦除小 WMH 的风险，重建方法的选择会影响病灶保真度；本研究中 ECLARE 是最优恢复小病灶的选择，而 INR 未带来额外增益。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: RRC: Unlocking Generative Reward Models in LLM Reinforcement Learning via Ranking-Based Reward Construction
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in reward modeling show a paradigm shift from discriminative reward models to generative reward models. However, despite their strong capabilities in response ranking, generative reward models have not realized their potential in reinforcement learning (RL). Our analysis reveals that this limitation arises from a mismatch between the comparative nature of generative reward modeling and the scalar scoring paradigm adopted by existing RL algorithms. To bridge this gap, we propose a Ranking-based Reward Construction (RRC) approach, which enables generative reward models to provide more effective RL learning signals by deriving rewards from relative preference rankings. RRC introduces two complementary strategies: self-competitive ranking, which exploits comparisons among sampled responses, and anchor-guided ranking, which enables scalable ranking-based reward construction with a small set of reference responses. Experiments across open-ended chat and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that RRC substantially improves RL training with generative reward models, achieving consistent gains over existing reward construction approaches. Our code can be found at https://github.com/wangclnlp/RRC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Ranking-based Reward Construction (RRC)，用于解决生成式奖励模型 (generative reward model) 在强化学习 (RL) 中学习信号不有效的问题。作者指出，现有 RL 算法采用标量打分范式，与生成式奖励模型的比较性本质不匹配，因此 RRC 从相对偏好排序中构造奖励，包含 self-competitive ranking 和 anchor-guided ranking 两种互补策略。在开放域对话与推理基准上，RRC 相比已有奖励构造方法带来一致提升，代码已开源。
Motivation: 生成式奖励模型虽然在响应排序上能力强，但在 RL 训练中潜力未被释放；原因在于其比较式建模与现有 RL 算法的标量打分范式不匹配。
Method: 提出 RRC，通过从相对偏好排序中派生奖励来提供更有效的 RL 学习信号；具体包含 self-competitive ranking（利用采样响应之间的比较）和 anchor-guided ranking（借助少量参考响应实现可扩展的排序式奖励构造）两种策略。
Result: 在开放域对话和推理基准上的实验表明，RRC 显著改善了使用生成式奖励模型的 RL 训练，并在现有奖励构造方法之上取得一致增益。
Conclusion: 作者认为，通过排序式奖励构造弥补生成式奖励模型与标量打分 RL 之间的差距，可以更好地发挥生成式奖励模型在 RL 中的作用；代码已公开。

papers.title: UQ-Loc: Uncertainty-Aware LiDAR Scene Coordinate Regression
papers.abstract_en: LiDAR-based Scene Coordinate Regression (SCR) maps point clouds directly to 3D scene coordinates, enabling precise 6-DoF localisation without explicit map retrieval. However, existing methods produce deterministic predictions, discarding aleatoric uncertainty that could improve robustness and downstream decision-making. We present UQ-Loc, which extends the LightLoc architecture with an anisotropic Gaussian covariance head that predicts a full 3x3 positive-definite covariance matrix per voxel. Training uses a Negative Log-Likelihood (NLL) loss augmented with a kNN-based spatial smoothness regulariser, while inference employs a modified SC2-PCR solver with uncertainty-weighted seed scoring and a Mahalanobis-distance inlier test. We adopt Expected Calibration Error (ECE) as a principled metric for evaluating the quality of the predicted uncertainty. Experiments demonstrate that UQ-Loc achieves consistent improvement in 6-DoF localization accuracy while producing well-calibrated covariances.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UQ-Loc，在 LightLoc 架构基础上为 LiDAR 场景坐标回归 (SCR) 引入各向异性高斯协方差头，预测每个体素的 3x3 正定协方差矩阵。训练采用负对数似然 (NLL) 损失并附加 kNN 空间平滑正则化，推理使用修改的 SC2-PCR 求解器，配合不确定性加权种子评分与马氏距离 (Mahalanobis) 内点检验。摘要报告该方法在 6-DoF 定位精度上取得一致提升，并产生良好校准的协方差。
Motivation: 现有基于 LiDAR 的 SCR 方法输出确定性预测，丢弃了偶发不确定性 (aleatoric uncertainty)，这限制了系统的鲁棒性以及下游决策能力。
Method: 在 LightLoc 上添加预测每个体素完整 3x3 正定协方差矩阵的高斯协方差头；训练使用 NLL 损失加基于 kNN 的空间平滑正则化；推理采用修改的 SC2-PCR 求解器，包含不确定性加权种子评分和基于马氏距离的内点检验，并以期望校准误差 (ECE) 作为不确定性质量的评估指标。
Result: 实验表明 UQ-Loc 在 6-DoF 定位精度上持续改进，同时产生良好校准的协方差。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过显式建模不确定性并将其用于评分与内点校验，可以同时改善 LiDAR 场景坐标回归的定位精度和不确定性校准质量。

papers.title: Beyond Top-K: Replacing Black-Box Retrieval with Interpretable Agentic Operations
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation over long documents is dominated by one design: chunk the text, embed the chunks, and surface the top-k nearest neighbours of the query. We argue that for an important class of documents -- financial statements, audit reports, regulatory returns -- this design is structurally unsound, and we make the argument measurable. On a 780-page government financial report, 86.8% of content lines are table rows, thousands of near-identical figures compete in one embedding space, and a figure inherits its unit from a header a median of 13 lines above it -- so a chunk boundary routinely separates a number from whether it is in lakh or crore, an error of two orders of magnitude. A table-aware chunker built as a steelman fixes the unit problem but leaves 27-30% of numeric chunks with no fiscal-year header at every chunk size we tried. We propose READ (Reliable Embedding-free Agentic Document-search), in which an agent reads the raw document through three deterministic operations -- normalized lexical search, structural navigation, and bounded span reads -- exposed over the Model Context Protocol, so a trajectory is a replayable audit trail, not an opaque similarity score. On 51 verified questions READ answers 58.8% against dense retrieval's 15.7% (p_Holm = 2 x 10^-5) -- or 35.3% tuned, which READ still leads by 23.5 points (p_Holm = 0.017). An agent given the same loop but a top-k tool reaches only 27.5%, locating the gain in the interface rather than in iteration. We also report what the evidence does not support: BM25 is statistically indistinguishable from READ, so our result separates embedding-based from embedding-free retrieval, not agentic from lexical search.

papers.title: HarnessOpt-Bench: Evaluating LLMs at Harness Optimization
papers.abstract_en: As LLMs are increasingly deployed within agentic systems, their capabilities depend not only on the model weights but also on the harness: the prompts, tools, control flow, memory, and orchestration code surrounding them. This makes automated harness optimization -- the iterative and evaluation-guided improvement of a harness by an AI system -- both an important route to improving AI systems and a demanding capability for AI systems themselves. Yet the community lacks a common protocol for measuring how well frontier LLMs perform at this task. We introduce HarnessOpt-Bench, a benchmark for end-to-end harness optimization under expensive and stochastic evaluation. An optimizer, an LLM paired with a coding harness, receives a target agent's seed harness, graded evaluation feedback, and a fixed target-evaluation budget. It edits the harness and nominates a final candidate, which is scored by its normalized gain over the seed on a held-out test partition that remains inaccessible throughout search. A trusted execution environment enforces the evaluation boundary, meters target-agent resource use, and preserves candidate versions for audit. We evaluate 5 frontier LLMs as optimizers both under a shared coding harness and under their native harnesses across 4 downstream tasks, over 111 scored runs. Experiment results show that optimizer models separate more than the coding harnesses they act through, native harnesses are not consistently superior, and gains vary substantially across tasks and seed regimes. These results establish harness optimization as a measurable and discriminative capability with large space for improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HarnessOpt-Bench，一个用于评估 LLM 在端到端 harness 优化上的基准。该基准设置下，优化器（LLM 与编码 harness 配对）接收目标智能体的种子 harness、分级评估反馈和固定评估预算，反复编辑 harness 并提名最终候选，最终按在保留测试分区上的归一化增益评分。作者在 4 个下游任务上对 5 个前沿 LLM 进行了 111 次评分运行，发现优化器模型之间的能力差异大于其使用的编码 harness 之间的差异，原生 harness 并非一致更优，且增益在不同任务和种子状态下差异显著。
Motivation: LLM 在智能体系统中的表现不仅取决于模型权重，还取决于其周围的 harness（提示、工具、控制流、内存与编排代码），因此自动化 harness 优化是提升 AI 系统的重要途径，但社区缺乏衡量前沿 LLM 在此任务上表现的通用协议。
Method: 引入 HarnessOpt-Bench 基准，规定优化器在固定评估预算内修改目标智能体的 seed harness 并提名最终候选，以归一化增益为评分指标；可信执行环境负责强制评估边界、计量目标智能体的资源使用并保留候选版本以供审计。
Result: 摘要报告在 4 个下游任务、111 次评分运行中，优化器模型之间的区分度高于所依赖的编码 harness，原生 harness 并不始终优于共享 harness，且不同任务与种子状态下的增益差异显著。
Conclusion: 结果表明 harness 优化是一项可测量且具有区分度的能力，但当前前沿 LLM 在此任务上仍有很大改进空间。

papers.title: Bias Analysis of L2 Speaking Assessment Systems Using Concept Activation Vectors
papers.abstract_en: Automatic speaking assessment systems are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings to mark second language (L2) learners' speaking tests, making it critical to show that their scores depend on speaking proficiency rather than irrelevant speaker attributes such as first language (L1) or age. Transformer-based foundation models have improved the accuracy of these L2 speaking graders, but their black-box representations make fairness and interpretability analysis more difficult. Building on prior work that used Concept Activation Vectors (CAVs) to detect bias towards unwanted attributes (`concepts') in feature-based graders, we extend CAV-based analysis to two neural speaking assessment systems: a text-based BERT grader and a speech-and-text multimodal grader based on Whisper. CAVs represent human-interpretable concepts as directions in a model's activation space, allowing us to distinguish between whether a concept is encoded in a model's internal representations and whether it influences the predicted score, the latter quantified using a gradient-based sensitivity metric. Since CAVs rely on linear separability, which is less likely in complex neural embedding spaces, we also investigate whether sparse autoencoders (SAEs) provide cleaner concept directions by learning CAVs in a sparse latent space and mapping them back to activation space. Our analysis shows that concept recoverability depends strongly on the representation and architecture being probed, rather than on the concept alone. Sensitivity to concepts is also architecture-dependent. SAEs make concepts more linearly recoverable, but attenuate the original activation-space sensitivity, especially in low-dimensional layers. These findings highlight the need to distinguish concept recoverability from concept influence when auditing bias in speaking assessment systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文扩展了基于概念激活向量（CAV）的偏差分析方法，用于两个神经L2口语评估系统：基于文本的BERT评分器和基于Whisper的语音-文本多模态评分器。作者区分概念在模型内部表示中被编码与概念影响预测分数（后者用梯度敏感性度量），并考察稀疏自编码器（SAE）能否提供更清晰的概念方向。分析发现概念可恢复性强烈依赖于被探测的表示和架构，且SAE会使概念更线性可恢复但减弱原始激活空间敏感性。
Motivation: 自动口语评估系统被部署在高风险场景中评判第二语言（L2）学习者的测试，必须证明分数取决于口语水平而非第一语言（L1）或年龄等无关属性；但基于Transformer的基础模型是黑盒表征，使公平性和可解释性分析更加困难。
Method: 将先前基于特征评分器的CAV偏差检测扩展到两个神经口语评估系统：文本BERT评分器和基于Whisper的语音-文本多模态评分器。CAV将人类可解释概念表示为激活空间中的方向，并用基于梯度的敏感性度量区分概念是否被编码以及是否影响预测分数；同时尝试在稀疏潜在空间学习CAV并映射回激活空间，即用SAE获取更清晰的概念方向。
Result: 分析显示概念的可恢复性主要取决于被探测的表示和架构，而非概念本身；对概念的敏感性也依赖架构。SAE使概念更线性可恢复，但会衰减原始激活空间中的敏感性，在低维层中尤其明显。
Conclusion: 这些发现强调在审计口语评估系统偏差时，需要区分概念可恢复性（concept recoverability）与概念影响（concept influence），二者并不等价。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On-Policy Self-Distillation without Any Supervision
papers.abstract_en: On-policy (Self-)Distillation (OPD / OPSD) has shown strong potential for post-training large language models (LLMs). However, existing methods still rely heavily on external supervision, including ground-truth signals, environmental feedback, or guidance from larger models, and therefore fall short of genuine "self"-distillation. In this study, we show that on-policy self-distillation can be achieved using only a model's own generations via internal consistency. We propose Unsupervised On-Policy Self-Distillation (U-OPSD). U-OPSD first samples multiple rollouts and constructs a pseudo-solution by majority vote under a self-consistency threshold. It then conditions a teacher distribution on the shortest pseudo-solution and distills it into prefixes of the model's longest incorrect completion, allowing the model to correct itself precisely where it is confidently wrong. Across diverse benchmarks, base models, and training settings, U-OPSD consistently improves over the base models and matches or surpasses supervised methods with ground truth (GT), such as OPSD and GRPO. On AIME24, AIME25, HMMT25, MATH500, and AMC23, U-OPSD improves over the base model by 8.5% and 10.7% on Qwen3 non-thinking mode at the 4B and 8B scales, respectively, and outperforms OPSD by an average of 3.2% and 2.3%. In thinking mode, U-OPSD remains on par with OPSD, outperforming it by 0.9% at 4B and matching it at 8B, while surpassing GRPO by 0.7% and 1.1%, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出无监督在线策略自蒸馏 (Unsupervised On-Policy Self-Distillation, U-OPSD)，仅利用模型自身生成结果和内部一致性实现真正的自蒸馏，无需任何外部监督。方法先采样多条 rollout，在自一致性阈值下通过多数投票构造伪解，再以最短伪解为教师分布，蒸馏到模型最长错误补全的前缀中，使模型在确定出错的位置自我修正。在多个基准、基础模型和训练设置下，U-OPSD 一致优于基础模型，并匹配或超越使用 ground truth 的监督方法如 OPSD 和 GRPO。
Motivation: 现有在线策略自蒸馏 (OPD/OPSD) 在 LLM 后训练中虽有潜力，但依赖外部监督信号，包括 ground-truth、环境反馈或更大模型的指导，因而并非真正的“自”蒸馏。
Method: U-OPSD 先采样多个 rollout，并在自一致性阈值下用多数投票构造伪解；随后把教师分布建立在最短伪解上，将其蒸馏到模型生成的最长错误补全的前缀中，使模型仅凭自身输出进行精确的自我纠正。
Result: 在 AIME24、AIME25、HMMT25、MATH500 和 AMC23 上，U-OPSD 相比基础模型在 Qwen3 non-thinking 模式下 4B 和 8B 规模分别提升 8.5% 和 10.7%，平均超过 OPSD 3.2% 和 2.3%；thinking 模式下与 OPSD 持平（4B 高 0.9%，8B 持平），并分别超过 GRPO 0.7% 和 1.1%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，仅依靠模型自身生成和内部一致性即可实现有效的在线策略自蒸馏，且能匹配或超越使用 ground truth 的监督后训练方法。

papers.title: QuanTiMedAI: Quantum-Enhanced Time-Series Model guided by Agentic AI for Cardiac Arrest Mortality Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Cardiac arrest remains one of the most lethal conditions encountered in intensive care units. Despite the growing availability of electronic health record data, existing mortality prediction studies in this population largely depend on static summaries derived from early admission. Such approaches ignore the temporal progression of physiological deterioration and recovery that unfolds throughout a patient's ICU stay. To address this limitation, we introduce QuanTiMedAI, a quantum-agentic framework developed for cardiac arrest mortality prediction using agentic AI guided quantum enhancement time series model. The proposed system combines an agentic large language model (LLM) for clinically informed feature discovery with a compact quantum recurrent network for temporality aware mortality prediction. Our findings demonstrate that agentic LLM-guided feature selection consistently outperforms conventional feature selection approaches, and the proposed quantum architecture achieves competitive predictive performance through nonlinear feature enhancement while keeping the number of parameters very low. Through extensive experimentation on a MIMIC-IV cohort of cardiac arrest patients, QuanTiMedAI's quantum-enhanced architecture attains an AUROC of 0.852 using only 605 parameters, an improvement of approximately 2.9\% over a current state-of-the-art baseline for this task. A structured ablation study systematically validates the contribution of each architectural design choice. These results show that quantum-enhanced sequential modeling can exceed classical recurrent networks while using substantially fewer parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QuanTiMedAI，一个面向心脏骤停死亡预测的量子-智能体框架，将用于临床特征发现的智能体大语言模型（LLM）与紧凑型量子循环网络相结合，进行时间感知的死亡率预测。在 MIMIC-IV 心脏骤停患者队列上，该方法以仅 605 个参数取得 0.852 的 AUROC，比当前最先进基线提升约 2.9%，并通过结构化消融实验验证了各设计选择的贡献。
Motivation: 现有针对 ICU 心脏骤停患者的死亡预测研究大多依赖入院早期的静态摘要，忽略了整个 ICU 住院期间生理恶化与恢复的时间进程，因此需要能刻画时序演变的建模方法。
Method: 提出量子-智能体框架：用智能体 LLM 进行临床相关的特征发现，再用紧凑的量子循环网络（quantum recurrent network）对时间序列做死亡率预测，通过非线性特征增强在极低参数规模下实现预测。
Result: 在 MIMIC-IV 心脏骤停患者队列上取得 AUROC 0.852，仅用 605 个参数，较当前最先进基线提升约 2.9%；智能体 LLM 引导的特征选择一致优于传统特征选择方法。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，量子增强的序列建模能够以显著更少的参数超越经典循环网络，作者通过结构化消融实验验证了各架构组件的贡献。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: BaKron: Efficient Quantization with Kronecker-Factored Hessians
papers.abstract_en: We accelerate a family of algorithms for neural network quantization whose geometry is informed by any Kronecker-factored approximation of the Hessian. GPTQ-style adaptive rounding typically uses one-sided information derived from input activations. Two-sided Kronecker-factored Hessian approximations can additionally capture correlations across output coordinates, but applying GPTQ directly in the vectorized weight domain is computationally expensive. Building on the two-sided adaptive-rounding formulation used by BoA and YAQA, we introduce BaKron, an efficient solver that combines anti-diagonal parallelism with a recursive divide-and-conquer construction. For an $m\times n$ weight matrix, BaKron uses $O(m+n)$ sequential steps while reducing the total work from $O(m^2n^2)$ to $O(mn(m+n))$. Thus, it matches the cubic scaling of GPTQ while exploiting richer curvature information. Moreover, BaKron is modular with respect to both the base quantizer and the Hessian estimator. We also provide practical benchmarks, consider a range of Hessians that BaKron can be called with, find an efficient technique to compute these Hessians, and evaluate the algorithm experimentally.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BaKron，一种面向神经网络量化的高效求解器，其几何信息由任意 Kronecker-factored Hessian 近似提供。BaKron 建立在 BoA 和 YAQA 使用的双侧自适应舍入 (two-sided adaptive rounding) 基础上，结合反对角并行与递归分治构造，对 m×n 权重矩阵将总工作量从 O(m^2n^2) 降至 O(mn(m+n))，同时保持 O(m+n) 的串行步数，从而匹配 GPTQ 的三次方规模并利用更丰富的曲率信息。
Motivation: GPTQ 风格的自适应舍入通常只利用输入激活导出的单侧信息，难以捕捉输出坐标之间的相关性；尽管双侧 Kronecker-factored Hessian 近似可以补充这类信息，但在向量化权重域直接应用 GPTQ 计算代价过高。
Method: BaKron 是一个高效求解器，结合抗反对角并行 (anti-diagonal parallelism) 与递归分治构造，在双侧自适应舍入框架下求解量化问题；它同时对基础量化器和 Hessian 估计器保持模块化，并支持多种可调用的 Hessian。
Result: 摘要报告了实用基准测试，考察了 BaKron 可搭配的一系列 Hessian，找到了一种高效计算这些 Hessian 的技术，并进行了实验评估；摘要未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为 BaKron 在利用更丰富的双侧曲率信息的同时，实现了与 GPTQ 相当的立方级计算规模，并且模块化设计便于替换基础量化器与 Hessian 估计器。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Learning Latent Memory States from Longitudinal Athlete Monitoring Data
papers.abstract_en: We propose a new unit of analysis for longitudinal data: the Latent Memory Table. The scientific contribution is not the encoder. It is that table, treated as a reusable statistical object on the same footing as a matrix of principal-component scores, a table of estimated random effects, or a table of predicted probabilities. We estimate a statistical table that summarizes recent longitudinal history and is intended to be stored, queried, analysed and reused throughout the statistical workflow. A memory operator maps each masked windowed history to a finite-dimensional state; collecting those states with uncertainty yields the Latent Memory Table. Validation is organized around six properties---recoverability, personalization, temporal coherence, interpretability, stability and reusability---summarized by a composite quality index \(Q\); the Transformer, the SoccerMon case study and the simulations exist to argue that this table deserves that status. Classical exponentially weighted moving averages and related short- and long-horizon scalar summaries arise as restricted, typically univariate special cases of the same operator class. A simulation study with known memory mechanisms shows that \(Q\) and rotation-invariant recovery scores discriminate genuine multivariate or personalized memory from negative controls and from misspecified windows, whereas regime classification accuracy alone does not. SoccerMon serves as an empirical case study: a constructed Latent Memory Table attains \(Q\approx 0.73\) versus about \(0.40\) for classical and lagged principal-component baselines, with incremental held-out value for some wellness targets and Procrustes ensembles for row-wise reliability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对纵向监测数据提出一种新的分析单元——潜在记忆表 (Latent Memory Table)，将其视为与主成分得分、随机效应表或预测概率表同级的可复用统计对象。作者设计一个记忆算子 (memory operator) 将带掩码的窗口化历史映射为有限维状态，并连同不确定性收集成表；验证围绕六个性质并汇总为复合质量指标 Q。模拟研究与 SoccerMon 案例研究支持该表作为标准统计对象的地位。
Motivation: 纵向数据中观测历史的压缩与复用缺乏统一且可重用的统计表达；作者希望得到一个可存储、查询、分析并在整个统计工作流中反复使用的表格化摘要，而不只依赖某个具体的编码器。
Method: 提出通过学习记忆算子将每个带掩码的窗口化历史映射到有限维潜在状态，收集各状态及其不确定性构成 Latent Memory Table；用 Transformer 实现，并围绕可恢复性、个性化、时间一致性、可解释性、稳定性和可重用性六个性质构造复合质量指标 Q。
Result: 模拟实验表明 Q 与旋转不变恢复指标能区分真实的多变量或个性化记忆与负对照及错误窗口，而仅靠 regime 分类精度无法区分；SoccerMon 案例中构造的表的 Q≈0.73，高于经典与滞后主成分基线的约 0.40，并对部分 wellness 目标具有增量留出价值。
Conclusion: 经典指数加权移动平均及相关的短长期标量摘要只是该算子类的受限（通常单变量）特例；作者主张该表应获得与主成分得分等类似的标准统计对象地位，并强调单纯的 regime 分类精度不足以验证记忆结构。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Surv-IPTB: An Attention-Based Model for Estimating Individual Probability of Treatment Benefit with Survival Data
papers.abstract_en: This work presents a novel attention-based framework for estimating the Individual Probability of Treatment Benefit (IPTB) in survival analysis contexts. The proposed model, called Surv-IPTB, directly quantifies the probability that a specific patient will experience extended survival time under treatment versus control. We reformulate IPTB estimation as a binary classification problem, leveraging pairwise patient comparisons across treatment and control cohorts. The framework incorporates a principled handling of right-censored observations through imprecise probability representations, where uncertain treatment effects are characterized by interval-valued probabilities. An attention mechanism with learnable query-key transformations enables flexible, data-driven aggregation of pairwise comparisons, while simultaneously learning soft class probabilities for censored cases. Through extensive experiments on synthetic datasets with complex nonlinear structures, including spiral, bell-shaped, and circular feature spaces, we demonstrate that our approach maintains robust performance across varying censoring rates and treatment effect strengths. The model consistently outperforms meta-learner baselines (T-learner and S-learner) equipped with random survival forests, Cox proportional hazards, and Beran estimators, particularly in challenging nonlinear scenarios where conventional methods exhibit significant degradation. The results establish the proposed attention-based framework as a scalable and statistically principled solution for personalized treatment benefit assessment in survival settings. The code implementing the model is publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出注意力框架 Surv-IPTB，用于在生存分析中估计个体治疗获益概率（IPTB），即患者接受治疗相比对照获得更长生存期的概率。方法将 IPTB 估计重构为二分类问题，利用治疗组与对照组患者的配对比较，并通过不精确概率表示处理右删失观测。在螺旋、钟形、圆形等非线性合成数据集上，模型在不同删失率和治疗效果强度下保持稳健，且优于配备随机生存森林、Cox 比例风险与 Beran 估计器的元学习基线。代码已公开。
Motivation: 现有治疗获益估计方法在复杂非线性生存数据场景下性能明显退化，且对右删失观测的处理缺乏原则性；需要一种能直接量化个体层面治疗获益概率的稳健框架。
Method: 将 IPTB 估计重述为配对患者间的二分类问题，用区间值概率的不精确表示刻画不确定的治疗效应以处理右删失；引入带可学习查询-键变换的注意力机制，以数据驱动方式聚合配对比较，同时为删失样本学习软类别概率。
Result: 在含螺旋、钟形和圆形特征空间的合成数据集上，Surv-IPTB 在不同删失率和治疗效果强度下保持稳健性能，并在挑战性非线性场景中一致优于 T-learner 与 S-learner 基线，后者配备随机生存森林、Cox 比例风险及 Beran 估计器。
Conclusion: 作者认为该注意力框架是生存设置下个性化治疗获益评估的可扩展且统计原理合理的解决方案，并公开实现代码。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The Tamed Subgradient Unadjusted Langevin Algorithm beyond Convexity
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of sampling from target distributions whose potentials are simultaneously non-smooth, subject to superlinear gradient growth, and non-convex. We introduce the Subgradient Tamed Unadjusted Langevin Algorithm (SG-TULA), a discretisation of the Langevin diffusion that operates directly on subgradients, without relying on computationally demanding smoothing procedures. To handle the superlinear regime, taming techniques are employed to produce a stable, explicit scheme. We derive non-asymptotic convergence bounds in Wasserstein-2 distance, with all constants tracked explicitly in terms of dimension and inverse temperature, improving upon the currently known rates for subgradient-based Langevin algorithms. We further provide excess risk estimates for the associated optimisation problem. We verify the assumptions, with explicit constants, for the regularized pretraining potential of a LLM in the GPT-2 lineage and the boosted coordinate-wise variant of SG-TULA pretrains the former competitively against finetuned AdamW and Muon, for which no comparable non-asymptotic guarantees are presently available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Subgradient Tamed Unadjusted Langevin Algorithm (SG-TULA)，用于从势函数同时具有非光滑、超线性梯度增长和非凸性的目标分布中采样。算法直接在次梯度上运行并采用 taming 技巧，无需计算昂贵的平滑步骤；作者给出 Wasserstein-2 距离下的非渐近收敛界，所有常数显式依赖维度和逆温度，并改进现有基于次梯度的 Langevin 算法速率。文章还在 GPT-2 谱系的 LLM 正则化预训练势上验证假设，其 boosted 坐标式变体在预训练中与微调后的 AdamW 和 Muon 竞争。
Motivation: 现有基于次梯度的 Langevin 采样算法在同时处理非光滑、超线性梯度增长与非凸势函数时缺少令人满意的非渐近理论保证，而常用的平滑化预处理计算代价高。
Method: 引入 SG-TULA：一种直接作用于次梯度的 Langevin 扩散离散化，采用 taming 技术构造稳定的显式格式以处理超线性增长；另提出 boosted 坐标式变体用于大规模预训练。
Result: 摘要报告得到 Wasserstein-2 距离下的非渐近收敛界，常数显式跟踪维度和逆温度，改进已知的次梯度 Langevin 算法速率；还给出相应优化问题的 excess risk 估计，并在 GPT-2 谱系 LLM 预训练任务上与 AdamW 和 Muon 进行了竞争性比较。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法的假设可在实际 LLM 正则化预训练势上以显式常数验证，且其变体无需 AdamW/Muon 目前尚缺的非渐近保证即可取得竞争性能；论文属采样与优化理论范畴。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告得到 Wasserstein-2 距离下的非渐近收敛界，常数显式跟踪维度和逆温度，改进已知的次梯度 Langevin 算法速率；还给出相应优化问题的 excess risk 估计，并在 GPT-2 谱系 LLM 预训练任务上与 AdamW 和 Muon 进行了竞争性比较。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调该方法的假设可在实际 LLM 正则化预训练势上以显式常数验证，且其变体无需 AdamW/Muon 目前尚缺的非渐近保证即可取得竞争性能；论文属采样与优化理论范畴。

papers.title: Stochastic Dynamics on Persistence Diagram Space via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Persistence diagrams (PDs) provide stable and interpretable summaries of multiscale topological structure. While substantial progress has been made in the statistical analysis of PDs, existing literature often treats diagrams as static objects and provide limited frameworks for probabilistic modeling and stochastic evolution on PD space. We introduce a reinforcement learning framework for stochastic dynamics on PD space, where diagrams evolve through topology aware local edit operations. The dynamics define controlled Markov processes on spaces of finite PDs with variable cardinality. We establish conditions under which the induced Markov chains are irreducible, aperiodic, and geometrically ergodic, implying the existence of unique stationary probability laws on PD space. To guide the dynamics toward scientifically relevant topological targets, we formulate objectives that encompass distribution matching, task specific topological statistics, and structure-preserving compression. The resulting rewards balance task specific distributional targets, diagram fidelity, and complexity reduction, and yield a framework for adaptive topological simplification and probabilistic modeling. Experiments on synthetic and neuroimaging PDs demonstrate that the proposed framework can preserve dominant topological structure while reducing diagram complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用强化学习 (reinforcement learning) 在持久图 (persistence diagram, PD) 空间上构建随机动力学，通过拓扑感知的局部编辑操作让图在变基数有限 PD 空间上演化，形成受控马尔可夫过程。作者证明在特定条件下这些马尔可夫链不可约、非周期且几何遍历，从而在 PD 空间上存在唯一平稳概率测度；目标函数综合分布匹配、任务相关拓扑统计与结构保持压缩，用于自适应拓扑简化与概率建模。在合成和神经影像 PD 上的实验表明，该方法能在降低图复杂度的同时保留主要拓扑结构。
Motivation: 现有持久图统计分析大多把图视为静态对象，缺乏对 PD 空间上概率建模与随机演化的统一框架。
Method: 提出强化学习框架，定义 PD 空间上带可变基数 (variable cardinality) 的控制马尔可夫过程；奖励函数平衡任务特定分布目标、图保真度与复杂度缩减。
Result: 摘要报告在合成和神经影像 PD 实验中，该方法能保留主导拓扑结构并降低图复杂度；同时建立马尔可夫链不可约、非周期和几何遍历的条件。
Conclusion: 该框架为自适应拓扑简化与概率建模提供了途径，但摘要并未报告与天气或降水等具体应用的关系。

papers.title: TLNM: Externally Validated Tooth Detection, Numbering and Segmentation from Smartphone Photographs Using Mask R-CNN
papers.abstract_en: Oral health issues affect billions globally, but the cost and limited access to professional dental care hinder preventive oral healthcare. Research relies on clinical-grade radiographs or intraoral camera images, unavailable for public self-screening. This study introduces a tooth localisation and numbering model for smartphone photographs. We developed a customised Mask Region-based Convolutional Neural Network (Mask R-CNN) pipeline trained on 1,272 annotated smartphone images. To address variability in patient-generated health data, the pipeline incorporates two domain-informed mechanisms: a masked gray-world white-balancing algorithm to mitigate artificial colour casts and an anatomically constrained detection layer to enforce structural validity and suppress false positives. Evaluation comprised four stages: internal held-out testing, independent external testing, a descriptive ablation study, and fold-based training stability analysis using the same internal test set. On the internal test set, the model achieved an instance-mask AP@50 of 0.818, class-aware PQ of 0.780, and operational F1 of 0.884. Training stability showed limited between-model variation: across ten runs, instance-mask AP@50 had a standard deviation of 0.009. On the external dataset, the model achieved an instance-mask AP@50 of 0.901, class-aware PQ of 0.832, and operational F1 of 0.928 despite differences in population, sensors, and acquisition protocols. The inference pipeline is available as an open-source, containerised API. These results demonstrate that consumer-grade smartphone imagery can support automated tooth-level anatomical mapping, offering a scalable, potentially low-cost foundation for remote screening and tele-dentistry in resource-constrained environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于 Mask R-CNN 的牙齿定位与编号模型，用于从智能手机照片中自动检测、编号并分割牙齿。模型在 1,272 张标注的智能手机图像上训练，并引入 masked gray-world 白平衡与解剖约束检测层来处理患者生成数据的差异。内部测试集上 instance-mask AP@50 为 0.818、class-aware PQ 为 0.780、operational F1 为 0.884；外部数据集上分别达到 0.901、0.832 与 0.928，且十次运行的稳定性标准差仅 0.009。
Motivation: 口腔健康问题影响全球数十亿人，但专业牙科护理的成本和可及性限制了预防性口腔保健；现有研究依赖临床级放射影像或口内相机图像，公众无法用于自我筛查。
Method: 开发了定制的 Mask R-CNN 管道，在 1,272 张标注智能手机图像上训练，并加入两个领域信息机制：masked gray-world 白平衡算法以缓解人工色偏，以及解剖约束检测层以强制结构有效性并抑制假阳性。
Result: 内部测试集上 instance-mask AP@50 为 0.818、class-aware PQ 为 0.780、operational F1 为 0.884；十次运行中 instance-mask AP@50 标准差为 0.009。外部数据集上 instance-mask AP@50 达到 0.901、class-aware PQ 为 0.832、operational F1 为 0.928，尽管外部数据在人群、传感器和采集协议上存在差异。
Conclusion: 摘要认为消费级智能手机图像可以支持自动牙齿级解剖映射，为资源受限环境中的远程筛查和远程牙科提供可扩展且潜在低成本的方案；推理管道以开源、容器化 API 形式提供。

papers.title: The Illusion of Visual Tool-Use: A Causal Audit of Thinking with Images
papers.abstract_en: The "thinking-with-images" paradigm equips multimodal LLMs with active visual operations such as crop-and-zoom. However, models using these operations often achieve only marginal or negative gains over direct inference at substantially higher token cost. They may also repeatedly crop irrelevant regions and fail on questions that direct inference answers correctly. We ask whether the returned visual evidence causally affects the answer. To answer this question, we formulate visual tool-use as a causal graph that separates observation-mediated paths from action-induced shortcuts. We then audit it through interventions at the three levels: policy (comparing tool-use with direct inference), trajectory (corrupting all observations during rollout), and step (counterfactually replacing one individual observation under a fixed prefix). Our step-level estimand, Visual Evidence Gain, isolates the contribution of each returned observation. Across six representative models and five fine-grained perception benchmarks, we uncover policy miscalibration with two failure modes. In Calling Without Looking, returned observations have no causal effect on the answer. In Looking Without Planning, observations are informative but the call schedule is incoherent. A trajectory-level diagnostic decomposes the policy-level accuracy gain and shows that the gain is concentrated in a Calibrated minority. We term this discrepancy the illusion of visual tool-use: despite aggregate accuracy gains, visual tool-use is not causally effective across a broad range of rollouts. The code is available at https://github.com/OpenCausaLab/CauAudit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对多模态大模型（multimodal LLM）的“用图像思考”（thinking-with-images）视觉工具使用范式（如 crop-and-zoom）进行因果审计。作者将视觉工具使用建模为因果图，区分观察介导路径与动作引起的捷径，并在策略、轨迹、步骤三个层级实施干预，提出步骤级估计量 Visual Evidence Gain 来隔离每个返回观察的贡献。在六个代表性模型和五个细粒度感知基准上，作者发现工具操作带来的准确率增益并不对应因果有效性，并将这种不一致称为“视觉工具使用的幻觉”（the illusion of visual tool-use）。
Motivation: 现有视觉工具操作（如裁剪放大）相比直接推理往往只有边际或负增益，却显著增加 token 成本；模型还可能反复裁剪无关区域，并对直接推理本可正确回答的问题失败。因此需要回答一个核心问题：返回的视觉证据是否真正因果地影响答案。
Method: 将视觉工具使用形式化为因果图，分离观察介导路径（observation-mediated paths）与动作诱导捷径（action-induced shortcuts）；在三个层级进行干预审计：策略层（比较工具使用与直接推理）、轨迹层（在 rollout 中破坏所有观察）、步骤层（在固定前缀下反事实替换单个观察）。步骤层估计量 Visual Evidence Gain 用于隔离每个返回观察的因果贡献，并辅以轨迹级诊断来分解策略级准确率增益。
Result: 在六个代表性模型和五个细粒度感知基准上，摘要报告发现了策略校准不当（policy miscalibration）及两种失败模式：Calling Without Looking（返回观察对答案没有因果效应）和 Looking Without Planning（观察有信息但调用调度不连贯）。轨迹级诊断显示策略级准确率增益集中在少数“校准”（Calibrated）子集中，说明聚合增益掩盖了因果有效性的缺乏。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，尽管视觉工具使用在聚合指标上显示出准确率提升，但在广泛的 rollout 中其并非因果有效；这种“幻觉”意味着聚合增益不足以证明工具调用的实际价值。代码已开源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Improving the Realism of Synthetic Clinical Benchmarks Under Utility Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic clinical benchmarks for enterprise AI agents can pass existing utility checks and still remain structurally unrealistic, especially in privacy-sensitive healthcare settings where operational data are hard to access. We study how to improve such benchmarks without breaking the downstream utility checks already used in practice. We formulate benchmark revision as utility-constrained realism improvement: dataset changes should increase realism while staying above an operational utility floor. We instantiate this idea on a care-gap benchmark derived from Synthea-generated patients exercised through demonstration electronic health record workflows and then processed by the same downstream pipeline as operational data. Realism is measured through missingness structure, simplicity, structural plausibility, and population alignment. The baseline benchmark is extremely thin: sampled-pair missingness is 79.44%, only 12.75% of rows are actionable, 38.94% of patients have zero actionable measures, and top-three token concentration reaches 100.0%. Two deterministic revisions improve these panels while remaining above the current utility floor, whereas a naive densification control preserves unrealistic templating. We further show that internal benchmark realism and source fidelity to an aggregate operational reference are related but distinct objectives. These results suggest that synthetic benchmark quality should be optimized explicitly, with utility treated as one constraint rather than as sufficient evidence of realism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对企业 AI 代理的合成临床基准 (synthetic clinical benchmarks) 提出在保持既有下游效用检查不被破坏的前提下提升结构真实性的问题。作者将基准修订形式化为效用约束下的真实性改进 (utility-constrained realism improvement)，并在一个基于 Synthea 生成患者、经过演示电子健康记录工作流处理的 care-gap 基准上实现。基线基准非常单薄，而两种确定性修订能在高于当前效用下限的同时改善多个真实性指标，对照组则保留了不切实际的模板化。
Motivation: 合成临床基准可能通过现有的效用检查却仍缺乏结构真实性，尤其在隐私敏感的医疗场景中因难以访问真实运营数据而更突出；目标是改进真实性而不破坏实践中已有的下游效用检查。
Method: 将基准修订建模为效用约束下的真实性改进：数据集修改应提升真实性且保持在运营效用下限之上。真实性通过缺失结构 (missingness structure)、简洁性、结构合理性与人群对齐 (population alignment) 衡量，并用两种确定性修订与朴素的致密化 (densification) 对照进行验证。
Result: 基线中采样对缺失率为 79.44%，仅 12.75% 的行可操作，38.94% 的患者零可操作指标，前三 token 集中度达 100.0%。两种确定性修订改善了这些面板并保持在当前效用下限之上，而朴素致密化控制仍保留了不真实的模板化；内部真实性与对聚合运营参照的源保真度是相关但不同的目标。
Conclusion: 合成基准质量应被显式优化，效用应被视为一个约束而非真实性的充分证据。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: OTLesMix: Wasserstein Barycenter and Optimal Transport Map for Synthetic Lesion Generation with Diverse Shapes and Locations
papers.abstract_en: The development of deep learning over the past decade has revolutionized medical imaging segmentation, allowing the extraction of precise descriptors from large volumes to characterize pathologies. Data augmentation is a technique widely regarded as a way to improve model training. It includes simple transformations like spatial operations or intensity modifications, but also more advanced synthesis techniques. Their goal is to generate new realistic samples from an existing dataset to diversify the images used during training. Among them, several propose different mixing strategies to combine real samples. However, one of their major shortcomings is to yield limited variability in terms of generated lesion shapes and locations. In this work, we introduce a novel image synthesis method, called OTLesMix, that leverages Wasserstein barycenter and optimal transport plan to generate realistic and diverse samples. We evaluated our method on three brain lesion segmentation tasks, on which it improves the Dice score compared to a model trained without synthetic data by 2.9 to 6.6 points, and outperforms state-of-the-art mix-based methods.

papers.title: Hypothesis Testing with Conditional Queries: Learnability and the Value of Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Model evaluations may fix all tests before observing any responses or select later tests using earlier responses. We study this choice in a conditional-query model on a finite outcome space $\mathcal{X}$ with $|\mathcal{X}|=N$. We first ask which pairs of distribution classes can be reliably distinguished. We then ask how many additional queries are required to match an adaptive tester when all queried events must be fixed in advance. We show that learnability holds if and only if the two classes have positive separation in their pairwise conditional probabilities. When this separation is zero, the optimal worst-case error is exactly $1/2$ at every finite query budget. For any $T$-query adaptive policy and any $ρ\in (0,1)$, we construct a randomized non-adaptive procedure using $O(N^2(T + \log(1/ρ)))$ pair queries chosen before any response is observed. Its simulated transcript is within $ρ$ in total variation of the adaptive transcript, uniformly over all distributions in the model. We also construct a matching family with constant adaptive query complexity and $Ω_\varepsilon(N^2)$ non-adaptive query complexity. Consequently, the worst-case fixed-error adaptivity gap is $Θ_\varepsilon(N^2)$. Thus interaction can reduce the required number of tests by a quadratic factor, but the apparent exponential branching of an interactive evaluation does not yield an exponential query advantage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究有穷结果空间上的条件查询模型，比较固定测试集与根据先前响应选择后续测试这两种评估方式。摘要证明两类分布可被可靠区分当且仅当它们在成对条件概率上存在正分离；若分离为零，则任意有限查询预算下最优最坏情形误差恰为 1/2。对任意 T-查询自适应策略，作者构造了一个随机非自适应过程，仅需 O(N^2(T + log(1/ρ))) 对预先固定的查询即可使模拟转录在总变差距离上以 ρ 接近自适应转录。并构造匹配族说明自适应查询复杂度为常数而非自适应为 Ω_ε(N^2)，从而最坏情形固定误差自适应间隙为 Θ_ε(N^2)。
Motivation: 模型评估面临一个基本选择：在观察任何响应之前固定全部测试，还是利用早期响应来选择后续测试。论文希望刻画这一选择对分布类可区分性的影响，并量化自适应查询相对非自适应查询所需的额外查询量。
Method: 在有限结果空间的条件查询模型中，作者先给出可学习性判据：两类分布可区分当且仅当其成对条件概率具有正分离。随后针对任意 T-查询自适应策略，构造随机非自适应过程，使用 O(N^2(T + log(1/ρ))) 对提前固定的查询，使其转录在总变差距离内近似自适应转录；同时构造匹配的分布族以证明下界。
Result: 摘要证明当条件概率分离为零时，任意有限查询预算下的最优最坏情形误差恰好为 1/2。非自适应过程可用 N^2 因子模拟任何自适应策略，且存在自适应查询复杂度为常数、非自适应复杂度为 Ω_ε(N^2) 的匹配族，因此固定误差下的自适应间隙为 Θ_ε(N^2)。
Conclusion: 交互式评估的指数级分支并不会带来指数级查询优势；自适应查询相对于固定查询的最坏情形收益最多是二次因子。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RxnCLF: Contrastive Transformation-Aware Reaction Foundation Model for Improved Reactivity Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Reaction yield prediction remains challenging because labeled data are scarce and reaction space is both combinatorially large and sparsely populated, limiting the generalization of existing reaction representations. String-, fingerprint-, and graph-based reaction encodings only partially capture chemical transformations, making accurate prediction difficult for reactions with complex substrates. We propose reaction contrastive learning foundation (RxnCLF), a self-supervised contrastive framework for reaction representation learning. RxnCLF is built on a condensed reaction graph (CRG) that unifies reactant and product information into a single graph, enabling the model to learn explicit and enriched transformation structure rather than disconnected graphs. Pretrained on 1.7 million Pistachio reactions, RxnCLF learns a compact and continuous latent space that captures both reaction-center features and broader side chain contexts, making it transformation-aware and chemically interpretable. Fine-tuned on multiple yield prediction benchmarks, including Buchwald-Hartwig, Pd-catalyzed BH coupling, and proprietary HTE C-N coupling and amide formation datasets, RxnCLF consistently outperforms graph and sequence-based baselines, improving R2 and achieving the best performance overall. Our results highlight the promise of CRG-based RxnCLF as a scalable reaction foundation model, with the potential to generalize across broader reaction spaces and support diverse downstream reaction informatics tasks, including regioselectivity prediction, enantioselectivity prediction, and reaction condition optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RxnCLF，一个基于自监督对比学习 (contrastive learning) 的反应表示学习基础模型。它利用凝聚反应图 (condensed reaction graph, CRG) 将反应物与产物统一为单图，并在 170 万条 Pistachio 反应上预训练，随后在多个产率预测基准上微调，一致超越图与序列基线并取得最佳 R2。作者认为该方法具备作为可扩展反应基础模型的潜力。
Motivation: 反应产率预测面临标注数据稀缺、反应空间组合庞大且稀疏的问题，限制了现有反应表示模型的泛化。字符串、指纹和图基编码只能部分刻画化学转化，对复杂底物的反应预测困难。
Method: 提出 RxnCLF，一个自监督对比学习框架，核心是构建将反应物和产物信息统一到单一图的凝聚反应图 (CRG)，使模型学习显式且更丰富的转化结构，并在预训练中同时捕捉反应中心特征与侧链上下文。
Result: 在 Buchwald-Hartwig、Pd 催化 BH 偶联以及专有 HTE C-N 偶联和酰胺形成等多个产率预测基准上，RxnCLF 持续优于图与序列基线，改善 R2 并取得整体最佳性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基于 CRG 的 RxnCLF 有望成为可扩展的反应基础模型，具备向更广反应空间泛化并支持区域选择性、对映选择性预测及反应条件优化等下游任务的潜力。

papers.title: MASS: Multiplayer World Models with Authoritative Shared State
papers.abstract_en: Current video world models struggle in multiplayer environments because they entangle world state with view-dependent visual latents, leading to redundant compute, view inconsistencies, and poor scalability. We propose MAS (Multiplayer world models with Authoritative Shared State) to resolve this limitation. Inspired by multiplayer game architectures, MAS disentangles world dynamics and view rendering. A learned Logic Engine advances a global, authoritative typed state from joint actions without any hand-written transition function, acting as the sole recurrent memory and synchronization reference. From this shared state, a learned Rendering Engine generates independent and consistent views for any requested camera on demand. This explicit disentangling allows MAS to achieve superior state accuracy and lower cross-view inconsistency compared to state-of-the-art multi-view baselines on a matched multiplayer Snake benchmark. It advances predicted worlds with 1,024 concurrent players for 10,000 recurrent steps. Our results show that explicit, authoritative state modeling provides a practical foundation for scalable and consistent multi-agent world simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MAS（Multiplayer world models with Authoritative Shared State），将多玩家世界模型中的世界状态与视角渲染解耦：逻辑引擎从联合动作学习推进全局权威类型化状态，渲染引擎再按需生成独立且一致的视图。在匹配的多人 Snake 基准上，该方法相比 SOTA 多视图基线取得更高状态准确率和更低跨视角不一致性，并支持 1024 个并发玩家推进 10,000 个递归步。摘要的核心主张是显式权威状态建模为可扩展且一致的多智能体世界仿真提供了实用基础。
Motivation: 现有多玩家视频世界模型把世界状态与视角相关的视觉潜变量纠缠在一起，导致冗余计算、跨视角不一致以及扩展性差，难以支撑大规模多人仿真。
Method: 借鉴多人游戏架构，MAS 将世界动力学与视图渲染解耦。一个可学习的 Logic Engine 从联合动作推进全局权威类型化状态，不依赖手写转移函数，并作为唯一的循环记忆与同步参考；另一个可学习的 Rendering Engine 从该共享状态按需生成任意相机的独立且一致的视图。
Result: 在匹配的多人 Snake 基准上，MAS 相比 SOTA 多视图基线获得更高的状态准确率和更低的跨视角不一致性，并能将预测世界推进 1,024 个并发玩家、10,000 个递归步。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式、权威的状态建模为可扩展且一致的多智能体世界模拟奠定了实用基础。
Relevance: 3
