papers.title: Deep Generalised Mixed Models: a Novel Neural Network Structure for Analysing Hierarchical Data
papers.abstract_en: The experience sampling method (ESM) is a longitudinal research design where participants report their thoughts, emotional states and behaviours multiple times a day. Our work is motivated by such data collected by the GrowIt! app, which was released to investigate daily emotions among adolescents during the COVID-19 pandemic. Current procedures to analyse ESM data face various challenges. While standard statistical techniques may not scale well to a high-dimensional setting, machine learning procedures can give biased results due to selection bias introduced by missingness. In our motivating dataset, adolescents dropped out due to previous strong feelings of negative emotions. Hence, the implied missing data are of the missing-at-random type that standard machine learning procedures cannot accommodate. We develop a novel neural network architecture that generalises mixed effects models to deep learning to overcome these challenges. It allows semi-parametric and flexible modelling of data's mean and correlation structure through fixed and random effects. For estimation, we use an adaptation of variational auto-encoders and a Bayesian data augmentation algorithm. Through this approach, the model can accommodate longitudinal outcomes following generic distributions, scale well to high-dimensional settings and provide valid inference when data are missing-at-random. We applied the Deep Generalised Mixed Model to the GrowIt! study and various simulations. The results show potential for the Deep Generalised Mixed Model, yet suboptimal performance due to model instability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对经验抽样法(ESM)纵向数据的分析挑战，提出一种将混合效应模型推广到深度学习的神经网络架构，即深度广义混合模型(Deep Generalised Mixed Model)。该模型通过固定效应和随机效应半参数地建模均值和相关结构，并利用变分自编码器(VAE)的改版和贝叶斯数据增广算法进行估计，以处理高维、缺失机制为随机缺失(MAR)的纵向数据。在GrowIt!青少年情绪数据集和多种模拟中应用，结果显示有潜力但性能次优，原因是模型不稳定。
Motivation: ESM数据分析面临双重困难：标准统计方法难以扩展到高维设置，而机器学习方法会因缺失带来的选择偏差产生有偏结果；在本研究的GrowIt!数据集中，青少年因先前强烈的负面情绪而退出，导致缺失符合随机缺失(MAR)类型，标准机器学习程序无法处理这种缺失。
Method: 提出一种新的神经网络架构，将混合效应模型推广到深度学习，通过固定效应和随机效应对数据的均值与相关结构进行灵活的半参数建模；估计方法采用变分自编码器(variational auto-encoders)的改版和贝叶斯数据增广算法，使模型能适应任意分布的纵向结果、扩展到高维设置，并在随机缺失条件下提供有效推断。
Result: 摘要报告将该Deep Generalised Mixed Model应用于GrowIt!研究和多种模拟实验，结果显示该模型具有潜力，但由于模型不稳定性而表现出次优性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该模型能够应对随机缺失数据、高维设置和通用分布的纵向结果，但当前应用受模型不稳定性限制，性能表现仍待改进。

papers.title: BioM-JEPA: joint-embedding prediction of graph-connected gene blocks in single cells
papers.abstract_en: Single-cell transcriptomes are sparse observations of coordinated biological programmes, yet most self-supervised models learn by reconstructing individual genes. Here we present BioM-JEPA, a joint-embedding predictive architecture that instead predicts aggregate representations of graph-connected gene blocks defined by protein-association and corpus-derived coexpression evidence. A student network infers each target-block representation from the remaining genes in a cell, while a slowly updated teacher supplies the corresponding target from the full observed gene set. Under the reported extraction procedure, block-level prediction produced embeddings with higher effective rank and weaker association with detected-gene depth in the tested diagnostics than token-prediction, random-block and reconstruction controls. Across CellBench tasks, frozen BioM-JEPA embeddings retained expression, pathway and neighbourhood information and achieved the lowest aggregate perturbation-response error among the evaluated models. Representation diagnostics were also consistent with canonical pancreatic programmes and compositional relationships between genetic perturbations. Linear attention avoids constructing a quadratic gene-by-gene attention matrix; in a matched one-epoch hPancreas experiment at batch size 8, BioM-JEPA provided 5.75-fold higher fine-tuning throughput and 3.76-fold higher held-out embedding throughput than scFoundation. Together, these results support graph-connected gene blocks as useful prediction units for JEPA-style representation learning in single-cell biology.
papers.comment: 34 pages, 6 figures, and 13 supplementary tables (Tables S1-S13); includes Supplementary Information with detailed training and evaluation protocols. Numerical source data for all figures are provided as ancillary files; training code and the BioM-JEPA checkpoint will be released via GitHub
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BioM-JEPA，一种用于单细胞转录组的联合嵌入预测 (joint-embedding predictive) 架构，不再重建单个基因，而是预测由蛋白关联与语料共表达证据定义的图连通基因模块 (graph-connected gene blocks) 的聚合表示。学生网络从细胞其余基因推断目标模块表示，缓慢更新的教师网络从完整基因集提供对应目标；线性注意力避免了二次规模的基因-基因注意力矩阵。摘要报告模块级预测在诊断指标上优于 token 预测、随机模块与重建等对照，并在 CellBench 任务中取得最低的聚合扰动-响应误差，同时相对 scFoundation 具有明显吞吐优势。
Motivation: 单细胞转录组是对协调生物程序的稀疏观测，但大多数自监督模型通过重建单个基因来学习，忽略了基因间的协同结构。作者旨在验证图连通基因模块能否作为 JEPA 式表示学习的更有效预测单元。
Method: 采用 joint-embedding predictive architecture，以蛋白关联和语料推导的共表达证据定义基因模块；学生网络从细胞中除目标模块外的剩余基因预测目标块的表示，缓慢更新的教师网络则基于完整观测基因集提供目标表示。使用线性注意力避免构建二次的基因-基因注意力矩阵。
Result: 在报告的特征提取流程下，模块级预测相比 token 预测、随机模块和重建对照产生更高有效秩 (effective rank) 且与检测基因深度关联更弱；冻结的 BioM-JEPA 嵌入在 CellBench 任务中保留表达、通路与邻域信息，并获得所评估模型中的最低聚合扰动-响应误差。在 batch size 8 的匹配单轮 hPancreas 实验中，其微调吞吐为 scFoundation 的 5.75 倍，留出嵌入吞吐为其 3.76 倍。
Conclusion: 结果表明，图连通基因模块是单细胞生物学中 JEPA 式表示学习的有用预测单元。

papers.title: BALANCE: Hybrid Autoregressive-Speculative LLM Inference in Wireless Edge Networks
papers.abstract_en: Edge inference is a promising paradigm to provide large language model (LLM) inference services in next-generation mobile networks. LLM inference mainly relies on two approaches: Autoregressive decoding (AD) generates output tokens sequentially, resulting in long latency; Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates inference by using a small language model (SLM) to generate multiple draft tokens for LLM verification, but incurs extra memory costs. Due to this latency-memory tradeoff, neither approach alone can efficiently serve users with heterogeneous demands under limited edge computing resources. To address this challenge, we propose a hybrid autoregressive-speculative inference (BALANCE) framework for edge LLM inference. In BALANCE, an edge server hosts both an SLM and an LLM, assigns each user to AD or SD, and performs the two modes simultaneously. To maximize the number of served users, we formulate a task throughput maximization problem to jointly determine user scheduling and computing resource allocation between AD and SD under user latency requirements and server memory constraints. Since the problem is NP-hard, we develop a polynomial-time algorithm that transforms the original problem into two sub-problems and obtains a sub-optimal solution with a constant approximation guarantee. Experiments demonstrate that BALANCE consistently outperforms conventional AD and SD and significantly improves task throughput.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向无线边缘网络大语言模型推理的混合自回归-投机解码框架 BALANCE。边缘服务器同时部署小型语言模型(SLM)和大型语言模型(LLM)，将每个用户分配到自回归解码(AD)或投机解码(SD)模式并同时并行执行两种模式；通过用户调度与计算资源分配的联合优化最大化服务用户数，并给出具有常数近似保证的多项式时间算法。实验表明 BALANCE 在任务吞吐量上优于传统 AD 和 SD。
Motivation: 边缘推理需要在有限计算资源下服务异构用户，但 AD 延迟长、SD 虽加速推理却引入额外内存开销，单一模式无法同时满足不同用户的延迟需求与服务器内存约束。
Method: 将用户分配和 AD/SD 间的计算资源分配建模为任务吞吐量最大化问题，该问题为 NP-hard；作者将其拆分为两个子问题，设计多项式时间算法并证明常数近似比。
Result: 摘要报告实验显示 BALANCE 持续优于传统 AD 与 SD，并显著提升任务吞吐量。
Conclusion: 本文将混合 AD/SD 推断与边缘资源分配结合，说明通过联合调度可缓解延迟-内存折中并提高边缘 LLM 服务的用户承载能力。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Floating Radiance Networks
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in neural scene representations enable photorealistic novel-view synthesis, yet most methods remain tightly coupled to a single rendering paradigm, limiting their versatility and integration with conventional graphics workflows. We introduce Floating Radiance Networks (FlaRe), a neural scene representation combining explicit ray-traceable geometry with continuous neural radiance functions. A scene is represented by floating planar generalized Gaussian primitives, each carrying a compact latent descriptor of a local radiance field. A lightweight decoder shared across the scene maps this descriptor, local surface coordinates, and viewing direction to color and opacity. This formulation preserves the expressiveness of neural fields while providing an explicitly addressable structure that can be efficiently queried and manipulated. Hardware-accelerated primitive intersections enable interactive rendering and recursive ray-tracing, including reflections, refractions, transparency, and shadows. The same representation further supports primitive-level deformation, mesh extraction, and appearance stylization directly in its learned descriptor space. Experiments across standard reconstruction benchmarks demonstrate competitive rendering quality while using a compact set of primitives. Together, these results establish FlaRe as a versatile representation that brings high-fidelity neural rendering, ray-tracing, geometric manipulation, and appearance editing into a unified scene model. Source code is available online. Source code can be found at: https://github.com/KByrski/FlaRe
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Floating Radiance Networks (FlaRe)，一种将显式可光线追踪几何与连续神经辐射场相结合的神经场景表示。场景由浮动的平面广义高斯原语组成，每个原语携带局部辐射场的紧凑潜在描述子，并通过共享的轻量解码器映射到颜色和不透明度。该表示支持硬件加速的交互式渲染、递归光线追踪（反射、折射、透明、阴影）、原语级变形、网格提取和外观风格化。在标准重建基准上的实验表明，使用紧凑原语集能达到有竞争力的渲染质量。
Motivation: 现有神经场景表示大多与单一渲染范式紧密耦合，限制其通用性及与传统图形工作流的集成；需要一种既保持神经场表现力、又具备显式可寻址结构以支持交互式查询和操作的表示。
Method: FlaRe 用平面广义高斯原语表示场景，每个原语携带局部辐射场的潜在描述子，由一个跨场景共享的轻量解码器结合局部表面坐标和观察方向输出颜色与不透明度；利用硬件加速的原语求交实现交互渲染，并在描述子空间中直接支持变形、网格提取与外观编辑。
Result: 在标准重建基准上的实验表明，FlaRe 在使用紧凑原语集的同时达到了有竞争力的渲染质量，并支持实时交互、递归光线追踪及几何与外观编辑。
Conclusion: 作者认为 FlaRe 将高保真神经渲染、光线追踪、几何操作和外观编辑统一到单一场景模型中，是一种多用途的场景表示；源代码已公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Mapping Armenian Paris: Extracting and Geocoding Commercial Advertisements from the 20th-Century Diaspora Press
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents an end-to-end, IIIF-based pipeline that turns the digitised Armenian press of France into an interactive map of the 20th-century Parisian Armenian commercial community. On each page, commercial advertisements are located, read, and parsed into structured records, which are then geocoded and placed on the map. Western Armenian is under-resourced and unsupported by off-the-shelf layout and OCR models, so the pipeline uses vision-language models (VLMs) as a data-bootstrapping strategy: they produce usable structured records at a scale hand annotation could not reach, and stay reliable on the strongly curved scans where conventional line-level CRNN OCR breaks down. The contribution includes a 500-page Western Armenian press corpus with 3,270 advertisement-level annotations, a Label Studio template that captures detection and semantic fields in a single annotation pass, and a reproducible workflow transposable to other under-resourced historical corpora. More broadly, the work shows that VLM-driven data bootstrapping is an effective lever for under-resourced historical languages such as (Western) Armenian.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于 IIIF 的端到端流程，将 20 世纪法国亚美尼亚侨民报刊数字化为巴黎亚美尼亚商业社区交互式地图。流程在每页上定位、读取并解析商业广告为结构化记录，再进行地理编码并放置到地图上。由于西亚美尼亚语缺乏现成的版面与 OCR 模型支持，作者利用视觉语言模型 (VLM) 作为数据引导策略，在强弯曲扫描件上比传统行级 CRNN OCR 更可靠。贡献包括 500 页语料、3,270 条广告级标注、Label Studio 模板与可复现工作流。
Motivation: 西亚美尼亚语属于资源匮乏语言，现成的版面分析和 OCR 模型不支持，手工标注难以覆盖规模；同时传统行级 CRNN OCR 在强弯曲扫描件上失效，需要一种能规模化产出可用结构化记录的方法。
Method: 构建基于 IIIF 的端到端管道，使用视觉语言模型 (VLM) 进行数据引导 (data bootstrapping)：在页面中定位、识别并解析商业广告为结构化记录，再对记录进行地理编码与地图放置；同时发布包含检测与语义字段的 Label Studio 单次标注模板。
Result: 论文提供 500 页西亚美尼亚语报刊语料，包含 3,270 条广告级标注；VLM 驱动的流程在强弯曲扫描件上比传统行级 CRNN OCR 更可靠，并达到手工标注无法企及的规模化产出。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作可复现并适用于其他资源匮乏的历史语料，并表明 VLM 驱动的数据引导是处理此类历史语言的有效杠杆。

papers.title: CourseGraph: Finding overlaps and differences in Computer Science courses across universities
papers.abstract_en: Student mobility programs such as Erasmus+ enable students to take courses at other universities, broadening their academic and cultural horizons. However, this flexibility also leads to a practical challenge: ensuring that students do not take courses elsewhere that substantially overlap with courses in their home curriculum. In this work, we propose CourseGraph, a methodology that automates the evaluation of external courses based on insights obtained from the process followed by curriculum administrators when assessing courses for inclusion in a degree program. Course- Graph extracts information such as course titles, descriptions, and learning outcomes from the course webpage. Then, this information is represented semantically using a BERT-based language model, after which the pair-wise similarity between courses can be computed. This information is then used by a Random Forest classifier to determine whether a candidate course abroad overlaps with a course already contained in the student's curriculum. We evaluate CourseGraph using (1) the Computer Science program at Eindhoven University of Technology, which contains information about courses with substantial overlap, and (2) six approved international programs from students enrolled in the Computer Science program at Lund University, including the corresponding decisions made by a curriculum administrator. The experimental results indicate that CourseGraph provides an effective approach for identifying overlapping courses and supporting curriculum alignment across universities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CourseGraph，一种根据课程管理员评估外部课程加入学位项目的流程来自动化评估外部课程的方法。该方法从课程网页提取课程标题、描述和学习成果，用基于 BERT 的语言模型进行语义表示，计算课程间两两相似度，再由 Random Forest 分类器判断海外候选课程是否与本校已有课程重叠。实验使用埃因霍温理工大学计算机科学项目及隆德大学六个已批准的国际项目数据，结果显示 CourseGraph 能有效识别重叠课程并支持跨校课程对齐。
Motivation: Erasmus+ 等学生流动项目允许学生在其他大学修课，但带来实际挑战：需要确保学生在别处修的课程与本校课程没有明显重叠，而此类评估通常依赖课程管理员的人工判断，缺乏自动化支持。
Method: CourseGraph 从课程网页抽取标题、描述和学习成果等信息，使用 BERT-based 语言模型进行语义表示，计算课程间的 pair-wise 相似度，再将这些信息输入 Random Forest 分类器，判定候选的外部课程是否与当前课程中的某门课程重叠。
Result: 在埃因霍温理工大学计算机科学项目（包含大量重叠课程信息）和隆德大学计算机科学专业学生申请的六个国际项目（含课程管理员对应决策）上的实验表明，CourseGraph 能有效识别重叠课程并辅助课程对齐。
Conclusion: 作者认为 CourseGraph 为识别重叠课程和支持高校间课程对齐提供了有效手段。

papers.title: Robust-WAM: Bridging Generative Pretraining and Semantic Foresight in World-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Mainstream World-Action Models (WAMs) adapt pretrained video generation models (VGMs) for robot control, transferring their learned dynamics prior for action prediction. These VGMs are typically trained in a variational autoencoder (VAE) latent space. However, the VAE latent space is optimized for pixel reconstruction, which rewards fine appearance detail and leaves the action prediction fragile under visual shifts. Recent works build WAMs in semantic latent space, which are more robust to appearance shifts. However, these models cannot leverage the large-scale VGM pretraining that exists only in VAE space. To overcome this dilemma, we propose Robust-WAM, a general post-training method for video-generation-based WAMs that preserves the VAE-based generative path and adds a lightweight semantic foresight alignment objective on the action stream. This retains the large-scale VGM pretraining while grounding actions in appearance-invariant dynamics that stay reliable under illumination shifts and other visual out-of-distribution conditions. Specifically, we employ learnable query tokens to bring future-scene semantics into the action stream by aligning their output hidden states with the semantic foresight of future ground-truth frames. To establish the temporal correspondence between each query and the future step it describes, we give it the positional encoding of the matching action tokens. Experiments on out-of-distribution generalization simulation benchmarks and a real-robot setup show that our Robust-WAM consistently improves the success rates of multiple WAM baselines without sacrificing in-distribution performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Robust-WAM，一种针对基于视频生成的世界-动作模型 (World-Action Model, WAM) 的通用后训练方法。其核心思路是保留基于 VAE 的生成路径以继承大规模视频生成模型 (VGM) 预训练，同时在动作流上加入轻量的语义前瞻对齐 (semantic foresight alignment) 目标，使动作预测在光照变化等视觉分布外 (out-of-distribution) 条件下保持可靠。实验在分布外泛化仿真基准和真实机器人平台上提升了多个 WAM 基线的成功率，且不牺牲分布内性能。
Motivation: 主流的 WAM 将预训练视频生成模型适配到机器人控制，但这些 VGM 在 VAE 潜空间中训练，该空间针对像素重建优化，导致动作预测在视觉偏移下脆弱。近期工作在语义潜空间构建 WAM，对表观变化更鲁棒，却无法利用仅存在于 VAE 空间的大规模预训练。
Method: Robust-WAM 是一种通用后训练方法：保留 VAE 生成路径，并在动作流上增加语义前瞻对齐目标。具体使用可学习查询 token (learnable query tokens) 对齐其输出隐状态与未来真实帧的语义前瞻表征，并通过给查询 token 赋予对应动作 token 的位置编码来建立时间对应关系。
Result: 在分布外泛化仿真基准和真实机器人实验中，Robust-WAM 一致提升了多个 WAM 基线的任务成功率，同时保持分布内性能不下降。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作弥合了 VAE 空间大规模预训练与语义空间鲁棒性之间的两难，提供了一种不改变生成路径即可将动作锚定到表观不变动力学上的后训练方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CohortHijack: Robustness of Single Cell Annotation to Companion Cell Removal
papers.abstract_en: Many single-cell annotation tools refine an initial cell label using nearby cells or cluster-level voting. We study whether this refinement can be manipulated without changing the target cell. We introduce CohortHijack, a robustness audit that removes selected non-target cells from the query cohort while preserving the target expression profile, base prediction, and trained model. We evaluate random and structured removal methods, together with greedy, multi-start, and beam search, on PBMC3K and Paul15 using logistic regression and calibrated linear SVM classifiers. Structured removal was consistently stronger than random removal on Paul15. Multi-start search changed 24.33% of linear-SVM targets and 19.67% of logistic-regression targets while removing a small fraction of the cohort and keeping mean collateral changes below 0.4%. Ablations confirmed that the effect disappeared when neighborhood refinement was disabled. We also evaluated CellTypist majority voting, where independent predictions remained unchanged across all evaluations, but refined labels changed after small companion-cell removals. These findings identify query cohort composition as a target-preserving attack surface in single-cell annotation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究单细胞注释工具中基于邻近细胞或聚类投票的标签精修是否可在不改变目标细胞的情况下被操纵。作者提出 CohortHijack 鲁棒性审计方法，通过移除查询队列中的非目标细胞来测试精修稳定性，并在 PBMC3K 与 Paul15 上结合逻辑回归和线性 SVM 分类器、多种搜索策略进行评估。结果表明队列结构移除能稳定改变部分目标标签，而禁用邻域精修后效应消失。
Motivation: 许多单细胞注释工具会利用邻近细胞或聚类投票来精修初始标签，但这种精修可能被恶意操纵；现有研究未系统考察在不改变目标细胞表达谱和模型的情况下，仅通过调整查询队列组成能否改变注释结果。
Method: 提出 CohortHijack 审计框架：在保持目标表达谱、基础预测和已训练模型不变的前提下，移除选定的非目标细胞，并比较随机移除与结构化移除、以及贪心、多起点和 beam search 等搜索策略；实验采用 PBMC3K 和 Paul15 数据集、逻辑回归与校准线性 SVM 分类器，并额外评估 CellTypist 多数投票。
Result: 结构化移除在 Paul15 上始终强于随机移除；多起点搜索分别改变了 24.33% 的线性 SVM 目标和 19.67% 的逻辑回归目标，同时只移除少部分队列且平均附带变化低于 0.4%。消融实验表明禁用邻域精修后效应消失；CellTypist 的独立预测在所有评估中不变，但小规模伴随细胞移除后精修标签发生变化。
Conclusion: 查询队列组成构成了一个保持目标不变的单细胞注释攻击面，提示依赖邻近细胞精修的方法存在被操纵的风险。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GSBF: Gaussian Splatting for Environment-Aware Beamforming
papers.abstract_en: Beamforming plays a key role in multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) communication systems. However, conventional beamforming design normally requires accurate instantaneous channel state information (CSI) and iterative optimization, which incur substantial pilot overhead and computational complexity. Recognizing that radio propagation is intrinsically governed by the physical geometry, we develop a 3D Gaussian splatting for environment-aware beamforming (GSBF) pipeline based on multi-modal data, which characterizes the environment through a persistent 3D Gaussian representation. Specifically, GSBF models the environmental scattering response with reciprocity-preserving bidirectional spherical Gaussian (Bi-SG) kernels and performs two-sided electromagnetic rasterization to render an angular propagator map. The rendered map is then aggregated through an over-complete array-manifold dictionary and projected to the constant-modulus beamformers, thereby synthesizing beams directly from the access point (AP) pose and user position without online instantaneous CSI. Simulations demonstrate that GSBF consistently outperforms baselines such as exhaustive beam alignment (EBA) with lower latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GSBF，一种基于 3D 高斯溅射 (3D Gaussian splatting) 的环境感知波束成形流水线。它用多模态数据构建持久 3D 环境表示，通过双向球面高斯 (Bi-SG) 核建模散射响应并做双侧电磁光栅化，渲染角度传播图，再经过完备阵列流形字典聚合后直接生成恒模波束，从而不需要在线瞬时 CSI。摘要报告仿真中该方法在性能上持续优于穷举波束对齐 (EBA) 等基线，且延迟更低。
Motivation: 传统波束成形依赖精确的瞬时信道状态信息 (CSI) 和迭代优化，带来大量导频开销和计算复杂度；而无线电传播本质上由物理几何决定，因此作者希望利用持久的环境表示直接从接入点姿态和用户位置合成波束。
Method: GSBF 使用保互易性的双向球面高斯 (Bi-SG) 核来描述环境散射响应，执行双侧电磁光栅化 (two-sided electromagnetic rasterization) 以渲染角度传播图，再将该图通过过完备阵列流形字典聚合，并投影到恒模波束形成器，实现基于 AP 姿态与用户位置的直接波束合成。
Result: 仿真结果表明，GSBF 在性能上一致优于穷举波束对齐 (EBA) 等基线，并且具有更低的延迟。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 GSBF 提供了一种无需在线瞬时 CSI 的环境感知波束合成路径，并将其性能优势归因于对物理几何的显式建模；该工作尚停留在仿真评估层面。

papers.title: ECG-LENS: Lead-Aware Clinical Context Enriched ECG Report Generation and Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Electrocardiography (ECG) is one of the most widely used non-invasive tools for diagnosing cardiovascular disease, but transforming multi-lead ECG recordings into reliable clinical reports remains challenging. Automating ECG report generation could reduce clinicians' interpretive workload, improve diagnostic efficiency, and expand access to cardiac assessment in underserved communities. Unlike image-based report-generation tasks, ECG interpretation requires the analysis of subtle temporal morphologies, followed by coherent diagnostic reasoning expressed in dense clinical terminology. Existing systems predominantly focus on classification, while current report-generation methods often produce outputs that remain inadequate for practical clinical use. To address these challenges, we propose ECG-LENS, an end-to-end ECG report-generation framework that jointly integrates multi-lead signal modeling, diagnosis-aware representations, and clinically grounded text generation. ECG-LENS combines lead-wise encoders that preserve localized waveform morphology with a global encoder that captures inter-lead dependencies. To guide report generation, we fuse signal representations with clinically enriched textual prompts that condition a GPT-2 decoder. We further introduce an ECG-specific report-preprocessing strategy that helps the model focus on clinically meaningful findings. Finally, because lexical metrics may under- or overestimate report quality, we propose F1-ECGBERT, a BERT-based, ECG-specific metric that measures agreement between diagnostic labels extracted from generated and reference reports. In-domain experiments on PTB-XL and cross-domain evaluation on MIMIC-IV-ECG show that ECG-LENS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with absolute gains of 4.0%, 6.3%, and 11.5% in METEOR, ROUGE-L, and F1-ECGBERT, respectively, over the strongest baselines.

papers.title: Alternating Levenberg-Marquardt Training of Physics-Informed Neural Networks with Fourier-Enhanced Features
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) often fail to accurately resolve partial differential equations (PDEs) with high-frequency or multi-scale solutions, as well as strongly nonlinear problems. Two factors underlie this difficulty: spectral bias, the tendency of neural networks to underfit high-frequency features; and representation-coefficient coupling, the entanglement of representation learning and coefficient fitting within a single nonconvex optimization objective. In this work, we propose the Fourier-enhanced alternating Levenberg--Marquardt PINN (FALM-PINN), an optimization framework that decouples representation learning from coefficient fitting. The upper-level problem learns a Fourier-enhanced basis that enriches the latent space with high-frequency components, while the lower-level problem resolves the coupling by fitting the projection coefficients on this basis, solving a nonlinear least-squares problem with the Levenberg--Marquardt algorithm. The framework applies to general nonlinear and coupled PDE systems, and reduces to a single-step convex optimization problem for linear PDEs. We prove global convergence of the alternating training scheme in both cases. Numerical examples on multiple challenging high-frequency and nonlinear PDEs show that FALM-PINN achieves relative $L^2$ errors up to two orders of magnitude lower than state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FALM-PINN，一个用于物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 训练的交替优化框架，旨在解决高频/多尺度 PDE 解和强非线性问题中的谱偏差 (spectral bias) 与表示-系数耦合问题。上层问题学习傅里叶增强基 (Fourier-enhanced basis) 以丰富潜空间的高频成分，下层问题用 Levenberg-Marquardt 算法在该基上拟合投影系数。摘要报告在多个高频和非线性 PDE 算例上，相对 $L^2$ 误差比现有最先进基线低最多两个数量级，并证明了交替训练方案的全局收敛性。
Motivation: PINN 在求解具有高频或多尺度解以及强非线性的 PDE 时经常无法准确收敛，根源在于神经网络的谱偏差（容易欠拟合高频特征）以及表示学习与系数拟合在同一非凸优化目标中的耦合。
Method: 提出 FALM-PINN：将训练解耦为上层表示学习与下层系数拟合。上层学习含高频分量的傅里叶增强基，下层将该基上的投影系数拟合转化为非线性最小二乘问题并用 Levenberg-Marquardt 算法求解。该框架适用于一般非线性及耦合 PDE 系统，对线性 PDE 可退化为单步凸优化问题，并给出了两种情形下交替训练方案的全局收敛性证明。
Result: 在多个具有挑战性的高频和非线性 PDE 数值算例中，FALM-PINN 实现比最先进基线低最多两个数量级的相对 $L^2$ 误差。
Conclusion: 作者强调该优化框架通过解耦表示学习与系数拟合来缓解 PINN 的谱偏差和耦合问题，且适用于一般非线性耦合 PDE 系统；对线性 PDE 可简化为凸优化问题，并具备全局收敛保证。

papers.title: AppDeltaWorld: Transition-Grounded Delta Code World Model for Mobile GUI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Mobile GUI agents can operate apps through pixel perception and touch actions, making them a promising interface for collecting and improving long-horizon mobile interaction policies. However, real trajectories are difficult to obtain for sensitive apps and privacy-critical operations. At the same time, existing simulated environments are costly to scale up, and GUI world models still suffer from unstable generation, limited modality coverage, and inconsistent action-transition logic. To address these limitations, we propose AppDeltaWorld, a transition-grounded delta code world model that predicts the next GUI as a reachable code update rather than as an unconstrained image or text description. AppDeltaWorld retrieves app-specific Level-1 HTML references under an action-transition constraint, generates Level-2 executable HTML conditioned on the current screen, action, predicted next-screen text, and retrieved structure, and inserts generated visual assets into image slots before browser rendering. As a world model, AppDeltaWorld achieves the highest fidelity on CMGUIBench-500 under Code2World evaluation, with clear gains in structural layout and UI element reconstruction over image-only and code-only baselines. As a training environment, AppDeltaWorld supports filtered closed-loop SFT data construction that, when combined with public supervision, enables AppDeltaAgent to achieve state-of-the-art performance on AndroidLens and consistent gains on MobileGym and MobileWorld. Moreover, world-model-based test-time reinforcement learning enables policy adaptation and shows further improvements without additional interaction with real apps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AppDeltaWorld，一种面向移动 GUI agent 的 transition-grounded delta code world model，将下一帧 GUI 预测建模为可执行的代码更新而非无约束的图像或文本生成。方法在 action-transition 约束下检索应用特定的 Level-1 HTML 参考，基于当前屏幕、动作、预测的下一屏文本和检索到的结构生成 Level-2 可执行 HTML，并在浏览器渲染前插入生成的视觉素材。作为世界模型，它在 CMGUIBench-500 的 Code2World 评估中取得最高保真度；作为训练环境，它支撑的 AppDeltaAgent 在 AndroidLens 上达到 SOTA，并在 MobileGym 和 MobileWorld 上取得一致提升。
Motivation: 移动 GUI agent 的真实轨迹在敏感应用和隐私关键操作上难以获取，现有模拟环境扩展成本高，而 GUI 世界模型存在生成不稳定、模态覆盖有限、动作-转移逻辑不一致的问题。
Method: 提出以可达代码更新（delta code）形式预测下一屏 GUI 的世界模型：在动作转移约束下检索应用相关的 Level-1 HTML 引用，生成以当前屏幕、动作、预测下一屏文本和检索结构为条件的 Level-2 可执行 HTML，并将视觉素材插入图像槽位后交给浏览器渲染。此外，利用该世界模型构建带过滤的闭环 SFT 数据，并支持基于世界模型的测试时强化学习（test-time RL）。
Result: 摘要报告 AppDeltaWorld 在 CMGUIBench-500 的 Code2World 评估中达到最高保真度，在结构布局和 UI 元素重建上明显优于仅图像和仅代码基线；AppDeltaAgent 在 AndroidLens 上达到 SOTA，在 MobileGym 和 MobileWorld 上取得一致增益；测试时 RL 在不与真实应用额外交互的情况下进一步提升策略表现。
Conclusion: 作者强调将 GUI 下一帧预测锚定在可执行代码更新上，可以同时提升世界模型的模拟保真度和移动 GUI 策略训练的数据效率与适应性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The em-dash em-beds in Congress: A population-level rise in em-dash frequency in U.S. congressional press releases at the dawn of the large-language-model era, 2021-2025
authors: Przemysław Czuma (Polish Association for Artificial Intelligence in Medicine)
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can leave small stylistic traces in text written with their help. The most discussed is the em-dash (U+2014), especially the unspaced form word---word, which is normal in typeset English prose but unusual in U.S. press writing, where AP style calls for spaced dashes. This study asks whether that trace is measurable in congressional press releases. In a preregistered design (OSF: 10.17605/OSF.IO/U5NEY), 146,239 scraper-sourced releases from 480 House and Senate offices (2021-2025, the open congress-press dataset) were analyzed: density of unspaced prose-form em-dashes per 1,000 characters of cleaned text, Poisson/negative-binomial models with a length offset, clustering by office. Density stayed within 0.10-0.12 per 1,000 characters through 2021-2024, then rose to 0.217 in 2025, more than twice the four-year baseline; the share of releases with such an em-dash rose from ~13% to 24.8%. The primary frequency ratio (2023-2025 vs 2021-2022) was 1.55 (95% CI 1.28-1.93; exact registered cut-off: 1.528), just above the prespecified 1.5x threshold. The rise was net-new (hyphen density stable), held within authors (75.6% of 262 continuous offices increased; p ~ 1e-16) and in a closed panel of 224 offices, and survived falsification tests: three placebo cut-offs were null, the pipeline showed no step at the 2024/2025 boundary, and continuing offices carried the rise. A segmented regression finds no step at the ChatGPT cut-off but a clear post-period acceleration; the 2025 rise is symmetric across parties and chambers. Because the registered validation gate was formally breached, the full preregistered decision rule was not met; the interpretation (broad diffusion of LLM-assisted writing as the models matured) is offered as exploratory. The em-dash remains a population-level marker, not a per-release authorship detector, and the design supports no causal claim.
papers.comment: Preregistered study (OSF: 10.17605/OSF.IO/U5NEY); deviations from the registered plan, including a formal validation-gate breach, are disclosed in Section 4.6. Companion study: arXiv:2606.29540. 3 figures, 4 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一项预注册研究，使用 2021-2025 年美国国会新闻稿（480 个众议院和参议院办公室的 146,239 篇）检验无空格散文式破折号（em-dash, U+2014）频率是否可作为大语言模型辅助写作的文体痕迹。结果显示，每 1,000 字符的破折号密度在 2021-2024 年保持 0.10-0.12，2025 年升至 0.217，含此类破折号的新闻稿比例从约 13% 升至 24.8%。作者强调该发现是总体层面（population-level）的标记而非逐篇作者归属检测，且由于预注册验证门被正式突破，解释仅具探索性。
Motivation: LLM 可能在辅助写作中留下细微文体痕迹，其中被讨论最多的是破折号，尤其是无空格形式 word---word；这种形式在排印英文中常见，但在遵循 AP 风格（要求带空格破折号）的美国新闻写作中不寻常。该研究旨在检验这一痕迹是否能在国会新闻稿中被测量。
Method: 采用预注册设计（OSF: 10.17605/OSF.IO/U5NEY），分析 146,239 篇抓取的新闻稿；以每 1,000 字符清洁文本中无空格散文式破折号的密度为指标，使用带长度偏移（length offset）的 Poisson/负二项模型，并按办公室聚类。还进行了伪造检验（falsification tests）：三个安慰剂切点、2024/2025 边界管线检验、持续办公室检验，以及分段回归（segmented regression）。
Result: 破折号密度在 2021-2024 年稳定在 0.10-0.12，2025 年升至 0.217，超过四年基线两倍；含破折号的新闻稿比例从约 13% 升至 24.8%。主要频率比（2023-2025 对比 2021-2022）为 1.55（95% CI 1.28-1.93；注册精确切点为 1.528），略高于预设的 1.5 倍阈值。262 个持续办公室中 75.6% 呈现上升（p 约 1e-16）；安慰剂切点均为零，ChatGPT 切点处无阶跃但后段加速明显，且上升在两党和两院中对称。
Conclusion: 由于预注册验证门被正式突破，完整的预注册决策规则未满足，作者将阐释（LLM 辅助写作随模型成熟而广泛扩散）视为探索性结论。摘要强调破折号仍是总体层面的标记而非逐篇作者归属检测器，且该设计不支持因果性主张。

summary_sections.motivation: LLM 可能在辅助写作中留下细微文体痕迹，其中被讨论最多的是破折号，尤其是无空格形式 word---word；这种形式在排印英文中常见，但在遵循 AP 风格（要求带空格破折号）的美国新闻写作中不寻常。该研究旨在检验这一痕迹是否能在国会新闻稿中被测量。
summary_sections.method: 采用预注册设计（OSF: 10.17605/OSF.IO/U5NEY），分析 146,239 篇抓取的新闻稿；以每 1,000 字符清洁文本中无空格散文式破折号的密度为指标，使用带长度偏移（length offset）的 Poisson/负二项模型，并按办公室聚类。还进行了伪造检验（falsification tests）：三个安慰剂切点、2024/2025 边界管线检验、持续办公室检验，以及分段回归（segmented regression）。
summary_sections.result: 破折号密度在 2021-2024 年稳定在 0.10-0.12，2025 年升至 0.217，超过四年基线两倍；含破折号的新闻稿比例从约 13% 升至 24.8%。主要频率比（2023-2025 对比 2021-2022）为 1.55（95% CI 1.28-1.93；注册精确切点为 1.528），略高于预设的 1.5 倍阈值。262 个持续办公室中 75.6% 呈现上升（p 约 1e-16）；安慰剂切点均为零，ChatGPT 切点处无阶跃但后段加速明显，且上升在两党和两院中对称。
summary_sections.conclusion: 由于预注册验证门被正式突破，完整的预注册决策规则未满足，作者将阐释（LLM 辅助写作随模型成熟而广泛扩散）视为探索性结论。摘要强调破折号仍是总体层面的标记而非逐篇作者归属检测器，且该设计不支持因果性主张。

papers.title: CodeGrep: An RL-Trained Retrieval Agent for LLM Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Modern LLM coding agents such as Claude Code and OpenHands share a common inefficiency: they spend much of their token budget finding the file to patch, rather than patching it. On SWE-Bench Verified, a 30B OpenHands agent averages 23 rounds and 631K tokens per resolved issue, with many calls spent on grep, glob, and view_file during repository exploration. We introduce CodeGrep, a 14B retrieval agent trained end-to-end with GRPO to issue multi-turn parallel grep, glob, and read tool calls and return candidate files to a frozen downstream coding agent. On all 500 SWE-Bench Verified instances, CodeGrep preserves resolve rate while substantially improving efficiency: 27.0% versus 25.8% for the no-retrieval baseline, with 15% fewer rounds and 19% fewer tokens on resolved instances. Across retrievers, downstream utility follows a precision threshold: BM25 with precision 0.375 degrades the agent, Jina with precision 0.445 is neutral, and CodeGrep with precision 0.677 crosses the threshold at which retrieval begins to reduce rollout cost. To enable this study, we mine supervision from 67K open-source agent trajectories using CATM and build a Git-worktree environment for multi-turn agent RL. In our setting, applying the efficiency signal at the advantage layer rather than the reward layer reduces KL drift and translates cleanly into downstream efficiency. We will release the model, training pipeline, RL environment, and evaluation harnesses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CodeGrep，一个 14B 参数的检索智能体，端到端使用 GRPO 训练，通过多轮并行 grep、glob 和 read 工具调用为冻结的下游编码智能体返回候选文件。在全部 500 个 SWE-Bench Verified 实例上，CodeGrep 在保持解决率的前提下显著提升效率，并分析了检索器精度如何决定下游编码智能体的收益。
Motivation: 现代 LLM 编码智能体（如 Claude Code、OpenHands）的大量 token 预算浪费在仓库探索上而不是真正修改代码；在 SWE-Bench Verified 上，一个 30B 的 OpenHands 智能体平均每个已解决问题消耗 23 轮和 631K token，其中大量调用用于 grep、glob 和 view_file。
Method: 训练一个 14B 的检索智能体 CodeGrep，使用 GRPO 端到端训练，使其发出多轮并行 grep/glob/read 工具调用并向冻结的下游编码智能体返回候选文件；从 67K 开源智能体轨迹中通过 CATM 挖掘监督信号，并构建 Git-worktree 环境用于多轮智能体强化学习；效率信号作用于优势层（advantage layer）而非奖励层。
Result: 在全部 500 个 SWE-Bench Verified 实例上，CodeGrep 达到 27.0% 的解决率，高于无检索基线的 25.8%，同时已解决问题减少 15% 轮数和 19% token 消耗；不同检索器存在精度阈值效应：BM25（精度 0.375）使智能体退化，Jina（精度 0.445）为中性，CodeGrep（精度 0.677）越过阈值并开始降低 rollout 成本。
Conclusion: 作者认为训练检索智能体能够在不损失解决率的情况下显著提升编码智能体的效率，且将效率信号置于优势层而非奖励层可以减少 KL 漂移并干净地转化为下游效率；论文将开源模型、训练流程、RL 环境和评测框架。

papers.title: Beyond Feature Importance: A Comparative Analysis of Pattern Detection Methods in Cluster Interpretation
papers.abstract_en: Interpreting clustering outcomes remains a fundamental challenge in data analysis, particularly in domains such as healthcare where meaningful patterns must be extracted from high-dimensional data. While numerous explainability techniques exist, they are primarily designed to assess feature importance or provide local instance-level explanations rather than to identify structured patterns present within clusters. This work presents a comparative evaluation of commonly used post-hoc analysis methods for pattern detection in clustering results. To enable controlled evaluation, we introduce a suite of synthetic datasets in which predefined patterns are systematically injected. Three widely used techniques are evaluated: a Random Forest surrogate model with permutation feature importance, LIME (Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations), and principal component analysis. Results demonstrate that although each method can successfully recover relevant features, none consistently detects all injected pattern types. These findings high- light a critical gap between existing explainability tools and the requirements of pattern-level cluster interpretation, motivating the development of dedicated pattern detection methodologies.
papers.comment: 6 pages. Accepted in 36th Irish Signals and Systems Conference (ISSC) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对聚类结果解释中的模式检测(post-hoc pattern detection)方法进行对比评估，提出一组注入预定义模式的合成数据集，并比较随机森林代理模型加置换特征重要性、LIME 和主成分分析三种常用方法。结果表明每种方法都能恢复相关特征，但没有一种方法能一致检测所有注入的模式类型，说明现有可解释性工具与聚类模式级解释需求之间存在差距。
Motivation: 聚类结果解释仍然困难，尤其在医疗保健等高维数据场景中；现有可解释性技术主要面向特征重要性或局部实例级解释，而非识别簇内结构化模式。
Method: 构建一组可控制地注入预定义模式的合成数据集，用于评估三种后验分析方法：带置换特征重要性(permutation feature importance)的随机森林代理模型、LIME(Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations)和主成分分析(principal component analysis)。
Result: 三种方法均能成功恢复相关特征，但没有任何一种方法能一致检测全部注入模式类型，暴露出可解释性工具与模式级聚类解释需求之间的关键差距。
Conclusion: 作者认为需要专门针对模式检测的方法论来弥合现有可解释性工具与聚类模式级解释之间的差距。

papers.title: To See a World in a Living Context: Unified Indoor-Outdoor Urban World Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-driven 3D generation has advanced rapidly in creating large-scale outdoor environments and detailed indoor scenes, but these domains are usually synthesized independently, lacking the correspondence required for a coherent urban world. We present HoloWorld, a unified indoor-outdoor urban world generation framework built on a continuously updated cross-scale world context. Initializing from a user description, HoloWorld progressively represents and updates the diverse world information, from city-scale planning to individual buildings, allowing generated interiors to maintain explicit correspondence with their associated exterior buildings. Conditioned on the evolving context and previously generated neighboring blocks, HoloWorld autoregressively generates urban exteriors with consistent spatial organization and visual identity across blocks. The generated exterior representations are further grounded in 3D building instances and footprints, enabling building-specific indoor generation with geometry-constrained layouts and inherited appearance characteristics. To our knowledge, HoloWorld is the first framework to unify indoor and outdoor generation within a coherent 3D urban world. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HoloWorld achieves superior urban exterior generation performance, improving the average AQS score over the SOTA by 7.68\% and obtaining the highest average RDR score, while maintaining strong building-level indoor-outdoor correspondence and cross-block continuity within a unified 3D urban world.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HoloWorld，一个统一的室内外城市世界生成框架，基于持续更新的跨尺度世界上下文（world context）。该方法从用户描述出发，逐步表示并更新从城市尺度规划到单体建筑的信息，使生成的室内场景与对应外部建筑保持显式对应，并以自回归方式生成空间组织与视觉形象一致的城市场景。作者称这是首个在连贯 3D 城市世界中统一室内外生成的框架，实验显示其城市外部生成性能优于 SOTA。
Motivation: 现有文本驱动的 3D 生成通常分别合成大规模室外环境与精细室内场景，两个域之间缺乏对应关系，难以形成连贯的城市世界。
Method: HoloWorld 从用户描述初始化，逐步构建跨尺度世界上下文；利用该上下文与已生成邻接街区，自回归生成具有一致空间组织和视觉形象的城市外部；生成的外部表示进一步落实到 3D 建筑实例与足迹上，从而支持受几何约束、继承外观特征的单体建筑内部生成。
Result: 摘要报告 HoloWorld 在城市外部生成上取得优于现有方法的性能，平均 AQS 分数较 SOTA 提升 7.68%，并获得最高平均 RDR 分数，同时在统一 3D 城市世界中保持较强的建筑级室内外对应与跨街区连续性。
Conclusion: 作者认为 HoloWorld 是首个在连贯 3D 城市世界中统一室内与室外生成的框架，能够同时保证建筑级室内外对应和跨街区连续性。

papers.title: MAVISEG: Manifold Propagation and Visual Prototypes for Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary Segmentation in Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion transformers learn about objects and scenes by learning to generate them, making them strong candidates for training-free zero-shot open-vocabulary semantic segmentation. State-of-the-art attribution methods score each pixel independently, comparing its features against a fixed text-derived class representation, whether as an output-space similarity or as a cross-attention weight. This discards structured signals the model itself exposes: the temporal structure of the generative trajectory, the visual appearance statistics of each concept, and the image's own pairwise feature geometry. We present MAVISEG, a training-free refinement layer that recovers these signals. Because its operators consume only a pixel-by-concept score field and a pixel feature space, MAVISEG is capture-agnostic rather than tied to one attribution method. Across six benchmarks it achieves the strongest overall results among training-free methods, including the best mIoU on every benchmark. Interestingly, gains are largest where the initial capture is weakest, and individual operators contribute depending on the noise in the field they refine. Our results indicate that diffusion transformers carry more concept-level information than current attribution methods recover, and that much of it is lost on the way to the mask rather than absent from the model.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 14 figures, 9 tables. Preprint under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MAVISEG，一个免训练的细化层，用于文本到图像扩散 Transformer 的零样本开放词汇语义分割。它通过流形传播（manifold propagation）和视觉原型（visual prototypes）恢复现有逐像素归因方法所丢弃的结构化信号，包括生成轨迹的时间结构、各概念的外观统计以及图像自身的成对特征几何。由于算子只消费逐像素-逐概念的分数场和像素特征空间，MAVISEG 与具体归因方法无关；在六个基准上，它取得免训练方法中的最强总体结果，并在每个基准上达到最佳 mIoU。
Motivation: 现有最先进的归因方法逐像素独立打分，将像素特征与固定的文本派生类表示进行比较（无论是输出空间相似度还是交叉注意力权重），从而丢弃了模型自身暴露的结构化信号，导致扩散 Transformer 中已有的概念级信息在转换为掩码时大量丢失。
Method: MAVISEG 是一种免训练的细化层，其算子只依赖逐像素-逐概念分数场和像素特征空间，因此采用捕获方式无关（capture-agnostic）的设计，而非绑定于特定归因方法。它显式恢复三类信号：生成轨迹的时间结构、每个概念的视觉外观统计，以及图像自身的成对特征几何。
Result: 在六个基准的评估中，MAVISEG 在免训练方法中取得最强的总体结果，并刷新了每个基准上的最佳 mIoU。增益在初始捕获（initial capture）最弱时最大，且各个算子的具体贡献取决于其所细化场中的噪声水平。
Conclusion: 结果表明扩散 Transformer 携带的概念级信息比当前归因方法所能恢复的更多，且其中大部分是在通往掩码的过程中丢失，而非模型本身缺乏这些信息。该文为 20 页预印本，目前处于审稿中。

papers.title: D-CLOT: Double Closed Loop Optimal Transport for Unsupervised Action Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Optimal transport (OT) has emerged as an effective framework for unsupervised action segmentation. Yet, in existing OT-based methods, the latent action prototypes that define the OT costs are not re-estimated from the refined frame geometry. Instead, they evolve solely through gradients from the pseudo-label loss. We identify this \emph{representation--prototype inconsistency} as a central bottleneck, particularly around ambiguous transitions and for short or infrequent actions. To address this issue, we build on the recently introduced CLOT, which refines frame embeddings based on estimated segment embeddings, and further re-estimates the action prototypes from the refined frame embeddings. Specifically, we introduce a graph-constrained module that regularizes the OT-refined frame and segment representations by preserving the local neighborhood geometry of the encoder output. An action-embedding refinement step then periodically re-anchors the prototypes to this stabilized representation geometry. We study two instantiations that share the same backbone, graph module, and objective: D-CLOT updates the prototypes using $k$-means, whereas D-CLOT$_{B}$ updates them as OT barycenters weighted by the refined transport plan, yielding an assignment-aware prototype update consistent with the current transport geometry. Across five established benchmarks, both variants improve segment-level quality over CLOT, with per-video gains of up to $+12.7$ F1 and $+10.2$ mIoU (YTI) and activity-level gains of up to $+8.9$ F1 (FS-Eval). We further establish the first unsupervised action-segmentation baseline on Assembly101, a procedural and substantially more fine-grained benchmark than those commonly used in prior work. Extensive ablations and sensitivity analyses demonstrate that the two refinement mechanisms are complementary and robust.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 D-CLOT，一种用于无监督动作分割 (unsupervised action segmentation) 的双闭环最优传输方法。作者指出现有基于 OT 的方法中动作原型只依赖伪标签损失的梯度更新，导致表示与原型不一致；D-CLOT 在 CLOT 基础上加入图约束模块保持编码器输出的局部邻域几何，并周期性地从精炼表示中重新锚定原型。摘要报告该方法在五个基准上优于 CLOT，并建立了 Assembly101 上的首个无监督动作分割基线。
Motivation: 现有基于最优传输的无监督动作分割方法中，定义 OT 代价的潜在动作原型不会根据精炼后的帧几何重新估计，而只通过伪标签损失的梯度演化；这种表示-原型不一致 (representation–prototype inconsistency) 在模糊过渡段以及短时或低频动作上尤为严重，成为性能瓶颈。
Method: 作者在 CLOT 的基础上，从估计的片段嵌入精炼帧嵌入，再从精炼帧嵌入重新估计动作原型。具体引入图约束模块，通过保留编码器输出的局部邻域几何来正则化 OT 精炼后的帧与片段表示；随后用动作嵌入精炼步骤周期性地将原型重新锚定到稳定的表示几何上。论文给出两种实例：D-CLOT 用 k-means 更新原型，D-CLOT_B 用由精炼传输计划加权的 OT 重心更新原型，后者使原型更新与当前传输几何保持一致。
Result: 在五个既有基准上，两种变体相对 CLOT 都提升了片段级分割质量，其中 YTI 上每视频最高提升 +12.7 F1 和 +10.2 mIoU，FS-Eval 上活动级最高提升 +8.9 F1。论文还首次在比此前常用基准细粒度更高的程序性基准 Assembly101 上建立了无监督动作分割基线，并通过消融与敏感性分析表明两种精炼机制互补且稳健。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过图约束的表示稳定化与周期性原型重锚定构成的双闭环精炼，能够缓解表示-原型不一致，并在包括细粒度程序性视频在内的多种基准上带来稳健提升；两种原型更新方式互补。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Personalized Deep Research Query Refinement with Graph-Scaffolded Evidence Grounding
papers.abstract_en: User requests serve as research specifications for deep research agents, shaping what evidence to seek and how to synthesize it. In personalized deep research, these specifications must additionally reflect user goals, constraints, preferences, and evaluation criteria. User context can be incorporated either within the deep research pipeline or into the research specification provided as its input. We focus on the latter, refining the user request into a personalized research specification before passing it to an unchanged deep research agent. This requires resolving three coupled decisions: which framing factors are relevant, whether the available user context sufficiently supports them, and whether to retrieve user memory, ask the user, or stop and refine the query. For training, G-STEER organizes framing factors as elicitation targets in an Intent Elicitation Graph that captures their dependencies. It learns a clarification policy from graph-scaffolded trajectories spanning diverse factor dependencies and evidence conditions. The policy produces a refined query while balancing target coverage against the costs of evidence acquisition. Experiments show that G-STEER achieves the strongest overall weighted target coverage and the highest downstream report personalization across both evaluated DRAs, while asking roughly one third as many user questions as a strong clarification baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 G-STEER，一种在将用户请求送入深度研究代理（deep research agent）之前将其精化为个性化研究规格的方法。G-STEER 将 framing factors 组织成意图引导图（Intent Elicitation Graph），并学习基于图支撑轨迹的澄清策略，在目标覆盖与证据获取成本之间权衡。实验显示，在两种被评估的深度研究代理上，它取得最强的整体加权目标覆盖和最高的下游报告个性化，同时提问数量约为强澄清基线的三分之一。
Motivation: 个性化深度研究中，用户请求作为研究规格需要反映用户目标、约束、偏好和评价标准，但现有做法要么在深研管线内部融入用户上下文，要么依赖输入规格本身携带这些信息。本文聚焦后者，需要解决三个耦合决策：哪些框架因素相关、现有用户上下文是否充分支撑，以及应检索用户记忆、询问用户还是停止并精化查询。
Method: G-STEER 将框架因素组织为意图引导图（Intent Elicitation Graph）中的 elicitation targets，捕获因素间的依赖关系，并从覆盖多种依赖与证据条件的图支撑轨迹中学习澄清策略。该策略在生成精化查询时平衡目标覆盖与证据获取成本。
Result: 实验表明 G-STEER 在两种评估的深度研究代理（DRAs）上取得最强的整体加权目标覆盖和最高的下游报告个性化，同时提问数量约为强澄清基线（strong clarification baseline）的三分之一。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是，在将请求交给未改动的深度研究代理之前，通过图支撑的澄清策略精化用户请求，可以显著提升个性化效果并降低用户交互负担。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MACRO: Markov Chain Routing of Transformer Layers
papers.abstract_en: Standard Large Language Models (LLMs) execute layers sequentially. Dynamic layer routing, i.e. search for a different execution path through layers involving layer repetitions, skips and other moves, can improve performance. Existing routing approaches often require updating model weights, running expensive search loops per test instance, or demand ground-truth labels during inference. In this work, we propose Markov Chain Routing of Transformer Layers (MACRO), a framework that learns task-specific routes over LLM architectures without modifying underlying parameters. MACRO models layer routing as a context-dependent Markov policy conditioned on layer indices, computation budget phases, directional displacements, and operator context, supporting skip, repeat, and residual hidden-state addition operations. The Markov route distribution is updated via feedback on training data and decoded using a top-k Viterbi algorithm to isolate high-probability candidate programs. We evaluate MACRO across diverse reasoning and knowledge benchmarks on multiple open-weight LLMs. MACRO achieves a +5.0% average accuracy improvement over the unrouted baselines, with largest gains on small models. We outperform the best dynamic routing approach Dr. LLM by +7.2%, while reducing route-search time 9.4x (from 14.8 to 1.6 hours). Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Batorskq/MACRO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MACRO（Markov Chain Routing of Transformer Layers），一种在不修改 LLM 底层参数的前提下学习任务特定层路由（layer routing）的框架。MACRO 将层路由建模为依赖上下文的马尔可夫策略，条件包括层索引、计算预算阶段、方向位移和算子上下文，支持跳跃、重复与残差隐状态加法操作，并通过训练数据反馈更新路由分布、用 top-k Viterbi 算法解码高概率候选程序。在多个开放权重 LLM 的推理与知识基准上，MACRO 相比无路由基线平均准确率提升 +5.0%，并超越动态路由方法 Dr. LLM 达 +7.2%，同时将路由搜索时间从 14.8 小时降至 1.6 小时（9.4 倍加速）。
Motivation: 标准 LLM 按层顺序执行，而通过层重复、跳跃等动态层路由可能提升性能；但现有路由方法常需要更新模型权重、在测试时运行昂贵的搜索循环，或依赖推理时的真实标签，限制了实际使用。
Method: MACRO 将 Transformer 层路由形式化为上下文相关的马尔可夫策略，以层索引、计算预算阶段、方向位移和算子上下文为条件，支持 skip、repeat 与残差隐状态加法操作；路由分布基于训练数据反馈更新，并使用 top-k Viterbi 算法解码出高概率候选程序，全程不修改底层模型参数。
Result: 在多个开放权重 LLM 的推理与知识基准上，MACRO 相对无路由基线平均准确率提升 +5.0%，小模型收益最大；相比当前最佳动态路由方法 Dr. LLM 提升 +7.2%，并将路由搜索时间缩短 9.4 倍（从 14.8 小时降至 1.6 小时）。
Conclusion: 作者强调可以在不改变底层 LLM 参数的情况下学习任务特定路由，从而同时提升准确率与路由搜索效率；代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Improving Interoperability among Defence and National Security Ontologies: Analysis and Evaluation Tasks
papers.abstract_en: The use of ontologies and knowledge graphs is becoming increasingly widespread in the defence and national security domain. Numerous ontologies have been developed through initiatives led by academia, industry, and government. Achieving interoperability across diverse defence and national security ontologies remains a major challenge due to the domain's breadth and specialisation. In this work, we analyse and document over 60 publicly available ontologies and introduce a new track for the Ontology Alignment Evaluation Initiative (OAEI). This track comprises eight matching tasks, consensus alignments and manually-curated (silver-standard) mappings. The consensus alignments are derived by aggregating the outputs of several state-of-the-art ontology alignment systems. The silver-standard is obtained from the manual validation of the consensus alignment together with a subset of the unique mappings (i.e., mappings suggested by only one system).
papers.comment: Paper accepted at the Resource Track, the 25th International Semantic Web Conference (ISWC 2026), 25 - 29 October 2026, Bari, Italy
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析并记录了 60 多个公开可用的国防与国家安全领域本体，并为本体对齐评估计划（OAEI）引入一个新 track，包含 8 个匹配任务、共识对齐（由多个最先进本体对齐系统输出聚合而成）以及人工整理的银标准映射。
Motivation: 国防与国家安全领域已开发出大量来自学术界、工业界和政府机构的本体，但该领域范围广且高度专业化，跨本体的互操作性仍然是重大挑战。
Method: 作者分析并文档化 60 多个公开本体，构建 OAEI 新 track；共识对齐通过聚合多个最先进本体对齐系统的输出来生成，银标准则来自对共识对齐及部分唯一映射（即仅被单个系统提出的映射）的人工验证。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，而是描述所构建的评估资源：包含 8 个匹配任务、共识对齐和人工整理的银标准映射。
Conclusion: 该工作旨在为国防与国家安全本体提供可复用的对齐评估基准，以支持该领域本体互操作性的系统评估与改进。

papers.title: Seeing Is Not Deciding: Can Multimodal LLMs Act as Effective CEOs?
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly applied as autonomous decision-making agents. However, in executive business decisions, existing benchmarks are limited to textonly settings. This makes it unclear whether models can perceive visual business evidence and effectively integrate it to improve decision quality. We introduce C-SUITEBENCH, a controlled multimodal benchmark that includes five decision tasks under paired text-only and multimodal conditions across 50 scenarios. We place nine frontier models in the role of a chief executive officer and evaluate their decision-making ability. Multimodal inputs consistently improve evidence-centric reasoning, with the largest and most reliable gains appearing in risk forecasting and board-facing justification. However, we uncover a multimodal integration paradox: adding visual business information degrades constrained resource allocation for all nine models, even as visual grounding itself improves. Ablation experiments reveal that this failure emerges from signal crowding, although each visual channel helps individually, their combination disrupts constraint satisfaction during decoding. These findings demonstrate that visual perception and constrained action are separable bottlenecks in multimodal agents, and that indiscriminate visual augmentation can harm high-stakes decision making, motivating selective grounding strategies for future executive AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 C-SUITEBENCH，一个受控的多模态 CEO 决策基准，包含 50 个场景下五个决策任务，并分别在纯文本与多模态条件下评估九个前沿大模型。摘要报告多模态输入一致地改善基于证据的推理，尤其在风险预测和面向董事会的论证中增益最大且最稳定；但所有九个模型在受限资源分配任务上出现退化，消融实验将这一失败归因于信号拥挤（signal crowding）。整体表明视觉感知与约束行动是多模态智能体中可分离的瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有高管商业决策基准局限于纯文本设定，无法回答模型能否感知视觉商业证据并将其有效整合以提升决策质量，这一缺口对将 LLM 用作自主决策智能体具有重要意义。
Method: 构建受控多模态基准 C-SUITEBENCH，在 50 个场景中设置纯文本与多模态配对条件，覆盖五个决策任务，并让九个前沿模型扮演首席执行官（CEO）评估决策能力；另通过消融实验检验各视觉通道的组合效应。
Result: 多模态输入一致改善证据中心推理，最大且最可靠的提升出现在风险预测与董事会论证任务；但加入视觉商业信息反而使全部九个模型的受限资源分配表现退化，消融显示每个视觉通道单独有效、组合后却破坏解码期间的约束满足。
Conclusion: 作者认为视觉感知与约束行动是多模态智能体中可分离的瓶颈，不加选择的视觉增强可能损害高风险决策，因此未来高管 AI 系统应采用选择性接地（selective grounding）策略。

papers.title: Runtime Observability for Heterogeneous Attention Memory
papers.abstract_en: Modern models no longer keep a plain KV cache: latent caches, learned sparse selectors and recurrent states each carry the model's memory in a different form, and each fails differently under compression. We give a runtime observability contract that covers all four memory classes with three operators, instantiate it on six model configurations across five architecture families, and compose the per-stage bounds into an executable request-level risk ledger. Contracts carry their error metric as a type -- composition is only defined when metrics match, and this check rejected our own first composed chain; the repaired chain crosses metrics through two proved bridges, and whatever no formal system can certify is measured instead, dropping the composed tier to empirical automatically: every claim is certified, partially certified, or empirical, composition inherits the weakest tier, and the tier is decided by the machine. Replayed over $12.4$M entry reads and run under eight-way concurrency with per-request budgets and fail-closed identity attribution, the ledger quantifies the honest trade-off on today's witness and holds its risk budget with zero violations. A fused always-on probe observes a declared one-layer subset under CUDA graphs inside the serving noise floor. Applied to a served DeepSeek-V4 stack with a packed compressed-KV prototype, the same machinery localizes a silent corruption to a precise structural boundary -- exact in the eviction-free, identity-isolated regime, with every observed failure in an eviction or slot-reuse regime -- through a machine-adjudicated discrimination campaign whose calculus rejected two of our own confounded inferences along the way. All artifacts, guards, and the Lean development are released at https://github.com/metask-ai/witprobe-attention-memory; every number in this paper regenerates from the shipped artifacts by one command.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 5 figures. Code, artifacts, and Lean 4 development: https://github.com/metask-ai/witprobe-attention-memory
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现代模型不再使用单一 KV cache 的情况，提出一个运行时可观测性契约，用三个算子覆盖四类注意力内存（潜在缓存、学习稀疏选择器、循环状态等），并在五个架构族、六个模型配置上实例化。作者把逐阶段误差界组合成可执行的请求级风险账本，错误度量以类型携带，组合仅在度量匹配时成立；无法被形式系统证明的部分自动降级为经验层级，并由机器判定。摘要报告在 12.4M 条目读取和八路并发下账本零违反地保持风险预算，并在 DeepSeek-V4 压缩 KV 原型上把静默损坏定位到精确结构边界。
Motivation: 现代模型的记忆以多种异构形式承载（潜在缓存、稀疏选择器、循环状态等），每种形式在压缩下的失效方式不同，缺乏一套统一的运行时机制来跟踪、区分并核算这些异构内存的风险。
Method: 提出一个运行时可观测性契约，用三个算子覆盖四类内存类；将错误度量作为类型嵌入契约，组合只在度量匹配时定义，否则被拒绝。作者用两个被证明的桥接链实现跨度量组合，并对无法形式化证明的部分自动降级为经验层级，最后把各阶段界组合为请求级风险账本，配合 fail-closed 身份归因和每请求预算执行。
Result: 在 12.4M 条目读取、八路并发下复现时，风险账本保持风险预算且零违反；融合的常开探针在 CUDA graphs 下可以观察声明的一层子集，且处于服务噪声底限内。将其应用于带打包压缩 KV 原型的 DeepSeek-V4 服务栈，定位了一个静默损坏到精确结构边界，机器裁决的判别竞选还拒绝了两条作者自身有混淆的推断。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方案让每个声明被标记为已证明、部分证明或经验性，组合继承最弱层级，层级由机器决定；所有工件、守卫与 Lean 4 开发均已开源，论文中的每个数字可由一条命令从部署工件重新生成。

papers.title: Evidential Rule Learning for Interpretable Classification with Abstention
papers.abstract_en: Interpretable classification often requires more than accurate predictions for real-life deployment: models should be transparent about the evidence behind their decisions and abstain when they cannot decide reliably. We introduce Fast Evidential Rule Learning (FERL), a method that learns interpretable, accurate fuzzy rule models whose outputs are evidential. Unlike post-hoc calibration, FERL's belief, plausibility, and abstention capabilities arise directly from the fuzzy memberships in a single deterministic pass, with no auxiliary head, held-out set, or repeated inference. Our theoretical analysis further shows that FERL is Lipschitz stable, which means that its evidential outputs vary smoothly with the input. Against state-of-the-art rule learners, FERL is statistically significantly more accurate across a 30 tabular-dataset benchmark ($+2.6\%$ average accuracy over the second best). Its native set predictions attain the best utility-discounted accuracy among credal classifiers ($u_{65}/u_{80}=0.80/0.83$ vs.\ $0.79/0.80$ for the naive credal classifier), at higher set coverage ($0.92$ vs.\ $\le0.82$). FERL also matches dedicated out-of-distribution detectors on tabular near-OOD detection ($77.7$ vs.\ $77.4$ AUROC for the strongest baseline). Under detector-class-disjoint concept-bottleneck evaluation, its it is within $2.3$ AUROC points of the strongest dedicated detector on both CUB and AwA2, while attaining the best AwA2 AUPR-Out ($68.3$) and novel-class rejection ($57.2$), while being able to name which attributes are anomalous.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出快速证据规则学习 (Fast Evidential Rule Learning, FERL)，一种可解释且准确的模糊规则分类方法，其输出直接带有证据性质：信念 (belief)、似真性 (plausibility) 与弃权 (abstention) 均由单次确定性前向传播中的模糊隶属度产生，无需辅助头、留出集或重复推理。理论分析证明 FERL 具有 Lipschitz 稳定性，即证据输出随输入平滑变化。在 30 个表格数据集基准上，FERL 相对最先进的规则学习器平均准确率提升 2.6%，并在表格近分布外检测与概念瓶颈评估中接近专用 OOD 检测器的表现。
Motivation: 可解释分类在实际部署中不仅需要准确预测，还要求模型对其决策背后的证据保持透明，并在无法可靠决策时主动弃权；现有方法往往依赖事后校准或额外的辅助组件来实现这些能力。
Method: FERL 直接让信念、似真性与弃权能力来自模糊隶属度，在单个确定性前向过程中完成，不借助辅助头、留出集或重复推理；作者还给出了其 Lipschitz 稳定性的理论证明。
Result: 在 30 个表格数据集上，FERL 相对第二好的规则学习器平均准确率提高 2.6% 且具有统计显著性；其原生集合预测 (set predictions) 在可信分类器中取得最优效用折扣准确率（u65/u80 = 0.80/0.83，而朴素可信分类器为 0.79/0.80），集合覆盖率更高（0.92 vs ≤0.82）。在表格近 OOD 检测上，FERL 与最强专用检测器相当（AUROC 77.7 vs 77.4）；在 CUB 与 AwA2 的 detector-class-disjoint 概念瓶颈评估中，FERL 距离最强专用检测器不超过 2.3 个 AUROC 点，并取得 AwA2 最优 AUPR-Out（68.3）与新类拒绝（57.2），且能指出哪些属性异常。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 FERL 能将证据与弃权能力内建于模糊规则学习过程本身，同时具备准确性、稳定性和原生 OOD/弃权能力，并能命名异常属性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Shape-Aware Oriented Bounding Box (OBB) to Horizontal Bounding Box (HBB) Conversion
papers.abstract_en: Accurate object detection in aerial and satellite imagery is dependent upon the bounding box representation. This is especially true for spatially oriented objects such as ships or aircrafts. Oriented Bounding Boxes (OBB) have a tighter fit and more robust non-max suppression compared to Horizontal Bounding Boxes (HBB), any current post-processing conversion from OBB to HBB either introduces excess empty and background space or removes data from the detection. This paper introduces a novel approach for a shape-aware OBB-to-HBB conversion for ship detection in remote sensing imagery. It leverages hull shape, hull fullness, and the bounding box orientation to produce a tighter axis-aligned HBB representation. The proposed method is benchmarked against three baselines methods for OBBto-HBB conversion, Outer HBB which uses minimum and maximum, Area Equivalent HBB and GBB Marginalized HBB.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对遥感图像中的船舶检测，提出一种形状感知的 OBB 到 HBB 转换方法。作者利用船体形状、船体丰满度以及边界框朝向，生成更紧致的轴对齐 HBB 表示，并与 Outer HBB、Area Equivalent HBB 和 GBB Marginalized HBB 三种基线方法进行对比。摘要未报告具体定量指标。
Motivation: 现有 OBB 到 HBB 的后处理转换在遥感目标检测中要么引入过多空白和背景区域，要么移除部分检测数据，导致表示不够精确。
Method: 提出一种 shape-aware 的 OBB-to-HBB 转换方法，结合 hull shape、hull fullness 和边界框朝向信息，以生成更紧致的轴对齐 HBB。
Result: 摘要仅说明该方法与 Outer HBB、Area Equivalent HBB 和 GBB Marginalized HBB 三种基线进行了基准比较，未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该方法能为遥感船舶检测提供更紧致的 HBB 表示，但未讨论局限性或应用范围。

papers.title: MameLoshnLM: Yiddish Language Model and Evaluation Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: We present MameLoshnLM, the first open-source 8B-parameter language model built specifically for Yiddish. Despite Yiddish's rich textual tradition, its limited digital presence and the scarcity of reliable evaluation resources have constrained progress in Yiddish language modeling. Existing multilingual corpora and benchmarks are often poor proxies for the language, containing substantial amounts of noisy, machine-translated, and misclassified text. We address these gaps by introducing Oytser, a high-quality Yiddish pretraining corpus that combines contemporary web-native sources with literary materials, and Kashes, a multi-task benchmark spanning translation, linguistic analysis, information extraction, and language understanding. Using these resources, we continue pretraining Llama 3.1 8B to obtain MameLoshnLM. Across the tasks in the benchmark, MameLoshnLM outperforms open baselines of similar scale. Our analyses show that these gains are not only quantitative: relative to general-purpose multilingual models, MameLoshnLM better captures language-defining lexical and morphological patterns, pointing to a broader failure mode of noisy web-scale multilingual data for low-resource languages. Our results provide both a foundation for Yiddish NLP and a practical template for language model development in historically rich but digitally underrepresented languages.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MameLoshnLM，首个面向意第绪语（Yiddish）的开源 8B 参数语言模型，并配套发布高质量预训练语料 Oytser 与多任务评测基准 Kashes。作者在 Llama 3.1 8B 上继续预训练得到该模型，在基准任务上优于同规模开放基线，并显示其更准确地捕捉意第绪语的词汇与形态模式。
Motivation: 意第绪语虽有丰富的文本传统，但数字资源稀缺、可靠评测不足，现有多语料库与基准包含大量噪声、机器翻译和错误分类文本，阻碍了该语言建模进展。
Method: 构建 Oytser 高质量预训练语料（结合当代网络来源与文学作品），设计 Kashes 多任务基准（涵盖翻译、语言分析、信息抽取和语言理解），并在 Llama 3.1 8B 上继续预训练得到 MameLoshnLM。
Result: 在 Kashes 基准各项任务上，MameLoshnLM 优于同规模开放基线；分析显示其相对通用多语言模型更好地捕捉语言定义的词汇与形态模式。

papers.title: DTRNet: Dual Text-Radical Decoding for Handwritten Chinese Text Recognition with Faked Character Detection
papers.abstract_en: In K-12 educational scenarios, handwritten Chinese text recognition should not only transcribe student writing, but also detect faked characters. However, existing recognition models are usually confined to a predefined set of normal characters and therefore cannot explicitly identify faked characters. Existing detection methods exhibit complementary limitations: character-level methods provide interpretable structural evidence but suffer from low efficiency, whereas line-level methods are efficient but rely heavily on confidence scores, making them prone to missed detections and lacking explicit structural evidence. Thus, the key challenge is to preserve character-structural evidence independent of contextual inference while maintaining line-level efficiency. To this end, we propose DTRNet, a dual Text-Radical decoding framework for line-level faked character detection. DTRNet decouples context-aware text recognition from character-wise structural verification, where the text branch performs line-level transcription and the radical branch predicts legal Ideographic Description Sequences (IDS) for lexicon-based faked character judgment. We further introduce IDS-Guided Confidence Adjustment (IGCA) to refine text predictions using structural evidence during inference. Experimental results demonstrate that DTRNet effectively detects faked characters while maintaining strong recognition performance and providing interpretable radical-level evidence. Code, checkpoints, and the processed dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/BNU-ERC-ITEA/DTRNet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DTRNet，一个面向 K-12 教育场景的手写中文文本识别框架，在行级转录的同时检测伪造字符 (faked character)。DTRNet 采用双 Text-Radical 解码结构，将上下文感知的文本识别与字符级结构验证解耦，并用 IDS 引导的置信度调整 (IGCA) 融合结构证据。实验表明该方法能有效检测伪造字符，同时保持较强识别性能并提供可解释的 radical 级证据。
Motivation: 现有手写中文识别模型通常局限于预定义的正常字符集，无法显式识别伪造字符；字符级检测方法虽有结构证据但效率低，行级方法高效但依赖置信度分数，容易漏检且缺乏显式结构证据。关键挑战是在保持行级效率的同时保留不依赖上下文推断的字符结构证据。
Method: 提出 DTRNet，双 Text-Radical 解码框架：文本分支负责行级转录，radical 分支预测合法的 Ideographic Description Sequences (IDS) 以进行基于词典的伪造字符判断；并引入 IDS-Guided Confidence Adjustment (IGCA)，在推理时用结构证据修正文本预测。代码、检查点和处理后的数据集已公开。
Result: 实验结果表明 DTRNet 能有效检测伪造字符，同时保持较强的识别性能，并提供可解释的 radical 级证据。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过解耦上下文识别与结构验证，可以在行级效率下实现具有显式结构证据的伪造字符检测，适合教育场景应用。

papers.title: Curia-MAE: Multi-Modal Multi-Anatomy MAE Pre-Training for 3D Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Radiology foundation models learn transferable representations that can be adapted to new tasks by training only small layers on top of a frozen encoder. Dense prediction tasks such as 3D segmentation are, however, underrepresented in their evaluation, and, with the encoder kept frozen, pre-trained models still fall short of nnU-Net, the state-of-the-art reference trained from scratch. To close this gap we extend convolutional MAE pre-training with a robust reconstruction objective, a feature regularizer, and a local-global similarity objective. Using this method, we propose Curia-MAE, a multi-modal, multi-anatomy MAE model pre-trained on 300,000 CT and MRI images covering a large number of anatomical sites. On eight anatomy- and lesion-focused segmentation benchmarks, Curia-MAE improves frozen-encoder performance over a strong MAE baseline, while remaining competitive under full finetuning and superior on lesion tasks, where labeled data is scarce. These results indicate that a single frozen encoder can be reused across diverse segmentation tasks, reducing the cost of adapting and deploying such models in clinical workflows. We will make our pre-trained model weights publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Curia-MAE，一种多模态、多解剖部位的卷积 MAE 预训练模型，用于三维医学图像分割。作者通过扩展卷积 MAE 预训练，加入稳健重建目标、特征正则化器以及局部-全局相似性目标，并在约 30 万张 CT 和 MRI 图像上预训练。在八个解剖与病变分割基准上，Curia-MAE 相比强 MAE 基线提升了冻结编码器性能，全面微调时保持竞争力，并在标签稀缺的病变任务上表现更优。
Motivation: 放射学基础模型通常通过冻结编码器并仅训练小规模头部来适应新任务，但三维分割等密集预测任务在其评估中代表性不足，且冻结编码器性能仍落后于从零训练的 nnU-Net 这一强参考。
Method: 扩展卷积 MAE 预训练，引入稳健重建目标、特征正则化器与局部-全局相似性目标，构建多模态、多解剖部位的预训练模型 Curia-MAE。
Result: 在八个解剖与病变分割基准上，Curia-MAE 的冻结编码器性能优于强 MAE 基线；全面微调下保持竞争力，并在标注数据稀缺的病变任务上表现更好。
Conclusion: 单个冻结编码器可复用于多种分割任务，降低临床工作流中模型的适配与部署成本；预训练权重将公开。

papers.title: Overcoming Attention Drift: Homogeneity-Heterogeneity Guided Feature Aggregation for Low-Light Remote Sensing Image Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Restoring high-fidelity remote sensing imagery from extreme low-light degradation is indispensable for reliable Earth observation and downstream machine vision. However, under severe noise and illumination corruption, existing methods suffer from attention drift, erroneously aggregating features across distinct physical boundaries and causing severe structural blurring and color distortion. To address this, we propose HALO, a dual-prior-driven enhancement framework that formulates enhancement as a guided feature aggregation problem driven by foundation model priors. Specifically, an illumination-invariant semantic prior provides regional homogeneity as a positive bias for content-consistent aggregation, while a pseudo-3D topological prior provides boundary heterogeneity as a negative penalty to strictly prevent cross-boundary confusion. To cooperatively incorporate these two priors, we propose a Homogeneity-Heterogeneity Cooperative Attention Module (H2CAM) to resolve feature conflicts during cross-modal prior fusion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HALO achieves state-of-the-art performance across 8 challenging synthetic and real-world remote sensing benchmarks, significantly improving physical boundary sharpness and color fidelity while maximizing the preservation of discriminative features for downstream Earth observation tasks.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables. Yaozi Zhong and Xingxing Yang contributed equally. Code: https://github.com/AlexYangxx/HALO
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HALO，一种面向极低光照遥感图像增强的双先验驱动框架。针对现有方法在严重噪声与光照退化下出现的注意力漂移 (attention drift) 问题，作者用光照不变语义先验提供区域同质性正偏置、用伪 3D 拓扑先验提供边界异质性负惩罚，并设计 H2CAM 模块协调两种先验的融合。实验在 8 个合成与真实遥感基准上达到 SOTA，改善物理边界清晰度与色彩保真度。
Motivation: 极端低光退化下，现有增强方法容易出现注意力漂移：跨物理边界错误聚合特征，导致结构模糊和色彩失真，从而影响遥感图像在下游机器视觉任务中的可靠性。
Method: 提出 HALO 框架，将低光增强建模为受基础模型先验引导的特征聚合问题。引入光照不变语义先验（区域同质性，作为正偏置）和伪 3D 拓扑先验（边界异质性，作为负惩罚），并设计 Homogeneity-Heterogeneity Cooperative Attention Module (H2CAM) 来协调跨模态先验融合中的特征冲突。
Result: 摘要报告 HALO 在 8 个合成与真实遥感基准上达到 state-of-the-art 性能，显著提升物理边界清晰度与色彩保真度，同时最大化保留用于下游对地观测任务的判别性特征。
Conclusion: 摘要强调同质性正偏置与异质性负惩罚的协同能够克服注意力漂移，为低光遥感图像增强提供有效方案；摘要未提及明确局限。

papers.title: Accurate Localization of Road Traffic Objects on the Road Plane Using Surveillance Camera Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Accurate vehicle localization from monocular roadside surveillance cameras is important for intelligent transportation systems, traffic monitoring, and traffic conflict analysis. Standard approaches often estimate vehicle position from the center of the detector bounding box, which can produce large errors due to perspective distortion and parallax, especially for elevated cameras and large vehicles. This paper proposes a two-stage geometry-aware localization pipeline that estimates the projection of the vehicle footprint onto the road plane. First, vehicles are detected using a YOLO26-based detector. Second, a dedicated ResNet34 regression network predicts four corner points corresponding to the projected vehicle base. The final position is computed as the geometric center of the predicted quadrilateral. The method was trained on synthetic data generated in CARLA and fine-tuned on real-world roadside imagery from DAIR-V2X. Experiments on synthetic and real data showed clear improvements over naive bounding-box-center localization. On DAIR-V2X, the mean image-space localization error decreased from 31.77 px to 15.30 px, a 51.8% improvement, while the median error decreased to 4.29 px. Median ground-plane error for medium-range vehicles decreased from 5.52 m to 0.90 m, and for far-range vehicles from 8.67 m to 1.84 m. The results also show that contextual information surrounding the detector bounding box is important for geometric localization. The largest gains were observed for distant vehicles and geometrically challenging cases affected by strong perspective distortion and parallax.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. Accepted for publication in the proceedings of the 2026 Progress in Applied Electrical Engineering (PAEE) conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对单目路侧监控摄像头的车辆定位问题，提出两阶段几何感知定位流水线：先用YOLO26检测车辆，再用ResNet34回归网络预测车辆投影到路面的四个角点，以预测四边形的几何中心作为最终位置。模型在CARLA合成数据上训练并在DAIR-V2X真实路侧图像上微调，实验显示相比朴素检测框中心定位显著降低了图像空间和地面平面的定位误差。
Motivation: 标准方法通常用检测框中心估计车辆位置，但在路侧摄像头场景下，透视畸变和视差会导致较大误差，尤其是摄像头架设较高或车辆较大时。
Method: 提出两阶段定位流水线：第一阶段用YOLO26检测车辆；第二阶段用专门的ResNet34回归网络预测车辆底座投影的四个角点，最终位置取预测四边形的几何中心。训练使用CARLA合成数据并在DAIR-V2X真实图像上微调。
Result: 在DAIR-V2X上，图像空间平均定位误差从31.77 px降至15.30 px（改善51.8%），中位数误差降至4.29 px；中等距离车辆的地面平面误差中位数从5.52 m降至0.90 m，远距离车辆从8.67 m降至1.84 m。最大增益出现在远距离及强透视畸变和视差影响的几何困难情形。
Conclusion: 摘要强调检测框周围的上下文信息对几何定位很重要，所提方法在远距离和几何挑战场景下改进最明显。

papers.title: A neural operator view on U-Nets for inverse imaging problems
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks have shown great empirical success in the solution of a wide variety of ill-posed inverse problems in imaging. Yet, very few works have studied their behavior in the limit that turns the discretized ill-conditioned problems into truly ill-posed ones, i.e., for an increasing resolution of the discretization. In this work, we review common approaches to neural operator learning in architectures that resemble a U-Net, one of the most common classical architectures for inverse imaging problems. We discuss advantages and drawbacks of the respective approaches, consider a 1D toy example for improved interpretability, and present extensive numerical experiments on how different types of neural operator U-Nets can improve a first (crude) limited angle CT-reconstruction. In particular, we study how well networks trained for a certain resolution of the discretization generalize to other resolutions. Our finding is that while U-shaped neural operator architectures are by design resolution-invariant, the classical U-Net architecture seems to be more robust with respect to resolution changes than expected.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从神经算子（neural operator）的视角审视用于成像反问题（inverse imaging problems）的 U-Net 类架构，关注当离散化分辨率趋于无穷、病态问题变为真正不适定问题时网络的行为。作者综述了 U-Net 中神经算子学习的常见做法，结合 1D 玩具示例，并在有限角度 CT 重建上做大量数值实验，考察网络在不同分辨率训练与测试之间的泛化。核心发现是：U 形神经算子架构在设计上具备分辨率不变性，而经典 U-Net 对分辨率变化的鲁棒性出乎意料地更好。
Motivation: 深度网络在图像反问题中经验上很成功，但很少有工作研究在离散化分辨率不断提高、病态问题趋近真正不适定极限时网络会如何表现；理解该极限行为对网络设计和分辨率泛化很重要。
Method: 综述并比较多种在类 U-Net 架构中实现神经算子学习的方法，讨论各自优缺点；引入一个 1D 玩具问题增强可解释性，并针对一个粗糙的有限角度 CT 重建结果，系统比较不同类型神经算子 U-Net 的改进效果以及跨分辨率泛化能力。
Result: 大量数值实验表明，不同神经算子 U-Net 都能改进粗略的有限角度 CT 重建，并揭示了分辨率泛化特性：U 形神经算子架构天然具有分辨率不变性，而经典 U-Net 对分辨率变化的鲁棒性比预期更强。

papers.title: Controllable Clothing: Precise Labels and Generation for Virtual Try-On with Latent Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: In this technical report, I present a new method for guiding image generation in the context of Virtual- Try-On (VITON). The proposed method leverages new open source Ai models to augment the image data with labels, such as lengths and styles. By training adapters with these labels paired with images of the garments, the model can produce a more diverse set of images that the user can control. For the end user, such as a retailer, this means that they can assure that the produced image is as true to the true fit as possible, not misleading consumers
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于虚拟试穿 (Virtual Try-On) 的引导图像生成方法，利用开源 AI 模型为服装图像补充长度、风格等标签，并基于这些标签与服装图像训练适配器，使生成结果更具可控性和多样性。
Motivation: 虚拟试穿生成结果需要尽可能贴近真实版型，避免误导消费者，但现有方法对生成图像的控制能力有限。
Method: 使用新的开源 AI 模型为图像数据扩充标签（如长度和风格），再将标签与服装图像配对训练适配器，从而引导潜在扩散模型 (latent diffusion model) 生成用户可控的图像。
Result: 摘要未报告具体定量实验数据，仅说明该方法能产生更多样化且可由用户控制的图像，并让最终用户确保图像贴近真实穿着效果。
Conclusion: 该方法面向零售商等终端用户，目标是提升虚拟试穿生成图像的保真度和可控性，减少对消费者的误导。

papers.title: ViSR-KGC: Visual Subgraph Reasoning with Vision-Language Models for Multimodal Knowledge Graph Completion
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge graph completion (KGC) aims to infer missing entities or relations from incomplete graph structures, and has evolved into multimodal knowledge graph completion (MMKGC), where entities are associated with multiple modalities such as text and images. Traditional representation learning approaches follow the embedding-based paradigm and may struggle when relation-specific evidence is limited. Meanwhile, LLM-based reasoning methods typically linearize graph structures into textual prompts, which obscures structural topology and neglects vital visual information. While vision-language models (VLMs) excel at multimodal reasoning, they cannot natively interpret structured graph topology, particularly when it comes to knowledge graphs where nodes and edges carry complex semantics. To bridge this gap, we propose ViSR-KGC, a visual subgraph reasoning approach for KGC. It integrates three complementary capabilities to capture semantic correlations: identifying global topology dependencies via representation learning, analyzing local multimodal evidence using VLMs, and providing necessary commonsense knowledge inherent in pre-trained models. Based on learned multimodal embeddings, our framework first extracts a compact and query-aware subgraph from the MMKG. Then, this subgraph is transformed into a visually interpretable image using a layout strategy selected through empirical comparison.Finally, the visualized subgraph, entity images, textual descriptions, and candidate answers are combined into a unified prompt, enabling the VLM to infer the missing entity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ViSR-KGC，一种面向多模态知识图谱补全 (MMKGC) 的视觉子图推理方法。该方法结合表示学习、视觉语言模型 (VLM) 和预训练模型中的常识知识，先从 MMKG 中提取查询相关的紧凑子图，再将其转换为视觉可解释的图像，并与实体图像、文本描述和候选答案一起组成统一提示，交由 VLM 推理缺失实体。
Motivation: 传统基于嵌入的 MMKGC 方法在关系特定证据有限时效果不佳，而基于 LLM 的推理方法将图结构线性化为文本提示，会破坏拓扑结构并忽略视觉信息；VLM 虽擅长多模态推理，却无法直接理解带复杂语义的知识图谱结构。
Method: ViSR-KGC 集成三种互补能力：用表示学习捕获全局拓扑依赖，用 VLM 分析局部多模态证据，并利用预训练模型固有的常识知识。基于学习到的多模态嵌入，先提取紧凑且查询感知的子图，再通过经验比较选定的布局策略将其可视化为图像，最后将可视化子图、实体图像、文本描述和候选答案组合成统一提示供 VLM 推理。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值或基准结果，仅说明所提框架能够实现上述端到端的缺失实体推理流程。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过将子图可视化并引入 VLM，可以弥合多模态推理与知识图谱结构理解之间的差距。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning to Rank Tensor Network Contraction Plans for GPU-Accelerated Quantum Circuit Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Classical simulation remains essential for developing and validating quantum algorithms, but its cost grows rapidly with circuit size. Tensor-network contraction can reduce this cost by exploiting circuit structure, although its efficiency depends strongly on the chosen contraction plan. On GPUs, plans with similar theoretical complexity may perform very differently because execution also depends on parallelism, reduction structure, memory traffic, and contraction geometry. We present a learning-to-rank framework for selecting efficient contraction plans before executing them. Each plan is represented by structural features derived directly from its sequence of pairwise contractions, and gradient-boosted rankers are trained from GPU measurements using listwise and pairwise objectives. We evaluate the resulting models on diverse circuit families, using separate in-distribution and circuit-family-shift test sets, and compare them with random and MinFill-based baselines. The learned rankers generally identify better plans, with the listwise model providing the strongest overall decision quality. We also study backend shift by comparing empirical plan orderings on two GPU architectures and evaluating the source-trained models on the second device without retraining. The rankings remain substantially, though not perfectly, stable across GPUs, and the models retain useful decision quality. These results support Learning to Rank as a practical way to reduce contraction-plan search, while showing that performance remains partly backend dependent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于学习排序 (learning to rank) 的框架，用于在 GPU 上执行张量网络收缩之前选出高效的收缩方案。每个方案由其逐对收缩序列的结构特征表示，并用梯度提升排序器在 GPU 实测数据上训练，采用 listwise 和 pairwise 目标。摘要报告学习到的排序器通常能选出优于随机和 MinFill 基线的方案，其中 listwise 模型的整体决策质量最强，且跨 GPU 架构的排序大体稳定但仍部分依赖后端。
Motivation: 经典模拟对开发和验证量子算法至关重要，但其代价随电路规模迅速增长；张量网络收缩虽可利用电路结构降低该代价，但效率强烈依赖所选收缩方案。在 GPU 上，理论复杂度相近的方案因并行性、归约结构、内存流量和收缩几何不同而表现差异显著，因此需要一种在执行前选择高效收缩方案的方法。
Method: 提出 learning-to-rank 框架：从每个收缩方案的逐对收缩序列中直接提取结构特征，训练梯度提升排序器 (gradient-boosted rankers)，并采用 listwise 与 pairwise 排序目标；训练数据来自 GPU 实测测量。
Result: 在多种电路族上评估模型，使用独立的分布内 (in-distribution) 和电路族偏移 (circuit-family-shift) 测试集，并与随机及 MinFill 基线比较；学习排序器普遍选出更好的方案，listwise 模型整体决策质量最强。研究还对比了两块 GPU 架构上的经验方案排序，源设备训练的模型在第二块设备上无需重训仍保留有用的决策质量，表明排序跨 GPU 基本稳定但并非完全一致。
Conclusion: 这些结果支持 Learning to Rank 作为减少收缩方案搜索的实用途径，同时也表明方案性能仍部分依赖后端设备。
Relevance: 0
