papers.title: LiteKD-Net: Lightweight Knowledge-Distilled Network for Mobile Image Denoising
papers.abstract_en: Mobile image denoising requires both good restoration quality and low computational cost. In addition, it's annoying to collect large-scale LQ-GT clean pairs. As a result, we propose LiteKD-Net, a lightweight knowledge-distilled network for mobile image denoising. First, a physics-guided noise simulation pipeline generates paired training data by adding pixel crosstalk compared with pipelines applied to cameras. Next, we adapt the Real-ESRGAN to identity-resolution denoising and construct a lightweight Student using Lite-RRDB blocks based on depthwise separable convolutions. Third, feature-level knowledge distillation is applied to transfer the Teacher's restoration capability to the Student without introducing additional inference cost. Experiments on real-world datasets show that our model reaches great reduction in runtime and increase in the inference rate with good restoration quality. Our model also reaches the best in all metrics compared with SwinIR. These results indicate that LiteKD-Net provides a great trade-off between restoration quality and computational efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LiteKD-Net，一个面向移动端图像去噪的轻量级知识蒸馏网络，目标是在保持恢复质量的同时降低计算成本，并避免收集大规模低清-高清 (LQ-GT) 干净配对数据的麻烦。作者用物理引导的噪声模拟管线生成配对训练数据，将 Real-ESRGAN 适配为同分辨率去噪教师网络，并基于深度可分离卷积的 Lite-RRDB 构建轻量学生网络，再通过特征级知识蒸馏将教师能力迁移给学生。实验表明模型在真实数据集上大幅缩短运行时间、提升推理速度，并在所有指标上优于 SwinIR。
Motivation: 移动端图像去噪同时需要好的恢复质量和低计算开销，而收集大规模低清-高清干净配对数据成本很高，这是现有方法在实际部署中的主要障碍。
Method: 方法包含三部分：一是加入像素串扰 (pixel crosstalk) 的物理引导噪声模拟管线以生成配对训练数据；二是将 Real-ESRGAN 适配到同分辨率去噪并用作教师网络；三是基于深度可分离卷积的 Lite-RRDB 构建轻量学生网络，并通过特征级知识蒸馏 (feature-level knowledge distillation) 迁移教师能力而不增加推理开销。
Result: 在真实世界数据集上，该方法显著降低运行时间并提高推理率，同时保持较好的恢复质量；与 SwinIR 相比，在所有评价指标上均取得最优结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为 LiteKD-Net 在恢复质量与计算效率之间提供了良好的权衡，适合移动端图像去噪场景。

papers.title: ABC: Numerical Data Collection under Local Differential Privacy without Prior Knowledge
papers.abstract_en: Local Differential Privacy (LDP) provides strong privacy guarantees for collecting numerical data. A fundamental challenge, however, is that existing LDP mechanisms require a predefined data domain, which is often unknown in practice. This lack of prior knowledge creates a critical dilemma for the data collector: if the chosen domain is too narrow, values outside the range are clipped, leading to information loss. Conversely, if the domain is too wide, excessive noise is added during the privatization process, which degrades the quality of collected data. This highlights the need for methods that can dynamically estimate the data domain. In this work, we propose an adaptive LDP framework that addresses this problem. In our method, each user sends two pieces of information: their perturbed numerical data, and a privatized signal indicating if their original value was clipped by the current domain. By aggregating these signals, our proposed method, Adaptive Bounding of Clipping regions (ABC) method, iteratively adjusts the domain to fit the underlying data distribution without prior knowledge. Our theoretical analysis shows that the estimated data domain converges to an appropriate range. In the empirical evaluation, the results demonstrate that our framework significantly improves the quality of numerical data collection across various datasets and underlying LDP mechanisms. We also show that the estimated range successfully converges in practice and our approach is robust to its hyperparameters through comprehensive ablation studies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对本地差分隐私（LDP）数值数据采集中数据域未知的问题，提出 Adaptive Bounding of Clipping regions (ABC) 自适应框架。每个用户发送扰动后的数值以及一个表示原始值是否被当前域裁剪的私有化信号，数据收集端聚合这些信号迭代调整域范围，无需先验知识。理论分析证明估计数据域收敛到合适区间；实验显示在多个数据集和底层 LDP 机制上显著提升数据质量，并通过消融研究验证超参数鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有 LDP 机制需要预定义数据域，而实际场景中该域往往未知；域过窄会导致值被裁剪从而丢失信息，域过宽则会引入过多噪声、降低收集数据的质量。
Method: 提出 ABC 方法：每个用户发送扰动数值和一个指示原始值是否被当前裁剪域裁剪的私有化信号，收集端通过聚合这些信号迭代调整域边界，使其逐渐贴合底层数据分布。
Result: 理论分析表明估计的数据域收敛到适当范围；实验结果显示该方法在多种数据集和底层 LDP 机制下显著提升数值数据采集质量，且估计范围在实践中成功收敛并对超参数稳健。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法无需先验知识即可动态估计 LDP 数据域并改善收集质量；摘要未明确说明方法的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Subliminal Learning is Non-Semantic Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Subliminal Learning (SL) is a surprising type of generalization displayed by modern language models. It allows the transfer of a bias or behavior from a teacher model to a student by distilling from seemingly unrelated or random synthetic data from the teacher. This presents challenges in ensuring AI systems remain predictable and are trained safely, as standard auditing of the input data would not catch the hidden subliminal signal. Here, we investigate several open questions as to the enabling mechanisms and drivers of SL. First is the nature of the process by which biases are encoded in the data. We find that by adding Gaussian noise to the weights of the teacher and student models, the magnitude of subliminal transfer is increased by a factor of 1.9 in Gemma and 1.3 in Llama, suggesting that non-semantic weight structures play a crucial role. We show that steering vectors can be applied to the teacher to produce subliminal data, in addition to prompting and finetuning as used in previous studies. Analysis of the activations of the student models that have been trained on steered and prompted data demonstrates that students inherit not just the semantic meaning of the teacher's bias, but also the type of intervention that was used to apply it: steered students imitate steering vectors, prompted students do not. Additionally, the gradients of steered subliminal data show a linear correlation with the teacher's steering vectors, showing promise for data auditing. More broadly, as synthetic data becomes central to frontier training pipelines, being able to see the latent signals hidden in training data becomes paramount.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型中的潜意识学习（Subliminal Learning, SL），即学生模型通过蒸馏教师模型生成的看似随机或无关的合成数据，就能继承教师的偏见或行为。作者探索其使能机制，发现对教师和学生模型权重加入高斯噪声后，Gemma 上迁移幅度提升约 1.9 倍、Llama 上提升约 1.3 倍，表明非语义权重结构起关键作用；还证明除提示和微调外，可用转向向量（steering vectors）生成潜意识数据。对学生激活的分析显示，学生不仅继承教师偏见的语义含义，还继承施加干预的类型；转向数据产生的梯度与教师转向向量呈线性相关，可用于数据审计。
Motivation: SL 使标准输入数据审计无法捕捉隐藏信号，给 AI 系统的可预测性和安全训练带来挑战，因此需要弄清偏见如何编码进数据以及哪些机制驱动这一过程。
Method: 通过在教师和学生模型权重上加入高斯噪声，测量潜意识迁移幅度的变化；使用提示、微调以及转向向量生成潜意识数据；分析学生模型的激活模式，并检验转向数据梯度和教师转向向量之间的相关性。
Result: 权重加噪使迁移幅度在 Gemma 和 Llama 上分别增加约 1.9 倍和 1.3 倍；经过转向向量训练的学生模仿转向向量，而经过提示训练的学生则不然；转向数据的梯度与教师转向向量呈线性相关，提示可用于数据审计。
Conclusion: 摘要强调随着合成数据成为前沿训练流程的核心，识别训练数据中隐藏的潜在信号至关重要；SL 的机制与模型的非语义权重结构密切相关。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CircuitSteer: Geometrically Aligned Multi-Layer Steering via Sparse Autoencoder Circuits
papers.abstract_en: Controlling the behavior of large language models (LLMs) remains a critical challenge for AI alignment. Existing steering methods, such as Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA), typically rely on fixed single-layer interventions derived from aggregate activation differences. These methods impose a single intervention across semantically diverse inputs and often fail to sustain consistent behavioral changes across layers, limiting the effectiveness of the steering. In this work, we introduce CircuitSteer, a novel framework that leverages Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to identify and manipulate coherent semantic circuits distributed across multiple layers. By constructing a feature flow circuit based on feature co-activation and the geometric alignment of decoder directions, we isolate the specific multi-layer subcircuits responsible for a target behavior. We then synthesize dense steering vectors from these sparse features and apply multi-point interventions to guide the model's internal semantic trajectory. We evaluate CircuitSteer using contrastive examples across a diverse set of tasks, including toxicity, emotion-intensity, sycophancy, and refusal, spanning two model families. Across all models and datasets, CircuitSteer is the only method to consistently produce fluency-preserving interventions; competing methods either sacrifice text quality or lack coverage, failing entirely on complex behaviors like sycophancy and refusal. These results demonstrate that multi-layer circuit steering, enabled by enforcing geometric alignment among selected features, yields strictly more robust and effective behavioral control than static single-point interventions. Code is available at https://github.com/mehrshad-sdtn/CircuitSteer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CircuitSteer，一个利用稀疏自编码器（Sparse Autoencoders, SAEs）识别并操控跨多层分布的连贯语义电路（circuits）的 LLM 行为控制框架。通过基于特征共激活和 decoder 方向几何对齐构建特征流电路，作者从稀疏特征合成稠密转向向量（steering vectors），并施加多点干预来引导模型内部语义轨迹。在毒性、情绪强度、谄媚（sycophancy）和拒绝（refusal）等任务及两个模型家族上，CircuitSteer 是唯一能持续保持文本流畅性的方法。
Motivation: 现有转向方法如对比激活添加（Contrastive Activation Addition, CAA）通常依赖由聚合激活差异得到的固定单层干预，在语义多样的输入上施加统一干预，且难以在多层间维持一致的行为变化，限制了转向效果。
Method: 利用 SAE 基于特征共激活和 decoder 方向的几何对齐构造特征流电路，定位负责目标行为的多层子电路，再从稀疏特征中合成稠密转向向量，并对多个层施加多点干预。
Result: 在全部模型和数据集上，CircuitSteer 是唯一持续产生保持流畅性干预的方法；对比方法要么牺牲文本质量，要么缺乏覆盖，并且在谄媚和拒绝等复杂行为上完全失效。
Conclusion: 作者认为，通过强制所选特征之间的几何对齐实现的多层电路转向，比静态单点干预能带来更稳健、更有效的行为控制；代码已开源。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Unified Agent: Managing Interactions across Devices
papers.abstract_en: As capabilities rapidly increase, AI agents can move from running inside one app to acting across a user's devices over time. Yet existing agent systems still fall short in this scenario. This is because observations are scattered across devices and moments, but mainstream systems are not designed around this fact: a single agent that treats devices as tools lacks effective state management for all devices across time, and multi-agent systems coordinate across agents but do not maintain the compact carried state a cross-device, cross-time request needs. We argue that the agent should maintain an effectively designed state that organizes engagement evidence, stated facts, and the standing request in a compact, action-ready form for deciding its action given the current observation. To compare state designs, we construct a benchmark of user-agent interaction across devices and time. We instantiate this principle in Unified Agent, a stateful agent that carries interaction evidence across devices and moments and uses it with the current observation to act. In the default setting, it significantly outperforms our adaptations of four published designs. Across changes in multimodal large language model (MLLM) family, capability, and reasoning effort, it remains ahead of all compared systems, demonstrating that the state-design advantage is robust across MLLM settings. Our code and data will be publicly available on GitHub.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文关注 AI 智能体跨设备、跨时间管理用户交互的场景，指出现有系统缺乏对这种分散观测的有效状态管理。作者提出智能体应维护一个紧凑、可直接用于决策的状态，组织交互证据、已陈述事实和当前待办请求，并将该原则实例化为 Unified Agent。摘要报告其在自建基准上显著优于四种已发表设计的适配版本，且优势在多种多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 设置下保持。
Motivation: 现有智能体系统在观测分散于不同设备和时刻的场景中表现不足：单一智能体把设备当工具，缺少跨时间的状态管理；多智能体系统虽能协调，却不维护跨设备、跨时间请求所需的紧凑携带状态。
Method: 提出以有效状态设计为核心的方法，状态以紧凑、可执行的形式组织交互证据、已陈述事实与待办请求；据此实现有状态智能体 Unified Agent，使其携带跨设备与时刻的交互证据并结合当前观测采取行动；同时构建一个跨设备、跨时间的用户-智能体交互基准用于比较不同状态设计。
Result: 在默认设置下，Unified Agent 显著优于对四种已发表设计做的适配版本；在更换 MLLM 家族、能力及推理努力（reasoning effort）的情况下仍领先于所有对比系统，表明状态设计优势对 MLLM 设置具有稳健性。代码与数据将公开在 GitHub。
Conclusion: 作者认为为跨设备、跨时间请求维护紧凑且可执行的状态是关键设计原则，并在多种 MLLM 配置下验证了该状态设计优势的稳健性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Engram-E2VID: Reference-Based Event-to-Video Reconstruction via Generative Activation of Appearance Engrams
papers.abstract_en: Reference-based event-to-video reconstruction aims to recover target RGB frames from a reference frame and the event stream captured over the reference-to-target interval. Although events provide fine-grained temporal cues, they encode sparse and asynchronous log-intensity changes rather than absolute appearance, making faithful reconstruction intrinsically challenging. The central challenge lies in associating event-derived target-time structures with relevant appearance information from the reference frame, especially under complex motion and long temporal intervals. In this work, we propose Engram-E2VID, a structure-guided framework that reconstructs target frames through the generative activation of appearance engrams. Specifically, the reference frame is encoded into token-space appearance engrams, while the event stream and reference context are transformed into a target-time motion-structure scaffold that captures motion boundaries and event-induced structural changes. Within a one-step diffusion backbone, scaffold-derived structural tokens progressively interact with and activate relevant appearance engrams across layers. This token-space association allows target structures to access reference appearance without relying on direct pixel-wise correspondence, while the diffusion prior complements uncertain or newly revealed regions. Across three benchmarks, Engram-E2VID improves PSNR by up to 3.29 dB and reduces LPIPS by up to 0.08 over the strongest same-input baseline, while degrading more slowly as the reconstruction interval increases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Engram-E2VID，一种基于参考帧和事件流重建目标 RGB 帧的结构引导框架。方法将参考帧编码为 token 空间的外观印记（appearance engrams），并将事件流与参考上下文转换为目标时刻的运动结构支架，在单步扩散骨干中让结构 token 逐层激活相关印记。在三个基准上，PSNR 最高提升 3.29 dB，LPIPS 最多降低 0.08，且随重建区间增大性能退化更慢。
Motivation: 事件流只提供稀疏、异步的对数光强变化而非绝对外观，参考帧与事件导出的目标时刻结构之间缺乏直接对应关系，导致复杂运动和长时间隔下的事件到视频重建困难。
Method: 提出结构引导的生成式激活框架：参考帧被编码为 token 空间外观印记，事件流与参考上下文生成目标时刻运动结构支架以捕获运动边界和结构变化；在一阶扩散骨干中，支架 token 跨层逐步交互并激活相关印记，实现无需像素级对应的 token 空间关联，并用扩散先验补全不确定或新暴露区域。
Result: 在三个基准上，与最强的同输入基线相比，Engram-E2VID 将 PSNR 最高提升 3.29 dB，将 LPIPS 最多降低 0.08，且重建时间间隔增加时性能下降更慢。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 token 空间关联使目标结构无需直接像素对应即可访问参考外观，并借助扩散先验处理新区域，从而在复杂运动和长间隔条件下实现更稳健的重建。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LILAC: An Idempotent Neural Speech Codec
papers.abstract_en: Neural Audio Codecs are widely adopted in speech generation and editing. However, existing neural audio codecs are not idempotent: across the paper's twelve baseline systems, every configuration tested rewrites, on average, at least 15% of its tokens in a single decode-re-encode pass. This poses a problem for utilizing Neural Audio Codecs as token interfaces in pipelines where re-encoding decoded outputs can occur. We present LILAC, a fully convolutional 24 kHz speech codec at 9.375 Hz and 0.75 kbit/s that is codec idempotent by construction; re-encoding the decoded audio of any valid token stream returns the identical stream. LILAC achieves idempotency while maintaining competitive quality, reaching UTMOS 4.14 and 4.24 on LibriSpeech and LibriTTS-R test sets, comparable to SOTA sub-1 kbit/s Neural Audio Codecs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LILAC，一种按构造具备幂等性 (idempotent) 的神经语音编解码器，工作于 24 kHz、9.375 Hz 和 0.75 kbit/s。作者指出现有神经音频编解码器在单次解码-重编码过程中会重写至少 15% 的 token，而 LILAC 对任意合法 token 流重编码后返回完全相同流。摘要报告其在 LibriSpeech 和 LibriTTS-R 测试集上达到 UTMOS 4.14 和 4.24，与 SOTA 亚 1 kbit/s 神经编解码器相当。
Motivation: 现有神经音频编解码器不具幂等性：在语音生成和编辑流水线中，若将编解码器用作 token 接口并对解码输出进行重编码，每次操作都会重写相当比例的 token，影响下游稳定性。
Method: 提出 LILAC，一个全卷积 (fully convolutional) 24 kHz 语音编解码器，以 9.375 Hz 和 0.75 kbit/s 运行，并通过构造保证编解码幂等性，使解码音频重编码后得到与原始输入完全一致的 token 流。
Result: 论文评估的十二个基线系统在单次解码-重编码中平均至少重写 15% 的 token；LILAC 在 LibriSpeech 和 LibriTTS-R 测试集上分别达到 UTMOS 4.14 和 4.24，质量与 SOTA 亚 1 kbit/s 神经音频编解码器相当。
Conclusion: 摘要强调编解码器幂等性可以与竞争性语音质量兼得，适用于需要重复重编码解码输出的语音生成与编辑流水线。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 论文评估的十二个基线系统在单次解码-重编码中平均至少重写 15% 的 token；LILAC 在 LibriSpeech 和 LibriTTS-R 测试集上分别达到 UTMOS 4.14 和 4.24，质量与 SOTA 亚 1 kbit/s 神经音频编解码器相当。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调编解码器幂等性可以与竞争性语音质量兼得，适用于需要重复重编码解码输出的语音生成与编辑流水线。

papers.title: Sparse Mutual Information Graph Averaging for Improving Random Indexing Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Sparse word embedding pipelines can avoid dense co-occurrence matrix materialization, dense factorization, and gradient training while still relying on sparse global corpus statistics. This paper studies Random Indexing (RI) vectors refined by weighted averaging on a sparse Positive Pointwise Mutual Information (PPMI) graph. On a fairytales corpus, the covered semantic analogy set consists of 272 Google family- category questions. On this family subset, PPMI top-K graph averaging repairs a weak RI initialization, improving accuracy from 19.4+-0.7% to 30.7+-2.9% across five seeds. Under the single tested runs, the same neighborhood averaging reduces family- subset analogy accuracy for PPMI+SVD (singular value decom- position), Binary+SVD, CBOW, and Skip-gram. Thus the method is not competitive with neural baselines on text8 and gives near- zero strict similarity correlation on SimLex-999. While Bloom filter sketches underperform RI in the tested configuration, we find that PPMI graph averaging with top-K pruning is a useful non-gradient repair for weak RI embeddings. On the fairytales dataset, PPMI top-K=50 graph averaging improves RI with accuracy going from 19.4+-0.7% to 30.7+-2.9%, and performing best with a seed42 of 34.6%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究用稀疏 PPMI 图上的加权平均来精炼 Random Indexing (RI) 词嵌入。在 fairytales 语料上的 272 个 Google family 类比子集上，PPMI top-K 图平均将 RI 的准确率从 19.4±0.7% 提升到 30.7±2.9%（五个种子），seed42 下最好为 34.6%；但对 PPMI+SVD、Binary+SVD、CBOW、Skip-gram 等基线会降低同类类比准确率，且在 text8 上与神经基线不具竞争力，在 SimLex-999 上严格相似度相关接近零。
Motivation: 稀疏词嵌入管线可避免稠密共现矩阵、稠密分解和梯度训练，但仍依赖稀疏全局语料统计。本文针对弱 RI 初始化的修复问题，研究基于稀疏 PPMI 图的邻域加权平均是否能改善嵌入质量。
Method: 在稀疏 Positive Pointwise Mutual Information (PPMI) 图上对 RI 向量做 top-K 邻域加权平均，作为非梯度 (non-gradient) 修复手段，并与 Bloom filter 草图及若干神经/矩阵分解基线对比。
Result: 在 fairytales 语料上，PPMI top-K=50 图平均使 RI 在 272 个 Google family 类比的准确率从 19.4±0.7% 提升到 30.7±2.9%，seed42 下最佳为 34.6%；同样的邻域平均在单次测试中降低 PPMI+SVD、Binary+SVD、CBOW 和 Skip-gram 的 family 子集类比准确率，在 text8 上不敌神经基线，在 SimLex-999 上严格相似度相关接近零。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 PPMI 图平均配合 top-K 剪枝是对弱 RI 嵌入有用的非梯度修复，但该方法整体上不具与神经基线的竞争力，且 Bloom filter 草图在测试配置下不如 RI。

papers.title: PhyLatent: Learning Dynamics-Relevant Representations for JEPA World Models
papers.abstract_en: We propose PhyLatent, a dynamics-relevant training objective for JointEmbedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) world models. Our key observation is that preventing global latent collapse does not ensure that a representation preserves physical states and action consequences. We identify three failure modes in JEPA world models: physical invariance collapse, physical identifiability collapse, and counterfactual dynamics collapse. PhyLatent addresses them through three training pathways: physical invariance, physical identifiability, and counterfactual dynamics, implemented with physical state grounding, future representation alignment, static visual invariance, counterfactual branch separation, and latent denoising. On OGBench-Cube, PhyLatent reduces the three failure rates from 15.60%, 6.71%, and 8.41% to 7.53%, 0.95%, and 4.62%, respectively, and improves model predictive control (MPC) success from 70.0% to 78.1%. With the same architecture and planner, it further improves success from 81.0% to 98.0% on TwoRooms and remains competitive on Reacher and PushT. These results show that global non-collapse alone is insufficient for learning a reliable JEPA worldmodel state space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PhyLatent，一种针对 JEPA 世界模型的动力学相关训练目标。作者指出仅仅避免全局潜在表征坍缩 (global latent collapse) 并不能保证表征保留物理状态与动作后果，并识别出物理不变性坍缩、物理可辨识性坍缩和反事实动力学坍缩三种失效模式。在 OGBench-Cube 上，PhyLatent 将三类失效率分别从 15.60%、6.71%、8.41% 降至 7.53%、0.95%、4.62%，并将模型预测控制 (MPC) 成功率从 70.0% 提升到 78.1%；在 TwoRooms 上从 81.0% 提升到 98.0%，在 Reacher 和 PushT 上保持竞争力。
Motivation: 现有 JEPA 世界模型的训练目标主要关注全局非坍缩，但全局非坍缩不足以保证表征保留物理状态和动作后果，导致世界模型状态空间不可靠。
Method: 提出 PhyLatent，包含三条训练路径：物理不变性 (physical invariance)、物理可辨识性 (physical identifiability) 和反事实动力学 (counterfactual dynamics)，并通过物理状态锚定、未来表征对齐、静态视觉不变性、反事实分支分离和潜在去噪实现。
Result: 在 OGBench-Cube 上，三种失效率从 15.60%、6.71%、8.41% 降至 7.53%、0.95%、4.62%，MPC 成功率从 70.0% 提升到 78.1%；在 TwoRooms 上从 81.0% 提升到 98.0%，并在 Reacher 和 PushT 上保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调全局非坍缩不足以构建可靠的 JEPA 世界模型状态空间，物理动力学相关的训练目标能显著提升下游控制性能。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Iterative Hybrid Discrete-Continuous Viewpoint Planning for UAV Photogrammetry
papers.abstract_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) photogrammetry requires camera networks that provide sufficient surface coverage, image overlap, parallax, and resolution, yet conventional flight patterns are often poorly adapted to scene geometry resulting in local reconstruction errors. This paper proposes an iterative hybrid discrete-continuous viewpoint planning method for targeted UAV photogrammetry from a proxy reconstruction. The method scores sampled surface points using photogrammetric heuristics based on frontality, imaging distance, parallax, and multi-view observation count, while also evaluating the full viewpoint set in terms of visibility, pairwise overlap, and graph connectivity. Candidate viewpoints are generated around weakly observed regions, refined using clustered Covariance matrix adaptation evolution strategy (CMA-ES) optimisation, and removed when redundant. The final flight path combines close-range detail viewpoints with wider model-coverage viewpoints, balancing local reconstruction quality with global image-network robustness. Evaluation on three synthetic scenes shows that the proposed method improves both reconstruction accuracy and completeness compared with prior UAV path-planning methods.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Accepted for publication at the 14th IEEE European Conference on Visual Information Processing (EUVIP 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无人机摄影测量中常规航线难以适配场景几何、导致局部重建误差的问题，提出一种基于代理重建 (proxy reconstruction) 的迭代混合离散-连续视点规划方法。方法用摄影测量启发式评分采样表面点，并评估整个视点集的可见性、成对重叠与图连通性；弱观测区域周围生成候选视点，经聚类 CMA-ES 优化并去除冗余，最终航线结合近距细节视点与广覆盖视点。在三个合成场景上的评估显示，该方法相较已有无人机路径规划方法同时提升了重建精度与完整性。
Motivation: 常规无人机飞行模式往往不能适应场景几何，造成表面覆盖、重叠、视差和分辨率不足，从而产生局部重建误差，需要面向目标场景的自适应视点规划。
Method: 提出迭代混合离散-连续视点规划：利用基于正面性 (frontality)、成像距离、视差和多视角观测计数的摄影测量启发式对采样表面点评分，同时从可见性、成对重叠和图连通性评估完整视点集；围绕弱观测区域生成候选视点，使用聚类 CMA-ES 优化细化，并删除冗余视点，最终融合近距细节视点与广覆盖视点。
Result: 在三个合成场景上的评估表明，与已有 UAV 路径规划方法相比，该方法同时改善了重建精度和重建完整性。
Conclusion: 作者认为将局部重建质量与全局图像网络鲁棒性相结合是提升无人机摄影测量效果的可行路线，但评估仅限于三个合成场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BlockPython: A Process-Aware Agent-Supported Platform for the Transition from Block-Based to Python Programming
papers.abstract_en: The transition from block-based to text-based programming requires learners to convert visible program structures into abstract textual expressions, which may create a cognitive gap between understanding computational concepts and expressing them in Python syntax. To support this transition, we designed and implemented BlockPython. The platform centers on bidirectional translation between blocks and Python and guides learners through four stages: Task Decomposition, Block-Based Practice, Code Challenge, and Extended Interaction. Across these stages, learners progressively establish connections among program structure, runtime behavior, and textual code. During learning, the platform continuously collects process evidence, including block artifacts, code versions, run outcomes, use of support, and dialogue. Deterministic diagnosis, program visualization, and the learning assistant use this evidence to identify different difficulties in computational understanding and Python expression. The rule-based system is responsible for program execution, objective evaluation, and stage control, while the learning assistant uses verified evidence to provide explanations, prompts, and guiding questions. This report describes the design rationale, learning workflow, and process-aware support mechanisms of BlockPython and provides a system-design reference for supporting the transition from block-based to text-based programming and for analyzing learning processes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 BlockPython，一个用于支持学习者从块编程 (block-based) 过渡到文本 Python 编程的平台。平台以块与 Python 之间的双向翻译为核心，设计了任务分解、块编程练习、代码挑战和扩展交互四个学习阶段，并在过程中持续收集块产物、代码版本、运行结果、支持使用情况和对话等过程证据。规则系统负责程序执行、客观评估与阶段控制，学习助手则基于经过验证的证据提供解释、提示和引导性问题。文章主要给出设计理由、学习工作流和过程感知支持机制的系统设计参考。
Motivation: 从块编程转向文本编程需要学习者把可见的程序结构转换为抽象的文本表达，这可能在理解计算概念与用 Python 语法表达之间造成认知鸿沟，现有支持手段对此过渡过程的分析不足。
Method: 设计与实现 BlockPython 平台，核心是块与 Python 的双向翻译，并通过四个学习阶段引导学习者逐步建立程序结构、运行行为和文本代码之间的联系。平台持续收集过程证据，由规则系统执行确定性诊断和阶段控制，同时结合程序可视化与学习助手，利用验证过的证据识别计算理解和 Python 表达方面的不同困难并提供支持。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果，主要贡献是系统设计描述；该报告提供了支持块到文本编程过渡及学习过程分析的系统设计参考。
Conclusion: 文章强调其价值在于呈现 BlockPython 的设计理由、学习工作流和过程感知支持机制，为后续构建相关学习平台与分析学习过程提供参考框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hijacking Robots with a Piece of Paper: A Systematic Study of Physical Prompt Injection in VLM-Controlled Robots
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed as planners in robotic systems, where they translate natural-language commands into executable actions grounded in visual scene understanding. This tight coupling between perception and instruction-following introduces a new attack surface: adversarial text placed within the robot's visual field can act as an indirect prompt injection into the VLM's reasoning stack. We present a systematic study of physical prompt injection attacks against VLM-controlled sorting, introducing a four-category taxonomy, indirect signage, task redefinition, authority impersonation, and conflict injection, instantiated as a benchmark of 20 attack prompts evaluated across three physical scene layouts and three command formulations that vary in destination specificity and rule explicitness. Across 5,670 trials on three frontier VLMs (GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Qwen3-VL-32B), attacks succeed at 27.0%, 29.4%, and 5.0% respectively, with authority-impersonating and negation attacks transferring across all three models. Analysis of reasoning traces reveals that successful compromise is nearly always conscious (99.9% acknowledgment rate), and that models defend through structurally different mechanisms, explicit rejection for Gemini, perceptual inattention for GPT-4o. We evaluate three simple mitigations: prompt-based defense (75-100% effective, model-dependent), two-stage verification (85-100%), and pre-processing text masking (100%). Our findings show that VLM-controlled manipulation is meaningfully vulnerable to human-readable physical signage, and that simple defenses substantially reduce risk, though defense choice involves trade-offs. The defenses preserve general task capabilities in our benchmark, but they may impair tasks that require reading in-scene labels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了针对 VLM 控制机器人的物理提示注入 (physical prompt injection) 攻击。作者提出四类攻击分类学（间接标识、任务重定义、权威冒充、冲突注入），构建包含 20 条攻击提示的基准，并在三个物理场景布局和三种指令形式下对 GPT-4o、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Qwen3-VL-32B 进行 5,670 次试验，攻击成功率分别为 27.0%、29.4% 和 5.0%。作者还评估了三种简单防御手段，并分析模型推理轨迹以解释攻击成功与防御机制。
Motivation: VLM 越来越多地被用作机器人规划器，将视觉场景理解与指令执行紧密耦合，这使得放置在机器人视野内的对抗性文本可能成为对 VLM 推理栈的间接提示注入；此前缺乏对此类物理攻击的系统性研究。
Method: 提出四类攻击分类学（间接标识、任务重定义、权威冒充、冲突注入），实例化为覆盖 20 条攻击提示的基准，结合三种物理场景布局和三种在目标指定性与规则明确性上不同的指令形式；在三个前沿 VLM 上运行 5,670 次试验，分析推理轨迹，并评估基于提示的防御、两阶段验证和文本掩码预处理三种缓解手段。
Result: GPT-4o、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Qwen3-VL-32B 的攻击成功率分别为 27.0%、29.4% 和 5.0%，权威冒充和否定类攻击可跨模型迁移；成功攻击的推理轨迹几乎总是有意识妥协（99.9% 的确认率），Gemini 表现为显式拒绝，GPT-4o 表现为感知忽视。三种防御的有效性分别为 75-100%、85-100% 和 100%（文本掩码）。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 VLM 控制的机械操作对可读的物理标牌存在显著脆弱性，简单防御能大幅降低风险，但防御选择存在权衡；这些防御在本基准中保持通用任务能力，但可能损害需要读取场景内标签的任务。

papers.title: RA-CAD: Learning Post-Execution Critique for State-Aware Text-to-CAD Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-CAD generation translates natural-language design intent into editable and executable parametric computer-aided design (CAD) codes, reducing the expertise and effort required for manual modeling. Existing methods incorporate fixed, externally supplied, prompt-induced, or separately optimized critique mechanisms to optimize the generation process, but they do not necessarily optimize how feedback is interpreted and translated into effective corrective actions throughout the generation process. To bridge this feedback-utilization gap, we present RA-CAD (ReAct Agent for CAD), a state-aware agent that interacts with the CAD environment through a Generate--Execute--Critique--Rewrite loop. At each iteration, RA-CAD executes the current code and observes its outcome. Conditioned on the design instruction, current code, and execution feedback, the agent then generates an explicit post-execution critique as an intermediate policy action. This critique either validates the current result for termination or provides revision-oriented guidance that conditions the next rewrite. CAD Code Bootstrapping (CCB) first establishes fundamental parametric CAD coding capabilities through supervised fine-tuning. Feedback-Driven Agent Optimization (FAO) subsequently applies trajectory-level Group Relative Policy Optimization to both policy-generated code and critique sequences, assigning terminal F1 and Chamfer Distance rewards to the complete interaction trajectory. This formulation makes critique an outcome-aligned, learnable policy decision rather than an unoptimized auxiliary output. Experiments on CADFusion and Text2CAD show that RA-CAD achieves state-of-the-art execution validity and geometric quality compared with existing methods and strong proprietary language models, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed state-aware text-to-CAD agent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RA-CAD（ReAct Agent for CAD），一个与 CAD 环境交互的状态感知智能体，通过 Generate–Execute–Critique–Rewrite 循环迭代生成参数化 CAD 代码。每次迭代中，智能体执行当前代码并观察结果，基于设计指令、当前代码和执行反馈生成显式的执行后批评（post-execution critique），作为中间策略动作来验证终止或指导重写。训练分两阶段：CAD Code Bootstrapping（CCB）用监督微调建立基础能力，Feedback-Driven Agent Optimization（FAO）用轨迹级 GRPO 联合优化代码与批评序列。在 CADFusion 和 Text2CAD 上实现了执行有效性和几何质量的最先进结果。
Motivation: 现有 text-to-CAD 方法依赖固定、外部提供、提示诱导或单独优化的批评机制来优化生成过程，但没有系统优化反馈如何被解释并转化为有效修正动作，存在反馈利用缺口。
Method: 提出状态感知的 ReAct 风格智能体，在 Generate–Execute–Critique–Rewrite 循环中与环境交互；先通过 CCB 监督微调建立基础 CAD 编码能力，再通过 FAO 用轨迹级 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）对策略生成的代码和批评序列进行联合优化，以终止 F1 和 Chamfer Distance 作为轨迹奖励。
Result: 在 CADFusion 和 Text2CAD 基准上，RA-CAD 相对于现有方法和强闭源大语言模型取得了最先进的执行有效性和几何质量。
Conclusion: 本文将批评视为与结果对齐、可学习的策略决策而非未优化的辅助输出，验证了状态感知 text-to-CAD 智能体的有效性。

papers.title: Shaping Human-AI Interactions to Provide Improvement Pathways and Balance Competing Objectives
papers.abstract_en: When an AI system is deployed, the individuals who use and or are evaluated by it form beliefs about how the system operates and use those beliefs to strategically present their preferences, behaviors, or attributes. The system then responds with feedback or a decision outcome, thereby creating a human-AI interaction loop. This thesis studies how to design and shape such interactions to achieve three goals: (1) help individuals develop accurate beliefs about the AI systems so they can improve and or secure favorable outcomes at minimal cost, (2) encourage improvement and or discourage gaming behaviors, and (3) ensure that the AI system continues to achieve its intended objectives, such as maximizing accuracy. To address these goals, the thesis is organized into three complementary parts that examine and study human-AI interactions from the perspectives of both evaluated individuals and AI systems. Together, the work presented in this thesis advances human-centered machine learning by providing principles and methods for designing AI systems that align with human needs, values, and capabilities. Methodologically, this thesis integrates theoretical analysis, data-driven modeling, human-subject experiments, and empirical evaluations on real-world and semi-synthetic datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本论文研究如何设计与塑造人类与AI系统之间的交互回路，目标包括帮助个体形成对系统的准确信念、促进改进并抑制博弈行为，同时确保AI系统继续实现其预定目标（如最大化准确性）。论文从被评估个体与AI系统两个视角出发，整合理论分析、数据驱动建模、人类受试者实验以及真实与半合成数据的实证评估，推进以人为本的机器学习。
Motivation: AI系统部署后，使用者或被评估者会形成对系统运行方式的信念，并据此策略性地呈现自己的偏好、行为或属性，系统再给予反馈或决策结果，形成交互回路。这种回路可能造成信念失真、博弈行为或系统目标偏移，因此需要设计原则来引导交互朝良性方向发展。
Method: 论文以博士论文形式组织为三个互补部分，分别从被评估个体和AI系统的视角研究人类-AI交互，方法论上整合理论分析、数据驱动建模、人类受试者实验以及真实与半合成数据集上的实证评估。
Result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，仅说明工作提出了一套设计原则与方法，目标是在帮助个体以最小成本改进或获得有利结果的同时，抑制博弈行为并维持AI系统的预定目标。
Conclusion: 作者强调该论文通过提供设计与塑造人类-AI交互的原则和方法，推进了以人为本的机器学习，使AI系统与人类需求、价值观和能力对齐。

papers.title: One Ranking, Any Budget: Matryoshka Evidence-to-Context Frame Selection for Long-Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Frame selection is essential for applying Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) to long videos due to severe frame redundancy and limited context windows. Since the appropriate frame budget varies with the downstream LMM, reasoning demands, and latency constraints, a practical selector should serve multiple budgets. However, existing methods typically optimize an isolated frame subset for each predefined budget: when the budget changes, previously selected evidence may be replaced rather than progressively augmented. Ranking frames by a fixed score would allow prefix reuse across budgets, but it ignores the distinct roles of different ranking positions. In this paper, we formulate long-video frame selection as a Matryoshka ranking problem: constructing a single priority sequence whose small prefixes concentrate query-conditioned evidence, while progressively larger prefixes preserve this evidence and add broader temporal context. Efficiently constructing such a ranking is itself challenging, as densely sampling long videos and evaluating frame-query relevance incurs substantial overhead. We therefore introduce Matryoshka Evidence-to-Context (MEC) Frame Selection, a training-free framework that builds a reusable sparse video index, discovers candidates through sparse probing and local zooming, and greedily constructs a position-adaptive ranking: early positions emphasize evidence; later positions progressively favor temporal coverage while preserving visual diversity. A single ranking can thus be truncated to any target budget without rerunning the selector. Across four benchmarks and six frame budgets, MEC improves average accuracy over uniform sampling by 3.77 percentage points, matches strong state-of-the-art selectors, and reduces end-to-end selection latency by 47.37-51.19%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Matryoshka Evidence-to-Context (MEC) Frame Selection，一种免训练的长视频帧选择框架，用于解决大多模态模型 (LMMs) 在有限上下文窗口中处理长视频时的帧冗余问题。MEC 构建可复用的稀疏视频索引，通过稀疏探测 (sparse probing) 与局部放大 (local zooming) 发现候选帧，并贪心构造位置自适应排序：靠前位置集中查询相关的证据帧，靠后位置逐步补充时序覆盖并保持视觉多样性。该单一排序可在任意目标预算下直接截断使用，无需重跑选择器。
Motivation: 现有帧选择方法通常为每个预定义预算分别优化一个孤立子集，预算变化时已有证据可能被替换而非逐步扩充；而按固定分数排序虽支持前缀复用，却忽略了不同排序位置应承担的不同作用。实际应用中预算会随下游 LMM、推理需求和延迟约束变化，因此需要一个能同时服务多种预算的选择器。
Method: 将长视频帧选择形式化为 Matryoshka ranking 问题，即构造单一优先级序列，使小前缀集中查询条件证据，逐渐增大的前缀保留证据并补充更广的时序上下文。为此引入免训练框架 MEC：先构建可复用稀疏视频索引，再通过稀疏探测与局部放大发现候选帧，最后贪心地构造位置自适应排序，早期位置强调证据、后期位置逐步偏向时序覆盖并保持视觉多样性。
Result: 在四个基准和六个帧预算上，MEC 相比均匀采样平均精度提升 3.77 个百分点，与强状态选择器 (state-of-the-art selectors) 性能相当，并将端到端选择延迟降低 47.37%-51.19%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调单一排序可被截断到任意目标预算而无需重跑选择器，这是一种免训练、预算无关 (budget-agnostic) 的长视频帧选择方案，适用于 LMM 驱动的长视频理解场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LAWM-3D: Learning 3D-Aware Latent Actions from Human Videos for Generalizable Robot World Models
papers.abstract_en: World models enable agents to perform forward rollout and planning without real-world interaction. However, their application in open-world embodied intelligence remains limited by the high cost of action annotations and the heterogeneity of action spaces across platforms. Recently, latent action models (LAMs) have alleviated this bottleneck by learning action representations directly from unlabeled human videos in a self-supervised manner. Nevertheless, most existing LAMs rely on single-view inputs and operate primarily in 2D pixel space, raising a fundamental question: can simply incorporating multi-view videos into LAM training endow the learned latent actions with 3D-aware perception? Our study shows that the answer is negative. The primary reasons lie in future-frame appearance leakage as well as inter-camera appearance discrepancies and viewpoint variations. To address these issues, we propose LAWM-3D, which introduces three tightly coupled key designs: (1) a multi-view invariant unified action tokenization scheme for learning 3D-aware latent actions; (2) a geometric alignment constraint that anchors intermediate encoder features to a pretrained 3D foundation model, thereby explicitly providing cross-view geometric correspondences; and (3) a non-injective RGB-D joint reconstruction objective that prevents shortcut learning from future-frame appearance information, forcing the LAM to focus supervision on motion cues with geometric significance. Importantly, these components are not simply stacked but are tightly coupled through a unified motivation. Built upon a two-stage paradigm of large-scale human video pretraining followed by robot fine-tuning, extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed 3D-aware latent actions significantly improve world model performance, achieving SOTA results in generation quality, physical consistency, and generalization ability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LAWM-3D，一种从人类视频中学习 3D 感知潜在动作（latent actions）的方法，用于增强机器人世界模型（world models）的泛化能力。作者通过实验表明，简单地将多视角视频加入潜在动作模型训练并不能直接带来 3D 感知能力，原因在于未来帧外观泄漏和相机间外观/视角差异；为此设计了多视角不变动作分词、几何对齐约束和非单射 RGB-D 联合重建目标三个紧密耦合的模块，并在大规模人类视频预训练加机器人微调的两阶段范式下取得 SOTA 效果。
Motivation: 开放世界具身智能中，世界模型的应用受限于动作标注成本高和跨平台动作空间异质。潜在动作模型（latent action models, LAMs）可通过无标注人类视频自监督学习动作表示，但现有 LAM 多依赖单视角输入并在 2D 像素空间运作；论文质疑简单地加入多视角视频是否就能赋予 3D 感知能力。
Method: 提出 LAWM-3D，包含三个紧密耦合的设计：(1) 多视角不变统一动作分词方案，学习 3D 感知潜在动作；(2) 几何对齐约束，将中间编码器特征锚定到预训练 3D 基础模型以获得跨视角几何对应；(3) 非单射 RGB-D 联合重建目标，防止从未来帧外观信息中走捷径，迫使模型关注具有几何意义的运动线索。训练采用大规模人类视频预训练后接机器人微调的两阶段框架。
Result: 实验表明，所提出的 3D 感知潜在动作显著提升世界模型性能，在生成质量、物理一致性和泛化能力上达到 SOTA 结果。
Conclusion: 简单加入多视角视频不足以让 LAM 获得 3D 感知能力，必须显式解决外观泄漏和视角差异；LAWM-3D 的三个设计通过统一的动机紧密耦合，而非简单堆叠。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Spectral Aliasing Pretext: A novel task for Self-Supervised fault diagnosis in rotating machinery
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning is a new way for machinery fault diagnosis but requires extensive labeled data, a scarce resource in industrial settings. We propose Spectral Aliasing Pretext (SAP), a self-supervised learning method that pretrains models on unlabeled vibration data by exploiting spectral aliasing. We deliberately undersample signals to create folded spectrum, then train a Transformer to reconstruct the original unfolded spectrum. This pretext task forces the model to learn frequency-domain invariants characteristic of mechanical faults, without potentially destructive augmentations. Experiments on the CWRU dataset show that SAP learns stable and highly discriminative representations. In a linear probing setting, SAP quickly achieves very high classification performance with only a small fraction of labeled data and low variance. In contrast, full fine-tuning, including fully supervised training, does not lead to more stable or better results. Overall, these findings suggest that SAP combined with linear probing can be more effective and reliable than fully supervised training for fault diagnosis with limited labeled data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对旋转机械故障诊断中标注数据稀缺的问题，提出一种自监督预训练任务 Spectral Aliasing Pretext (SAP)。该方法通过对振动信号刻意欠采样以产生折叠频谱 (folded spectrum)，并训练 Transformer 重建原始展开频谱，从而迫使模型学习与机械故障相关的频域不变特征，避免使用可能有破坏性的数据增强。在 CWRU 数据集上的实验表明，SAP 学到的表示稳定且判别性强，线性探测 (linear probing) 仅需少量标注数据即可达到很高的分类性能且方差低。
Motivation: 深度学习方法在机械故障诊断中表现良好，但依赖大量标注数据，而工业场景中标注数据稀缺，这一问题限制了深度模型的实用部署。
Method: 提出 Spectral Aliasing Pretext (SAP) 自监督任务：对未标注振动信号进行刻意欠采样，使频谱发生混叠 (aliasing) 形成折叠频谱，再训练 Transformer 模型重建原始的未折叠频谱，以此作为预训练目标来学习频域不变量。
Result: 在 CWRU 数据集上，SAP 预训练后使用线性探测即可在仅小部分标注数据下快速达到很高的分类性能，且方差较低；相比之下，包括全监督训练在内的完整微调并未带来更稳定或更好的结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为，SAP 结合线性探测在标注数据有限的故障诊断场景下可能比全监督训练更有效、更可靠。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: G$^2$ARD-GS: Geometry-Guided Anchor-Regularized Gaussian Splatting Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Dense colored LiDAR maps provide accurate city-scale geometry, but lifting them into 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) retains millions of primitives, making the resulting models costly to store, transmit, render, and adapt. Aggressive primitive reduction alleviates this burden, but can remove the local surface support needed for stable novel-view synthesis and downstream geometric use. We introduce G$^2$ARD-GS, a geometry-guided distillation method that converts a dense Gaussian prior instantiated either as a training-free point-cloud lift or a trained GS model into a compact, reusable representation. G$^2$ARD-GS progressively consolidates the prior into surface-aware representatives, then recovers appearance on the resulting fixed topology under construction-time anchor constraints, with no primitives added or removed during recovery. Under limited supervision, geometry-aware view selection allocates the available view budget. On MatrixCity, G$^2$ARD-GS achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS across matched $5\times$--$30\times$ compression budgets, outperforming PUP by $3.2$--$6.8$,dB in PSNR. When reused as frozen geometry, the compact model improves off-trajectory appearance adaptation by $3.7$--$4.9$,dB over PUP 3D-GS and preserves image-to-model registration accuracy on Cambridge KingsCollege at $30\times$ compression. Project page: https://patrick1159.github.io/gardGS-page/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 G^2ARD-GS，一种几何引导的蒸馏方法，将稠密彩色 LiDAR 地图提升得到的 3D 高斯先验（无论是无训练点云提升还是已训练的 GS 模型）转换为紧凑可复用的表示。方法在 MatrixCity 上于匹配的 5×–30× 压缩预算下取得最佳 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS，并报告相比 PUP 在 PSNR 上提升 3.2–6.8 dB。
Motivation: 稠密彩色 LiDAR 地图在提升为 3DGS 后会保留数百万个基元，导致存储、传输、渲染和适配成本高昂；而激进的基元削减会移除新视角合成和下游几何应用所需的局部表面支撑。
Method: G^2ARD-GS 将稠密高斯先验渐进合并为表面感知的代表点，随后在构建时的锚定约束（anchor constraints）下恢复外观，恢复阶段不增删基元；在监督有限时，采用几何感知的视图选择来分配可用视图预算。
Result: 在 MatrixCity 上，该方法在 5×–30× 压缩预算下取得最佳 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS，PSNR 比 PUP 高 3.2–6.8 dB；作为冻结几何复用时，离轨外观适应比 PUP 3D-GS 高 3.7–4.9 dB，并在 Cambridge KingsCollege 的 30× 压缩下保持图像到模型配准精度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法生成的紧凑模型可作为冻结几何复用，在显著压缩的同时保留外观适应能力和几何配准可用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: StreamArena: Toward Continuous, Interactive, and Long-Horizon Agentic Streaming Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Deploying autonomous multimodal agents in continuous, real-world environments requires them to ingest unbounded audio-visual streams and maintain hour-scale memory. However, current evaluations predominantly rely on brief clips and multiple-choice formats. This design allows minimal baselines that process only the last four frames to match or surpass complex streaming models, while answer options also expose language shortcuts. We introduce StreamArena, a benchmark for hour-scale, interactive streaming video understanding. StreamArena contains 243 full-length videos averaging 88.8 minutes and 3,646 rigorously annotated, open-ended question-answer pairs that evaluate real-time perception, historical retrospection, proactive interaction, and multimodal tool utilization. Evaluation across diverse systems exposes a tension between continuous interaction and long-horizon multimodal comprehension. Methods that retain only recent frames cannot recover distant events, methods that convert past observations into text lose visual evidence, and methods that repeatedly compress visual memory struggle to preserve fine-grained details over time. We address this tension with StreamMind, a two-tier architecture that assigns latency-critical interaction and proactive monitoring to independently scheduled frontend workers, while backend workers asynchronously construct persistent multimodal memory and perform historical recall and external search. StreamMind outperforms existing streaming baselines across all four capabilities and reduces query-to-answer latency by reusing persistent state.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StreamArena，一个面向小时级、交互式流式视频理解 (streaming video understanding) 的基准，包含 243 个平均时长 88.8 分钟的全长视频和 3,646 个开放式问答对，评估实时感知、历史回溯、主动交互和多模态工具使用四类能力。针对连续交互与长时多模态理解之间的张力，作者还提出 StreamMind 双层级架构，在四个能力上均超过现有流式基线，并通过复用持久状态降低查询到回答的延迟。
Motivation: 现有视频理解评测大多依赖短视频片段和选择题形式，导致仅处理最后四帧的最小基线就能匹敌甚至超过复杂流式模型，且选项会暴露语言捷径；而真实环境中的自主智能体需要接收无界音视频流并维持小时级记忆。
Method: 构建 StreamArena 基准，使用全长视频和开放式问答对覆盖四类能力；提出 StreamMind 双层级架构，将时延敏感型交互和主动监控分配给独立调度的前端 (frontend) 工作者，后端 (backend) 工作者异步构建持久多模态记忆，并负责历史召回与外部搜索。
Result: 摘要报告 StreamMind 在全部四类能力上优于现有流式基线，并通过复用持久状态降低查询到回答的时延；同时揭示仅保留最近帧的方法无法恢复遥远事件、将历史转为文本会丢失视觉证据、反复压缩视觉记忆难以保持细粒度细节。
Conclusion: 作者指出连续交互与长时多模态理解之间存在张力，并认为 StreamArena 与 StreamMind 可用于评估和缓解这一问题。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SEAM: Global consistency beyond local accuracy in scientific machine learning
papers.abstract_en: Scientific machine learning commonly validates models at the level of a subdomain, a benchmark split, or an explanation for one prediction. Yet such local checks cannot establish whether the resulting explanations can be assembled into one globally admissible explanation. We introduce Scientific Explanation-Admissibility Machines (SEAM), a generator-agnostic framework that makes this local-to-global consistency question computable across regions, sensors, regimes, and model components. The finite explanation-sheaf instantiation SEAM-$Ω$ represents each region by a structured explanation with state, closure, and observation channels together with optional contract metadata; compares neighboring explanations on their overlaps; and converts disagreement into a channel-resolved obstruction. This obstruction locates inconsistency and tests competing declared accounts by restricting each repair to the revisions that one account permits. Exact feasibility refutes or retains an account; when exact repair is unavailable, residual-aware regularized records provide a separately labeled empirical attribution. The framework also separates inconsistency from non-identifiability and monitors learned generators under distribution shift. We establish theorems for minimum-cost intervention and conservation-contract detectability, together with companion results for identifiability and closure recoverability. Across nineteen experiments involving synthetic partial differential equation systems and out-of-distribution Fourier neural operator (FNO) monitoring, SEAM detects incompatible explanations even when local predictions are accurate, and attributes failures to specific channels and overlaps. SEAM adds a global explanation-consistency audit to existing solvers and learning models, testing whether their local explanations form a coherent scientific account.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Scientific Explanation-Admissibility Machines (SEAM)，一个与生成器无关的框架，用于在科学机器学习中检验局部解释是否能组装成全局一致的说明。SEAM-Ω 用有限解释层（explanation-sheaf）表示各区域的结构化解释，并通过通道解析的阻碍（obstruction）定位不一致性。论文建立最小代价干预与守恒契约可检测性等定理，并在 19 个合成 PDE 与分布外 FNO 监控实验中表明，即使局部预测准确，SEAM 也能检测出不相容解释。
Motivation: 现有科学机器学习验证通常只在子域、基准划分或单预测解释层面进行局部检查，无法回答这些局部解释能否组装成一个全局可采纳的说明；论文瞄准这一局部到全局的一致性问题。
Method: 提出生成器无关的 SEAM 框架，其有限层实例化 SEAM-Ω 将每个区域表示为含状态、闭包、观测通道和可选契约元数据的结构化解释，在重叠部分比较相邻解释，并将分歧转化为通道解析的阻碍；通过将修复限制在某个声明所允许的修订内来检验相互竞争的声明，并用残差感知正则化记录实现经验归因。
Result: 在 19 个实验（合成偏微分方程系统和分布外 Fourier 神经算子监控）中，SEAM 能在局部预测准确时检测到不相容解释，并将失败归因到特定通道和重叠部分；论文还建立了最小代价干预、守恒契约可检测性、可辨识性与闭包可恢复性定理。
Conclusion: SEAM 为现有求解器和学习模型增加了一种全局解释一致性审计，用于检验其局部解释是否能形成连贯的科学说明；框架同时区分不一致性与不可辨识性，并监控分布偏移下的学习生成器。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: TAU-Bench: From Anomaly Instance Tracking to Fine-Grained Video Anomaly Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Humans understand anomalous events through a coherent perceptual process in which they identify the focal instance, follow its behavior as the event unfolds, and interpret why it violates the expectations of the surrounding scene. Video anomaly understanding (VAU) seeks to endow models with a similar capability, moving beyond deciding whether a video is anomalous toward explaining how the event develops and why it matters. Although recent vision--language models (VLMs) can generate detailed and plausible anomaly descriptions, their semantic fluency does not ensure that these interpretations remain grounded in the correct anomaly instance over time. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate tracking and semantic understanding through separate protocols, leaving such instance--semantic inconsistency largely unmeasured. We therefore introduce TAU-Bench, a track-centric benchmark for jointly evaluating anomaly instance tracking and fine-grained anomaly understanding. TAU-Bench contains 1,118 videos, 1,454 tracks, and 202,438 pixel-level masks spanning 49 event and 45 scene categories, together with track-centric annotations that connect instance-level identification, event-level understanding, and scene-level reasoning. To build TAU-Bench at scale, we developed an automated data engine integrating anomaly suitability filtering, anomaly instance track construction, hierarchical caption annotation, and human quality control. Evaluations across representative VLM families show that models producing plausible anomaly interpretations may still fail to localize and track the correct instance reliably, revealing a persistent gap between semantic reasoning and visual grounding. These findings therefore highlight instance-grounded evaluation as an important step toward more faithful and reliable VAU systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TAU-Bench，一个以跟踪为中心的基准，用于联合评估视频异常实例跟踪与细粒度异常理解。基准包含 1,118 个视频、1,454 条轨迹和 202,438 个像素级掩码，覆盖 49 个事件类别和 45 个场景类别，并配备连接实例识别、事件理解和场景推理的轨迹中心标注。评测显示，能生成合理异常解释的 VLM 仍可能无法可靠定位和跟踪正确实例，说明语义推理与视觉 grounding 之间存在持续差距。
Motivation: 现有视频异常理解基准通常将跟踪与语义理解分开评测，导致实例-语义不一致问题未被度量；模型生成的异常描述虽然在语义上流畅，却不一定始终锚定在正确的异常实例上。
Method: 构建 TAU-Bench，并开发自动化数据引擎，包括异常适用性过滤、异常实例轨迹构建、层级化字幕标注和人工质量控制，以规模化生成轨迹中心的标注。
Result: 对代表性 VLM 家族的评测显示，模型可能产生看似合理的异常解释，但仍会在定位和跟踪正确实例上失败，暴露出语义推理与视觉 grounding 之间的持续差距。
Conclusion: 作者强调实例 grounded 的评测是迈向更忠实、可靠的视频异常理解系统的重要一步。

papers.title: A Low-Power Wearable Respiratory Sensor for Non-Invasive Stress Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Respiration provides a continuously available window into physiological state and behavior. However, monitoring it outside controlled settings remains challenging because a wearable system must capture small body deformations while remaining comfortable, low power, and robust to changes in posture and motion. We present a compact non-invasive respiratory sensing system based on a force-sensitive resistor (FSR) embedded in an abdominal belt and integrated with a custom Bluetooth Low Energy acquisition board. The system combines a simple piezoresistive readout with a mechanical holder designed to transfer abdominal expansion to the sensor without analog amplification. We evaluate the complete sensing pipeline across multiple breathing patterns and body positions. In stationary settings, the recorded signals exhibit consistent amplitude changes and recurring peak-to-peak timing across breathing maneuvers; under light movement, these variations remain visible despite motion-induced baseline shifts. We further design a five-phase stress-induction protocol and collect respiratory recordings from 12 participants. Using interpretable time-domain features and standard classifiers, we examine whether the acquired signals distinguish relaxation from stress-induction phases. In this preliminary experiment, the best-performing model achieves 88.0% test accuracy, indicating that the extracted respiratory features distinguish stress-induced phases from relaxation phases in this dataset. Overall, our results show that the proposed platform enables real-time respiratory monitoring across diverse daily-life scenarios and captures respiratory changes that distinguish stress-induction from relaxation phases, supporting its potential for affective-computing applications.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于力敏电阻 (force-sensitive resistor, FSR) 的低功耗非侵入式呼吸传感系统，传感器嵌入腹部腰带并集成定制蓝牙低功耗 (BLE) 采集板，无需模拟放大即可拾取腹部扩张信号。作者在多种呼吸模式和体位下评估完整传感链路，并设计五阶段压力诱导协议采集 12 名受试者的呼吸数据，用可解释时域特征和标准分类器区分放松与压力诱导阶段，最优模型测试准确率达 88.0%。
Motivation: 呼吸是非受控环境下持续可获取的生理窗口，但在受控环境之外监测很困难：可穿戴系统需在保持舒适、低功耗且对姿态和运动鲁棒的同时捕捉微小的身体形变。作者希望构建能在日常场景中实时监测呼吸并支持情感计算 (affective computing) 应用的平台。
Method: 系统由嵌入腹部腰带的 FSR 传感器和定制 BLE 采集板组成，采用简单的压阻式读出 (piezoresistive readout) 配合机械固定结构将腹部扩张传递给传感器，避免模拟放大。评估覆盖多种呼吸模式和体位，并设计五阶段压力诱导协议采集数据，提取可解释时域特征后用标准分类器进行阶段判别。
Result: 静态条件下记录信号在不同呼吸动作中呈现一致的幅度变化和重复的峰-峰时序；轻微运动时这些变化在运动引起的基线漂移中仍然可见。在 12 名受试者的初步实验中，最优分类模型在区分放松与压力诱导阶段上达到 88.0% 的测试准确率。
Conclusion: 作者认为该平台能在多样化的日常场景中实现实时呼吸监测，并能捕捉区分压力诱导与放松阶段的呼吸变化，支持其在情感计算中的应用潜力；但这是初步实验，样本量为 12 人。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DreamGuard: Efficient Runtime Guardrail for LLM Agents via Risk-Aware World Model
papers.abstract_en: As large language model (LLM) agents increasingly invoke external tools and interact with real-world systems, unsafe actions may cause irreversible consequences on external states, user data, and downstream services. Recent runtime guardrails mitigate such risks by checking proposed actions before execution, but many remain reactive: they primarily assess the apparent safety of the current action, lacking an explicit model of how risk evolves across the trajectory. This limitation creates a critical blind spot for long-horizon risks, where individually benign-looking actions can gradually drift the agent toward hazardous states. In response, we propose DreamGuard, a proactive guardrail for LLM agents built around a risk-aware world model. The world model maintains a compact recurrent latent state over the trajectory and predicts future latent states from which DreamGuard derives immediate-hazard and prefix-risk evidence. It then fuses these multi-horizon signals into intervention decisions before execution. Experiments across four benchmarks and an online guardrail evaluation show that DreamGuard outperforms generic, reactive, and proactive guardrail baselines, achieves the best safety-utility trade-off among evaluated guardrails, and maintains an average end-to-end latency of 25 ms per call.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DreamGuard，一种面向 LLM 智能体 (LLM agent) 的主动运行时护栏，核心是风险感知世界模型 (risk-aware world model)。该模型在轨迹上维护压缩的循环潜在状态并预测未来状态，从而在动作执行前导出即时危险与前缀风险证据并融合为干预决策。在四个基准和一个在线护栏评估中，DreamGuard 优于通用、反应式及主动式护栏基线，取得最佳安全-效用权衡，平均端到端延迟为 25 ms/次。
Motivation: 现有运行时护栏多为反应式，只评估当前动作的表面安全性，缺乏对风险如何在轨迹中演化的显式建模，因而对长时域风险存在盲点——单个看似安全的动作可能逐步将智能体推向危险状态。
Method: 提出以风险感知世界模型为核心的主动护栏 DreamGuard：世界模型维护轨迹上的紧凑循环潜在状态 (recurrent latent state)，预测未来潜在状态，并从中提取即时危险 (immediate-hazard) 与前缀风险 (prefix-risk) 证据，在执行前将多时域信号融合为干预决策。
Result: 在四个基准和一个在线护栏评估中，DreamGuard 超越通用、反应式和主动式护栏基线，在评估的护栏中取得最佳安全-效用权衡，并保持平均每次调用 25 ms 的端到端延迟。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，通过显式建模风险演化并提供多时域的前置干预信号，可以在不牺牲实用性的前提下提升 LLM 智能体运行时安全性。

papers.title: SciQNet: Two-Stage Multimodal Adaptation for Scientific Image Quality Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Scientific images are essential for communicating experimental observations, quantitative evidence and conceptual knowledge. Unlike natural images, their quality depends on both visual clarity and scientific informativeness, making assessment challenging. In this work, we present SciQNet, a two-stage multimodal adaptation framework for scientific image quality assessment. The first stage performs domain-adaptive pretraining on scientific document images and the second stage conducts task-specific fine-tuning with joint scoring and understanding supervision. For scoring-oriented supervision, we combine instruction tuning with a Huber loss derived from rating-word logits, while understanding-oriented supervision is formulated as multiple-choice visual question answering. Experiments show that using a 40% stratified subset of the domain-adaptive data gives the best performance among the evaluated pretraining fractions, suggesting that pretraining-data relevance may be as important as pretraining-data scale. The final model achieves an SIQA-S score of 92.21, an SIQA-U score of 47.38 and a combined score of 69.80. This work presents our solution to the ICME 2026 Scientific Image Quality Assessment Challenge, which ranked 2nd in the scoring track.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SciQNet，一个用于科学图像质量评估的两阶段多模态适配框架。第一阶段在科学文档图像上做领域自适应预训练，第二阶段用评分与理解双重监督进行任务微调；评分监督结合指令微调与基于评分词 logits 的 Huber 损失，理解监督采用多选视觉问答。作者报告 40% 分层子集的预训练数据效果最佳，最终模型在 SIQA-S 上得 92.21、SIQA-U 上得 47.38、综合得分 69.80，是 ICME 2026 科学图像质量评估挑战赛评分赛道的第 2 名方案。
Motivation: 科学图像的质量不仅取决于视觉清晰度，还取决于科学信息量，现有面向自然图像的质量评估方法难以直接适用，需要针对科学图像设计专门的评估框架。
Method: 提出两阶段方法：先对科学文档图像进行领域自适应预训练，再进行任务特定微调；微调阶段联合评分监督（指令微调加 Huber 损失）与理解监督（多选视觉问答）。
Result: 在预训练数据比例实验中，40% 分层子集取得最佳性能，表明预训练数据相关性可能与规模同样重要；最终模型取得 SIQA-S 92.21、SIQA-U 47.38、综合 69.80，并在 ICME 2026 科学图像质量评估挑战赛评分赛道排名第 2。
Conclusion: 作者将工作定位为 ICME 2026 挑战赛的解决方案，强调领域自适应预训练数据的选择策略以及联合评分与理解监督的有效性。

papers.title: Answer First, Reason Later: Commitment Order in Diffusion LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) can commit tokens in any order -- a freedom marketed as their core advantage over autoregressive decoding. We show that on reasoning tasks this freedom is instead the axis of failure. Logging every commitment during decoding of LLaDA-8B on GSM8K, we find that unconstrained (pure) decoding commits the final answer at 15-24% of the trajectory while half the reasoning region is still masked, and collapses to answer-only outputs on up to 90% of problems as the canvas grows. The cause is not the model's termination beliefs -- EOS "pressure" is nearly identical across decoders -- but reachability: whether the sampler may act on those beliefs at distant positions. A 2x2 prompt-decoder design shows that chain-of-thought helps only under ordered commitment (interaction +34.8 percentage points, 95% CI [26.8, 42.8]; without reasoning text the decoders are indistinguishable), an interaction we decompose into a collapse channel and an order channel and replicate on Dream-7B and MATH-500. A single-knob intervention -- frontier-gated commitment -- causally recovers the full gap (0.528 to 0.852) while preserving up to 4x parallel decoding, along a measured frontier whose optimal window flips from w=1 at full refinement to unconstrained at 8 tokens/step. Our results reframe existing window-style samplers, previously motivated by efficiency, as the minimal fix for a reasoning pathology they were never designed to address.

TL;DR: 本文研究掩码扩散语言模型 (dLLM) 在推理任务中的 token 提交顺序问题。通过对 LLaDA-8B 在 GSM8K 上的解码过程进行日志分析，作者发现无约束解码会在推理区域仍有一半被掩码时提前提交最终答案，并随画布增大在多达 90% 的问题上退化为仅输出答案。作者提出单旋钮干预“frontier-gated commitment”，在不牺牲并行解码的前提下恢复性能，并将已有的窗口式采样器重新诠释为对这一推理病理的最小修复。
Motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型可以以任意顺序提交 token，这一自由度被视为相对自回归解码的核心优势；但本文指出在推理任务上该自由度恰恰是失败原因。已有窗口式采样器最初出于效率动机设计，并未针对推理退化问题进行优化，因此需要厘清其实际作用。
Method: 作者记录 LLaDA-8B 在 GSM8K 上的每次提交，设计 2x2 提示-解码器实验，将“链式思考仅在有序提交下有效”的交互作用分解为崩溃通道和顺序通道，并在 Dream-7B 与 MATH-500 上复现。随后提出单旋钮干预“frontier-gated commitment”来因果性地控制提交顺序，并测量其调度窗口的最优设置。
Result: 摘要报告无约束解码在轨迹进行到 15-24% 时即提交最终答案，而此时推理区域仍有一半被掩码；链式思考仅在有序提交下带来 +34.8 个百分点（95% CI [26.8, 42.8]）的提升，无推理文本时不同解码器无差异。该干预将性能从 0.528 恢复到 0.852，同时保留最多 4 倍并行解码，且最优窗口从完全细化时的 w=1 翻转到 8 tokens/step 时的无约束。

papers.title: Provably Efficient Self-Calibrating Quantum Fault Tolerance
papers.abstract_en: Quantum error correction protects logical information only when every physical operation remains below the fault-tolerance threshold, a condition that must be maintained continuously rather than only at the initial calibration. In practice, however, analog control parameters inevitably drift because of environmental fluctuations. As future fault-tolerant quantum computations are expected to run for days or even months, interrupting computation for repeated recalibration becomes fundamentally impractical. A promising alternative is to integrate calibration directly into computation by repurposing syndrome measurements as a calibration signal (Sivak et al, Nature 2026), but whether such self-calibration can be achieved with provable efficiency remains an open question. Here we establish a theoretical framework for self-calibrating quantum fault tolerance. We prove that, for a broad class of control-induced errors, the detection rate defines a locally strongly convex surrogate objective for analog calibration with high probability. This geometric property enables efficient online optimization using only syndrome measurements collected during normal error correction. We prove convergence to an $\varepsilon$ detection rate within $O(1/\varepsilon^2)$ epochs for time-independent drifts and also establish guarantees for time-dependent drifts. We further show that the convergence rate is independent of the code distance for quantum low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes. Pulse-level simulations of neutral-atom arrays and large-scale circuit-level Clifford simulations confirm these theoretical predictions. Our results establish self-calibrating fault tolerance as a provably efficient paradigm in which the same syndrome measurements simultaneously protect logical information and stabilize the underlying hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为自校准量子容错建立了理论框架。作者证明，对一类控制诱导误差，检测率 (detection rate) 能以高概率定义模拟校准的局部强凸代理目标，从而仅用正常纠错过程中收集的综合征测量 (syndrome measurements) 实现高效的在线优化。他们证明对时间无关漂移，收敛到 ε 检测率需 O(1/ε^2) 轮，并对时间相关漂移也给出保证；收敛率与量子 LDPC 码的码距无关。脉冲级中性原子阵列模拟和大规模电路级 Clifford 仿真验证了这些理论预测。
Motivation: 量子纠错只有在所有物理操作持续低于容错阈值时才有效，但模拟控制参数会因环境波动而漂移；未来容错量子计算运行数天甚至数月，反复中断重新校准不现实。将校准直接整合进计算、复用综合征测量作为校准信号虽已被提出，但能否以可证明的效率实现仍是开放问题。
Method: 建立自校准量子容错的理论框架，核心是证明对广泛的控制诱导误差，检测率以高概率构成模拟校准的局部强凸代理目标。这一几何性质使得仅利用纠错过程中收集的综合征测量即可进行高效的在线优化。
Result: 证明对时间无关漂移，收敛到 ε 检测率需要 O(1/ε^2) 轮，对时间相关漂移也有收敛保证；并证明收敛率与量子 LDPC 码的码距无关。脉冲级中性原子阵列模拟与大规模电路级 Clifford 仿真确认了理论预测。
Conclusion: 作者把自校准容错确立为可证明高效的范式：同一组综合征测量同时保护逻辑信息并稳定底层硬件。摘要强调其理论保证适用于量子 LDPC 码等一系列设置。

papers.title: Grounded Well-Condition Anomaly Detection on the Volve Field: Constructed Labels, a Baseline, and a Dual-Head Model
papers.abstract_en: Most public benchmarks for machine-condition monitoring come from test rigs, where faults are induced on purpose and every event is known. Real production fields rarely offer that. They give you sensor histories with no fault log attached, which is exactly the situation where an anomaly-detection method has to invent its own labels, and where quiet assumptions can slip in unnoticed. We work with the open Volve field data released by Equinor and take two things seriously that such datasets usually skip. First, we build anomaly labels that are not just patterns in the numbers but are checked against what the field's own engineering documents say can physically go wrong, and we release the reasoning behind every label. Second, we test whether those constructed labels are learnable at all, using both an unsupervised baseline and a small dual-head model that marks when an event happens and what kind it is, an idea we carry over from earlier work on defect detection in metal parts. The results are honest. An unsupervised detector that never sees the labels still lands on the same regions our rules flagged, which tells us the labels are not arbitrary. A compact supervised model recovers event presence and event type well across wells it has never seen, and locates events in time only roughly. We report what worked, what did not, and every assumption in between. The dataset, grounded labels, per-label provenance, baseline scores, trained model, and code are released publicly under CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于 Equinor 发布的 Volve 油田开放数据，构建了依据油田工程文档校验的异常标签，并检验这些标签是否可学习。作者测试了一个无监督基线和一个小型双头模型（dual-head model），后者同时标记事件发生时刻与事件类型；结果显示无监督检测器在未接触标签时仍落在规则标记的同一区域，监督模型在未见井上能较好恢复事件存在性与类型，但事件时间定位仅大致准确。数据集、标签、逐标签出处、基线分数、模型和代码以 CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0 公开。
Motivation: 大多数机器状态监测公开基准来自测试台架，其中故障被刻意诱发且每个事件都已知；真实生产现场只有传感器历史而没有故障日志，异常检测方法不得不自行构造标签，容易混入隐性假设。
Method: 先用油田自身的工程文档构建物理上可能出错的异常标签，并公开每个标签的推理依据；再检验标签可学习性：一个完全不接触标签的无监督基线，以及一个从金属缺陷检测工作迁移来的小型双头模型，同时输出事件是否发生与事件类型。
Result: 摘要报告无监督检测器在未见标签的情况下仍落在规则标记的相同区域，说明标签并非任意；紧凑的监督模型能在未见过的井上较好恢复事件存在性和事件类型，但事件时间定位仅大致准确。
Conclusion: 作者强调结果是诚实的：报告哪些方法有效、哪些无效，以及过程中的所有假设，并公开带出处标签的完整数据与代码供复现。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Nonvisual Classification of Ground-Condition by Artificial Proprioception in an Amoeba-Inspired Autonomous Walking Robot
papers.abstract_en: Nonvisual classification of ground condition based on a multimodal sensing approach was investigated for an amoeba-inspired autonomous walking robot. To classify ground condition without image sensing and processing, we implemented artificial proprioception by integrating a three-axis accelerometer, eight foot pressure sensors, and reservoir computing (RC). Even when large fluctuations in the sensor outputs are caused by dynamic motions of a four-legged robot in walking, our system can classify the ground condition, flat or rough, with high accuracy. We demonstrate on-site switching of walking gait depending on ground condition in the robot. We also discuss the contribution of each sensor to ground condition classification.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 7 figures, The paper has been submitted to IEEE SCIS ISIS 2026 for consideration
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究类变形虫启发的自主四足行走机器人，利用多模态传感实现非视觉地面状态分类。系统将三轴加速度计、八个足底压力传感器与储层计算 (reservoir computing, RC) 结合，构建人工本体感觉 (artificial proprioception)，在机器人动态行走导致传感器输出大幅波动时仍能高精度区分平坦与粗糙地面，并实现了根据地面状态在线切换步态。摘要还讨论了各传感器对分类的贡献。
Motivation: 目标是在不使用图像传感与图像处理的前提下判断地面状态，从而避免视觉方案带来的计算与感知开销；四足机器人行走时的动态运动会造成传感器输出的大幅波动，给稳定分类带来挑战。
Method: 提出基于多模态传感的非视觉分类方案：集成三轴加速度计、八个足底压力传感器和储层计算 (RC)，将多路传感器信号映射为地面状态特征，用于区分平坦与粗糙地面。
Result: 在四足机器人行走产生较大传感器波动的条件下，系统仍能以高精度完成平坦/粗糙地面分类；论文演示了机器人根据分类结果在线切换行走步态，并分析了各传感器对分类的贡献。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，结合人工本体感觉与储层计算可在无视觉输入的情况下高精度分类地面条件，并支持依据地面状态进行步态切换；同时给出了各传感器的贡献分析。

papers.title: DistMedVL: Distributional Vision-Language Alignment for Uncertainty-Aware Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Cross-modal alignment of visual and textual representations is fundamental to multimodal medical image understanding, yet remains hindered by uncertainty in both modalities under real-world clinical conditions. Existing vision-language segmentation methods rely on deterministic cross-modal matching, which overlooks aleatoric uncertainty from ambiguous boundaries and epistemic uncertainty from limited training data, leading to fragile performance under domain shift. To address this issue, we propose DistMedVL, a probabilistic vision-language framework that introduces a lightweight Probabilistic Cross-Modal Adapter (PCM-Adapter) upon frozen encoders to explicitly model representational uncertainty. Specifically, the PCM-Adapter comprises two sequential modules for progressive probabilistic alignment. We first devise a Mahalanobis Alignment Module (MAM) that models textual tokens as Gaussian distributions and computes patch-text compatibility via Mahalanobis distance, yielding variance-conditioned matching that downweights unreliable feature dimensions. Moreover, we devise a Distribution Flow Module (DFM) that estimates modality-wise confidence parameters and performs vision-guided refinement of textual distributions, accommodating distributional variation across imaging modalities. Extensive experiments across eight medical segmentation benchmarks demonstrate that DistMedVL outperforms state-of-the-art methods with only 6.3M trainable parameters, exhibiting superior data efficiency, perturbation robustness and cross-dataset generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DistMedVL，一个面向医学图像分割的概率视觉-语言对齐框架，在冻结编码器上引入轻量级 Probabilistic Cross-Modal Adapter (PCM-Adapter)，显式建模表征中的偶然不确定性与认知不确定性。PCM-Adapter 包含 Mahalanobis Alignment Module (MAM) 和 Distribution Flow Module (DFM) 两个串行模块，实现渐进式概率对齐。摘要在八个医学分割基准上报告该方法优于现有方法，且仅需 6.3M 可训练参数。
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言分割方法依赖确定性的跨模态匹配，忽略了模糊边界带来的偶然不确定性和有限训练数据带来的认知不确定性，导致在领域偏移下性能脆弱。
Method: 提出 PCM-Adapter，包含 MAM 和 DFM 两个模块：MAM 将文本 token 建模为高斯分布，通过 Mahalanobis 距离计算 patch-文本兼容性，实现方差条件化的匹配并对不可靠特征维度降权；DFM 估计模态级置信参数，并对文本分布进行视觉引导的细化，以适应不同成像模态的分布差异。
Result: 在八个医学分割基准上的实验表明，DistMedVL 以 6.3M 可训练参数超越现有方法，并展现出更优的数据效率、扰动鲁棒性和跨数据集泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，概率化的跨模态对齐能够更好地处理双模态不确定性，从而提升医学图像分割在真实临床条件下的鲁棒性与泛化性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Consistency Has a Computable Blind Spot: A Commutation Theory of Label-Free Reliability for Vision-Language Figure Reading
papers.abstract_en: Label-free reliability for vision-language models rests on invariance: perturb the input and a faithful reader's answer should not change. This has a known blind spot, a systematic misreading survives the perturbation and gets certified wrong, which we show is computable, not just real: an error is invisible to an edit exactly when the two commute, so the errors a suite cannot reach form its joint centralizer, a set that shrinks as edits are added and can be written down rather than guessed at. We act on the complementary relation, equivariance: edit a figure's data and the correct answer must change by a computable amount. Two matched edits are provably complete for affine reading errors; no suite of swap edits is complete for label permutations, and cyclic relabeling closes most of that gap. We instantiate the theory as the Equivariance-Consistency Score, a label-free, training-free detector, and release REND-EQUIV, pairing matched invariance and equivariance sets over identical data. The predicted ordering holds across three models and a hand-labeled population immune to the one circularity in how it is selected; a second invariance-family method confirms the blind spot belongs to the relation, not to any implementation; and cyclic relabeling delivers its predicted gain on a matched real sample. The same characterization explains a reported inversion of this ordering in the classifier metamorphic-testing literature: detectability is a joint property of the relation and the fault class, never of the relation alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型（vision-language models）在无标签（label-free）条件下的可靠性检测，指出基于不变性（invariance）的扰动校验存在可计算的盲点：若编辑与误差可交换（commute），则系统性的错误读取会逃过扰动认证。作者转而利用等变性（equivariance），提出 Equivariance-Consistency Score 这一免标签、免训练检测器，并发布配套的 REND-EQUIV 数据集，在三个模型上验证了理论预测的排序，同时解释分类器变质测试文献中观测到的排序反转现象。
Motivation: 免标签可靠性依赖输入扰动下的答案不变性，但存在已知盲点：一种系统性的误读可能在扰动后依旧存活并被错误认证。作者证明该盲点不仅是现实存在的，而且是可计算的——错误对编辑不可见当且仅当二者交换，因此未被编辑套件覆盖的错误构成其联合中心化子（joint centralizer），可被显式写出而非猜测。
Method: 提出交换性（commutation）视角刻画不变性检测的盲区，并转向互补的等变性关系：编辑图表数据后正确答案应发生可计算的改变。文中证明两个匹配的编辑对仿射读取错误是完备的，并给出交换编辑对标签置换不完全、循环重标记（cyclic relabeling）能缩小大部分差距的理论结果，据此实例化为 Equivariance-Consistency Score 检测器。
Result: 在三个模型及手工标注群体上，预测的排序成立；另一个不变性家族方法证实盲点属于关系本身而非具体实现；循环重标记在匹配的真实样本上带来预测中的增益。作者还用同一刻画解释了分类器变质测试文献中排序反转的报道。
Conclusion: 可检测性（detectability）是关系与故障类别二者的联合属性，而非关系单独决定；该理论为免标签、免训练的视觉语言图表读取可靠性评估提供了可计算的框架与配套基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Unified Framework for Trajectory Prediction with Explicit Planning and Reaction Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Trajectory prediction has shifted toward structured formulations with explicit social modeling. However, existing methods inadequately distinguish the functional roles of social influence in trajectory planning. Observing that agents typically form motion plans by anticipating others' future behaviors before making local reactive adjustments, we identify social interactions as playing staged roles, namely planning precedes reaction. We propose INTraJ, a unified framework that decomposes social influence into two stages: a planning stage constructs reference trajectories using future social information, and a reaction stage recovers local adjustments from the residual between full-context prediction and the reference. INTraJ supports both multi-target and single-target paradigms. Extensive experiments on four standard benchmarks, including Argoverse 2, Argoverse 2-ped, ETH/UCY, and SDD, demonstrate consistent improvements, particularly in FDE and long-horizon consistency, with state-of-the-art performance achieved in several settings. INTraJ reframes trajectory prediction as a planning-driven two-stage process, validating that staged social modeling is critical for stable predictions. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/11isnotavailable/INTraJ.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 INTraJ，一个将社会影响分解为两阶段的统一轨迹预测框架：规划阶段利用未来社会信息构建参考轨迹，反应阶段从全上下文预测与参考轨迹的残差中恢复局部调整。在 Argoverse 2、Argoverse 2-ped、ETH/UCY 和 SDD 四个基准上取得一致改进，尤其在 FDE 与长时一致性上，部分设置达到 SOTA。作者将轨迹预测重构为规划驱动的两阶段过程，并公开了代码。
Motivation: 现有轨迹预测方法虽已引入显式社会建模，但未能区分社会影响在轨迹规划中的功能角色。作者观察到智能体通常先预期他人未来行为形成运动计划，再进行局部反应调整，因此认为社会交互的作用是分阶段的，规划先于反应。
Method: 提出 INTraJ 统一框架，将社会影响分解为两个阶段：规划阶段使用未来社会信息构建参考轨迹，反应阶段从全上下文预测与参考轨迹的残差中学习局部调整。框架同时支持多目标与单目标预测范式。
Result: 在 Argoverse 2、Argoverse 2-ped、ETH/UCY 和 SDD 四个标准基准上的实验显示一致改进，特别在 FDE 和长时一致性指标上提升明显，并在若干设置下取得最优性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为将轨迹预测重构为规划驱动的两阶段过程是有效的，并强调分阶段的社会建模对稳定预测至关重要；代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: URNet: A Unified Reparameterized Network for Efficient RGB-D Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Previous RGB-D semantic segmentation methods commonly employ dual encoders to separately process RGB and depth inputs, followed by dedicated modules for cross-modal feature fusion. However, such designs often inadequately capture depth representations and consequently limit effective cross-modal interaction, while the additional encoder branch introduces redundant computation that hinders lightweight execution. To tackle these challenges, we propose URNet, a Unified Reparameterized RGB-D Network that performs simultaneous multi-modal feature extraction and cross-modal fusion within a single encoder. Specifically, we adopt a reparameterization strategy to compact the network architecture and facilitate fast inference. Within each Reparameterized Block (RepBlock), a Linear Gated Attention (LGA) module is introduced to fully exploit complementary RGB and depth cues across different feature scales. Furthermore, considering that decoder design has been relatively underexplored in existing RGB-D segmentation models, we develop a concise yet effective universal decoder, termed the Pyramid Merging Decoder (PMD). Extensive experiments on multiple RGB-D segmentation benchmarks demonstrate that URNet achieves state-of-the-art performance while maintaining high efficiency. Code will be available at https://github.com/Wild-Stephen/URNet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: URNet 提出一种统一重参数化的 RGB-D 语义分割网络，将多模态特征提取与跨模态融合放在单一编码器中完成，取代常见的双编码器设计。每个重参数化块（RepBlock）内引入线性门控注意力（LGA）以利用不同尺度下 RGB 与深度信息的互补线索，并设计了轻量通用的金字塔合并解码器（PMD）。摘要在多个 RGB-D 分割基准上报告了 state-of-the-art 性能与高效率。
Motivation: 现有 RGB-D 分割方法通常使用双编码器分别处理 RGB 和深度图，再配以专门模块进行跨模态融合；这类设计对深度表征捕获不足，限制了跨模态交互，同时额外编码器分支带来冗余计算，难以满足轻量部署需求。
Method: 采用重参数化（reparameterization）策略压缩网络结构以加速推理；在每个 Reparameterized Block 中引入线性门控注意力（LGA）模块，在不同特征尺度上充分挖掘 RGB 与深度信息的互补性；此外提出一种简洁有效的通用解码器 Pyramid Merging Decoder（PMD）。
Result: 在多个 RGB-D 语义分割基准上的大量实验表明，URNet 在取得 state-of-the-art 性能的同时保持了高推理效率。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调统一编码器结合重参数化与 PMD 解码器能够在保持轻量高效的同时实现高性能 RGB-D 分割，并指出代码将公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Does Consensus Mean Correctness? Measuring the Agreement-Accuracy Coupling with Semantics-Preserving Re-Rendering
papers.abstract_en: A model's agreement across perturbed inputs is used both as a label-free reliability signal and as a self-training target, on the premise that agreement tracks correctness. That coupling is rarely measured directly: natural-image perturbations preserve meaning only by assumption, and no exact answer key localizes errors. Scientific figures remove both obstacles, a figure is drawn from data by a program, so redrawing it yields images that are semantically equivalent by construction and share a programmatically exact answer. We build RENDEQ, a generator of such render-equivalence sets, and measure the coupling on three open-weight VLMs, checking every finding across three independent instantiations. Re-rendering beats resampling on both accuracy and reliability. Agreement beats an evidence-carrying baseline, mean token log-probability, on two of three models and ties on the third, reversing an intermediate, buggy replication traced to a rendering-pipeline failure. The dispersion behind this is concentrated in one style factor, the plotting library, more than double the next-largest factor and an order of magnitude above the noise floor. Fine-tuning on the model's own cross-render consensus inverts: accuracy falls in every one of five replication runs, the opposite sign to published results on natural images. Agreement certifies correctness only above a threshold set by how diffuse a model's errors are, and an objective that rewards agreement destroys exactly that diffuseness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RENDEQ，一种利用科学图表程序化重绘生成语义等价图像集合的生成器，并借此直接测量开放权重视觉语言模型（VLM）的‘一致性与正确性’耦合。结果表明重绘（re-rendering）在准确率和可靠性上均优于重采样（resampling），一致性信号在三个模型中的两个上超过平均 token 对数概率基线，并在第三个上打平，同时发现误差离散度主要由绘图库这一风格因素驱动。
Motivation: 模型在扰动输入上的一致性被用作无标签可靠性信号和自训练目标，前提是一致性反映正确性，但该耦合很少被直接测量：自然图像扰动只能假设保持语义，且没有精确答案键来定位错误。科学图表恰好消除了这两重障碍，因此成为验证该前提的理想场景。
Method: 构建 RENDEQ 生成渲染等价集（render-equivalence sets）：图表由程序从数据绘制，重绘得到的图像在构造上语义等价，并共享程序可精确计算的答案。作者用该工具在三个开源权重 VLM 上测量一致性与准确率的耦合，并通过三个独立实例复现验证每一项发现。
Result: 重绘在准确率和可靠性上均优于重采样；一致性在三个模型中的两个上优于携带证据的基线（平均 token 对数概率），在第三个上打平，并纠正了源于渲染管线故障的中间错误复现。方差分析显示绘图库是主导风格因素，其贡献比次大因素高一倍以上，比噪声底高一个数量级；基于模型自身跨渲染一致性的微调则在全部五次复现运行中使准确率下降，与自然图像上的既有结论符号相反。
Conclusion: 一致性仅在模型误差离散度所确定的一个阈值之上才能保证正确性，而奖励一致性的目标恰好会破坏这种离散度，因此作者强调该耦合具有条件性和脆弱性。

summary_sections.motivation: 模型在扰动输入上的一致性被用作无标签可靠性信号和自训练目标，前提是一致性反映正确性，但该耦合很少被直接测量：自然图像扰动只能假设保持语义，且没有精确答案键来定位错误。科学图表恰好消除了这两重障碍，因此成为验证该前提的理想场景。
summary_sections.method: 构建 RENDEQ 生成渲染等价集（render-equivalence sets）：图表由程序从数据绘制，重绘得到的图像在构造上语义等价，并共享程序可精确计算的答案。作者用该工具在三个开源权重 VLM 上测量一致性与准确率的耦合，并通过三个独立实例复现验证每一项发现。
summary_sections.result: 重绘在准确率和可靠性上均优于重采样；一致性在三个模型中的两个上优于携带证据的基线（平均 token 对数概率），在第三个上打平，并纠正了源于渲染管线故障的中间错误复现。方差分析显示绘图库是主导风格因素，其贡献比次大因素高一倍以上，比噪声底高一个数量级；基于模型自身跨渲染一致性的微调则在全部五次复现运行中使准确率下降，与自然图像上的既有结论符号相反。
summary_sections.conclusion: 一致性仅在模型误差离散度所确定的一个阈值之上才能保证正确性，而奖励一致性的目标恰好会破坏这种离散度，因此作者强调该耦合具有条件性和脆弱性。

papers.title: SafeDivertor: Faithful Divertor Heat Flux Reconstruction from Macroscopic Plasma State Signals via Time-Frequency Prior Exploitation
papers.abstract_en: Divertor heat-flux analysis is essential for understanding plasma-wall interactions and protecting plasma-facing components in magnetic-confinement fusion devices, while conventional infrared-based inversion is usually performed after discharge and requires heat-conduction modeling with device-specific material properties, divertor geometry, and boundary conditions. Rather than accelerating this conventional infrared-based inversion paradigm, we introduce a new online-oriented signal-based reconstruction paradigm that directly reconstructs time-resolved radial heat-flux profiles from multi-source macroscopic plasma-state signals available during discharge. To enable systematic study of this task, we construct \textbf{DivMPS2HF}, a multi-source discharge dataset that provides the data foundation and benchmark for signal-based divertor heat-flux reconstruction. We further propose \textbf{SafeDivertor}, a task-driven framework designed to address the key challenges of signal-based heat-flux reconstruction. It employs physical prior-aware initialization to provide radial-distribution guidance for target channels, input perturbation to reduce over-reliance on specific heterogeneous signals, spectral-aware reconstruction optimization to exploit time-frequency priors and preserve transient dynamics, and progressive training to stabilize the optimization of these complementary objectives. Experiments on DivMPS2HF demonstrate that SafeDivertor achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated time-series baselines across all five metrics, establishing a new performance benchmark for signal-based divertor heat-flux reconstruction. The source code will be released on https://github.com/Event-AHU/OpenFusion
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向磁约束聚变装置偏滤器（divertor）热流分析的在线信号重构新范式：不再加速传统红外反演流程，而是直接从放电过程中可获得的多源宏观等离子体状态信号重建时间分辨的径向热流分布。作者构建了多源放电数据集 DivMPS2HF 作为数据基础与基准，并设计 SafeDivertor 框架，结合物理先验感知初始化、输入扰动、频谱感知重构优化与渐进训练，在 DivMPS2HF 上的全部五项指标均优于所评估的时间序列基线。
Motivation: 传统红外反演通常在放电结束后进行，且依赖设备特定的材料属性、偏滤器几何结构与边界条件，难以在线使用；而基于信号的偏滤器热流重构此前缺少系统的数据基础与专门方法，因此作者希望建立一种在线导向的重构范式。
Method: SafeDivertor 采用物理先验感知的初始化为目标通道提供径向分布引导；通过输入扰动降低模型对特定异构信号的过度依赖；利用频谱感知重构优化来挖掘时频先验并保留瞬态动力学；并用渐进训练稳定这些互补目标的联合优化。同时构造 DivMPS2HF 多源放电数据集以支持该任务的系统研究。
Result: 在 DivMPS2HF 基准上，SafeDivertor 在所有五项评估指标上取得所比较时间序列基线中的最佳整体性能，为基于信号的偏滤器热流重构建立了新的性能基准。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作为偏滤器热流重构提供了一个可在线执行的新范式与公开基准，并计划在 GitHub 上发布源代码；摘要未明确提及方法局限。
