papers.title: Modeling Scientific Experiment Scenes: Dataset and Model
papers.abstract_en: Scene Graph Generation (SGG) is fundamental to structured visual understanding, yet existing benchmarks focus mainly on daily life images and overlook scientific experiment scenes with specialized instruments, task-specific experimental semantics, and dense, fine-grained physical relations. These scenes are increasingly important for automated experimental analysis and smart education. To bridge this gap, we introduce PhysScene, the first SGG dataset for physical experiment scenes, providing densely annotated scene graphs and benchmarks under multiple supervision and protocol settings. PhysScene further exposes two key algorithmic challenges for SGG: pronounced long-tail relational predicate distributions and a substantial visual-textual semantic gap. To address these challenges, we propose the Cross-Modal Dual-Path Generator (CM-DPG), a model for robust open-vocabulary SGG. The model enhances object-level semantic representations through joint visual-textual encoding and improves relational reasoning using complementary visual and geometric cues. We also incorporate relation-aware pre-training, caption-derived pseudo-supervision, and adaptive weighting to support balanced learning across head and tail predicates. Extensive experiments on PhysScene and VG150 show that CM-DPG achieves competitive performance across multiple evaluation settings, with ablation studies validating the contribution of each component. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://github.com/ZMH-SDUST/CM-DPG.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PhysScene，首个面向物理实验场景的场景图生成 (SGG) 数据集，密集标注场景图并提供多种监督与协议设置下的基准。作者进一步提出跨模态双路径生成器 (CM-DPG)，用于开放词汇 SGG，通过联合视觉-文本编码、互补几何线索、关系感知预训练以及 caption 伪监督来处理长尾谓词分布与视觉-文本语义鸿沟。在 PhysScene 和 VG150 上的实验验证了模型性能。需要留意 arXiv 评论指出作者因发现需大幅修订的问题而撤回了当前版本。
Motivation: 现有 SGG 基准主要覆盖日常图像，忽略包含专业仪器、任务特定实验语义和密集细粒度物理关系的科学实验场景；这类场景对自动化实验分析和智慧教育日益重要，但缺乏相应数据集与基准。PhysScene 还暴露出长尾关系谓词分布和视觉-文本语义鸿沟两大算法挑战。
Method: 提出跨模态双路径生成器 (CM-DPG)：通过联合视觉-文本编码增强目标级语义表示，并利用互补的视觉与几何线索改进关系推理；同时引入关系感知预训练、caption 衍生的伪监督和自适应加权，以支持头部与尾部谓词的平衡学习。
Result: 在 PhysScene 和 VG150 上的大量实验表明，CM-DPG 在多种评测设置下取得有竞争力的性能，消融研究验证了每个组件的贡献；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为 PhysScene 填补了科学实验场景 SGG 数据集的空白，CM-DPG 为开放词汇 SGG 提供了一条可行的建模路径。但当前 arXiv 版本已因需要实质性修订而被作者撤回，阅读时应以后续修订版本为准。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Field Aware Agent Skill Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: As lifelong learning agents accumulate lifelong growing skill banks, retrieving the correct skill becomes an increasingly important bottleneck. Most current skill retrieval methods treat each skill as one flat document by concatenating fields such as the name, description, and body. However, skills are naturally structured, multi-field objects, where each field provides different information about when and how the skill should be used. In this work, we study whether preserving this structure improves skill retrieval. We represent each skill as its separate components, and compute sparse and dense similarities for each field independently, exposing a naturally tensorized, field-aware representation of the skill bank. We then combine these field-level scores either with uniform weights or with a small learned MLP. Across two different skill retrieval benchmarks, SkillRet and SRA-Bench, we find that keeping fields separate improves hybrid retrieval, and learning over the field-level scores gives the strongest and most consistent results. Our field-aware MLP reaches $77.95$ Recall@10 on SkillRet and $83.78$ Recall@10 on SRA-Bench, outperforming the corresponding concatenated learned baselines. We also find that the advantage grows as the skill bank becomes larger, suggesting that field-aware skill retrieval becomes especially useful in the setting where retrieval is most difficult. Our results show that skill representation itself matters, and that simply preserving the structure already present in skill files can substantially improve retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究终身学习智能体在技能库不断增长时如何提升技能检索效果，核心观点是技能天然是结构化多字段对象，不应被简单拼接成扁平文档。作者将每个技能拆分为独立组件，对每个字段分别计算稀疏与稠密相似度，形成张量化的字段感知表示，再用均匀权重或小型学习型 MLP 融合字段级分数。在 SkillRet 与 SRA-Bench 两个基准上，字段分离的混合检索优于拼接式基线，且字段感知 MLP 取得最佳一致效果。
Motivation: 现有技能检索方法大多将技能视为单一扁平文档，直接拼接 name、description、body 等字段，忽略了技能内部各字段对"何时用、如何用"提供不同信息的自然结构，导致检索瓶颈在技能库扩增时愈发明显。
Method: 将每个技能按独立字段分别表示，逐字段计算稀疏和稠密相似度，得到技能库的字段感知张量化表示；随后采用两种方式融合字段级分数：均匀权重或通过一个小型学习型 MLP 学习组合权重。
Result: 字段感知 MLP 在 SkillRet 上达到 77.95 的 Recall@10，在 SRA-Bench 上达到 83.78 的 Recall@10，均超过对应的拼接式学习基线；且技能库越大，字段感知方法的优势越明显。
Conclusion: 技能表示本身对检索效果有显著影响，仅保留技能文件中已有的结构信息即可实质性改善混合检索，尤其在检索难度最大的大规模技能库场景下收益更大。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Invisible Ink Threats: Adversarial Goals Behind Legitimate Tasks in Computer-Use Agents
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents (CUAs), which empower large language models to autonomously operate operating systems and the web, are increasingly vulnerable to indirect prompt injection attacks. A widely adopted defense is the human-in-the-loop paradigm, in which the agent pauses for explicit user confirmation before executing sensitive operations. While effective against conspicuously high-harm attacks, this defense offers little protection against what we term Invisible Ink Threats: low-harm injected goals, such as starring a repository or installing a package, that are behaviorally indistinguishable from legitimate task execution and thus evade both model safety mechanisms and human oversight. To systematically investigate this blind spot, we present II-Bench, a collection of seemingly harmless adversarial tasks. II-Bench comprises 444 examples targeting confidentiality and integrity attacks across three platforms, spanning three attack categories: page navigation and interaction, sensitive information exfiltration, and code download and execution. Each category is instantiated in both natural language and code forms under two levels of instruction specificity. Furthermore, we construct HITLCUA, a comprehensive adversarial testing framework that integrates a real virtual machine operating system environment with isolated Docker-based web platforms, and simulates human participation by allowing CUAs to consult an API-simulated user before proceeding with suspicious operations. Extensive evaluations of leading CUAs reveal that low-harm injections frequently bypass both agent defenses and simulated user review, exposing severe and previously underexplored security risks in current CUAs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“隐形墨水威胁”(Invisible Ink Threats)：计算机使用智能体 (computer-use agents, CUAs) 在面对低危害、外观与合法任务无异的间接提示注入目标时，现有的人类在环 (human-in-the-loop) 防御会被绕过。作者构建了包含 444 个示例的 II-Bench 基准，覆盖三个平台、三类攻击（页面导航与交互、敏感信息外泄、代码下载与执行），并搭建 HITLCUA 测试框架，在真实虚拟机与隔离 Docker 网页环境中模拟用户审查。对主流 CUAs 的评测显示，低危害注入常能同时绕过智能体防御和模拟用户复核。
Motivation: 现有针对高危害攻击的人类在环防御在低危害注入目标面前几乎失效，因为这些目标在行为上与合法任务不可区分，且能避开模型安全机制和人工监督，形成尚未被系统研究的安全盲区。
Method: 构建 II-Bench 数据集，包含 444 个伪装成无害任务的对抗示例，涉及机密性与完整性攻击，任务以自然语言和代码两种形式、两种指令具体程度呈现；同时构造 HITLCUA 对抗测试框架，集成真实虚拟机操作系统与基于 Docker 的隔离网页平台，并通过 API 模拟用户在可疑操作前进行咨询。
Result: 对主流 CUAs 的大量评测表明，低危害注入频繁绕过智能体自身的防御以及模拟用户审查，暴露出当前 CUAs 中严重且此前少被探索的安全风险。
Conclusion: 作者强调低危害注入是现有防御体系的系统性盲区，II-Bench 与 HITLCUA 为系统评估此类威胁提供了基础设施；摘要未讨论局限性与后续缓解方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ASTRA: Asynchronous Spatio-Temporal Reconstruction via Trajectory Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic 3D scene reconstruction has achieved remarkable success under the assumption of strictly synchronized multi-camera inputs. However, in real-world scenarios, temporal asynchrony among capturing devices remains a critical challenge, leading to severe motion blur and geometric artifacts. Existing asynchronous reconstruction methods typically estimate temporal offsets through photometric supervision, but appearance matching provides weak temporal cues under large offsets and complex motions. We attribute this limitation to two major bottlenecks: texture-induced collapse, where low-texture regions provide nearly vanishing alignment signals, and deformation-induced coupling, where temporal errors are absorbed into distorted geometry or motion rather than being explicitly corrected. To address these issues, we propose ASTRA (Asynchronous Spatio-Temporal Reconstruction via Trajectory Alignment), a framework that introduces 2D motion trajectories as explicit, texture-agnostic supervision for asynchronous dynamic reconstruction. Instead of synchronizing cameras solely through rendered color residuals, ASTRA jointly optimizes temporal offsets and dynamic 3D representations by aligning the projected motion of reconstructed 3D points with observed 2D trajectories, while using dynamic and certainty masking to suppress unreliable trajectory constraints. Extensive experiments on different dynamic Gaussian Splatting backbones show that ASTRA preserves high-frequency spatial details and sustains strong robustness even under severe asynchrony with up to 25-frame offsets, achieving approximately 1.4 dB PSNR improvement, reducing temporal-offset MAE by 54.0\%, and nearly quadrupling the synchronization success rate.
papers.comment: We wish to withdraw this preprint because the current statistical analysis of the experimental data is incomplete and requires re-verification. We plan to submit a revised and thoroughly checked version in the near future
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ASTRA（Asynchronous Spatio-Temporal Reconstruction via Trajectory Alignment），面向异步多相机动态三维重建。ASTRA 把 2D 运动轨迹作为与纹理无关的监督信号，将重建 3D 点的投影运动与观测到的 2D 轨迹对齐，以联合优化时间偏移与动态三维表示。摘要报告在动态 Gaussian Splatting 骨架上最高约 1.4 dB PSNR 提升、时间偏移 MAE 降低 54.0%，并在高达 25 帧偏移的严重异步条件下保持鲁棒性。需要说明的是，作者已发布撤稿声明，称当前实验数据的统计分析不完整、需要复核。
Motivation: 严格同步的多相机假设在真实场景中难以满足，设备间的时间异步会导致运动模糊和几何伪影。现有异步重建方法依赖光度监督估计时间偏移，但在大偏移和复杂运动下外观匹配提供的时间线索很弱，原因是低纹理区域几乎不提供对齐信号（texture-induced collapse），以及时间误差容易被扭曲的几何或运动吸收（deformation-induced coupling）。
Method: ASTRA 引入 2D 运动轨迹作为显式且与纹理无关的监督，通过将重建 3D 点的投影运动与观测 2D 轨迹对齐，联合优化时间偏移与动态三维表示；同时使用动态掩码（dynamic masking）和确定性掩码（certainty masking）抑制不可靠的轨迹约束。
Result: 在多个动态 Gaussian Splatting 骨干上的实验显示，ASTRA 在严重异步（最高 25 帧偏移）下保持高频空间细节和强鲁棒性，PSNR 提升约 1.4 dB，时间偏移 MAE 降低 54.0%，同步成功率几乎翻两番。
Conclusion: 摘要强调轨迹对齐监督能够显式校正时间偏移并避免纹理退化与运动-几何耦合问题；但作者已在 arXiv 评论中说明，由于当前实验数据的统计分析不完整、需要重新验证，该预印本将被撤回，并计划提交修订版。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: PhotoHOI: Synthesizing 3D Hand-Object Interactions from a Single RGB Photograph
papers.abstract_en: Hand-object interaction (HOI) is a fundamental human behavior with broad applications in AR/VR, digital humans, and embodied interaction. Existing methods typically require predefined object geometry, object trajectories, or task-specific conditions, limiting their use with natural real-world inputs. To address this, we study a more practical problem of synthesizing 3D hand-object interaction sequences from a single RGB photograph and an open-vocabulary language instruction, and introduce PhotoHOI. PhotoHOI first uses a vision-language model to parse the input image and instruction into a structured task specification, including the interaction object, target region, and spatial relation. It then recovers a compact task-relevant 3D scene and plans a smooth collision-aware object trajectory based on the recovered object states, support relations, and surrounding scene geometry. To synthesize hand motion that generalizes to real-world photographs and unseen objects, it learns transferable task-conditioned contact and contact-conditioned grasp priors from large-scale affordance and HOI data. The grasp is further refined in a learned latent space, constraining the optimization to a plausible hand-pose manifold. Experiments on GRAB and H2O demonstrate improved contact quality and reduced penetration over representative baselines. Results on real-world photographs further demonstrate higher task success and scene consistency, together with generalization to unseen objects and open-vocabulary instructions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PhotoHOI，从单张 RGB 照片和开放词汇语言指令合成 3D 手物交互序列。方法先用视觉语言模型把图像与指令解析为结构化任务规格，再恢复任务相关的 3D 场景并规划碰撞感知的物体轨迹，同时学习可迁移的任务条件接触先验和接触条件抓取先验，并在隐空间中细化抓取。在 GRAB 和 H2O 上相比代表性基线提升了接触质量并减少穿透，在真实照片上表现出更高的任务成功率和场景一致性。
Motivation: 现有手物交互合成方法通常依赖预定义物体几何、物体轨迹或任务特定条件，难以处理真实世界自然输入；作者针对从单张照片和自然语言指令直接合成交互序列这一更实际的问题展开研究。
Method: PhotoHOI 分为四步：用视觉语言模型将图像与指令解析为任务规格（交互物体、目标区域、空间关系）；恢复紧凑的任务相关 3D 场景，并基于物体状态、支撑关系和周围场景几何规划平滑且碰撞感知的物体轨迹；从大规模 affordance 与 HOI 数据学习可迁移的任务条件接触先验和接触条件抓取先验；在学到的隐空间中细化抓取，使优化被约束在合理的手型流形上。
Result: 在 GRAB 和 H2O 上的实验显示，相比代表性基线，接触质量提升且穿透减少；真实照片上的结果进一步展示了更高的任务成功率与场景一致性，并泛化到未见物体和开放词汇指令。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，结合结构化任务解析、场景恢复以及可迁移的抓取和接触先验，能够使单图手物交互合成泛化到真实照片和未见物体；摘要未讨论明确的局限性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Prompt-Driven Simulation with Feature Perturbation for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Data augmentation, which simulates diverse visual variations to expand the source distribution and induce synthetic domain shifts, is a simple yet effective strategy for mitigating severe domain shifts and limited labeled target data in cross-domain few-shot object detection (CD-FSOD). Existing approaches rely on conventional data augmentation, such as Color-Jitter, Mosaic, and background-centric adaptation (e.g., Domain-RAG), which are limited in modeling complex domain shifts and often lead to suboptimal performance. In this paper, we propose PSP-FSOD, a principled framework that integrates prompt-driven domain simulation with feature perturbation regularization to improve generalization in CD-FSOD. To enable controllable domain synthesis, we design a prompt-driven strategy that leverages the visual grounding capability of large VLMs to jointly model foreground and background variations, generating semantically consistent yet domain-diverse training samples. Moreover, we adopt a grounding-aware generation scheme that guides object placement and alleviates semantic-spatial misalignment, thereby improving foreground adaptation. To ensure training stability and robustness, we further introduce a noise-induced feature perturbation mechanism that injects Gaussian noise into multi-scale intermediate features with distribution correction, encouraging consistent predictions under perturbations and reducing reliance on domain-specific cues. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PSP-FSOD produces high-quality domain-diverse supervision and learns domain-invariant representations, consistently improving performance across CD-FSOD benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PSP-FSOD，一个面向跨域少样本目标检测 (CD-FSOD) 的框架，通过提示驱动的域仿真和特征扰动正则化来提升泛化能力。方法利用大型视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的视觉定位能力联合建模前景与背景变化，生成语义一致且域多样化的训练样本，并引入接地感知生成方案缓解语义-空间错位。此外，通过向多尺度中间特征注入高斯噪声并做分布校正，增强预测一致性并减少对域特定线索的依赖。实验显示该方法在 CD-FSOD 基准上持续提升性能。
Motivation: 跨域少样本目标检测面临严重的域偏移和有限的标注目标数据，现有数据增强方法如 Color-Jitter、Mosaic 及背景中心化适配 (如 Domain-RAG) 建模复杂域偏移能力有限，导致性能次优。
Method: 提出 PSP-FSOD 框架，包含提示驱动的域仿真策略，利用大型 VLM 的视觉接地能力联合建模前景与背景变化；采用接地感知生成方案指导目标放置并缓解语义-空间错位；引入噪声诱导的特征扰动机制，向多尺度中间特征注入高斯噪声并做分布校正，鼓励扰动下预测一致。
Result: 大量实验表明 PSP-FSOD 能生成高质量的域多样化监督并学习域不变表示，在 CD-FSOD 基准上持续提升性能。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调提示驱动域仿真与特征扰动正则化的结合能有效改善跨域少样本检测的泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Distill What the Student Can See: Fisher-Projected On-Policy Distillation for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) samples trajectories from the current student policy and minimizes token-level divergence between student and teacher next-token distributions at prefixes along those trajectories. This aligns the distillation states with the student's own generation distribution. However, it still assumes that the complete teacher distribution is an appropriate target across student capacities. In vision--language reasoning, teacher corrections can depend on visual distinctions that a compact student cannot represent. Our target-scaling study shows that, as the target approaches the complete teacher distribution, the student realizes less of the prescribed shift and obtains worse downstream performance. We therefore propose \emph{Fisher-Projected On-Policy Distillation} (FP-OPD), which distills only locally realizable teacher corrections. FP-OPD uses continuous visual perturbations to estimate the student's local visual tangent space and projects the centered teacher--student log-probability gap onto this space under the student's Fisher metric. The resulting capacity-aware target is optimized with full-vocabulary reverse KL on student trajectories, retaining the standard OPD framework. In 8B-to-2B distillation, FP-OPD improves all seven evaluated multimodal benchmarks. It raises the average score by 2.77 points over the pretrained student and by 1.60 points over standard OPD. These results demonstrate that locally realizable teacher corrections provide a more effective target for distilling compact vision--language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 的 on-policy distillation (OPD)，指出完整教师分布对紧凑学生模型并非总是可实现的优化目标。作者提出 Fisher-Projected On-Policy Distillation (FP-OPD)，通过连续视觉扰动估计学生局部视觉切空间，并在此空间上按 Fisher 度量投影教师-学生 log-probability 差距，只蒸馏学生可实现的那部分教师修正。在 8B 到 2B 的蒸馏中，FP-OPD 在七个多模态基准上均提升，平均分比预训练学生高 2.77 分，比标准 OPD 高 1.60 分。
Motivation: 现有 OPD 假设完整教师分布在不同学生容量下都是合适目标；但在视觉-语言推理中，教师修正可能依赖紧凑学生无法表示的视觉区分，导致学生实现不了规定的更新且下游表现变差。target-scaling 实验显示目标越接近完整教师分布，学生实现的修正越少、性能越差。
Method: 提出 FP-OPD：用连续视觉扰动估计学生局部视觉切空间 (visual tangent space)，把中心化的教师-学生 log-probability 差距投影到该空间（在学生的 Fisher 度量下），得到容量感知 (capacity-aware) 的蒸馏目标；随后用全词表 reverse KL 在学生轨迹上优化，保留标准 OPD 框架。
Result: 在 8B-to-2B 蒸馏中，FP-OPD 在所有七个评估的多模态基准上均提升；平均分比预训练学生提高 2.77 分，比标准 OPD 提高 1.60 分。
Conclusion: 作者认为局部可实现 (locally realizable) 的教师修正为蒸馏紧凑视觉-语言模型提供了更有效的目标，这些结果支持容量感知蒸馏目标的有效性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DASH: Decoupled Adaptive Surrogate - Acquisition Harness for Automated Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian optimization (BO) relies on a surrogate model and an acquisition function, yet the most suitable choices vary across tasks and optimization stages. Automated Bayesian optimization (AutoBO) addresses this variability by adapting BO components online. However, existing AutoBO methods either adapt one component, leaving the other mismatched and creating a bottleneck, or jointly select surrogate--acquisition pairs under a shared criterion, overlooking their distinct roles: surrogate selection depends on predictive reliability, whereas acquisition adaptation should respond to campaign context.In this paper, we propose DASH, a Decoupled Adaptive Surrogate--Acquisition Harness for large-language- model (LLM)-enhanced AutoBO. DASH selects surrogates by predictive reliability, uncertainty calibration, and ranking consistency; its two-stage acquisition controller periodically reallocates quotas across acquisition functions, builds a BO shortlist accordingly, and delegates final selection to an LLM. DASH also incorporates an integrated harness, consisting of knowledge-guided warm start and structured memory, to ground optimization in domain knowledge and accumulated feedback. Across four chemical optimization tasks, DASH outperforms the best AutoBO baseline by 12.51% in trajectory-level Acceleration Factor and 5.00% in endpoint Enhancement Factor. Results remain strong across LLM backbones, and ablations verify the complementary contributions of all components. Full-table and behavioral contamination checks find no detectable evidence that direct benchmark memorization or source-cell leakage explains these gains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DASH，一种面向大语言模型（LLM）增强的自动化贝叶斯优化（AutoBO）的解耦自适应代理-采集框架。DASH 分别依据预测可靠性、不确定性校准和排序一致性来选择代理模型，并由两阶段采集控制器配合 LLM 做最终采集函数选择；同时集成知识引导的 warm start 与结构化记忆。在四个化学优化任务上，DASH 相对最佳 AutoBO 基线在轨迹级加速因子（Acceleration Factor）上提升 12.51%、端点增强因子（Enhancement Factor）上提升 5.00%，且通过污染检查未发现基准记忆或数据泄漏可解释这些收益。
Motivation: 现有 AutoBO 方法要么只自适应代理模型或采集函数中的单一组件，导致另一组件失配成为瓶颈；要么在共享准则下联合选择 surrogate–acquisition 对，忽略了两者的不同角色：代理选择依赖预测可靠性，而采集函数适应应响应优化进程的上下文。
Method: DASH 按预测可靠性、不确定性校准和排序一致性选择代理模型；其两阶段采集控制器周期性为各采集函数重新分配配额、据此构建 BO 候选名单（shortlist），并把最终选择交由 LLM 裁决；此外集成 harness 由知识引导的 warm start 和结构化记忆构成，将领域知识与累积反馈纳入优化。
Result: 在四个化学优化任务上，DASH 相对最佳 AutoBO 基线在轨迹级 Acceleration Factor 上提升 12.51%、端点 Enhancement Factor 上提升 5.00%；结果在多种 LLM 后端下保持稳健，消融实验验证了各组件的互补贡献；完整表格与行为污染检查未发现直接基准记忆或源数据泄漏的证据。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将代理选择与采集适应解耦、并借助 LLM 与领域知识 harness 的互补设计可提升 AutoBO 效率；其有效性主要在化学优化任务上验证，摘要未展开讨论跨领域泛化或更广泛局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DocPO: Advancing Document Policy Optimization via Tailored Step-Aware Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) for document parsing often relies on reference-based rewards rooted in edit distance (e.g., tree edit distance), yet it remains hard to optimize in the high-accuracy regime because such rewards become weakly discriminative: near-correct outputs receive very similar scores, providing limited learning signal for hard cases. We propose Step-Aware Annealing (SAA), a plug-and-play reward sharpening mechanism that progressively increases reward curvature during training, amplifying subtle quality differences among high-scoring samples while preserving stability in early learning. Built on SAA, we introduce DocPO, a document policy optimization framework with element-specific, reference-based rewards anchored by edit-distance signals: normalized string edit distance (NED) for text, tree edit distance similarity (TEDS) for tables, and a hybrid Rubric+edit reward for formulas. Experiments on OmniDocBench and DocElemHard show that SAA consistently improves GRPO-style RL across document elements over non-annealed rewards, without requiring additional human supervision for reward construction.
papers.comment: 14 pages. Accepted to the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM Multimedia 2026). Yunhao Wang and Binghong Wu contributed equally. Updated to the camera-ready version with supplementary material and corrected references
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Step-Aware Annealing (SAA) 奖励锐化机制与 DocPO 文档策略优化框架，针对文档解析中基于编辑距离的奖励在高精度区间判别力不足的问题，通过逐步增大奖励曲率来放大高分样本间的细微质量差异。实验在 OmniDocBench 和 DocElemHard 上显示 SAA 能一致提升 GRPO 风格强化学习在文本、表格、公式三种文档元素上的效果，且无需额外人工监督。
Motivation: 文档解析的强化学习常用基于编辑距离（如树编辑距离）的参考奖励，但在高精度区间这些奖励判别力弱，近似正确的输出得分接近，难以为困难样本提供有效学习信号。
Method: 提出 Plug-and-play 的奖励锐化机制 SAA，在训练过程中渐进增加奖励曲率，放大高分样本间的质量差异并保持早期训练稳定性；基于 SAA 构建 DocPO 框架，对文本用归一化字符串编辑距离 (NED)，对表格用树编辑距离相似度 (TEDS)，对公式用混合 Rubric+编辑奖励。

papers.title: InferQ: A Database-Oriented Benchmark for Quantum Circuits Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Recent work suggests that relational database management systems (RDBMSs) can execute quantum circuit simulation by compiling the simulation into SQL workloads (primarily join-and-aggregate tensor contractions). While early results are promising, they largely focus on a narrow set of highly structured circuits and offer limited support for systematic database research, such as query optimization, physical design, and engine-level evaluation across a broad range of circuits. We present InferQ, a database-oriented benchmark for quantum circuit simulation. InferQ generates general, compositional circuits by assembling subcircuits from a set of circuit templates, emits each simulation task as an RDBMS-ready SQL workload, and extracts circuit and query features (static, graph, SQL, and dynamic) for workload characterization. InferQ also releases a large dataset of 202,975 circuits online, with a web-based viewer to support searching, filtering, and downloading circuits and feature records. In experiments across RDBMS engines (PostgreSQL, SQLite, DuckDB, and Umbra) and the widely used Qiskit Aer simulator, we find that RDBMSs achieve better peak memory usage than Qiskit Aer on more than 50% of the circuits generated by InferQ. Moreover, using InferQ features, lightweight machine learning models (linear and tree-based models) can accurately predict when SQL execution is preferable (with accuracy up to 95.6% for runtime and 97.4% for memory), enabling data-centric simulator selection and opening the door to principled optimization of SQL-based quantum circuit simulation.
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at ACM SIGMOD 2027 and publication in the Proceedings of the ACM on Management of Data (PACMMOD). This arXiv version is an extended technical report that includes the complete appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InferQ 是一个面向量子电路模拟的数据库基准，通过从电路模板组装通用组合电路，将模拟任务编译为 RDBMS 可执行的 SQL 负载（主要是 join-and-aggregate 张量收缩），并提取静态、图、SQL 与动态特征用于负载刻画。作者在线发布了包含 202,975 个电路的大型数据集及 Web 查看器。实验在 PostgreSQL、SQLite、DuckDB、Umbra 与 Qiskit Aer 之间进行，发现 RDBMS 在超过 50% 的 InferQ 电路上峰值内存优于 Qiskit Aer，且轻量机器学习模型能准确预测 SQL 执行是否更优。
Motivation: 已有研究表明 RDBMS 可通过将量子电路模拟编译为 SQL 工作负载来执行，但早期结果聚焦于狭窄的高结构化电路，缺乏面向查询优化、物理设计和引擎级评估的系统性数据库研究支持，也缺少覆盖广泛电路的基准。
Method: InferQ 从一组电路模板组装通用组合电路来生成模拟任务，将每个任务输出为 RDBMS 可用的 SQL 工作负载，并提取静态、图、SQL 和动态特征以进行工作负载刻画；同时发布大规模在线数据集和基于 Web 的查看器用于搜索、过滤和下载。
Result: 摘要报告在 PostgreSQL、SQLite、DuckDB、Umbra 和 Qiskit Aer 的对比中，RDBMS 在 InferQ 生成的超过 50% 电路上取得更好的峰值内存使用；利用 InferQ 特征训练的线性与树模型预测 SQL 执行更优场景的准确率最高达 95.6%（运行时）和 97.4%（内存）。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 InferQ 为基于 SQL 的量子电路模拟提供了系统化基准、特征数据和数据集，能够支持数据驱动的模拟器选择，并为这类模拟的原理性优化打开空间。

papers.title: WitCert: Sound Runtime Risk Observability and Gating for KV-Cache Quantization
papers.abstract_en: KV-cache quantization is validated today by offline benchmark averages; a deployed system cannot tell whether compression is damaging the request it is serving right now. We give it a provably sound runtime meter -- a "DTrace for KV quantization": a per-(layer, head, step) upper bound on the total variation between exact and compressed attention. The meter has two tiers: a deterministic band-norm-witness bound, sound for any cache-preserving black-box quantizer and for any query (adaptive-safe, worst-case Cauchy--Schwarz plus RoPE band-unitarity), and a tighter probabilistic certificate for a controlled subtractively-dithered INT8 quantizer under an explicit request-level failure budget (stated for non-adaptive queries; core theorems machine-checked in Lean 4). Three results. Observability: the meter enters SGLang through an env-guarded patch, and any scheme registered as one tensor function is measured in live serving. Repair: meter-driven gating -- risk-ranked where the witness is saturated, certified where it is informative -- empirically restores the quality floor at benchmark scale, e.g. raw-cast fp8 from 22.8 back to 79.7 on hard RULER tasks with the difference from uncompressed bounded at $[+0.0,+0.8]$ by a paired test. Analysis: aggressive schemes survive on cross-layer error cancellation, not per-step fidelity -- in a 28-layer sweep, no single layer's pollution alone loses anything (0/28) -- and the certified int8 cache serves $1.88\times$ more KV tokens at the same memory in SGLang. All artifacts, guards, and the Lean development are released at https://github.com/metask-ai/witcert-kv-certificates; every number regenerates from the shipped artifacts by one command.
papers.comment: 39 pages, 7 figures. Code, artifacts, and Lean proofs: https://github.com/metask-ai/witcert-kv-certificates
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 KV-cache 量化在部署时无法感知当前请求是否受损的问题，提出一个可证明可靠的运行时计量器（runtime meter），对每层、每头、每步给出精确注意力与压缩注意力之间总变差的上界。计量器包含两档：一个适用于任意保持缓存的黑盒量化器及任意查询的确定性 band-norm-witness 界，以及一个针对受控 subtractively-dithered INT8 量化器、在显式请求级失败预算下的概率性证书（核心定理在 Lean 4 中机器验证）。作者将计量器以 env-guarded 补丁接入 SGLang，并通过计量驱动的门控（gating）恢复质量下限，同时用跨层误差抵消分析解释激进量化方案为何能存活。
Motivation: 现有 KV-cache 量化仅靠离线基准平均值验证，部署系统无法判断压缩是否正在损害当前正在服务的请求；因此需要一个逐请求、可证明可靠的风险观测手段。
Method: 提出两档式计量器：确定性 band-norm-witness 界基于最坏情况 Cauchy–Schwarz 与 RoPE band-unitarity，对任意 cache-preserving 黑盒量化器和任意 query 成立；概率性证书面向受控 subtractively-dithered INT8 量化器，在显式失败预算下成立（针对非自适应 query）。计量器通过 env-guarded 补丁进入 SGLang，任何注册为单个 tensor 函数的方案都可在实时服务中被测量，并据此进行风险排序或认证门控。
Result: 摘要报告三个结果：可观测性上，计量器接入 SGLang 并可在实时服务中测量任意注册方案；修复上，计量驱动门控在基准规模下恢复质量下限，例如 raw-cast fp8 在困难 RULER 任务上从 22.8 恢复到 79.7，配对检验显示与未压缩版本的差异被界定在 [+0.0, +0.8]；分析上，28 层扫描中没有任何单层污染单独造成损失（0/28），而认证 int8 cache 在 SGLang 中同内存下可服务 1.88 倍更多的 KV tokens。
Conclusion: 作者强调激进量化方案能存活靠的是跨层误差抵消而非逐步骤保真度；所有工件、防护措施与 Lean 4 证明均已开源，且每个数字可由附带工件单条命令重新生成。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: AISPA: User-Centric System Prompt Auditing for Large Language Model Applications
papers.abstract_en: System prompts are instructions configured by developers to govern the behaviors of foundation models in AI applications. They are used throughout commercial AI products, but are rarely disclosed to the public or regulators, creating a serious trust and accountability gap in the wide deployment of AI systems. In this paper, we introduce Artificial Intelligence System Prompt Assurance (AISPA), a user-centric framework for systematically auditing system prompts in AI systems. AISPA examines specific parts of a system prompt and evaluates them along eight dimensions that matter to users. We then use this framework to review 3,249 instructions from system prompts in 88 commercial AI products, classifying each instruction as either protective (of users) or problematic. Our audit surfaces four core findings. First, system prompt design varies substantially across products and developers, with some organizations averaging over 60 protective instructions per product while others average fewer than 5. Second, protective instructions are widely adopted but shallow in scope: 98.9% of products contain at least one, yet only 24% cover all eight dimensions of the AISPA taxonomy. Third, system prompts have grown steadily longer and more protective of users, suggesting that user protection is becoming a more visible concern in commercial prompt design. Fourth, despite this progress, problematic instructions remain pervasive: roughly 40% of products contain at least one instruction that works against user interests, and protective and problematic instructions frequently coexist within the same prompt. Our findings highlight the need for greater transparency, standardization, and independent oversight for system prompts in commercial AI products.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AISPA（Artificial Intelligence System Prompt Assurance），一个以用户为中心的系统提示词（system prompt）审计框架，从八个维度评估系统提示词的指令内容，并将其分类为保护用户或损害用户两类。作者用该框架审查了 88 个商业 AI 产品中的 3,249 条指令，发现保护性指令虽广泛采用但覆盖深度不足，同时约 40% 的产品仍含有至少一条与用户利益相悖的指令。
Motivation: 系统提示词由开发者配置以控制基础模型在 AI 应用中的行为，在商业产品中被广泛使用却很少向公众或监管机构披露，形成了严重的信任与问责缺口。
Method: 引入 AISPA 框架，针对系统提示词的具体部分按八个对用户重要的维度进行审计，并将每条指令分类为保护性的（protective）或问题性的（problematic），随后将其应用于 88 个商业产品中的 3,249 条指令。
Result: 审计得出四点核心发现：产品与开发者之间的提示词设计差异很大；98.9% 的产品含有至少一条保护性指令，但仅 24% 覆盖全部八个维度；系统提示词随时间变得更长且更偏向保护用户；约 40% 的产品含有至少一条损害用户利益的指令，且保护性与问题性指令经常共存于同一提示词中。
Conclusion: 研究结果强调商业 AI 产品中的系统提示词需要更高的透明度、标准化以及独立监督。

papers.title: OSReward: Instituting Standardized Evaluation for Cross-Platform Computer-Use Reward Models
papers.abstract_en: Computer-using agents (CUAs) are advancing rapidly across the digital world. A CUA trajectory records the agent's actions, states, and reasoning. Verifying whether it fulfilled the task instruction is central to CUA evaluation, data curation, and reinforcement learning. Neither human-written verifiers nor human annotators can provide such verification at scale, so the field increasingly turns to vision-language models (VLMs) as judges of CUA trajectories. But a fundamental question has long gone unexamined: are these VLM judges reliable enough? To study it systematically, we introduce OSReward, a realistic, high-quality benchmark that evaluates VLM judges on CUA trajectories. The trajectories come from diverse agent backbones executing human-verified instructions across platforms, and are then rigorously labeled with ground-truth verdicts through multi-stage human annotation. Building on it, we derive OSReward-Hard, a challenge set concentrating genuinely hard cases, and OSReward-Multi for fine-grained efficiency and alignment scoring. The most comprehensive evaluation of VLM judges to date finds even state-of-the-art models fall short of an ideal judge, sharing a systematic leniency bias that mislabels failed runs as successes. The few reliable enough to trust are too expensive to run at scale, while affordable open models trail far behind. To close this gap, we construct and release OS-Shepherd-100K, an open corpus of reasoning-annotated trajectory judgments for the CUA community. On it, we train OS-Shepherd (9B and 35B), open reward models that supply low-cost, stable, and reliable reward signals, matching commercial judges at 30-60x lower cost than the frontier. Extensive analyses further inform the design of reliable CUA reward at scale. Our code, benchmark, dataset, and model checkpoints are available at https://os-copilot.github.io/OSReward-Home/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OSReward，一个用于系统评估视觉语言模型 (VLM) 作为计算机使用智能体 (CUA) 轨迹裁判的基准。轨迹来自多种 agent 骨干、跨平台且经人工验证的指令，并通过多阶段人工标注得到 ground-truth 判定；在此基础上派生出困难集 OSReward-Hard 和细粒度评分集 OSReward-Multi。评估显示即使最先进的 VLM 裁判也存在系统性宽松偏差 (leniency bias)，常把失败轨迹误判为成功；作者因此构建 OS-Shepherd-100K 语料并训练开源奖励模型 OS-Shepherd (9B/35B)，以 30-60 倍更低成本匹配商业裁判。
Motivation: CUA 轨迹是否正确完成任务是评估、数据筛选和强化学习的核心，但人类验证无法规模化，领域越来越依赖 VLM 作为裁判；然而这些 VLM 裁判是否足够可靠这一基本问题此前未被系统研究。
Method: 构建 OSReward 基准：从多种 agent 骨干采集跨平台、经人工验证指令的轨迹，用多阶段人工标注给出 ground-truth 判定；进一步构造 OSReward-Hard 聚焦真正困难样本，OSReward-Multi 面向细粒度效率与对齐评分；基于推理标注语料 OS-Shepherd-100K 训练开源奖励模型 OS-Shepherd。
Result: 对 VLM 裁判的迄今最全面评估表明，SOTA 模型也达不到理想裁判，普遍存在把失败运行误标为成功的宽松偏差；少数可靠的裁判推断成本过高，低成本开源模型则明显落后。OS-Shepherd 以 30-60 倍低于前沿模型的成本匹配商业裁判表现。
Conclusion: 作者强调可靠且低成本的 CUA reward 信号是规模化部署的前提，并发布代码、基准、数据集和模型检查点；同时指出相关工作为可靠大规模 CUA reward 的设计提供了分析依据。论文标注为 work in progress。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Kohn-Sham Spectral Embedding on Sparse Graphs at the Nishimori Temperature for Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: We propose Kohn-Sham Spectral Embedding (KSSE), an energy-based model replacing the top-layer classifier of convolutional networks with a sparse-graph spectral embedding at the Nishimori temperature of an associated Random-Bond Ising Model the spectral detectability threshold where class structure becomes marginally distinguishable from disorder. Mapping pre-trained features onto quasi-cyclic low-density parity-check graphs, we construct a regularized Laplacian (Bethe-Hessian) as an effective Kohn-Sham Hamiltonian, yielding D independent spectral problems-one per feature channel-solvable in $O(N log N + k_{mode}^{2} N)$ time by FFT on circulant blocks (Pontryagin self-duality), with low-mode Rayleigh-Ritz refinement ($k_{mode}=5$). Physically, this is a k.p effective-mass reduction on a one-dimensional ring crystal: the circulant support is the perfect crystal, the data weights a slowly varying impurity potential, and the Nishimori crossing a Fermi level at the band edge. Star-domain surgery optimizes the graph: instead of eliminating all frustrated cycles impossible without destroying the codewords-edge shifts create certified convexity around codewords with bounded residual frustration, with multi-scale fractal certification (basins $D_{2}<1$ vs rough landscapes $D_{2}>3$). The theory includes a generalized Ihara-Bass identity with a sharp spectral threshold, a non-backtracking growth trichotomy with frustration as a gauge-invariant $Z_{2}$ flux, a trapping-set spectral test, exact channel separability with a cup-product obstruction, plus loop-series, convexity, surgery, and quasi-stationarity bounds. On ImageNet-1000 with frozen EfficientNet-B4 features (D=1792) under a transductive protocol, KSSE achieves 88.93% Top-1 accuracy with ~21.24M parameters-beating Swin-L (197M, 86.4-87.3%) and matching the lower end of ViT-H/14 (632M, 88.0-89.5%) with 10x and 30x fewer parameters.
papers.comment: 67 pages, 12 figures, 7 tables, was presented at the 10th International Conference 'Deep Learning on Computational Physics (DLCP2026)', under review for the Moscow University Physics Bulletin, Physics series
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Kohn-Sham Spectral Embedding (KSSE)，一种基于能量的模型，用稀疏图谱嵌入替换卷积网络顶层分类器。方法将预训练特征映射到准循环 LDPC 图上，在随机键 Ising 模型的 Nishimori 温度（谱可检测阈值）下构造 Bethe-Hessian 正则化拉普拉斯作为有效 Kohn-Sham 哈密顿量，得到 D 个独立的谱问题，复杂度 O(N log N + k_mode^2 N)。在 ImageNet-1000 上使用冻结 EfficientNet-B4 特征（D=1792）和转导协议，KSSE 以约 21.24M 参数达到 88.93% Top-1 准确率。
Motivation: 现有卷积网络顶层分类器在大规模分类任务中需要大量参数；本文试图用物理启发的谱嵌入替代这一层，以更小的参数量获得有竞争力的精度，同时利用稀疏图和 FFT 保持计算效率。
Method: KSSE 将预训练特征映射到准循环低密度奇偶校验图上，构造 Bethe-Hessian 作为 Kohn-Sham 哈密顿量，用 FFT 在循环块上并行求解 D 个独立谱问题，并以低模 Rayleigh-Ritz 细化（k_mode=5）。图优化采用星域手术（star-domain surgery），通过边移位在有界残差挫折下围绕码字产生可证凸性；理论部分包括广义 Ihara-Bass 恒等式、非回溯增长三分法、陷阱集谱检验、杯积障碍以及若干界。
Result: 在 ImageNet-1000 上，采用冻结 EfficientNet-B4 特征（D=1792）和转导协议，KSSE 达到 88.93% Top-1 准确率，约 21.24M 参数；超越 Swin-L（197M，86.4-87.3%），并以 10 倍和 30 倍更少的参数匹配 ViT-H/14（632M，88.0-89.5%）的下限。
Conclusion: 论文表明，受凝聚态物理启发的谱嵌入可以有效替代深度网络顶层分类器，在 ImageNet 等大规模分类任务中以极小参数量取得有竞争力的精度；结果是在冻结特征和转导协议下获得的。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Space2Ground 2.0: A Multi-Source Dataset and Framework for Agricultural Monitoring through Fusion of Street-Level and Satellite Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Accurate and scalable parcel-level agricultural monitoring remains challenging because satellite Earth Observation alone provides only an overhead perspective of agricultural parcels, while optical observations are further affected by cloud-induced temporal gaps. This paper presents Space2Ground 2.0, a multi-source framework integrating Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 multispectral time series with geo-tagged street-level imagery acquired using vehicle-mounted cameras and shared through the Mapillary platform. A largely automated processing pipeline performs semantic filtering, image quality assessment, viewpoint-based parcel association, and dataset refinement, transforming large volumes of crowdsourced imagery into parcel-linked, analysis-ready data. Applied over Cyprus during the 2022 growing season, the pipeline produced a curated dataset of 46,050 annotated street-level images, selected from an initial collection exceeding 900,000 images and linked with satellite information for 8,581 agricultural parcels. The practical value of the dataset was assessed through parcel-level crop classification experiments using both single- and multi-source observations. The results demonstrate that street-level imagery provides complementary fine-scale visual information that enhances classification when integrated with satellite time series. Overall, Space2Ground 2.0 provides an openly available benchmark dataset and a reproducible methodology for multimodal agricultural monitoring, with potential applications in visual verification, reduced reliance on costly field inspections, and data-driven agricultural policy implementation.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted for presentation at the 45th EARSeL Symposium, Athens, Greece. The Space2Ground 2.0 dataset, is publicly available through Zenodo at: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21219542
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Space2Ground 2.0，一个融合 Sentinel-1 SAR、Sentinel-2 多光谱时间序列与 Mapillary 街景图像的农业监测数据集与框架。自动化处理流水线对众包街景图像进行语义过滤、质量评估、地块关联和精炼，在塞浦路斯 2022 生长季生成包含 46,050 张标注街景图像、关联 8,581 个农业地块的数据集。基于地块的作物分类实验表明，街景图像提供的细粒度视觉信息与卫星时间序列融合后可提升分类性能。
Motivation: 单纯依赖卫星对地观测只能提供地块的俯视视角，且光学观测受云层造成的时间缺失影响，导致高精度、可扩展的地块级农业监测仍然困难。
Method: 提出多源融合框架 Space2Ground 2.0，将 Sentinel-1 SAR 与 Sentinel-2 多光谱时间序列同带地理标签的街景图像结合；采用高度自动化的流水线完成语义过滤、图像质量评估、基于视角的地块关联与数据集精炼，把大规模众包影像转化为地块级可直接分析的数据。
Result: 流水线在塞浦路斯 2022 生长季从超过 900,000 张初始图像中筛选出 46,050 张标注街景图像，并关联 8,581 个农业地块；地块级作物分类实验显示，将街景图像与卫星时间序列整合可增强分类效果。
Conclusion: Space2Ground 2.0 提供了公开可用的基准数据集和可复现的多模态农业监测方法，潜在应用包括视觉验证、减少昂贵的地面巡查以及对数据驱动的农业政策提供支持。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Shapes from Examples: Foundations of Shape Learning in Recursive SHACL
papers.abstract_en: SHACL shapes enable data graph validation, making automatic shape learning essential for knowledge graph applications. We investigate the well-known fitting approach to this task: given sets P and N of positive and negative example nodes from an input graph, compute a shape expression C, possibly using shape names defined in a recursive shape catalogue, that validates at every node in P and none in N. We focus on the case where C is written in a core fragment of SHACL corresponding to the Description Logic ELI. For the catalogue, we consider the well-founded, stable, and supported semantics. We address fitting existence and most specific fitting computation, establish tight exponential-time upper bounds for both problems, and obtain polynomial bounds for relevant special cases.
papers.comment: full version of a paper accepted at ISWC26
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 SHACL 形状学习的拟合问题：给定输入图中的正例节点集 P 和反例节点集 N，计算一个形状表达式 C（可能使用递归形状目录中的形状名），使 C 验证 P 中所有节点且不验证 N 中任何节点。作者将 C 限制在对应描述逻辑 ELI 的 SHACL 核心片段，并考察良基、稳定和支持三种目录语义，讨论拟合的存在性与最特异拟合计算，建立两个问题的紧指数时间上界，并在相关特殊情形下获得多项式界。
Motivation: SHACL 形状用于数据图验证，而自动形状学习对知识图谱应用至关重要；现有工作缺乏对递归形状目录下核心片段拟合问题的理论分析。
Method: 聚焦 SHACL 中对应描述逻辑 ELI 的核心片段，对递归形状目录采用良基、稳定和支持三种语义，形式化拟合存在性与最特异拟合计算问题，分析其计算复杂度。
Result: 摘要报告对拟合存在性和最特异拟合计算都建立了紧的指数时间上界，并在相关特殊情形下得到多项式时间界。
Conclusion: 作者指出这些复杂度结果覆盖了递归 SHACL 形状学习的基本理论边界，但未在摘要中讨论实验或实际系统实现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Geometry of Flow-Matching Uncertainty: A Cost-free Uncertainty Proxy and Its Application in Flow-based VLA Failure Detection
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching (FM) has become a popular action head paradigm for modern embodied models. However, as a conditional generative model, it does not explicitly expose its inherent uncertainty, producing faulty action chunks even when it misinterprets the scene or encounters out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs. Therefore, determining when an FM-generated action can be trusted is essential for safe deployment, yet existing uncertainty estimation methods on real-time control suffer from several issues: extra training budget, high computational overhead, and low generalization ability. In this work, we provide a geometric interpretation of FM uncertainty in the velocity field, showing that uncertainty manifests as deviation from an ideal affine-isotropic contraction field. Building on this observation, we introduce denoising acceleration ($\mathrm{accel}$), a highly-generalizable and cost-free uncertainty proxy that measures the bending of the denoising trajectory from a single forward pass, without additional model evaluations, training, or resampling. We theoretically and empirically demonstrate that $\mathrm{accel}$ is a faithful proxy for FM uncertainty and further test its utility in online failure detection. Results show that $\mathrm{accel}$ identifies failing rollouts well before termination, matching or even outperforming costly resampling- and training-based baselines across settings under realistic deployment budget. Code and demos available at: https://github.com/rrrrrrzy/fm-geometry.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从几何视角解释流匹配 (flow matching, FM) 中不确定性在速度场中的表现，提出一种零成本不确定性代理 denoising acceleration (accel)，仅需单次前向传播即可度量去噪轨迹的弯曲程度。作者在理论和实验上论证 accel 可作为 FM 不确定性的可靠代理，并将其用于在线失败检测，能在任务终止前识别失败 rollout，且性能匹配或超过基于重采样和训练的基线方法。
Motivation: 流匹配已成为现代具身模型常用的动作头范式，但它作为条件生成模型不显式暴露内在不确定性，在场景误读或面对分布外 (OOD) 输入时会生成错误动作块。现有不确定性估计方法在实时控制场景中存在额外训练预算、高计算开销和泛化能力低的问题，因此需要低成本且可泛化的不确定性代理。
Method: 作者给出 FM 不确定性在速度场中的几何解释，将不确定性视为对理想仿射-各向同性收缩场 (affine-isotropic contraction field) 的偏离。基于此提出 denoising acceleration (accel)，它通过单次前向传播度量去噪轨迹的弯曲程度，无需额外模型评估、训练或重采样。
Result: 理论上和经验上均证明 accel 是 FM 不确定性的忠实代理；在在线失败检测中，accel 能在 rollout 终止前识别失败，且在真实部署预算下与昂贵的重采样和训练基线相当或更优。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 accel 是一种高泛化、零成本的不确定性代理，可用于流匹配驱动的具身模型安全部署；代码和演示已在 GitHub 公开。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: H+ Embedding: Harmonizing Global and Token-Level Retrieval with Context-Dependent Phrases
papers.abstract_en: Terminology-intensive retrieval, especially in medical settings, depends on preserving multi-word entities, abbreviations, numerical constraints, and compositional concepts. However, existing representations lie at two extremes: single-vector retrievers often over-compress local relevance signals, while token-level late interaction retains every tokenizer subword at substantial indexing, storage, and scoring cost. This mismatch raises a natural question: can context-dependent phrases provide a useful retrieval unit between global vectors and tokens? We introduce H+ Embedding, a unified multi-granularity retriever that predicts variable-length phrase partitions, preserves uncovered tokens as singletons, and applies importance-guided unit selection with weighted MaxSim interaction. Across 16 scientific, medical, and bilingual tasks, its phrase retrieval branch exceeds the global retrieval branch by 6.91 macro nDCG@10. It also nearly matches Token while using 13.7% fewer document vectors and outperforms content-independent grouping rules under moderate vector budgets. Context-dependent phrase interaction therefore provides an intermediate quality-cost point between global compression and token-level interaction for practical retrieval systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 H+ Embedding，一种统一的多粒度检索器，以上下文相关短语 (context-dependent phrases) 作为介于全局向量与 token 级交互之间的检索单元。方法预测可变长度的短语切分，将未覆盖 token 保留为单例，并采用重要性引导的单元选择与加权 MaxSim 交互。在 16 个科学、医学和双语任务上，短语检索分支比全局检索分支的 macro nDCG@10 高 6.91，同时比 Token 级方法少用 13.7% 的文档向量并几乎追平其效果。
Motivation: 术语密集型检索（尤其是医学场景）依赖多词实体、缩写、数值约束和组合概念，而现有表示处于两个极端：单向量检索器过度压缩局部相关信号，token 级延迟交互则需保留每个子词，带来高昂的索引、存储和打分成本。作者提出疑问：上下文相关短语能否作为全局向量与 token 之间的有用检索单元。
Method: 引入 H+ Embedding，一种统一的多粒度检索器，预测可变长度的短语切分，未被覆盖的 token 保留为单例，并应用重要性引导的单元选择 (importance-guided unit selection) 与加权 MaxSim 交互 (weighted MaxSim interaction)。
Result: 在 16 个科学、医学和双语任务上，短语检索分支相对全局检索分支提升 6.91 macro nDCG@10；该分支几乎匹配 Token 级检索，同时减少 13.7% 的文档向量，并在中等向量预算下优于基于内容无关分组规则的基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为上下文相关短语交互在全局压缩与 token 级交互之间提供了实用的质量-成本中间点，适合实际检索系统部署。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Budget-Aware LLM Discovery via Cost-Calibrated Frontier Utility
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly support scientific and algorithmic discovery through inference-time search over evaluated candidates. Existing adaptive discovery controllers assign credit based only on score progress, even though prompt length, retries, and guidance calls cause search actions to incur different token costs. We prove that cost-blind credit can forfeit all but a vanishing fraction of attainable quality as frontiers multiply and costs diverge. Under a fixed search-side token budget, the controller must decide which frontier is improving and whether its gain justifies the realized cost before the budget is exhausted. We introduce \textbf{CostAda}, a cost-calibrated adaptive controller built around \emph{cost-calibrated frontier utility}. The utility values frontier progress relative to realized action cost and conditions that credit on the remaining budget. CostAda uses this signal to control local exploration intensity, frontier allocation, and budgeted tactic intervention. Cost and remaining budget therefore shape the search rather than serving only as accounting variables or a stopping rule. CostAda reaches the strongest baseline's full-budget quality with at most half the budget on twelve of sixteen benchmark--backbone pairs while achieving the strongest mean final quality on all eight benchmarks under GLM-5 and GPT-5.4.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大规模语言模型在推理时搜索（inference-time search）中进行科学发现与算法发现的任务，提出 CostAda——一种成本校准的自适应控制器。作者证明，在候选前沿（frontier）增多且成本分化时，忽略成本的信用分配会损失几乎全部可达到的质量；CostAda 基于成本校准的前沿效用（cost-calibrated frontier utility）来权衡前沿进展与已实现的动作成本，并依据剩余预算调节搜索。摘要报告 CostAda 在十六个基准-骨干（benchmark–backbone）组合中的十二个上，以不超过一半的预算达到最强基线在全预算下的质量。
Motivation: 现有自适应发现控制器只依据分数进展分配信用（credit），但提示长度、重试和指导调用会让不同搜索动作产生不同的 token 成本。在固定搜索侧 token 预算下，这种无视成本的信用分配可能使可达到的质量大幅损失。
Method: CostAda 以成本校准的前沿效用为核心，将前沿进展相对实际动作成本进行估值，并让该信用信号依赖剩余预算。控制器利用该信号调节局部探索强度、前沿分配和预算化的策略干预（budgeted tactic intervention），使成本和剩余预算真正塑造搜索过程，而非仅作为记账变量或停止规则。
Result: 在十六个基准–骨干组合中的十二个上，CostAda 以不超过一半的预算达到最强基线在完整预算下的质量；在 GLM-5 和 GPT-5.4 下，它在全部八个基准上取得最强的平均最终质量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，搜索控制中的成本与剩余预算应影响搜索策略本身，而不只是用于记录或决定何时停止；这种成本校准的信用分配能显著提升预算受限下的发现质量。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Property-driven Causal Abstractions for Markov Decision Processes
papers.abstract_en: Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) are widely used as decision-making models, commonly specified over factored state spaces through state variables and their valuations. The exponential blowup in the number of states renders many reasoning tasks in MDPs challenging. Abstractions are promising techniques to reduce MDPs and thus mitigate scalability issues. In this work, we introduce a notion of causality on factored MDPs and a novel property-driven causal abstraction technique that retains many characteristics of the original MDP model. For this, we rely on causal relations over state variable predicates and identify those states that share the same reasons for fulfilling or violating a given abstraction property. We theoretically and empirically compare various causal MDP abstractions using different model types such as MDPs, interval MDPs, or stochastic games. Our evaluation demonstrates the potential of our approach: For several standard benchmarks, we obtain small abstractions that allow us to compute near-optimal policies for the original MDP. Furthermore, our causal abstractions often generalize to related large-scale MDP models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在因子化MDP上引入因果性概念，提出一种属性驱动的因果抽象技术，利用状态变量谓词间的因果关系来识别对满足或违反给定属性具有相同原因的状态。作者在MDP、区间MDP和随机博弈等不同模型类型上进行了理论和经验比较，并在多个标准基准上获得小规模抽象，从而能为原MDP计算近最优策略。
Motivation: MDP通常定义在因子化状态空间上，状态数随变量呈指数增长，导致许多推理任务难以处理。抽象技术被视为缓解这一可扩展性问题的有前景手段。
Method: 提出因子化MDP上的因果性定义，并据此构造属性驱动的因果抽象：基于状态变量谓词的因果关系，合并那些对给定属性成立与否具有相同原因的状态。论文还比较了不同模型类型（MDP、区间MDP、随机博弈）下的因果抽象变体。
Result: 在多个标准基准上，该方法能产生足够小的抽象，使原MDP的近最优策略可以被计算；此外，这些因果抽象往往能泛化到相关的大规模MDP模型。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，所提因果抽象在理论和经验上均与多种模型类型进行了对比，展现出缓解状态爆炸问题并泛化到大规模MDP模型的潜力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Enfold: Folding World Model Imagination into Predictive Representations for Ultra-Efficient Embodied Control
papers.abstract_en: World generative models are typically used through what they produce: a rendered future, a video-conditioned action, or latent context computed by a costly generative branch. We argue that their more reusable asset is the computation that constructs a future. As a generator transforms a corrupted future into a coherent trajectory, its intermediate states organize appearance, spatial layout, and interaction across levels of abstraction. Can this future-generative computation be internalized in a representation inferred from the present alone? We present Enfold, which transfers this computation into a representation predicted from the current visual context and language instruction. During training, multi-level states exposed as the generator processes the observed future supervise a current-only encoder. The learned representation is fed back to condition future generation and is read by task heads without allowing task gradients to reshape the encoder. At deployment, action prediction no longer executes the generator. Across LIBERO, RoboTwin2.0, and real-robot tasks, Enfold supports strong control while reducing action latency by $3.7\times$ relative to Fast--WAM, Enfold-Flash reaches $10.1\times$. Representation analyses show that it suppresses nuisance variation and preferentially captures changes that emerge over longer horizons. When the current scene is altered by human intervention, both the generated continuation and the executed actions adapt, which is inconsistent with fixed trajectory replay. These results recast a world generator as a source of predictive control representations: its future need not be materialized at every step if its internal structure can be enfolded into the present.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Enfold，将世界生成模型（world generative model）在重建未来时产生的多级中间计算，蒸馏到仅由当前视觉上下文和语言指令预测的表征中，使部署时动作预测不再执行生成器。在 LIBERO、RoboTwin2.0 和真实机器人任务上，Enfold 将动作延迟相对 Fast-WAM 降低 3.7 倍，Enfold-Flash 达 10.1 倍。表征分析显示该表征抑制无关扰动，偏好捕获更长时程上发生的变化；人为改变当前场景时生成延续与执行动作都随之调整，排除固定轨迹回放。
Motivation: 以往世界模型的价值主要体现在其生成产物，如渲染的未来帧、视频条件化动作或由昂贵生成分支计算的潜在上下文；作者认为更具复用价值的是"构造未来"的计算过程本身，并追问能否把这种未来生成式计算内化到仅从当前信息推断的表征中。
Method: 训练时，用生成器处理观测到的未来时所暴露的多级状态来监督一个仅输入当前的编码器（current-only encoder）。学习到的表征被反馈用于条件化未来生成，并被任务头读取，但不允许任务梯度重塑该编码器。部署时动作预测不再运行生成器。
Result: 在 LIBERO、RoboTwin2.0 和真实机器人任务上，Enfold 在保持强控制性能的同时，将动作延迟相对 Fast-WAM 降低 3.7 倍，Enfold-Flash 达到 10.1 倍。表征分析显示它抑制扰动量（nuisance variation），并优先捕获随更长时程出现的状态变化。
Conclusion: 作者将世界生成器重新定位为预测性控制表征的来源：如果其内部结构能被"折入"当前表征，则无需每一步都物化未来。人为干预当前场景时，生成延续与执行动作均会适应，表明其行为与固定轨迹回放不一致。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: 训练时，用生成器处理观测到的未来时所暴露的多级状态来监督一个仅输入当前的编码器（current-only encoder）。学习到的表征被反馈用于条件化未来生成，并被任务头读取，但不允许任务梯度重塑该编码器。部署时动作预测不再运行生成器。
summary_sections.result: 在 LIBERO、RoboTwin2.0 和真实机器人任务上，Enfold 在保持强控制性能的同时，将动作延迟相对 Fast-WAM 降低 3.7 倍，Enfold-Flash 达到 10.1 倍。表征分析显示它抑制扰动量（nuisance variation），并优先捕获随更长时程出现的状态变化。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者将世界生成器重新定位为预测性控制表征的来源：如果其内部结构能被"折入"当前表征，则无需每一步都物化未来。人为干预当前场景时，生成延续与执行动作均会适应，表明其行为与固定轨迹回放不一致。

papers.title: LumaGuide: Distribution Shaping for Training-Free HDR Generation in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained diffusion models generate realistic images but are constrained by the statistical biases of their training data, limiting their ability to produce high dynamic range (HDR) content. In this work, we introduce LumaGuide, a training-free framework for distribution shaping in diffusion models. Instead of modifying model parameters, LumaGuide steers the sampling process to match target feature distributions via differentiable energy-based guidance. We instantiate this framework for HDR generation by controlling luminance distributions in perceptually uniform PQ space. Our results show that aligning luminance histograms is sufficient to induce HDR-consistent behavior, including coherent highlights and preserved shadow detail, while maintaining semantic fidelity. Beyond HDR, LumaGuide enables flexible specification of target distributions through data-driven presets, reference images, or text-driven predictors, and extends naturally to video generation with temporal consistency constraints. More broadly, our work demonstrates that controllable generation can be achieved by directly shaping output distributions at sampling time, without retraining diffusion models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LumaGuide，一种免训练 (training-free) 的扩散模型分布塑造框架，通过可微能量引导 (differentiable energy-based guidance) 在采样时引导输出特征分布匹配目标分布，用于 HDR 图像生成：在感知均匀 PQ 空间控制亮度直方图即可诱导 HDR 一致行为，包括连贯高光和保留阴影细节，同时保持语义保真度。框架还支持通过数据驱动预设、参考图像或文本驱动预测器指定目标分布，并扩展到带时间一致性约束的视频生成。
Motivation: 预训练扩散模型受训练数据统计偏差限制，难以生成高动态范围 (HDR) 内容；现有方法往往需要重训练或修改模型参数，缺乏免训练的可控生成手段。
Method: 提出 LumaGuide 免训练框架，不修改模型参数，而是通过可微能量引导在采样过程中将输出分布塑造成目标特征分布；HDR 实例化中在感知均匀 PQ 空间控制亮度直方图分布。
Result: 摘要报告对齐亮度直方图足以诱导 HDR 一致行为，包括连贯高光和保留阴影细节，同时保持语义保真度；并可在时间一致性约束下扩展到视频生成。
Conclusion: 作者认为无需重训练扩散模型，可直接在采样时通过塑造输出分布实现可控生成；该框架支持多种目标分布指定方式，并适用于视频。

papers.title: Localized Anomaly Detection via Differentiable D-vine Copulas
papers.abstract_en: Vine copulas provide a flexible framework for modeling complex multivariate distributions through a hierarchical decomposition into bivariate pair-copulas. Fitting a D-vine requires selecting a copula family and parameter configuration for each pair-copula from a set of candidates encoding different dependence patterns. As the number of variables and candidate families increases, the number of possible configurations grows combinatorially. Existing fitting procedures address this challenge through sequential greedy decisions, committing to a single locally optimal family at each step and potentially discarding configurations that would yield a better global fit. To overcome this limitation, we propose a novel estimation framework that combines gradient-based maximum likelihood estimation, enabled by our fully differentiable implementation, with a beam-search strategy that maintains multiple competing D-vine configurations throughout the fitting process. This allows a broader exploration of the configuration space while remaining computationally tractable. Building on the fitted D-vine, we introduce a localized anomaly detection framework that exploits the hierarchical decomposition to produce both global anomaly scores and edge-level explanations. Statistical guarantees are provided through Mondrian conformal prediction, while the pair-copula structure enables the localization of anomalies to specific variable relationships. We evaluate the proposed framework on both benchmark and real-world datasets, demonstrating its effectiveness for interpretable anomaly detection with uncertainty quantification.
papers.comment: Workshop paper accepted for presentation at the CAESAR workshop within ECML-PKDD (September 2026, Naples)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于可微 D-vine copula 的估计框架与局部异常检测方法。作者将梯度最大似然估计与 beam search 结合，在拟合过程中维护多个竞争性的 D-vine 配置，以替代逐步贪心选择 pair-copula 家族的做法；随后利用该层次分解同时输出全局异常分数和边级解释，并通过 Mondrian 共形预测提供统计保证。摘要在基准与真实数据集上报告了该方法对可解释异常检测和不确定性量化的有效性。
Motivation: 拟合 D-vine 时需要为每个 pair-copula 从候选集合中选取家族与参数，配置空间随变量数和候选家族数组合爆炸。现有流程通过顺序贪心决策提交单一局部最优家族，可能丢弃整体拟合更优的配置。
Method: 提出可微 D-vine 实现以支持基于梯度的最大似然估计，并用 beam search 在拟合全程保留多个候选配置以拓宽搜索空间。基于拟合出的 D-vine 构建局部异常检测框架，利用层次分解产生全局异常分数与边级解释，结合 Mondrian 共形预测给出不确定性量化。
Result: 摘要报告在基准数据集与真实数据集上的评估表明该框架能有效实现带不确定性量化的可解释异常检测，但未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 作者强调该框架通过保留多个竞争配置克服了贪心拟合的局限，并借助 pair-copula 层次结构将异常定位到具体变量关系，兼具共形预测的统计保证；其目标场景是可解释异常检测。

papers.title: Variance-Preserving Orthogonal Selection (VPOS): Greedy Feature Selection via Orthogonal Deflation in PCA Loading Space
papers.abstract_en: We present Variance-Preserving Orthogonal Selection (VPOS), an unsupervised feature-selection method that performs sequential orthogonal deflation in the variance-weighted principal component analysis (PCA) loading space $\mathbf{V}_d\mathbfΛ_d^{1/2}$. After each feature is selected, its loading direction is projected out of all remaining candidates, so subsequent selections cover complementary directions of the rank-$d$ covariance approximation while returning original variables. We establish rank-reduction guarantees and a determinant-growth interpretation, and distinguish VPOS from greedy selection on raw data, unweighted eigenvector pivoting, Principal Feature Analysis (PFA), and Principal Variable Selection (PVS). Experiments enforce $k\leq d$, tune method-specific parameters on validation observations, and evaluate on unseen outer folds. Across seven labelled benchmarks, VPOS improves held-out normalised reconstruction error over matched PCA without deflation on every dataset, with reductions of 1--78%. It obtains the lowest mean reconstruction error on Wine, Breast Cancer, and MNIST and is within 1.7% of the lowest error on CIFAR-10 and HighDim. On CIFAR-10, VPOS is approximately 24$\times$ faster than the closely related PVS baseline while incurring a 1.7% reconstruction gap. These results establish VPOS as an efficient covariance-coverage method, particularly when correlated high-dimensional data must be represented by a small set of identifiable original variables.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VPOS（Variance-Preserving Orthogonal Selection），一种无监督特征选择方法，在方差加权的主成分分析（PCA）载荷空间 $\mathbf{V}_d\mathbf{\Lambda}_d^{1/2}$ 中执行顺序正交收缩。每选出一个特征后，将其载荷方向从所有剩余候选中投影掉，从而在秩为 $d$ 的协方差近似下覆盖互补方向，同时返回原始变量。实验在七个标注基准上于每个数据集都改善了留出归一化重建误差，降幅为 1–78%，并在 Wine、Breast Cancer 和 MNIST 上取得最低平均重建误差。
Motivation: 现有无监督特征选择方法（如原始数据上的贪心选择、未加权特征向量枢轴、Principal Feature Analysis (PFA) 和 Principal Variable Selection (PVS)）在需要用少量可辨识的原始变量覆盖高维相关数据的协方差结构时存在效率或覆盖性不足的问题。
Method: VPOS 在方差加权 PCA 载荷空间中进行顺序正交收缩（orthogonal deflation）：每选择一个特征，就把该特征的载荷方向从其余候选中投影出去，使后续选择覆盖秩-$d$ 协方差近似的互补方向，同时保留原始变量作为输出。作者还给出了秩缩减保证和行列式增长解释，并将其与在原始数据上的贪心选择、未加权特征向量枢轴、PFA 和 PVS 加以区分。
Result: 在七个标注基准上，VPOS 在每个数据集上都优于未做收缩的匹配 PCA，留出归一化重建误差降低 1–78%；在 Wine、Breast Cancer 和 MNIST 上取得最低平均重建误差，在 CIFAR-10 和 HighDim 上距最低误差仅 1.7%。在 CIFAR-10 上，VPOS 比关系密切的 PVS 基线快约 24 倍，同时有 1.7% 的重建误差差距。实验限制 $k\leq d$，使用验证观测调参并在未见过的外层折上评估。
Conclusion: 作者认为 VPOS 是一种高效的协方差覆盖方法，特别适用于需要用少量可辨识的原始变量表示相关高维数据的场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DishSeg24k: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Food Segmentation with Stochastic Expert Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Food segmentation is essential for applications such as intelligent catering, dietary assessment, and recommendation. However, existing benchmarks fail to capture the complexity of real-world dining scenes. The challenges of dense inter-dish overlap, fine-grained class similarity, and extreme long-tail class distributions exceed the fidelity of current datasets. To fill this gap, we introduce \textbf{DishSeg24k}, a large-scale dish-level segmentation benchmark with 24,096 images, 112,281 instances, and 278 fine-grained categories in real-world dining environments. Based on DishSeg24k, we further propose \textbf{Food Expert-Adaptive Segmentation Transformers (FEAST)} to address these challenges. FEAST models query-based decoding as a Markov Decision Process (MDP), where each decoder layer update is treated as a sequential decision step that explores uncertainty along dish boundaries. We further redesign the decoder with a reinforcement learning (RL)-guided Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) module, in which a dual-critic decoupled optimization scheme separates task-oriented query refinement from structure-aware expert routing. This design promotes expert specialization and prevents expert collapse under long-tail category distributions. Finally, extensive experiments on DishSeg24k demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of FEAST, which outperforms previous methods by {+3.21\%} mIoU, {+3.68\%} mDice, and {+4.00\%} mAcc, respectively. We further validate the effectiveness of FEAST on FoodSeg103. The dataset and code will be publicly released.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 8 figures. This paper has been accepted by ACMMM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DishSeg24k，一个大规模菜品分割基准，包含 24,096 张图像、112,281 个实例和 278 个细粒度类别，面向真实餐饮场景。针对密集菜品重叠、细粒度类别相似和长尾分布问题，提出 Food Expert-Adaptive Segmentation Transformers (FEAST)，将查询解码建模为马尔可夫决策过程，并用 RL 引导的 MoE 模块配合双评论家解耦优化。在 DishSeg24k 上超过此前方法 +3.21% mIoU、+3.68% mDice、+4.00% mAcc，并在 FoodSeg103 上验证有效性。
Motivation: 现有食品分割基准无法反映真实餐饮场景的复杂度：密集菜品相互重叠、细粒度类别高度相似、极端长尾分布，超出当前数据集的保真度，因此需要更贴近实际的大规模基准和对应方法。
Method: 提出 FEAST，将基于查询的解码过程建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），每一层解码器更新视为沿菜品边界探索不确定性的序贯决策步；重新设计解码器为 RL 引导的 Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）模块，采用双评论家解耦优化，分离任务导向的查询精炼与结构感知的专家路由，以促进专家特化并防止长尾分布下的专家坍缩。
Result: 在 DishSeg24k 上，FEAST 取得 SOTA，相对此前方法提升 +3.21% mIoU、+3.68% mDice、+4.00% mAcc；并在 FoodSeg103 上进一步验证有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 DishSeg24k 与 FEAST 可用于应对真实餐饮场景中的菜品分割挑战，并承诺公开数据集和代码；摘要未提及明确的局限性。

papers.title: IR275K: A Benchmark for Infrared Multi-Frame Super-Resolution Toward Efficient Remote Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Efficient processing is becoming increasingly important in infrared remote sensing, where satellite constellations produce large volumes of observations under constrained detector resolution, power, and downlink bandwidth. Multi-frame super-resolution (MFSR) offers a software-based route to spatial enhancement, but its evaluation in infrared sensing remains fragmented across private datasets and ad-hoc protocols. Existing benchmarks do not explicitly capture the thermal contrast, sensor noise, weak texture, and platform-induced frame-to-frame variation that characterize infrared video. We introduce IR275K, a curated benchmark containing 594 infrared video sequences and 275,196 frames. It provides sequence-level train/validation/test splits and a reproducible X4 evaluation protocol. As an initial architectural probe, we further evaluate CGMamba, a lightweight state-space model with 10.90M parameters and 112.14G FLOPs. CGMamba combines 2D rotary position encoding (2D~RoPE) with center-guided cross-Mamba (CGCM) fusion for implicit multi-frame reconstruction. It achieves 33.19dB PSNR, outperforming infrared single-image super-resolution references by 0.35--0.52~dB at substantially lower computational cost. Ablation results show that removing 2D~RoPE from CGCM causes a 1.53dB drop and severe grid-like artifacts. This indicates that explicit spatial anchoring is critical for stabilizing SSM-based cross-frame gating under infrared conditions. IR275K provides a reproducible foundation for accuracy--efficiency evaluation of infrared MFSR methods, while the architectural analysis offers a concrete starting point for spatially aware SSM design under resource-constrained infrared sensing. Dataset and evaluation resources are available at: https://github.com/InfraRecon7/IR275K.

papers.title: TRW: TRACE-RealWorld---An Auditable Consistency Contract for World Models as Materialized Views
papers.abstract_en: World models let agents plan against predicted physical state, but that state drifts; re-observation is costly and delayed, and repair can fail. We present TRACE-RealWorld (TRW), to our knowledge the first commitment-level consistency contract for world models. TRW treats predicted state as a materialized view and a physical commitment as a read whose authorization can expire. Typed, calibrated claims specify consequence-conditioned freshness and priced verification. Adaptive refresh generalizes dual-Kalman synchronization to consult the world when evidence could change a decision; dependency-scoped SagaLLM compensation repairs reversible commitments invalidated after authorization. Under an event-aligned risk oracle and recovery-liveness assumptions, we prove that synchronization and compensation are insufficient alone, whereas their composition gives a conditional consistency guarantee. Otherwise, the argument yields an auditable decomposition of violations into named debts. We implement TRW in Flood-SAR, a search-and-rescue simulator over real geography, and test six preregistered questions at frozen operating points on held-out seeds. Adaptive refresh reduces stale execution but does not dominate fixed refresh on cost, coverage, or rescue outcomes. Localized repair reduces repair work by 9.56 units per mission and restoration latency by 80.7 seconds relative to global recovery; the observed residual-violation difference is zero without establishing equivalence. Detection coverage is 0.83-0.89, and 10 of 97 invoked restorations are incomplete by mission end. The campaign treats empirical slack as sensitivity inputs rather than discharging the theorem's assumptions or providing a simultaneous population certificate. Exact replay reconstructs a disputed dispatch. TRW thus makes a world model an auditable predictive interface rather than a self-validating source of truth.
papers.comment: v2 propagates declared point and extended hazards through the composition theorem and separates point-event from interval-risk budgets. It aligns Flood-SAR adjudication with each hazard class, sharpens calibration-slack and drift claims, adds bootstrap Monte Carlo error and joint-coverage requirements, revises terminology, and expands related-work context
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TRACE-RealWorld (TRW)，号称首个面向世界模型的承诺级一致性契约 (commitment-level consistency contract)，把预测状态视为物化视图 (materialized view)，把物理承诺视为可过期授权的读。自适应刷新将双卡尔曼同步 (dual-Kalman synchronization) 推广为在证据可能改变决策时咨询真实世界，依赖作用域的 SagaLLM 补偿用于修复授权后失效的可逆承诺。在事件对齐风险预言机和恢复活性假设下，作者证明同步与补偿单独均不足，组合后才能给出条件一致性保证，否则能将违规可审计地分解为具名债务。Flood-SAR 仿真实验表明 TRW 能降低陈旧执行并加速局部修复，但经验余量仅作为敏感性输入，未完全验证定理假设。
Motivation: 世界模型依据预测物理状态进行规划，但状态会漂移；重新观测代价高且有延迟，修复过程也可能失败。现有方法缺少一个在承诺级别约束世界模型、并允许审计违约来源的一致性框架。
Method: TRW 将物理承诺建模为可过期授权的读，使用类型化且校准过的声明表达后果条件的新鲜度与定价验证。自适应刷新在证据可能改变决策时咨询真实世界，泛化了双卡尔曼同步；依赖作用域的 SagaLLM 补偿用于撤销被后续证据否定的可逆承诺。理论上在事件对齐风险预言机和恢复活性假设下证明同步与补偿的合取给出条件一致性保证，否则违约可分解为具名债务；实现基于真实地理的 Flood-SAR 搜救模拟器，并在冻结运行点上测试六个预注册问题。
Result: 自适应刷新减少了陈旧执行，但并未在成本、覆盖或救援结果上全面优于固定刷新。与全局恢复相比，局部修复使每次任务的修复工作量减少 9.56 单位，恢复延迟减少 80.7 秒；观测到的残余违规差异为零但未建立等价性。检测覆盖率在 0.83–0.89 之间，97 次调用恢复中有 10 次在任务结束前未完成。
Conclusion: 作者强调经验余量应作为敏感性输入，而不是用来免除定理假设或提供同时成立的总体证书；精确重放可重建争议调度。TRW 的定位是把世界模型变成可审计的预测接口 (auditable predictive interface)，而非自我验证的真相源。
Relevance: 58

papers.title: Analytic Distribution of Classifier-Free Guidance for Schedule Design
papers.abstract_en: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) is the default mechanism for conditional generation in diffusion models, but the distribution sampled by its deterministic guided dynamics is not captured by the usual product-distribution heuristic $p_0^ωq_0^{1-ω}$. We analyze CFG through the probability flow ODE and derive exact analytic path-integral representations of the induced distributions for both constant and time-dependent guidance. The resulting formulas show that CFG modifies $p_{t_0}$ by an exponential path-integral correction, and that a time-dependent schedule enters this correction through the weight $ω(t)-1$. This characterization explains how score discrepancies accumulate along sampling trajectories and motivates Distribution-Guided CFG (DG-CFG), a schedule that balances timestep contributions while accounting for signal strength and low-noise score-error amplification. A toy model with analytic scores closely verifies the predicted distributions. Across Stable Diffusion~1.5, Stable Diffusion~2.1, and Stable Diffusion~XL, DG-CFG yields a stronger diversity--fidelity trade-off and robustly mitigates the saturation and quality degradation caused by strong constant or heuristic guidance. Complete NFE experiments on Stable Diffusion~1.5 and Stable Diffusion~2.1 confirm that these gains persist across sampling budgets, while fixed-quality experiments on both backbones show that DG-CFG reaches target metrics with fewer sampling steps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从概率流 ODE (probability flow ODE) 出发分析 classifier-free guidance (CFG) 在扩散模型中诱导的真实分布，指出通常的乘积分布启发式 p_0^ω q_0^{1-ω} 并不准确，并推导出常数值与时变 guidance 下分布的精确路径积分表示。该表示显示 CFG 通过指数路径积分修正改变 p_{t_0}，时间依赖调度通过权重 ω(t)-1 进入修正项，并据此提出分布引导的 CFG 调度 DG-CFG。在 Stable Diffusion 1.5/2.1/XL 上，DG-CFG 改善了多样性-保真度权衡并缓解强 guidance 导致的饱和与质量下降，NFE 与固定质量实验也支持其收益。
Motivation: CFG 是扩散模型条件生成的默认机制，但其确定性引导动态所采样的分布无法被常见的乘积分布启发式刻画，导致对引导机制的理论理解不足。
Method: 通过概率流 ODE 分析 CFG，推导常数和时变 guidance 下诱导分布的精确解析路径积分表示，揭示修正项由权重 ω(t)-1 控制，进而提出 DG-CFG 调度，在平衡各时间步贡献的同时考虑信号强度和低噪声区间的 score 误差放大。
Result: 带解析 score 的玩具模型验证了预测分布；在 Stable Diffusion 1.5、2.1 和 XL 上，DG-CFG 获得更强的多样性-保真度权衡，并稳健缓解强常数或启发式 guidance 造成的饱和与质量退化。完整 NFE 实验表明收益在不同采样预算下保持，固定质量实验显示 DG-CFG 用更少采样步达到目标指标。
Conclusion: 论文将 CFG 诱导分布刻画为带 ω(t)-1 权重的指数路径积分修正，说明调度设计对引导质量的关键作用，并表明 DG-CFG 可作为强 guidance 场景下的稳健替代方案。
Relevance: 25

papers.title: Recti-Q: Feature-Space Rectification for Out-of-Distribution-Robust Quantized Perception in Edge Robotics
papers.abstract_en: Robotic perception pipelines increasingly rely on large vision backbones deployed on SWaP-constrained edge platforms, making post-training quantization (PTQ) attractive for real-time inference. However, while PTQ often preserves clean in-distribution accuracy, we show that it can substantially degrade reliability under deployment-relevant distribution shifts (e.g., sensor noise, severe weather, and novel operating environments), creating a Quantization-Induced Robustness Gap. Across foundational vision benchmarks (ImageNet-C and PACS), 4-bit PTQ models exhibit pronounced robustness degradation despite negligible ID accuracy loss. To address this, we propose Recti-Q, a lightweight feature-space rectification framework that freezes the quantized backbone and trains a small classifier-head LoRA adapter using only source data. Recti-Q is architecture-agnostic across CNNs and Transformers, supports efficient teacher-free training, and recovers a significant portion of the lost robustness, in some cases matching or exceeding FP32 performance. At less than 1% parameter overhead (as small as 6 KB), Recti-Q preserves over 99% of PTQ memory savings, adds negligible compute, and enables low-bandwidth Over-The-Air (OTA) resilience patching for deployed robotic fleets operating in unpredictable physical environments.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究后训练量化（PTQ）在边缘机器人感知中的分布外鲁棒性问题，指出 4-bit PTQ 在 ImageNet-C 与 PACS 上虽保持分布内精度，却显著损失部署相关的鲁棒性，形成所谓 Quantization-Induced Robustness Gap。作者提出 Recti-Q，一个轻量特征空间矫正框架：冻结量化骨干，仅用源数据训练小型分类头 LoRA 适配器，在不到 1% 参数开销（最小 6 KB）下恢复大部分鲁棒性，部分情况达到或超过 FP32 性能，并支持低带宽 OTA 韧性补丁。
Motivation: 机器人感知常在大规模视觉骨干上采用 PTQ 以满足边缘平台的尺寸、重量与功耗（SWaP）约束；但 PTQ 在传感器噪声、恶劣天气和新型环境等分布偏移下会严重降低可靠性，而现有研究多只关注分布内精度，忽略了这种鲁棒性差距。
Method: Recti-Q 冻结量化后的骨干网络，仅训练一个附加在分类头的小型 LoRA 适配器，且只使用源域数据；该方案与 CNN/Transformer 架构无关，支持无需教师模型的训练，并可作为低带宽 Over-The-Air（OTA）补丁部署。
Result: 实验显示 4-bit PTQ 模型在 ImageNet-C 和 PACS 上鲁棒性显著退化而分布内精度损失可忽略；Recti-Q 以低于 1% 的参数开销（最小 6 KB）恢复大部分丢失的鲁棒性，部分情形匹配或超过 FP32，同时保留 PTQ 超过 99% 的内存节省并增加可忽略的算力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 Quantization-Induced Robustness Gap 是 PTQ 部署中的一个被忽视问题，并表明轻量特征空间矫正可以低成本恢复分布外鲁棒性，适合机器人车队在不可预测物理环境中的实际部署与远程修复。

summary_sections.motivation: 机器人感知常在大规模视觉骨干上采用 PTQ 以满足边缘平台的尺寸、重量与功耗（SWaP）约束；但 PTQ 在传感器噪声、恶劣天气和新型环境等分布偏移下会严重降低可靠性，而现有研究多只关注分布内精度，忽略了这种鲁棒性差距。
summary_sections.method: Recti-Q 冻结量化后的骨干网络，仅训练一个附加在分类头的小型 LoRA 适配器，且只使用源域数据；该方案与 CNN/Transformer 架构无关，支持无需教师模型的训练，并可作为低带宽 Over-The-Air（OTA）补丁部署。
summary_sections.result: 实验显示 4-bit PTQ 模型在 ImageNet-C 和 PACS 上鲁棒性显著退化而分布内精度损失可忽略；Recti-Q 以低于 1% 的参数开销（最小 6 KB）恢复大部分丢失的鲁棒性，部分情形匹配或超过 FP32，同时保留 PTQ 超过 99% 的内存节省并增加可忽略的算力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调 Quantization-Induced Robustness Gap 是 PTQ 部署中的一个被忽视问题，并表明轻量特征空间矫正可以低成本恢复分布外鲁棒性，适合机器人车队在不可预测物理环境中的实际部署与远程修复。

papers.title: Infrared Organization and Critical Cognitive Field Formation in Transformer Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Large language models exhibit remarkable emergent behaviors, yet the physical mechanism governing their collective dynamics remains poorly understood. Cognitive Field Theory predicts that learning reorganizes the collective relaxation spectrum through the infrared accumulation of slow relaxation modes, thereby enhancing memory self-energy, long-memory dynamics, and collective susceptibility. Here we test this framework directly in Transformer dynamics. Using publicly available Pythia language models, we extract relaxation spectra from layer Jacobians throughout training, prompt ensembles, network depth, and model scale, allowing the collective observables of Cognitive Field Theory to be measured quantitatively. The measurements reveal pronounced infrared reorganization of the relaxation spectrum. Slow relaxation modes progressively accumulate toward the infrared, producing an approximately flat time-scale density of states, \( ρ(λ)\simλ^β,\ β\simeq-0.1, \) while the corresponding memory kernel exhibits universal scaling, \( K(t)\sim1/t. \) The collective observables further reveal a critical formation process: the memory self-energy reaches a transient maximum during early training before relaxing toward a metastable near-critical regime. Prompt-resolved and token-subspace measurements show that distinct local Jacobians converge toward the same normalized infrared TDOS, consistent with an infrared fixed-point organization under coarse graining. The reproducibility of the same infrared organization across training, prompt ensembles, network depth, and Transformer model scales establishes infrared slow-mode organization as a universal collective principle underlying Transformer dynamics, providing the first quantitative experimental realization of the collective observables predicted by Cognitive Field Theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用公开的 Pythia 语言模型，从层 Jacobian 中提取弛豫谱，直接检验 Cognitive Field Theory 对 Transformer 集体动力学的预测。测量显示弛豫谱出现显著的红外重组：慢弛豫模式逐渐向红外累积，时间尺度态密度接近平坦（ρ(λ)~λ^β, β≈-0.1），记忆核呈普适标度 K(t)~1/t；记忆自能在训练早期达到瞬态极大后弛豫到亚稳态近临界区。作者认为这种红外慢模式组织在训练、提示集成、网络深度和模型尺度上均可复现，是 Transformer 动力学中普遍存在的集体原理，并声称这是 Cognitive Field Theory 所预测集体观测量的首次定量实验实现。
Motivation: 大语言模型表现出显著的涌现行为，但其集体动力学的物理机制仍不清楚。Cognitive Field Theory 预测学习会通过慢弛豫模式的红外累积重组集体弛豫谱，从而增强记忆自能、长时记忆动力学和集体磁化率，但该框架此前缺少在 Transformer 动力学中的直接定量验证。
Method: 使用公开可得的 Pythia 语言模型，在训练过程、提示集成、网络深度和模型规模等条件下，从层 Jacobian 提取弛豫谱，并对 Cognitive Field Theory 的集体可观测量进行定量测量；同时通过提示分辨与 token 子空间测量检验局部 Jacobian 在粗粒化下的红外固定点组织。
Result: 摘要报告弛豫谱发生显著红外重组，慢模式向红外累积，时间尺度态密度近似为 ρ(λ)~λ^β、β≈-0.1，对应记忆核呈 K(t)~1/t 的普适标度；记忆自能在早期训练达到瞬态最大值后进入近临界亚稳态；不同局部 Jacobian 在粗粒化下收敛到相同的归一化红外 TDOS，且该组织在训练、提示集成、深度和模型尺度上重复出现。
Conclusion: 作者强调红外慢模式组织是 Transformer 动力学中跨训练、提示、深度与模型尺度可复现的普遍集体原理，构成 Cognitive Field Theory 预测的集体观测量的首次定量实验实现；摘要未讨论该方法对下游任务性能或实际应用的影响。

papers.title: MAC 2026: Advancing Micro-Action Analysis Towards Fine-Grained Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Micro-Actions (MAs) are subtle and spontaneous human behaviors that provide important non-verbal cues in social interaction and affective communication. However, their short duration, weak motion patterns, and fine-grained semantic differences make them difficult to annotate, model, and evaluate in a standardized manner. To promote academic research on micro-action analysis, we proposed and have annually organized the Micro-Action Analysis Grand Challenge (MAC) as a public benchmark platform for this emerging field. The first two editions of MAC established standardized evaluation settings for micro-action recognition and detection, providing publicly accessible datasets and protocols. Building upon these editions, this paper presents the 3rd MAC, held in conjunction with ACM Multimedia 2026. Under the theme of moving from recognition to fine-grained micro-action understanding, this edition further expands the scope of the challenge beyond conventional recognition and detection. In particular, we introduce a new task named fine-grained micro-action understanding, evaluated with the assistance of multimodal large language models, aiming to assess models' ability to capture fine-grained semantic cues and interpret subtle human micro-actions at a deeper level. We summarize the datasets, task settings, evaluation protocols, competition results, and representative solutions from top-performing teams. Finally, we discuss future directions for micro-action analysis and its broader role in human-centric video understanding.
papers.comment: Challenge Summary Paper of the 3rd Micro-Action Analysis Grand Challenge (MAC 2026) at ACM Multimedia 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是第三届微动作分析挑战赛 (MAC 2026) 的挑战赛总结论文，主题从常规识别与检测转向细粒度微动作理解。作者引入一个名为细粒度微动作理解 (fine-grained micro-action understanding) 的新任务，借助多模态大语言模型 (multimodal large language models) 辅助评估模型捕捉细微语义线索和深层解读微动作的能力，并总结数据集、任务设置、评估协议、比赛结果及优胜队伍的解决方案。
Motivation: 微动作 (Micro-Actions) 是细微且自发的人类行为，短时长、弱运动模式和细粒度语义差异使其难以被标准化地标注、建模和评估；前两届挑战赛已建立识别与检测的基准，本届旨在将研究推进到更细粒度的理解层面。
Method: 在既有识别与检测任务基础上，提出新的细粒度微动作理解任务，并使用多模态大语言模型进行辅助评估，以考查模型对细微语义线索的捕捉和对深层微动作含义的解读能力；同时沿用了公开数据集与标准化评估设置。
Result: 摘要未报告具体量化指标，而是总结了本挑战赛的数据集、任务设置、评估协议、比赛结果，以及顶尖队伍的代表性解决方案。
Conclusion: 作者讨论了微动作分析的未来方向及其在人中心视频理解 (human-centric video understanding) 中的更广泛作用，强调从识别走向更深入的细粒度理解。
