papers.title: Role Steering of Language Models for Social Simulations
papers.abstract_en: Social simulations built from language-model agents need role-conditioned behavior that can be checked before agents are placed into a simulated population. We introduce an activation-steering screening workflow for role-conditioned agents: define a role profile, extract a role-specific direction, sweep four steering coefficients, evaluate role-profile alignment, and pass or flag each candidate configuration. On OLMo-3-7B-Instruct, we apply the workflow to a mixed 275-role inventory with 228 role-agnostic questions, GPT-4.1-mini prompted role references, and GPT-4.1-mini judges. Role-specific directions receive higher judged role-profile alignment than an assistant-axis directional control from prior persona-vector work, with mean overall scores of 63.2 versus 41.1 across the tested grid. They also preserve high lexical diversity, while the control drops sharply at larger coefficients. The role-level screen is the main practical output: most roles improve as steering increases, but 38 roles decline across all six measured dimensions, showing why simulation builders should choose coefficients per role rather than deploy a uniform high-strength setting. We make our code and evaluation artifacts available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/anonymous-research-code-5F03/.
papers.comment: 35 pages. Published at the Social Sim'26 Workshop, COLM 2026. Code: https://github.com/eilab-gt/casting-call-vectors
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对语言模型智能体的角色激活转向筛选工作流 (activation-steering screening workflow)，用于社交模拟 (social simulation) 中的角色条件化行为验证。工作流包括定义角色档案、提取角色特定方向、扫描四个转向系数、评估角色档案对齐度，并对候选配置给出通过或标记。在 OLMo-3-7B-Instruct 上使用 275 个角色和 228 个与角色无关的问题，角色特定方向在判断对齐度上优于先前的助手指向控制 (63.2 对 41.1)，同时保持较高的词汇多样性。摘要强调 38 个角色在所有六个维度上随转向强度增加而下降，说明应按角色选择系数而非统一高强度设置。
Motivation: 基于语言模型智能体的社交模拟需要可核查的角色条件化行为，以便在智能体放入模拟群体之前进行验证。现有方法缺乏一个系统性的筛选流程来预先评估角色转向方向的有效性。
Method: 提出角色转向工作流：定义角色档案，提取角色特定方向，扫描四个转向系数，使用 GPT-4.1-mini 生成角色参考和评判，评估角色档案对齐度，并对候选配置执行通过/标记筛选。实验设置包括混合 275 角色清单、228 个角色无关问题，以及来自先前人格向量工作的助手指向控制作为对比。
Result: 角色特定方向的平均整体得分 63.2，显著高于助手指向控制的 41.1；并且角色特定方向在较大系数下保持高词汇多样性，而控制组的词汇多样性显著下降。大多数角色在转向增强时表现提升，但有 38 个角色在所有六个测量维度上均下降。
Conclusion: 摘要强调社交模拟构建者应针对每个角色单独选择转向系数，而非对所有角色统一采用高强度设置；代码与评估产物已公开。

papers.title: Benchmark Evaluation of Federated Learning on Multi-organ Images
papers.abstract_en: The privacy requirements of medical data and its substantial variations across organs and modalities hinder the clinical implementation of medical AI. Federated learning (FL) is a feasible approach to overcome these challenges. Due to the continuous emergence of FL algorithms and the highly heterogeneous nature of medical data, objectively evaluating their performance in real-world clinical settings remains difficult. Therefore, a comprehensive federated medical imaging benchmark, serving as a unified evaluation standard, is crucial for advancing the technology toward reliable clinical application. Existing federated medical imaging benchmarks have not yet adequately incorporated state-of-the-art algorithms, are limited to data from single organs or modalities, and overly emphasize model accuracy, making it difficult to comprehensively assess the overall efficacy of FL in real-world medical environments. To address these challenges, we developed the MobenFL benchmark. This benchmark integrates 20 cutting-edge FL algorithms and 22 medical imaging datasets, covering 12 critical organs across the human body, surpassing existing benchmark in breadth. In terms of evaluation dimensions, MobenFL not only assesses performance but also systematically incorporates key metrics such as algorithmic efficiency and privacy protection capabilities. Additionally, it conducts specialized evaluations for complex real-world clinical scenarios involving different diseases, devices, and imaging modalities, thereby providing a comprehensive and in-depth evaluation framework for the clinical application of FL in the medical field.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MobenFL，一个面向多器官医学影像的联邦学习（federated learning, FL）基准，整合了20种FL算法和22个医学影像数据集，覆盖人体12个关键器官，并在性能之外纳入算法效率和隐私保护能力，同时对跨疾病、设备和成像模态的真实临床场景进行专项评估。
Motivation: 现有联邦医学影像基准未能充分纳入最新FL算法、局限于单一器官或单一模态，且过度强调模型准确率，难以全面评估FL在真实医学环境中的综合效果。
Method: 构建 MobenFL 基准，集成20种前沿FL算法与22个医学影像数据集，覆盖12个关键器官；评估维度上同时考察性能、算法效率和隐私保护能力，并设计针对不同疾病、设备和成像模态的真实临床场景专项评估。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的定量实验结果；主要贡献体现在基准规模（20种算法、22个数据集、12个器官）和评估维度的扩展上。
Conclusion: 作者认为 MobenFL 为FL在医学领域的临床应用提供了更全面和深入的评估框架。

papers.title: Bi-PT: Bidirectional Cross-Attention Point Transformers for Four-Chamber Heart Reconstruction from Sparse Cardiac MRI Data
papers.abstract_en: We propose Bi-PT, a pipeline for reconstructing 3D four-chamber human heart meshes from clinical sparsely sampled cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (CMR) data. This work addresses the error-prone generation of 3D cardiac shape from a sparse point cloud (SPC) extracted from 2D long-axis and short-axis views used in routine clinical CMR protocols. Bi-PT enables accurate inference of the four-chamber heart mesh from the SPC by learning robust point features via bidirectional point cross-attention between an atlas and the SPC, together with per-point semantic labels that improve correspondence estimation. We formulate the deformation field as a Neural Ordinary Differential Equation (NODE) parameterized by a per-point affine transformation and translation to deform the atlas toward the target heart shape. By learning such a NODE, we can guarantee the deformation field to be a locally affine diffeomorphic deformation. We also integrate a semantic label loss into the Chamfer distance to encourage label-consistent correspondences and add a smoothness regularization to stabilize and improve the learning of the deformation field. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Bi-PT achieves accurate and robust performance compared to baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Bi-PT，一条从临床稀疏采样心脏 MRI (CMR) 数据重建三维四腔心心脏网格的流程。方法从常规 CMR 的二维长轴和短轴视图提取稀疏点云 (SPC)，通过 atlas 与 SPC 之间的双向点交叉注意力学习鲁棒点特征，并用逐点语义标签改进对应关系估计。变形场被建模为神经 ODE (NODE)，由逐点仿射变换和平移参数化，从而保证局部仿射微分同胚变形。实验表明相比基线方法，Bi-PT 达到准确且鲁棒的重建性能。
Motivation: 针对常规临床 CMR 协议中二维长轴/短轴视图提取的稀疏点云 (SPC) 生成三维心脏形状误差大的问题，目标是实现四腔心网格的准确推断。
Method: 提出 Bi-PT 流程：利用 atlas 与 SPC 间的双向点交叉注意力学习鲁棒点特征，并引入逐点语义标签改进对应估计；将变形场建模为由逐点仿射变换和平移参数化的 NODE，保证局部仿射微分同胚变形；在 Chamfer 距离中集成语义标签损失，并加入平滑正则化以稳定变形场学习。
Result: 摘要报告大量实验表明，与基线相比 Bi-PT 在稀疏 CMR 数据上实现准确且鲁棒的四腔心重建性能。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过 NODE 学习的局部仿射微分同胚变形配合标签一致对应与平滑正则化，能提升稀疏数据下心脏网格重建的准确性和鲁棒性。

papers.title: MSA-DCNN: A Data-Efficient Multi-Scale Attention Deformable CNN for Medical Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Existing deep learning methods perform well in medical image classification but struggle with multi-scale morphology and limited annotations due to fixed sampling and data-hungry training. Existing approaches address these challenges in isolation: DCN-based models provide adaptive sampling but lack explicit multi-scale attention fusion and label-efficient regularisation; multi-scale architectures typically rely on static fusion; and semi-supervised methods target label scarcity without jointly modelling adaptive cross-scale representations. We propose MSA-DCNN, a scale-consistent deformable attention learning framework that introduces adaptive multi-scale sampling, within-scale saliency refinement, learned cross-scale fusion, and auxiliary self-distillation within a unified optimisation scheme, with potential to generalise to structurally heterogeneous anatomy. We evaluate on three public benchmarks and an external hold-out set for leukaemia. MSA-DCNN demonstrates competitive and often better performance against ViT baselines, CNN baselines, and a MICCAI semi-supervised baseline under distribution shift and label scarcity in accuracy, F1, and AUC (binary), while using fewer parameters. Ablations confirm complementary component contributions, supporting MSA-DCNN as a practical foundation for data-efficient medical image classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MSA-DCNN，一个面向医学图像分类的尺度一致可变形注意力学习框架。它统一了自适应多尺度采样、尺度内显著性细化、学习式跨尺度融合和辅助自蒸馏，以应对多尺度形态和标注稀缺问题。在三个公开基准和一个外部白血病留出集上，该方法在分布偏移和标签稀缺条件下相比 ViT、CNN 及 MICCAI 半监督基线取得有竞争力或更优的性能，且参数更少。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法在医学图像分类中受限于固定采样和数据饥饿训练，难以处理多尺度形态和少量标注。已有方法孤立地解决这些问题：DCN 模型有自适应采样但缺少显式多尺度注意力融合和标签高效正则化，多尺度架构通常采用静态融合，半监督方法仅针对标签稀缺而未联合建模自适应跨尺度表示。
Method: 提出 MSA-DCNN 框架，包含自适应多尺度采样、尺度内显著性细化、学习式跨尺度融合以及辅助自蒸馏，并将这些组件纳入统一优化方案中进行联合训练。
Result: 在三个公共基准和一个外部白血病留出集上，MSA-DCNN 在分布偏移和标签稀缺条件下，于 accuracy、F1 和 AUC（二分类）上相较 ViT 基线、CNN 基线和 MICCAI 半监督基线表现出有竞争力且常更优的性能，同时使用更少的参数；消融实验确认各组件贡献互补。
Conclusion: 作者认为 MSA-DCNN 可作为数据高效医学图像分类的实用基础，并具有推广到结构异质解剖区域的潜力。

papers.title: HunyuanOCR-1.5: Making Lightweight OCR VLMs Faster and Better
papers.abstract_en: We present HunyuanOCR-1.5, a lightweight end-to-end OCR-specialized vision-language model. HunyuanOCR unifies document parsing, text spotting, information extraction, text-image translation, and multi-image document understanding within a single end-to-end VLM. Building upon the lightweight architecture of HunyuanOCR-1.0, HunyuanOCR-1.5 does not redesign the backbone, but systematically improves both efficiency and capability. For efficiency, we adapt DFlash to OCR decoding, significantly reducing the latency of long structured outputs such as dense documents, tables, and formulas while preserving output distribution. Powered by DFlash, HunyuanOCR-1.5 achieves a 6.37x Transformer inference speedup and a 2.14x speedup under vLLM, delivering the fastest inference among lightweight OCR VLMs. For capability, we propose Agentic Data Flow, an agent-driven data construction system that transforms model weaknesses into executable data requirements and autonomously performs material search, quality verification, and pipeline development. It substantially improves long-tail capabilities in ancient-script OCR, fine-grained chart and table parsing, multi-image text-centric QA, low-resource multilingual parsing, and document hallucination evaluation. HunyuanOCR-1.5 ranks among the top-tier end-to-end OCR solutions on OmniDocBench v1.6 while achieving new performance milestones across these long-tail tasks. Combined with an upgraded pretraining and post-training recipe, HunyuanOCR-1.5 further extends its capability in high-resolution, long-context, and multi-task scenarios. Experiments demonstrate faster inference, broader OCR capability coverage, and the deployment advantages of a lightweight end-to-end model. We will release the model weights and training code to support future research and real-world OCR applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HunyuanOCR-1.5，一个轻量级端到端 OCR 专用视觉语言模型 (VLM)，在 HunyuanOCR-1.0 架构基础上不做主干网络改动，而是从效率和能力两方面系统改进。效率上引入 DFlash 加速长结构化输出（密集文档、表格、公式）的解码；能力上提出 Agentic Data Flow 数据构建系统，针对模型弱点自动生成数据需求并完成素材搜索与质量验证。摘要报告其 Transformer 推理加速 6.37 倍、vLLM 下加速 2.14 倍，并在 OmniDocBench v1.6 及多项长尾任务上取得新进展。
Motivation: 现有轻量级 OCR VLM 在长结构化输出解码上延迟较高，且长尾能力（古代文字 OCR、细粒度图表解析、多图文本问答等）覆盖不足；作者希望在不改造主干的前提下同时提升推理效率与能力覆盖。
Method: 提出两种系统化改进：一是将 DFlash 适配到 OCR 解码，在保持输出分布不变的情况下减少密集文档、表格和公式等长结构化输出的延迟；二是提出 Agentic Data Flow，一种智能体驱动的数据构建系统，将模型弱点转化为可执行的数据需求，并自主完成素材搜索、质量验证和流水线开发；同时升级预训练与后训练配方以支持高分辨率、长上下文和多任务场景。
Result: 摘要报告 DFlash 带来 6.37 倍的 Transformer 推理加速和 vLLM 下的 2.14 倍加速，在轻量级 OCR VLM 中推理最快；HunyuanOCR-1.5 在 OmniDocBench v1.6 上位列端到端 OCR 方案第一梯队，并在古代文字 OCR、细粒度图表与表格解析、多图文本 QA、低资源多语种解析及文档幻觉评测等长尾任务上达到新的性能里程碑。
Conclusion: 作者强调轻量级端到端模型兼顾更快推理、更广 OCR 能力覆盖与部署优势，并将开源模型权重和训练代码以支持后续研究与实际 OCR 应用。

papers.title: TESSERA v2: Scaling Pixel-wise Earth Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Pixel-wise Earth-observation (EO) foundation models are now achieving state-of-the-art performance via generated spatial embeddings. However, how these models scale and how best to spend a pretraining budget remain poorly understood. We present the largest controlled scaling study for EO to date: 395 training runs within a fixed pixel-wise Barlow Twins family, each evaluated on 15 diverse downstream tasks. We find that pretraining loss barely predicts downstream performance (|Pearson r| < 0.2), so selecting models by loss wastes a large share of the compute. We also find that, as the training budget grows, the encoder and the data should grow together while the projector stays fixed, which gives a simple rule for allocating compute. Using this rule, we train a family of pixel-wise teachers (0.5B, 1B, and 2B) and distil the largest into compact students for embeddings-as-data deployment. In aggregate, our 44-million-parameter distilled student outperforms every open and proprietary embedding product we test, several of them an order of magnitude larger. These students produce Matryoshka representations that are inexpensive to serve: a 16-dimensional prefix keeps 92% of the full 128-dimensional performance at 1/8 of the storage. Together, these results give a concrete, empirically grounded recipe for scaling pixel-wise EO foundation models: train large encoders, select by downstream performance, and distil into flexible student models. We plan to release global 10 m annual embeddings covering 2017-2025 as version 2 of the TESSERA foundation-model embeddings product. All code is available at: https://github.com/ucam-eo/tessera
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是面向像素级对地观测 (Earth observation) 的 TESSERA v2 扩展，报告了迄今最大规模的控制变量缩放研究：在固定 Barlow Twins 模型族中完成 395 次训练，并在 15 个下游任务上评估。作者发现预训练损失几乎无法预测下游性能，并提出编码器与数据同步增长、投影器保持不变的算力分配规则；基于该规则训练 0.5B/1B/2B 教师模型，并将最大模型蒸馏为紧凑学生模型。44M 参数的蒸馏学生在测试的所有开源与专有 embedding 产品上取得最优结果，且 Matryoshka 表示可用 16 维前缀保留 128 维全量性能的 92%。
Motivation: 像素级对地观测基础模型已通过生成的空间嵌入 (spatial embeddings) 达到前沿性能，但这些模型如何缩放、以及如何最优分配预训练预算仍缺乏理解；现有按预训练损失选模型的做法会浪费大量算力。
Method: 在固定的像素级 Barlow Twins 框架内进行 395 次受控训练，统一在 15 个下游任务上评测；根据缩放规律提出分配规则：训练预算增长时编码器与数据规模应同步扩大，而投影器 (projector) 保持固定。依据该规则训练 0.5B、1B、2B 教师模型，再将最大的教师蒸馏为紧凑学生模型，并输出 Matryoshka 表示以降低存储与推理成本。
Result: 预训练损失与下游性能几乎不相关 (|Pearson r| < 0.2)，据此选择模型会浪费大量算力；44M 参数的蒸馏学生模型胜过测试中的所有开源与专有 embedding 产品，其中多个模型规模大一个数量级；16 维前缀在 1/8 存储下保留 128 维全量性能的 92%。
Conclusion: 作者给出的经验性缩放配方是：训练大规模编码器、按下游性能而非预训练损失选模型、并蒸馏为灵活的学生模型。论文计划以 TESSERA v2 形式发布 2017-2025 年全球 10 m 年度 embeddings 产品，代码已在 GitHub 公开。
Relevance: 40

papers.title: Accelerating Q-learning through Efficient Value-Sharing across Actions
papers.abstract_en: Action values are foundational to many control algorithms such as Q-learning. Therefore, efficient action-value learning is central to reinforcement learning (RL). However, learning them can be slow, requiring many updates to move values from their initialization, typically near zero, to their true values, which may be far from zero. Moreover, action-value learning algorithms typically update each state-action pair independently, without learning a value that is common to all actions within a state. In this paper, we address these inefficiencies by introducing the mean-expansion layer, which accelerates action-value learning by sharing values across actions within a state and by changing the problem from directly learning potentially large action-values to learning a lower-norm representation of them. In deep RL, this layer can be applied as a parameter-free addition to Q-network architectures without altering the underlying algorithm. Applied to deep Q-networks and implicit quantile networks, it improves aggregate performance across 57 Atari 2600 games while increasing action gaps and dramatically reducing value overestimation.
papers.comment: ICML 2026 (Spotlight); Adaptive and Learning Agents workshop 2026 (Best paper runner-up)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 Q-learning 中动作值学习缓慢的问题，提出 mean-expansion layer，通过在同一状态内跨动作共享值，并把直接学习可能较大的动作值改为学习其低范数表示，来加速动作值学习。该层可作为无参数模块直接加入 Q 网络架构，不改变底层算法。在深度 Q 网络 (DQN) 和隐式分位数网络 (implicit quantile networks) 上，该方法在 57 个 Atari 2600 游戏的整体性能上获得提升，同时增大 action gaps 并大幅降低值过估计。
Motivation: 动作值学习是 Q-learning 等控制算法的基础，但通常很慢：值从接近零的初始化移动到可能远离零的真实值需要大量更新，且每个状态-动作对通常被独立更新，没有利用同一状态内所有动作共有的值信息。
Method: 提出 mean-expansion layer，通过跨同一状态内的动作共享值来加速动作值学习，并将问题从直接学习可能较大的动作值转化为学习其低范数表示。在深度 RL 中，该层作为无参数模块附加到 Q 网络架构上，无需修改底层算法。
Result: 摘要报告，将该层应用于深度 Q 网络和隐式分位数网络后，在 57 个 Atari 2600 游戏上提升整体性能，且增加了 action gaps 并显著降低了值过估计。
Conclusion: 本文表明，通过跨动作的值共享（mean-expansion layer）可以高效加速 Q-learning，且能以无参数方式集成到现有深度 Q 网络架构中。摘要未提及超出 Atari 2600 基准之外的泛化范围或局限。

papers.title: SP-Mind: An Autonomous Reasoning Agent for Spatial Proteomics Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Spatial proteomics enables single-cell-resolution characterization of protein expression within tissue architecture, playing a critical role in understanding tumor microenvironments and guiding precision medicine. However, current analysis workflows remain fragmented, requiring expert manual orchestration of heterogeneous tools and limiting research scalability and reproducibility. We present SP-Mind, the first autonomous AI agent designed to unify the spatial proteomics analysis pipeline, from raw multiplexed tissue imaging to downstream phenotype discovery. Equipped with expert-curated biological analysis skills and specialized computational tools, SP-Mind converts natural-language queries into end-to-end analytical workflows without task-specific fine-tuning. To rigorously evaluate its capabilities, we introduce SP-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark spanning diverse tissue types, comprising 102 tasks across 18 distinct categories. Through extensive evaluation on SP-Bench and established downstream tasks, SP-Mind achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to existing open-source biomedical agent baselines. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/tomtommyyuan/spmind.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to ICML 2026. Equal contribution by Yucheng Yuan and Yuanfeng Ji
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SP-Mind，一个面向空间蛋白组学 (spatial proteomics) 分析的自主 AI 代理，将原始多重组织成像到下游表型发现的流程统一为端到端分析工作流。作者同时引入包含 102 个任务、18 个类别的基准 SP-Bench，并在该基准及既有下游任务上报告了优于现有开源生物医学代理基线的性能。
Motivation: 当前空间蛋白组学分析流程碎片化，需要专家手动编排多种异构工具，限制了研究规模化与可复现性。
Method: SP-Mind 配备专家精选的生物分析技能与专门计算工具，无需任务特定微调即可将自然语言查询转换为端到端分析工作流；评估采用自建基准 SP-Bench，覆盖多种组织类型、102 个任务和 18 个类别。
Result: 在 SP-Bench 和既有下游任务上，SP-Mind 相比现有开源生物医学代理基线取得最优性能。
Conclusion: 作者强调这是首个统一空间蛋白组学分析管线的自主 AI 代理，并公开代码以支持复现。

papers.title: Time Series Classification through Diffeomorphic Time Warping (DiffTW)
papers.abstract_en: Time series classification involves learning a mapping from a continuous, temporally ordered sequence of real-valued observations to discrete response variables, like class labels. This task is fundamental in domains, including health monitoring, where temporal structure is critical for prediction. Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) is a standard technique for measuring similarity between sequences varying in time or speed. However, DTW is restricted to discrete point matching. Moving beyond pairwise alignment, we propose a theoretical framework learning mappings between real-valued functions. These mappings approximate the flow associated with the characteristic curves of a linear transport equation with a space-dependent velocity field, providing a diffeomorphic transformation between time series. Using the method of characteristics, we transform this partial differential equation into ordinary differential equations (ODEs) modeling system dynamics. The objective function to learn these ODEs derives from the fundamental theorem of calculus. To enable flexible, expressive representations of the velocity field, we utilize reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces and optimal control methods. Our method, Diffeomorphic Time Warping (DiffTW), provides a theoretically grounded dissimilarity measure. Using a 1-nearest neighbor classifier, DiffTW outperforms unconstrained DTW on 39 of 85 datasets with 3 ties; however, constrained DTW outperforms DiffTW on 48 of 85 datasets with 5 ties.
papers.comment: 39 pages including appendix and references, 8 figures. v2: Corrected a miscalculation in the DTW nearest neighbor accuracy, identified by an author of the UCR archive, Prof. Eamonn Keogh. Updated results show the algorithm performs comparably to unconstrained DTW, but below constrained DTW. Added new discussion on constrained vs. unconstrained DTW
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Diffeomorphic Time Warping (DiffTW)，一种基于线性输运方程与特征线法的时序相似性度量框架，将 DTW 的离散点匹配推广为实值函数之间的微分同胚变换。作者用 1 近邻分类器在 85 个 UCR 数据集上评估，修正后的结果显示 DiffTW 在 39 个数据集上优于无约束 DTW（3 个平局），但受约束 DTW 在 48 个数据集上优于 DiffTW（5 个平局）。
Motivation: DTW 是衡量时间或速度变化序列相似度的标准技术，但它局限于离散点匹配，缺少在连续函数层面进行对齐的理论框架。
Method: 通过一个空间相关速度场的线性输运方程的特征曲线来逼近时间序列之间的微分同胚变换，利用特征线法将偏微分方程转化为常微分方程组，并用微积分基本定理构造目标函数；速度场用再生核希尔伯特空间与最优控制方法进行灵活表示。
Result: 摘要报告，在 85 个 UCR 数据集中，DiffTW 在 39 个数据集上优于无约束 DTW（3 个平局）；但受约束 DTW 在 48 个数据集上优于 DiffTW（5 个平局），算法表现与无约束 DTW 相当、低于受约束 DTW。
Conclusion: 作者在 v2 中修正了 DTW 最近邻准确率计算错误，并新增了受约束与无约束 DTW 的讨论，强调 DiffTW 虽然提供了理论上有依据的相异性度量，但其分类性能整体不及受约束 DTW。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MotionMAR: Multi-scale Auto-Regressive Human Motion Reconstruction from Sparse Observations
papers.abstract_en: Human motion follows a temporal hierarchical structure, transitioning from low-frequency global trajectories to high-frequency details. Inspired by the success of multi-level autoregressive models in computer vision, we propose MotionMAR, a coarse-to-fine framework for motion reconstruction from sparse observations. It first estimates the global trajectory of human motion and then gradually refines the temporal details. This architecture consists of four integrated components. The Temporal Multi-scale Tokenization (TMT) VQ-VAE encodes the data at multiple temporal resolutions, separating semantic motion from minor jitters. The Motion Autoregressive Network (MAN) operates in this latent space, predicting motion across scales. It first establishes the global structure through coarse indices and then generates finer indices to recover specific details. Meanwhile, the Scale-Aware Control (SAC) module integrates sparse tracking data to ensure the generated output aligns with actual observations. The Motion Refinement Network (MRN) subsequently smooths consecutive poses and eliminates quantization artifacts. Experiments show that MotionMAR achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on the AMASS dataset, providing a reliable and structure-aware approach for motion reconstruction. The source code is publicly available at http://www.lidarhumanmotion.net/motionmar/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MotionMAR，一种从稀疏观测重建人体运动的 coarse-to-fine 多尺度自回归框架。方法先估计全局运动轨迹，再逐步细化时序细节，由 TMT VQ-VAE、运动自回归网络 MAN、尺度感知控制 SAC 模块和运动细化网络 MRN 四部分组成。摘要报告该方法在 AMASS 数据集上达到 state-of-the-art 精度，并提供结构感知的可靠运动重建。
Motivation: 人体运动具有时间层级结构，从低频全局轨迹过渡到高频细节；从稀疏观测重建完整运动需要显式建模这种多尺度结构。
Method: 使用 Temporal Multi-scale Tokenization (TMT) VQ-VAE 在多个时间分辨率下编码数据，区分语义运动与微小抖动；Motion Autoregressive Network (MAN) 在潜在空间中先通过粗索引建立全局结构，再生成细索引恢复细节；Scale-Aware Control (SAC) 模块融合稀疏跟踪数据以对齐观测；Motion Refinement Network (MRN) 平滑相邻姿态并消除量化伪影。
Result: 实验表明 MotionMAR 在 AMASS 数据集上达到 state-of-the-art 重建精度。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法提供了一种可靠且结构感知的人体运动重建途径，并将源代码公开。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Matching Matters: A Fair Quality-Efficiency Benchmark for Command-Line Agents
papers.abstract_en: Rapid advances in large language models have improved the task-solving capabilities of command-line-interface (CLI)-based agents, whose CLIs determine how models invoke tools, maintain interaction history, and recover from failures. Consequently, effective matching between CLIs and LLMs has become essential. However, existing agent benchmarks largely emphasize success rate while overlooking practical objectives such as cost and efficiency, as well as the selection of LM-CLI combinations, all of which are critical in real-world deployment. We therefore introduce AgentMeter, a quality-efficiency benchmark with a new metric, the AgentMeter Score (AMS), that jointly characterizes task quality, budget sensitivity, and resource-intensive zero-reward execution, enabling a more complete assessment of deployed LM-CLI pairs. Furthermore, collected task descriptions may inadvertently favor LM-CLI pairs that are particularly compatible with their wording and structure, causing evaluation results to reflect description-specific advantages rather than general task-solving capability. We therefore propose AgentMeter-Opt, a trajectory-grounded optimization framework that constructs pair-adapted, task-preserving description variants to build a fairer evaluation set across LM-CLI pairs. Extensive experiments show that no CLI is universally optimal across language models and that task success, execution cost, and AMS identify different competitive configurations. Results on AgentMeter-Opt further reveal that task-preserving description changes affect LM-CLI pairs unevenly and can alter their relative ordering across valid description conditions. Together, AgentMeter and AgentMeter-Opt provide a practical foundation for fair and deployment-relevant evaluation of command-line agents.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables; includes supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentMeter，一个面向命令行界面 (CLI) 智能体的质量-效率基准，并引入 AgentMeter Score (AMS) 指标，联合刻画任务质量、预算敏感性和资源密集的零奖励执行。作者还提出 AgentMeter-Opt 优化框架，通过基于轨迹的、配对自适应的任务描述变体构建更公平的评估集。实验表明没有 CLI 在所有语言模型上普遍最优，且任务成功、执行成本和 AMS 会识别出不同的竞争配置。
Motivation: 现有 CLI 智能体基准主要强调成功率，忽略了部署中关键的成本、效率以及 LM-CLI 组合选择问题；同时任务描述可能无意中偏向与措辞更兼容的 LM-CLI 对，使评估结果反映描述特定优势而非通用任务求解能力。
Method: 提出 AgentMeter 基准及新指标 AMS，用于联合评估任务质量、预算敏感性与零奖励执行；并提出 AgentMeter-Opt，一种基于轨迹 (trajectory-grounded) 的优化框架，生成配对自适应、保持任务语义的描述变体，构建跨 LM-CLI 对更公平的评估集。
Result: 大量实验显示没有 CLI 对所有语言模型普遍最优，任务成功率、执行成本与 AMS 会识别出不同竞争配置；AgentMeter-Opt 结果还表明，保持任务语义的描述改动对不同 LM-CLI 对影响不均，并可能改变它们在有效描述条件下的相对排序。
Conclusion: AgentMeter 与 AgentMeter-Opt 共同为命令行智能体的公平且贴近部署的评估提供了实用基础。

papers.title: SEED: Simple ViT and Evolving Harness for Explainable Text Forgery Detection
papers.abstract_en: AI-assisted image editing threatens trust in financial, legal, and identity records. The GenText-Forensics Challenge at ACM MM 2026 addresses this by requiring structured forensic reports, in which integrating detection, pixel-level localization, and natural language explanation for multilingual text-centric forgery images. We present SEED, a modular system with three components. First, a similarity-guided pipeline augments training with diverse synthetic forgeries. Second, a single ViT, built on DINOv3 with LoRA adaptation, jointly performs detection and pixel-level localization while preserving pre-trained priors with minimal trainable parameters. Third, an evolving harness takes the detector's predictions and generates a complete forensic report via an MLLM, iteratively improved through a proposer-evaluator loop optimizing report quality. SEED ranked 3rd in the GenText-Forensics Challenge. Code and data are available at https://github.com/KahimWong/GenText-Forensics-3rd-Place.

papers.title: RealityBridge: Bridging Editable 3D Gaussian Splatting Driving Simulations and Real-World Videos
papers.abstract_en: Long-tail hazardous scenarios are essential for safety-oriented autonomous driving, yet they are difficult to collect at scale. Editable 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) simulation offers a scalable alternative through real-scene reconstruction and controllable editing. However, edited 3DGS-rendered videos often exhibit a significant Sim-to-Real gap, manifested as rendering artifacts, degraded foreground assets, illumination mismatch, and temporal flickering. Addressing these coupled defects requires jointly restoring local appearance, harmonizing edited content, and maintaining temporal consistency, whereas existing methods typically address only a subset of these requirements. To fill this gap, we propose RealityBridge, a video restoration and harmonization framework that converts edited 3DGS renderings into realistic driving footage while preserving simulator-defined structure, edits, and dynamics. RealityBridge conditions a video foundation model on complementary modality signals, with a lightweight GateNet adaptively controlling their injection across backbone blocks. We further develop a task-oriented curation pipeline to construct training data, and design a four-stage supervised training strategy followed by reward-guided post-training. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RealityBridge outperforms existing methods in restoration and harmonization while preserving strong temporal consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RealityBridge，一个将可编辑 3D 高斯泼溅 (3DGS) 渲染视频转化为逼真驾驶视频的修复与和谐化框架。它通过轻量级 GateNet 控制互补模态信号注入视频基础模型，并采用任务导向的数据构建流程与四阶段监督训练及奖励引导后训练，以修复渲染伪影、前景资产退化、光照不匹配和时间闪烁等问题。实验表明该方法在恢复与和谐化上优于现有方法，并保持较强的时间一致性。
Motivation: 长尾危险场景对安全自动驾驶至关重要但难以大规模采集，可编辑 3DGS 仿真提供可扩展替代方案；然而编辑后的 3DGS 渲染视频存在显著 Sim-to-Real 差距，表现为渲染伪影、前景资产退化、光照不匹配与时间闪烁，而现有方法通常只处理其中部分问题。
Method: RealityBridge 将视频基础模型 (video foundation model) 以互补模态信号为条件，通过轻量级 GateNet 自适应控制信号在不同骨干块中的注入；还设计了任务导向的数据构建流程，并采用四阶段监督训练策略，随后进行奖励引导的后训练。
Result: 大量实验表明 RealityBridge 在视频恢复与和谐化方面优于现有方法，同时保持较强的时间一致性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调同时恢复局部外观、和谐化编辑内容并维持时间一致性可以弥合编辑 3DGS 渲染与真实驾驶视频之间的差距。

papers.title: Persona-Pruner: Sculpting Lightweight Models for Role-Playing
papers.abstract_en: Language Models (LMs) have shown remarkable potential as role-playing chatbots, delivering consistent, stylized interactions when given a specification of a character or user persona. However, applying these capabilities to real-world applications (e.g., ecosystems with numerous NPCs interacting simultaneously) exposes a critical inefficiency due to the excessive computational cost. In this paper, we question the necessity of dedicating a full, generalist model to a single persona, hypothesizing that a specific character identity relies on only a fraction of the model's total capacity. We observe that naively pruning LMs often severely degrades the role-playing performance for a specific persona; it does not distinguish between redundant knowledge and essential character traits. We propose Persona-Pruner, a framework that sculpts a lightweight role-playing model by isolating persona-specific sub-networks from a single description. Our experiments consistently show that Persona-Pruner preserves role-playing performance substantially more effectively than existing state-of-the-art LLM pruning techniques, reducing the performance drop from the dense model by up to 93.8% over the strongest baseline on RoleBench in LLM-as-a-judge score, while still maintaining general LLM capabilities. Code is available at https://github.com/jsu-kim/Persona-Pruner.
papers.comment: 25 pages; ICML 2026; Code is available at https://github.com/jsu-kim/Persona-Pruner
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Persona-Pruner，一个通过从单一描述中隔离出 persona 特化子网络 (persona-specific sub-network) 来雕琢轻量级角色扮演模型的框架。作者假设一个具体角色身份只依赖模型总容量的一小部分，并用该框架避免朴素剪枝 (naive pruning) 对角色扮演能力的严重破坏。实验表明，在 RoleBench 的 LLM-as-a-judge 评分上，Persona-Pruner 相比最强基线把与稠密模型的性能差距最多缩小 93.8%，同时保持通用 LLM 能力。
Motivation: 将完整通用模型部署到每个角色上计算开销过大，尤其当生态中需要大量 NPC 同时互动时。直接对 LLM 剪枝不能区分冗余知识与关键角色特质，导致特定 persona 的角色扮演性能严重退化。
Method: 提出 Persona-Pruner 框架，从单个角色描述出发隔离出 persona 特化的子网络，从而得到轻量级角色扮演模型，而非依靠无区分能力的普通剪枝。
Result: 摘要报告，在 RoleBench 数据集上以 LLM-as-a-judge 评分，Persona-Pruner 比现有最强 LLM 剪枝技术更有效地保留角色扮演性能，把相对稠密模型的性能下降最多减少 93.8%，且不牺牲通用 LLM 能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为特定角色身份只依赖模型的一小部分容量，因此可以通过 persona 特化剪枝得到轻量高效的角色扮演模型；该结论主要面向角色扮演与 LLM 部署场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: What Drives Test-Time Adaptation for CLIP? A Controlled Empirical Study from an Update Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as CLIP have become a standard backbone for open-vocabulary recognition, yet their zero-shot predictions remain vulnerable to distribution shifts encountered at deployment. Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) has recently been extended to CLIP as a lightweight solution, leading to a rapidly growing body of TTA4CLIP methods. However, empirical progress in this area has largely outpaced our understanding of what truly drives adaptation, where their gains originate, and under which shifts they remain reliable. In this paper, we take a step back from the pursuit of state-of-the-art accuracy and conduct a systematic controlled study of TTA4CLIP. We first organize existing methods into three unified paradigms according to what is updated at test time. We then introduce TTABC, an open-source TTA Benchmark for CLIP, which standardizes evaluation protocols and integrates more than 20 representative methods. Our controlled empirical analysis focuses on three key areas. First, we determine the driving factors in parameter-based methods, revealing that adaptation gains are primarily driven by test-time evidence and reliable proxies rather than heavy optimization. Second, we explore evidence utilization beyond heavy parameter tuning, showing that competitive and efficient performance can be achieved through cross- or current-sample evidence and lightweight prototype updates. Finally, we demonstrate that there is no silver bullet for TTA: no single adaptation paradigm is universally optimal, and the preferred paradigm depends on the nature of shift. We hope our benchmark and study provide a clearer understanding of the current TTA4CLIP landscape and establish a foundation for further research.
papers.comment: Benchmark and codes are available at https://github.com/walawalagoose/TTABC
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对 CLIP 的测试时自适应 (Test-Time Adaptation, TTA) 方法做了一次受控实证研究。作者将现有 TTA4CLIP 方法按测试时更新对象归纳为三个统一范式，并发布开源基准 TTABC，集成了 20 多个代表性方法并标准化评估协议。受控实验显示参数类方法的增益主要来自测试时证据和可靠代理而非重度优化，且不存在对所有分布偏移普遍最优的单一范式。
Motivation: TTA4CLIP 方法数量增长迅速，但实证进展超过了对其机制的理解：什么真正驱动自适应、增益从何而来、在哪些分布偏移下可靠，这些问题缺乏系统性的受控研究。
Method: 提出 TTABC 基准，标准化评估协议并集成 20 余种代表性方法；将现有方法按测试时更新对象划分为三个统一范式 (unified paradigms)；围绕参数类方法的驱动因素、证据利用方式以及范式与偏移性质匹配三方面进行受控分析 (controlled empirical study)。
Result: 摘要报告：参数类方法的自适应收益主要由测试时证据和可靠代理 (reliable proxies) 驱动，而非重度优化；借助跨样本或当前样本证据及轻量原型更新即可得到有竞争力且高效的表现；没有任何单一自适应范式普遍最优，首选范式取决于偏移性质。
Conclusion: 作者指出 TTA 不存在银弹，最优范式依赖于具体分布偏移类型，并希望基准与研究能厘清 TTA4CLIP 现状、为后续研究建立基础。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: VISA: VLM-Guided Instance Semantic Auditing for 3D Occupancy World Models
papers.abstract_en: Semantic 3D occupancy provides a voxelized world state for autonomous driving and robot decision making, but object and rare-class errors can affect free-space interpretation, collision checking, and temporal state propagation. We show that a common VLM strategy, aligning 3D voxel or object features with crop-caption embeddings, improves text-space similarity without reliably improving closed-set occupancy mIoU. Motivated by this mismatch, we propose VISA, a training-time semantic auditing approach for existing occupancy world models. VISA queries an offline VLM on a representative crop of each physical object instance, obtains a structured audit with class hypotheses, plausible confusions, reliability, attributes, and evidence, and propagates it along the object track. The audit is grounded to matched 3D object voxels and distilled into semantic logits through reliability-weighted taxonomy, attribute-factor, and scene-level audit graph losses, while inference remains unchanged and requires no VLM. On nuScenes, averaged across three runs, VISA improves OccWorld from 19.06 to 20.05 mIoU and GaussianWorld from 21.36 to 21.91 mIoU; on GaussianWorld, object mIoU improves from 18.18 to 19.16 and rare-class mIoU from 15.60 to 16.79. These results suggest that VLMs are better suited to closed-set occupancy as reliability-aware semantic auditors than as generic caption-embedding targets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VISA，一种训练时语义审计方法，用于提升现有 3D 占用世界模型 (occupancy world model) 的闭集语义占用 mIoU。作者指出常见的 VLM 策略（对齐 3D 体素/物体特征与 crop-caption 嵌入）只改善文本空间相似度而不能可靠提升闭集占用 mIoU；VISA 通过离线 VLM 对每个物理对象实例进行结构化审计并蒸馏到语义 logits，推理时不需 VLM。在 nuScenes 上三次运行平均，VISA 将 OccWorld 从 19.06 提升到 20.05 mIoU，GaussianWorld 从 21.36 提升到 21.91 mIoU，并在 GaussianWorld 上提升物体类与稀有类 mIoU。
Motivation: 语义 3D 占用为自动驾驶和机器人决策提供体素化世界状态，但物体和稀有类错误会影响自由空间解释、碰撞检查和时间状态传播。常见的 VLM 特征对齐策略不能可靠改进闭集占用 mIoU，存在训练目标与下游指标失配的问题。
Method: VISA 在训练时查询离线 VLM 对每个物理对象实例的代表性裁剪图，获得包含类别假设、可能混淆、可靠性、属性和证据的结构化审计，并沿物体轨迹传播。审计被匹配到 3D 物体体素，通过可靠性加权的 taxonomy、attribute-factor 和 scene-level audit graph 损失蒸馏到语义 logits；推理时保持原模型不变，不依赖 VLM。
Result: 在 nuScenes 上三次运行平均，VISA 将 OccWorld 的 mIoU 从 19.06 提升到 20.05，GaussianWorld 从 21.36 提升到 21.91；在 GaussianWorld 上，物体 mIoU 从 18.18 提升到 19.16，稀有类 mIoU 从 15.60 提升到 16.79。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 VLM 更适合作为可靠性感知的语义审计器 (reliability-aware semantic auditor) 来改进闭集占用，而不是作为通用的 caption-embedding 对齐目标。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: VISA 在训练时查询离线 VLM 对每个物理对象实例的代表性裁剪图，获得包含类别假设、可能混淆、可靠性、属性和证据的结构化审计，并沿物体轨迹传播。审计被匹配到 3D 物体体素，通过可靠性加权的 taxonomy、attribute-factor 和 scene-level audit graph 损失蒸馏到语义 logits；推理时保持原模型不变，不依赖 VLM。
summary_sections.result: 在 nuScenes 上三次运行平均，VISA 将 OccWorld 的 mIoU 从 19.06 提升到 20.05，GaussianWorld 从 21.36 提升到 21.91；在 GaussianWorld 上，物体 mIoU 从 18.18 提升到 19.16，稀有类 mIoU 从 15.60 提升到 16.79。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要认为 VLM 更适合作为可靠性感知的语义审计器 (reliability-aware semantic auditor) 来改进闭集占用，而不是作为通用的 caption-embedding 对齐目标。

papers.title: Why does AI unlock new possibilities in STEM education? A Bibliometric Analysis of Trends and Future Agenda
papers.abstract_en: STEM education faces challenges in personalization and interdisciplinary integration. AI technology has brought new possibilities, but the mechanisms by which AI reshapes the STEM education ecosystem require systematic investigation. This study employs bibliometric methods to analyze 242 publications from 2015-2025, constructing knowledge maps to reveal the evolutionary trajectory. The findings show that the field has transformed from intelligent tutoring systems to inquiry-based learning and computational thinking cultivation driven by LLMs. AI's key contribution lies in providing intelligent scaffolding that lowers the threshold for understanding knowledge. In this sense, AI is a core driving force promoting its shift from knowledge transmission to capability development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文采用文献计量学 (bibliometric) 方法分析 2015-2025 年间 242 篇关于人工智能在 STEM 教育中应用的论文，构建知识图谱以揭示其演化轨迹。研究显示该领域已从智能辅导系统 (intelligent tutoring systems) 转向由大语言模型 (LLMs) 驱动的探究式学习和计算思维培养，并认为 AI 的核心贡献在于提供智能脚手架 (intelligent scaffolding)，降低知识理解门槛，推动教育从知识传授转向能力发展。
Motivation: STEM 教育在个性化和跨学科整合方面面临挑战，AI 技术带来了新的可能性，但 AI 重塑 STEM 教育生态系统的机制缺乏系统性研究。
Method: 采用文献计量方法，分析 242 篇 2015-2025 年的出版物，构建知识图谱以呈现领域演化轨迹。
Result: 研究发现该领域已从智能辅导系统转向由 LLMs 驱动的探究式学习与计算思维培养，AI 的关键作用在于提供智能脚手架以降低知识理解门槛。
Conclusion: 作者认为 AI 是推动 STEM 教育从知识传授转向能力发展的核心驱动力。

papers.title: SemDINO: Foundation Prior-Guided Cross-Temporal Semantic Alignment Network for Remote Sensing Change Detection
papers.abstract_en: Semantic change detection (SCD) in remote sensing aims to identify land-cover transitions between bi-temporal observations while suppressing pseudo-changes caused by illumination variations, seasonal differences, and registration errors. Although Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) provide transferable semantic priors, their application to SCD remains challenging due to the mismatch between foundation-model representations and task-specific spatial features, as well as temporal-order sensitivity. To address these issues, this paper proposes SemDINO, a foundation prior-guided framework that integrates transferable vision foundation model priors with hierarchical convolutional representations for cross-temporal semantic reasoning. Specifically, a Gated Pyramid Fusion (PyFu) module is developed to adaptively combine foundation-model semantics with CNN spatial details while reducing domain noise. A Multi-scale Temporal Bi-directional Transformer (M-TBTT) is introduced to achieve symmetric cross-temporal feature interaction and alleviate temporal-order bias. Furthermore, a Feature Change Enhancement (FeaCE) flow is designed to refine aligned representations and distinguish genuine semantic transitions from pseudo variations. Finally, a multi-branch decoupled prediction head jointly generates change masks, bi-temporal semantic maps, and edge constraints. Extensive experiments across five benchmark datasets demonstrate that SemDINO consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods on both semantic and binary change detection tasks. The results validate the effectiveness of alignment-oriented representation learning for robust remote sensing change analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SemDINO，一个面向遥感语义变化检测（SCD）的基础先验引导框架，用于识别双时相观测之间的土地覆盖变化并抑制由光照、季节和配准误差引起的伪变化。方法通过门控金字塔融合（PyFu）组合视觉基础模型（VFM）语义与 CNN 空间细节，用多尺度双向时序 Transformer（M-TBTT）实现对称的跨时相交互，并设计特征变化增强（FeaCE）流区分真实变化与伪变化。摘要报告在五个基准数据集上，该方法在语义和二元变化检测任务上均一致优于现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 视觉基础模型（VFM）虽提供可迁移的语义先验，但其表征与任务相关的空间特征存在不匹配，且对时相顺序敏感，限制了其在 SCD 中的应用；同时光照、季节和配准误差造成的伪变化需要被抑制。
Method: 提出 SemDINO 框架，核心组件包括：门控金字塔融合（Gated Pyramid Fusion, PyFu）自适应结合 VFM 语义与 CNN 空间细节并降低域噪声；多尺度时序双向 Transformer（Multi-scale Temporal Bi-directional Transformer, M-TBTT）实现对称跨时相特征交互以缓解时序顺序偏差；特征变化增强（Feature Change Enhancement, FeaCE）流细化对齐表征并区分真实语义变化与伪变化；多分支解耦预测头联合输出变化掩码、双时相语义图和边缘约束。
Result: 在五个基准数据集上的实验表明，SemDINO 在语义变化检测和二元变化检测任务上均一致优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 摘要结论强调，对齐导向的表示学习（alignment-oriented representation learning）对稳健的遥感变化分析是有效的。摘要未报告具体量化结果或局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PhysScene: A Scene Graph Dataset for Scientific Visual Reasoning in Physics Experiments
papers.abstract_en: Scene Graphs (SGs) provide structured representations of visual scenes by modeling objects and their pairwise relationships. Despite recent progress, existing datasets primarily focus on generic natural contexts, leaving domain-specific and function-oriented scenes largely underexplored. This limitation restricts the evaluation of relational reasoning in scientific experimental scenes, thereby hindering the development of intelligent monitoring, analysis, and related applications in such scenes. To address this gap, we introduce PhysScene, the first SG dataset tailored to physics experiments. PhysScene encompasses specialized instruments, structured experimental setups, and functional relations intrinsic to experimental environments, enabling reasoning that extends beyond spatial co-occurrence to logical dependencies. Rather than pursuing large data scale, PhysScene focuses on strong semantic constraints and high relation density in experimental scenes, posing new challenges for existing scene parsing algorithms while offering opportunities for further improvements. Extensive analyses and experiments show that PhysScene complements existing benchmarks and establishes a valuable testbed for advancing scientific visual reasoning. The dataset is publicly available at https://github.com/ZMH-SDUST/PhysScene.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PhysScene，据称是首个面向物理实验的场景图 (Scene Graph) 数据集。该数据集覆盖专业仪器、结构化实验装置以及实验环境特有的功能关系，使推理不仅限于空间共现，还能延伸到逻辑依赖。作者强调 PhysScene 不以大规模数据量为目标，而是侧重于强语义约束和高关系密度，为现有场景解析算法带来新挑战。公开数据集可作为科学视觉推理的测试平台。
Motivation: 现有场景图数据集主要关注通用自然场景，缺乏领域特定和功能导向的场景，导致科学实验场景中的关系推理难以被评估，进而阻碍智能监控、分析等应用的发展。
Method: 作者构建了 PhysScene 数据集，纳入专用仪器、结构化实验装置和实验环境内在的功能关系，强调强语义约束与高关系密度，以支撑超越空间共现的推理。
Result: 大量分析和实验表明 PhysScene 补充了现有基准，并为推进科学视觉推理建立了有价值的测试平台；摘要未报告具体数值指标。
Conclusion: PhysScene 作为首个物理实验场景图数据集，为科学视觉推理提供了新测试平台，并公开于 GitHub；其设计可能会挑战现有场景解析算法并推动进一步改进。

papers.title: Pixel-TTS: Image based Text Rendering for Robust Text-to-Speech
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in pixel-based text modeling show that representing text as images enables models to exploit visual cues for language understanding. Grounding text in its visual form allows structurally similar characters with different Unicode encodings to produce similar embeddings, benefiting cross-lingual and zero-shot scenarios. Conventional text-based approaches treat each character independently, limiting generalization to unseen characters and requiring embedding expansion during cross-lingual adaptation. We propose Pixel-TTS, a text-to-speech framework for visually grounded speech synthesis. It renders text as images and projects them through a 2D convolutional layer to generate embeddings. This design eliminates embedding matrix expansion during fine-tuning while improving robustness to unseen characters and orthographic variations. Extensive experiments show Pixel-TTS achieves competitive performance with strong baselines, faster convergence and robust zero-shot generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Pixel-TTS 提出将文本渲染为图像，通过 2D 卷积层将图像投影成嵌入，用于端到端语音合成。该设计替代传统逐字符嵌入，避免微调时嵌入矩阵扩展，并提升对未见字符和正字法变体的鲁棒性。实验表明其性能与强基线相当、收敛更快，并具有稳健的零样本泛化能力。
Motivation: 传统文本式 TTS 将每个字符独立处理，限制了对未见字符的泛化，且跨语言适配时需要扩展嵌入矩阵。像素级文本建模可利用视觉线索，使结构相似但 Unicode 编码不同的字符产生相近嵌入，有利于跨语言和零样本场景。
Method: 提出 Pixel-TTS 框架：将输入文本渲染为图像，再通过 2D 卷积层（2D convolutional layer）生成嵌入，并将其接入语音合成流程，从而消除微调过程中的嵌入矩阵扩展。
Result: 大量实验显示 Pixel-TTS 在性能上与强基线相当，同时收敛更快，并展现出稳健的零样本泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将文本视觉化（visually grounded）可以提升 TTS 对未见字符和正字法变体的鲁棒性，并简化跨语言适配。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Robust Scene Transfer for PointGoal Navigation via Privileged Sensor Guided Contrastive Learning
papers.abstract_en: We propose a sensor-guided adaptive contrastive learning framework for visual representation learning in PointGoal navigation. During training, privileged LiDAR sensing guides the contrastive objective through a geometry-aware similarity metric and adaptive temperature scaling, encouraging visual embeddings to capture navigation-relevant structure rather than scene-specific appearance. The resulting encoder is pretrained independently, frozen, and used as the perceptual backbone for reinforcement learning, decoupling representation learning from policy optimization. We further introduce a cross-stage domain mismatch between representation pretraining and policy learning to suppress environment-specific shortcuts and promote reliance on task-relevant features. Extensive experiments in high-fidelity simulation demonstrate that our approach significantly improves policy-level scene transfer across diverse indoor and outdoor environments. At deployment, the agent relies only on monocular RGB observations together with standard task-related inputs such as goal position and proprioceptive signals, without access to LiDAR or other privileged sensors. Our method outperforms large pretrained vision models and standard contrastive baselines under severe appearance and semantic shifts. We also release a multimodal dataset to support future research on privileged-guided visual representation learning for navigation. The code is available at:
papers.comment: 8 pages, Accepted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种传感器引导的自适应对比学习 (sensor-guided adaptive contrastive learning) 框架，用于 PointGoal 导航的视觉表征学习。训练时使用特权 LiDAR 传感通过几何感知相似度度量和自适应温度缩放引导对比目标，使视觉嵌入捕捉导航相关结构而非场景外观。编码器预训练后冻结，作为强化学习的感知骨干，并在预训练与策略学习之间引入跨阶段域不匹配以抑制环境特定捷径。实验表明该方法在多样化室内外场景中显著提升策略级场景迁移，部署时仅依赖单目 RGB 与任务输入，无需 LiDAR。
Motivation: PointGoal 导航中视觉编码器容易过拟合场景特定外观，导致跨场景迁移时表现下降；现有方法常忽视表征学习与策略优化的耦合。作者希望让视觉表征聚焦于导航相关的几何结构，并抑制环境特定捷径。
Method: 提出对比学习框架，由特权 LiDAR 在训练时通过几何感知相似度度量与自适应温度缩放指导对比目标；编码器被独立预训练并冻结，作为 RL 的感知骨干，解耦表征学习与策略优化。另引入跨阶段域不匹配，即在表征预训练与策略学习之间制造域差异，以抑制环境特定捷径并促进对任务相关特征的依赖。
Result: 在高保真仿真中的多样化室内外场景上，该方法显著提升策略级场景迁移；在严重外观与语义偏移下，性能优于大型预训练视觉模型和标准对比学习基线。
Conclusion: 部署时智能体仅需单目 RGB 以及目标位置、本体感觉等标准任务输入，无需 LiDAR 或其它特权传感器。作者还发布了多模态数据集，以支持特权引导的导航视觉表征学习研究。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种传感器引导的自适应对比学习 (sensor-guided adaptive contrastive learning) 框架，用于 PointGoal 导航的视觉表征学习。训练时使用特权 LiDAR 传感通过几何感知相似度度量和自适应温度缩放引导对比目标，使视觉嵌入捕捉导航相关结构而非场景外观。编码器预训练后冻结，作为强化学习的感知骨干，并在预训练与策略学习之间引入跨阶段域不匹配以抑制环境特定捷径。实验表明该方法在多样化室内外场景中显著提升策略级场景迁移，部署时仅依赖单目 RGB 与任务输入，无需 LiDAR。

papers.title: PrivacyPeek: Auditing What LLM-Based Agents Acquire, Not Just What They Say
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents are rapidly advancing, autonomously invoking external tools to complete multi-step tasks for users. However, agents often acquire more sensitive information than the task requires. Existing privacy benchmarks audit what the agent's response or outgoing actions disclose, but overlook the acquisition stage where data first enters the agent's context. The over-acquired information is then one careless action or one attack away from an outright leak. To assess its prevalence, we introduce \emph{PrivacyPeek}, a benchmark for evaluating acquisition-stage privacy leakage of LLM-based agents, with $1{,}182$ cases across $7$ acquisition behaviours and $16$ application domains. Specifically, \emph{Acquisition Inspection} examines the agent's tool-call trajectory, both the tools it invokes and the data it receives, to detect when it acquires sensitive information beyond the task scope. \emph{Probe Elicitation} then issues a follow-up probe and measures how readily an attacker could elicit sensitive information the agent acquired but did not disclose. Our experiments on $10$ LLM-based agents across $4$ model families show that the unnecessary acquisition of sensitive information is widespread. In addition, we observe a correlation between the task-completion capability and acquisition-stage leakage. Prompt-level defences reduce only a small fraction of acquisition-stage leakage, leaving the majority unmitigated. These results make auditing acquisition-stage privacy both urgent and necessary. Our dataset and code are available at https://github.com/Xuan269/PrivacyPeek-Resource.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PrivacyPeek，一个专门评估 LLM 智能体在数据获取阶段（acquisition stage）隐私泄露的基准，包含 1,182 个案例，覆盖 7 种获取行为和 16 个应用领域。基准由 Acquisition Inspection（检查工具调用轨迹及接收数据是否超出任务范围）和 Probe Elicitation（通过后续探针衡量攻击者能否诱导出已获取但未披露的敏感信息）两部分组成。在 10 个来自 4 个模型家族的 LLM 智能体上的实验表明，超出任务范围的敏感信息获取普遍存在，且提示级防御只能缓解一小部分此类泄露。
Motivation: 现有隐私基准只审计智能体响应或外部行为所披露的内容，忽略了数据首次进入智能体上下文中的获取阶段；过度获取的信息距离真正的泄露仅差一次疏忽操作或一次攻击，因此评估该阶段泄露具有紧迫性。
Method: 构建 PrivacyPeek 基准：Acquisition Inspection 通过分析智能体的工具调用轨迹（包括调用的工具和接收的数据）检测其是否获取了超出任务范围的敏感信息；Probe Elicitation 则发出后续探针，度量攻击者从智能体已获取但未披露的信息中诱导出敏感内容的难易程度。
Result: 在 10 个 LLM 智能体（覆盖 4 个模型家族）上的实验显示，不必要的敏感信息获取广泛存在；任务完成能力与获取阶段泄露之间存在相关性；提示级防御只能降低一小部分获取阶段泄露，大部分仍未得到缓解。
Conclusion: 作者认为对智能体获取阶段的隐私进行审计既紧迫又必要，并公开了数据集与代码。

papers.title: Domain-Gated Latent Diffusion: Generative Inverse Design of HMX-Class Energetic Materials with First-Principles Validation
papers.abstract_en: Energetic materials power mining, demolition, propulsion and airbags, yet today's compounds were designed decades ago. A successor must combine high energy release, low sensitivity to accidental initiation and a practical synthesis route, found within an astronomically large molecular space. Generative models are the natural search tool, but their training data are mostly untrustworthy: of approximately 66,000 molecules with recorded properties, only approximately 3,000 were measured or computed from first principles. Models trained on all of them imitate the rough estimates and propose molecules that collapse under real physics. We introduce Domain-Gated Latent Diffusion (DGLD), a diffusion model that treats data reliability as an explicit design parameter: labels are sorted into four trust tiers, and only trustworthy ones steer generation, while the unreliable majority still teaches the model what a plausible molecule looks like. Learned controls tune performance, safety and viability independently, and every proposal passes a four-stage screen ending in a quantum-chemical DFT audit. DGLD proposes 10 molecules unknown to PubChem that survive this screen. The best, 3,4,5-trinitro-1,2-isoxazole, matches the benchmark explosives HMX and PETN in calculated detonation performance, is unlike molecules in its training set, and has a four-step synthesis route. Trust gating is chemistry-independent and can be applied wherever abundant weak data surround a reliable core.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Domain-Gated Latent Diffusion (DGLD)，一种把数据可靠性作为显式设计参数的扩散模型，用于含能材料 (energetic materials) 的生成式逆向设计。针对约 66,000 个有记录性质的分子中仅约 3,000 个来自第一性原理计算或实测的问题，DGLD 将标签分为四个信任层级，只让可靠标签引导生成，同时用不可靠的多数数据学习分子形貌。论文报告 DGLD 提出 10 个 PubChem 未知分子并通过四阶段筛选，其中最佳分子 3,4,5-trinitro-1,2-isoxazole 在计算爆轰性能上与 HMX 和 PETN 相当，且具有四步合成路线。
Motivation: 现有含能材料设计依赖几十年前的化合物，而新候选需要在巨大的分子空间内同时满足高能量释放、低意外起爆敏感性和可实现的合成路线。生成模型是自然的搜索工具，但其训练数据大多不可信：绝大多数有记录性质的分子来自粗糙估计，仅少数经过实测或第一性原理计算，直接训练会使模型模仿粗糙估计并生成在实际物理条件下不成立的分子。
Method: 引入 Domain-Gated Latent Diffusion (DGLD)，将数据可靠性作为显式设计参数：标签被分为四个信任层级，只有可信标签引导生成，不可靠的多数数据仍用于学习合理分子形貌。学习到的控制项可独立调节性能、安全性和可行性，每个生成候选都要通过四阶段筛选，最终以量子化学 DFT 审计收尾。
Result: DGLD 提出 10 个 PubChem 未知分子并通过全部筛选；最佳分子 3,4,5-trinitro-1,2-isoxazole 的计算爆轰性能与基准炸药 HMX 和 PETN 相当，与训练集中的分子差异明显，并具有四步合成路线。
Conclusion: 信任门控 (trust gating) 与化学无关，可应用于任何“丰富弱数据围绕可靠核心”的领域。论文强调该框架在数据可靠性分层条件下仍能生成经第一性原理验证的候选分子。

papers.title: Behind EvoMap: Characterizing a Self-Evolving Agent-to-Agent Collaboration Network
papers.abstract_en: Agent-to-Agent (A2A) networks enable autonomous AI agents to collaborate by sharing reusable problem-solving instructions. However, how these decentralized ecosystems operate in practice remains largely unexplored. We present the first large-scale empirical study of EvoMap, a prominent A2A collaboration network. By analyzing over 1.5M assets and 128K agents, we show how design choices that prioritize scalable growth introduce trade-offs in reusability, evolution, and auditability. First, EvoMap's credit economy rewards agents for publishing valuable assets. Although this design encourages participation at scale, rewards are tied primarily to publication rather than adoption. This leads agents to mass-produce assets to accumulate credits. As a result, 98% of assets are never reused, while rewards become highly concentrated among a small fraction of agents. Second, EvoMap employs an algorithm (referred to as GDI) to score and rank the quality of these shared assets. We demonstrate that this scoring system is flawed: rather than measuring objective performance, an asset's rank is heavily dictated by unverified, self-reported metadata (e.g., claimed lines of code modified). This allows agents to trivially manipulate their asset's scores. Finally, EvoMap relies on agents to provide local execution logs as evidence that uploaded assets function correctly. Because these validations are not independently verified, over 84% of approved assets bypass quality checks using vacuous tests (e.g., console$.$log()). Our findings show that future A2A collaboration networks cannot rely on unverified self-reporting alone. Scalable collaboration requires mechanisms that balance open participation with verifiable execution and trustworthy evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对 EvoMap 这一 Agent-to-Agent (A2A) 协作网络的首次大规模实证研究，分析了超过 1.5M 个资产和 128K 个智能体。研究发现，EvoMap 的信用经济主要奖励发布而非采用，导致 98% 的资产从未被复用、奖励高度集中于少数智能体；其资产评分算法 GDI 依赖未经验证的自报元数据，可被操纵；超过 84% 的获批资产通过空测试（如 console.log()）绕过质量检查。作者据此认为，未来的 A2A 协作网络不能只依赖未经核实自报机制，而需要在开放参与与可验证执行、可信评估之间取得平衡。
Motivation: A2A 网络让自主 AI 智能体通过共享可复用的问题解决指令进行协作，但这些去中心化生态在实际中如何运作尚缺乏研究。本文旨在填补这一空白，通过实证刻画 EvoMap 的运行特征及其设计权衡。
Method: 采用大规模实证分析方法：收集并分析 EvoMap 中的 1.5M 个资产与 128K 个智能体，考察信用经济激励、GDI 评分算法和本地执行日志验证这三类机制的实际效应，并设计测试验证评分可操控性与质量检查漏洞。
Result: 研究发现：1) 信用经济主要奖励发布而非采用，导致资产被大量生产但 98% 从未被复用，奖励高度集中于少数智能体；2) GDI 评分主要由未经验证的自报元数据决定，可被轻易操纵；3) 由于本地执行日志未经独立验证，超过 84% 的获批资产使用空测试（如 console.log()）绕过质量检查。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，可扩展的 A2A 协作不能依赖未经核实自报机制；未来设计需要将开放参与与可验证执行和可信评估相结合。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: OpenAI Privacy Filter: A Cross-Lingual, Cross-Domain PII Evaluation Across 32 Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: We present what is, to our knowledge, the first systematic evaluation of OpenAI's Privacy Filter (OPF), a 1.5B-parameter model that converts an autoregressive language model into a bidirectional PII detector, across 32 benchmarks spanning 14 languages and 5 domains. Our most practically actionable finding is a domain-dependent labeled-data crossover: fine-tuned XLM-RoBERTa surpasses OPF's zero-shot performance with only ~500 labeled examples on English synthetic PII (~100 on non-English Kiji), and ~1000 on synthetic medical PII. Crucially, per-class fine-tuning (17 PII entity types, a subset of OPF's 33) is less data-efficient than binary labels at small n -- at n=100, binary F1=0.634 vs. per-class 0.360. Zero-shot, OPF achieves F1=0.464 on the SPY medical benchmark and F1=0.855 on AI4Privacy, substantially outperforming Presidio and XLM-RoBERTa-large-NER. However, OPF degrades sharply outside its PII training distribution: F1=0.04--0.40 on general NER benchmarks and collapses for non-Latin scripts (Arabic: 0.04, Cyrillic: 0.03). Error analysis reveals OPF excels on structurally regular PII (email: 0.78, phone: 0.76) but struggles with culturally variable entities (person names: 0.40, addresses: 0.49), and is recall-biased across most PII domains (precision 0.31--0.54, recall 0.70--0.85). We provide a decision heuristic for when to use OPF zero-shot, when to fine-tune XLM-RoBERTa, and which language families to avoid.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables; evaluation of a production PII detection system
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统评估 OpenAI 的 Privacy Filter (OPF)，一个 1.5B 参数的 PII 检测模型，覆盖 32 个基准、14 种语言和 5 个领域。研究发现领域相关的标注数据交叉点：微调的 XLM-RoBERTa 仅需约 500 条英文合成 PII 标注样本即可超过 OPF 的零样本性能，而 OPF 在分布外泛化上退化严重。误差分析显示 OPF 对结构化 PII 表现好，对文化变体实体表现差，且整体偏向高召回低精度。
Motivation: 生产级 PII 检测系统（如 OPF）缺乏系统性、跨语言跨领域的评估，用户不清楚何时直接使用零样本模型、何时需要微调小型模型。
Method: 作者在 32 个基准、14 种语言和 5 个领域上对比 OPF 与 Presidio、XLM-RoBERTa 等基线，进行零样本评估、小样本微调实验（二分类 vs 逐类）以及误差分析。
Result: OPF 在 SPY 医疗基准上 F1=0.464，在 AI4Privacy 上 F1=0.855，明显优于 Presidio 和 XLM-RoBERTa-large-NER；但在普通 NER 基准上 F1 仅 0.04–0.40，非拉丁脚本崩溃（阿拉伯语 0.04，西里尔语 0.03）。微调 XLM-RoBERTa 在英文合成 PII 上约 500 条样本即可超过 OPF 零样本，非英语 Kiji 约 100 条，合成医疗 PII 约 1000 条。小样本下二分类比逐类（17 类 vs OPF 的 33 类）更省数据（n=100 时 F1 0.634 vs 0.360）。OPF 对结构化实体（email 0.78，phone 0.76）表现好，对人名（0.40）和地址（0.49）表现差，且整体 precision 0.31–0.54、recall 0.70–0.85，呈召回偏差。
Conclusion: 作者提供决策启发式：何时使用 OPF 零样本、何时微调 XLM-RoBERTa、以及应避免哪些语言族。摘要强调 OPF 的域外泛化脆弱性、对非拉丁脚本的失效以及小样本下标签粒度的数据效率差异。

papers.title: DocQT: Improving Document Forgery Localization Robustness via Diverse JPEG Quantization Tables
papers.abstract_en: Document manipulation localization models achieve strong performance on public benchmarks yet fail to generalize to operational document workflows. We identify a critical and overlooked source of this gap: the mismatch between the narrow distribution of JPEG quantization tables used during training -restricted to standard libjpeg quality factors -and the heterogeneous compression profiles encountered in real-world insurance document pipelines. To isolate this factor, we conduct a controlled factorial study comparing two architectures with contrasting levels of quantization table awareness -FFDN [2] and Mesorch [20] -each trained under either standard quality factor augmentation (Standard-QT ) or operationally calibrated quantization tables sampled from DocQT, a quantization-table bank derived from a MAIF operational image corpus (Real-QT ), and evaluated under three recompression conditions. Training under Real-QT yields substantial localization gains on DocTamper [15] and significantly reduces the pixel-level false positive rate on authentic operational documents, but only for architectures that explicitly ingest the quantization table as input. The released DocQT quantization-table dataset and compression-reproduction material are directly available at https://github.com/Kyliroco/Improving-Document-Forgery-Localization-Robustness-via-Diverse-JPEG-Quantization-Tables. These results demonstrate that standard quality factor augmentation does not adequately proxy operational compression diversity, and that architectural choices explicitly conditioning on the quantization table provide a meaningful robustness advantage for real-world deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对文档篡改定位模型在真实业务流程中泛化失败的问题，指出训练时 JPEG 量化表 (quantization table) 分布过窄是重要原因：标准 libjpeg 质量因子无法覆盖保险文档流水线中的异构压缩配置。作者在两种量化表感知程度不同的架构 FFDN 与 Mesorch 上做受控析因实验，对比标准质量因子增强 (Standard-QT) 与来自 MAIF 操作图像语料构建的 DocQT 量化表库 (Real-QT)，并在三种重压缩条件下评估。结果显示只在显式把量化表作为输入的架构上，Real-QT 训练能显著提升 DocTamper 上的定位性能并降低真实操作文档的像素级误报率。
Motivation: 文档篡改定位模型在公开基准上表现良好，但在实际工作流中泛化失败；摘要将其归因于训练时 JPEG 量化表分布与真实保险文档流水线压缩配置之间的失配，且这一因素常被忽视。
Method: 开展受控析因研究：对比量化表感知程度不同的两种架构 FFDN 与 Mesorch，分别在标准质量因子增强 (Standard-QT) 与从 DocQT 量化表库采样的操作校准量化表 (Real-QT) 下训练，并在三种重压缩条件下评估；DocQT 由 MAIF 操作图像语料构建并随论文发布。
Result: 在 Real-QT 下训练在 DocTamper 上带来显著的定位性能提升，并明显降低真实操作文档上的像素级误报率；但该收益只出现在显式将量化表作为输入的架构中。
Conclusion: 标准质量因子增强不能充分代理操作环境中的压缩多样性，显式条件化于量化表的架构选择能为实际部署带来有意义的鲁棒性优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CP-MoE: Consistency-Preserving Mixture-of-Experts for Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Catastrophic forgetting remains a major obstacle to continual learning in large language models (LLMs) and vision--language models (VLMs). Although Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures offer an efficient path to scaling, existing LoRA-based MoE continual learning methods still face a fundamental trade-off: they either isolate experts too aggressively, limiting knowledge transfer across tasks, or allow task-specific updates to overwrite important existing parameters, leading to severe forgetting. To address this, we propose CP-MoE, a continual learning framework built around a transient expert that captures early task-specific updates and guides their integration into stable experts. CP-MoE introduces a consistency-preserving routing bias, which uses the transient expert to estimate representation similarity with stable experts and steer routing towards more compatible expert selection, and a transient expert-guided regularisation mechanism, which selectively protects important historical parameters during merging. Together, these components reduce parameter interference and forgetting while preserving cross-task knowledge transfer. We validate CP-MoE on both unimodal and multimodal continual learning benchmarks with LLM-based and VLM-based MoE models. On SuperNI benchmark, spanning diverse sequential language tasks, CP-MoE achieves state-of-the-art performance and stronger zero-shot transfer to unseen tasks. On VQA v2 dataset, it scales effectively to multimodal visual reasoning, consistently reduces forgetting, and outperforms strong MoE baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CP-MoE，一个面向持续学习 (continual learning) 的 MoE 框架，核心是引入一个临时专家 (transient expert) 来捕获任务早期的参数更新，并通过一致性保持路由偏置和正则化机制将其整合进稳定专家。论文在基于 LLM 和 VLM 的 MoE 模型上验证，摘要报告在 SuperNI 基准上达到 state-of-the-art 并与更强的零样本迁移，在 VQA v2 上有效降低遗忘并优于强 MoE 基线。
Motivation: 灾难性遗忘仍是 LLM 和 VLM 持续学习的核心障碍；现有基于 LoRA 的 MoE 方法面临两难：要么过度隔离专家限制跨任务知识迁移，要么任务特定更新覆盖重要参数导致严重遗忘。
Method: CP-MoE 围绕一个临时专家构建：该专家捕获早期任务特定更新；一致性保持路由偏置 (consistency-preserving routing bias) 利用临时专家估计与稳定专家的表示相似性，引导路由选择更兼容的专家；临时专家引导的正则化机制在合并时选择性保护重要的历史参数。
Result: 在 SuperNI 基准上，CP-MoE 取得 state-of-the-art 性能并表现出更强的对未见任务的零样本迁移；在 VQA v2 数据集上，方法有效扩展到多模态视觉推理，持续降低遗忘并优于强 MoE 基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架通过减少参数干扰和遗忘，同时保留跨任务知识迁移；结论范围限于所报告的 LLM/VLM MoE 持续学习基准。

papers.title: Fast Rates for Inverse Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: We establish novel structural and statistical results for entropy-regularized min-max inverse reinforcement learning (Min-Max-IRL) in finite-horizon MDPs with Borel state and action spaces. We show that maximum likelihood estimation (MLE) and Min-Max-IRL are equivalent at the population level, and at the empirical level under deterministic dynamics. For linear reward classes, we leverage pseudo-self-concordance of the Min-Max-IRL loss to prove that both the excess trajectory-level KL divergence and the squared parameter error in the Hessian norm decay at the fast rate $O(n^{-1})$, where $n$ is the number of expert trajectories. A local minimax lower bound matches the parameter-error rate up to logarithmic factors in the well-specified deterministic setting. Our guarantees apply under misspecification and require no uniform state-coverage assumption. We further extend reward-identifiability results to general Borel spaces and compare our results with MLE-based guarantees.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究有限时域、Borel 状态与动作空间 MDP 中熵正则化的 min-max 逆强化学习 (Min-Max-IRL) 的结构性与统计性结果。作者证明在总体层面 MLE 与 Min-Max-IRL 等价，并在确定性动力学下于经验层面等价；在线性奖励函数类中利用伪自协调性 (pseudo-self-concordance) 得到轨迹级 KL 散度与 Hessian 范数下参数平方误差均为 O(n^{-1}) 的快速收敛率，并给出匹配的局部极小极大下界。
Motivation: 逆强化学习的现有理论保证往往依赖均匀状态覆盖等强假设，且针对熵正则化 min-max 形式的统计收敛速率刻画不充分，尤其在一般 Borel 空间上缺乏系统的可辨识性与误差界分析。
Method: 作者建立熵正则化 Min-Max-IRL 的损失结构，证明其与 MLE 在总体层面及确定性动力学下的经验层面等价；对线性奖励类，利用伪自协调性推导轨迹级 KL 散度和 Hessian 范数下参数误差的 O(n^{-1}) 快速率，并在良好设定的确定性情形下证明局部极小极大下界与参数误差率在对数因子内匹配。
Result: 摘要报告，在线性奖励类下，超额轨迹级 KL 散度与 Hessian 范数下的平方参数误差均以 O(n^{-1}) 速率衰减，其中 n 为专家轨迹数；局部极小极大下界在良好设定的确定性情形下与该速率匹配（至多差对数因子）。
Conclusion: 结论层面的贡献是：这些保证在模型误设定下仍然成立，且不要求均匀状态覆盖假设；同时将奖励可辨识性结果推广到一般 Borel 空间，并与基于 MLE 的保证进行比较。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Physics-Guided Concentration Inference from Resistance Transients in a Mixed-Phase SnO-SnO$_2$ Carbon Monoxide Sensor with p-n Switching
papers.abstract_en: This work presents a physics-guided machine-learning framework for carbon monoxide concentration inference from experimentally measured resistance transients of a mixed-phase SnO-SnO$_2$ material gas sensor exhibiting temperature-dependent p-n switching behavior. Cycle-level transient responses are represented through physically interpretable descriptors and complemented by compact fast Fourier transform (FFT) and discrete wavelet transform (DWT)-based summaries. Using leakage-aware grouped cross-validation, we study both multi-class concentration classification and continuous concentration regression for the p-type and n-type sensing regimes separately. Across both regimes, fused features provide the strongest overall performance, while the physics-guided descriptor block remains highly competitive, indicating that the dominant concentration information is already encoded in physically meaningful transient dynamics. The p-type branch shows the best concentration-class discrimination, with the fused Random Forest classifier reaching approximately $96.5\%$ accuracy, whereas the n-type branch yields the best quantitative concentration estimation, with the fused Random Forest regressor achieving an MAE$\approx 1.48$ ppm and an R$^2$ $\approx 0.992$. These results reveal a clear dual-regime behavior: p-type sensing is particularly favorable for classification, whereas n-type sensing is more favorable for high-fidelity regression. More broadly, the study demonstrates that leakage-aware, cycle-level, physics-guided machine learning can extend conventional gas-sensing analysis beyond single-response metrics while preserving physical interpretability
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个物理引导的机器学习框架，用于从混合相 SnO-SnO₂ 气体传感器在温度依赖 p-n 切换行为下测得的电阻瞬态中推断一氧化碳浓度。瞬态响应通过物理可解释的描述符以及 FFT 和 DWT 摘要表示，并在考虑泄漏感知的分组交叉验证下分别研究 p 型与 n 型传感模式的浓度分类与连续回归。结果表明融合特征总体最优，p 型分支最适合浓度分类（随机森林约 96.5% 准确率），n 型分支最适合高保真回归（MAE≈1.48 ppm，R²≈0.992）。
Motivation: 传统气体传感分析通常依赖单一响应指标，未能充分利用瞬态动力学中的浓度信息；同时混合相传感器存在 p-n 切换行为，需要能够分离两种传感模式并进行可解释浓度推断的建模方法。
Method: 以循环级（cycle-level）电阻瞬态为基础，提取物理可解释的描述符，并辅以紧凑快速傅里叶变换（FFT）和离散小波变换（DWT）摘要；分别对 p 型和 n 型传感区域进行多分类浓度分类与连续浓度回归，采用泄漏感知的分组交叉验证（leakage-aware grouped cross-validation）评估模型。
Result: 在两种传感模式下，融合特征均表现最强，而物理引导描述符块也极具竞争力；p 型分支的融合随机森林分类器达到约 96.5% 准确率，n 型分支的融合随机森林回归器达到 MAE≈1.48 ppm 和 R²≈0.992。
Conclusion: 研究揭示双模式行为：p 型传感更有利于浓度分类，n 型传感更有利于高保真回归；同时表明泄漏感知、循环级、物理引导的机器学习可在保持物理可解释性的前提下扩展传统气体传感分析范式。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一个物理引导的机器学习框架，用于从混合相 SnO-SnO₂ 气体传感器在温度依赖 p-n 切换行为下测得的电阻瞬态中推断一氧化碳浓度。瞬态响应通过物理可解释的描述符以及 FFT 和 DWT 摘要表示，并在考虑泄漏感知的分组交叉验证下分别研究 p 型与 n 型传感模式的浓度分类与连续回归。结果表明融合特征总体最优，p 型分支最适合浓度分类（随机森林约 96.5% 准确率），n 型分支最适合高保真回归（MAE≈1.48 ppm，R²≈0.992）。
summary_sections.motivation: 传统气体传感分析通常依赖单一响应指标，未能充分利用瞬态动力学中的浓度信息；同时混合相传感器存在 p-n 切换行为，需要能够分离两种传感模式并进行可解释浓度推断的建模方法。
summary_sections.method: 以循环级（cycle-level）电阻瞬态为基础，提取物理可解释的描述符，并辅以紧凑快速傅里叶变换（FFT）和离散小波变换（DWT）摘要；分别对 p 型和 n 型传感区域进行多分类浓度分类与连续浓度回归，采用泄漏感知的分组交叉验证（leakage-aware grouped cross-validation）评估模型。
summary_sections.result: 在两种传感模式下，融合特征均表现最强，而物理引导描述符块也极具竞争力；p 型分支的融合随机森林分类器达到约 96.5% 准确率，n 型分支的融合随机森林回归器达到 MAE≈1.48 ppm 和 R²≈0.992。
summary_sections.conclusion: 研究揭示双模式行为：p 型传感更有利于浓度分类，n 型传感更有利于高保真回归；同时表明泄漏感知、循环级、物理引导的机器学习可在保持物理可解释性的前提下扩展传统气体传感分析范式。

papers.title: Reducing Hallucination in Vision-Language Models via Stage-wise Preference Optimization under Distribution Shift
papers.abstract_en: Hallucination remains a fundamental challenge in vision-language models (VLMs), where autoregressive generation may produce linguistically plausible yet physically inconsistent or visually ungrounded responses due to likelihood maximization under joint probabilistic modeling. We propose a stage-wise preference optimization framework for hallucination reduction through targeted multimodal data construction. Rather than directly optimizing on generic instruction-following data, our approach progressively constructs hallucination-focused preference pairs near known failure boundaries. The framework emphasizes ambiguous spatial orientation, object relationships, OCR uncertainty, and adversarial false-premise training. Hallucinated negatives are generated through minimally perturbed yet visually inconsistent alternatives, enabling Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to better separate grounded reasoning from plausible hallucination. Experiments on open-source benchmarks and real-world multimodal evaluation scenarios demonstrate improved grounding consistency, reduced hallucination, and more informative grounded responses. Cross-model qualitative evaluation further shows that the proposed multimodal LLM DPO framework produces more visually grounded responses than several frontier proprietary VLMs, such as in ambiguous spatial reasoning and adversarial false-premise settings. The results suggest that hallucination may arise not only from limited model capacity, but also from inherent tendencies of autoregressive probabilistic generation to favor linguistically plausible continuations under weak visual grounding. Future work may explore physical consistency modeling, uncertainty-aware multimodal reasoning, and architectural alternatives beyond standard autoregressive decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向视觉语言模型（VLM）幻觉缓解的分阶段偏好优化框架，通过针对已知失效边界构造多模态偏好对，并利用 Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) 训练，以提升生成内容与视觉证据的耦合。摘要报告在开源基准和真实多模态评测中，该框架改善了 grounding 一致性并减少幻觉，且在模糊空间推理等情境下优于若干前沿专有 VLM。作者认为幻觉不仅源于模型容量，也可能源于自回归概率生成在弱视觉 grounding 下偏好语言学上合理的延续。
Motivation: VLM 中的幻觉仍是根本性挑战：自回归生成在联合概率建模下可能产生语言上合理但与视觉不一致的响应，现有方法直接在通用指令数据上优化，难以有效分离 grounded 推理与看似合理的幻觉。
Method: 提出分阶段偏好优化框架，不直接在通用指令数据上优化，而是逐步构造贴近已知失效边界的幻觉聚焦偏好对，涵盖模糊空间方向、物体关系、OCR 不确定性及对抗性错误前提训练；幻觉负样本通过最小扰动但视觉不一致的替代内容生成，使 DPO 能更好区分 grounded 推理与幻觉。
Result: 在开源基准和真实多模态评估场景中，该方法改善了 grounding 一致性、减少幻觉并生成更具信息量的 grounded 响应；跨模型定性评估显示，该多模态 LLM DPO 框架在模糊空间推理和对抗性错误前提设置下比若干前沿专有 VLM 产生更视觉 grounded 的响应。
Conclusion: 实验表明幻觉可能不仅源于模型容量限制，也源于自回归概率生成在弱视觉 grounding 下倾向语言上合理的延续；未来工作可探索物理一致性建模、不确定性感知的多模态推理，以及超越标准自回归解码的架构替代方案。

papers.title: Phylogenetic Tree Inference with Tropical Axial Attention
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we introduce a Tropical Axial Attention neural reasoning architecture that replaces vanilla softmax dot-product attention with max-plus operators, inducing a piecewise-linear structure aligned with dynamic programming formulations. From multi-species sequence alignments, our model learns all possible pairwise distances and is trained using a combination of $\ell_1$ and tropical symmetric distance metric losses with an ultrametric violation penalty. We leverage the well known isomorphic relationship between the space of all phylogenetic trees with $n$ species and tropical Grassmannian to show that tropical attention provides a natural geometric framework for phylogenetic inference. On empirical $DS1-DS11$ alignments, where true trees are unknown, the tropical model achieves the lowest MAE to its FastME-induced tree metric on every dataset, with a MAE reductions averaging 81.5% relative to Phyloformer and 98.4% relative than Phyloformer 2. These results suggest that tropical attention is a useful geometric inductive bias for neural phylogenetic inference, especially under distribution shift and when tree-metric consistency is important.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为 Tropical Axial Attention 的神经推理架构，用 max-plus 算子替换标准 softmax dot-product 注意力，使模型具有与动态规划一致的分段线性结构。模型从多物种序列比对中学习所有成对距离，并用 ℓ1 损失、tropical 对称距离损失和 ultrametric 违规惩罚进行训练；作者利用系统发育树空间与 tropical Grassmannian 的同构关系，论证 tropical attention 为系统发育推断提供了自然的几何框架。在 DS1–DS11 比对数据上，该模型在每个数据集上对 FastME 诱导的树度量均取得最低 MAE，平均相对 Phyloformer 降低 81.5%、相对 Phyloformer 2 降低 98.4%。
Motivation: 现有神经系统发育推断方法缺少与树空间几何结构相匹配的归纳偏置，在分布偏移以及需要树度量一致性的场景下表现受限；作者希望引入一种与动态规划及树空间几何天然对应的注意力机制。
Method: 提出 Tropical Axial Attention 架构，使用 max-plus 算子替代 softmax 点积注意力，从而产生分段线性结构；训练结合 ℓ1 损失、tropical 对称距离损失与 ultrametric 违规惩罚，并基于树空间与 tropical Grassmannian 的同构建立几何框架。
Result: 在真实树未知的 DS1–DS11 数据集上，tropical 模型对 FastME 诱导树度量的 MAE 在每个数据集上均最低，平均相对 Phyloformer 降低 81.5%，相对 Phyloformer 2 降低 98.4%。
Conclusion: 作者认为 tropical attention 是一种对神经系统发育推断有用的几何归纳偏置，尤其适用于分布偏移和树度量一致性重要的情形。

papers.title: Positive-Data Learning of Fixed-Observation Linear MCFGs from Working Binary Presentations
papers.abstract_en: We study positive-data learning of languages admitting reduced working binary linear nondeleting multiple context-free grammar presentations of bounded fan-out. The learner is supplied with a fixed explicit finite monoid homomorphism (h:Σ^*\to M), used as a compositional finite-state observation. We define ((f,h))-tuple substitutability through named sentence-context distributions. For every fixed fan-out bound (f) and morphism (h), a canonical set-driven learner exactly reconstructs each target from a finite presentation-relative characteristic sample. Its raw hypothesis uses equal-fan-out unit rules; polynomial unit elimination yields an equivalent unit-free working MCFG. From a finite sample (K), the final hypothesis is constructible in time (|K|_+^{O(f)}), including output size. The finite observation is substantive. We call the class obtained by fixing one finite observation morphism (h) a fixed-observation fiber; the same morphism is supplied to the learner for every target in that class. The language (L_3={a^n b^n c^n\mid n\ge1}) belongs to such a fiber but fails Yoshinaka's original two-dimensional substitutability condition. General binary presentations admit a characteristic-sample obstruction uniform over fixed set-driven learners, whereas a natural single-spine subclass has polynomial characteristic samples and includes the three-block and cross-serial examples. Finally, bounded-size observations compile into one product morphism, while the unbounded union over all finite observations is not identifiable from positive data; an infinite member-kernel criterion excludes the copy language from every fixed fiber.
papers.comment: 42 pages. Major revision. Sentence-interface types are eliminated from learner and refinement states; reconstruction now uses componentwise output typing and concrete occurrence witnesses. Added unit elimination, separation examples, characteristic-sample bounds for single-spine presentations, observation-parameter results, and member-kernel obstructions
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究正数据学习 (positive-data learning) 下可接受有界 fan-out 的归约工作二元线性非删除多上下文无关语法 (working binary linear nondeleting MCFG) 表示的语言类。作者为学习器配备一个固定的有限幺半群同态作为有限态观测，定义 ((f,h))-元组可替换性，并给出一个典范的集合驱动学习器，能从有限的表示相关特征样本中精确重构目标语法。摘要报告了假设可在 |K|_+^{O(f)} 时间内构造，并刻画了固定观测纤维的可辨识性边界。
Motivation: 现有可辨识性条件（如 Yoshinaka 的二维可替换性）不足以覆盖某些语言，例如 L3={a^n b^n c^n | n≥1}；同时需厘清在正数据下、借助固定有限观测究竟能学习哪类 MCFG 语言。
Method: 提出 ((f,h))-元组可替换性，基于命名的句子-上下文分布；对每个固定 fan-out 界 f 和有限幺半群同态 h，定义典范集合驱动学习器，先用等 fan-out 单元规则生成原始假设，再通过多项式时间的单元消去得到等价的无单元工作 MCFG。
Result: 摘要称从有限样本 K 构造最终假设的时间为 |K|_+^{O(f)}（含输出规模）；L3 属于某个固定观测纤维但违反 Yoshinaka 条件；一般二元表示对所有固定集合驱动学习器存在特征样本障碍，而单脊子类具有多项式特征样本并涵盖三块与交叉串例子；所有有限观测的无界并集无法从正数据辨识，且无穷成员核准则将复制语言排除在任一固定纤维之外。
Conclusion: 作者强调固定有限观测对学习是实质性的，并给出了可辨识性与不可辨识性的清晰边界：有界规模观测可编译进单一积同态，而无界并集不可辨识；该框架扩展了正数据下 MCFG 语言学习的适用范围。

papers.title: The Impossibility Triangle of Long-Context Modeling
papers.abstract_en: We identify and prove a fundamental trade-off governing long-sequence models: no model can simultaneously achieve (i) per-step computation independent of sequence length (Efficiency), (ii) state size independent of sequence length (Compactness), and (iii) the ability to recall a number of historical facts proportional to sequence length (Recall). We formalize this trade-off within an Online Sequence Processor abstraction that unifies Transformers, state space models, linear recurrent networks, and their hybrids. Using the Data Processing Inequality and Fano's Inequality, we prove that any model satisfying Efficiency and Compactness can recall at most O(poly(d)/log V) key-value pairs from a sequence of arbitrary length, where d is the model dimension and V is the vocabulary size. We classify 52 architectures published before March 2026 into the triangle, showing that each achieves at most two of the three properties and that hybrid architectures trace continuous trajectories in the interior. Experiments on synthetic associative recall tasks with five representative architectures validate the theoretical bound: empirical recall capacity lies strictly below the information-theoretic limit, and no architecture escapes the triangle.
papers.comment: Withdrawn because Section 4.2 contains a substantive error in the proof of the main theorem: Eq. (11) incorrectly drops the query key (k_i) when applying the data processing inequality. The positivity condition used in Eqs. (6) and (14) is also insufficient. These errors invalidate the main theorem
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出"长上下文建模的不可能三角"，在 Online Sequence Processor 抽象下论证效率（每步计算与序列长度无关）、紧凑性（状态大小与序列长度无关）与回忆能力（可回溯与序列长度成正比的历史事实）三者不可兼得。摘要称用数据处理不等式与 Fano 不等式证明同时满足效率与紧凑性的模型最多只能回忆 O(poly(d)/log V) 个键值对，并对 52 个已有架构进行分类与实验验证。但该论文已被撤回：第 4.2 节主定理证明存在实质错误，Eq. (11) 在应用数据处理不等式时错误地丢弃了 query key (k_i)，且 Eqs. (6) 和 (14) 所用的正性条件不充分，主定理因此无效。
Motivation: 长序列模型在效率、紧凑性和回忆能力之间存在被广泛感知但缺乏统一形式化的基本权衡；论文试图给出一个严格的不可兼得定理，解释为何主流架构无法同时满足这三种性质。
Method: 定义 Online Sequence Processor 抽象以统一 Transformer、状态空间模型、线性递归网络及其混合体；利用数据处理不等式和 Fano 不等式推导任意长度序列上可回忆键值对数量的信息论上界，并把 2026 年 3 月前发表的 52 种架构映射到该三角形中。
Result: 理论结果为回忆容量上界 O(poly(d)/log V)，其中 d 为模型维度、V 为词表大小；在五个代表性架构上的合成联想回忆实验显示经验回忆容量严格低于该信息论上界，且没有架构能逃出三角形。需要指出，撤回声明表明主定理证明有误，核心结论不再成立。
Conclusion: 论文本身因第 4.2 节主定理证明中的实质错误被撤回，作者明确说明这些错误使主定理无效，因此该论文的理论结论不宜作为可靠结果引用。其主题与降水临近预报、天气预测、资料同化等关键词无关。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出"长上下文建模的不可能三角"，在 Online Sequence Processor 抽象下论证效率（每步计算与序列长度无关）、紧凑性（状态大小与序列长度无关）与回忆能力（可回溯与序列长度成正比的历史事实）三者不可兼得。摘要称用数据处理不等式与 Fano 不等式证明同时满足效率与紧凑性的模型最多只能回忆 O(poly(d)/log V) 个键值对，并对 52 个已有架构进行分类与实验验证。但该论文已被撤回：第 4.2 节主定理证明存在实质错误，Eq. (11) 在应用数据处理不等式时错误地丢弃了 query key (k_i)，且 Eqs. (6) 和 (14) 所用的正性条件不充分，主定理因此无效。
