papers.title: Skill Neologisms: Towards Skill-based Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Modern LLMs show mastery over an ever-growing range of skills, as well as the ability to compose them flexibly. However, extending model capabilities to new skills in a scalable manner is an open problem: fine-tuning and parameter-efficient variants risk catastrophic forgetting, while context-based approaches have limited expressiveness and are constrained by the model's effective context. We explore skill neologisms--soft tokens integrated in the model's vocabulary and optimized to improve capabilities over a specific skill--as a way to selectively acquire new skills without weight updates. We first observe that pretrained LLMs already exhibit tokens associated with procedural knowledge. We then show on a controlled synthetic task that skill neologisms can be learned to improve model capabilities on specific skills while being composable with out-of-distribution skills, and that independently trained skill neologisms can be composed zero-shot. Finally, we validate zero-shot composition of independently learned skill neologisms on the more realistic natural language setting of the Skill-Mix benchmark. These results suggest that skill neologisms may provide a scalable path towards skill-based continual learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“技能新词”（skill neologisms），即集成到模型词汇表中的软 token，针对特定技能进行优化，从而在不更新权重的情况下选择性获取新技能。作者先观察到预训练 LLM 已存在与程序性知识相关的 token，随后在受控合成任务上证明技能新词能提升特定技能能力、可与分布外技能组合，且独立训练的技能新词可以零样本组合；最后在更真实的 Skill-Mix 基准上验证了该零样本组合。作者据此认为技能新词可能为基于技能的持续学习（skill-based continual learning）提供可扩展路径。
Motivation: 扩展 LLM 到新技能的可扩展方法仍是开放问题：微调及其参数高效变体存在灾难性遗忘风险，而基于上下文的方法表达力有限且受限于模型有效上下文长度。因此需要一种能选择性获取新技能而无需权重更新的机制。
Method: 将技能新词定义为集成在模型词汇表中的软 token，并针对特定技能进行优化，全程不进行权重更新。研究包括预训练模型中的程序性知识 token 观察、受控合成任务上的技能获取与分布外组合实验，以及自然语言 Skill-Mix 基准上的零样本组合验证。
Result: 摘要报告：预训练 LLM 中已存在与程序性知识相关的 token；在受控合成任务中，技能新词可提升特定技能能力并可组合分布外技能；独立训练的技能新词能够零样本组合，且在 Skill-Mix 基准上得到验证。
Conclusion: 摘要认为技能新词可能为基于技能的持续学习提供一条可扩展路径，属于探索性结果，强调“可能”（may）且未给出完整持续学习流程的实证支持。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Dream-MPC: Gradient-Based Model Predictive Control with Latent Imagination
papers.abstract_en: State-of-the-art model-based Reinforcement Learning (RL) approaches either use gradient-free, population-based methods for planning, learned policy networks, or a combination of policy networks and planning. Hybrid approaches that combine Model Predictive Control (MPC) with a learned model and a policy prior to leverage the advantages of both paradigms have shown promising results. However, these approaches typically rely on gradient-free optimization methods, which can be computationally expensive for high-dimensional control tasks. While gradient-based methods are a promising alternative, recent works have empirically shown that gradient-based methods often perform worse than their gradient-free counterparts. We propose Dream-MPC, a novel approach that generates few candidate trajectories from a rolled-out policy and optimizes each trajectory by gradient ascent using a learned world model, uncertainty regularization and amortization of optimization iterations over time by reusing previously optimized actions. Our results on 24 continuous control tasks show that Dream-MPC can significantly improve the performance of the underlying policy and can outperform gradient-free MPC and state-of-the-art baselines. Code and videos are available at https://dream-mpc.github.io.
papers.comment: Accepted for International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Dream-MPC，一种基于梯度的模型预测控制方法：从 rollout 的策略生成少量候选轨迹，用学习到的世界模型对每条轨迹做梯度上升优化，并加入不确定性正则化和跨时间步复用已优化动作来摊销迭代。在 24 个连续控制任务上，Dream-MPC 显著提升了底层策略的性能，并优于无梯度 MPC 和现有基线。该工作已被 ICML 2026 接收。
Motivation: 现有结合 MPC、学习模型与策略先验的混合方法通常依赖无梯度优化，在高维控制任务上计算开销大；而梯度方法虽然高效，但此前经验上表现往往不如无梯度方法。
Method: 从 rollout 的策略生成少量候选轨迹，利用学习的世界模型对每条轨迹执行梯度上升优化；通过不确定性正则化稳定优化，并通过复用先前优化好的动作在时间上摊销优化迭代，从而减少计算成本。
Result: 在 24 个连续控制任务上，Dream-MPC 能显著提升底层策略的性能，并超过无梯度 MPC 和当前最优基线。
Conclusion: 摘要表明基于梯度的 MPC 结合潜在想象可以有效替代无梯度方法，并公开了代码和视频。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Realizable Bayes-Consistency for General Metric Losses
papers.abstract_en: We study strong universal Bayes-consistency in the realizable setting for learning with general metric losses, extending classical characterizations beyond $0$-$1$ classification (Bousquet et al., 2020; Hanneke et al., 2021) and real-valued regression (Attias et al., 2024). Given an instance space $(X,ρ)$, a label space $(Y,\ell)$ with possibly unbounded loss, and a hypothesis class $H \subseteq Y^{X}$, we resolve the realizable case of an open problem presented in Tsir Cohen and Kontorovich (2022). Specifically, we find the necessary and sufficient conditions on the hypothesis class $H$ under which there exists a distribution-free learning rule whose risk converges almost surely to the best-in-class risk (which is zero) for every realizable data-generating distribution. Our main contribution is this sharp characterization in terms of a combinatorial obstruction: Similarly to Attias et al. (2024), we introduce the notion of an infinite non-decreasing $(γ_k)$-Littlestone tree, where $γ_k \to \infty$. This extends the Littlestone tree structure used in Bousquet et al. (2020) to the metric loss setting.
papers.comment: 14 pages. Accepted to ICML 2026; v2: fixed abstract metadata rendering; v3: strengthened lower-bound theorem statement to almost-sure infinite risk (proof unchanged)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究可实现设定 (realizable setting) 下通用度量损失 (general metric losses) 的强通用 Bayes 一致性。作者给出分布无关学习规则使得风险几乎必然收敛到类内最优风险（零）的充分必要条件，其刻画基于无限非递减 (γ_k)-Littlestone 树这一组合障碍，将此前仅覆盖 0-1 分类和实值回归的特征刻画推广到度量损失，并解决了 Tsir Cohen 和 Kontorovich (2022) 提出的开放问题。
Motivation: 经典 Bayes 一致性的刻画仅覆盖 0-1 分类与实值回归，而一般度量损失、可能无界标签空间下的可实现设定仍缺少完整刻画；理解何种假设类允许分布无关的强一致学习规则是该方向的核心开放问题。
Method: 引入无限非递减 (γ_k)-Littlestone 树（γ_k → ∞）作为组合障碍，类似 Attias 等人 (2024) 的做法，将 Bousquet 等人 (2020) 的 Littlestone 树结构推广到度量损失设定，并据此刻画假设类 H 的充要条件；同时将下界定理加强为几乎必然无穷风险。
Result: 摘要给出可实现设定下强通用 Bayes 一致性的锐利刻画：假设类 H 不包含此类无限非递减 (γ_k)-Littlestone 树是存在分布无关学习规则的必要且充分条件；版本 v3 还将下界定理强化到几乎必然无穷风险。
Conclusion: 该结果把 Bayes 一致性理论从 0-1 分类与实值回归推广到通用度量损失，并为 Tsir Cohen 和 Kontorovich (2022) 的可实现情形开放问题提供了完整回答。本文为纯理论贡献，摘要未涉及任何数值实验。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Diffusion Operator Geometry of Feedforward Representations
papers.abstract_en: Feedforward neural networks transform data through learned representations whose geometry shapes how classes separate and relate across successive layers. We study that geometry through diffusion operators. Each feature-cloud snapshot is assigned a Gaussian-kernel Markov operator, giving a smooth description of one-step transport between classes from which spectral, boundary, and local geometric information can be read. We define the empirical class chain, state the condition under which it is an exact Markov quotient, and derive both the corresponding population transition and a simpler overlap chain based on expected class affinities. For balanced shared-covariance Gaussian class-conditional snapshots these affinities have closed forms controlled by a regularized Mahalanobis separation, which yields explicit expressions for leakage and coarse spectral behaviour. We further show that operator observables vary smoothly under feature perturbations, whereas hard neighborhood graphs are controlled by neighbor-order margins. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 ResNet-18 representations find that class transport becomes increasingly persistent with depth while retaining structured relations between classes, and that the diffusion class chain is more stable than its $k$-nearest-neighbor counterpart under matched perturbations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究前馈神经网络表示在逐层变换中的几何结构，用扩散算子（diffusion operator）描述类别之间的传输。作者为每个特征云快照分配高斯核 Markov 算子，据此定义经验类别链（empirical class chain），给出其为精确 Markov 商的条件，并推导对应的总体转移与基于期望类别亲和度的重叠链；在平衡共享协方差高斯类条件快照下得到闭式解。CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100 的 ResNet-18 表示实验表明，类别传输随深度增加而更持久，且扩散类别链在匹配扰动下比 k 近邻图更稳定。
Motivation: 理解类别在深层网络中如何分离和关联是表示学习的关键问题，而硬近邻图对特征扰动敏感。论文希望用扩散算子提供一种平滑、可解析的几何描述，以捕捉特征云快照之间的一步传输、谱和边界信息。
Method: 对每一层特征云构造高斯核 Markov 算子，定义经验类别链并给出其为精确 Markov 商的条件；进一步推导总体转移链和基于期望类别亲和度的重叠链，对平衡共享协方差高斯类条件快照得到由正则化 Mahalanobis 距离控制的闭式泄漏与谱行为。
Result: 实验发现类别传输随网络深度增加而愈发持久，同时层间仍保留结构化类别关系；在匹配扰动下，扩散类别链比 k 近邻类别链更稳定。
Conclusion: 扩散算子视角能为前馈表示的类别几何提供平滑且稳定的刻画，而硬邻域图的行为则受邻域阶数边界（neighbor-order margins）支配；作者将稳定性优势归因于扩散算子的平滑性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: To Call or Not to Call: A Framework to Assess and Optimize LLM Tool Calling
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI architectures augment LLMs with external tools, unlocking strong capabilities but potentially incurring substantial costs. Moreover, tool use is not always beneficial: redundant or low-utility calls can even harm task performance. Effective tool use, therefore, hinges on a core LLM decision: whether to call or not call a tool when performing a task. We introduce a principled framework inspired by decision-making theory to understand tool-use decisions along three key factors: necessity, utility, and affordability. Our analysis combines two complementary lenses: a normative perspective that infers true need and utility for optimal tool calls, and a descriptive perspective that infers the model's self-perceived need and utility from their observed behaviors. We evaluate six open models and a proprietary OpenAI model across native and customized harnesses, two tools, and six tasks. Models' perceived need and utility remain misaligned with their true values, particularly under budget constraints. This misalignment produces both costly overuse and performance-degrading calls. To improve the tool decisions, we train lightweight latent estimators of need (LNEs) from model hidden states. LNEs generally predict true need more accurately than model self-reports and improve budgeted tool allocation across model scales and tool types. Code and dataset available at https://github.com/QinyuanWu0710/ToCall_or_NotToCall.

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于决策理论的框架，从必要性 (necessity)、效用 (utility)、可负担性 (affordability) 三个因素分析 LLM 的工具调用 (tool calling) 决策，并结合规范性 (normative) 视角与描述性 (descriptive) 视角。作者在六种开源模型和一种 OpenAI 模型上评估，发现模型的感知需要/效用与真实值错位，尤其在预算约束下导致过度调用和损害性能的调用。为解决该问题，作者从模型隐藏状态训练轻量级潜在需要估计器 (LNE)，其通常比模型自报更准确地预测真实需要，并改善跨模型规模与工具类型的预算化工具分配。
Motivation: Agentic AI 中工具调用并非总是有利，冗余或低效用调用会损害任务性能并产生显著成本，因此核心问题是 LLM 何时应当调用工具；现有研究缺少系统化理解这一决策的框架。
Method: 引入基于决策理论的框架，以必要性、效用、可负担性刻画工具调用决策；通过规范性视角推断最优调用的真实需要与效用，通过描述性视角从模型可观测行为推断其自感需要与效用。基于分析训练轻量级潜在需要估计器 (Latent Need Estimators, LNEs)，从模型隐藏状态预测真实需要。
Result: 在 native 和 customized harness、两个工具、六个任务上评估六种开源模型及一个 OpenAI 模型，结果显示模型的感知需要和效用与真实值错位，尤其在预算约束下会引发高成本过度调用和降低性能的调用；LNEs 通常比模型自报更准确地预测真实需要，并在不同模型规模和工具类型上改善预算化的工具分配。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于隐藏状态的 LNE 能够缓解感知需要与真实需要之间的错位，为预算受限场景下更可靠的工具调用决策提供支持；代码和数据集已公开。

papers.title: Assessing the Role of Intersection Proximity in Pedestrian Crashes: Insights from Data Mining Approach
papers.abstract_en: Although intersections are the most complex parts of the roadway network, pedestrian crashes at non-intersection locations are disproportionately frequent, highlighting a serious traffic safety concern. This study investigates non-intersection crashes involving pedestrians using a crash database (2017-2021) collected from Louisiana State. As the risk of pedestrian crashes tends to vary with distance from the intersection, the research team utilized a unique framework "distance to intersection" to capture the differences in crash patterns at non-intersection locations. The study identified that around 50% of non-intersection pedestrian crashes occurred within 198 ft. of the intersection. In the next step, the collected 3,135 pedestrian crashes at non-intersection locations during the study period were subdivided into three zones: D1 zone designates crashes occurring within 150 ft. of an intersection (1,277 crashes), D2 zone designates crashes occurring within 151 ft. to 435 ft. of an intersection (1,060 crashes) and D3 zone designates crashes occurring at 435 ft. or higher from an intersection (798 crashes). To explore the complex interaction of multiple factors, an intuitive data mining technique, Association Rules Mining was used. A total of the top 60 interesting association rules (20 for each zone) were identified by the algorithm (based on lift and support measures). In addition, a total of 124 rules were explored based on Lift Increase Criterion (LIC) measure. The findings of this research provide critical insights into pedestrian crash involvement at non-intersection locations and the variation in crash patterns according to the "distance to intersection". Based on the findings, some of the targeted problem-specific countermeasures are also recommended to address the crash patterns at non-intersection locations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用路易斯安那州 2017-2021 年的行人碰撞数据库，研究非交叉口位置的行人事故，并以“距交叉口距离”为框架将 3,135 起事故划分为三个距离区间（D1、D2、D3）。作者采用关联规则挖掘 (Association Rules Mining) 识别各区间内的事故模式，并基于提升度 (lift) 和支持度 (support) 以及 Lift Increase Criterion 提取规则，进而提出针对性的安全对策。
Motivation: 交叉口虽是道路网络中最复杂的部分，但非交叉口位置的行人碰撞事故却不成比例地频繁发生；已有研究对这一位置上的事故模式与距交叉口距离之间的关系关注不足。
Method: 提出了以“距交叉口距离”(distance to intersection) 为核心的分析框架，将非交叉口行人碰撞划分为三个区域；使用关联规则挖掘算法，按 lift 与 support 筛选各区间的 top 60 条规则，并额外基于 Lift Increase Criterion (LIC) 探索了 124 条规则。
Result: 研究发现约 50% 的非交叉口行人碰撞发生在距交叉口 198 ft 以内；3,135 起事故中，D1 区（≤150 ft）1,277 起、D2 区（151–435 ft）1,060 起、D3 区（≥435 ft）798 起，且各区间的碰撞模式存在差异。
Conclusion: 摘要指出这些发现揭示非交叉口行人碰撞的模式随距交叉口距离的变化，并据此推荐了针对特定问题的安全对策；研究范围局限于路易斯安那州 2017-2021 年数据。

papers.title: Supervised Learning Has a Geometric Blind Spot
papers.abstract_en: Ordinary supervised training minimises the task loss and then stops. It never pays for how far the representation moves when the input is nudged along directions that helped fit training labels---including directions that are nuisance at deployment. We call that leftover sensitivity the geometric blind spot of empirical risk minimisation. In a Gaussian linear model where the nuisance enters the label conditional and the decoder has finite Lipschitz constant, population MSE forces a floor on linearised representation drift. The same distinction predicts a failure mode of adversarial training: Jacobian magnitude can fall while clean class geometry worsens. We track that dissociation with a class-layout score and study isotropic encoder matching---penalising the squared distance between phi(x) and phi(x+delta) for Gaussian delta under a task-loss cap---when nuisance axes are unknown. On a Vision Transformer trained from scratch on CIFAR-10, projected gradient descent attains the smallest Jacobian Frobenius yet the worst clean layout score (1.353+/-0.020 over three seeds), above task-only training (1.093); isotropic matching attains the best (0.904). The drift floor is proved for the linear-Gaussian case; deep nets and cross-task orderings are protocol empirics. Design rule: report class-layout geometry beside the task score; prefer isotropic encoder matching when axes are unknown.
papers.comment: 35 pages. v2: JMLR-aligned revision of arXiv:2604.21395; Proposition 6 corrected to minimax (worst-case) anisotropy; title shortened to Supervised Learning Has a Geometric Blind Spot. Under submission at JMLR. Companion: arXiv:2605.22800
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出普通监督训练只最小化任务损失后即停止，不为表示沿“有助于拟合训练标签”的方向（包括部署时的 nuisance 方向）的移动付费，称之为经验风险最小化的几何盲区（geometric blind spot）。作者在线性高斯模型中证明群体 MSE 会对线性化表示漂移施加下界，并据此预测对抗训练可能出现 Jacobian 范数下降而干净类几何变差的分裂。在 CIFAR-10 上从头训练的 Vision Transformer 上，投影梯度下降（PGD）得到最小 Jacobian Frobenius 却得到最差干净布局分数，而各向同性编码器匹配（isotropic encoder matching）取得最好布局分数。
Motivation: 现有监督训练不约束表示对 nuisance 方向的敏感度，导致部署时表示漂移；作者希望刻画这一几何盲点，并给出同时维持任务性能与表示几何的方法。
Method: 在标签条件依赖 nuisance 且解码器有限 Lipschitz 的线性高斯模型中证明线性化表示漂移的下界；提出类布局分数（class-layout score）跟踪干净类几何，并研究在任务损失上限下、对高斯 delta 惩罚 phi(x) 与 phi(x+delta) 平方距离的各向同性编码器匹配。
Result: 线性高斯情形下的漂移下界得到证明；CIFAR-10 上从头训练的 ViT 中，PGD 取得最小 Jacobian Frobenius 却得到最差干净布局分数（1.353±0.020，三 seeds），高于仅任务训练（1.093），而各向同性匹配最优（0.904）。
Conclusion: 作者提出的设计规则是：报告任务分数的同时报告类布局几何，在 nuisance 轴未知时优先采用各向同性编码器匹配；深度网络结果与跨任务排序属于协议经验，强结论限于线性高斯情况。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: MoDAl: Self-Supervised Neural Modality Discovery via Decorrelation for Speech Neuroprosthesis
papers.abstract_en: Speech neuroprosthesis systems decode intended speech from neural activity in the absence of audible output, offering a path to restoring communication for individuals with speech-impairing conditions. Current approaches decode predominantly from motor cortical areas, discarding others -- such as area 44, part of Broca's area -- that may encode complementary linguistic information. We introduce MoDAl (Modality Decorrelation and Alignment), a framework that discovers complementary neural modalities through the interplay of two objectives in a shared projection space. A contrastive loss aligns each of several parallel brain encoders with the text embeddings of a pretrained large language model (LLM), while a decorrelation loss prevents the encoders from coalescing to duplicative representations. We prove that these objectives are in productive tension: Contrastive alignment induces transitive modality coalescence, which decorrelation must counteract for the framework to discover diverse neurolinguistic modalities. On the Brain-to-Text Benchmark '24, MoDAl reduces word error rate (WER) from 26.3% to 21.6% compared to the previous best end-to-end method, with the gain from incorporating previously discarded area 44 signals arising entirely from the decorrelation mechanism. Analysis of the discovered modalities reveals functional specialization: Encoders receiving area 44 input capture structural and syntactic properties (sentence length, grammatical voice, wh-words), consistent with the neurolinguistic understanding of Broca's area.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MoDAl（Modality Decorrelation and Alignment），一种用于语音神经假体 (speech neuroprosthesis) 的自监督框架，通过对比对齐与去相关的联合目标发现互补的神经模态。在 Brain-to-Text Benchmark '24 上，该方法将词错误率 (WER) 从 26.3% 降至 21.6%，优于此前最好的端到端方法，且纳入此前被丢弃的 area 44 信号带来的增益完全来自去相关机制。对发现模态的分析显示功能特化：接收 area 44 输入的编码器捕获句子长度、语法语态、wh-词等结构与句法属性。
Motivation: 现有语音神经假体主要从运动皮层区域解码，丢弃了 area 44（布罗卡区的一部分）等可能编码互补语言信息的脑区，因此需要一种能够自动发现并利用互补神经模态的框架。
Method: 在共享投影空间中引入两个目标的相互作用：对比损失 (contrastive loss) 将若干并行的脑编码器与预训练大语言模型 (LLM) 的文本嵌入对齐，而去相关损失 (decorrelation loss) 阻止编码器收敛到重复表示。作者还证明了这两个目标存在建设性张力：对比对齐会诱发传递性模态融合 (transitive modality coalescence)，去相关必须对此进行抵消才能发现多样的神经语言学模态。
Result: 在 Brain-to-Text Benchmark '24 上，MoDAl 将词错误率从 26.3% 降至 21.6%，优于此前最好的端到端方法；来自被丢弃的 area 44 信号的增益完全由去相关机制贡献。模态分析表明编码器出现功能特化，area 44 输入对应结构性与句法属性（句子长度、语法语态、wh-词），与布罗卡区的神经语言学认识一致。
Conclusion: 摘要强调去相关机制是从额外脑区发现多样性神经语言学模态并提升解码性能的关键；该工作聚焦于语音神经假体场景下的脑-文本解码，摘要未讨论其他任务或模态的适用性及局限。

papers.title: Text Steganography with Dynamic Codebook and Multimodal Large Language Model
papers.abstract_en: With the popularity of the large language models (LLMs), text steganography has achieved remarkable performance. However, existing methods still have some issues: (1) For the white-box paradigm, this steganography behavior is prone to exposure due to sharing the off-the-shelf language model between Alice and Bob. (2) For the black-box paradigm, these methods lack flexibility and practicality since Alice and Bob should share the fixed codebook while sharing a specific extraction prompt for each steganographic sentence. In order to improve the security and practicality, we introduce a black-box text steganography with a dynamic codebook and multimodal large language model. Specifically, we first construct a dynamic codebook via some shared session configuration and a multimodal large language model. Then an encrypted steganographic mapping is designed to embed secret messages during the steganographic text generation. Furthermore, we introduce a feedback optimization mechanism based on reject sampling to ensure accurate extraction of secret messages. Experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms existing white-box text steganography methods in terms of embedding capacity and text quality. Meanwhile, the proposed method has achieved better practicality and flexibility than the existing black-box paradigm in some popular online social networks.

Result: 实验结果显示，该方法在嵌入容量和文本质量上优于现有白盒文本隐写方法，并在一些流行在线社交网络上比现有黑盒范式具有更好的实用性和灵活性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调动态码本与多模态大语言模型结合可提升黑盒文本隐写的安全性和实用性，但未给出具体量化数值或讨论局限。

papers.title: DVAR: Adversarial Multi-Agent Debate for Video Authenticity Detection
papers.abstract_en: The rapid evolution of video generation technologies poses a significant challenge to media forensics, as conventional detection methods often fail to generalize beyond their training distributions. To address this, we propose DVAR (Debate-based Video Authenticity Reasoning), a training-free framework that reformulates video detection as a structured multi-agent forensic reasoning process. Moving beyond the paradigm of pattern matching, DVAR orchestrates a competition between a Generative Hypothesis Agent and a Natural Mechanism Agent. Through iterative rounds of cross-examination, these agents defend their respective explanations against abnormal evidence, driving a logical convergence where the truth emerges from rigorous stress-testing. To adjudicate these conflicting claims, we apply Occam's Razor through the Minimum Description Length (MDL) framework, defining an Explanatory Cost to quantify the "logical burden" of each reasoning path. Furthermore, we integrate GenVideoKB, a dynamic knowledge repository that provides high-level reasoning heuristics on generative boundaries and failure modes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DVAR achieves competitive performance against supervised state-of-the-art methods while exhibiting superior generalization to unseen generative architectures. By transforming detection into a transparent debate, DVAR provides explicit, interpretable reasoning traces for robust video authenticity assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DVAR（Debate-based Video Authenticity Reasoning），一个免训练框架，将视频真实性检测重构为结构化的多智能体取证推理过程。框架让 Generative Hypothesis Agent 与 Natural Mechanism Agent 进行多轮交叉盘问，并借助最小描述长度（MDL）框架下的解释代价来裁决冲突主张，同时集成动态知识库 GenVideoKB 提供高层推理启发。实验表明 DVAR 与有监督最先进方法性能相当，并在未见过的生成架构上展现出更强的泛化能力。
Motivation: 视频生成技术快速演进，传统取证方法往往难以泛化到训练分布以外的场景；需要超越模式匹配、具备可解释性和鲁棒性的检测途径。
Method: 将检测建模为生成假设与自然机制两类智能体之间的对抗性辩论，通过迭代交叉质询对异常证据的各自解释进行压力测试；采用奥卡姆剃刀原则，用 MDL 定义解释代价来量化每条推理路径的逻辑负担；并引入 GenVideoKB 提供生成边界与失效模式的高层启发式知识。
Result: 摘要报告 DVAR 在多个基准上取得与有监督最先进方法相当的性能，同时对未见生成架构表现出更优的泛化，并且推理过程带有显式、可解释的追踪痕迹。
Conclusion: 作者主张把检测转化为透明的辩论过程能够为鲁棒的视频真实性评估提供可解释的推理轨迹；论文为会议短文（9 页），未提及真实视频与生成视频数据集的细节。

papers.title: SCD4VPR: Multi-modal Scene Change Detection for Long-term Visual Place Recognition Database Update
papers.abstract_en: Long-term autonomy in mobile robotics requires maps that remain accurate as environments change over time. Visual Place Recognition (VPR), a core localization capability, degrades sharply as the temporal gap between query and database images grows, particularly across seasonal transitions. Scene Change Detection (SCD) offers a principled mechanism for database maintenance, but existing methods rely on binary, uni-modal visual features that cannot distinguish structural changes from viewpoint-induced differences - a distinction essential for correct update decisions. We propose SCD4VPR, a scene change detection that jointly reasons about what has changed and distinguishes genuine change from viewpoint-induced difference in a unified vision-language framework. SCD4VPR fuses VLM-generated semantic descriptions with visual features via cross-modal attention and refines predictions with geometric-semantic matching, producing multi-class change masks that separately identify object changes, appearance changes, and viewpoint-induced changes. We introduce NYC-CD, the first real-world street-view SCD benchmark with pixel-level multi-class annotations across 8,122 image pairs. Experiments across four SCD benchmarks show that SCD4VPR consistently improves three architecturally distinct backbones. In a controlled VPR database maintenance experiment on NYU-VPR spanning summer through late winter, we confirm that retrieval performance deteriorates substantially when the database is left unchanged, and show that SCD4VPR-guided updates recover most of this loss (+30.1 R@1 at the largest time gap) while keeping the database far more compact than naive append.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SCD4VPR，一种在统一视觉-语言框架下进行多模态场景变化检测（SCD）的方法，用于长期视觉地点识别（VPR）的数据库维护。该方法融合 VLM 生成的语义描述与视觉特征，通过跨模态注意力并辅以几何-语义匹配，输出多类变化掩码，区分物体变化、外观变化和视角引起的变化。作者还引入 NYC-CD，首个含像素级多类标注的真实街景 SCD 基准（8122 图像对）；在四个 SCD 基准上的实验显示 SCD4VPR 能一致提升三种架构不同的骨干网络。在 NYU-VPR 的受控数据库维护实验中，SCD4VPR 指导的更新在最大时间间隔下恢复大部分检索性能损失（+30.1 R@1），并使数据库远比朴素追加紧凑。
Motivation: 长期自主移动机器人要求地图随时间保持准确，而 VPR 在查询与数据库图像时间间隔增大、尤其跨季节时性能显著下降。现有 SCD 方法依赖二值、单模态视觉特征，无法区分结构性变化与视角差异，而这一区分对数据库更新决策至关重要。
Method: 提出 SCD4VPR，将 VLM 生成的语义描述与视觉特征在跨模态注意力中融合，并通过几何-语义匹配细化预测，生成多类变化掩码，分别标识物体变化、外观变化和视角引起的变化。同时构建 NYC-CD，首个带像素级多类标注的真实街景 SCD 基准，包含 8122 对图像。
Result: 在四个 SCD 基准上，SCD4VPR 一致提升了三种架构不同的骨干网络。在 NYU-VPR 从夏季到深冬的受控数据库维护实验中，数据库保持不变时检索性能大幅下降；SCD4VPR 指导的更新在最大时间间隔下恢复了大部分损失（+30.1 R@1），同时数据库规模远小于朴素追加方案。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将场景变化检测从二值分类推进到能区分视角差异的多类检测，可以有效支撑 VPR 长期数据库维护；NYC-CD 基准和视觉-语言融合框架为后续数据库更新研究提供了基础。摘要未详细说明方法与基准的局限性。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Are Pretrained Image Matchers Good Enough for SAR-Optical Satellite Registration?
papers.abstract_en: Cross-modal optical--SAR (Synthetic Aperture Radar) registration is a bottleneck in remote-sensing disaster response. Modern image matchers are developed and benchmarked almost exclusively on natural-image domains. We evaluate twenty-four pretrained matcher configurations in a zero-shot setting, with no fine-tuning or domain adaptation on satellite or SAR data. The evaluation spans SpaceNet9 and two additional cross-modal benchmarks under a deterministic protocol that uses tiled large-image inference, robust geometric filtering, and tie-point-grounded metrics. Our results show uneven transfer: matchers with explicit cross-modal training do not uniformly outperform those without it. XoFTR (trained for visible--thermal matching) and RoMa achieve the lowest reported mean tie-point error at $3.0$ px on the labeled SpaceNet9 training scenes. RoMa achieves this result \emph{without any cross-modal training}. MatchAnything-ELoFTR ($3.4$ px), trained on synthetic cross-modal pairs, is close behind. XoFTR also runs roughly an order of magnitude faster than the RoMa family ($0.4$ s vs. $5.0$ s per pair). RoMa's performance is consistent with the hypothesis that frozen DINOv2 features confer robustness to large appearance shifts. Deployment protocol choices (geometry model, tile size, inlier gating) change mean error by up to $33\times$ for a single matcher. This shift can exceed the effect of swapping matchers within our evaluated protocol ablations. Affine geometry alone reduces mean error from $12.3$ to $9.7$ px.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估二十四组预训练图像匹配器在零样本设置下对光学-SAR 跨模态配准的表现，不进行任何微调或域自适应。在 SpaceNet9 及两个额外跨模态基准上，XoFTR（可见光-热成像训练）与 RoMa 达到最低的平均 tie-point 误差 3.0 px，其中 RoMa 并未经过跨模态训练；XoFTR 速度明显更快（每对 0.4 s vs. RoMa 5.0 s）。研究还发现部署协议的选择（几何模型、tile 大小、内点门控）对误差的影响可超过更换匹配器本身。
Motivation: 光学-SAR 配准是遥感灾害响应的瓶颈，而现代图像匹配器几乎只在自然图像域上开发和评测，缺少对跨模态遥感的零样本迁移能力的系统评估。
Method: 采用确定性评估协议：tiled 大图推理、鲁棒几何滤波、基于 tie-point 的度量，在零样本（无微调、无域自适应）条件下评测二十四组预训练匹配器配置，并额外进行协议消融以分离匹配器与部署策略的影响。
Result: 跨模态迁移效果不均匀，显式跨模态训练的匹配器并非一致优于未训练的；XoFTR 和 RoMa 达到 3.0 px 的平均 tie-point 误差，RoMa 无需跨模态训练，MatchAnything-ELoFTR 为 3.4 px；XoFTR 约比 RoMa 快一个数量级。协议选择可导致单匹配器平均误差最多变化 33 倍，仅更换为仿射几何即可将平均误差从 12.3 px 降至 9.7 px。
Conclusion: 预训练匹配器在光学-SAR 配准上存在不均匀迁移，RoMa 的表现支持冻结 DINOv2 特征对大幅外观变化具有鲁棒性的假设；同时部署协议的选择对最终误差影响显著，应在评估和应用中同样重视。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Ge$^\text{2}$mS-T: Multi-Dimensional Grouping for Ultra-High Energy Efficiency in Spiking Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer superior energy efficiency over Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs). However, they encounter significant deficiencies in training and inference metrics when applied to Spiking Vision Transformers (S-ViTs). Existing paradigms including ANN-SNN Conversion and Spatial-Temporal Backpropagation (STBP) suffer from inherent limitations, precluding concurrent optimization of memory, accuracy and energy consumption. To address these issues, we propose Ge$^\text{2}$mS-T, a novel architecture implementing grouped computation across temporal, spatial and network structure dimensions. Specifically, we introduce the Grouped-Exponential-Coding-based IF (ExpG-IF) model, enabling lossless conversion with constant training overhead and precise regulation for spike patterns. Additionally, we develop Group-wise Spiking Self-Attention (GW-SSA) to reduce computational complexity via multi-scale token grouping and multiplication-free operations within a hybrid attention-convolution framework. Experiments confirm that our method can achieve superior performance with ultra-high energy efficiency on challenging benchmarks. To our best knowledge, this is the first work to systematically establish multi-dimensional grouped computation for resolving the triad of memory overhead, learning capability and energy budget in S-ViTs. Code is available at https://github.com/hzc1208/Ge2mST.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Ge^2mS-T，一种在时间、空间和网络结构三个维度进行分组计算的脉冲视觉 Transformer (S-ViT) 新架构，目标是一并优化内存开销、学习能力和能量消耗。方法包括基于分组指数编码的 IF 模型 (ExpG-IF) 以实现无损转换，以及面向分组的脉冲自注意力 (GW-SSA) 通过多尺度 token 分组和免乘法运算降低计算复杂度。摘要称实验在多个挑战性基准上取得了优越性能和超高能效，且称这是首个系统建立多维分组计算来解决 S-ViT 中内存、学习与能量三难问题的工作。
Motivation: SNN 相比 ANN 具有能效优势，但在 Spiking Vision Transformers 上训练和推理指标显著不足；现有 ANN-SNN Conversion 与 STBP 等方法存在固有局限，无法同时优化内存、精度和能耗。
Method: 提出 Ge^2mS-T 架构，在时间、空间和网络结构维度上实现分组计算 (grouped computation)；引入 Grouped-Exponential-Coding-based IF (ExpG-IF) 模型，支持恒定训练开销下的无损转换并精确调控脉冲模式；开发 Group-wise Spiking Self-Attention (GW-SSA)，在混合 attention-convolution 框架中通过多尺度 token 分组和免乘法操作降低计算复杂度。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在挑战性基准上取得卓越性能与超高能效，但未给出具体数值或数据集名称。
Conclusion: 作者强调这是首个系统性建立多维分组计算以解决 S-ViT 中内存开销、学习能力和能量预算三难问题的工作，代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Impact of Dimensionality on the Stability of Node Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Previous work has shown that node embedding methods can produce different representations and downstream predictions across repeated training runs, even when trained on the same data with identical hyperparameters. However, the role of embedding dimensionality in this instability remains poorly understood. In this work, we systematically analyze how embedding dimensionality affects the stability of embeddings from five widely used node embedding methods: ASNE, DGI, GraphSAGE, node2vec, and VERSE. We evaluate stability from both representational and functional perspectives across a broad range of dimensions, datasets, and repeated training runs, and relate the resulting stability patterns to predictive performance. Our results show that dimensionality can substantially affect embedding stability, although the observed effects depend strongly on the embedding method and stability notion considered. While node2vec and ASNE generally became more stable at higher dimensions, GraphSAGE and VERSE often exhibited non-monotonic behavior or decreasing stability. We further find that dimensions associated with high stability do not necessarily coincide with those yielding the strongest downstream performance. Overall, our findings demonstrate that embedding dimensionality can have a substantial impact on the stability of node embeddings and downstream predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究嵌入维度对节点嵌入稳定性的影响，针对 ASNE、DGI、GraphSAGE、node2vec 和 VERSE 五种常用方法，在多种维度、数据集和重复训练次数下，从表示层面和功能层面评估稳定性，并将其与下游预测性能关联。结果表明，维度对嵌入稳定性有显著影响，但效应强烈依赖具体方法和稳定性定义。
Motivation: 已有工作表明节点嵌入方法在相同数据和超参数下重复训练会产生不同表示和下游预测，但嵌入维度在这一不稳定现象中的作用尚未被充分理解。
Method: 对五种节点嵌入方法在广泛维度范围内进行系统分析，从表示稳定性和功能稳定性两个视角，结合多个数据集和重复训练运行评估，并将稳定性模式与预测性能相关联。
Result: 维度可显著影响嵌入稳定性：node2vec 和 ASNE 通常在更高维度下变得更稳定，而 GraphSAGE 和 VERSE 常呈现非单调行为或稳定性下降；高稳定性对应的维度并不一定与最强下游性能的维度一致。
Conclusion: 嵌入维度对节点嵌入及其下游预测的稳定性具有实质性影响，但具体效应取决于嵌入方法和所采用的稳定性度量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond Adoption Intention How Trust in Augmented Analytics Relates to Perceived Decision Quality Among Non-Technical BI Users
papers.abstract_en: Augmented analytics has transformed how Business Intelligence (BI) systems support decision-making, shifting non-technical managers from manual analysis toward dependence on automated insights. Current BI research often overlooks the cognitive mechanisms and the direct impact of AI-enabled analytics on decision quality. This study employs the theory of cognitive delegation to investigate the association between trust in augmented analytics and perceived decision quality among non-technical BI users. Data were collected from 250 business professionals across various organizational roles in Vietnam between January and March 2025 and analyzed using partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM). Findings indicate that augmented analytics capabilities are positively associated with perceived ease of use, usefulness, and trust in BI systems. Trust and usefulness are jointly associated with BI adoption intention and perceived decision quality. Notably, trust is positively related to perceived decision quality, as observed within the studied sample of non-specialist users. By framing augmented analytics as cognitive delegation, this study expands BI adoption research to include perceived decision outcomes and contributes to the understanding of human-AI interaction in organizations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以认知委托（cognitive delegation）理论为框架，研究非技术性 BI 用户对增强分析（augmented analytics）的信任与感知决策质量之间的关系。作者基于 2025 年 1 至 3 月在越南收集的 250 名企业专业人士问卷数据，使用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）进行分析。结果显示增强分析能力与感知易用性、感知有用性和对 BI 系统的信任正相关；信任和有用性共同关联于 BI 采纳意向，且信任与感知决策质量正相关。
Motivation: 现有 BI 研究常忽略 AI 驱动的分析如何通过认知机制直接影响决策质量，尤其是对非技术管理者的影响，本文试图填补这一空白。
Method: 采用认知委托理论构建研究模型，通过问卷调查收集 250 名越南不同组织角色的商业专业人士数据，并运用 PLS-SEM 进行假设检验。
Result: 增强分析能力与感知易用性、有用性及对 BI 系统的信任正相关；信任和有用性共同与 BI 采纳意向和感知决策质量相关；在研究样本中，信任与感知决策质量正相关。
Conclusion: 作者认为将增强分析视为认知委托可以扩展 BI 采纳研究，使其涵盖感知决策结果，并有助于理解组织中的人机交互；研究基于非专业用户样本，结论需在该范围内解释。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Parameter-Efficient Semantic Augmentation for Enhancing Open-Vocabulary Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVOD) enables models to detect any object category, including unseen ones. Benefiting from large-scale pre-training, existing OVOD methods achieve strong detection performance on general scenarios (e.g., OV-COCO) but suffer severe performance drops when transferred to downstream tasks with substantial domain shifts. This degradation stems from the scarcity and weak semantics of category labels in domain-specific task, as well as the inability of existing models to capture auxiliary semantics beyond coarse-grained category label. To address these issues, we propose HSA-DINO, a parameter-efficient semantic augmentation framework for enhancing open-vocabulary object detection. Specifically, we propose a multi-scale prompt bank that leverages image feature pyramids to capture hierarchical semantics and select domain-specific local semantic prompts, progressively enriching textual representations from coarse to fine-grained levels. Furthermore, we introduce a semantic-aware router that dynamically selects the appropriate semantic augmentation strategy during inference, thereby preventing parameter updates from degrading the generalization ability of the pre-trained OVOD model. We evaluate HSA-DINO on OV-COCO, several vertical domain datasets, and modified benchmark settings. The results show that HSA-DINO performs favorably against previous state-of-the-art methods, achieving a superior trade-off between domain adaptability and open-vocabulary generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HSA-DINO，一个针对开放词汇目标检测 (open-vocabulary object detection, OVOD) 的参数高效语义增强框架。其核心是引入多尺度提示库 (multi-scale prompt bank)，利用图像特征金字塔捕获层级语义并选择领域特定的局部语义提示，从粗粒度到细粒度逐步丰富文本表示；同时提出语义感知路由器 (semantic-aware router)，在推理时动态选择语义增强策略，避免参数更新损害预训练模型的泛化能力。摘要报告在 OV-COCO、多个垂直领域数据集及修改的基准设置上，HSA-DINO 优于先前 SOTA 方法，在领域适应性与开放词汇泛化之间取得更优权衡。
Motivation: 现有 OVOD 方法凭借大规模预训练在通用场景（如 OV-COCO）表现良好，但在存在显著领域漂移的下游任务上性能大幅下降。摘要将其归因于领域特定任务中类别标签稀少且语义弱，以及现有模型难以捕获粗粒度类别标签之外的辅助语义。
Method: 提出 HSA-DINO 参数高效语义增强框架：一方面构建多尺度提示库，基于图像特征金字塔选择领域特定的局部语义提示，逐步从粗到细丰富文本表示；另一方面引入语义感知路由器，在推理阶段动态选择合适的语义增强策略，从而防止参数更新破坏预训练 OVOD 模型的泛化能力。
Result: 在 OV-COCO、多个垂直领域数据集以及修改的基准设置上进行评估，HSA-DINO 的性能优于此前的最先进方法，实现了领域适应性与开放词汇泛化之间更优的权衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，参数高效的语义增强能够在保持预训练模型泛化能力的前提下提升领域适应性，为 OVOD 在领域漂移场景下的性能下降问题提供了一种有效方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SODA: Semi On-Policy Black-Box Distillation for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Black-box knowledge distillation for large language models presents a strict trade-off. Simple off-policy methods (e.g., sequence-level knowledge distillation) struggle to correct the student's inherent errors. Fully on-policy methods (e.g., Generative Adversarial Distillation) solve this via adversarial training but introduce well-known training instability and crippling computational overhead. To address this dilemma, we propose SODA (Semi On-policy Distillation with Alignment), a highly efficient alternative motivated by the inherent capability gap between frontier teachers and much smaller base models. Because a compact student model's natural, zero-shot responses are almost strictly inferior to the powerful teacher's targets, we can construct a highly effective contrastive signal simply by pairing the teacher's optimal response with a one-time static snapshot of the student's outputs. This demonstrates that exposing the small student to its own static inferior behaviors is sufficient for high-quality distribution alignment, eliminating the need for costly dynamic rollouts and fragile adversarial balancing. Extensive evaluations across four compact Qwen2.5 and Llama-3 models validate this semi on-policy paradigm. SODA matches or outperforms the state-of-the-art methods on 15 out of 16 benchmark results. More importantly, it achieves this superior distillation quality while training 10 times faster, consuming 27% less peak GPU memory, and completely eliminating adversarial instability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SODA（Semi On-policy Distillation with Alignment），一种面向大型语言模型的黑盒知识蒸馏方法。其核心思路是：由于小型学生模型的零样本输出几乎严格劣于强教师模型，只需将教师的最优响应与学生的一次性静态输出快照配对，即可构造对比信号完成分布对齐，从而避免全 on-policy 方法（如对抗式蒸馏）的动态采样开销与训练不稳定。实验覆盖 Qwen2.5 和 Llama-3 系列共四个紧凑模型，在 16 项基准中 15 项达到或超过现有最佳方法，同时训练速度提升 10 倍、峰值显存降低 27%，且完全消除对抗不稳定。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 黑盒蒸馏存在严格权衡：off-policy 方法（如序列级知识蒸馏）难以纠正学生模型自身的错误，而完全 on-policy 方法（如生成对抗蒸馏）虽能解决问题，却带来训练不稳定和极高的计算开销。本文旨在消除这一困境。
Method: 提出半 on-policy 蒸馏范式 SODA：利用前沿教师与小型学生模型之间固有的能力差距，将教师的最优响应与学生模型一次生成的静态输出快照配对，构造对比信号（contrastive signal）指导对齐，无需动态 rollout 或对抗平衡。
Result: 在四个紧凑的 Qwen2.5 和 Llama-3 模型上的广泛评估中，SODA 在 16 项基准结果中的 15 项达到或超越现有最佳方法；同时训练速度提升 10 倍，峰值 GPU 内存消耗降低 27%，并完全消除了对抗不稳定。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将小型学生模型暴露于其自身的静态劣质行为足以实现高质量的分布对齐，这验证了半 on-policy 蒸馏范式的高效性与实用性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在四个紧凑的 Qwen2.5 和 Llama-3 模型上的广泛评估中，SODA 在 16 项基准结果中的 15 项达到或超越现有最佳方法；同时训练速度提升 10 倍，峰值 GPU 内存消耗降低 27%，并完全消除了对抗不稳定。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，将小型学生模型暴露于其自身的静态劣质行为足以实现高质量的分布对齐，这验证了半 on-policy 蒸馏范式的高效性与实用性。

papers.title: CREBench: Evaluating Large Language Models in Cryptographic Binary Reverse Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Reverse engineering (RE) is central to software security, particularly for cryptographic programs that handle sensitive data and are highly prone to vulnerabilities. It supports critical tasks such as vulnerability discovery and malware analysis. Despite its importance, RE remains labor-intensive and requires substantial expertise, making large language models (LLMs) a potential solution for automating the process. However, their capabilities for RE remain systematically underexplored. To address this gap, we study the cryptographic binary RE capabilities of LLMs and introduce CREBench, a benchmark comprising 432 challenges built from 48 standard cryptographic algorithms, 3 insecure crypto key usage scenarios, and 3 difficulty levels. Each challenge follows a Capture-the-Flag (CTF) RE challenge, requiring the model to analyze the underlying cryptographic logic and recover the correct input. We design an evaluation framework comprising four sub-tasks, from algorithm identification to correct flag recovery. We evaluate eight frontier LLMs on CREBench. GPT-5.4, the best-performing model, achieves 64.03 out of 100 and recovers the flag in 59\% of challenges. We also establish a strong human expert baseline of 92.19 points, showing that humans maintain an advantage in cryptographic RE tasks. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/wangyu-ovo/CREBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CREBench，一个用于评估大语言模型在密码学二进制逆向工程（cryptographic binary reverse engineering）能力的基准。基准包含 432 个挑战，覆盖 48 种标准密码算法、3 种不安全密钥使用场景和 3 个难度等级，并设计从算法识别到正确 flag 恢复的四类子任务。评测显示最佳模型 GPT-5.4 得分为 64.03/100，而人类专家基准为 92.19 分。
Motivation: 逆向工程对软件安全至关重要，尤其是处理敏感数据且易受漏洞影响的密码程序，但该过程劳动密集且需要大量专业知识。尽管 LLM 可能自动化该过程，其密码学二进制逆向能力仍缺乏系统性研究。
Method: 构建 CREBench 基准，包含 432 个基于 CTF 风格的挑战，并设计包含算法识别到正确 flag 恢复的四子任务评估框架，用于评测 LLM 分析底层密码逻辑并恢复正确输入的能力。
Result: 对八个前沿 LLM 的评测中，最佳模型 GPT-5.4 得分 64.03/100，并在 59% 的挑战中恢复 flag；人类专家基准得分为 92.19 分，表明人类在密码学逆向任务上仍具优势。
Conclusion: 作者认为该基准揭示了当前 LLM 在密码学二进制逆向中的能力不足，人类仍保持明显优势；代码和数据集已公开。

papers.title: TRU: Targeted Reverse Update for Efficient Multimodal Recommendation Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal recommendation systems (MRS) jointly model user-item interaction graphs and rich item content, but this tight coupling makes user data difficult to remove once learned. Approximate machine unlearning offers an efficient alternative to full retraining, yet current MRS unlearning applies reverse updates largely uniformly across model components. We show that this uniform treatment is misaligned with modern MRS: deleted-data influence is distributed unevenly across \textit{ranking behavior}, \textit{modality branches}, and \textit{model modules}. This non-uniformity gives rise to three bottlenecks in MRS unlearning: target-item persistence in the collaborative graph, modality imbalance across feature branches, and concentrated module-level sensitivity in the parameter space. To address this mismatch, we propose \textbf{targeted reverse update} (TRU), a plug-and-play unlearning framework for MRS. Instead of applying a uniform global reversal, TRU performs three coordinated interventions across the model hierarchy: a ranking fusion gate to suppress residual target-item influence in ranking, branch-wise modality scaling to preserve retained multimodal representations, and capacity-aware parameter-group selection to localize reverse updates to deletion-sensitive modules. Across two backbones, three datasets, and three unlearning regimes, TRU achieves a stronger retain--forget trade-off than MMRecUn in most settings. In two challenging user-level cases, TRU also attains favorable operating points among all evaluated baselines. Security audits report the lowest MIA BalAcc and a tie for the lowest ASR among approximate methods in both audited settings, while wall-clock trajectories show earlier convergence to favorable retain--forget regions.
papers.comment: Author Accepted Manuscript. Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM '26). This author-created manuscript is not the ACM Version of Record
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TRU（targeted reverse update），一个用于多模态推荐系统（MRS）的即插即用近似机器遗忘（approximate machine unlearning）框架。作者指出当前 MRS 遗忘方法对模型组件施加近似均匀的反向更新，而删除数据的影响在排序行为、模态分支和模型模块上分布不均，因此 TRU 在模型层级实施三项协调干预：排序融合门（ranking fusion gate）、分支级模态缩放（branch-wise modality scaling）和容量感知的参数组选择（capacity-aware parameter-group selection）。实验在两个骨干网络、三个数据集和三种遗忘机制下，TRU 比 MMRecUn 在多数设置下取得更强的保留-遗忘权衡，并在安全审计中取得最低的 MIA BalAcc 和并列最低的 ASR。
Motivation: 现代 MRS 将用户-物品交互图与丰富物品内容紧密耦合，导致学习后的用户数据难以移除；现有近似遗忘方法对模型各组件施加大致均匀的反向更新，但这种统一处理与 MRS 中删除数据影响的不均匀分布不匹配，造成协同图中目标物品残留、特征分支间模态不平衡和参数空间中模块级敏感度集中三个瓶颈。
Method: 提出 TRU，一个即插即用的 MRS 遗忘框架，用三种协调干预替代统一全局反向更新：ranking fusion gate 抑制排序结果中残留的目标物品影响；branch-wise modality scaling 保护被保留的多模态表示；capacity-aware parameter-group selection 将反向更新定位到对删除敏感的参数组。
Result: 在两个骨干网络、三个数据集和三种遗忘机制下，TRU 在大多数设置中比 MMRecUn 取得更强的 retain–forget 权衡；在两个具有挑战性的用户级场景中，TRU 还达到了优于所有评估基线的操作点。安全审计在两个被审计设置下报告了近似方法中最低的 MIA BalAcc 以及并列最低的 ASR，墙钟时间轨迹显示其更早收敛到有利的 retain–forget 区域。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将反向更新与 MRS 的层级结构（排序、模态分支、参数组）对齐可显著改善遗忘的保留-遗忘权衡与安全性，TRU 可作为即插即用模块嵌入现有多模态推荐系统；摘要未讨论明显局限。

papers.title: Look Twice: Training-Free Evidence Highlighting for Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering (KB-VQA) requires Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to identify and combine fine-grained visual cues with retrieved textual evidence. However, retrieval often introduces noisy and partially relevant content, while images contain distracting visual regions, causing pretrained MLLMs to overlook the evidence that actually supports the answer. To address this, we introduce Look Twice (LoT), a training-free inference-time framework that turns the model's own internal attention into an explicit multimodal evidence-selection mechanism. LoT first leverages the model's internal attention patterns to identify query-relevant image regions and textual sentences, filters attention sinks and distracting content, and reformulates the input to explicitly highlight the selected evidence before answer generation. The method requires no parameter updates, auxiliary models, or architectural modifications. Across four KB-VQA benchmarks and ten off-the-shelf MLLMs ranging from 2B to 38B parameters, LoT improves every evaluated backbone, with average gains of up to +12.5 accuracy points. It also provides further gains when combined with established context-refinement strategies, yielding additional improvements over already refined inputs. These results establish LoT as a general and effective mechanism for enabling pretrained MLLMs to exploit available multimodal evidence more accurately. Source code is publicly available at https://aimagelab.github.io/LoT/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Look Twice (LoT)，一种无需训练、推理时运行的框架，将模型自身内部注意力转化为显式的多模态证据选择机制。它先利用注意力模式识别与问题相关的图像区域和文本句子，过滤注意力汇聚点与干扰内容，再重构输入以突出所选证据后进行答案生成。在四个 KB-VQA 基准和十个参数量从 2B 到 38B 的现成 MLLM 上，LoT 改进了所有评估骨干，平均最高提升 12.5 个准确率点，并与既有上下文精炼策略叠加时获得额外增益。
Motivation: 知识型视觉问答 (KB-VQA) 中，检索常引入噪声和部分相关的内容，而图像包含干扰视觉区域，导致预训练 MLLM 忽略真正支撑答案的证据。
Method: LoT 利用模型内部注意力模式识别查询相关的图像区域和文本句子，过滤注意力汇聚点 (attention sinks) 和干扰内容，并在答案生成前显式重构输入以突出所选证据。该方法无需参数更新、辅助模型或架构修改。
Result: 在四个 KB-VQA 基准和十个从 2B 到 38B 参数规模的现成 MLLM 上，LoT 对每个评估骨干都有改进，平均增益最高达 +12.5 准确率点；与既有上下文精炼策略结合时还能在已精炼输入之上继续提升。
Conclusion: 摘要将 LoT 确立为通用且有效的机制，可使预训练 MLLM 更准确地利用可用的多模态证据；源代码已公开。

papers.title: Online Reasoning Calibration: Test-Time Training Enables Generalizable Conformal LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: While test-time scaling has enabled large language models to solve highly difficult tasks, state-of-the-art results come at exorbitant compute costs. These inefficiencies can be attributed to the miscalibration of post-trained language models, and the lack of calibration in popular sampling techniques. Here, we present Online Reasoning Calibration (ORCA), a framework for calibrating the sampling process that draws upon conformal prediction and test-time training. Specifically, we introduce a meta-learning procedure that updates the calibration module for each input. This allows us to provide valid confidence estimates under distributional shift, e.g. in thought patterns that occur across different stages of reasoning, or in prompt distributions between model development and deployment. ORCA not only provides theoretical guarantees on conformal risks, but also empirically shows higher efficiency and generalization across different reasoning tasks. At risk level $δ=0.1$, ORCA improves Qwen2.5-32B efficiency on in-distribution tasks with savings up to 47.5% with supervised labels and 40.7% with self-consistency labels. Under zero-shot out-of-domain settings, it improves MATH-500 savings from 24.8% of the static calibration baseline to 67.0% while maintaining a low empirical error rate, and the same trend holds across model families and downstream benchmarks. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/wzekai99/ORCA.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026; 22 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Online Reasoning Calibration (ORCA)，一个结合 conformal prediction 与 test-time training 的推理采样校准框架。ORCA 通过元学习过程为每个输入更新校准模块，从而在分布偏移（如推理阶段思维模式变化或开发与部署间提示分布差异）下提供有效的置信估计，并同时给出 conformal risks 的理论保证和更高的计算效率。实验表明，在风险水平 δ=0.1 下，Qwen2.5-32B 在分布内任务最高节省 47.5% 计算（监督标签）与 40.7%（自一致性标签），零样本域外场景下 MATH-500 的节省从静态校准基线的 24.8% 提升至 67.0%，且保持较低经验错误率。
Motivation: 测试时扩展使大语言模型能解决高难度任务，但最先进结果的计算成本极高；低效源于后训练语言模型的校准不足，以及常用采样技术本身缺乏校准。
Method: 提出 ORCA 框架，用 conformal prediction 与 test-time training 校准采样过程；具体采用元学习过程，对每个输入更新校准模块，以适应推理不同阶段思维模式或提示分布等出现的分布偏移。
Result: 在 δ=0.1 风险水平下，ORCA 使 Qwen2.5-32B 在分布内任务上最多节省 47.5% 计算（使用监督标签）和 40.7%（使用自一致性标签）；零样本域外设置下，MATH-500 节省从静态校准基线的 24.8% 提高到 67.0%，同时保持低经验错误率，且该趋势在多个模型家族与下游基准上一致。
Conclusion: ORCA 不仅提供关于 conformal risks 的理论保证，还在不同推理任务上实证展示了更高的效率与泛化能力，代码已公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DFM-VLA: Iterative Action Refinement for Robot Manipulation via Discrete Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models that encode actions using a discrete tokenization scheme have been widely adopted for robotic manipulation, but existing decoding paradigms remain fundamentally limited. Whether actions are decoded sequentially by autoregressive VLAs or in parallel by discrete diffusion VLAs, once a token is generated, it is typically fixed and cannot be revised in subsequent iterations. Consequently, early token errors cannot be effectively corrected later. We propose DFM-VLA, a discrete flow matching VLA that iteratively refines action tokens. DFM-VLA models a token-level probability velocity field that dynamically updates the full action sequence across refinement iterations. We investigate two approaches to constructing the velocity field: an auxiliary velocity-head formulation and an embedding-guided formulation. To further improve prediction accuracy, we introduce a metric-aligned action tokenizer (MAAT) tailored to the coarse-to-fine nature of DFM, together with a two-stage decoding strategy. Extensive experiments on CALVIN, LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. Our project is available at https://chris1220313648.github.io/DFM-VLA/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DFM-VLA，一种面向机器人操作的动作解码方法，核心是用离散流匹配 (discrete flow matching) 对动作 token 进行迭代细化。与自回归 VLA 或离散扩散 VLA 在生成后固定 token 不同，DFM-VLA 建模 token 级概率速度场，在细化迭代中动态更新完整动作序列。作者还提出面向粗到细细化过程的度量对齐动作 tokenizer (MAAT) 和两阶段解码策略。在 CALVIN、LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 及真实世界操作任务上验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 现有基于离散 token 的视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型在解码时，无论采用自回归还是并行离散扩散方式，一旦 token 生成就固定不可修改，导致早期 token 错误无法在后续迭代中纠正。
Method: 提出 DFM-VLA，通过 token 级概率速度场动态更新完整动作序列，并对比了两种速度场构造方式：辅助速度头 (auxiliary velocity-head) 和嵌入引导 (embedding-guided) 形式。为配合细化过程的粗到细特性，引入度量对齐动作 tokenizer (MAAT)，并设计两阶段解码策略。
Result: 摘要在 CALVIN、LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 和真实世界操作任务上的实验表明该方法有效，但未给出具体量化数值。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，通过离散流匹配对动作 token 进行迭代细化可以改善 VLA 的动作预测，早期 token 错误可被后续迭代修正；该方法面向机器人操作场景。

papers.title: IPV-Bench: Benchmarking Image Protection Methods under Diverse Image-to-Video Generation Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Image-to-video (I2V) generation models can be misused to animate a single image into a convincing fake video, motivating perturbation-based image protection methods that aim to disrupt such generation. Yet these methods remain difficult to compare: they are reported under inconsistent metrics and generation settings, are often validated only on the single generator they were optimized against, and are evaluated on narrow, single-domain image sets that do not reflect real misuse. To address these challenges, we introduce IPV-Bench (Image Protection against Video generation), the first systematic benchmark for image protection in I2V generation scenarios. IPV-Bench couples a unified protocol that jointly scores protection effectiveness, visual fidelity, and robustness to preprocessing attacks together with IPV-500, a prompt-paired dataset spanning five misuse-relevant domains. Based on this benchmark, we evaluate five representative protection methods across four I2V models covering distinct architectures and both open-source and commercial systems. Extensive experiments show a consistently sobering picture: image protection and video disruption trade off against each other, most methods fail to disrupt generation beyond noise, protection rarely transfers across generators, and the few effective cases are broken by simple preprocessing. We further find that image content governs the perceptual cost of protection but not its benefit: no image domain offers an easier target. Overall, IPV-Bench provides a rigorous, reproducible, and extensible foundation for developing protection methods that work in practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IPV-Bench，首个面向图像到视频（I2V）生成场景的图像保护系统化基准，配套统一评测协议和包含五个滥用相关领域的提示配对数据集 IPV-500。作者用该基准评估了五种代表性保护方法和四种架构各异（含开源与商业）的 I2V 模型，结论是图像保护与视频干扰相互权衡、保护极少跨生成器迁移、少数有效案例也会被简单预处理攻破。
Motivation: 现有图像保护方法难以比较：评测指标和生成设置不一致，常只在针对优化的单一生成器上验证，且图像集窄、未反映真实滥用场景，因此需要一个统一、可复现的系统化基准。
Method: 提出 IPV-Bench，包含一个联合评分保护有效性、视觉保真度和对预处理攻击鲁棒性的统一协议，以及一个覆盖五个滥用相关领域、带提示的图像数据集 IPV-500；并基于此对多种保护方法和 I2V 模型进行系统评测。
Result: 实验显示：图像保护与视频干扰之间存在权衡；大多数方法除噪声外无法有效破坏生成；保护效果很少跨生成器迁移；少数有效案例也会被简单预处理破坏。此外，图像内容决定保护的感知代价但不决定其收益，没有哪个图像域更容易被保护。
Conclusion: IPV-Bench 为开发实际可用的图像保护方法提供了严格、可复现且可扩展的评测基础，并揭示了当前保护方法在真实 I2V 场景下的普遍失效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: λSplit: Self-Supervised Content-Aware Spectral Unmixing for Fluorescence Microscopy
papers.abstract_en: In fluorescence microscopy, spectral unmixing aims to recover individual fluorophore concentrations from spectral images that capture mixed fluorophore emissions. Since classical methods operate pixel-wise and rely on least-squares fitting, their performance degrades with increasingly overlapping emission spectra and higher levels of noise, suggesting that a data-driven approach that can learn and utilize a structural prior might lead to improved results. Learning-based approaches for spectral imaging do exist, but they are either not optimized for microscopy data or are developed for very specific cases that are not applicable to fluorescence microscopy settings. To address this, we propose λSplit, a physics-informed deep generative model that learns a conditional distribution over concentration maps using a hierarchical Variational Autoencoder. A fully differentiable Spectral Mixer enforces consistency with the image formation process, while the learned structural priors enable state-of-the-art unmixing and implicit noise removal. We demonstrate λSplit on 3 real-world datasets that we synthetically cast into a total of 66 challenging spectral unmixing benchmarks. We compare our results against a total of 10 baseline methods, including classical methods and a range of learning-based methods. Our results consistently show competitive performance and improved robustness in high noise regimes, when spectra overlap considerably, or when the spectral dimensionality is lowered, making λSplit a new state-of-the-art for spectral unmixing of fluorescent microscopy data. Importantly, λSplit is compatible with spectral data produced by standard confocal microscopes, enabling immediate adoption without specialized hardware modifications.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 λSplit，一个面向荧光显微镜光谱拆分 (spectral unmixing) 的物理信息深度生成模型。模型用分层变分自编码器 (hierarchical VAE) 学习浓度图的条件分布，并通过全可微的 Spectral Mixer 约束其与图像形成过程一致，从而同时实现拆分与隐式去噪。作者在 3 个真实数据集上合成出共 66 个具有挑战性的基准，并与 10 种基线（含经典方法与学习方法）比较，结果显示在高噪声、光谱重叠严重或光谱维度降低时表现更稳健，并宣称达到该任务的新 SOTA。
Motivation: 传统光谱拆分逐像素进行最小二乘拟合，在发射光谱重叠加剧和噪声升高时性能明显下降；现有学习方法要么未针对显微数据优化，要么仅适用于无法推广到荧光显微镜的特殊场景。因此需要一种能够学习并利用结构先验的数据驱动方法。
Method: 提出 λSplit，一种物理信息深度生成模型：以分层 VAE 学习浓度图上的条件分布，并加入全可微的 Spectral Mixer 作为图像形成过程的约束，使生成结果与物理成像模型保持一致，同时利用学习到的结构先验完成拆分和隐式去噪。
Result: 在 3 个真实数据集上构成 66 个光谱拆分基准，与 10 种基线方法相比，λSplit 在整体上具有竞争力的表现，并在高噪声、发射光谱显著重叠以及光谱维度降低等困难条件下展现出更强的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者认为 λSplit 是荧光显微光谱拆分的新 SOTA 方法，且与标准共聚焦显微镜产生的光谱数据兼容，无需专用硬件改动即可直接采用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Communication-Aware Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Decentralized Cooperative UAV Deployment
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) swarms are increasingly used as rapidly deployable aerial relays and sensing platforms, yet practical deployments must operate under partial observability and intermittent peer-to-peer connectivity. We present a graph-based multi-agent reinforcement learning framework trained under centralized training with decentralized execution (CTDE): a centralized critic and global state are available only during training, while each UAV executes a shared policy using local observations and messages from nearby neighbors. Under restricted communication, neighbor relations are induced by an SNR-threshold connectivity graph. Our architecture encodes local agent state and nearby entities with an agent-entity attention module and aggregates inter-UAV messages with neighbor self-attention over a signal-quality-limited communication graph defined by a channel model. We evaluate the framework on a cooperative relay-deployment task, DroneConnect. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves an approximately 12% increase in target coverage over MAPPO under restricted communication and partial observability, while remaining competitive with a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP)-based offline upper bound with full node observability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于图的通信感知多智能体强化学习框架，用于去中心化协同 UAV 部署。框架采用集中训练、去中心化执行（CTDE）范式，训练时使用全局状态与集中式 critic，执行时每个 UAV 仅依据局部观测和邻近节点的消息做出决策，邻接关系由 SNR 阈值连通图定义。在协同中继部署任务 DroneConnect 上，该方法相比 MAPPO 在受限通信与部分可观测条件下将目标覆盖率提升约 12%，并与具有全节点可观测性的 MILP 离线上界保持接近。
Motivation: 实际 UAV 集群部署需要在部分可观测和间歇性对等连接条件下运行，而现有方法往往假设理想的全局信息或不受限通信，缺乏对通信受限场景的显式建模。
Method: 架构包含两个关键模块：用 agent-entity 注意力机制编码局部智能体状态与附近实体，并用邻居自注意力（neighbor self-attention）在由信道模型限定的信号质量受限通信图上聚合 UAV 间消息；训练采用 CTDE，即集中式 critic 与全局状态仅在训练阶段可用。
Result: 在 DroneConnect 协同中继部署任务上，该方法在受限通信和部分可观测条件下相比 MAPPO 提高约 12% 的目标覆盖率，并且与具备全节点可观测性的 MILP 离线上界相比仍具竞争力。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，将通信邻居关系显式编码进策略架构，能够在有限通信条件下显著改善去中心化协同部署性能，并接近全局可观测的离线规划上界。

papers.title: Clinician input steers AI toward accurate and harmful recommendations
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are entering clinical workflows, yet evaluations rarely assess how clinician reasoning shapes model behavior during clinical interactions. Using 61 curated NEJM Case Records, we tested how expert or misleading clinician reasoning influenced AI-generated differential diagnoses and next step recommendations across 21 reasoning variants from 8 proprietary and open-source models. After clinician exposure, LLM-clinician concordance increased: simulations with >=3 overlapping differential diagnoses rose from 65.8% to 93.5%, and those with >=3 overlapping next step recommendations from 20.3% to 53.8%. Expert context significantly improved correct final-diagnosis inclusion in all 21 models (mean +20.4 pp), reflecting both improved reasoning and passive content echoing, while adversarial context significantly degraded performance in 14 models (mean -5.4 pp). Expert context also significantly increased leading-diagnosis accuracy in all 21 models, whereas adversarial context significantly reduced it in 13. Multi-turn disagreement challenges revealed distinct model phenotypes, from highly conformist to dogmatic, with adversarial arguments remaining a vulnerability even in otherwise resilient models. Inference-time scaling reduced harmful echoing of clinician-introduced recommendations across WHO harm-severity tiers by 62.7% for mild, 57.9% for moderate, 76.3% for severe, and 83.5% for death-tier recommendations. Inference-time prompting recovered diagnostic accuracy lost to adversarial context while preserving expert-context benefits across GPT-5, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and Gemini 3 Flash, and sharply reduced highly consistent harmful echoing across severity tiers. These findings provide a foundation for evaluating clinician-AI collaboration and introduce interactive metrics and mitigation strategies essential to safety and robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究临床交互中临床医生的推理如何影响大语言模型（LLM）生成的鉴别诊断与下一步建议。基于61份NEJM病例记录和21种推理变体、8个专有及开源模型，作者发现暴露于临床医生输入后模型与医生的共识度显著上升；专家上下文提升最终诊断包含率，对抗性上下文则显著损害性能。文章还提出推理时扩展（inference-time scaling）与提示策略可减少有害回声（harmful echoing），并引入交互式指标用于评估临床医生-AI协作的安全性与鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有LLM临床评估很少考察临床医生推理在交互过程中如何塑造模型行为，而这类交互在真实临床工作流中不可避免，需要系统评估其安全影响。
Method: 使用61份精选NEJM Case Records，构造21种由专家或误导性临床医生推理构成的变体，测试8个专有与开源模型生成的鉴别诊断和下一步建议；对比暴露前后的一致性，并采用推理时扩展和提示策略来缓解有害回声。
Result: 暴露于临床医生输入后，含≥3个重叠鉴别诊断的模拟从65.8%升至93.5%，含≥3个重叠下一步建议的模拟从20.3%升至53.8%；专家上下文使全部21个模型正确最终诊断包含率平均提高20.4个百分点，对抗性上下文使14个模型平均下降5.4个百分点。推理时扩展将各WHO危害等级的有害回声降低57.9%–83.5%，并在多个模型中恢复被对抗上下文损失的诊断准确性。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些发现为评估临床医生-AI协作提供了基础，并引入交互式指标与缓解策略，强调对安全性和鲁棒性的重要性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究临床交互中临床医生的推理如何影响大语言模型（LLM）生成的鉴别诊断与下一步建议。基于61份NEJM病例记录和21种推理变体、8个专有及开源模型，作者发现暴露于临床医生输入后模型与医生的共识度显著上升；专家上下文提升最终诊断包含率，对抗性上下文则显著损害性能。文章还提出推理时扩展（inference-time scaling）与提示策略可减少有害回声（harmful echoing），并引入交互式指标用于评估临床医生-AI协作的安全性与鲁棒性。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有LLM临床评估很少考察临床医生推理在交互过程中如何塑造模型行为，而这类交互在真实临床工作流中不可避免，需要系统评估其安全影响。
summary_sections.method: 使用61份精选NEJM Case Records，构造21种由专家或误导性临床医生推理构成的变体，测试8个专有与开源模型生成的鉴别诊断和下一步建议；对比暴露前后的一致性，并采用推理时扩展和提示策略来缓解有害回声。
summary_sections.result: 暴露于临床医生输入后，含≥3个重叠鉴别诊断的模拟从65.8%升至93.5%，含≥3个重叠下一步建议的模拟从20.3%升至53.8%；专家上下文使全部21个模型正确最终诊断包含率平均提高20.4个百分点，对抗性上下文使14个模型平均下降5.4个百分点。推理时扩展将各WHO危害等级的有害回声降低57.9%–83.5%，并在多个模型中恢复被对抗上下文损失的诊断准确性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为这些发现为评估临床医生-AI协作提供了基础，并引入交互式指标与缓解策略，强调对安全性和鲁棒性的重要性。

papers.title: When Drafts Evolve: Speculative Decoding Meets Online Learning
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding has emerged as a widely adopted paradigm for accelerating large language model inference, where a lightweight draft model rapidly generates candidate tokens that are then verified in parallel by a larger target model. However, due to limited model capacity, drafts often struggle to approximate the target distribution, resulting in shorter acceptance lengths and diminished speedup. A key yet under-explored observation is that speculative decoding inherently provides verification feedback that quantifies the deviation between the draft and target models at no additional cost. This process naturally forms an iterative "draft commits-feedback provides-draft adapts" evolving loop, which precisely matches the online learning paradigm. Motivated by this connection, we propose OnlineSPEC, a unified framework that systematically leverages interactive feedback to continuously evolve draft models. Grounded in dynamic regret minimization, we establish a formal link between online learning performance and speculative system's acceleration rate, and develop novel algorithms via modern online learning techniques, including optimistic online learning that adaptively reuses historical gradients as predictive update hints, and online ensemble learning that dynamically maintains multiple draft models. Our algorithms are equipped with theoretical justifications and improved acceleration rates, achieving up to 24% speedup over seven benchmarks and five foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OnlineSPEC，一个把投机解码 (speculative decoding) 建模为在线学习 (online learning) 过程的统一框架。核心观察是投机解码天然带有验证反馈，形成“草稿提交—反馈—草稿适应”的循环。作者基于动态遗憾 (dynamic regret) 最小化建立在线学习性能与加速率之间的理论联系，并利用乐观在线学习与在线集成学习来持续演化草稿模型，在七个基准和五个基座模型上取得最高 24% 的加速提升。
Motivation: 投机解码中轻量草稿模型受容量限制，难以逼近目标模型分布，导致接受长度短、加速收益下降。摘要指出验证反馈其实零成本地量化了草稿与目标模型的偏差，且该迭代过程与在线学习范式精确匹配，但此前未被系统利用。
Method: 提出 OnlineSPEC 框架，从动态遗憾最小化出发推导在线学习表现与投机解码加速率之间的形式化联系；采用乐观在线学习 (optimistic online learning) 自适应复用历史梯度作为预测更新提示，并用在线集成学习 (online ensemble learning) 动态维护多个草稿模型。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在七个基准和五个基座模型上实现最高 24% 的加速提升，相比现有投机解码方法获得改进的加速率，并配有理论保证。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将投机解码与在线学习框架统一能持续演化草稿模型并带来理论上有依据的加速改进；未在摘要中给出明确的局限性说明。

papers.title: CoCo: Code as CoT for Text-to-Image Preview and Rare Concept Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) have significantly advanced text-to-image (T2I) generation, particularly through the integration of Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. However, existing CoT-based T2I methods largely rely on abstract natural-language planning, which lacks the precision required for complex spatial layouts, structured visual elements, and dense textual content. In this work, we propose CoCo (Code-as-CoT), a code-driven reasoning framework that represents the reasoning process as executable code, enabling explicit and verifiable intermediate planning for image generation. Given a text prompt, CoCo first generates executable code that specifies the structural layout of the scene. The code is then executed in a sandboxed environment to render a deterministic draft image. Subsequently, the model refines this draft through fine-grained image editing to produce the final high-fidelity result. To support this training paradigm, we construct CoCo-10K, a curated dataset containing structured draft-final image pairs designed to teach both structured draft construction and corrective visual refinement. Empirical evaluations on StructT2IBench, OneIG-Bench, and LongText-Bench show that CoCo achieves improvements of 68.83%, 54.8%, and 41.23%, respectively, over direct generation, while also outperforming other CoT-enhanced generation methods. These results demonstrate that executable code is an effective and reliable reasoning paradigm for precise, controllable, and structured text-to-image generation.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 7 figures, and 3 tables. Accepted to ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoCo（Code-as-CoT），一种将文本到图像（T2I）生成中的推理过程表示为可执行代码的框架。CoCo 首先生成描述场景结构布局的可执行代码，在沙箱环境中渲染出确定性的草稿图，再通过细粒度图像编辑精修得到最终图像。作者构建了包含草稿-最终图像对的 CoCo-10K 数据集，并在 StructT2IBench、OneIG-Bench 和 LongText-Bench 上报告相对直接生成分别提升 68.83%、54.8% 和 41.23%。
Motivation: 现有基于 Chain-of-Thought (CoT) 的 T2I 方法依赖抽象的自然语言规划，难以精确表达复杂空间布局、结构化视觉元素和密集文本内容，缺乏可验证的中间规划。
Method: 提出代码驱动推理框架 CoCo：给定文本提示，先生成可执行代码指定场景结构布局，在沙箱中执行代码渲染确定性草稿图，再通过细粒度图像编辑将草稿精修为最终高保真图像；并构建 CoCo-10K 数据集以训练结构草稿构建与纠错式视觉精修。
Result: 在 StructT2IBench、OneIG-Bench 和 LongText-Bench 上，CoCo 相对直接生成分别实现 68.83%、54.8% 和 41.23% 的提升，且优于其他 CoT 增强的生成方法。
Conclusion: 可执行代码是一种有效且可靠的推理范式，能够实现精确、可控且结构化的文本到图像生成。

papers.title: MM-ISTS: Cooperating Irregularly Sampled Time Series Forecasting with Multimodal Vision-Text LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Irregularly sampled time series (ISTS) are widespread in real-world scenarios, exhibiting asynchronous observations on uneven time intervals across diverse variables. Existing ISTS forecasting methods often solely utilize historical observations to predict future ones while falling short in learning contextual semantics and fine-grained temporal patterns. To address these problems, we propose MM-ISTS, a multimodal ISTS forecasting framework augmented by vision-text large language models, which bridges temporal, visual, and textual modalities. MM-ISTS encompasses a two-stage encoding mechanism. In particular, a Cross-Modal Vision-Text Encoding module is proposed to automatically generate informative visual images and textual data, enabling the capture of intricate temporal patterns and comprehensive contextual understanding, in collaboration with multimodal LLMs (MLLMs). In parallel, ISTS encoding extracts complementary yet enriched temporal features from historical ISTS observations, including multi-view embedding fusion and a Temporal-Variable Encoder. Further, we propose an Adaptive Query-Based Feature Extractor to compress MLLM token embeddings while preserving useful knowledge, which in turn reduces computational costs. In addition, a Multimodal Alignment module with Modality-Aware Gating is designed to alleviate the modality gaps. Extensive experiments on real data offer insight into the effectiveness of the proposed solutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MM-ISTS，一个由视觉-文本大语言模型增强的多模态不规则采样时间序列（ISTS）预测框架。方法包含两阶段编码：跨模态视觉-文本编码模块自动生成图像和文本数据并与多模态 LLM 协作，ISTS 编码模块提取历史观测的互补时序特征；另设计基于自适应查询的特征提取器压缩 MLLM token 以降低计算成本，以及带模态感知门控的多模态对齐模块缓解模态差距。真实数据上的实验表明所提方案有效。
Motivation: 现有 ISTS 预测方法通常只利用历史观测去预测未来，缺乏对上下文语义和细粒度时间模式的学习，导致预测能力受限。
Method: 提出 MM-ISTS 框架，包含 Cross-Modal Vision-Text Encoding 模块自动生成视觉和文本数据并与多模态 LLM（MLLM）协作；ISTS 编码通过多视图嵌入融合和 Temporal-Variable Encoder 提取时序特征；Adaptive Query-Based Feature Extractor 压缩 MLLM token 嵌入；Multimodal Alignment 模块配合 Modality-Aware Gating 缓解模态差异。
Result: 摘要仅报告在真实数据上的广泛实验验证了所提方案的有效性，未给出具体数值或数据集名称。
Conclusion: 作者认为利用视觉-文本多模态 LLM 桥接时间、视觉和文本模态，可以增强 ISTS 预测中的上下文理解与时间模式捕获能力。

papers.title: IDperturb: Enhancing Variation in Synthetic Face Generation via Angular Perturbation
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic data has emerged as a practical alternative to authentic face datasets for training face recognition (FR) systems, especially as privacy and legal concerns increasingly restrict the use of real biometric data. Recent advances in identity-conditional diffusion models have enabled the generation of photorealistic and identity-consistent face images. However, many of these models suffer from limited intra-class variation, an essential property for training robust and generalizable FR models. In this work, we propose IDPERTURB, a simple yet effective geometric-driven sampling strategy to enhance diversity in synthetic face generation. IDPERTURB perturbs identity embeddings within a constrained angular region of the unit hyper-sphere, producing a diverse set of embeddings without modifying the underlying generative model. Each perturbed embedding serves as a conditioning vector for a pre-trained diffusion model, enabling the synthesis of visually varied yet identity-coherent face images suitable for training generalizable FR systems. Empirical results demonstrate that training FR on datasets generated using IDPERTURB yields improved performance across multiple FR benchmarks, compared to existing synthetic data generation approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IDPERTURB，一种几何驱动的采样策略，通过在单位超球面的受限角度区域内扰动身份嵌入，生成多样化嵌入集合并作为预训练扩散模型的条件向量，从而在不修改生成模型的前提下提升合成人脸图像的类内多样性。摘要称用该方法生成的数据集训练人脸识别 (FR) 模型，在多个 FR 基准上取得优于现有合成数据生成方法的性能。
Motivation: 身份条件扩散模型可以生成逼真且身份一致的合成人脸，但许多这类模型存在类内变化不足的问题，而类内多样性是训练鲁棒、可泛化 FR 模型的关键属性。
Method: 在单位超球面 (unit hyper-sphere) 的受限角度区域内对身份嵌入进行角度扰动，产生一组视觉多样但身份一致的嵌入，每个扰动嵌入作为预训练扩散模型的条件向量来合成训练图像。
Result: 摘要报告，使用 IDPERTURB 生成的数据集训练 FR 模型，在多个 FR 基准上的性能优于现有合成数据生成方法。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法无需修改底层生成模型，仅靠嵌入层面的几何扰动即可提升合成数据的类内多样性，适合训练泛化性人脸识别系统；其应用范围局限于人脸识别领域。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When AI Benchmarks Plateau: A Systematic Study of Benchmark Saturation
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence benchmarks are an important mechanism to measure model progress and guide deployment decisions. However, benchmarks quickly "saturate", making it difficult to differentiate models and diminishing their long-term value. In this study, we define benchmark saturation and analyze it across 60 language model benchmarks using 14 properties that relate to saturation. We find that nearly half of our benchmarks exhibit saturation, with rates increasing with age. Further, we find that resilience to saturation is impacted by expert-curation, not by public test data. Our results suggest that design choices can extend benchmark longevity and inform more durable evaluation approaches.
papers.comment: Published at ICML 2026 (Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究AI基准的饱和现象，将其定义为区分模型能力的能力随分数趋近上限而下降。作者基于14个与饱和相关的属性，分析了60个语言模型基准，发现近半数基准已饱和，且饱和率随基准年龄增长而上升；对饱和的韧性受专家策展（expert-curation）影响，而非公共测试数据的可用性。
Motivation: 基准会迅速饱和，导致模型之间难以区分，削弱其长期价值，但这一现象缺乏系统的定义和大规模分析。
Method: 给出基准饱和的操作性定义，并选取60个语言模型基准，通过14个与饱和相关的属性进行大规模定量分析。
Result: 约一半的所分析基准表现出饱和，且饱和比例随基准年龄增加而上升；专家策展对饱和韧性有影响，而公共测试数据是否公开则不显著。
Conclusion: 基准设计中的选择可以延长基准的使用寿命，并为构建更持久的评估方法提供依据。

summary_sections.motivation: 基准会迅速饱和，导致模型之间难以区分，削弱其长期价值，但这一现象缺乏系统的定义和大规模分析。
summary_sections.method: 给出基准饱和的操作性定义，并选取60个语言模型基准，通过14个与饱和相关的属性进行大规模定量分析。
summary_sections.result: 约一半的所分析基准表现出饱和，且饱和比例随基准年龄增加而上升；专家策展对饱和韧性有影响，而公共测试数据是否公开则不显著。
summary_sections.conclusion: 基准设计中的选择可以延长基准的使用寿命，并为构建更持久的评估方法提供依据。

papers.title: Continuous-Time Piecewise-Linear Recurrent Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: In dynamical systems reconstruction (DSR) we aim to recover the dynamical system (DS) underlying observed time series. Specifically, we aim to learn a generative surrogate model which approximates the underlying, data-generating DS, and recreates its long-term properties (`climate statistics'). In scientific and medical areas, in particular, these models need to be mechanistically tractable -- through their mathematical analysis we would like to obtain insight into the recovered system's workings. Piecewise-linear (PL), ReLU-based RNNs (PLRNNs) have a strong track-record in this regard, representing SOTA DSR models while allowing mathematical insight by virtue of their PL design. However, all current PLRNN variants are discrete-time maps. This is in disaccord with the assumed continuous-time nature of most physical and biological processes, and makes it hard to accommodate data arriving at irregular temporal intervals. Neural ODEs are one solution, but they do not reach the DSR performance of PLRNNs and often lack their tractability. Here we develop theory for continuous-time PLRNNs (cPLRNNs): We present a novel algorithm for training and simulating such models, bypassing numerical integration by efficiently exploiting their PL structure. We further demonstrate how important topological objects like equilibria or limit cycles can be determined semi-analytically in trained models. We compare cPLRNNs to both their discrete-time cousins as well as Neural ODEs on DSR benchmarks, including systems with discontinuities which come with hard thresholds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对动力学系统重建（DSR）中现有分段线性 RNN（PLRNN）均为离散时间映射、与物理和生物过程的连续时间本质不符的问题，提出连续时间 PLRNN（cPLRNN）。作者给出训练与模拟 cPLRNN 的新算法，利用其分段线性结构绕过数值积分，并展示如何半解析地确定平衡点和极限环等拓扑对象。在 DSR 基准上，cPLRNN 与离散时间 PLRNN 及 Neural ODE 进行了比较，包括带硬阈值的间断系统。
Motivation: 现有 PLRNN 虽在 DSR 中达到 SOTA 且具备数学可解释性，但都是离散时间映射，难以处理不规则时间间隔数据，也与多数物理、生物过程的连续时间性质不符；Neural ODE 虽具连续时间形式，但 DSR 性能不及 PLRNN 且可解性较差。
Method: 提出连续时间 PLRNN（cPLRNN）及其训练、模拟算法，通过高效利用分段线性结构绕过数值积分；并给出对训练后模型中平衡点、极限环等拓扑对象的半解析求解方法。
Result: 在 DSR 基准上将 cPLRNN 与其离散时间版本及 Neural ODE 进行比较，涵盖带硬阈值的间断系统；摘要未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 cPLRNN 在保持 PLRNN 可解释性的同时引入连续时间建模能力，并可能在含间断或阈值机制的系统中优于现有方法，但需阅读正文确认具体性能差异。

papers.title: EqDeepRx: Learning a Scalable and Interference Mitigating MIMO Receiver
papers.abstract_en: While machine learning (ML)-based receiver algorithms have received a great deal of attention in the recent literature, they often suffer from poor scaling with increasing spatial multiplexing order and lack of explainability and generalization. This paper presents EqDeepRx, a practical deep-learning-aided multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) receiver, which is built by augmenting linear receiver processing with carefully engineered ML blocks. At the core of the receiver model is a shared-weight DetectorNN that operates independently on each spatial stream or layer, enabling near-linear complexity scaling with respect to multiplexing order. To ensure better explainability and generalization, EqDeepRx retains conventional channel estimation and augments it with a lightweight DenoiseNN that learns frequency-domain smoothing. To reduce the dimensionality of the DetectorNN inputs, the receiver utilizes two linear equalizers in parallel: a linear minimum mean-square error (LMMSE) equalizer with interference-plus-noise covariance estimation and a regularized zero-forcing (RZF) equalizer. The parallel equalized streams are jointly consumed by the DetectorNN, after which a compact DemapperNN produces bit log-likelihood ratios for channel decoding. 5G/6G-compliant end-to-end simulations across multiple channel scenarios, pilot patterns, and inter-cell interference conditions show improved error rate and spectral efficiency over a conventional baseline, while maintaining low-complexity inference and support for different MIMO configurations without retraining.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to IEEE for consideration for publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EqDeepRx，一种基于深度学习的 MIMO 接收机，通过在传统线性接收处理上叠加精心设计的 ML 模块来构建。核心是共享权重的 DetectorNN 逐空间流独立处理，使复杂度随复用阶数近似线性增长；同时用轻量 DenoiseNN 学习频域平滑以增强可解释性和泛化性。5G/6G 端到端仿真显示在多种信道、导频图案和小区间干扰场景下，误码率和频谱效率优于传统基线，且推理复杂度低、支持不同 MIMO 配置无需重训。
Motivation: 现有基于机器学习的接收机算法在空间复用阶数增高时扩展性差，且缺乏可解释性和泛化能力，难以在实际 5G/6G 系统中落地。
Method: EqDeepRx 保留传统信道估计并加入 DenoiseNN 做频域平滑；并行使用带干扰加噪声协方差估计的 LMMSE 均衡器和正则化迫零 (RZF) 均衡器降低 DetectorNN 输入维度，DetectorNN 联合处理两路均衡输出，最后由紧凑的 DemapperNN 生成用于信道解码的比特对数似然比 (LLR)。
Result: 在符合 5G/6G 规范的端到端仿真中，覆盖多种信道场景、导频图案和小区间干扰条件，EqDeepRx 相比传统基线改善了误码率和频谱效率，同时保持低复杂度推理，并可在不同 MIMO 配置间无需重新训练。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过将线性接收机与共享权重、逐层独立的神经网络模块结合，可以在保持可解释性和泛化性的同时获得优于常规基线的性能。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: On the Limits of Layer Pruning for Generative Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has shown that layer pruning can effectively compress large language models (LLMs) while retaining strong performance on classification benchmarks, often with little or no finetuning. In contrast, generative reasoning tasks, such as GSM8K and HumanEval\textsuperscript{+}, exhibit substantially weaker recovery. We show that beyond surface-level text degradation, pruning leads to a loss of key algorithmic capabilities, including arithmetic computation and balanced parenthesis generation. Under realistic post-training constraints, using a single 80GB GPU and without access to pretraining-scale data or compute, we evaluate a simple recovery strategy based on supervised finetuning with self-generated responses. This approach recovers up to 90\% of baseline performance on classification tasks, but recovery for generative reasoning remains limited. We further find that this gap persists even under a favorable task-aligned recovery setting, where pruned models are fully finetuned on self-generated GSM8K responses, suggesting that the degradation is not merely due to generic instruction data or parameter-efficient tuning. As complementary evidence, we analyze a depth-pruned model trained with nearly 100B post-pruning tokens and find that deficits persist even on simple arithmetic tasks that do not require multi-step generation. Overall, we characterize practical recovery limits of layer pruning for generative reasoning and provide guidance on when depth reduction is effective under constrained post-training regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究层剪枝 (layer pruning) 对大型语言模型生成式推理能力的损害。作者发现，剪枝后的模型在分类基准上可保留较强性能，但在 GSM8K 和 HumanEval+ 等生成式推理任务上恢复有限；即使使用自生成响应进行监督微调，推理能力仍无法有效恢复，且该缺陷在近 100B 后训练 token 的深度剪枝模型中依然存在。
Motivation: 已有工作表明层剪枝能在几乎不需要微调的情况下压缩 LLM 并保持分类性能，但生成式推理任务上的退化程度未被充分刻画；本文旨在明确在受限后训练条件下层剪枝对生成式推理的实际恢复极限。
Method: 在单张 80GB GPU、无预训练规模数据与算力的现实约束下，评估基于自生成响应的监督微调 (supervised finetuning) 恢复策略；同时设置任务对齐恢复场景，即在自生成 GSM8K 响应上完全微调剪枝模型，并分析一个用近 100B token 后训练的深度剪枝模型。
Result: 该恢复策略可在分类任务上恢复约 90% 的基线性能，但生成式推理的恢复仍然有限；即使在任务对齐恢复设置下，GSM8K 性能差距依旧存在。对近 100B token 后训练模型的补充分析显示，即使是不需要多步生成的简单算术任务，缺陷也难以消除。
Conclusion: 作者认为层剪枝对生成式推理的能力损害超越了表层文本退化，表现为算法能力（如算术计算和平衡括号生成）的丧失，并指出在受限后训练条件下深度缩减对生成式推理的恢复效果存在明确上限。
