papers.title: CASCADE: An Agentic Regulatory Network Framework for Patient-Data-Validated Downstream Perturbation Prediction
papers.abstract_en: CASCADE is an agentic framework that predicts downstream transcriptional effects of gene perturbation from precomputed ARACNe regulatory networks, exposed via MCP. Prior work validates such tools by checking whether predicted genes are known cancer genes (membership); we instead test whether the predicted direction of change matches reality, using focal-gene copy-number amplification as a dosage-based proxy for the inverse of knockdown against real TCGA patient tumor data. For MYC, CASCADE's predicted knockdown targets show strong concordance with real amplified-vs-non-amplified tumor expression across three cancer types (BRCA: 90.0%, COAD: 72.0%, STAD: 85.7%; all p<0.0013), well above permutation baselines, surviving a PAM50 subtype control and replicating in an independent cohort (METABRIC, 87.2%). Compared against curated MSigDB gene-set baselines via Fisher's exact test, CASCADE's accuracy is not shown to exceed existing public knowledge of MYC- or E2F-driven biology, though its gene-specific direction-calling clearly outperforms a naive uniform guess. Extending to fifteen additional genes, validation proves gene-specific rather than universal: proliferation-machinery regulators mostly replicate, while lineage-identity transcription factors and one cyclin-D paralog (CCND2) consistently fail, a pattern we discuss as a hedged, post-hoc hypothesis. We separately benchmark whether an LLM-based agent correctly grounds natural-language requests into CASCADE's real MCP tool calls. Across 35 queries, a documented local model reaches 71.4% exact match (85.7% for a larger model); schema and gene-alias failures are resolved by scale or server-side correction, but both models confidently default to the wrong perturbation type on ambiguous queries, a failure a targeted fix could not resolve because its trigger condition never occurs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CASCADE 是一个基于 agent 的框架，利用经 MCP 暴露的预计算 ARACNe 调控网络，预测基因扰动（gene perturbation）的下游转录效应。作者不再用预测基因是否为已知癌症基因来验证工具，而是以焦点基因拷贝数扩增作为敲低（knockdown）的剂量代理，对照真实 TCGA 患者肿瘤数据检验预测的方向是否与现实一致。在 MYC 上，预测的敲低靶标与扩增/非扩增肿瘤表达在三种癌症类型中高度一致（BRCA 90.0%、COAD 72.0%、STAD 85.7%，均 p<0.0013），并能在 METABRIC 独立队列中复现（87.2%）；但相对 MSigDB 基因集基线，准确率并未超过已有公共知识。
Motivation: 现有基因扰动预测工具的验证通常只检查预测基因是否为已知癌症基因（membership），不检验预测的变化方向是否正确。作者希望用真实患者肿瘤数据验证方向性预测，并进一步检验 CASCADE 的基因特异性。
Method: 提出 CASCADE 框架，从 ARACNe 调控网络计算基因扰动的下游效应，并通过 MCP 暴露给 LLM-based agent。验证上使用焦点基因拷贝数扩增作为基因敲低的剂量代理，对照 TCGA 患者肿瘤数据，并用置换检验、PAM50 亚型对照、METABRIC 独立队列及 Fisher's exact test 与 MSigDB 基线比较。
Result: 对 MYC，预测敲低靶标的方向调用在 BRCA、COAD、STAD 上分别达到 90.0%、72.0%、85.7%（p<0.0013），高于置换基线，能通过 PAM50 亚型对照并在 METABRIC 复现（87.2%）；但相对 MSigDB 公共基因集基线没有显示超出。扩展到 15 个额外基因后，增殖机制调控因子大多复现，而谱系身份转录因子和 CCND2 一致失败。另有 35 条查询的 agent grounding 基准：本地模型精确匹配率 71.4%，更大模型 85.7%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基因特异性（gene-specific）而非普适性的验证结果，并对失败模式给出 hedged、post-hoc 的解释；同时指出 LLM agent 在模糊查询上会自信地默认到错误的扰动类型，且针对性修复因触发条件从未出现而无效。论文属于生物信息学与 LLM agent 交叉领域，与所给天气/降水关键词无关。

papers.title: DG-FedReuse: Proxy-Gradient-Gated Cached-Update Reuse with Matched Sparse Uplink Accounting
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning repeatedly incurs local optimization and model-update transmission. We study DG-FedReuse, a simulator-level mechanism that allows selected clients to contribute age-decayed cached updates when a stochastic head-gradient discrepancy proxy remains below a round-dependent threshold. A hard cache-age limit and minimum fresh-client quota constrain reuse, while fresh updates use an adaptive per-tensor Top-K numerical-field representation. Experiments cover six image-classification datasets, 50 virtual clients, Dirichlet label heterogeneity (α=0.5), and three seeds. At a common 90-round budget, DG-FedReuse yields 83.36-85.42% modeled update-data-field uplink saving, compared with 76.88% for matched Top-K FedAvg; the seed-aligned accuracy differences range from -5.29 to -0.14 percentage points. Best-observed test accuracies obtained under test-controlled checkpointing are retained only as exploratory archival evidence and range from -2.38 to +0.45 percentage points relative to matched FedAvg. A symmetric dense-model-downlink sensitivity reduces the headline saving to 41.68-F42.71% and the incremental gain over Top-K FedAvg to 3.24-4.27 percentage points, demonstrating the dependence of communication conclusions on the accounting boundary. The study characterizes the proposed reuse rule in the implemented simulator; it does not establish unbiased generalization, end-to-end bandwidth reduction, runtime or energy savings, faster convergence, or superiority over existing stale-update and lazy-aggregation methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DG-FedReuse，一种在模拟器层面实现的联邦学习机制：当随机头梯度差异代理指标低于逐轮阈值时，允许选中的客户端贡献按年龄衰减的缓存更新（cached updates），并通过硬缓存年龄上限与最小新鲜客户端配额进行约束；新鲜更新则采用自适应的逐张量 Top-K 数值字段表示。在 6 个图像分类数据集、50 个虚拟客户端、Dirichlet 标签异质性（α=0.5）和 3 个种子的实验中，90 轮预算下该机制相比匹配的 Top-K FedAvg 在建模的更新数据字段上行链路节省上表现更好，但精度变化为负。
Motivation: 联邦学习反复产生本地优化和模型更新传输的开销，作者希望利用客户端可复用的缓存更新来减少上行通信成本。
Method: 提出一种带门控的缓存更新复用规则：仅当随机头梯度差异代理指标低于轮次相关阈值时才允许复用年龄衰减的缓存更新，并设置硬缓存年龄上限与最小新鲜客户端配额；新鲜更新使用自适应的逐张量 Top-K 表示。
Result: 在 90 轮公共预算下，DG-FedReuse 实现了 83.36%-85.42% 的建模更新数据字段上行链路节省，而匹配的 Top-K FedAvg 为 76.88%；种子对齐的精度差异为 -5.29 至 -0.14 个百分点。考虑对称的稠密模型下行链路敏感性后，头条节省降为 41.68%-42.71%，相比 Top-K FedAvg 的增量收益为 3.24-4.27 个百分点。
Conclusion: 作者明确说明该研究仅在实现的模拟器中刻画所提复用规则，并未建立无偏泛化、端到端带宽降低、运行时或能耗节省、更快收敛，也未证明优于现有的陈旧更新和惰性聚合方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LoDA: A Level of Detection Aware Method and a Multimodal Sensing Benchmark for Object Level Change Detection
papers.abstract_en: High-definition 3D LiDAR maps are important for autonomous driving and smart-city services, which require reliable detection of object-level changes in multi-temporal urban LiDAR to keep digital maps aligned with the physical world. Existing approaches from raster height differencing to depth image and point-cloud networks often remain tile-based and threshold-driven, yielding per-point scores without explicit detection limits or consistent object-level labels. We propose an object-level 3D change-detection pipeline that integrates detection-limit-aware registration, geometry-driven object proxies with rule-based semantic and instance segmentation, and displacement cues in height, volume, and surface-normal direction to assign five change labels with confidence. By decoupling registration, geometry, and semantics, the pipeline propagates pose uncertainty into spatially varying detection limits, stabilizes cross-epoch correspondences, and suppresses false changes caused by residual misalignment and density variation. We also present LoDA, a level-of-detection (LoD) aware benchmark for the Subiaco district with fused multi-temporal vehicle-LiDAR maps constructed with LiDAR, GNSS, and IMU support, semantic instances, and object-level annotations. On this benchmark, our method achieves 95.0% accuracy, 90.8% macro F1, and 83.0% macro IoU, exceeding the best baseline by 8.7 IoU points and 4.4 F1 points. On the public Urb3DCD-V2 benchmark evaluated under the official point-wise protocol, it reaches 96.81% mean accuracy and 89.52% mean change IoU, improving over the strongest reported baselines by 1.36 points in mAcc and 3.18 points in mIoUch.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM 2026) Main Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LoDA，一个面向对象级 3D 变化检测的水平检测感知方法，并配套发布了 Subiaco 地区的多模态传感基准。方法将检测限感知配准、基于几何的对象代理以及规则化的语义/实例分割解耦，利用高度、体积和表面法线方向的位移线索为每个对象分配五种带置信度的变化标签。在 LoDA 基准上达到 95.0% 准确率、90.8% macro F1 和 83.0% macro IoU，并在公开 Urb3DCD-V2 上按官方点级协议取得 96.81% 平均准确率和 89.52% 平均变化 IoU。
Motivation: 多时相城市 LiDAR 地图需要可靠地检测对象级变化以保持数字地图与物理世界对齐，但现有方法多为基于瓦片和阈值的点级评分，缺乏明确的检测界限和一致的对象级标签。
Method: 提出一个对象级 3D 变化检测流水线，包括检测限感知配准、几何驱动的对象代理与基于规则的语义和实例分割，以及结合高度、体积和表面法线方向位移线索的五类变化标签分配。通过解耦配准、几何和语义，传播位姿不确定性到空间变化的检测限，稳定跨时期对应关系并抑制残余错位和密度变化造成的虚假变化。
Result: 在 LoDA 基准上，方法达到 95.0% 准确率、90.8% macro F1 和 83.0% macro IoU，比最强基线高 8.7 IoU 点和 4.4 F1 点；在公开 Urb3DCD-V2 官方点级协议下达到 96.81% 平均准确率和 89.52% 平均变化 IoU，较最强基线提升 1.36 mAcc 和 3.18 mIoUch。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法通过解耦配准、几何和语义并引入检测限感知，能够在对象级保持一致的 3D 变化检测，同时提供 LoDA 基准以支持该任务的评估。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Online Traffic Scheduling in Time-Sensitive Application
papers.abstract_en: Time-sensitive networking (TSN) is increasingly integrated into mobile edge computing (MEC) to support applications with stringent latency requirements, such as extended reality (XR). However, existing TSN scheduling solutions predominantly rely on static optimization techniques or centralized learning models that are based on fixed traffic patterns, limiting their effectiveness in dynamic environments. In practice, MEC environments often host multiple co-located XR traffic flows whose characteristics evolve over time, creating complex inter-queue dependencies that current schedulers fail to capture. Addressing these challenges requires adaptive, decentralized scheduling mechanisms capable of coordinating multiple TSN queues under varying traffic conditions. To this end, this paper proposes a multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) framework for TSN scheduling, where each TSN queue is modeled as an autonomous agent. The Heterogeneous-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (HAPPO) algorithm is employed to explicitly model inter-agent dependencies and jointly optimize service delivery across queues. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed approach reduces average frame waiting times by up to 26.8% and worst-case delays by approximately 16.8%, highlighting its effectiveness in dynamic XR-driven MEC scenarios.

papers.title: Positive-Unlabeled Preference Optimization For Chest X-ray Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for radiology report generation are typically trained on retrospective clinical reports, which suffer from omission noise: clinically present findings are left unreported due to the omission of subtle findings. For example, prior studies show that cardiomegaly may be omitted from ICU chest X-ray reports when the imaging request is focused on monitoring support device placement. As a result, models trained with standard approaches inherit these omissions, learning to under-report findings themselves. We propose PU-DPO, a preference optimization framework to prevent omission noise from corrupting the preference signal. We reformulate the objective under a positive-unlabeled (PU) learning framework, treating absent mentions as unlabeled rather than truly negative. Our framework provides preference supervision using constructed contrastive pairs, generated using edits to model responses, producing variants that explicitly mention or omit a specific finding. Generated responses that mention the finding are naturally preferred in the context of visual evidence. Across semi-synthetic experiments and analyses on real-world chest radiograph benchmarks where adjudicated labels are available, PU-DPO yields consistent gains in detection rates and recovery of hidden positives across multiple pathologies, and is more robust to omission noise than prior approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PU-DPO，一个基于正-未标注 (positive-unlabeled, PU) 学习的偏好优化框架，用于胸部 X 光报告生成，以缓解回顾性临床报告中因遗漏细微发现而产生的 omission noise 问题。作者将缺失提及视为未标注而非真正阴性，通过构造对比对提供偏好监督，使显式提及发现的响应更受偏好。在半合成实验和真实胸部 X 光基准（有 adjudicated labels）上，PU-DPO 在多个病理类型上提升了检出率和隐藏阳性的恢复率。
Motivation: 放射学报告生成中用于训练的回顾性临床报告存在 omission noise：临床上存在但细微的发现常未被报告，例如 ICU 胸部 X 光报告可能遗漏心脏肥大，模型继承这些遗漏并学会低报发现。该工作旨在防止这种遗漏噪声污染偏好信号，使模型不会系统性漏报。
Method: 提出 PU-DPO，将偏好优化目标在 PU 学习框架下重新表述，把缺失提及视为 unlabeled 而非真正阴性。通过编辑模型响应构造对比对，生成显式提及或省略特定发现的变体，并基于视觉证据偏好提及发现的响应。
Result: 在半合成实验以及可获得 adjudicated labels 的真实胸部 X 光基准上，PU-DPO 在多个病理类型上一致提升检出率并恢复隐藏阳性，且比先前方法对 omission noise 更稳健。
Conclusion: 作者强调将缺失视为未标注并借助结构化对比对进行偏好监督，可以避免遗漏噪声破坏偏好信号，提升放射学报告生成的可靠性。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Transformer for Queue-Level XR Traffic Scheduling in TSN Networks
papers.abstract_en: Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) and Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) hold strong potential for enabling ultra-reliable low-latency communication for time-sensitive applications, such as eXtended Reality (XR). However, the widespread adoption of XR introduces significant challenges due to co-located services in MEC environments, leading to contention for shared network resources. Moreover, XR traffic types have distinct characteristics and criticality in terms of timing requirements, further increasing the complexity and dynamics of such environments. Although reinforcement learning has shown promise for TSN scheduling optimization in dynamic network scenarios, existing approaches rely on centralized or high-level multi-agent designs and are typically tailored to periodic and predictable industrial traffic, limiting their applicability to XR workloads. As a result, these approaches suffer from (i) limited ability to capture inter-queue dependencies due to coarse-grained control, and (ii) poor adaptability to highly dynamic and heterogeneous XR traffic. To address these gaps, we propose a multi-agent reinforcement learning approach for queue-level XR traffic scheduling. We adopt the multi-agent transformer (MAT) to model inter-queue dependencies via attention over agents' observations and actions, enabling implicit coordination across heterogeneous co-located XR applications. Our simulation results show that the proposed method outperforms baselines, achieving up to 71.42% latency reduction and up to 83.2% reduction in failure rate, while consistently achieving high reliability across all queues.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于多智能体 Transformer (multi-agent transformer, MAT) 的多智能体强化学习方法，用于 TSN 网络中队列级 XR 流量调度。方法通过注意力机制对智能体的观测和动作建模队列间依赖，在 MEC 环境中共存的异构 XR 应用间实现隐式协调。仿真结果显示相比基线最多降低 71.42% 时延和 83.2% 失败率，并在所有队列上保持高可靠性。
Motivation: 现有基于强化学习的 TSN 调度方法多采用集中式或高层多智能体设计，且针对周期性、可预测的工业流量，难以适应动态异构的 XR 工作负载；同时粗粒度控制难以捕捉队列间依赖关系，限制了其在 XR 场景中的适用性。
Method: 提出一种多智能体强化学习调度方法，采用多智能体 Transformer (MAT)，通过注意力机制对智能体观测和动作建模队列间依赖，从而在共存的异构 XR 应用之间实现隐式协调。
Result: 仿真结果表明，与基线方法相比，所提方法最多可降低 71.42% 的时延和 83.2% 的失败率，并在所有队列上持续实现高可靠性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基于注意力的队列级多智能体设计能有效捕捉队列间依赖，并显著提升动态异构 XR 流量下的调度性能与可靠性。

papers.title: Physics-Based Molecular Fingerprints from Spectral Graph Theory Provide Efficient Geometry-Aware Measures of Chemical Similarity
papers.abstract_en: Molecular representations are essential for the evaluation of molecular similarity and the development of structure-property relationships. Despite the known importance of 3D structure to determine chemical and physical properties, the most widely used molecular fingerprints encode only two-dimensional connectivity. Such representations fail to distinguish similar but distinct stereoisomers and conformers. Alternative 3D methods are typically defined pairwise, making their application to large chemical spaces prohibitive, while deep learning embeddings are expressive but uninterpretable and limited by their training data diversity. Here, we introduce novel physics-inspired molecular fingerprints based on principles from spectral graph theory. We represent molecules as a complete graph in 3D space, with edge weights encoding heuristic physical interactions. Eigenvalue decomposition of the resulting graph Laplacian matrix results in a computationally efficient fixed-length chemical fingerprint that encodes 3D structure while obeying necessary physical symmetries of permutation and E(3) invariance. Spectral fingerprints differentiate between unique molecular structures with identical 2D connectivity, overcoming a limitation of 2D descriptors, while maintaining the low computational cost needed for efficient screening of vast chemical spaces. We evaluate our fingerprints with community detection algorithms and observe strong performance against representative baselines across datasets from organic, inorganic, biological, reticular, and reaction chemistry. Nearest-neighbor property estimation and applicability domain analyses reveal the utility of our molecular representation in machine learning and cheminformatics. We anticipate that spectral fingerprints will serve as generalizable, interpretable, and efficient measures of chemical similarity that incorporate 3D information at minimal cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于谱图理论的物理启发分子指纹（spectral fingerprints），将分子表示为三维空间中的完全图，边权重编码启发式物理相互作用，对图拉普拉斯矩阵做特征值分解得到固定长度的几何感知指纹，兼具置换不变性与E(3)不变性，能区分二维连接相同但三维结构不同的分子，并以低计算成本用于大规模化学空间筛选。在有机、无机、生物、网状和反应化学数据集上用社区检测算法评估，表现优于代表性基线。
Motivation: 现有最常用的分子指纹只编码二维连接，无法区分立体异构体和构象；三维方法通常成对定义、难以扩展到大规模化学空间，深度学习嵌入表达力强但不可解释且受训练数据多样性限制。
Method: 将分子表示为三维空间中的完全图，边权重编码启发式物理相互作用；对所得图拉普拉斯矩阵进行特征值分解，生成固定长度的化学指纹，满足置换不变性和E(3)不变性。
Result: 摘要报告该指纹能区分具有相同二维连接的唯一分子结构，并保持低计算成本；使用社区检测算法评估时，在有机、无机、生物、网状和反应化学数据集上相对代表性基线表现强。还进行了最近邻性质估计和适用域分析。
Conclusion: 作者预期谱指纹可作为通用、可解释且高效的化学相似性度量，以最小成本纳入3D信息。

papers.title: Context Matters: Support Set Selection and Failure Detection for In-Context Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: In-context learning (ICL) adapts medical image segmentation models to unseen structures and modalities without retraining by conditioning on a task-specific support set of image-mask exemplars. Because this support set is the model's only task-specific signal, its composition directly influences segmentation performance. In this work, we investigate the support set as a controllable determinant of ICL reliability. First, we compare random sampling against similarity-based selection, where exemplars are retrieved based on their visual similarity to the query image. Second, we train a transformer-based classifier to predict, from the query and support images alone, whether a segmentation will fall below a specified Intersection-over-Union (IoU) threshold. Using MultiverSeg with DINOv3 embeddings across four benchmarks and three imaging modalities, we show that similarity-based selection consistently matches or outperforms random sampling, with the largest gains at the smallest support set sizes. Furthermore, our classifier predicts segmentation failure above chance on all four benchmarks. Ultimately, these results demonstrate that the reliability of in-context segmentation can be both improved via informed support selection and anticipated before use, providing practical mechanisms for safer clinical deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究医学图像分割中上下文学习 (in-context learning, ICL) 的支持集选择与失败预测。作者对比了随机采样与基于视觉相似性的示例检索，并训练一个 transformer 分类器从查询图像和支持图像预测分割是否低于指定的 IoU 阈值。实验在 MultiverSeg 与 DINOv3 嵌入下、四个基准和三种成像模态上进行，结果显示相似性选择一致匹配或优于随机采样，且失败预测在全部基准上高于随机水平。
Motivation: ICL 中支持集是模型唯一的任务特异信号，其组成直接影响分割性能，但目前缺乏对支持集作为可控因素的研究，也缺乏在部署前预判分割失败的手段。
Method: 首先比较随机采样与基于查询-支持图像视觉相似性的相似性选择；其次训练一个基于 transformer 的分类器，仅从查询和支持图像预测分割结果是否低于指定 Intersection-over-Union (IoU) 阈值；实验采用 MultiverSeg 与 DINOv3 嵌入。
Result: 在四个基准和三种成像模态上，相似性选择一致匹配或优于随机采样，且最小的支持集规模下收益最大；该失败预测分类器在全部四个基准上的表现均优于随机猜测。
Conclusion: 结果表明，ICL 分割的可靠性既可以通过知情支持集选择来提升，也可以在使用前被预测，这为更安全的临床部署提供了实用机制。

papers.title: Hierarchical Server Architecture for Agentic Science
papers.abstract_en: Agentic science is transforming the landscape of computational work, extending to scientific pipelines and workload managers. The workloads require specialized hardware within and across institutions. If assessing workload needs against environments is required for scheduling, automated discovery of resources is an essential step. In this paper, we present a hierarchical, dynamic architecture and software to discover resources across diverse cloud, edge, and HPC systems. The design enables concurrent, asynchronous negotiation, selection, and dispatch of requests for work using secretary agents. The agents probe and discover 51 real and simulated providers across 7 categories. We perform 19,973 negotiation and 6,952 selection simulations to assess reliability of decisions, demonstrating high (87.71\%) negotiation accuracy and selection costs comparable to more traditional strategies. Designed for extensibility and currently supporting the Genesis Mission, this architecture exemplifies the importance of careful coordination between agents, discovery tools, and infrastructure for agentic science.

papers.title: Computationally Efficient Collaborative Communication Via Regularity-Based Coarsening
papers.abstract_en: Our results show that the existence of a short high-utility protocol already suffices for efficient communication. In particular, in a game with $n$ possible observations and $m$ actions: (1) For any achievable target utility $α$, we give an algorithm with $\mathrm{poly}(n, m, 1/ε)$ runtime that designs a protocol achieving utility at least $α-ε$ using only $2^{\mathcal O(CC_α(G))}/ε^2$ bits of communication. Here, $CC_α(G)$ is the minimum number of bits used by any protocol, even a computationally inefficient one, to achieve utility $α$. (2) We prove that this exponential dependence on $CC_α(G)$ is tight up to a constant. That is, unless $\mathrm P=\mathrm{NP}$, no polynomial-time algorithm can in general find optimal protocols using fewer than $2^{CC_α(G) -2}$ bits. We note that our results strictly weaken the assumptions required by prior work in the multi-agent information aggregation literature, filling a gap that had remained elusive even for games with constant $CC_α(G)$. In particular, prior guarantees for agreement-based information aggregation rely on structural assumptions such as informational substitutes or weak learnability. We show that these assumptions already imply $CC_α(G) = O(1)$ and are therefore more restrictive conditions than required by our protocol to succeed. On a technical level, our results involve a novel strengthening of the Frieze-Kannan weak regularity lemma and yield the following powerful polynomial-time transformation tool: for every communication game $G$, it constructs a game $\hat G$ that is a coarsening of the agents' observation spaces into constant-size partitions, such that $G$ and $\hat G$ are indistinguishable with respect to every short communication protocol. This coarsening theorem is the engine behind our algorithm and may be of independent interest.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多智能体信息聚合中的通信效率问题，证明只要存在一个短的、高效用的协议，就能在多项式时间内设计出同样高效用且通信量可控的协议。作者给出算法，在包含 n 个观测和 m 个动作的博弈中，以 poly(n, m, 1/ε) 运行时间构造效用至少 α-ε 的协议，通信位数仅需 2^{O(CC_α(G))}/ε^2，其中 CC_α(G) 是任意（即使计算上低效）实现效用 α 的最短协议位数；同时证明该指数依赖在常数因子内是紧的，除非 P=NP，否则多项式时间算法无法用少于 2^{CC_α(G)-2} 位找到最优协议。技术上，论文提出对 Frieze-Kannan 弱正则引理的强化，得到一个多项式时间变换工具：将任意通信博弈 G 的观测空间粗化为常数大小分区，得到与 G 对一切短通信协议不可区分的博弈 Ĝ。
Motivation: 先前多智能体信息聚合文献中的协议保证依赖结构性假设，如信息替代品 (informational substitutes) 或弱可学习性 (weak learnability)，而这些假设实际上要求 CC_α(G)=O(1)，过于严格；即使在 CC_α(G) 为常数的博弈中，是否存在不需要这些假设的高效通信方案此前仍悬而未决。
Method: 作者证明了短且高效用协议的存在性本身就足以支持高效通信，并给出一种多项式时间算法：对于任意可达目标效用 α，以 poly(n, m, 1/ε) 时间构造一个使用 2^{O(CC_α(G))}/ε^2 位通信、效用至少 α-ε 的协议。核心工具是 Frieze-Kannan 弱正则引理的一种新强化，得到粗化定理：可将观测空间粗化为常数大小分区，使原博弈与粗化博弈对所有短通信协议不可区分。
Result: 摘要报告：(1) 对任意可达目标效用 α，存在 poly(n, m, 1/ε) 运行时间的算法，用 2^{O(CC_α(G))}/ε^2 位通信实现效用 ≥ α-ε；(2) 该指数依赖在常数因子内紧，即除非 P=NP，否则不存在多项式时间算法能用少于 2^{CC_α(G)-2} 位找到最优协议。此外，先前文献所需的假设（如信息替代品、弱可学习性）都会蕴含 CC_α(G)=O(1)，因而比本文协议成功所需条件更严格。
Conclusion: 作者强调他们的结果严格弱化了多智能体信息聚合领域先前工作所需的假设，填补了甚至对 CC_α(G) 为常数的博弈也长期存在的空白；提出的粗化定理可作为独立的多项式时间变换工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: QEvict: Recoverable Quantized KV Eviction for Attention-Drift-Robust Long-Context Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive large language model inference is increasingly constrained by the memory footprint of the Key-Value (KV) cache. A dominant line of work reduces this footprint by evicting tokens that appear unimportant under attention-derived scores. However, such policies make an implicit irreversible decision: once a token is evicted, it cannot become useful again. We show that this assumption is brittle during decoding. Token and window importance drift as generated queries evolve, causing standard eviction policies to permanently discard states that later receive substantial attention under the full-cache model. To characterize this behaviour, we introduce Future Missed Mass and Global LIR, two diagnostics that measure future attention assigned to discarded states and the reactivation of historically inactive regions. We propose QEvict, a three-tier KV-cache management scheme that replaces binary retain-or-delete eviction with recoverable eviction. QEvict maintains high-confidence windows in full precision, stores intermediate windows in a quantized recoverable tier, and deletes only the lowest-confidence windows. During decoding, cumulative attention scores update window importance and when a quantized window becomes important again, it is dequantized and promoted to the full-precision. Under a fixed memory budget, this design preserves broader historical context while retaining exact full precision for the most important regions. Across long-context understanding, retrieval, and reasoning benchmarks, QEvict consistently improves over representative eviction and quantization baselines, reducing missed attention and improving information retention
papers.comment: 24 pages, 6 figures. The first four authors contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自回归大语言模型解码中 KV cache 内存占用过大的问题，指出基于注意力分数的逐出策略具有不可逆性，而 token 与窗口的重要性会随生成查询变化而漂移。作者提出 QEvict，一种三层 KV cache 管理方案，用可恢复的量化逐出替代二值的保留/删除决策，并引入 Future Missed Mass 与 Global LIR 两个诊断指标刻画被丢弃状态的未来注意力与历史不活跃区域的重新激活。实验表明在长上下文理解、检索与推理基准上，QEvict 一致优于代表性的逐出与量化基线。
Motivation: 现有 KV cache 逐出策略一旦删掉 token 就无法恢复，但解码过程中 token 和窗口的重要性会随查询演化而漂移，导致标准逐出策略永久丢弃后续在全缓存模型下会获得大量注意力的状态。
Method: 提出 QEvict 三层缓存管理：高置信窗口保留全精度，中间窗口存入可恢复的量化层，仅删除最低置信窗口；解码时用累计注意力分数更新窗口重要性，量化窗口重新变重要时被反量化并提升到全精度层。
Result: 在长上下文理解、检索和推理基准上，QEvict 一致优于代表性的逐出与量化基线，减少了被错过的注意力并改善了信息保留。
Conclusion: 在固定内存预算下，可恢复的逐出设计能在保留更广历史上下文的同时，对最重要区域保持精确的全精度表示。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Rectifying Geometric Misalignment: Online Source-Free Adaptation for Class-Imbalanced EEG
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) based Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs) often require unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) to generalize across subjects and sessions. While Riemannian alignment methods like the Riemannian Centering Transformation (RCT) are effective for handling covariate shifts, they implicitly assume balanced class priors. However, in realistic online BCI scenarios, the label distributions vary dynamically (label shift), causing standard alignment techniques to geometrically misalign the target data distributions. In this work, we propose OSPDIM (Online SPD manifold information maximization), a source-free online UDA framework designed to address label shifts on the Riemannian manifold. OSPDIM introduces a manifold-constrained bias parameter into the tangent space mapping, which is optimized via information maximization to correct the geometric skew caused by imbalanced data streams. Unlike offline methods relying on global batch statistics, OSPDIM estimates and corrects geometric bias on-the-fly. Simulations on 2D SPD matrices visually demonstrate that OSPDIM successfully rectifies the misalignment where standard centering fails. Extensive experiments on multiple motor imagery datasets show that OSPDIM significantly outperforms standard Riemannian baselines, particularly in challenging online adaptation scenarios with severe class imbalance, offering a robust solution for practical, plug-and-play BCI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 EEG 脑机接口（BCI）在线场景中类别不平衡导致的 Riemannian 几何错位问题，提出无源在线域适应框架 OSPDIM（Online SPD manifold information maximization）。该方法在切空间映射中引入流形约束的偏置参数，并通过信息最大化（information maximization）在线优化该偏置，以修正不平衡数据流造成的几何偏斜。2D SPD 矩阵模拟以及多个运动想象数据集上的实验表明，OSPDIM 能有效纠正标准对齐方法无法处理的错位，并在严重类别不平衡的在线适应场景中显著优于标准 Riemannian 基线。
Motivation: Riemannian 对齐方法如 Riemannian Centering Transformation (RCT) 能处理协变量偏移，但隐式假设类别先验均衡；真实在线 BCI 中标签分布会动态变化（标签偏移），导致标准对齐方法使目标数据分布发生几何错位，影响泛化性能。
Method: 提出源自由在线无监督域适应（UDA）框架 OSPDIM，在切空间映射中引入流形约束的偏置参数，并通过信息最大化优化该参数以校正类别不平衡引起的几何偏移。与依赖全局批量统计的离线方法不同，OSPDIM 在数据流上在线估计并纠正几何偏置。
Result: 在 2D SPD 矩阵模拟中，OSPDIM 成功修正了标准 centering 方法失效的几何错位；在多个运动想象数据集上，OSPDIM 显著优于标准 Riemannian 基线，尤其在类别严重不平衡的挑战性在线适应场景中表现突出。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 OSPDIM 为实用、即插即用的 BCI 系统提供了鲁棒的在线适应方案，能够有效应对真实在线场景中的类别不平衡与几何错位问题。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Failing Gracefully: Mitigating Impact of Inevitable Robot Failures
papers.abstract_en: Service robots operate in household environments shared with humans, pets, and everyday objects, where they are highly susceptible to failures such as software crashes, hardware degradation, or unpredictable interactions. While roboticists strive to minimize failures, some remain inevitable, making it critical to mitigate their potential consequences for safe and reliable deployment. This paper introduces a novel safety formulation that evaluates both the probability of impactful interactions between robots and surrounding entities during failures, and the severity of their outcomes. By quantifying the impact of failures on different entities, our approach enables robots to make informed planning decisions that balance safety with task efficiency. To support systematic evaluation, we also present FailBench, a MuJoCo-based simulation framework for studying robot-environment interactions under diverse failure modes, including sensing issues and actuator malfunctions. Together, our safety formulation and FailBench provide a foundation for developing safer and more robust motion plans and learned policies in real-world household environments.
papers.comment: Accepted to IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对家用服务机器人在与人类、宠物和日常物体共享的环境中不可避免地发生故障的问题，提出一种新的安全公式，同时评估故障期间机器人与周围实体发生有影响交互的概率以及后果的严重程度。作者还提出 FailBench，一个基于 MuJoCo 的仿真框架，用于在多种故障模式（如传感问题和执行器故障）下研究机器人-环境交互。摘要称该公式与 FailBench 为在真实家庭环境中开发更安全、更鲁棒的运动规划和习得策略奠定基础。
Motivation: 服务机器人在家庭环境中极易因软件崩溃、硬件退化或不可预测交互而失败，有些故障无法完全避免，因此必须减轻其潜在后果，以确保安全可靠的部署。
Method: 提出一种安全公式，量化故障对不同实体的影响，综合考虑故障期间机器人与周围实体交互的发生概率和后果严重程度，使机器人能够在安全与任务效率之间做出权衡的规划决策；同时构建 MuJoCo 仿真基准 FailBench，以支持对不同故障模式的系统化评估。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果，主要贡献在于提出安全公式和 FailBench 仿真框架本身。
Conclusion: 该安全公式与 FailBench 为在真实家庭环境中开发更安全、更鲁棒的运动规划和习得策略提供基础。

papers.title: EdgeXpert: An Edge Device for Memory-Efficient LLM Inference with Mixture-of-Experts and Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: On-device deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) has become essential for personalized edge applications. A primary bottleneck is external memory access (EMA) in feed-forward network (FFN) layers. Speculative decoding and mixture-of-experts (MoE) are promising solutions. Speculative decoding reduces the number of decoding stages by generating multiple tokens per stage, and MoE minimizes per-stage cost through sparse expert activation. However, there is an incompatibility when combining these two techniques. We propose EdgeXpert, a software-hardware co-designed LLM accelerator that resolves this incompatibility. In the prefill stage, the prompt-wise expert reuse reformulates routing as prompt-level expert reuse rather than independent per-token expert selection. It identifies important tokens using a lightweight encoder, constructs a shared expert set from them, and routes less important tokens with a reduced expert budget to lower expert EMA. In the decode stage, depth-aware expert coalescing exploits the contextual similarity and mutual exclusivity of same-depth candidate tokens. Rather than loading the union of all required channels, EdgeXpert loads only salient channels and applies computational calibration to recover accuracy without additional memory access. Synthesized in Samsung 28nm technology at 800 MHz, EdgeXpert achieves up to 56.3% latency reduction and 44.1% energy reduction compared to prior works, while maintaining near-baseline accuracy.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 59th IEEE/ACM International Symposium on Microarchitecture (MICRO 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EdgeXpert，一个针对边缘设备上的 LLM 推理设计的软硬件协同加速器，目标是降低 FFN 层外部内存访问（EMA）。作者指出投机解码（speculative decoding）与混合专家（mixture-of-experts, MoE）单独都能减少解码开销，但二者结合存在不兼容性；EdgeXpert 通过 prefill 阶段和 decode 阶段的两种专用机制化解这一矛盾，并在 28nm 工艺下取得了显著的延迟与能耗下降。
Motivation: 边缘端部署 LLM 时，FFN 层的外部内存访问（EMA）是主要瓶颈。投机解码和 MoE 分别通过多 token 生成和稀疏专家激活降低开销，但两者的直接组合存在不兼容问题，限制了实际收益。
Method: EdgeXpert 提出两阶段方案：prefill 阶段采用 prompt-wise expert reuse，用轻量编码器识别重要 token 并构建共享专家集，对不重要 token 以缩减的专家预算路由；decode 阶段采用 depth-aware expert coalescing，利用同深度候选 token 的上下文相似性与互斥性，仅加载关键通道，并通过计算校准恢复精度而不增加额外内存访问。
Result: 在 Samsung 28nm 工艺、800 MHz 频率下综合实现，相比先前工作最高可降低 56.3% 延迟和 44.1% 能耗，同时保持接近基准的精度。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，通过软硬件协同设计解决投机解码与 MoE 的不兼容性，可以在边缘设备上实现内存高效的 LLM 推理，且不牺牲精度。

papers.title: Agentic self-driving microscopy benchmarks support qualification but do not necessarily generalize to unseen tasks
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents are increasingly being developed to control a wide range of scientific characterization tools including microscopes and synchrotron beamlines. Research into agentic control of physical infrastructure is nascent and there are few well-established paradigms for how to engineer an agentic system. There are many choices to make when designing a microscopy agent, including the choice of LLM, the number of agents to use, agent responsibilities and delegation rules, retrieval-augmented generation parameters, and more. When designing and optimizing an agentic microscope controller, researchers not only want to ensure that the agent can correctly perform known tasks but also that the agent can generalize to new tasks that it has not encountered before. In this study, we develop a benchmark and trace-logging framework that reveals a) how different choices of agent architecture impact performance at microscopy tasks and b) the limitations of benchmarks for predicting if a particular agent will perform well on unseen microscopy tasks. The framework was used to evaluate one-, two-, and three-agent graph topologies, five LLMs, RAG and context parameters, and operational constraints across 53 microscopy benchmark tests. In total, 105 agent configurations, 1,949 individual test runs, and 49,109 RAG retrievals were recorded. Direct comparisons showed clear differences in latency, token use, cost, and failure mode between configurations. However, surrogate models trained on agent architecture and test results did not reliably predict an agent's performance on new, unseen tasks. These results show that these benchmarks are useful for qualification, regression testing, diagnosis, and direct comparison, but the current heterogeneous test suite does not support a task-independent global configuration model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型智能体（LLM agent）控制显微镜等科学表征工具时的工程设计问题。作者开发了一个基准测试与轨迹日志（trace-logging）框架，在53项显微镜基准测试上评估了1、2、3智能体图拓扑、五个LLM、RAG与上下文参数以及操作约束，共记录105种配置、1,949次独立测试运行和49,109次RAG检索。结果表明不同配置在延迟、token用量、成本和失败模式上存在明确差异，但基于架构与历史测试结果训练的代理模型（surrogate model）无法可靠预测智能体在未见任务上的表现，说明当前基准适合资格验证但不支持任务无关的全局配置模型。
Motivation: 智能体控制物理基础设施的研究尚处于早期，缺乏成熟的工程化范式；设计者在优化显微镜智能体时不仅要求其正确完成已知任务，还希望其泛化到未见过的任务。该工作旨在揭示不同智能体架构选择对显微任务性能的影响，并检验现有基准对未见任务预测能力的局限。
Method: 开发了一个基准测试与trace-logging框架，系统变化智能体架构（1/2/3智能体图拓扑）、LLM选择、RAG与上下文参数以及操作约束，在53项显微镜任务上采集了105种配置、1,949次独立测试运行和49,109次RAG检索；随后训练基于架构和测试结果的代理模型，考察其能否预测新任务上的性能。
Result: 直接对比显示不同配置在延迟、token使用、成本和失败模式上差异明显；然而，代理模型未能可靠预测智能体在未见过任务上的表现，表明现有异构测试集不支持任务无关的全局配置模型。
Conclusion: 这些基准对资格验证（qualification）、回归测试、诊断和直接比较有用，但摘要明确指出基准表现并不必然泛化到未见任务，不能据此推断任务无关的全局最优配置。

papers.title: Evaluating Machine Learning Models for Post-Wildfire Debris-Flow Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Prediction of post-wildfire debris flows is critical for mitigating hazards to communities, infrastructure, and resources during intense rainfall in recently burned areas. However, identifying reliable machine learning models is complicated by overlapping debris-flow and non-debris-flow events in feature space, the need for model interpretability, and limited training data. This paper addresses these challenges through a systematic evaluation of machine learning models in terms of predictive performance, feature importance, and synthetic data augmentation. Using basin-scale observations of post-wildfire debris-flow events across the western United States, we compare 15 models, including the Tabular Prior-Data Fitted Network (TabPFN). Repeated stratified cross-validation shows that TabPFN achieves the highest unaugmented performance with a threat score of 0.637, closely followed by the best tree-based models. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) are used to identify the features driving predictions, revealing that short-duration rainfall intensity and storm accumulation consistently rank highest, while burn severity and terrain features contribute less. We further evaluate synthetic data augmentation using TabPFN-generated samples to address the scarcity of debris-flow observations. Synthetic augmentation improves the performance of all models except CNN, with the largest mean threat score increase of +0.041 among the deep learning models. By combining rigorous model benchmarking, interpretable feature analysis, and synthetic data augmentation, this work provides a comprehensive framework for improving post-wildfire debris-flow prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了用于山火后泥石流 (post-wildfire debris-flow) 预测的机器学习模型，使用美国西部流域尺度观测数据对比了 15 个模型（含 TabPFN）。重复分层交叉验证显示 TabPFN 在无增广数据时威胁评分 (threat score) 最高，达 0.637；SHAP 特征重要性分析表明短时降雨强度与风暴累积量贡献最大，燃烧严重度和地形特征贡献较小。基于 TabPFN 生成样本的合成数据增广除 CNN 外提升了所有模型性能，深度学习模型平均威胁评分最高提升 +0.041。
Motivation: 山火后强降雨引发的泥石流预测对社区和基础设施减灾至关重要，但可靠模型的选择受限于特征空间中泥石流与非泥石流事件重叠、模型可解释性需求以及训练数据稀缺。
Method: 作者对 15 个机器学习模型（包括 Tabular Prior-Data Fitted Network, TabPFN）进行系统性基准评估，采用重复分层交叉验证，并结合 SHAP 进行特征重要性分析，同时用 TabPFN 生成合成样本进行数据增广以缓解灾害样本不足。
Result: 无增广条件下 TabPFN 取得最高威胁评分 0.637，略优于最优树模型；SHAP 显示短历时降雨强度和风暴累积量排名最高，燃烧严重度与地形特征贡献较低；合成增广使除 CNN 外的所有模型性能提升，深度学习模型平均威胁评分最大提升 +0.041。
Conclusion: 通过模型基准测试、可解释特征分析和合成数据增广相结合，该工作为改进山火后泥石流预测提供了综合框架。
Relevance: 65

papers.title: OrchestraBench: Evaluating Multi-Agent Orchestration Failure Modes, Recovery, and Decomposition Quality
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent orchestration frameworks are moving from demos to production, yet benchmarks typically report task accuracy without diagnosing why a pipeline failed, where a cascade began, or which routing decision caused the breakdown. OrchestraBench evaluates failure, recovery, and decomposition through a controlled, seed-reproducible failure-injection harness over templated enterprise workflows. It introduces cascade radius and per-failure-mode recovery as primary metrics and compares routing policies with bootstrap confidence intervals and paired tests. On a 26-case gold-labelled diagnostic, a keyword/flag router scored 0% on adversarial cases with misleading or missing surface flags, whereas an intent-reasoning model router scored 100%, matching the oracle. Controlled mechanism probes with a real Claude agent over a verifiable arithmetic dependency chain revealed three failure-handling tiers across five MAST modes: tool faults recovered fully (1.0), ambiguous delegation recovered partially (0.30), and three latent or semantic modes never recovered (0.0). This ordering persisted when the computation was reframed as a loan-approval workflow and across Sonnet, Opus, and Haiku, although absolute rates shifted with context. Blind retry reproduced latent faults and increased time to detection, indicating that detection and attribution are necessary for containment. Cascade radius increased with pipeline depth (mean 0.9 to 4.7 across depths 3-7). A trusted-state repair ablation showed that apparent containment gains primarily came from the trusted-state signal rather than autonomous detection. These results are controlled-chain mechanism probes, not domain-workload claims.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OrchestraBench，一个用于多智能体编排 (multi-agent orchestration) 管线的可控故障注入评测框架，重点诊断失败模式、恢复能力与任务分解质量。其核心指标是级联半径 (cascade radius) 和逐失败模式恢复率 (per-failure-mode recovery)。在 26 例带金标的诊断集上，关键词/标志路由器在对抗性案例中得分为 0%，而基于意图推理的模型路由器得分为 100%；在真实 Claude agent 的可验证算术链机制探针中，五类 MAST 模式呈现三档恢复能力。摘要强调这些是受控链机制探针，而非领域工作负载结论。
Motivation: 现有多智能体编排基准通常只报告任务准确率，而不诊断管线为何失败、级联从何处开始、或哪个路由决策导致崩溃；随着编排框架从演示走向生产，这种可诊断性缺口变得重要。
Method: 通过可复现种子的故障注入 (failure-injection) 与模板化企业工作流构建受控测试环境；引入 cascade radius 和 per-failure-mode recovery 作为主要指标；用 bootstrap 置信区间和配对检验比较路由策略；并对可信状态修复 (trusted-state repair) 做消融以区分信号来源。

papers.title: A Paragraph is Worth a Thousand Captions: Rethinking Text Supervision for Vision-Language Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Contrastive vision-language models such as CLIP and BLIP are typically trained on short image captions, limiting their ability to retrieve images from detailed textual descriptions. While methods such as Long-CLIP extend the token limit through positional embedding interpolation, we ask a simpler question: does training text granularity alone determine long-text retrieval performance? We present a systematic study of supervision ranging from single captions to multi-sentence paragraphs for contrastive image-text retrieval. Using a synthetic pipeline based on Qwen2-VL and Llama 3.2 Vision, we generate diverse captions, hard negatives, and quality-scored paragraphs for 500K CC3M images. To isolate the effect of text granularity, we fine-tune only the BLIP text encoder while keeping the vision encoder frozen across 10 training configurations. Our paragraph-supervised models match Long-CLIP-L on ShareGPT4V and outperform it by more than 14 points on DOCCI for image-to-text retrieval, without architectural changes. We further show that paragraph supervision enables effective use of long token sequences, whereas caption-only training degrades beyond 60 tokens. Increasing caption diversity improves short-caption retrieval with diminishing returns, while paragraph supervision consistently benefits long-description benchmarks and hard negatives prove detrimental in text-only fine-tuning. Evaluations on Flickr30k, COCO, ShareGPT4V, and DOCCI provide a comprehensive analysis of the trade-offs between text granularity, retrieval direction, and description length.
papers.comment: Accepted at the MUCG workshop, ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究对比式视觉-语言检索中文本监督粒度的影响，提出一个核心问题：是否仅凭训练文本粒度就能决定长文本检索性能。作者基于 Qwen2-VL 和 Llama 3.2 Vision 构建合成流水线，为 500K 张 CC3M 图像生成多样化短描述、硬负样本和质量评分的段落，并在冻结视觉编码器的情况下仅微调 BLIP 文本编码器，比较从单句到多句段落的 10 种训练配置。结果表明，段落监督的模型在 ShareGPT4V 上匹配 Long-CLIP-L，并在 DOCCI 的图像到文本检索上超过其 14 个点以上，且无需架构改动。
Motivation: CLIP 和 BLIP 等对比式视觉-语言模型通常用短图像描述训练，难以从详细文本描述中检索图像；Long-CLIP 等方案通过位置编码插值扩展 token 上限，但训练文本粒度本身是否为决定性因素尚未被系统研究。
Method: 提出一种系统性的文本粒度研究框架，利用基于 Qwen2-VL 和 Llama 3.2 Vision 的合成流水线为 500K 张 CC3M 图像生成多样化描述、硬负样本以及按质量评分的段落；仅微调 BLIP 文本编码器并冻结视觉编码器，在 10 种训练配置中隔离文本粒度的影响。
Result: 段落监督模型在 ShareGPT4V 上匹配 Long-CLIP-L，并在 DOCCI 的图像到文本检索上领先超过 14 个点；仅用单句描述训练时，性能在超过 60 token 后下降；增加描述多样性可提升短描述检索但收益递减，而硬负样本在纯文本微调中反而有害。
Conclusion: 训练文本粒度本身即可决定长文本检索能力，段落监督使得长 token 序列能被有效利用；作者在 Flickr30k、COCO、ShareGPT4V 和 DOCCI 上的评估给出了文本粒度、检索方向与描述长度之间的权衡分析。

papers.title: IMMENSE: Inductive Multi-perspective User Classification in Social Networks
papers.abstract_en: Online social networks increasingly expose people to users who propagate discriminatory, hateful, and violent content. Young users, in particular, are vulnerable to exposure to such content, which can have harmful psychological and social repercussions. Given the massive scale of today's social networks, in terms of both published content and number of users, there is an urgent need for effective systems to aid Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs) in identifying and addressing users that disseminate malicious content. In this work we introduce IMMENSE, a machine learning-based method for detecting malicious social network users. Our approach adopts a hybrid classification strategy that integrates three perspectives: the semantics of the users' published content, their social relationships and their spatial information. Such contextual perspectives potentially enhance classification performance beyond text-only analysis. Importantly, IMMENSE employs an inductive learning approach, enabling it to classify previously unseen users or entire new networks without the need for costly and time-consuming model retraining procedures. Experiments carried out on a real-world Twitter/X dataset showed the superiority of IMMENSE against five state of the art competitors, confirming the benefits of its hybrid approach for effective deployment in social network monitoring systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IMMENSE，一种基于归纳学习 (inductive learning) 的多视角混合分类方法，用于检测社交网络中的恶意用户。该方法结合用户发布内容的语义、社交关系和空间信息三种视角，并可在无需重新训练的情况下对未见用户或全新网络进行分类。在真实 Twitter/X 数据集上的实验表明，其性能优于五个现有方法。
Motivation: 社交网络中歧视性、仇恨性和暴力内容日益泛滥，尤其对年轻用户造成心理和社会危害；执法机构 (LEAs) 需要在大规模网络中自动识别传播恶意内容的用户，而传统纯文本分析可能不够充分。
Method: 提出混合分类策略，整合三个视角：用户发布内容的语义、用户的社交关系以及用户的空间信息；并采用归纳式学习方式，使得模型能够对训练时未见过的用户或整个新网络进行预测，无需重新训练。
Result: 在真实 Twitter/X 数据集上的实验显示，IMMENSE 优于五个最先进 (state-of-the-art) 的对比方法，验证了混合视角在社交网络监测中的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为结合语义、社交和空间信息的归纳式混合方法有助于提升恶意用户检测性能，适合部署在社交网络监控系统中。

papers.title: Grad-CAM for Vision Transformers: A Systematic Taxonomy and Audit of Methodological Ambiguity in Explainable AI
papers.abstract_en: Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) is widely used to visualize model decisions, but it was originally formulated for convolutional neural networks, where spatial feature maps and channel dimensions have clear architectural meanings. Vision Transformers (ViTs) do not provide the same structure, instead representing images through tokens, attention, residual streams, and multimodal interactions. This paper presents a systematic taxonomy and literature audit of how Grad-CAM and related methods are adapted, justified, and reported for ViT-based architectures. From an initial search of more than 550 papers, we identify 175 papers that apply Grad-CAM or Grad-CAM-adjacent methods to ViTs. We find that most papers do not provide a full mathematical or implementation-level account of how Grad-CAM is adapted to transformer representations. To characterize this gap, we introduce a descriptive taxonomy of ViT Grad-CAM adaptations that makes explicit the feature locations, gradient targets, spatial reconstruction steps, and aggregation choices that are often left implicit. This taxonomy is not intended to prescribe a single correct adaptation, but to clarify the range of methodological choices being made. The study shows that Grad-CAM on ViTs is often treated as a trivial extension of CNN-based Grad-CAM, despite requiring nontrivial choices that affect rigor, reproducibility, and interpretation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 Grad-CAM 从 CNN 迁移到 Vision Transformer (ViT) 时缺乏明确数学与实现细节的问题，进行系统性的分类与文献审计。作者从 550 余篇论文中筛出 175 篇在 ViT 上应用 Grad-CAM 或类似方法的论文，发现大多数没有完整说明如何将 Grad-CAM 适配到 transformer 表征。文中提出一种描述性分类法，显式区分特征位置、梯度目标、空间重建步骤和聚合选择等常被隐式处理的环节。
Motivation: Grad-CAM 最初为 CNN 设计，其空间特征图和通道维度具有明确的架构含义；ViT 通过 token、注意力、残差流和多模态交互表示图像，缺乏相同结构，导致适配时存在大量隐含的方法学选择，影响严谨性、可复现性和解释可靠性。
Method: 论文采用文献审计与分类法构建方法：从超过 550 篇论文的初步检索中识别出 175 篇对 ViT 应用 Grad-CAM 或 Grad-CAM 邻近方法的论文，并据此提出一个描述性分类法，以显式刻画特征位置、梯度目标、空间重建步骤和聚合选择等维度。
Result: 研究发现大多数论文未提供 Grad-CAM 如何适配 transformer 表征的完整数学或实现级说明；ViT 上的 Grad-CAM 常被当作 CNN 版本的平凡扩展，尽管其中涉及影响严谨性、可复现性和解释的非平凡选择。
Conclusion: 该分类法并不旨在规定某种唯一正确的适配方式，而是为了阐明当前方法选择的多样性；作者强调这一方法学模糊性是 ViT 可解释性研究中的重要缺口。

papers.title: Posture and Sustainment Optimization Under Adversarial Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Pre-commitment posture, the assignment of military assets to theater locations before conflict scenarios resolve, is a critical and formally unsolved problem in joint operational planning. Current practice relies on greedy heuristics that maximize value and ignore geographic coverage and are structurally vulnerable to adversaries that target high-strategic value locations. This paper presents a scenario-weighted adversarially robust posture optimization engine for the Posture and sustainability allocation (PSA) problem, modeled as a finite-horizon Markov Decision Process over assets, theater locations, and time steps. We introduce the Composite Expected Value (CEV) optimizer, which places assets by maximizing scenario-weighted expected posture efficiency over a distribution of threat scenarios, and the RobustCEV extension, which iterates against a Bayesian adversary that updates its targeting distribution in response to observed placement. Across three experiments in an Indo-Pacific basing environment with 20 assets and 5 theater locations, we demonstrate that: (1) the greedy baseline incurs a permanent 25.1% posture efficiency penalty due to geographic under-coverage and a 57.3% scenario-weighted readiness collapse under value-correlated adversarial threat; (2) the CEV optimizer recovers up to 19.8% efficiency over greedy when the threat distribution carries a geographic signal, with a curated set of 5 to 20 scenarios sufficient to capture the majority of this gain; and (3) the RobustCEV extension recovers up to 158% efficiency relative to a naive optimizer when an adaptive adversary employs a deceptive threat prior. All findings are validated using paired t-tests with Bonferroni correction and two-level variance decomposition, confirming that the performance gaps reported are structural properties of placement strategies rather than sampling artifacts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究联合行动规划中的预先承诺态势问题（pre-commitment posture），即在冲突场景明确前把军事资产分配到战区位置。作者将该问题建模为有限时域马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），提出基于场景加权期望态势效率的 CEV 优化器，以及针对贝叶斯对抗者迭代更新的 RobustCEV 扩展。在 20 个资产、5 个战区位置的印太基地环境中，实验显示贪心基线存在结构性效率损失，而两种优化器在不同威胁分布下均能显著恢复性能。
Motivation: 当前军事规划实践依赖最大化价值并忽略地理覆盖的贪心启发式，且结构上易受针对高战略价值位置的对抗者攻击；预先承诺态势分配（PSA）问题此前未被形式化求解，需要一个能显式考虑地理覆盖和对抗不确定性的优化框架。
Method: 提出场景加权、对抗鲁棒的态势优化引擎，将 PSA 问题建模为资产、战区和时间步上的有限时域 MDP。核心是 CEV 优化器，通过最大化威胁场景分布下的场景加权期望态势效率来放置资产；RobustCEV 扩展则与一个根据观测到的放置更新其目标分布的贝叶斯对抗者迭代对抗。
Result: 在印太基地环境的三个实验中，贪心基线因地理覆盖不足产生永久性 25.1% 的态势效率惩罚，并在价值相关对抗威胁下出现 57.3% 的场景加权战备崩溃；当威胁分布带有地理信号时，CEV 优化器相对贪心最多恢复 19.8% 的效率，5 到 20 个精选场景即可捕获大部分收益；在面对采用欺骗性威胁先验的自适应对抗者时，RobustCEV 相对朴素优化器最多恢复 158% 的效率。所有结果均通过配对 t 检验（Bonferroni 校正）和两层方差分解验证。
Conclusion: 作者强调所报告的绩效差距是放置策略的结构性属性而非采样伪影，表明对比度、地理覆盖感知以及针对自适应对抗者的迭代鲁棒性对态势分配性能至关重要。

papers.title: An Emerging Retail Portfolio Management Application: Personalized, Tax-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Natural Language Goals
papers.abstract_en: Retail investors lack access to the kind of personalized, tax-aware portfolio management that institutional clients take for granted -- existing robo-advisors use static, rule-based allocation, and institutional-grade systems require account minimums and technology stacks unavailable to individual investors. We present a fully built, integration-tested application that closes this gap: a FastAPI backend and web dashboard that let a user describe an investment goal in plain language (e.g. "I want steady growth but need to sell some shares next month for a down payment"), routes that goal to one of six investment mandates, and produces a live, broker-integrated portfolio recommendation from athree-phase reinforcement learning system -- a self-supervised cross-asset encoder, a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) allocation policy with a learned intent router, and a lightweight LoRA adapter that personalizes recommendations from an individual's revealed brokerage behavior without retraining the shared model. The system is functionally complete and integration-tested end-to-end against a live brokerage API (Alpaca, paper-trading mode), including multi-user authentication, a trust first preview-before-apply confirmation flow, daily email digests, and an auditable action-integrity chain, but has not yet been opened to real end-users; we report this honestly as an emerging, pre-deployment application with a concrete path to full deployment, alongside 14-day walk-forward backtests (bootstrapped confidence intervals included) as preliminary, pre-deployment validation rather than production performance. We also report several practical engineering lessons -- silently-inactive integration paths, hanging third-party API calls, and the value of end-to-end empirical verification over trusting checkpoint metadata -- that we believe generalize to other applied RL systems built on external, live data sources.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍一个面向零售投资者的个性化、税收感知的投资组合管理应用：用户用自然语言描述目标，系统将其路由到六个投资授权之一，并由三阶段强化学习系统（自监督跨资产编码器、MoE 分配策略与意图路由器、LoRA 适配器）生成实时经纪商集成的投资组合推荐。应用已与 Alpaca 纸面交易 API 完成端到端集成测试，但尚未面向真实用户开放；作者以 14 天 walk-forward 回测作为部署前初步验证，并报告了若干工程经验。
Motivation: 零售投资者缺乏机构客户习以为常的个性化、税收感知的投资组合管理；现有 robo-advisor 使用静态规则分配，机构级系统又要求账户门槛和专用技术栈，普通个人投资者难以获得类似服务。
Method: 构建 FastAPI 后端与 Web 仪表盘，将自然语言投资目标映射到六个投资授权；核心是三级强化学习系统：自监督跨资产编码器、带学习意图路由器的 MoE 分配策略，以及基于个人经纪交易行为的 LoRA 适配器，用于在不重训共享模型的情况下个性化推荐。
Result: 系统功能完整并通过端到端集成测试（Alpaca 纸面交易、多用户认证、先预览后确认流程、每日邮件摘要、可审计行动完整性链）。作者给出 14 天 walk-forward 回测（含自举置信区间）作为初步部署前验证，并总结了几条工程经验，包括静默失效的集成路径、第三方 API 调用挂起，以及端到端实证验证优于信任 checkpoint 元数据。
Conclusion: 作者如实将该应用定位为新兴的、部署前系统，尚未对真实用户开放，回测结果只是初步验证而非生产性能；同时认为部分工程经验可推广到其他依赖外部实时数据源的应用型强化学习系统。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Rotations: AuroOFT for Expressive Quantized Orthogonal Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Quantized orthogonal fine-tuning (qoft) enables parameter-efficient adaptation of low-bit language models by learning structured activation rotations before frozen quantized weights. However, its task-specific updates remain constrained to linear orthogonal transformations, limiting input-dependent nonlinear corrections. We introduce AuroOFT, which keeps qoft as a stable quantization-compatible branch while attaching a zero-start gated low-rank nonlinear residual to each adapted linear layer. AuroOFT maps activations into an RMS-normalized compact latent space and uses adaptive nonlinear bases with bounded or token-dependent gating. The zero-initialized up projection makes AuroOFT functionally identical to qoft at initialization, while orthogonality remains a branch-level stability property rather than a property of the combined nonlinear layer. Under matched data, optimization, decoding, and parser protocols, AuroOFT improves Macro-6 over matched qoft by 1.30-2.70% on the 1.5B/3B Qwen2.5 settings, exceeds QLoRA by 6.52-10.62%, and saves 32.3-44.7% trainable parameters relative to QLoRA in representative scales. The small exam-style multiple-choice math set is treated only as a protocol-sensitivity diagnostic. Our code is available at the anonymous repository: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AuroOFT-F3FD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AuroOFT，一种在量化正交微调（qoft）基础上增加零初始化门控低秩非线性残差的方法，用于低比特语言模型的参数高效微调。该方法在初始化时与 qoft 功能等价，同时把正交性保留为分支级稳定属性而非整体非线性层的属性。在匹配的实验协议下，AuroOFT 在 Qwen2.5 1.5B/3B 上比 qoft 的 Macro-6 提升 1.30–2.70%，比 QLoRA 高 6.52–10.62%，并相对 QLoRA 节省 32.3–44.7% 的可训练参数。
Motivation: qoft 通过在冻结量化权重前学习结构化激活旋转来实现低比特语言模型的参数高效适配，但其任务特定更新局限于线性正交变换，无法提供依赖输入的（input-dependent）非线性修正，限制了表达能力。
Method: AuroOFT 保留 qoft 作为稳定的量化兼容分支，并为每个适配线性层附加一个零起点（zero-start）门控低秩非线性残差。激活被映射到 RMS 归一化的紧凑潜空间，使用带边界或 token 依赖门控的自适应非线性基；零初始化上投影保证初始时与 qoft 功能一致，正交性只是分支级稳定性属性。
Result: 在数据、优化、解码和解析协议均匹配的条件下，AuroOFT 在 Qwen2.5 1.5B/3B 上比匹配的 qoft 提升 Macro-6 1.30–2.70%，比 QLoRA 高 6.52–10.62%，并在代表性规模下相对 QLoRA 节省 32.3–44.7% 的可训练参数。
Conclusion: 作者强调 AuroOFT 在保持初始化等价与量化兼容的同时增强了非线性表达能力；小型选择题形式数学集仅被视为协议敏感性诊断（protocol-sensitivity diagnostic），而非核心评测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Full-Model Rollback: AuroSFT for Adapter-State Multi-Task Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-task supervised fine-tuning (SFT) often casts a heterogeneous data mixture as a single optimization problem, even though different tasks may reach their best generalization at different times. msft exposes this mismatch through task-wise roll-out, exclusion, and rollback, but its original formulation materializes the scheduler state as full-model checkpoints, making stage transitions costly to store, restore, and deploy. This paper introduces AuroSFT, a parameter-efficient framework that recasts the carried state of overfitting-aware multi-task SFT as a compact, mergeable adapter state. AuroSFT freezes the pretrained backbone, trains only injected adapters, rolls back adapter checkpoints at task-wise peaks, and continues on the remaining active mixture. At the layer level, each adapter applies an AuroRA-inspired adaptive nonlinear layer to a low-rank weight factor rather than to the sample representation. The resulting update remains linear in the input, rank-bounded, and exactly mergeable into the frozen projection. Under the retained-backbone comparison protocol, AuroSFT achieves 61.36% average accuracy, compared with 59.85% for the corresponding msft reference row, and obtains higher accuracy on all five backbones. Our code is available at the anonymous repository: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AuroSFT-80D1.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AuroSFT，一种参数高效的多任务监督微调 (SFT) 框架，将过拟合感知多任务训练中的调度器状态从全模型检查点重铸为紧凑、可合并的适配器状态。AuroSFT 冻结预训练骨干，只训练注入的适配器，在任务级峰值回滚适配器检查点，并在剩余活动任务混合上继续训练。在保留骨干的对比协议下，AuroSFT 在五个骨干上的平均准确率为 61.36%，高于对应 msft 参考行的 59.85%。
Motivation: 多任务 SFT 常把异构数据混合当作单一优化问题，而不同任务可能在各自不同时间达到最佳泛化；msft 通过任务级回滚暴露了这一不匹配，但其原始形式将调度器状态物化为全模型检查点，导致阶段转换在存储、恢复和部署上成本高昂。
Method: AuroSFT 冻结预训练骨干，仅训练注入的适配器，在任务级峰值回滚适配器检查点并继续剩余活动混合。层级别上，每个适配器采用受 AuroRA 启发的自适应非线性层，作用于低秩权重因子而非样本表示；得到的更新保持对输入线性、秩有界，并可精确合并到冻结投影中。
Result: 在保留骨干的对比协议下，AuroSFT 平均准确率为 61.36%，对应 msft 参考行为 59.85%，且在全部五个骨干上均获得更高准确率。
Conclusion: AuroSFT 表明将过拟合感知多任务 SFT 的状态重铸为紧凑、可合并的适配器状态，可以在降低全模型检查点带来的存储与部署开销的同时提升准确率；作者提供了匿名代码仓库。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PRISM: Priority-aware Rubric Internalization via Structured Multimodal Data Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Real-world multimodal instructions often bundle multiple requirements with unequal importance, yet most multimodal training data still reduce instruction following to answering one self-contained question. We study this gap through \textbf{rubric comprehension}, which casts the model not as a generator measured against rubrics but as an \textbf{executor} that follows them: given an image and a typed, prioritized rubric, the model must verify each rule before producing an overall judgment. To support this setting, we propose \textbf{PRISM}, a four-stage data synthesis framework that produces persona--task pairs, prefix-guided rule sets, quality-filtered rubrics, and structured verification traces. We further introduce \textbf{PRISM-Eval}, whose Loose and Strict metrics use deterministic matching against fixed labels and therefore require no inference-time judge model. With only 10K synthesized samples, PRISM lifts Qwen3-VL-4B from 9.5\% to 30.1\% Strict accuracy on PRISM-Eval while preserving average performance on general benchmarks, and the gains transfer to four additional open-source MLLMs across dense and MoE architectures, suggesting that structured rubric supervision is a scalable path toward multi-rule, priority-aware multimodal instruction following.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: WorldClaw: Agentic 3D Open-World Generation at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Generating large-scale, freely explorable 3D worlds from open-ended text remains challenging because a system must jointly maintain global spatial coherence, rich local content, and explicit assets suitable for downstream editing and reuse. We present WorldClaw, a fully agentic, coarse-to-fine framework for open-world 3D scene generation. Planning agents translate a text prompt into a structured specification of regions, terrain, assets, materials, and spatial relations. WorldClaw then builds a globally coherent terrain foundation from semantic layouts, reusable assets, generative or procedural materials, and a region-aware height field. For detail-demanding regions, it generates terrain-conditioned compositions, reconstructs editable textured meshes, and recovers their placement on the terrain; render-based agents further refine terrain, objects, appearance, and contacts. Across diverse open-world prompts, WorldClaw produces large-scale scenes with coherent spatial organization, visually compelling local content, and editable instance-level assets while preserving a consistent global terrain structure.
papers.comment: Authors are listed in alphabetical order by given name
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WorldClaw 是一个完全智能体驱动 (agentic)、从粗到细 (coarse-to-fine) 的开放世界 3D 场景生成框架，用于从开放式文本提示生成大规模、可自由探索的 3D 世界。规划智能体把文本提示转为区域、地形、资产、材质与空间关系的结构化规格，随后构建全局一致的地形基础，并对细节密集区域生成地形条件化的组合、重建可编辑纹理网格并恢复其在地形上的放置。摘要称该方法在多样化开放世界提示下能保持全局空间组织与地形一致性，同时产出视觉上吸引人的局部内容和可编辑的实例级资产。
Motivation: 从开放式文本生成大规模、可自由探索的 3D 世界仍然困难，因为系统需要同时保持全局空间连贯性、丰富的局部内容，以及适合下游编辑和复用的显式资产 (explicit assets)。
Method: 提出完全智能体化的粗到细框架：规划智能体将文本提示转换为包含区域、地形、资产、材质和空间关系的结构化规格；再用语义布局、可复用资产、生成式或程序化材质以及区域感知高度场构建全局一致的地形基础。对于细节要求高的区域，生成地形条件化组合、重建可编辑的纹理网格并恢复其在地形上的位置，并通过基于渲染的智能体进一步细化地形、物体、外观和接触关系。
Result: 摘要报告称在多种开放世界提示下，WorldClaw 能够生成具有连贯空间组织、视觉上吸引人的局部内容以及可编辑实例级资产的大规模场景，同时保持一致的全局地形结构。
Conclusion: 该框架通过将全局地形构建与局部细节生成解耦，并引入可分层的智能体管线，解决了开放世界 3D 生成中全局一致性、局部丰富性与可编辑性之间的权衡。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LUNAR: Benchmarking Personalized Large Language Models on UNiversal User BehAvioR Logs
papers.abstract_en: Existing personalized LLM benchmarks primarily rely on textual personas or isolated behavioral signals, providing limited evaluation of cross-domain behavioral personalization, where responses must be grounded in heterogeneous daily-life activities. To address this gap, we introduce LUNAR, the first benchmark for evaluating how LLMs personalize responses from longitudinal app interaction histories across universal daily-life domains, including clothing, food, housing, and mobility. To support scalable benchmark construction while mitigating data sparsity and privacy concerns, LUNAR uses a multi-stage coarse-to-fine synthesis pipeline grounded in real-world behavioral patterns. Fidelity analyses show closer alignment with real behavioral distributions than other synthetic benchmarks. Experiments on 19 mainstream LLMs show that access to behavioral logs is necessary but not sufficient for deep personalization: neither more context nor larger models guarantees better performance; effective personalization depends on selecting and integrating relevant evidence across domains. Direct retrieval of fine-grained behavioral records consistently outperforms compressed memory, while stronger personalization can come at the cost of privacy protection. These findings identify evidence selection, cross-domain integration, and privacy control as key challenges for personalized LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LUNAR，据称是首个基于跨领域日常生活行为日志（涵盖衣、食、住、行）评估大语言模型个性化能力的基准。LUNAR 采用多阶段由粗到细的合成流程，以真实行为模式为基础构建数据，缓解数据稀疏与隐私问题。对 19 个主流 LLM 的实验表明，行为日志是深度个性化的必要但不充分条件，证据选择、跨域整合与隐私控制是关键挑战。
Motivation: 现有个性化 LLM 基准主要依赖文本化人设或孤立的单一行为信号，难以评估需要依据异构日常活动进行响应的跨域行为个性化。
Method: 提出多阶段由粗到细的合成流水线（multi-stage coarse-to-fine synthesis pipeline），基于真实行为模式构建基准数据，并进行了与真实行为分布的一致性（fidelity）分析。
Result: 在 19 个主流 LLM 上的实验显示，更多上下文或更大模型并不必然带来更好性能；直接检索细粒度行为记录始终优于压缩记忆，且更强的个性化可能以隐私保护为代价。
Conclusion: 作者指出证据选择、跨域整合与隐私控制是当前个性化 LLM 面临的核心挑战，行为日志访问本身不足以实现深度个性化。

papers.title: Search2Skill: Skill Distillation Beyond Knowledge Boundaries Via Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reusable skills, which encapsulate the procedural knowledge required to solve real-world professional tasks, offer LLM-based agents a path toward self-evolution in expert domains. Existing self-evolving skill methods construct skills internally from the model's parametric knowledge or trajectories, and are therefore bounded by what the model already knows. However, the domain conventions and standard procedures underlying professional skills often lie beyond this boundary and are hard to elicit from the agent alone. To address this issue, we therefore propose a novel framework, Search2Skill, that automatically identifies the agent's capability gaps, searches external sources to address them, and distills the retrieved evidence into structured, reusable skills. Specifically, Search2Skill is optimized by a rubric-based reinforcement learning scheme that jointly improves when to search, how to search, and how to generate skills. Experiments on eight expert-level domains from three benchmarks show that Search2Skill consistently outperforms both search-augmented and trajectory-based skill-learning baselines under both streaming and held-out evaluation protocols. Further analyses show that the gains arise from skill abstraction rather than raw retrieved evidence, and that the acquired skills transfer across model scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Search2Skill 框架，利用基于评分细则的强化学习 (rubric-based reinforcement learning) 让 LLM 智能体自动识别自身能力缺口、检索外部证据，并将检索证据蒸馏为结构化可复用技能。在来自三个基准的八个专家级领域上，该方法在流式与留出评估协议下均优于搜索增强和基于轨迹的技能学习基线，且增益来自技能抽象而非原始检索证据。
Motivation: 现有自进化技能方法从模型参数化知识或历史轨迹内部构建技能，因而受限于模型已有的知识边界；专业技能的领域规范和标准流程往往在该边界之外，难以仅由智能体自身引出。
Method: 提出 Search2Skill 框架，通过基于规则 (rubric) 的强化学习联合优化三个环节：何时搜索、如何搜索以及如何生成技能，并将检索到的外部证据蒸馏为结构化可复用技能。
Result: 在三个基准的八个专家级领域上，Search2Skill 在 streaming 和 held-out 两种评估协议下均一致优于搜索增强与轨迹式技能学习基线；进一步分析表明收益源于技能抽象而非原始检索证据，且技能可跨模型规模迁移。
Conclusion: 摘要认为通过外部搜索填补能力缺口并蒸馏为可复用技能，可为 LLM 智能体在专家领域内实现自我进化提供一条路径。

papers.title: A Unified Causal Inference Framework for the Desirability of Outcome Ranking Paradigm in Benefit-Risk Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: We developed a unified covariate-adjusted causal inference framework for estimating the desirability of outcome ranking (DOOR) probability for benefit-risk evaluation in randomized trials and observational studies. The framework expresses the DOOR probability as a bilinear functional of the marginal ordinal outcome distributions under the two treatment strategies, estimates conditional ordinal distributions through sequential risk-set hazards, and derives the efficient influence function (EIF) of the DOOR probability. The point-estimation simulations compared G-computation, normalized inverse probability weighting (IPW), augmented IPW (AIPW), and targeted maximum likelihood estimation (TMLE), with nuisance functions estimated using generalized linear models or Super Learner (SL). TMLE-SL showed the strongest and most consistent point-estimation performance, with AIPW-SL ranking second. EIF-based inference was then evaluated for AIPW-SL and TMLE-SL, with and without cross-fitting, across settings varying in overlap, treatment-effect heterogeneity, and treatment allocation. CVTMLE-SL showed the strongest overall performance across DOOR-scale bias, recovery of the underlying ordinal distributions, standard-error accuracy, and confidence-interval coverage. We illustrate the methodology using data from the multidrug-resistant organism network of the Antibacterial Resistance Leadership Group.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的协变量调整因果推断框架，用于在随机试验和观察性研究中估计结局排序可取性（DOOR）概率，以支持获益-风险评估。框架将 DOOR 概率表示为两种治疗策略下边际有序结局分布的双线性泛函，通过序贯风险集危险度估计条件有序分布，并推导其高效影响函数（EIF）。模拟研究比较了 G-computation、归一化 IPW、AIPW 和 TMLE 等估计器，其中 TMLE-SL 点估计表现最强，交叉拟合的 CVTMLE-SL 在总体推断性能上最优，并用抗菌耐药领导集团的多重耐药菌网络数据做了示例说明。
Motivation: 获益-风险评估中需要一种稳健且可解释的指标来权衡治疗结局的不同维度，DOOR 范式虽被提出但缺乏统一的协变量调整因果推断框架，尤其是在观察性研究中的估计与推断方法尚不完善。
Method: 将 DOOR 概率表达为边际有序结局分布的双线性泛函，利用序贯风险集危险度建模条件有序分布，推导高效影响函数，并系统比较 G-computation、归一化 IPW、AIPW 与 TMLE（含 Super Learner 估计 nuisance 函数），同时评估交叉拟合对推断的影响。
Result: 模拟显示 TMLE-SL 的点估计性能最强且最稳定，AIPW-SL 次之；在 DOOR 尺度偏差、有序分布恢复、标准误准确性和置信区间覆盖率方面，CVTMLE-SL 总体表现最优。
Conclusion: 作者展示了统一框架下交叉拟合 TMLE 结合 Super Learner 对 DOOR 概率估计与推断的实用优势，并以多重耐药菌网络数据为例说明方法的应用。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 将 DOOR 概率表达为边际有序结局分布的双线性泛函，利用序贯风险集危险度建模条件有序分布，推导高效影响函数，并系统比较 G-computation、归一化 IPW、AIPW 与 TMLE（含 Super Learner 估计 nuisance 函数），同时评估交叉拟合对推断的影响。
summary_sections.result: 模拟显示 TMLE-SL 的点估计性能最强且最稳定，AIPW-SL 次之；在 DOOR 尺度偏差、有序分布恢复、标准误准确性和置信区间覆盖率方面，CVTMLE-SL 总体表现最优。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者展示了统一框架下交叉拟合 TMLE 结合 Super Learner 对 DOOR 概率估计与推断的实用优势，并以多重耐药菌网络数据为例说明方法的应用。

papers.title: Marginal Matching Does Not License Factorized Sampling: Auditing Conditional Style Leakage in Factorized Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Factorized generative models commonly regularize a latent style variable z_s by matching its marginal distribution to a fixed Gaussian prior and interpret this as evidence that the style representation is independent of class information. We show that this interpretation is incorrect. Matching only the marginal distribution places no constraint on the class-conditional distributions, allowing the latent style to remain highly predictive of the label despite appearing perfectly Gaussian in aggregate. We derive an exact decomposition showing that this mismatch is one of four conditions required for factorized sampling, and demonstrate that eliminating it is necessary but not sufficient to obtain the intended factorization. Empirically, our case-study model and four representative latent baselines achieve near-zero global MMD while still allowing a linear probe to recover class labels with 74%--100% accuracy (10% chance level). Our model reaches 99.15% clustering accuracy, whereas externally evaluated class-conditional generation succeeds only 16% of the time. This leakage remains under six independent perturbations involving model capacity, curriculum, prior geometry, and supervision across two datasets. Four mitigation strategies reduce probe accuracy to 21%--46%, although they leave within-class dependence largely unchanged. A post-hoc conditional prior improves externally evaluated class generation to 0.97 on MNIST without retraining but reaches only 0.41 on CIFAR-10, while an empirical style bank achieves 0.88 on CIFAR-10. These results demonstrate that no divergence computed solely on the marginal distribution of the style latent can certify independence from class labels, and that reporting marginal statistics alone does not verify the property commonly claimed in factorized generative models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出因子化生成模型（factorized generative models）中常见的做法——将风格隐变量 z_s 的边缘分布匹配到固定高斯先验——并不能保证风格表示与类别信息独立。作者推导出精确分解，说明边缘分布匹配只是因子化采样所需四个条件之一，消除该失配是必要但不充分条件。实验显示多个基线在全局 MMD 接近零的情况下，线性探针仍能以 74%–100% 的精度恢复类别标签（随机水平 10%），说明仅基于风格隐变量边缘分布的散度无法认证与类别的独立性。
Motivation: 现有因子化生成模型常以边缘分布匹配到高斯先验作为风格表示与类别解耦的证据，但这种统计量并未约束类条件分布，可能导致潜在的类别信息泄漏；作者试图从理论和实验上证明该验证方式不成立。
Method: 作者从理论上推导边缘匹配失配仅是因子化采样四个必要条件之一，并针对一个案例模型和四个代表性潜在变量基线，使用全局 MMD、线性探针、聚类准确率以及外部评估的类条件生成成功率来审计条件风格泄漏；同时测试六种扰动、四种缓解策略、后验条件先验和经验风格库。
Result: 案例模型与四个基线在近零全局 MMD 下，线性探针仍以 74%–100% 准确率恢复类别标签；模型聚类准确率达 99.15%，而外部评估的类条件生成仅 16% 成功。六种扰动（模型容量、课程、先验几何、监督方式，跨两个数据集）下泄漏持续存在；四种缓解策略将探针准确率降至 21%–46%，但类内依赖基本不变；后验条件先验使 MNIST 外部类生成达 0.97、CIFAR-10 仅 0.41，经验风格库在 CIFAR-10 达 0.88。
Conclusion: 任何仅基于风格隐变量边缘分布计算的散度都无法认证与类标签的独立性，仅报告边缘统计量不能验证因子化生成模型宣称的解耦性质。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Disentangling 3D Modeling from Spatial Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we explore an alternative paradigm for spatial reasoning by explicitly disentangling 3D perception from reasoning, rather than jointly acquiring implicit 3D perception and reasoning through large-scale training. Our key observation is that modern perception models excel at estimating continuous 3D geometry, whereas large language models (LLMs) are particularly effective at compositional and symbolic reasoning. Motivated by these complementary strengths, we propose the Disentangled Spatial Reasoner (DiSR), a simple yet effective framework that reconstructs the physical world into structured 3D evidence using off-the-shelf expert perception models and fine-tunes an LLM with LoRA to perform reasoning solely over this explicit geometric evidence. Without large-scale 3D VQA training or complex tool-use policies, DiSR achieves competitive performance on popular spatial reasoning benchmarks. Beyond its strong performance, DiSR offers improved interpretability, modularity, and computational efficiency, demonstrating that explicit separation of perception and reasoning is a scalable and effective alternative paradigm to end-to-end modeling for spatial intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Disentangled Spatial Reasoner (DiSR)，将 3D 感知与空间推理显式解耦：用现成感知模型把物理世界重建为结构化 3D 证据，再用 LoRA 微调的 LLM 仅基于这些几何证据进行推理。摘要称该方法无需大规模 3D VQA 训练或复杂工具使用策略，即在流行空间推理基准上取得有竞争力的性能，并带来更好的可解释性、模块化和计算效率。
Motivation: 现有方法通过大规模端到端训练隐式联合学习 3D 感知与推理；作者观察到感知模型擅长连续几何估计，而 LLM 擅长组合与符号推理，因此认为显式解耦是更可扩展的替代范式。
Method: 提出 DiSR 框架：使用现成的专家感知模型将物理世界重建为结构化 3D 证据（explicit geometric evidence），并用 LoRA 微调 LLM，使推理完全基于这些显式几何证据，不需要大规模 3D VQA 训练或复杂工具使用策略。
Result: 在流行空间推理基准上取得与端到端方法有竞争力的性能，同时提升可解释性、模块化与计算效率。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式分离感知与推理是空间智能中可扩展且有效的替代范式，而非继续端到端联合建模。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: One Qubit Can Beat One Bit: Quantum Advantage for Post-Training Quantization
papers.abstract_en: One-bit post-training quantization represents each weight using only its sign, requiring all deployment contexts to share the same binary weight matrix even when their activation statistics favor different sign patterns. We study this shared-sign constraint and introduce Quantum Random Access Quantization (QRAQ). This framework encodes context-dependent signs in a quantum random-access code and retrieves them via context-matched Pauli measurements. Under an explicit fresh-copy logical readout model, QRAQ produces an unbiased, context-specific binary surrogate with a tractable shot-noise penalty. We prove a row-wise separation from shared-sign one-bit PTQ with signed per-row scales. When the optimal context-wise signs are incompatible, QRAQ achieves a strictly lower ideal reconstruction risk. We also derive finite-shot and calibrated-noise conditions under which this separation is retained. Fixed-readout quantum schemes are classically simulable, so the relevant resource in this model is measurement incompatibility rather than quantization alone. Finally, we characterize the role of scale granularity, provide finite-sample certificates, and evaluate the predicted ideal, finite-shot, noisy, and multi-context regimes in simulator experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一位后训练量化 (post-training quantization, PTQ) 中共享符号约束带来的精度问题：每个权重仅用符号表示，所有部署上下文被迫共享同一二值权重矩阵，即使不同上下文的激活统计偏好不同符号模式。作者提出 Quantum Random Access Quantization (QRAQ)，将上下文相关的符号编码进量子随机访问码，并通过上下文匹配的泡利测量 (Pauli measurements) 读取；在显式 fresh-copy 逻辑读出模型下，QRAQ 产生无偏、上下文特定的二值代理，并带有可处理的散粒噪声惩罚，证明其理想重构风险可严格低于共享符号的一位 PTQ。
Motivation: 现有一位 PTQ 将每个权重压缩为仅含符号的形式，要求所有部署上下文共享同一个二值权重矩阵，而不同上下文的激活统计往往对应不同的最优符号模式，这个共享符号约束限制了量化精度。
Method: 提出量子随机访问量化 (QRAQ)：用量子随机访问码编码上下文相关的符号，并通过上下文匹配的泡利测量进行检索；在 fresh-copy 逻辑读出模型下推导无偏二值代理及其散粒噪声惩罚，同时给出有限样本与校准噪声条件下优势保持的证明，并分析尺度粒度与有限样本证书。
Result: 作者证明当最优上下文相关符号不兼容时，QRAQ 相比带符号逐行尺度的共享符号一位 PTQ 具有严格更低的理想重构风险；固定读出 (fixed-readout) 量子方案可经典模拟，因此该模型相关的资源是测量不相容性 (measurement incompatibility) 而非量化本身；模拟实验评估了理想、有限样本、噪声和多上下文等场景。
Conclusion: 摘要强调量子优势来源于测量不相容性而非量化本身，且该优势在有限样本和噪声条件下仍能保持；但固定读出方案可经典模拟，结论主要由理论证明和模拟器实验支撑。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Decoupling Perception from Description: Computation-Grounded Representation Alignment between Multivariate Time Series and Language
papers.abstract_en: Training multimodal models to align time series with language runs into a self-supervision trap. The usual recipe asks an LLM to read a series and write a description, so label quality is capped by the perceptual skill the model is supposed to learn. The data can never teach more than the labeler already knows. A second gap makes this worse: most datasets use a single variable, but the patterns that matter (cross-channel correlation, lead-lag structure, co-occurring anomalies) appear only with several variables, right where the labeling LLM's limits are most exposed. These two problems create a trilemma: existing methods are reliable, realistic, or scalable, but none achieves all three. We resolve this by decoupling perception from description. Deterministic code computes a set of statistics from real, open-source multivariate series; the LLM verbalizes those precomputed facts. Perception, which LLMs do poorly, is handled by computation, while the LLM handles expression. This produces CGTime, our 4B-parameter computation-grounded time-series-language model. CGTime outperforms far larger general-purpose models on multivariate understanding tasks: it attains the best multivariate fact score on our held-out benchmark (0.283 vs. 0.173 for GPT-4o-mini and 0.203 for GPT-5.4-nano), a gap that survives Holm-corrected paired significance tests against every baseline. It also states verifiable numerical facts in generated captions more accurately and covers a broader range of statistical properties.
papers.comment: 46 pages, 9 figures, including supplementary material. Submitted to AAAI 2027. Xinran Feng and Yi Xie contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出多模态时间序列-语言对齐训练存在“自监督陷阱”：让LLM读序列写描述会使标签质量被模型自身感知能力封顶，且多数数据集为单变量，难以覆盖跨通道相关、领先滞后结构等关键模式。作者提出将感知与描述解耦，用确定性代码从真实开源多元序列计算统计量，再由LLM将这些预计算事实言语化，得到4B参数的CGTime模型。CGTime在多元理解基准上取得最佳多元事实分数（0.283），显著优于GPT-4o-mini（0.173）和GPT-5.4-nano（0.203），并通过Holm校正的配对显著性检验。
Motivation: 现有时间序列-语言对齐方法依赖LLM自行感知序列并生成描述，标签质量受限于模型感知能力；同时常见数据集仅含单变量，而重要的跨变量模式只出现在多变量场景中，进一步放大了瓶颈。这导致现有方法在可靠、真实、可扩展三方面无法兼得。
Method: 将感知与描述解耦：确定性代码从真实开源多元时间序列中计算一组统计量，LLM只负责将这些预计算事实verbalize为自然语言描述，由此构建计算接地（computation-grounded）的训练数据和模型CGTime（4B参数）。
Result: 在留出基准上，CGTime的多元事实分数为0.283，超过GPT-4o-mini（0.173）和GPT-5.4-nano（0.203），差异经Holm校正配对显著性检验；其生成的标题中涉及可验证数值事实的部分更准确，覆盖的统计性质范围也更广。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将感知交给计算、将表达交给LLM可以突破自监督陷阱，使较小规模（4B）的专门模型在多元时间序列-语言理解上超越更大通用模型。
Relevance: 20

summary_sections.result: 在留出基准上，CGTime的多元事实分数为0.283，超过GPT-4o-mini（0.173）和GPT-5.4-nano（0.203），差异经Holm校正配对显著性检验；其生成的标题中涉及可验证数值事实的部分更准确，覆盖的统计性质范围也更广。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，将感知交给计算、将表达交给LLM可以突破自监督陷阱，使较小规模（4B）的专门模型在多元时间序列-语言理解上超越更大通用模型。

papers.title: In-Context Forcing: Uncovering Context Effects in Autoregressive Video Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Current few-step autoregressive video diffusion models depend on previous fully denoised clean frames as context for all denoising steps of the current frame. However, these clean frames leak excessive local details, which causes the model to take shortcuts, resulting in compromised temporal semantics and dynamics. Inspired by the perspective of diffusion as masking, we explore the impact of noisy contexts on few-step autoregressive generation. Yet, simply applying contexts with the same noise levels provides insufficient guidance, leading to poor temporal consistency. To resolve this dilemma, we introduce In-Context Forcing, a progressive autoregressive paradigm that utilizes contexts with decreasing noise levels. By applying less masking to distant frames and more masking to adjacent ones, this approach provides adaptive guidance, effectively ensuring both robust temporal consistency and high inter-frame dynamics. Furthermore, by decoupling the strict dependence on previous clean frames, our paradigm enables cross-frame parallel denoising, achieving substantial inference acceleration without sacrificing performance. Extensive experiments on VBench demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in both visual fidelity and inference speed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 In-Context Forcing，一种用于少步自回归视频扩散模型的渐进式自回归范式。核心思想是让当前帧在去噪过程中使用噪声水平递减的上下文帧：远帧少掩码、近帧多掩码，从而在保持时序一致性和帧间动态之间取得平衡。该方法还解耦了对前一帧干净帧的严格依赖，支持跨帧并行去噪以加速推理。实验在 VBench 上表明其视觉保真度和推理速度均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有少步自回归视频扩散模型使用完全去噪的干净帧作为所有去噪步骤的上下文，但这些干净帧泄露过多局部细节，导致模型走捷径，损害时序语义和动态表现。简单地对上下文施加相同噪声水平又会导致引导不足和时序一致性差。
Method: 提出 In-Context Forcing 范式：对上下文帧施加递减的噪声水平（远帧去噪更充分、近帧保留更多噪声），以提供自适应引导。同时通过解除对前序干净帧的严格依赖，实现跨帧并行去噪。
Result: 在 VBench 基准上的大量实验表明，该方法在视觉保真度和推理速度两方面都显著优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调递减噪声水平的上下文能够兼顾时序一致性与帧间动态，并带来可观的推理加速而不损失性能。
Relevance: 0
