papers.title: PPDL: LLM-Based Flows as Probabilistic Programs
papers.abstract_en: Building reliable applications that leverage large language models (LLMs) remains a significant challenge. While LLMs offer impressive capabilities across diverse tasks, their outputs often lack accuracy and provide no clear measure of confidence. This uncertainty compounds in flows of multiple calls to LLMs and other tools, making it difficult for developers and end-users to trust the results. This paper introduces a probabilistic language for programming LLM-based flows. It enables developers to quantify and propagate uncertainty throughout the application's flow, and experiment with different inference scaling techniques without adding a single line of code beyond the flow's logic. We present an experimental study to demonstrate this capability, and a case study building a theorem proving agent for the Rocq theorem prover.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PPDL，一种用于编程 LLM 流（LLM-based flows）的概率语言，将 LLM 调用视为概率程序，以量化和传播整个应用流中的不确定性。作者称该方法允许开发者在不修改流程逻辑的前提下试验不同的推理缩放（inference scaling）技术。实验研究展示了该能力，并给出了面向 Rocq 定理证明器的定理证明智能体案例。
Motivation: 基于 LLM 的应用虽然能力强大，但输出常缺乏准确性且无明确的置信度度量；多个 LLM 与工具调用组成的流会放大这种不确定性，使开发者和最终用户难以信任结果。
Method: 提出一种概率语言来形式化 LLM 流，使不确定性可以在流程中被量化并传播；用户无需改动流程逻辑即可尝试不同推理缩放技术。
Result: 摘要报告了验证该能力的实验研究，以及构建 Rocq 定理证明器用定理证明智能体的案例研究。
Conclusion: 作者认为这种概率程序视角有助于构建更可靠的 LLM 应用，但其证据以实验与案例研究为主，未给出定量性能对比。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Coherence-Oriented Dream Scene Visualisation
papers.abstract_en: Dreams can be emotionally intense but difficult to communicate. We describe the Dream Scene Visualiser (DSV) system which turns written dream descriptions into a temporal sequence of four panel images visualising the dream. This starts with a large language model prompted to split a dream description into four chronological parts. Then a text-to-image model produces images for each part with visual coherence maintained across the sequence, and DSV regenerates any image not suitably matching the text. We evaluate DSV over 50 visualisations from dream descriptions in DreamBank, and report quality, fidelity and coherence results via objective measures employing the CLIP, DINOv2 and Qwen2-VL vision-language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Dream Scene Visualiser (DSV) 系统，将书面梦境描述转化为按时间顺序排列的四格图像序列。系统先用大语言模型将梦境描述拆分为四个时间片段，再用文本到图像模型逐段生成图像，并通过在序列间保持视觉连贯性以及重新生成不匹配图像来提升质量。作者在 DreamBank 的 50 个梦境描述上评估了该系统，并使用 CLIP、DINOv2 和 Qwen2-VL 进行客观的质量、保真度和连贯性度量。
Motivation: 梦境常常情感强烈但难以向他人传达，现有工具缺乏将梦境文本自动转化为连贯视觉叙事序列的方法。
Method: DSV 分三步工作：用大语言模型将梦境描述按时间顺序拆分为四部分；用文本到图像模型为每部分生成图像并维持序列间的视觉连贯性；对与文本匹配不佳的图像进行重新生成。
Result: 摘要报告在 DreamBank 的 50 个梦境描述可视化上，通过 CLIP、DINOv2 和 Qwen2-VL 等视觉语言模型进行了质量、保真度和连贯性的客观评估。
Conclusion: 作者展示了基于大语言模型拆分与文本到图像生成相结合的梦境可视化流程，并强调其评估方案采用多种视觉基础模型进行客观度量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Analysis of Numerical Localisation in LLM Translations
papers.abstract_en: The work of Tang et. al. (2025) on numerical translation is extended by analysing the capability of five large language models (LLMs) for the localisation of times, numbers, and dates instead of translation. Models were selected that could be loaded onto and run on commodity hardware and a baseline quality for each mode is computed, then three different strategies to improve on that accuracy were tested. In contrast to Tang et. al., it was discovered that on the tested LLMs, embedding the localisation principles into the prompt context provided a statistically significant improvement in accuracy compared to direct translation or the alternative strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文扩展 Tang et al. (2025) 的数值翻译工作，转而分析五个大语言模型 (LLM) 对时间、数字和日期的本地化 (localisation) 能力，而非翻译。模型选定为可在普通消费级硬件 (commodity hardware) 上运行，先计算每种模式的基线质量，再测试三种改进策略。与 Tang et al. 不同，作者发现在这些 LLM 上，将本地化原则嵌入提示上下文 (prompt context) 比直接翻译或替代策略带来统计显著的准确率提升。
Motivation: Tang et al. 的数值翻译工作未覆盖时间、数字、日期在翻译中的本地化问题；本文希望评估可在普通硬件上运行的 LLM 在该任务上的表现，并寻找可行的改进方式。
Method: 选取五个可在 commodity hardware 上运行的 LLM，针对时间、数字、日期分别计算本地化基线质量，然后测试三种改进策略，并将其中将本地化原则嵌入 prompt context 的做法与直接翻译及其他策略进行比较。
Result: 与 Tang et al. 的结论相反，在测试的 LLM 上，将本地化原则嵌入提示上下文相比直接翻译和其他替代策略带来统计显著的准确率提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，对于这些可在 commodity hardware 上运行的 LLM，将本地化原则嵌入提示上下文是有效的改进手段；该结论限于所测试的模型和本地化任务本身。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Quality Diversity for Reliable Data Driven Time-Use Optimization
papers.abstract_en: The daily allocation of the finite 24-hour time budget is strongly associated with physical, mental, and cognitive health. While predictive models can estimate the relationship between time-use compositions and health outcomes such as body mass index, life satisfaction, and cognition, most optimization approaches focus only on maximizing expected benefit and do not consider the uncertainty inherent in data-driven prediction. Ignoring uncertainty in health-related decisions can lead to unrealistic time-use recommendations. To address this gap, we introduce an uncertainty quantification Quality Diversity (QD) framework for a more reliable time-use recommendation. Objective functions are derived using compositional data analysis using a large child cohort dataset n > 1000, to capture the relationship between daily activity compositions and multiple health indicators. We develop a new approach that incorporates predictive uncertainty into QD processes and produces more reliable recommendations that balance the expected health benefits with the confidence of the model. We explore the solution space through variable-based and objective-based behavioral representations, revealing diverse high-quality time-use composition and explicit relationships between health outcomes under uncertainty. By embedding uncertainty directly into optimization, our framework shifts the time-use recommendations toward regions of lower uncertainty while preserving high-quality structures for more reliable decision-making in behavioral health.
papers.comment: To appear in the Proceedings of Parallel Problem Solving from Nature (PPSN 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个将预测不确定性纳入质量多样性（Quality Diversity, QD）优化的框架，用于更可靠的日常时间使用（time-use）推荐。目标函数基于成分数据分析（compositional data analysis），在儿童队列（n > 1000）上建模每日活动组成与多项健康指标的关系。作者通过变量基与目标基两种行为表示探索解空间，得到多样化的高质量时间使用组成，并揭示不确定性下健康结果之间的显式关系。
Motivation: 现有时间使用优化大多只最大化期望健康收益，忽略数据驱动预测本身的不确定性，可能导致不切实际的行为推荐。
Method: 提出不确定性量化 QD 框架，将预测不确定性嵌入优化过程；目标函数由成分数据分析和大规模儿童队列数据推导，并通过变量基和客观基的行为表示来探索解空间。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果；定性结果表明该方法能生成在期望健康收益与模型置信度之间取得平衡的更可靠推荐，并在不确定性下发现多样化的高质量时间使用结构。
Conclusion: 将不确定性直接嵌入优化后，框架将时间使用推荐导向低不确定性区域，同时保留高质量结构，从而支持行为健康领域更可靠的决策。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TriQua: Reconciling Granularity and Context in Factuality Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: The "decompose-then-verify" paradigm for LLM factuality evaluation faces a fundamental trade-off: atomic facts, i.e., one sentence conveying one unit of information, often omit essential context, while broader statements lack the granularity needed for precise assessment. To address this, we introduce TriQua, a framework that flexibly models facts based on their complexity. Simple claims are extracted as standard triples, while complex claims are represented as hyperrelational facts by attaching auxiliary contextual qualifiers. This adaptive structure preserves the necessary context for accurate retrieval and verification without sacrificing atomicity. Furthermore, TriQua's verification process directly annotates concrete errors within specific triples and qualifiers, providing fine-grained explainability for error detection. Alongside the framework, we propose TriQuaScore to quantify the factuality of these structured fact units. Empirical evaluations show that TriQuaScore strongly aligns with human annotated factuality scores, TriQua achieves robust decomposition quality, and outperforms existing decomposition-based frameworks in evidence-based fact verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TriQua 框架，针对 LLM 事实性评估中“分解-验证”范式的粒度与上下文权衡：简单声明提取为标准三元组，复杂声明则表示为附加上下文限定符的超关系事实，并配套提出 TriQuaScore 来量化结构化事实单元的事实性。摘要称 TriQuaScore 与人工标注的事实性分数高度一致，TriQua 分解质量稳健，并在基于证据的事实验证上优于现有基于分解的框架。
Motivation: 原子事实在拆解时常丢失必要上下文，而更宽泛的表述又缺乏精确评估所需的粒度；现有“分解-验证”范式在这两者之间存在根本性权衡。
Method: TriQua 根据事实复杂度弹性建模：简单声明用标准三元组，复杂声明用超关系事实并附加辅助上下文限定符，以保留检索与验证所需语境；验证过程直接在具体三元组和限定符上标注错误，提供细粒度可解释性；TriQuaScore 用于量化这些结构化事实单元的事实性。

papers.title: NeuroAdaptTrainer: A Fiji/ImageJ Plugin for YOLO-Based Neuron Segmentation, InteractiveCorrection and Transfer Learning
papers.abstract_en: Neuron counting and segmentation in microscopy images of neuronal cultures is a routine and time-consuming task in neuroscience research, traditionally performed through manual inspection or semi-automatic tools. We present NeuroAdaptTrainer, an open-source Fiji/ImageJ plugin that integrates a YOLO instance-segmentation model directly into the microscopist's workflow. The plugin allows a user to run automatic neuron detection on a single image or a batch of images, manually correct the resulting detections from within Fiji, and use those corrections to adapt the model to new imaging conditions via transfer learning. A built-in external validation module allows the base and adapted models to be compared quantitatively on a held-out annotated set. NeuroAdaptTrainer lowers the barrier for non-specialist users to benefit from deep-learning-based segmentation while keeping expert supervision at the center of the workflow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 NeuroAdaptTrainer，一个开源的 Fiji/ImageJ 插件，将 YOLO 实例分割模型嵌入显微镜工作流，用于神经元培养图像的自动计数与分割。插件支持单张或批量自动检测、在 Fiji 内手动修正检测结果，并利用这些修正通过迁移学习（transfer learning）使模型适应新的成像条件。内置的外部验证模块可在独立标注集上定量比较基础模型与自适应模型。摘要未报告具体数值结果。
Motivation: 神经元计数与分割是神经科学研究中常规且耗时的任务，传统上依赖人工检查或半自动工具；非专业用户使用基于深度学习的分割方法存在较高门槛。
Method: 在 Fiji/ImageJ 中集成 YOLO 实例分割模型，用户可对单张或批量图像运行自动神经元检测，在 Fiji 界面内手动修正检测结果，并通过迁移学习将这些修正用于模型适配新成像条件；同时提供内置外部验证模块，用于在留出标注集上定量比较基础模型与适配后的模型。
Result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果，其核心宣称是这种交互式工作流降低了非专业用户使用深度学习分割的门槛，同时将专家监督保留在流程中心。
Conclusion: 作者强调该插件使深度学习方法对非专业用户更可及，并让专家监督保持核心地位；其适用场景限于神经元培养显微镜图像中的 YOLO 实例分割与迁移学习。

papers.title: Project2Task: Graph-Guided Project-Level Planning for Autonomous Research
papers.abstract_en: Research agents can increasingly search literature, propose hypotheses, generate code, run experiments, and draft manuscripts from a single topic. However, a research project is not merely a larger task: it is a long-horizon agenda that must be advanced through multiple bounded tasks with distinct but related objectives, parallel alternatives, and dependency-aware sequences. Existing single-task systems often treat the project as one oversized task, produce a flat set of vague or overlapping tasks, or leave task boundaries and execution order to manual coordination. We introduce Project2Task, a graph-guided project-level planning layer for autonomous research. Given a project brief, it represents candidate contributions as innovation atoms and organizes them in a directed lineage graph. A lightweight Bernoulli block-model objective selects among horizontal, vertical, and hybrid portfolio decompositions. Project2Task then generates bounded tasks with explicit contribution ownership, repairs overlaps and missing execution fields, and emits dependency-aware task contracts that specify objectives, inputs, expected artifacts, evaluation requirements, boundary constraints, dependencies, and execution order. The contracts are independent of any particular downstream research executor and support integration of task outputs into a coherent project-level result. On a benchmark of ten project briefs yielding roughly 30 tasks, manuscript-based portfolio evaluation gives Project2Task an average quality score of 7.15, compared with 4.58 for the Brief Baseline and 5.31 for the Topic-only Setting. Integrating its contracts with AutoResearchClaw increases average downstream task accuracy from 0.536 to 0.759. These results demonstrate the value of explicit project-to-task planning for producing coherent, non-redundant, and executable research-task portfolios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Project2Task，一个面向自主科研智能体的图引导项目级规划层。它将项目简报中的候选贡献表示为创新原子（innovation atoms），组织成有向谱系图（lineage graph），并通过轻量级 Bernoulli block-model 目标在水平、垂直和混合组合分解之间选择，最终生成带依赖感知的任务契约，指定目标、输入、预期产物、评估要求、边界约束、依赖和执行顺序。在十个项目简报约 30 个任务的基准上，基于手稿的整体评估平均质量分为 7.15（Brief Baseline 为 4.58，Topic-only Setting 为 5.31）；与 AutoResearchClaw 集成后，平均下游任务准确率从 0.536 提升到 0.759。
Motivation: 现有单任务研究系统常把整个研究项目当作一个超大任务，或生成扁平、含糊、重叠的任务集合，任务边界和执行顺序依赖人工协调。作者认为研究项目本质上是多阶段、有并行替代方案和依赖感知顺序的长程议程，需要显式的项目级规划。
Method: Project2Task 先根据项目简报把候选贡献组织为创新原子，并以有向谱系图表示其关系；再用轻量 Bernoulli block-model 目标在水平、垂直和混合组合分解中做选择；随后修复任务重叠和缺失执行字段，生成依赖感知的任务契约。契约与具体下游研究执行器解耦，并支持将任务输出整合为连贯的项目级结果。
Result: 在十个项目简报（约 30 个任务）的基准上，基于手稿的集成评估平均质量分为 7.15，显著高于 Brief Baseline 的 4.58 和 Topic-only Setting 的 5.31。将契约集成到 AutoResearchClaw 后，平均下游任务准确率从 0.536 提升到 0.759。
Conclusion: 作者强调显式的项目到任务规划能够生成连贯、非冗余且可执行的研究任务组合，并且对下游执行准确率有可量化的提升。任务契约独立于具体执行器，可作为不同研究代理之间的通用接口。

papers.title: Small Foundation Models of Human Cognition and Behaviour
papers.abstract_en: Large language models fine-tuned on human behavioural data have emerged as general-purpose cognitive proxies, but the scale this requires, and whether these models process task structure or exploit statistical shortcuts, remain open questions. We train fourteen models from 135M to 14B parameters across four architecture families on Psych-101, a dataset of 10.7 million trial-level choices from 160 experiments. In-distribution, scale barely matters. The models fall within a narrow band, as though against a ceiling, and 0.6B to 1B parameters suffice to match a 70B baseline on held-out participants. Out-of-distribution, that band opens into a markedly steeper scaling gradient, with larger models clearly advantaged in generalisation to novel task structure. To determine what information these models use, we run two diagnostics. We progressively strip four prompt channels -- task instructions, experimental stimuli, outcome feedback, and choice history -- across 27 experiments, and permute trial order. Masking the content of stimuli and feedback destroys 75.7% of learned information and pushes models below chance, demonstrating that choice history alone does not account for performance. Permutation reveals invariance on tasks with independent trials but sensitivity where trial order is determined by prior responses. Small cognitively fine-tuned models therefore show promise as noise ceiling estimators for psychological experiments, though their scope remains bounded by the paradigms seen in training.
papers.comment: published as a conference paper at COLM'26
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 Psych-101 数据集（来自 160 个实验的 1070 万个 trial 级选择）上训练了四个架构家族、规模从 135M 到 14B 的 14 个模型，考察小规模认知微调基础模型的行为。结果显示分布内（in-distribution）尺度几乎不重要，0.6B 到 1B 参数即可匹配 70B 基线；分布外（out-of-distribution）则出现明显更陡的扩展梯度，大模型在泛化到新任务结构时更有优势。作者还通过剥离提示通道和排列试验顺序两项诊断来判定模型使用的信息。
Motivation: 大语言模型在人类行为数据上微调后已成为通用认知代理，但所需的模型规模，以及模型究竟是处理任务结构还是利用统计捷径，仍是未解决的问题。
Method: 在 Psych-101 数据集上训练 14 个模型（135M 到 14B 参数，四种架构家族）；随后在 27 个实验中逐步剥离任务指令、实验刺激、结果反馈和选择历史四个提示通道，并排列试验顺序，以检测模型依赖的信息来源。
Result: 分布内模型的性能落在一个窄带内，尺度几乎无影响，0.6B 到 1B 参数即可匹敌 70B 基线；分布外的扩展梯度明显更陡，大模型在泛化到新颖任务结构时占优。掩蔽刺激与反馈内容会破坏 75.7% 的学习信息并使模型低于随机水平，而排列试验顺序在独立试验任务上表现不变、在由先前响应决定试验顺序的任务上敏感。
Conclusion: 小的认知微调模型有望作为心理实验的噪声天花板估计器（noise ceiling estimators），但其适用范围受限于训练中所见过的实验范式。

papers.title: When Privileged Guidance Misaligns: State-Matched Routing and Contextualized Self-Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents
papers.abstract_en: Privileged on-policy distillation provides dense supervision for multi-turn agents by allowing a synchronized teacher to re-score the student's response at every turn with access to training-only references, such as successful trajectories. In interactive environments, however, the student's preceding actions continually change the execution state. As the student takes different actions or completes subgoals in a different order, its rollout may reach states not covered by the reference, making the reference an unreliable source of guidance for the state actually reached. Applying privileged distillation indiscriminately therefore creates state--reference mismatch. This mismatch motivates a central objective: providing privileged reference guidance that remains compatible with the student's current execution state. We introduce State-Matched Routing and Contextualized Self-Distillation (SMRC-SD), which explicitly determines when and how a privileged trajectory should guide an on-policy student. At each turn, SMRC-SD verifies whether the student's current execution state matches a supported state along the reference trajectory. Distillation is applied only at matched states, filtering out turns for which the reference lacks locally compatible guidance. For each matched state, SMRC-SD further constructs state-conditioned teacher context from the successful trajectory, grounding supervision in the state actually reached. Across ALFWorld and WebShop, SMRC-SD consistently outperforms unconditional successful full-path distillation. With Qwen3-1.7B, it improves task success from $0.746$ to $0.865$ on ALFWorld and from $0.574$ to $0.693$ on WebShop. Controlled routing and context ablations support both selecting locally supported turns and constructing state-compatible teacher context as contributors to these gains. Code is available at https://github.com/liujunzhuo/SMRC-SD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多轮智能体的特权同策略蒸馏（privileged on-policy distillation）中出现的状态-参考不匹配问题，提出 SMRC-SD（State-Matched Routing and Contextualized Self-Distillation）。该方法在每个回合先验证学生当前执行状态是否与参考轨迹中的受支持状态匹配，仅在匹配状态下进行蒸馏，并为匹配状态构造状态条件下的教师上下文。在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上，使用 Qwen3-1.7B 时该方法一致优于无条件的成功完整路径蒸馏。
Motivation: 交互环境中学生先前的动作会持续改变执行状态，其轨迹可能到达参考轨迹未覆盖的状态，使特权参考在这些状态下成为不可靠的监督来源；不加区分地应用特权蒸馏会造成状态-参考不匹配。
Method: SMRC-SD 显式决定特权轨迹应在何时以及如何指导同策略学生：逐回合验证当前执行状态是否匹配参考轨迹中的受支持状态，仅在匹配状态应用蒸馏以过滤掉缺乏局部兼容指导的回合；对每个匹配状态，再从成功轨迹构建状态条件化的教师上下文，使监督基于实际到达的状态。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 上任务成功率从 0.746 提升到 0.865，在 WebShop 上从 0.574 提升到 0.693（使用 Qwen3-1.7B），且一致优于无条件的成功完整路径蒸馏；路由与上下文消融实验表明，选择局部受支持的回合与构造状态兼容的教师上下文均有贡献。
Conclusion: 作者认为，显式状态匹配与状态兼容的教师上下文是提升特权蒸馏在多轮智能体中有效性的关键；实验范围限于 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 两个基准。

summary_sections.motivation: 交互环境中学生先前的动作会持续改变执行状态，其轨迹可能到达参考轨迹未覆盖的状态，使特权参考在这些状态下成为不可靠的监督来源；不加区分地应用特权蒸馏会造成状态-参考不匹配。
summary_sections.method: SMRC-SD 显式决定特权轨迹应在何时以及如何指导同策略学生：逐回合验证当前执行状态是否匹配参考轨迹中的受支持状态，仅在匹配状态应用蒸馏以过滤掉缺乏局部兼容指导的回合；对每个匹配状态，再从成功轨迹构建状态条件化的教师上下文，使监督基于实际到达的状态。
summary_sections.result: 在 ALFWorld 上任务成功率从 0.746 提升到 0.865，在 WebShop 上从 0.574 提升到 0.693（使用 Qwen3-1.7B），且一致优于无条件的成功完整路径蒸馏；路由与上下文消融实验表明，选择局部受支持的回合与构造状态兼容的教师上下文均有贡献。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为，显式状态匹配与状态兼容的教师上下文是提升特权蒸馏在多轮智能体中有效性的关键；实验范围限于 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 两个基准。

papers.title: PD-GS: Phoneme-Driven 3DGS for Audio-Driven Talking Heads
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables fast, photorealistic talking-head rendering, yet accurate lip articulation remains elusive: mouth motion is often over-smoothed and may violate hard articulatory constraints such as bilabial closures, producing the notorious ``leaky mouth'' artifact. A key difficulty is that brief, discrete articulatory events are inferred from a continuous acoustic embedding under a regression objective, which biases predictions toward averaged mouth configurations. While modern self-supervised speech encoders provide rich prosodic and phonetic cues, they do not provide an explicit, frame-aligned linguistic target that reliably disambiguates closure-level events. We propose \textbf{Phoneme-Driven Gaussian Splatting (PD-GS)}, which augments a 3DGS talker with time-aligned phoneme tokens obtained from an automatic ASR and forced-alignment pipeline. Our core component, the \textbf{Linguistic Fusion Module (LFM)}, adaptively fuses continuous audio context with discrete phoneme embeddings through a learned gate, allowing the model to preserve smooth audio-driven dynamics while strengthening phoneme guidance on articulation-critical segments. PD-GS is trained purely from monocular video using image reconstruction and lip landmark supervision. On HDTF, PD-GS achieves the best lip geometry among the compared baselines (LMD 2.66) and qualitatively reduces closure violations in challenging phoneme sequences, yielding more linguistically faithful neural avatars.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出音素驱动的 3D Gaussian Splatting (PD-GS) 用于音频驱动说话头生成，通过 ASR 与强制对齐获得时间对齐的音素 token，并引入语言融合模块 (LFM) 融合连续音频上下文与离散音素嵌入，以缓解口型过平滑和“漏嘴”(leaky mouth) 伪影。模型仅由单目视频训练，使用图像重建和唇部关键点监督。在 HDTF 上达到 LMD 2.66，减少闭合违规。
Motivation: 现有 3DGS 说话头生成中，口型运动常被过平滑，且可能违反双唇闭合等硬性发音约束，产生 leaky mouth 伪影；原因是回归目标将离散发音事件从连续音频嵌入中推断，倾向平均化口型配置。
Method: 提出 PD-GS，在 3DGS 说话头中加入时间对齐的音素 token，核心为 Linguistic Fusion Module (LFM)，通过学习的门控自适应融合连续音频上下文与离散音素嵌入，在发音关键段加强音素引导。训练仅用单目视频，监督为图像重建与唇部关键点。
Result: 在 HDTF 上，PD-GS 与对比基线相比取得最佳唇部几何 (LMD 2.66)，并在具有挑战性的音素序列中定性减少闭合违规。
Conclusion: 摘要认为融入显式、帧对齐的语音目标 (音素) 能产生更具语言保真度的神经化身，改善 3DGS 说话头的发音准确性。

papers.title: A Survey of Adversarial Efficiency Degradation for Vision Transformer by Exploiting Input-adaptive Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) increasingly rely on input-adaptive inference, such as token pruning and early halting, to meet energy and latency budgets. This survey examines a recent class of adversarial efficiency degradation attacks that target these mechanisms to increase computation without necessarily degrading accuracy. We unify and compare two representative attacks, SlowFormer (a universal adversarial patch) and DeSparsify (per-image perturbations), across three popular token-pruning frameworks: A-ViT, ATS, and AdaViT. We standardize reporting using GFLOPs, accuracy loss, and an Attack Success (AS) metric that measures how much of the model's compute savings the attack takes away. Understanding these attacks is crucial for designing countermeasures that not only mitigate risk but also remain lightweight, since deployment often occurs in low-power settings such as mobile or embedded devices. To organize our analysis, we focus on three questions: how input-adaptive optimizations (e.g., token pruning and early halting) create attack surfaces for efficiency degradation; how such attacks operate in practice and which optimizations are most vulnerable; and which defenses exist today and whether they meaningfully restore efficiency under attack.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于视觉 Transformer（ViT）中输入自适应推理机制所面临的对抗性效率退化攻击的综述。作者统一比较了 SlowFormer（通用对抗补丁）和 DeSparsify（逐图像扰动）两类攻击，在 A-ViT、ATS 和 AdaViT 三个 token 剪枝框架上的效果，并采用 GFLOPs、准确率损失和 Attack Success（AS）指标标准化评估。摘要关注三个问题：输入自适应优化如何产生攻击面、哪些优化最易受攻击，以及现有防御能否在保持轻量的前提下恢复效率。
Motivation: ViT 越来越多地依赖 token 剪枝和 early halting 等输入自适应推理来满足能耗和延迟预算，但这些机制可被攻击者利用，在不明显损害精度的前提下大幅增加计算量。理解这类攻击对设计轻量级防御至关重要，因为部署环境通常是移动或嵌入式低功耗设备。
Method: 该综述将两类代表性攻击（SlowFormer 与 DeSparsify）在三个 token 剪枝框架（A-ViT、ATS、AdaViT）上统一比较，并标准化了 GFLOPs、准确率损失和攻击成功率（AS，即攻击从模型计算节省中夺回的比例）等报告指标。分析围绕三个问题组织：攻击面来源、攻击实际运作方式与最脆弱的优化、现有防御及有效性。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但描述了统一的攻击对比框架和标准化指标，明确了所考察的攻击类别与受害框架，并指出这些攻击能在不必然降低精度的情况下增加计算开销。
Conclusion: 作者强调设计对策时不仅要缓解攻击风险，还必须保持轻量，因为部署常在低功耗移动或嵌入式设备上。该综述的结论是系统化理解此类攻击是设计有效且实用的轻量级防御的前提。

papers.title: VLAff: Vision-Language-Affordance Model for Unified Actionable Affordances
papers.abstract_en: Learning manipulation skills from human videos is promising for scalable robot learning. However, the embodiment mismatch between humans and robots makes this challenging. One promising solution is to learn object-centric actionable affordances that are embodiment-agnostic. In this work, we propose a framework that leverages egocentric human videos with state-of-the-art 3D Structure-from-Motion and hand mesh reconstruction to extract actionable affordances such as visual, grasp, and trajectory affordances that explicitly encode where to interact, how to grasp, and how to move. We construct EgoAffordance, a large-scale dataset comprising 204K episodes with 5.6M visual affordances and 11.6M grasp and trajectory affordances. Building on this, we introduce VLAff, a large vision-language model-based unified foundation model that learns cross-modal correlations across all actionable affordances. Given a visual observation and instruction, VLAff generates visual affordance heatmaps, grasp poses, and trajectories, which are then converted into directly executable actions by utilizing 3D scene information. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that VLAff not only achieves state-of-the-art performance on visual affordance prediction, but can also be effectively applied to real robot applications such as zero-shot manipulation and affordance-guided robot learning.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to IEEE/RSJ IROS 2026. Project page: https://ojh6404.github.io/vlaff/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VLAff，一个基于大视觉语言模型 (vision-language model) 的统一基础模型，用于学习与本体无关 (embodiment-agnostic) 的可操作可供性 (actionable affordances)。作者利用第一视角人类视频、3D Structure-from-Motion 和手部网格重建，提取视觉、抓取和轨迹三类可供性，并构建包含 204K 个片段、5.6M 视觉可供性和 11.6M 抓取/轨迹可供性的大规模数据集 EgoAffordance。实验表明 VLAff 在视觉可供性预测上达到 SOTA，并能用于真实机器人的零样本操作和可供性引导学习。
Motivation: 从人类视频学习操作技能有扩展机器人学习的潜力，但人机关节形态差异 (embodiment mismatch) 构成挑战。作者认为学习以物体为中心、与本体无关的可操作可供性是解决该问题的有前景方向，因此需要统一编码“在哪里交互、如何抓取、如何移动”的框架。
Method: 利用 SOTA 3D Structure-from-Motion 和手部网格重建从第一视角人类视频中提取视觉、抓取和轨迹可供性，构建 EgoAffordance 数据集；在此基础上训练 VLAff，一个基于大视觉语言模型的统一基础模型，学习所有可供性之间的跨模态相关性。给定视觉观测和指令，VLAff 生成视觉可供性热图、抓取位姿和轨迹，并借助 3D 场景信息将其转换为可直接执行的动作。
Result: 大量实验显示 VLAff 在视觉可供性预测上取得 SOTA 性能，并能有效应用于真实机器人场景，包括零样本操作和可供性引导的机器人学习。摘要未给出具体定量结果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调统一的可供性表征能够缓解人机关节形态差异，并展示从人类视频中学习的可供性可以迁移到真实机器人执行。摘要未说明方法局限。

papers.title: StyleComposer: Training-Free Multi-Reference Style Composition
papers.abstract_en: The style of a painting is not monolithic: color, texture, and structure may come from different sources. Existing reference-guided methods transfer them as one style signal, leaving each attribute's source and strength outside the user's control. We ask where in a diffusion model one attribute can change while the others hold, and find that no single representation isolates all three. The proposed StyleComposer therefore routes each style attribute through the representation where it separates best and coordinates the routes over denoising time. Without training or inversion, it satisfies three references and the prompt jointly more closely than prior methods, and exposes one strength slider per attribute. Project page: https://lexxsh.github.io/StyleComposer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StyleComposer，一种无需训练和反演的扩散模型风格合成方法，用于同时满足多个参考图像的风格属性。作者发现扩散模型中没有任何单一表示能同时隔离颜色、纹理和结构三个风格属性，因此将每个属性路由到分离效果最好的表示，并在去噪时间上协调各路由。摘要称该方法在满足三个参考风格与提示词联合约束上优于先前方法，并为每个属性提供强度滑杆。
Motivation: 现有参考引导方法把画作的风格当作单一信号整体迁移，颜色、纹理和结构各属性的来源与强度无法由用户控制。作者想找到扩散模型中哪个属性可以独立变化而其他属性保持不变的表示，但发现单一表示无法同时隔离全部三个属性。
Method: StyleComposer 为每个风格属性（颜色、纹理、结构）选择在扩散模型中分离效果最好的表示进行路由，并在去噪时间轴上协调这些路由。方法无需训练，也无需反演，并能为每个属性提供一个可控的强度滑杆。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在联合满足三个参考风格和提示词方面比先前方法更接近目标，并且无需训练或反演即可实现多参考风格组合。
Conclusion: 作者认为扩散模型中不存在能同时隔离颜色、纹理和结构的单一表示，因此按属性分开路由并协调是可行的设计；方法局限在于依赖预训练扩散模型的特征表示分离能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SearchAuditor: Auditing and Attributing Failures in Long-Horizon Search Agents
papers.abstract_en: Deep search agents tackle challenging questions through long-horizon web interactions, a process that is both complex and fragile: small reasoning errors may propagate through long, noisy trajectories into fluent but incorrect answers. Diagnosing such failures is difficult, requiring the manual inspection of extremely long execution traces, which could be beyond human capacity. We therefore introduce SearchAuditBench, a benchmark that evaluates whether LLM auditors can localize, attribute, and repair these failures, thereby reducing the human burden. SearchAuditBench comprises 1,243 failed trajectories, averaging 73.1 messages and 65.1K tokens, collected from eight open-weight models on five deep-search benchmarks, each expert-annotated with the critical error step, a search-specific root cause, and a reference repair with grading rubrics. We further propose SearchAuditor, a multi-perspective auditing framework that effectively localizes, attributes, and repairs search-agent failures through evidence-grounded adjudication. Experimental results show that even the strongest baseline, when powered by a frontier model like GPT-5.5, attains only a 26.6% end-to-end pass rate. In contrast, our SearchAuditor consistently outperforms all baselines across different frontier models, achieving an end-to-end pass rate of 32.3%, and resuming failed runs with its repairs enables agents to better recover from errors.

TL;DR: 本文提出 SearchAuditBench 基准与 SearchAuditor 审计框架，用于定位、归因并修复长程搜索智能体（long-horizon search agents）在网页交互中的失败。基准包含 1,243 条失败轨迹，平均 73.1 条消息、65.1K token，来自八个开源模型在五个深度搜索基准上的运行，并由专家标注关键错误步骤、搜索特定根因和带评分细则的参考修复。SearchAuditor 通过基于证据的裁定（evidence-grounded adjudication）进行多视角审计，在端到端通过率上超过所有基线。
Motivation: 深度搜索智能体通过长程网页交互回答复杂问题，小推理错误会在长而嘈杂的轨迹中传播为流畅但不正确的答案，而人工检查极长的执行轨迹可能超出人类能力，因此需要自动化地定位、归因并修复失败以降低人工负担。
Method: 提出 SearchAuditBench 基准，包含专家标注的失败轨迹、关键错误步骤、搜索特定根因和带评分细则的参考修复；并提出 SearchAuditor，一个多视角审计框架，通过证据支撑的裁定（evidence-grounded adjudication）完成失败定位、归因与修复。

Conclusion: 摘要表明，自动化的失败审计与修复能减少人工负担，并提升长程搜索智能体从错误中恢复的能力；该工作聚焦于搜索智能体的失败诊断，未涉及其他任务领域。

papers.title: Innocent Panels, Hateful Stories: Evaluating and Detecting Hateful Intent in Multi-Turn Visual Story Generation
papers.abstract_en: Picture books and comics have long been used to disseminate hateful narratives because they are easily understood even by children, as exemplified by the notorious Nazi propaganda picture book \emph{Der Giftpilz}. Recently, frontier text-to-image (T2I) systems such as Gemini and GPT-Image have enabled conversational generation with consistent characters and scenes across turns, making hateful visual stories, namely ordered image groups that collectively convey hateful narratives, cheap and scalable to produce. Although prior work has studied hateful content generation by T2I systems, it focuses on individual images, leaving group-level hateful meaning largely unexplored. We aim to address the gap. Concretely, we introduce \texttt{HatefulStoryPrompts}, comprising 330 multi-turn configurations from 55 hateful stories across two languages and three visual styles, and evaluate five frontier models over 4,950 attempts. Every model completes over 80\% of the stories, with the strongest reaching 99.0\%. We further evaluate existing moderation systems on \texttt{HatefulVisualStory}, a human-labeled dataset of 969 hateful image sets and 990 benign controls, and find that they frequently miss group-level hateful meaning: dedicated safety models achieve at most 34.9\% recall, while a strong vision-language model reaches 67.5\%. Finally, we propose complementary proactive and post-generation defenses. An interaction-aware monitor achieves 97.3\% recall for prompt-only sessions and 92.6\% when the user supplies the first image, while post-generation methods jointly analyzing completed image groups reach 80.2\%. Our work shows that, as image generation evolves from isolated outputs to coherent visual narratives, safety must evolve accordingly, from per-image moderation to stateful reasoning over interactions and image relationships.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多轮文本到图像 (T2I) 生成中由有序图片组构成的仇恨视觉故事 (hateful visual stories)，指出现有安全评测只关注单张图像而忽略组级仇恨含义。作者构建 HatefulStoryPrompts（55 个仇恨故事、330 个多轮配置、两种语言、三种视觉风格）和人工标注数据集 HatefulVisualStory（969 个仇恨图像组与 990 个良性对照），评测五个前沿模型与现有审核系统，并提出面向交互的前置监控与后置组级检测两类互补防御。
Motivation: 现有关于 T2I 仇恨内容生成的研究只针对单张图像，而对话式 T2I 系统（如 Gemini、GPT-Image）可低成本生成跨轮次角色与场景一致的组级仇恨叙事；组级仇恨含义尚未被系统研究，且现有审核系统对此类含义容易漏检。
Method: 构建 HatefulStoryPrompts 多轮仇恨故事提示集，在五个前沿模型上执行 4,950 次生成尝试；用 HatefulVisualStory 人工标注数据集评估现有审核系统；提出两类互补防御：交互感知监控器（覆盖 prompt-only 会话和用户提供首图情形）以及联合分析完整图像组的后置生成检测方法。
Result: 所有五个模型完成超过 80% 的仇恨故事，最强模型达到 99.0%；专用安全模型对 HatefulVisualStory 的召回率至多 34.9%，强视觉语言模型为 67.5%；交互感知监控器在 prompt-only 会话上召回率为 97.3%、用户提供首图时为 92.6%，后置组级检测达到 80.2%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调当图像生成从孤立输出演变为连贯视觉叙事时，安全机制也需从逐图像审核转向对交互和图像关系的状态化推理 (stateful reasoning)，即结合前置交互监控与后置图像组联合分析来防御组级仇恨含义。

papers.title: MapTCL: Temporal Consistency Learning via Bidirectional Alignment for Vectorized HD Map Construction
papers.abstract_en: Constructing reliable online HD maps remains challenging in dynamic urban environments due to moving objects and occlusions. While recent works employ feature-level temporal fusion to address this, they rely solely on per-frame ground truth supervision. Consequently, they lack an explicit objective to directly penalize the geometric noise and temporal jitter between consecutive online HD maps. To address this, we propose MapTCL, an auxiliary training strategy that formulates temporal consistency loss between current and past frames via bidirectional alignment. Specifically, Bidirectional Vector Consistency Learning (BVCL) models the geometric and semantic discrepancies between associated past and current vector instances as an auxiliary loss. We also employ Raster map Consistency Learning (RCL) as an additional loss to stabilize dense BEV features. By jointly training with these dual losses, MapTCL improves the temporal stability of generated HD maps. Extensive experiments on two standard benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. As a versatile plug-and-play module, MapTCL consistently enhances existing baseline models, achieving gains of +3.7 mAP & +2.8 C-mAP on nuScenes and +3.1 mAP & +2.5 C-mAP on Argoverse 2 without additional inference overhead.
papers.comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MapTCL，一种用于矢量高清地图（HD map）构建的辅助训练策略，通过当前帧与过去帧之间的双向对齐构造时间一致性损失。方法包含双向矢量一致性学习（BVCL）和栅格地图一致性学习（RCL）两个辅助损失，与基线联合训练后可提升生成地图的时间稳定性。在 nuScenes 和 Argoverse 2 上，该模块作为即插即用组件为基线带来 mAP 与 C-mAP 的提升，且不增加推理开销。
Motivation: 现有基于特征级时序融合的方法仅依赖逐帧真值监督，缺少显式惩罚连续在线 HD 地图之间几何噪声和时间抖动（temporal jitter）的目标，导致动态城市环境中的地图构建不够稳定。
Method: 提出辅助训练策略 MapTCL，利用双向对齐构造当前帧与过去帧之间的时间一致性损失；其中 BVCL 对关联的过去与当前矢量实例建模几何和语义差异，RCL 用于稳定稠密 BEV 特征，二者作为额外损失与原有监督联合训练。
Result: 在两个标准基准上的实验表明，MapTCL 作为即插即用模块一致提升现有基线：在 nuScenes 上取得 +3.7 mAP 与 +2.8 C-mAP，在 Argoverse 2 上取得 +3.1 mAP 与 +2.5 C-mAP，且不引入额外推理开销。
Conclusion: 作者认为联合训练双重时间一致性损失可以改善生成 HD 地图的时间稳定性，并强调该方法作为通用即插即用模块能增强现有基线模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Do Corrective Features Help? An Agent for Corrective Feature Discovery on Black-Box Forecasters
papers.abstract_en: Frozen pretrained forecasters often fail in structured, recurring ways that are costly to repair through fine-tuning. We study corrective feature discovery: mining interpretable features of a frozen forecaster's residual to drive a lightweight post-hoc corrector. Prior automated feature engineering models the data-generating process; corrective features instead model the model-failure process. We present CRAFTER (Corrective Residual Agent with Feature-based Temporal Exploration and Reasoning), which keeps the backbone frozen and mines its residual with two complementary generators: a compositional search over the raw input channels, and a large language model (LLM) that proposes named feature combinations, binary flags, and short executable code. A single validation-grounded gate accepts or rejects every candidate regardless of its origin, and a validation-selected corrector applies the accepted features or leaves the forecast unchanged. This source-agnostic pipeline also allows prior feature-engineering systems to be evaluated under identical conditions, making CRAFTER an instrument for attributing forecast improvements to the feature source alone. Across six public datasets and six frozen backbones, CRAFTER surpasses every dedicated feature-engineering system at every feature budget, roughly doubling the improvement achieved by the corrector alone and reducing the error of the weakest backbones by up to 27%. These gains are robust across different LLM backends and persist even when applied on top of fine-tuned backbones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究黑盒冻结预测器（frozen black-box forecaster）的修正特征发现（corrective feature discovery）问题，提出 CRAFTER 框架：在不修改骨干网络的前提下，通过原始输入通道的组合搜索和 LLM 生成命名特征组合、二元标志与可执行代码，并用验证集门控筛选特征、用验证集选择的后置修正器（corrector）决定是否应用特征或保持预测不变。在六个公开数据集和六个冻结骨干上，CRAFTER 在所有特征预算下超过专用特征工程系统，修正器单独改进约翻倍，最弱骨干误差最高降低 27%，且对不同 LLM 后端和微调骨干均稳健。
Motivation: 冻结的预训练预测器常以结构化、重复的方式失效，而微调修复成本高昂；现有自动化特征工程建模的是数据生成过程，而修正特征需要建模模型失效过程（model-failure process），这是一个此前未被充分针对的空白。
Method: 提出 CRAFTER，保持骨干冻结，用两个互补生成器挖掘残差：对原始输入通道进行组合搜索，以及用大语言模型（LLM）提出命名特征组合、二元标志和可执行代码；所有候选由单一验证集门控按来源无关的方式接受或拒绝，再由验证集选择的修正器应用被接受特征或保持预测不变。该流程还允许在相同条件下评估已有特征工程系统，从而将改进归因于特征来源。
Result: 在六个公开数据集和六个冻结骨干上，CRAFTER 在每个特征预算下都超过所有专用特征工程系统，大致使仅用修正器的改进翻倍，并将最弱骨干的错误降低最高 27%；增益对不同 LLM 后端稳健，且在微调骨干之上仍存在。
Conclusion: 摘要强调修正特征应建模模型失败过程而非数据生成过程，来源无关的门控管线使 CRAFTER 成为将预测改进归因于特征来源的工具。

papers.title: Otter: A Time-Aware, History-Conditioned Human Chess AI
papers.abstract_en: Otter is a 15.3M-parameter human chess AI that predicts human move selection by modeling play as a time-aware, sequential process rather than treating each position in isolation. It combines two conditioning signals: (1) a move history encoder that conditions predictions on the last 20 moves, capturing opening preferences, positional drift, and intra-game behavioral tendencies; and (2) a time control module that modulates predictions based on clock pressure. Otter is trained on 6.1 billion positions from 117 million Lichess rapid games over 30 days on a single T4 GPU. Otter achieves 55.23% top-1 and 90.95% top-5 move-prediction accuracy, surpassing the prior state-of-the-art human chess model, Maia 2, with far fewer parameters and less training data. Across 11 Elo brackets (<1100 to >=2000), accuracy peaks at 57.38% in the 1900-1999 bracket. These results show that modeling chess as a time-aware, sequential activity yields more human-accurate move prediction than position-only approaches, using a smaller model. Code, trained models, and complete training logs are publicly released.

Motivation: 现有面向人类走子预测的模型往往把每个局面当作独立输入处理，忽略了棋局的时间性和历史连贯性，因此对人类行为模式的刻画不够准确。

Conclusion: 作者认为，将国际象棋建模为时间感知的序列活动，比仅基于局面的方法能获得更接近人类的走子预测，而且模型更小；代码、训练好的模型和完整训练日志已公开。

papers.title: Abstract Event Causal Rules: Induction and Application
papers.abstract_en: Event-centric intelligent analytical systems heavily depend on explicit causal event knowledge for risk early warning, decision-making support and narrative comprehension. Nevertheless, existing instance-level causal pairs suffer severe generalization deficits on low-frequency long-tail and unseen event combinations. To address this limitation, this work proposes Abstract Event Causal Rule (AECR), a novel relation-level causal abstraction paradigm that transforms concrete cause-effect pairs into generalized abstract causal logic while retaining their intrinsic causal relationships. We design a multi-agent Concrete-to-Abstract Causal Induction (CACI) system coupled with similarity-constrained clustering to distill trustworthy AECRs from noisy raw causal data, based on which two complete AECR knowledge bases are built. To validate the practical utility of abstract causal knowledge, we propose an Abstract Rule-Guided Causal Attention Encoder (AR-GCAE), which injects the retrieved AECRs into the causality Graph Event Prediction (CGEP) benchmark task via rule-guided attention layers and gated representation fusion. Quantitative experimental results reveal that applying AECRs substantially strengthens the generalization capacity of event causal reasoning and brings consistent performance improvements to event prediction, with the most prominent gains observed on rare and unseen event samples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出抽象事件因果规则 (Abstract Event Causal Rule, AECR)，将具体因果事件对转化为关系层面的抽象因果逻辑，以缓解实例级因果对在低频长尾和未见事件组合上的泛化不足。作者设计多智能体 Concrete-to-Abstract Causal Induction (CACI) 系统并结合相似性约束聚类，从噪声原始数据中提炼可信 AECR，构建两个知识库；随后提出 Abstract Rule-Guided Causal Attention Encoder (AR-GCAE)，将检索到的 AECR 注入事件预测基准任务。实验表明 AECR 能增强事件因果推理的泛化能力，在稀有和未见事件样本上提升尤其明显。
Motivation: 事件中心智能分析系统依赖显式因果事件知识，但现有实例级因果对在低频长尾和未见事件组合上泛化能力差，限制了风险预警、决策支持和叙事理解等应用。
Method: 提出 AECR 关系级因果抽象范式，将具体因果对转化为保留内在因果关系的抽象因果逻辑；设计多智能体 CACI 系统配合相似性约束聚类，从噪声原始数据中蒸馏可信 AECR 并构建知识库；再提出 AR-GCAE，通过规则引导注意力层和门控表示融合将检索到的 AECR 注入因果图事件预测 (CGEP) 任务。
Result: 定量实验表明，应用 AECR 显著增强事件因果推理的泛化能力，并给事件预测带来一致性能提升，其中在稀有和未见事件样本上的收益最突出。
Conclusion: 摘要强调关系级抽象因果知识可作为提升事件预测泛化能力的有效途径，尤其在低频与未见事件场景下效果显著。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SkillTrace: Multi-Trace Provenance Auditing for LLM-Agent Skill Reuse
papers.abstract_en: LLM-agent ecosystems are rapidly growing around reusable skills: mixed-modality packages of metadata, natural-language instructions, code, tools, references, and operational workflows. As skills become marketplace artifacts, auditing their reuse is no longer the same problem as ordinary code clone detection. Existing detectors target single-modality source code or whole-package similarity, yet skill reuse evidence is distributed across authored text, implementation fragments, and operational structure. As a result, they can miss reuse that preserves only one part of a skill. We present SKILLTRACE, a multi-trace provenance auditing framework for LLM-agent skill reuse. SKILLTRACE extracts three provenance traces: Expression, Implementation, and Operational. It represents the Operational Trace as a Skill Operational Graph (SOG) that captures activation, procedure, and resource-flow structure. An LLM assists only the Operational-trace extraction, once at ingestion; at audit time SKILLTRACE compares cached traces deterministically, calibrates each trace against same-function strict negatives, and reports which trace supports a reuse decision. On SKILLTRACE-BENCH, with 820 transformed reuse positives over 100 marketplace anchors and 751 negative controls, SKILLTRACE achieves AUROC 0.938 and F1 0.898. A 36,446-skill wild audit further shows that trace-attributed evidence surfaces actionable reuse review queues beyond repository-level baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SKILLTRACE，一个面向 LLM 智能体技能复用审计的多轨迹溯源框架。技能被定义为混合模态的复用单元，包含元数据、自然语言指令、代码、工具、参考与操作流程；SKILLTRACE 抽取 Expression、Implementation、Operational 三类溯源轨迹，并将 Operational Trace 表示为技能操作图 (SOG)。在 SKILLTRACE-BENCH 基准 (820 个转换后的复用正样本、751 个负对照) 上取得 AUROC 0.938、F1 0.898，并在 36,446 个技能的大规模审计中展示出可操作的复用审查队列。
Motivation: LLM 智能体生态中可复用技能正成为市场化的审计对象，但技能复用审计不同于普通代码克隆检测：现有检测器只针对单模态源代码或整体包相似度，而技能复用证据分散在作者文本、实现片段与操作结构中，容易漏掉仅保留技能一部分的复用行为。
Method: SKILLTRACE 提取三种溯源轨迹：Expression、Implementation 与 Operational；其中 Operational Trace 用技能操作图 (SOG) 刻画激活、过程与资源流结构。LLM 仅在摄入时辅助一次 Operational 轨迹抽取，审计时对缓存轨迹进行确定性比较，并按同功能严格负样本校准每条轨迹，最终报告是哪条轨迹支持了复用判定。
Result: 在 SKILLTRACE-BENCH 上，SKILLTRACE 的 AUROC 为 0.938、F1 为 0.898；在 36,446 个技能的真实世界审计中，轨迹归因证据能生成超出仓库级基线的可操作复用审查队列。
Conclusion: 作者强调技能复用证据分布在多种轨迹中，多轨迹溯源与轨迹级归因比仓库级相似度基线更能支撑可操作的技能复用审计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Continuous Predictors to Clinical Thresholds: Early Evidence on Performance Trade-offs of Guideline-Based Categorisation for Ischaemic Stroke Outcome Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models achieve strong predictive accuracy for 90-day outcome prediction in acute ischaemic stroke, yet clinical adoption is limited by the misalignment of model explanations with clinicians' reasoning. Motivated by a clinician user study calling for clinical guideline-aligned cut-offs, we ask whether continuous predictors can be replaced by clinically informed categorical encodings without sacrificing performance. On a multi-centre European registry stratified into three treatment cohorts, we compare standard and fully categorised gradient-boosted models, the latter using stroke guideline-aligned, treatment-specific thresholds. The fully categorised models are statistically indistinguishable from their continuous counterparts in two of the treatment cohorts, with a significant drop in predictive accuracy in one cohort. Global feature importance rankings remain consistent, suggesting that discretising continuous predictors into guideline-based categories preserves the core hierarchy of prognostic factors across all treatment groups. Guideline-based categorisation is thus a viable design choice for stroke-outcome models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究急性缺血性卒中（acute ischaemic stroke）90天结局预测中，能否用临床指南对齐的分类编码替代连续预测变量而不损失性能。作者在欧洲多中心登记数据上按三种治疗队列分层，比较标准梯度提升模型与完全分类化的梯度提升模型（后者使用指南对齐、治疗特异的阈值）。结果显示，在三个治疗队列中的两个队列里，完全分类化模型与连续变量模型在统计上无差异，而在一个队列中预测精度显著下降；全局特征重要性排序保持一致。
Motivation: 机器学习模型对急性缺血性卒中90天结局预测准确率高，但模型解释与临床医生推理方式不一致限制了临床采用；一项临床医生用户研究呼吁使用指南对齐的截断值。作者因此提出一个问题：能否在不牺牲性能的前提下，用临床信息驱动的分类编码替换连续预测变量。
Method: 在按三种治疗队列分层的欧洲多中心登记数据上，比较标准梯度提升模型和完全分类化的梯度提升模型；后者采用卒中指南对齐、治疗特异的阈值对连续预测变量进行离散化分类编码。
Result: 完全分类化模型在两个治疗队列中与连续变量模型统计上不可区分，在一个队列中出现显著的预测精度下降；全局特征重要性排名在所有治疗组中保持一致。
Conclusion: 作者认为，基于指南的分类化是卒中结局模型中可行的设计选择，能够在各治疗组中保留预后因素的核心层级结构。

papers.title: ASTELD: A Six-Axis Classification Framework for Autonomous AI Agents - Design, Evaluation, and an OpenClaw Case Study
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous AI agent platforms differ substantially in architecture, security, tool integration, execution, autonomy, and deployment, yet the field lacks a common classification scheme for comparing these design choices. We propose ASTELD, an operational six-axis classification framework for autonomous AI agents: Architecture pattern, Security posture, Tool integration model, Execution paradigm, Level of autonomy and human control, and Deployment topology. ASTELD is constructed by synthesizing prior agent taxonomies with observable platform properties and explicit category-assignment rules. We evaluate its discriminative and explanatory utility by mapping eight representative frameworks and by using OpenClaw as an in-depth case study. The resulting profiles separate all eight platforms under their dominant configurations and reveal three cross-platform patterns: a security-accessibility diagonal, strong execution-architecture coupling, and capability convergence with persistent architectural differentiation. We further classify 50+ OpenClaw derivatives and find that innovation concentrates on the Security, Execution, and Deployment axes, indicating that ASTELD can explain where ecosystem fragmentation occurs. The OpenClaw case study also supplies a six-category vulnerability taxonomy, evidence from five institutional assessments, and adoption and governance analyses that connect platform coordinates to observed risks. These results position ASTELD as a reproducible method for comparing agent platforms, identifying unoccupied design regions, guiding framework selection, and organizing future empirical research. The analysis also exposes a consequential empty region: none of the evaluated systems combines local-first deployment with enterprise-grade security.
papers.comment: 40 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Introduces and empirically evaluates the ASTELD six-axis classification framework across eight autonomous AI agent platforms, with OpenClaw as an in-depth case study
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ASTELD，一个用于自主 AI 智能体的六轴分类框架，涵盖架构模式 (Architecture pattern)、安全姿态 (Security posture)、工具集成模型 (Tool integration model)、执行范式 (Execution paradigm)、自主性与人类控制水平 (Level of autonomy and human control) 以及部署拓扑 (Deployment topology)。作者通过映射八个代表性平台并以 OpenClaw 作为深度案例来评估其区分力与解释力，发现安全-可访问性对角线、执行-架构强耦合等跨平台模式，并识别出“本地优先部署 + 企业级安全”这一未被占据的设计区域。
Motivation: 自主 AI 智能体平台在架构、安全、工具集成、执行、自主性和部署方面差异显著，但领域内缺乏通用的分类方案来比较这些设计选择。
Method: ASTELD 通过综合既有智能体分类法 (agent taxonomies) 与可观测平台属性及显式类别分配规则构建；将八个代表性框架映射到六轴坐标，并以 OpenClaw 作为深度案例，包括对 50+ OpenClaw 衍生物进行分类，以及漏洞分类、机构评估、采用与治理分析。
Result: 摘要报告 ASTELD 能在各平台主导配置下区分全部八个平台，揭示三种跨平台模式：安全-可访问性对角线、执行与架构强耦合、能力收敛但架构持续分化；50+ OpenClaw 衍生物的创新集中在安全、执行和部署轴；没有任何被评估系统同时具备本地优先部署与企业级安全。
Conclusion: ASTELD 被定位为可复现的智能体平台比较方法，可用于识别未占据的设计区域、指导框架选择和组织未来实证研究；OpenClaw 案例还提供六类漏洞分类及五个机构评估的证据，将平台坐标与观察到的风险联系起来。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 ASTELD，一个用于自主 AI 智能体的六轴分类框架，涵盖架构模式 (Architecture pattern)、安全姿态 (Security posture)、工具集成模型 (Tool integration model)、执行范式 (Execution paradigm)、自主性与人类控制水平 (Level of autonomy and human control) 以及部署拓扑 (Deployment topology)。作者通过映射八个代表性平台并以 OpenClaw 作为深度案例来评估其区分力与解释力，发现安全-可访问性对角线、执行-架构强耦合等跨平台模式，并识别出“本地优先部署 + 企业级安全”这一未被占据的设计区域。
summary_sections.motivation: 自主 AI 智能体平台在架构、安全、工具集成、执行、自主性和部署方面差异显著，但领域内缺乏通用的分类方案来比较这些设计选择。
summary_sections.method: ASTELD 通过综合既有智能体分类法 (agent taxonomies) 与可观测平台属性及显式类别分配规则构建；将八个代表性框架映射到六轴坐标，并以 OpenClaw 作为深度案例，包括对 50+ OpenClaw 衍生物进行分类，以及漏洞分类、机构评估、采用与治理分析。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 ASTELD 能在各平台主导配置下区分全部八个平台，揭示三种跨平台模式：安全-可访问性对角线、执行与架构强耦合、能力收敛但架构持续分化；50+ OpenClaw 衍生物的创新集中在安全、执行和部署轴；没有任何被评估系统同时具备本地优先部署与企业级安全。

papers.title: SAKI: Score-Aware Low-Rank Key Indexing with Random-Matrix Noise Correction for KV Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Existing low rank KV cache methods preserve either model weights or key variance, neither of which directly reflects the attention scores used during inference. We derive the expected attention score distortion caused by rank r key compression and show that it yields a covariance weighted low rank objective. Under a margin condition, controlling this distortion also improves top k recall. The optimal rank r solution has a closed form asymmetric factorization obtained from the SVD of the covariance weighted query key operator. This motivates SAKI, a training free KV cache index that directly preserves attention scores rather than key reconstruction quality. Across LLaMA 3.1 8B, Qwen 2.5 7B, Mistral 7B v0.1, and Llama 3.2 3B, SAKI outperforms key PCA at every tested rank. At rank 32, it removes 13 to 30 percent of PCA's remaining top 64 recall error, including improvements from 0.748 to 0.799 on LLaMA 3.1 8B and from 0.786 to 0.850 on Qwen 2.5 7B. It improves 68 to 89 percent of attention heads per model, with the largest gains in deeper layers. Predicted score MSE reductions closely match empirical measurements, with a Pearson correlation of 0.997, while ablation studies confirm that the gains arise from optimizing the attention score objective rather than covariance weighting alone. Analysis of the scoring operator further explains why weight only, invariant subspace, and key reconstruction methods can be suboptimal. SAKI uses random-matrix theory to separate genuine covariance signal from autocorrelated sampling noise, matching PCA with only 512 calibration tokens and adding value exactly where PCA sees no reliable signal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAKI，一种无需训练的低秩键值缓存 (KV cache) 索引方法，其目标函数直接保持推理时的注意力分数而非键的重建质量。作者推导了秩 r 键压缩造成的期望注意力分数失真，得到协方差加权的低秩目标，并给出由协方差加权 query-key 算子 SVD 得到的闭式非对称因子分解。在多个 LLM 上，SAKI 在所有测试秩下优于 key PCA，并能用随机矩阵理论在极少校准数据下分离真实协方差信号与采样噪声。
Motivation: 现有低秩 KV 缓存方法要么保留模型权重，要么保留键的方差，但这些都不直接反映推理时实际使用的注意力分数，因此可能优化了错误的量，导致缓存索引并非最优。
Method: 推导秩 r 键压缩对期望注意力分数的失真表达式，得到协方差加权低秩目标；在 margin 条件下，控制该失真的同时可改进 top-k 召回。最优秩 r 解为闭式非对称因式分解，来自协方差加权 query-key 算子的 SVD。SAKI 进一步利用随机矩阵理论将真实协方差信号与自相关采样噪声分离，从而仅需少量校准 token。
Result: 在 LLaMA 3.1 8B、Qwen 2.5 7B、Mistral 7B v0.1 和 Llama 3.2 3B 上，SAKI 在所有测试秩下均优于 key PCA；秩 32 时去除 PCA 剩余 top-64 召回误差的 13% 至 30%，例如 LLaMA 3.1 8B 从 0.748 提升到 0.799，Qwen 2.5 7B 从 0.786 提升到 0.850。每模型 68% 至 89% 的注意力头得到改进，深层收益最大；预测分数 MSE 下降与实测高度一致，Pearson 相关为 0.997。消融表明增益来自优化注意力分数目标，而非仅协方差加权。
Conclusion: 作者认为直接优化注意力分数 (而非键重建质量) 的索引方法更有效，并分析了为何仅保留权重、不变子空间和键重建类方法可能次优；SAKI 在 PCA 无可靠信号的区域仍能增加价值，且仅需 512 个校准 token 即可匹配 PCA。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AI Security Leaderboard: Methodology, Results and Minimal Standard
papers.abstract_en: The AI Security Leaderboard is an independent benchmark that ranks the safeguards of frontier AI models from least to most secure. It tests models against the FAR$.$AI Minimal Standard for Safeguards, which represents a minimum bar for security: meeting it does not guarantee a secure model, but failing to meet it guarantees a lack of state-of-the-art security. Version 1.0 covers severe misuse requests across chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear, and explosive (CBRNE) threats and offensive cybersecurity. In this report, we tested four leading models for universal jailbreaks in the context of this minimal standard, and found more than a hundredfold difference in security. Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol held against every attack we ran, with no universal jailbreak found; we estimate they would likely cost more than \$14,200 to jailbreak, if it is possible with this methodology at all. Meanwhile, we found hundreds of universal jailbreaks for Grok 4.5 and Gemini 3.1 Pro; each broke for under \$300, with universal jailbreaks in Grok's weakest domain, cybersecurity, accessible for as little as \$24. The gap is fixable: every weakness we found belongs to a known class of attack that already has a defense deployed in production models. The leaderboard will be updated on a rolling basis as new models are released, and the evaluation methodology and Minimal Standard will be periodically revised to take into account the latest capabilities and the state-of-the-art in safeguards. The leaderboard is available at leaderboard.far.ai.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 AI 安全排行榜 (AI Security Leaderboard)，一个独立基准，用于将前沿 AI 模型的安全防护从最不安全到最安全排序。它依据 FAR.AI 最低安全标准 (Minimal Standard for Safeguards) 进行测试，1.0 版本覆盖化学、生物、放射、核与爆炸 (CBRNE) 威胁及攻击性网络安全。作者对四个领先模型进行通用越狱 (universal jailbreak) 测试，发现超过百倍的安全差距：Claude Fable 5 与 GPT-5.6 Sol 未被攻破，而 Grok 4.5 和 Gemini 3.1 Pro 出现数百个通用越狱。
Motivation: 前沿 AI 模型的安全防护缺乏可比较的独立评估基准，需要设立一个最低安全门槛来区分模型是否具备符合当前水平的安全防护。
Method: 以 FAR.AI 最低安全标准为测试框架，对四个领先模型发起严重滥用请求，覆盖 CBRNE 威胁与攻击性网络安全，并寻找可复现的通用越狱；排行榜将随新模型发布滚动更新，评估方法论与最低标准也会定期修订。
Result: 四个模型间安全差距超过百倍：Claude Fable 5 与 GPT-5.6 Sol 抵御了所有攻击，未发现通用越狱，估计越狱成本可能超过 14,200 美元；Grok 4.5 和 Gemini 3.1 Pro 均有数百个通用越狱，单个成本低于 300 美元，其中 Grok 最弱领域网络安全中的越狱最低仅需约 24 美元。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该安全差距是可以修复的：所有发现的弱点都属于已有生产模型部署了防御手段的已知攻击类别；排行榜将持续更新，方法论与最低标准将根据最新能力与防护水平定期调整。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Output-Aware Rotation for INT2 KV-Cache Quantization
papers.abstract_en: The key-value (KV) cache has become a major memory and bandwidth bottleneck in long-context large language model inference, making ultra-low-bit quantization increasingly important. However, existing rotation-based INT2 methods optimize cache statistics or proxy errors before the complete attention readout, even though the model is ultimately affected by the error propagated through attention and the output projection $W_O$. To address this mismatch, we propose \textit{OptR}, an output-aware rotation method that minimizes post-$W_O$ attention-output error. OptR decomposes the post-$W_O$ attention-output error into key- and value-induced terms and learns per-head orthogonal corrections through the full INT2 quantization and attention path. OptR further applies an attention-equivalent key reparameterization to reduce large channel-wise offsets without changing the softmax distribution. Across three models and five reasoning and coding benchmarks, OptR consistently improves both QuaRot and OSCAR and strengthens long-context retrieval, while preserving the paged KV-cache format with negligible inference overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OptR，一种面向 INT2 KV-cache 量化的输出感知旋转（output-aware rotation）方法。现有旋转方法在完整注意力读出之前优化缓存统计或代理误差，而 OptR 直接最小化经过输出投影 W_O 之后的注意力输出误差，将误差分解为 key 和 value 相关项，并通过完整的 INT2 量化与注意力路径逐头学习正交校正。在三个模型和五个推理/编程基准上一致提升 QuaRot 和 OSCAR 的效果，保持分页 KV-cache（paged KV-cache）格式且推理开销可忽略。
Motivation: 长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV cache 已成为主要的内存和带宽瓶颈，因此超低位宽量化日益关键。现有基于旋转的 INT2 方法优化的是注意力读出前的缓存统计或代理误差，未考虑最终经由注意力传播和输出投影 W_O 作用于模型的真实误差，存在优化目标与实际影响不匹配的问题。
Method: OptR 将 post-W_O 注意力输出误差分解为 key 诱导项和 value 诱导项，并通过完整的 INT2 量化与注意力路径逐头学习正交旋转校正（per-head orthogonal corrections）；同时采用注意力等价的 key 重参数化（attention-equivalent key reparameterization）来减小大通道偏移（channel-wise offsets）而不改变 softmax 分布。
Result: 摘要报告在三个模型和五个推理与编程基准上，OptR 一致改进 QuaRot 和 OSCAR，并增强长上下文检索能力，同时保持 paged KV-cache 格式且推理开销可忽略。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调输出感知的误差最小化比仅优化缓存统计或代理误差更有效；OptR 能在不破坏系统友好的分页 KV-cache 格式、几乎不增加推理开销的前提下提升 INT2 量化质量。

papers.title: Rapid Embodiment Adaptation for Quadrupedal Locomotion
papers.abstract_en: Humans readily adapt their movements as their bodies change through aging, injury, or load carrying, but learning-based robot policies often break when hardware properties shift. We introduce an online embodiment adaptation framework for quadrupedal locomotion that infers embodiment parameters from short interaction histories and conditions control on the inferred hardware state. Our method pairs a generalist policy trained under embodiment randomization with a lightweight adaptation module that identifies physical changes within half a second. We evaluate two representative forms of embodiment variation: joint-range constraints and trunk-mass changes, corresponding to joint-level kinematic degradation and body-level dynamic variation. In simulation, the module accurately estimates these changes and enables closed-loop control that substantially outperforms policies conditioned directly on interaction history. On a real Unitree Go2 robot, our system maintains stable locomotion under severe instances of the evaluated changes, including a fully locked leg and a 5 kg payload, where non-adaptive methods fail. These results demonstrate the practicality of explicit online embodiment identification for rapid adaptation to joint-limit and payload-mass changes, and provide a step toward handling broader forms of uncertain, degraded, or changing robot hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于四足机器人运动控制的在线具身适应框架，通过从短交互历史中推断具身参数并据此调节控制策略，应对硬件属性变化。方法结合具身随机化训练的一般性策略与轻量级适应模块，能在半秒内识别物理变化，并在仿真与真实 Unitree Go2 机器人上验证了针对关节限位约束与躯干质量变化的适应能力。
Motivation: 基于学习的机器人策略在硬件属性（如老化、损伤或负载变化）发生偏移时往往失效，而人类能够随身体变化快速调整动作；现有方法缺乏对具身参数的显式在线识别与快速适应。
Method: 框架包含在具身随机化 (embodiment randomization) 下训练的一般性策略，以及一个能根据短交互历史推断物理硬件状态的轻量级适应模块；控制策略以推断出的硬件状态为条件进行闭环控制。
Result: 仿真中模块能准确估计关节限位和躯干质量变化，闭环控制明显优于直接以交互历史为条件的策略；在真实 Unitree Go2 上，系统在完全锁死的腿和 5 kg 负载等严重变化下仍保持稳定运动，而非适应方法失败。
Conclusion: 显式在线具身识别能够快速适应关节限位与负载质量变化，展示了对更大范围不确定、退化或变化的机器人硬件进行处理的可行性。

summary_sections.motivation: 基于学习的机器人策略在硬件属性（如老化、损伤或负载变化）发生偏移时往往失效，而人类能够随身体变化快速调整动作；现有方法缺乏对具身参数的显式在线识别与快速适应。
summary_sections.method: 框架包含在具身随机化 (embodiment randomization) 下训练的一般性策略，以及一个能根据短交互历史推断物理硬件状态的轻量级适应模块；控制策略以推断出的硬件状态为条件进行闭环控制。
summary_sections.result: 仿真中模块能准确估计关节限位和躯干质量变化，闭环控制明显优于直接以交互历史为条件的策略；在真实 Unitree Go2 上，系统在完全锁死的腿和 5 kg 负载等严重变化下仍保持稳定运动，而非适应方法失败。
summary_sections.conclusion: 显式在线具身识别能够快速适应关节限位与负载质量变化，展示了对更大范围不确定、退化或变化的机器人硬件进行处理的可行性。

papers.title: Compliance2LoRA: Personalizable On-Demand Safety Alignment on Arbitrary Policy Subsets via Hypernetwork-Generated LoRA Adapters
papers.abstract_en: Post-training alignment in large reasoning models (LRMs) has significantly improved their adaptability to diverse safety compliance settings. However, as LRMs personalization for downstream users takes center stage, the demand for varying levels of policy compliance grows as different user-specific LRMs must adhere to distinct subsets of safety policies. Training a separate LRM for each policy subset introduces severe combinatorial overhead. While in context learning methods overcome this combinatorial overhead, they introduce additional computational challenges associated with long context generation. To address this challenge, we propose \ours, a unified adaptive hypernetwork-based framework for multi-policy compliance. In our framework, safety policies serve as customizable inputs to a LoRA adapter generator, which learns to produce policy compliant LoRA weights for downstream LRM. When added to the LRM these weights enable the generation of responses compliant with the specified policy subsets. In this work, we demonstrate that training such a hypernetwork enables on-demand policy adjustments on a single LRM without sacrificing task performance across reasoning models of different sized and different evaluation datasets. This highlights the effectiveness and practicality of adaptive hypernetwork based alignment in LRMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Compliance2LoRA，一个基于自适应超网络 (hypernetwork) 的统一多策略合规框架，用于大型推理模型 (LRM) 的安全对齐。框架将安全策略作为可定制输入送入 LoRA 适配器生成器，学习产生与指定策略子集兼容的 LoRA 权重，添加到 LRM 后即可按需调整政策合规行为。摘要报告该方法能在单一 LRM 上实现按需策略调整且不牺牲推理任务性能，并适用于不同规模与不同评估数据集。
Motivation: 为不同用户定制各自安全策略子集的合规行为，若对每个策略子集单独训练一个 LRM 会带来严重的组合开销；上下文学习方法虽能避免该开销，却引入长上下文生成带来的额外计算挑战。
Method: 提出统一的自适应超网络框架 Compliance2LoRA：安全策略作为可定制输入，由 LoRA 适配器生成器学习产生符合指定策略子集的 LoRA 权重，并将这些权重注入下游 LRM 以生成合规响应。
Result: 摘要称训练该超网络能够在单一 LRM 上实现按需策略调整，同时不牺牲任务性能，并在不同规模的推理模型和不同评估数据集上均表现出有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于自适应超网络的对齐方法在 LRM 中具有有效性和实用性，可避免为每个策略子集单独训练模型。摘要未提及具体局限性。

papers.title: Automated Numerical Stability Analysis of Deep Learning Operators
papers.abstract_en: Finite-precision arithmetic unavoidably introduces numerical approximation errors. Numerical computations may use insufficient precision or an improper formulation, which leads to numerical instability. In this paper, we introduce the first unified software tool that integrates CESTAC for detecting the numerical stability of deep learning operators. Our developed software not only enables numerical validation with a single computation pass but also detects the sources of numerical instability and provides numerical stability monitoring during deep learning training and inference. We verified its effectiveness on the detection of polluted operators with injected numerical instabilities across various tasks. We believe that our developed method and tool provide valuable insights into developing numerically stable computing kernels, which are particularly critical for numerically stable and efficient deep learning training and inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍首个集成 CESTAC 方法的统一软件工具，用于检测深度学习算子的数值稳定性。该工具可以在单次计算中完成数值验证，定位数值不稳定的来源，并在训练与推理过程中提供数值稳定性监控。作者在多种任务中通过注入数值不稳定性的算子验证了其有效性，认为该方法对开发数值稳定的计算内核有重要价值。
Motivation: 有限精度算术不可避免引入近似误差，而精度不足或公式不当会导致数值不稳定。现有工具难以在深度学习算子层面系统性地检测并定位这类问题。
Method: 提出一个统一软件工具，集成 CESTAC 方法，支持单次计算验证、不稳定源检测以及训练和推理期间的数值稳定性监控。
Result: 通过在多种任务中注入数值不稳定性的污染算子进行验证，结果表明该工具能够有效检测这些算子。
Conclusion: 该方法与工具为开发数值稳定的计算内核提供了见解，这对深度学习训练和推理的数值稳定性与效率至关重要。

papers.title: EA-Nav: Learning Safe Visual Navigation Policies with Embodiment Awareness
papers.abstract_en: Cross-embodiment navigation is a key challenge in embodied intelligence. Due to differences in embodiment, the same visual observation may imply different actions for different agents, making prediction ambiguous when relying solely on vision. Existing studies mainly rely on reinforcement learning, which requires large-scale interaction and careful reward design, making it difficult to support scalable pretraining and real-world adaptation. In contrast, imitation-learning-based approaches remain limited. To address these challenges, we propose an imitation-learning-based embodiment-aware navigation framework with a modular multi-stage design. In pretraining, we construct a cross-embodiment navigation dataset from Internet videos and introduce embodiment geometry as conditional tokens to reduce action ambiguity under the same observation. In fine-tuning, we design a multimodal information injection mechanism based on a decoupled architecture. Specifically, we design a trajectory augmentation strategy to generate high-risk samples, which are used to train spatial perception and risk-aware correction separately, thereby explicitly incorporating embodiment geometry for safe navigation. Experimental results show that the proposed method effectively improves navigation performance across different embodiment settings, demonstrating the effectiveness of incorporating embodiment geometry into embodied navigation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EA-Nav，一个基于模仿学习 (imitation learning) 的跨具身导航框架，采用模块化多阶段设计。预训练阶段从互联网视频构建跨具身导航数据集，并将具身几何 (embodiment geometry) 作为条件 token 来缓解同一视觉观察下的动作歧义；微调阶段基于解耦架构设计多模态信息注入机制，并通过轨迹增强策略生成高风险样本，分别训练空间感知与风险感知修正。摘要报告该方法在不同具身设置下均能提升导航性能。
Motivation: 跨具身导航中，相同视觉观察对不同 agent 可能对应不同动作，仅依赖视觉会产生预测歧义；而现有方法主要依赖强化学习，需要大规模交互和精细奖励设计，难以支撑可扩展的预训练与现实适应，模仿学习方向的探索仍然有限。
Method: 提出基于模仿学习的具身感知导航框架，包含预训练与微调两个阶段。预训练时从互联网视频构造跨具身导航数据集，并把具身几何编码为条件 token 以减少动作歧义；微调时采用解耦架构实现多模态信息注入，并设计轨迹增强策略生成高风险样本，用以分别训练空间感知和风险感知修正，显式利用具身几何实现安全导航。
Result: 实验表明，该方法在不同具身设置下均有效提升导航性能，验证了将具身几何纳入具身导航的有效性；摘要未给出具体量化数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调显式引入具身几何可以缓解视觉观察导致的动作歧义，并使基于模仿学习的框架能够支持安全的跨具身导航。

papers.title: Berkeley and Heiserman as an Unexhausted Architecture for Embodied Machine Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Edmund C. Berkeley is usually remembered as a mediator between symbolic logic and early computing, yet that standard description understates the scope of his work. This paper argues for a stronger reading: Berkeley should also be understood as an early theorist of embodied machine intelligence. Across Berkeley's major writings on symbolic logic, machine intelligence, living robots, and Squee, intelligence appears not as disembodied symbol manipulation alone but as the organized coordination of sensing, storage, calculation, control, state, and action in physically realized machines. The paper's first contribution is interpretive: it reconstructs Berkeley as a thinker of machine architecture, temporally extended behavior, and environment-coupled control. Its second contribution is comparative: it reads Berkeley alongside David L. Heiserman to recover a shared descriptive scheme centered on sensing, state or memory, control, action, and adaptation. Its third contribution is critical: it uses that scheme to assess current embodied-AI discourse. The broader claim is that contemporary LLM-centered robotics often demonstrates impressive capability without an equally explicit account of persistence, recoverability, maintenance, and structured modification of conduct through experience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新解读 Edmund C. Berkeley 的工作，认为他不仅是符号逻辑与早期计算之间的中介者，还应被视为具身机器智能 (embodied machine intelligence) 的早期理论家。作者通过 Berkeley 关于符号逻辑、机器智能、活机器人和 Squee 的著作，论证智能是感知、存储、计算、控制、状态与行动在物理机器中的组织化协调。论文还将其与 David L. Heiserman 的框架对照，提炼出围绕感知、状态/记忆、控制、行动和适应的共同描述方案，并用该方案批评当前以 LLM 为中心的具身 AI 讨论。
Motivation: 标准历史叙述低估了 Berkeley 工作的范围，且当代具身 AI 话语，尤其是 LLM 中心机器人学，往往展示强大能力却缺乏对持久性、可恢复性、维护和通过经验进行结构化行为修改的明确说明。
Method: 论文采用三种贡献：解释性重构 Berkeley 作为机器架构、时间延展行为和与环境耦合控制的思想家；将 Berkeley 与 Heiserman 对比以恢复共同的描述方案；用该方案评估当前具身 AI 论述。
Result: 摘要未报告实验数据或量化结果；其主张以解释性论证和批判性分析为主，认为 Berkeley 的理论提供了比当前 LLM 中心方法更完整的智能描述框架。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Berkeley 应被理解为具身智能的理论先驱，其与 Heiserman 共享的感知-状态-控制-行动-适应方案可用于审视当代具身 AI 的不足。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Fractal KV-Cache Archives: Lossless Symbolic Storage with In-Place Retrieval for Long-Context LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: The key-value (KV) cache dominates the memory cost of long-context autoregressive inference, and a growing body of work compresses it through quantization, eviction, or offloading. We study a complementary question: once a position's KV state has been quantized to codebook indices, how should the resulting symbol stream be stored, and can the storage layer do more than store? A family of contractive iterated-map codes that serialize a symbol sequence into a sequence of low-dimensional real vectors is revisited, and it is shown that they form a natural archive format for a quantized KV cache with the following features. The method provides exactly the access pattern a growing cache requires. It is lossless, it runs in linear time, and supports O(1) random access and O(1) amortized append. A controlled study of the quantizer feeding this archive is conducted on GPT-2 with 1024-token contexts. Keeping a small exact window (4 attention sinks plus 32 recent tokens) and archiving the rest, per-head residual vector quantization reduces the archived cache by 36-54x relative to an fp16 cache at a perplexity cost of 11-15%, and we quantify a sharp key/value asymmetry - quantizing keys is roughly 4x more damaging than quantizing values, consistent with prior low-bit KV work - and use it to allocate bits in a hybrid scheme. Finally, we show the archive is simultaneously a search index: approximate substring queries execute directly on the stored vectors, and matched context is decoded from the matched vector without ever materializing the surrounding text. We further characterize the archive's operating range: truncating stored points yields a lossy regime whose distortion we localize, and probability-weighting the maps recovers arithmetic coding, exposing a trade-off between rate efficiency, random access, and memory. We release all code; every number reproduces on a laptop CPU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究量化 KV cache 的存储层问题：给定已被量化到码本索引的符号流，如何存储这些符号并让存储层承担更多职责。作者重新考察一族压缩型迭代映射码 (contractive iterated-map codes)，证明它们能作为量化 KV cache 的无损归档格式，支持线性时间处理、O(1) 随机访问和 O(1) 摊还追加。在 GPT-2 的 1024-token 上下文上，配合每头残差向量量化 (per-head residual vector quantization) 可将归档缓存较 fp16 压缩 36-54 倍，困惑度代价为 11-15%；该归档还可直接作为近似子串查询的搜索索引。
Motivation: 长上下文自回归推理中 KV cache 主导内存开销，现有工作主要通过量化、驱逐或卸载来压缩，但较少关注量化后得到的符号流应如何存储，以及存储层能否在存储之外提供更多能力。
Method: 将一族把符号序列序列化为低维实向量的压缩型迭代映射码用于量化 KV cache 的归档格式，并研究其访问模式、无损性、随机访问与追加复杂度。作者在 GPT-2 上进行受控实验：保留一个小型精确窗口（4 个 attention sinks 加 32 个最近 token），其余部分归档，采用每头残差向量量化，并依据键/值不对称性做混合比特分配；同时展示归档向量可直接执行近似子串查询，截断存储点则进入有损区间。

papers.title: Beyond the Library: An Agentic Framework for Autoformalizing Research Mathematics
papers.abstract_en: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated exceptional capabilities in mathematical reasoning, they frequently produce subtle errors that evade human detection. Formal mathematical languages like Lean 4 offer mechanical proof checking, strongly motivating the need for autoformalization: the automatic translation of natural language mathematics into verifiable code. Recent trends indicate that general-purpose LLMs, heavily optimized for standard programming, now outperform smaller models explicitly fine-tuned for Lean. Leveraging this shift, we introduce *Theo*, an agentic autoformalization framework powered by general coding LLMs. At the core of our system is an orchestrator that manages a multi-agent pipeline tailored for research-level mathematics. Because cutting-edge research frequently relies on concepts outside the scope of existing libraries like Mathlib, our system dynamically extends necessary type definitions and validates them via a novel Auxiliary Lemma technique before formalizing the primary theorems. We applied our approach to PutnamBench, producing machine-checked Lean proofs for a random sample of 32 problems. Furthermore, we evaluate our system on seven research papers---five from the ACM Symposium on Theory of Computing (STOC) and two recent OpenAI manuscripts---spanning combinatorics, communication complexity, mechanism design, learning theory, number theory, discrete geometry, and graph theory. We successfully formalize their main theorems and proofs and validate the generated formalizations with human experts; notably, two developments require no axioms beyond Lean's kernel. All of our formalizations are available at https://beyondthelibrary.github.io/formal_arxiv/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Theo，一个由通用编程 LLM 驱动的智能体自动形式化框架（agentic autoformalization framework），用于将研究级数学中的自然语言定理自动翻译成 Lean 4 可验证代码。系统核心是 orchestrator 管理的多智能体流水线，针对超出 Mathlib 等现有库范围的概念动态扩展类型定义，并通过 Auxiliary Lemma 技术先验证这些定义再形式化主定理。作者在 PutnamBench 随机抽取的 32 个问题上生成机器检查的 Lean 证明，并在 7 篇研究论文上成功形式化主要定理和证明，其中 2 个开发不需要除 Lean 内核之外的公理。所有形式化结果均已公开。
Motivation: LLM 在数学推理中常产生人类难以察觉的细微错误，而 Lean 4 等形式化语言能提供机械证明检查，因此自动形式化很有价值。研究级数学经常依赖超出 Mathlib 等现有库范围的概念，这是形式化工作的主要瓶颈。
Method: 提出 Theo 框架，其核心 orchestrator 管理多智能体流水线，能够动态扩展必要的类型定义，并利用新颖的 Auxiliary Lemma 技术先对扩展定义做机械验证，再继续形式化主定理。系统基于通用编程 LLM，而非专门针对 Lean 微调的较小模型。
Result: 在 PutnamBench 上对随机抽样的 32 个问题产出机器检查的 Lean 证明；在 7 篇研究论文（涵盖组合学、通信复杂度、机制设计、学习理论、数论、离散几何和图论）上成功形式化其主要定理和证明，并经人类专家验证；其中两个开发不依赖额外公理。
Conclusion: 作者认为通用编程 LLM 在自动形式化任务上已优于专门微调 Lean 的模型，Theo 的智能体流水线与动态类型扩展机制能够处理研究级数学中的库外概念。所有形式化成果在项目网站公开供进一步使用与验证。

papers.title: Right Knowledge, Wrong Answer: Characterizing Parametric Temporal Conflict in Open-Weight Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Language models may encode both outdated facts and their newer replacements. We introduce Parametric Temporal Conflict (PTC), where the newer fact is present and recoverable, but the default forward pass prefers the outdated one. We release a deterministically verified benchmark of 8,746 Wikidata position-holder transitions and evaluate four open-weight language models across three families. A date-prefix prompt recovers the newer fact in 61-81% of PTC cases. Activation patching flips predictions in 72-85% of cases and localizes the preference to model-specific upper-layer regions. Residual-stream steering outperforms norm-matched random directions, indicating direction-specific representations. These results show that PTC reflects a localized representational preference rather than missing knowledge. Recovery is measured on oracle-identified conflicts because automatic detection remains unreliable. We release the benchmark, code, and statistics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出参数化时间冲突 (Parametric Temporal Conflict, PTC) 概念，指语言模型中较新的事实虽已编码且可恢复，但默认前向推理却倾向于输出过时事实。作者发布了包含 8,746 条 Wikidata 职位持有者变迁的确定性验证基准，评估三个模型家族的四个开源权重语言模型，并发现日期前缀提示可在 61-81% 的 PTC 案例中恢复新事实，激活修补 (activation patching) 可在 72-85% 的案例中翻转预测，并将偏好定位到模型特定的上层区域。
Motivation: 语言模型可能同时编码过时事实及其新版本，而默认推理会偏好过时答案，即使新知识实际存在于参数中；该问题影响模型的事实性和时间推理能力，且现有工作未系统刻画这一冲突。
Method: 作者定义 PTC 并构建确定性验证的 Wikidata 职位持有者变迁基准，随后对三个模型家族的四个开源权重模型进行评测，使用日期前缀提示、激活修补和残差流引导 (residual-stream steering) 等方法检验新事实是否可被恢复以及偏好所在位置。
Result: 日期前缀提示在 61-81% 的 PTC 案例中恢复新事实；激活修补在 72-85% 的案例中翻转预测，并将偏好定位到模型特定的上层区域；残差流引导优于规范匹配的随机方向，表明存在方向特定的表征。
Conclusion: 结果表明 PTC 反映的是局部化的表征偏好而非知识缺失；但恢复效果仅在 oracle 识别的冲突上测得，因为自动检测仍不可靠。

papers.title: As You Wish: Mission Planning with Formal Verification using LLMs in Precision Agriculture
papers.abstract_en: Though robotic systems are now being commercialized and deployed in various industries, many of these systems are highly specialized and often require an advanced skill set to operate and ensure they perform as instructed. To mitigate this problem, we recently introduced a mission planner leveraging LLMs to synthesize mission plans in precision agriculture based on mission descriptions provided in natural language. While the system demonstrates impressive performance, it also suffers from the inherent ambiguities of natural language. In this paper, we extend our system to address this issue by introducing multiple feedback loops in the planning architecture that leverage linear temporal logic (LTL) to ensure the mission planning system meets the specifications formulated by the user while still using natural language. To mitigate potential bias, this is achieved by using two different commercial LLMs in charge of the specification and verification subtasks. Through extensive experiments, we highlight the strengths and limitations of integrating mission verification into a fully autonomous pipeline, particularly regarding an LLM's ability to generate valuable LTL formulas, and show how our proposed implementation addresses and solves these challenges.
papers.journal_ref: Published in Proceedings of 2026 International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文扩展了作者此前提出的、基于大语言模型 (LLM) 的精准农业任务规划器，针对自然语言描述带来的歧义问题，在规划架构中引入多重反馈回路，并利用线性时序逻辑 (LTL) 将用户规范纳入验证流程。为避免偏差，规范生成与验证两个子任务分别由两家不同的商用 LLM 承担。实验重点考察了将任务验证集成到完全自主流水线中的优势与局限，尤其是 LLM 生成有效 LTL 公式的能力。
Motivation: 商用机器人系统往往高度专用化，操作者需要高级技能才能保证其按指令执行；此前基于 LLM 的精准农业任务规划器虽性能出色，但受限于自然语言固有的歧义性，难以确保生成的计划严格满足用户规范。
Method: 在规划架构中引入多个利用线性时序逻辑 (LTL) 的反馈回路，使系统在保持自然语言输入的同时验证任务计划是否符合用户规范；规范与验证子任务分别交由两个不同的商用 LLM 处理，以缓解单一模型带来的偏差。
Result: 通过大量实验，论文展示了将任务验证集成到完全自主流水线中的优势与局限，重点分析了 LLM 生成有价值 LTL 公式的能力，并说明所提出的实现如何应对这些挑战。摘要未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为在自主规划流水线中集成基于 LTL 的验证反馈可以有效提升计划对用户规范的符合度，同时也明确指出 LLM 生成 LTL 公式仍存在局限，而本文实现用于缓解这些问题。

papers.title: Beyond Weights and Gradients: A Taxonomy of Federated Learning Messages
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning is rapidly evolving beyond the exchange of traditional model weights and gradients, yet existing definitions fail to capture the full scope of modern payloads like synthetic data and federated analytics. This paper addresses the gap by proposing a formal mathematical definition of a federated message that accounts for both utility and privacy. We introduce a taxonomy that organizes these exchanges into three categories: model structures, statistical summaries, and data-conditioned representations. By evaluating these groups based on computational demands, communication costs, and privacy risks, we provide a clearer understanding of the trade-offs involved in decentralized training. Our review of 202 recent publications highlights a significant shift since 2021 toward diverse messaging paradigms, signaling a move away from standard deep learning updates toward more specialized information sharing. This framework provides a structured path for future research to optimize federated systems for varying hardware and security requirements.
papers.comment: 4 figures, 9 pages, with 7 pages of content
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出联邦学习（Federated Learning）正在超越传统权重与梯度的交换，但现有定义无法涵盖合成数据、联邦分析等现代负载。作者提出联邦消息（federated message）的形式化数学定义，兼顾效用与隐私，并将其归纳为模型结构、统计摘要、数据条件表示三类。通过回顾 202 篇近期文献，论文发现自 2021 年以来联邦学习通信范式呈现显著多样化趋势，并提供了一套评估计算开销、通信成本与隐私风险的分析框架。
Motivation: 现有联邦学习的定义主要围绕模型权重和梯度，无法捕捉合成数据、联邦分析等现代消息负载的多样性，因而缺少一个能同时刻画效用与隐私的统一定义框架。
Method: 提出一种联邦消息的形式化数学定义，并建立将消息划分为模型结构（model structures）、统计摘要（statistical summaries）、数据条件表示（data-conditioned representations）三类的分类法，再按计算需求、通信成本和隐私风险进行评估。
Result: 对 202 篇近期出版物的回顾显示，自 2021 年以来研究明显转向更多样化的消息范式，表明联邦学习正从标准深度学习更新走向更专门化的信息共享。
Conclusion: 该框架为面向不同硬件与安全需求优化联邦系统提供了结构化路径，作者强调其有助于未来研究在各消息类别间做出更好的权衡。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文指出联邦学习（Federated Learning）正在超越传统权重与梯度的交换，但现有定义无法涵盖合成数据、联邦分析等现代负载。作者提出联邦消息（federated message）的形式化数学定义，兼顾效用与隐私，并将其归纳为模型结构、统计摘要、数据条件表示三类。通过回顾 202 篇近期文献，论文发现自 2021 年以来联邦学习通信范式呈现显著多样化趋势，并提供了一套评估计算开销、通信成本与隐私风险的分析框架。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有联邦学习的定义主要围绕模型权重和梯度，无法捕捉合成数据、联邦分析等现代消息负载的多样性，因而缺少一个能同时刻画效用与隐私的统一定义框架。
summary_sections.method: 提出一种联邦消息的形式化数学定义，并建立将消息划分为模型结构（model structures）、统计摘要（statistical summaries）、数据条件表示（data-conditioned representations）三类的分类法，再按计算需求、通信成本和隐私风险进行评估。

summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架为面向不同硬件与安全需求优化联邦系统提供了结构化路径，作者强调其有助于未来研究在各消息类别间做出更好的权衡。

papers.title: ClayBuddy: A Framework, Evaluation, & Mitigation of Coding Agent Failures
papers.abstract_en: Software engineering and deployment are increasingly delegated to AI coding agents. The scale of their adoption is surfacing rare, but highly destructive, failure modes. In this paper, we study these failure modes as stemming from three distinct mechanisms: underspecification, where default model behavior is unsafe; capability errors, where the safe action is available but the model does not adhere to it due to bias or capability limitations; and agent harness errors, where the model fails to execute the safe action through the harness. We assess these across 8 different evaluations, each inspired by real-life deployment failures, totaling 20 coding environments and 59 synthetic transcript templates. These evaluations act as controlled stress tests for isolating our failure mechanisms. Based on this evaluation, we propose ClayBuddy, a harness modification that molds to user preferences and can be modified by the model in-session, to mitigate these errors. By adding tools for the agent to edit its own context, an extended system prompt, a customizable command classifier, and deterministic guardrails, we show that ClayBuddy is safer across a statistically significant number of samples. Thus, we suggest concrete mitigations for current coding agents and a design philosophy for future agent harness features.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 AI 编码代理（coding agent）在软件工程与部署中的罕见但破坏性故障模式，将其归因于三种机制：规格不足（underspecification）、能力错误（capability errors）与代理脚手架错误（agent harness errors）。作者构建了 8 个评估、20 个编码环境与 59 个合成转录模板作为受控压力测试，并提出 ClayBuddy——一种可随用户偏好调整、并允许模型在会话内自行修改的脚手架（harness）改造方案。摘要报告 ClayBuddy 在统计显著数量的样本上更安全。
Motivation: AI 编码代理的广泛采用正在暴露一些罕见但破坏性强的失败模式，而现有系统缺乏对这些失败机制的清晰分类与针对性缓解手段。
Method: 将故障分为 underspecification、capability errors 和 agent harness errors 三类，并设计 8 个源自真实部署失败场景的评估来隔离这些机制；随后提出 ClayBuddy，通过增加供代理编辑自身上下文的工具、扩展系统提示、可定制的命令分类器以及确定性护栏（guardrails）来缓解错误。
Result: 摘要称 ClayBuddy 在统计显著数量的样本上安全性更高，评估覆盖 20 个编码环境和 59 个合成转录模板。
Conclusion: 作者建议为当前编码代理提供具体缓解措施，并为未来代理脚手架特性提出设计理念。
