papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CLARA，一个通过下游结果分析来澄清自然语言癌症基因组学查询中语义歧义的框架。CLARA 将问题表示为类型化的科学查询规范，枚举少量可能解释并执行它们，当估计结果发散时请求用户澄清。在 TCGA PanCancer Atlas 8 个队列与 30 基因面板上的突变患病率对比基准中，CLARA 在 120 问 LLM 生成的语言压力测试上达到 89.2% 准确率，并揭示了下游执行如何区分后果性歧义与非后果性歧义。
Motivation: 自然语言界面能降低癌症基因组学数据库的使用门槛，但完全流畅的问题在科学语义上仍可能含糊；现有方法难以判断哪些歧义真正影响查询结果。
Method: CLARA 将问题转为带类型的科学查询规格，生成若干候选解释并实际执行，依据预先注册的发散判据（相对发散大于 0.10 或绝对发散大于 5 个百分点）决定是否发起澄清。
Result: 在 330 个可执行对比中，115 个为结果敏感 (result-sensitive)、215 个为结果稳定；独立实现的 pandas 执行引擎完全复现了 SQLite 引擎的全部 660 个结果。在 120 问语言压力测试中，CLARA 识别出全部 60 个结果敏感对比，对 60 个稳定对比中的 13 个进行不必要澄清（准确率 89.2%，灵敏度 100%，特异度 78.3%）；独立机器学习整体准确率更高（97.5%）但漏掉一个关键对比。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，通过下游执行可以区分实质性歧义与无关紧要的歧义，并显式展现安全性（不遗漏关键对比）与用户负担（不必要澄清）之间的权衡。

papers.title: Position: It's Time to Optimize LLMs for Self-Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Despite ever-increasing sophistication in language model (LM) pre- and post-training pipelines, many important failures persist: models overcondition on user framing ("sycophancy"), exhibit incomplete logical generalization, and produce confident but incorrect responses. We argue that these failures arise from a modeling assumption permeating all aspects of the pipeline: that behavior can be specified and evaluated independently on single-output pairs. Many model failures are difficult, if not impossible, to detect without reasoning about relationships between a model's responses across inputs. In this position paper, we propose self-consistency as a framework for understanding these failures. We first observe that a wide variety of techniques designed to improve specific aspects of LM behavior-targeting properties as diverse as adversarial robustness and factual coherence-can be understood as special cases of a common "consistency optimization" procedure and addressed with a standard set of optimization tools. We next outline a set of new model properties that could be achieved by optimizing for consistency, and conclude with a discussion of what it would mean to develop generally consistent LMs, including the capabilities they would enable and the objections they raise.

Motivation: 现有 LM 虽在预训练和后训练上日益复杂，仍存在谄媚 (sycophancy)、逻辑泛化不完整、自信但错误等持续失败。作者认为这些失败源于一种贯穿全流程的建模假设：行为可基于单输出对独立指定和评估，而许多失败需要跨输入的响应关系才能检测。
Method: 提出将自我一致性作为分析失败的框架，把多种针对不同属性（如对抗鲁棒性、事实连贯性）的现有技术重新解释为一种共同的一致性优化过程，并概述可通过优化一致性实现的一组新模型属性。
Result: 作为立场论文，未报告实验数据。核心论点是通过一致性视角统一多种现有技术，并推导出可优化获得的新性质。
Conclusion: 作者讨论开发一般一致性 LM 的意义，包括其能启用的能力与引发的异议，呼吁将优化目标从单输出对转向跨输入的自我一致性。

papers.title: HoloCount: A Holistic Visual Counting Benchmark for MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Visual counting is a fundamental pillar of multimodal intelligence, requiring a seamless integration of fine-grained grounding and spatial reasoning. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable success in qualitative scene understanding, their quantitative precision remains a significant bottleneck, often characterized by persistent numerical hallucinations. Existing counting benchmarks primarily focus on basic perception in simplified contexts, failing to capture the complex failure modes that emerge under logical constraints or adversarial conditions. To address these limitations, we introduce HoloCount, a holistic and diagnostically rich benchmark structured around a three-level hierarchical taxonomy. HoloCount evaluates MLLMs across: (1) Semantic Counting, focusing on atomic and property-based enumeration; (2) Analytical Counting, assessing logical composition through spatial and set-based reasoning; and (3) Robustness Testing, probing model integrity against adverse scenarios and grounded counter-priors, such as high-density scenes and linguistic biases. Through an exhaustive evaluation of over 20 state-of-the-art MLLMs, we reveal a critical performance gap: even top-tier models degrade significantly as tasks transition from perception to complex analytical reasoning and adverse scenarios. Our findings provide a systematic landscape of current MLLM counting capabilities and offer a roadmap for developing more grounded and reliable multimodal systems. The dataset is available at https://mm-mvr.github.io/HoloCount/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HoloCount，一个面向多模态大语言模型 (MLLMs) 的视觉计数基准，采用三级层次化分类法 (three-level hierarchical taxonomy) 系统评估模型的计数能力。作者对 20 多个前沿 MLLM 进行评测，发现即便是顶级模型也会在从基础感知转向复杂分析推理和对抗场景时显著退化，说明当前 MLLM 的定量精度仍是瓶颈。数据集已公开。
Motivation: 现有计数基准主要关注简化场景中的基础感知，无法覆盖逻辑约束或对抗条件下出现的复杂失败模式；同时 MLLMs 常出现数值幻觉 (numerical hallucinations)，定量精度不足。
Method: HoloCount 围绕三级分类法构建：语义计数 (Semantic Counting) 评估原子与属性基枚举，分析计数 (Analytical Counting) 通过空间与集合推理评估逻辑组合，鲁棒性测试 (Robustness Testing) 针对高密度场景与语言偏见等对抗/反先验情形检验模型。
Result: 对超过 20 个 SOTA MLLM 的系统评测显示存在显著性能差距：任务从感知过渡到复杂分析推理和不利场景时，即使是顶级模型也会大幅退化。
Conclusion: 该工作描绘了当前 MLLM 计数能力的系统全貌，并为开发更可靠、更扎实的多模态系统提供了路线图。

papers.title: Automatic Detection of Deaths from Social Networking Sites
papers.abstract_en: This dissertation analysed and discussed the differences in linguistic characteristics between pre-mortem and post-mortem social media content, and reported machine learning (ML) classifiers that achieved high performance in automatically detecting deaths of social networking site users from posts associated with their profiles. A new dataset was developed using Wikidata and Twitter. ML models, both traditional (RF, KNN, LR, and SVM) and deep learning (BiLSTM, CNN, and the state-of-the-art BERT), were trained on features extracted using TF-IDF and pre-trained embeddings (Glove, Word2Vec, and FastText) to classify post-mortem content from its pre-mortem counterpart. The results showed that RF outperformed all other traditional ML models; BiLSTM outperformed CNN; TF-IDF consistently outperformed pre-trained word embeddings for the traditional models; Word2Vec consistently outperformed Glove and FastText for the deep learning models; and BERT outperformed all other models. It was found that although pre-mortem and post-mortem tweets express similar levels of positive sentiment, post-mortem tweets exhibit higher negative sentiment, whereas pre-mortem tweets exhibit higher neutral sentiment. Feelings suggesting negativity (sad, angry, surprise, and fear) are more dominant in post-mortem tweets, while happy is more dominant in pre-mortem tweets. It was also found that words, personal pronouns, verbs, family words, religious words, death words, and swear words occur more frequently in post-mortem tweets, whereas impersonal pronouns and informal words occur more frequently in pre-mortem tweets. Additionally, analytical thinking is expressed more in post-mortem than pre-mortem conversations. This experiment's significant contribution is the successful development of an exceptionally high-performing technique for automatically detecting user deaths on social networking sites.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇分析社交媒体用户死亡前后内容语言差异并构建自动检测模型的学位论文。作者利用 Wikidata 和 Twitter 构建新数据集，训练传统机器学习（RF、KNN、LR、SVM）与深度学习（BiLSTM、CNN、BERT）模型，使用 TF-IDF 及多种预训练词向量进行分类。结果显示 BERT 综合表现最佳，RF 在传统模型中最优，TF-IDF 对传统模型更有效，Word2Vec 对深度学习模型更有效；情感与词汇分析也揭示了濒死与死后推文的差异。
Motivation: 社交媒体上存在大量已故用户的账号及其相关帖子，自动检测用户死亡对在线身份管理、遗产处理等场景有价值，而此前缺乏针对性的高准确率检测方法。
Method: 利用 Wikidata 和 Twitter 构建标注数据集，分别用 TF-IDF 和 GloVe、Word2Vec、FastText 提取特征，训练 RF、KNN、LR、SVM 以及 BiLSTM、CNN、BERT 等模型，对死后内容与生前内容进行分类，并对比不同特征与模型的性能。
Result: 摘要报告 RF 在传统模型中表现最优，BiLSTM 优于 CNN；TF-IDF 在传统模型上始终优于预训练词向量，Word2Vec 在深度学习模型上始终优于 GloVe 和 FastText，BERT 则超过所有其他模型。情感分析显示死后推文负面情绪更高、生前推文中性情绪更高，sad、angry、surprise、fear 等负面感受在死后推文中更突出，happy 在生前推文中更突出；词语、人称代词、动词、家庭词、宗教词、死亡词和脏话在死后推文中更频繁，非人称代词和非正式词在生前推文中更频繁，死后对话的分析性思维也更强。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作的主要贡献是成功开发了一种高性能的社交媒体用户死亡自动检测技术。

papers.title: Autonomous Research Agents: A Survey of AI Scientists and the Verification Gap
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used across the scientific research lifecycle: ideation, literature search, experiment design and execution, analysis, manuscript drafting, and review. End-to-end AI scientist systems can now produce paper-like manuscripts, but their claims are often harder to verify than their code is to run. This survey studies that gap in computational AI/ML research, where code, benchmarks, experiments, and write-ups are most visible. We screen 125 candidate works and include 35, with full-text coding of 26 entries: 24 runnable systems and two study or position papers. We code seven audit dimensions: lifecycle stage, autonomy level, evaluation method, released artifacts, human-in-the-loop points, novelty verification, and result-selection disclosure. The main pattern is that code release is now common, but reproducibility-grade and claim-verification artifacts remain much less common. In the 24 runnable systems, 83 percent release code, while 38 percent release seeds or execution traces and 38 percent report any novelty-verification method. Among nine closed-loop L4 systems, seven are mechanical reruns and one is author-claimed without an external check; no LLM-era system in the corpus demonstrates an externally validated in-loop oracle under our coding rule. We contribute a coded corpus, a lifecycle-by-autonomy map, an auditability-gap analysis, and a reviewer-facing reporting checklist. The survey argues that the field's central bottleneck is no longer only whether agents can complete research tasks, but whether reviewers can verify the claims those agents produce.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对端到端 AI 科学家（LLM agent 驱动的自动科研系统）的系统性综述，重点刻画其声称结果的“可验证性缺口”。作者筛选 125 篇候选工作、纳入 35 篇，并对其中 26 篇做全文编码（24 个可运行系统与 2 篇研究/立场论文），按生命周期阶段、自主性等级、评估方法、发布工件、人在回路点、新颖性验证和结果选择披露七个维度审计。主要发现是代码发布已很普遍，但可复现级与声称验证级工件仍明显不足；语料中没有 LLM 时代系统在外部验证下展示可用的环内 oracle（in-loop oracle）。
Motivation: LLM agent 正被用于科研生命周期的各个环节，并能产出近似论文的手稿，但其声称往往比代码更难验证。作者针对计算性 AI/ML 研究中代码、基准、实验与写作最可见的特点，研究这一验证缺口。
Method: 采用系统筛选与全文编码的综述方法：先筛选 125 篇候选工作，纳入 35 篇，并对 26 篇做全文编码；以七个审计维度（生命周期阶段、自主性等级、评估方法、发布工件、人在回路点、新颖性验证、结果选择披露）分析可运行系统及研究论文。
Result: 在 24 个可运行系统中，83% 发布代码，38% 发布种子或执行轨迹，38% 报告了任何新颖性验证方法；9 个闭环 L4 系统中 7 个是机械式重跑，1 个仅由作者声称而无外部检查，没有一个系统被编码规则认定具备外部验证的环内 oracle。
Conclusion: 作者认为该领域的核心瓶颈已不再是 agent 能否完成科研任务，而是审稿人能否验证这些 agent 所产生的声称；代码发布虽常见，但可复现级与声称验证级工件仍然缺乏，并据此提出编码语料、生命周期-自主性图谱、可审计性缺口分析与面向审稿人的报告检查清单。

papers.title: Who Gets Access? Global Region and Academic Status Bias in AI-Generated Academic Gatekeeping Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Equitable access to scientific knowledge often depends on informal gatekeeping decisions, particularly when resources such as paywalled articles, datasets, or professional materials such as curriculum vitae (CV) must be shared selectively. We introduce a controlled simulation framework in which large language model (LLM)-based professors must grant access to only one requestor. Across prompts, requesters vary systematically by global region (Global North vs. Global South) and academic seniority (undergraduate student, PhD candidate, postdoctoral researcher, and tenured professor), while all other factors remain constant. Across varying evaluation scenarios, LLMs exhibit contrasting academic status biases, with some prioritizing PhD candidates, while others favor tenured professors. However, when global regions differ, a distinct divergence emerges based on model architecture: while many frontier LLMs systematically favor requesters from the Global South due to pro-equity bias that results from equity-focused safety alignment, open-weight and small models frequently flip this preference to favor the Global North, reflecting the global region bias and unaligned geographic distribution of their baseline pre-training data. Our findings highlight how normative assumptions embedded in model behavior can shape gatekeeping decisions, underscoring the importance of auditing AI systems for fairness and value alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个受控模拟框架，让基于大语言模型（LLM）的教授角色只能将访问权授予一个请求者，请求者按全球区域（Global North vs. Global South）和学术资历（本科生、博士生、博士后、终身教授）系统变化。摘要报告LLM表现出相互对照的学术地位偏见，且在全球区域维度出现架构性分歧：许多前沿LLM因公平导向的安全对齐而偏向Global South，开放权重与小模型则常翻转偏好偏向Global North。作者强调规范性假设嵌入模型行为会影响把关决策，凸显审计AI公平性与价值对齐的重要性。
Motivation: 科学知识的公平获取常取决于非正式把关决策，例如选择性共享付费文章、数据集或简历等资源，而现有研究对LLM在此类把关场景中的系统性偏见关注不足。
Method: 构建受控模拟实验：由LLM扮演教授，在保持其他因素不变的情况下，仅依据请求者的全球区域和学术资历来决定唯一获批者，从而隔离区域与资历对决策的影响。
Result: 不同评估场景下LLM呈现对比性的学术地位偏见，有的偏向博士生，有的偏向终身教授；当区域变化时，前沿LLM因亲平等偏见（pro-equity bias）偏好Global South，而开放权重和小模型常偏好Global North，反映出预训练数据的地域分布偏差。
Conclusion: 模型行为中嵌入的规范性假设会塑造学术把关决策，研究强调需要对AI系统的公平性和价值对齐进行审计。

papers.title: Challenges for Musical Education in the Age of AI and Digital Transformation
papers.abstract_en: Music education has never been a static discipline. Each major technological shift has forced educators and institutions to reconsider what they teach, how they teach it, and why. We now stand at what may be the most consequential of such turning points. Three deeply intertwined transformations have been converging simultaneously: 1. The very nature of music has changed: how it is made, distributed, consumed, and valued; 2. The public for music has changed: listening habits are now shaped by streaming algorithms and the boundary between consumer and creator has blurred; 3. Music-making itself has changed: digital audio workstations (DAWs) have for two decades been reshaping compositional practice. In addition, generative AI has now irrupted, capable of producing complete, stylistically coherent musical pieces from a short text prompt. These changes are not independent of one another, and they all bear directly on musical education - both the content that must be taught, and the pedagogical tools and methods available to teach it. This paper attempts to map these challenges and to consider how education might adapt. Section 2 surveys the changes in various aspects of music (nature, production, public, economics). Section 3 examines the implications for education before Section 4 concludes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于人工智能与数字化转型背景下音乐教育所面临挑战的综述性/观点性论文。作者指出音乐本身、音乐受众以及音乐创作方式三方面变化正在同时发生，生成式 AI 已能根据短文本提示生成完整且风格一致的音乐作品，这些变化直接影响到音乐教育的内容与教学工具。文章试图系统梳理这些挑战，并思考教育可能的适应方向。
Motivation: 音乐教育历来随技术变迁而调整，而当前音乐本质、受众习惯与创作实践三个层面的变化相互交织并同时发生，加之生成式 AI 的闯入，使得音乐教育在教学内容、教学工具和方法上都需要重新审视。
Method: 论文采用结构化的梳理与论述方式：第 2 节综述音乐在本质、生产、受众和经济等方面的变化；第 3 节考察这些变化对音乐教育的影响；第 4 节进行总结。
Result: 摘要未报告任何实证结果或量化数据；论文的贡献在于对上述挑战进行系统性的映射和分析。
Conclusion: 作者指出音乐教育需适应这些技术驱动的变革，但摘要仅说明论文试图勾勒挑战并考虑适应路径，未给出具体的教育应对方案或结论建议。

papers.title: The Closing Window: How Governments Could Lose Their Ability to Restrain Advanced AI
papers.abstract_en: As AI capabilities advance, AI systems will pose greater risks to national security and potentially humanity as a whole. Governments may eventually conclude that these risks warrant restraining AI development. This motivates the question: will governments still be able to restrain AI development in the future, should they want to do so? In this paper we analyze which world events and changes to the state of AI development would make future governance more difficult or even effectively impossible. Our analysis surfaces likely pathways that would lead to these difficulties, including hardware proliferation, continued algorithmic progress, and the release of catastrophically dangerous AI models. Due to the field's lack of understanding of AI development, it may be difficult or impossible to know when we will hit a "point of no return", and we therefore recommend a conservative approach. The window may be closing, but governments currently have an opportunity to preserve their optionality if they act soon. Our policy recommendations would enable governments to restrain AI development in the future, while imposing relatively small costs today.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析未来政府是否仍能约束高级 AI 发展，并探讨哪些世界事件与 AI 发展状态变化会使治理变得更困难甚至几乎不可能，包括硬件扩散、持续算法进步以及灾难性危险 AI 模型的发布。作者指出由于该领域对 AI 发展缺乏理解，人们可能难以或无法预知何时会到达“不可逆转点”，因此建议采取保守策略；窗口可能正在关闭，但政府目前仍有通过低成本行动保留未来可选择性的机会。
Motivation: 随着 AI 能力提升，AI 系统将对国家安全乃至整个人类构成更大风险，政府最终可能认为有必要限制 AI 发展；因此核心问题是，未来政府若想约束 AI 发展，是否仍具备这种能力。
Method: 本文通过分析可能使未来治理更困难或失效的路径（硬件扩散、持续算法进步、发布灾难性危险 AI 模型等）来评估治理可行性，并提出政策建议，以让政府在当前付出相对较小成本的情况下保留未来约束 AI 发展的可选性。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数据或定量结果；主要结论是存在通往“不可逆转点”的多种可能路径，且由于领域认识不足，该时点难以或无法准确预知，因此作者推荐保守行动。
Conclusion: 作者强调治理窗口可能正在关闭，但政府若尽快行动仍有机会保留未来的约束能力；这些政策将给当前带来相对较小的成本。摘要同时承认 AI 发展不确定性使得“不可逆转点”的判断本身就十分困难。

papers.title: Estimating time spent on work tasks
papers.abstract_en: The task-based framework in economics models occupations as bundles of tasks. It is the standard lens for understanding how technology affects work: a new technology changes the cost or time each task requires and these task-level effects aggregate to occupation-level effects. We study how tasks should be weighted in this aggregation. Prior work has relied on idiosyncratic or ill-justified choices for task weights. While recent work suggests weighting tasks by time spent, existing time shares are either based on coarse ONET data not intended for this purpose or estimated via black-box language models. We address this gap by proposing a principled method for estimating time shares for nearly 18,000 tasks that constitute nearly all U.S. jobs. Our estimates factor a task's time into (i) the expected frequency of the task, derived from ONET, and (ii) the time to complete a single instance of it. To estimate the latter, we solve a constraint satisfaction problem based on pairwise comparisons elicited from language models about which tasks are longer per instance. We validate our estimates by characterizing the solution space of the constraint satisfaction problem and collecting data from workers for multiple occupations. We apply our time shares to analyze how AI exposes U.S. occupations and find that some prior results are sensitive to time weights. Accounting for the share of working time exposed to AI, rather than the share of tasks like prior work, widens the gap between the least and most exposed jobs: it lowers measured exposure for most occupations but raises it for the most exposed. Re-weighting by time also reshuffles 11 of the 25 occupations widely reported as most exposed to AI, shifting the top of the list away from clerical work and toward analytical roles. Time shares can serve as a general primitive for research and policy on the labor economy and the economics of technology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究经济学任务框架中任务权重（task weights）的确定问题，提出一种有原则的方法来估计几乎涵盖美国全部职业的约 18,000 个任务的时间份额（time shares）。作者将任务时间分解为 O*NET 推导的预期频率与单次实例所需时间之积，并用语言模型生成的成对比较构造约束满足问题（constraint satisfaction problem）来估计后者。验证后，他们用时间份额重新分析 AI 对美国职业的暴露程度，发现部分先前结论对时间权重敏感，并导致最暴露职业榜单发生明显重排。
Motivation: 任务框架是理解技术如何影响工作的标准视角，但此前任务权重多依赖主观或缺乏依据的选择；现有的时间份额要么基于并不为此目的设计的粗糙 O*NET 数据，要么来自黑箱语言模型。由于任务层面的效应会聚合成职业层面效应，权重选择直接决定 AI 暴露等结论的可靠性。
Method: 提出估计约 18,000 个任务时间份额的两因子方法：时间 = 任务的预期频率（来自 O*NET）× 完成单个实例所需时间。后者通过求解一个基于语言模型两两比较（哪个任务每实例耗时更长）的约束满足问题得到，并通过刻画该问题的解空间以及收集多个职业的工人数据进行验证。
Result: 结果显示，按工作时间暴露占比而非任务数量占比来度量 AI 暴露，会拉大暴露最低与最高职业之间的差距：大多数职业的测得暴露下降，而最高暴露职业反而上升。按时间重新加权还使广泛报道的 25 个最暴露职业榜单中 11 个发生变动，顶端从文书类工作转向分析类角色。
Conclusion: 作者认为时间份额可作为劳动经济与技术经济学研究及政策分析的通用基础构件；并强调已有 AI 暴露结论对时间权重敏感，按其方法修正后职业排名发生显著变化。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Beyond Information Retrieval: Generative AI as an Epistemic Arbiter to Enhance Collaborative Problem-Solving
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI (GAI) creates new opportunities for collaborative problem-solving (CPS), yet its role in shaping student interaction remains unclear. To address this gap, we conducted a six-week quasi-experimental study with 201 fifth-grade students in two conditions: with and without GAI. Chi-square analysis showed significant differences in CPS behavior distributions between groups. Compared with the control group, the GAI-supported group demonstrated more social behaviors, particularly engagement and conflict management, but less frequent cognitive behaviors such as task planning and solution reasoning. Lag sequential analysis further revealed distinct interaction patterns: while the control group followed a more conventional transition from listening to planning, the GAI group showed a robust pathway from task planning to conflict management to solution reasoning. Thematic analysis of AI interaction logs suggested that students used GAI as an epistemic arbiter, drawing on AI-generated facts and visualizations to resolve disagreements constructively. These findings suggest that GAI reshapes CPS by mediating the transition from social conflict to collaborative reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了一项为期六周的准实验研究，探讨生成式AI（GAI）在协作问题解决（CPS）中的作用，研究对象为201名五年级学生，分为有无GAI支持两种条件。卡方分析显示两组CPS行为分布存在显著差异：GAI支持组表现出更多社交行为（如参与和冲突管理），而较少认知行为（如任务规划和解决方案推理）。滞后序列分析和AI交互日志主题分析表明，学生将GAI用作“认知仲裁者”（epistemic arbiter），借助AI生成的事实和可视化来建设性地解决分歧。
Motivation: 生成式AI为协作问题解决创造了新机会，但其在塑造学生互动方面所起的具体作用尚不明确，作者旨在填补这一研究空白。
Method: 采用六周准实验设计，比较201名五年级学生在有/无GAI条件下的CPS行为；使用卡方分析检验行为分布差异，用滞后序列分析（lag sequential analysis）揭示交互模式，并对AI交互日志进行主题分析。
Result: 与对照组相比，GAI支持组的社交行为（特别是参与和冲突管理）更频繁，而任务规划和解决方案推理等认知行为较少；GAI组表现出从任务规划到冲突管理再到解决方案推理的稳定交互路径，而对照组遵循从听到规划的传统路径。
Conclusion: 研究认为GAI通过将社会冲突转化为协作推理来重塑CPS，学生将其用作认知仲裁者来建设性解决分歧。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 研究认为GAI通过将社会冲突转化为协作推理来重塑CPS，学生将其用作认知仲裁者来建设性解决分歧。

papers.title: DREAM: LLM-based Dynamic Role-playing via Event-Aware Memory Graph
papers.abstract_en: Role-playing agents (RPAs) have emerged as a key application of large language models, enabling immersive and high-fidelity character simulation. Accurate role-playing of established characters requires not only stylistic imitation but also temporally consistent and causally grounded behavioral reasoning. However, existing RPAs primarily rely on static character descriptions and unstructured memory, limiting their ability to maintain long-term narrative and personality coherence. We introduce DREAM, a structured memory framework for role-playing agents inspired by the Activating Event-Belief-Consequence (ABC) cognitive model. DREAM transforms unstructured literary text into an Event-aware Memory Graph (EMG) that organizes character experiences into temporally ordered and causally linked event graph. This representation enables the construction of dynamic, dual-granularity character profiles that capture both stable personality traits and event-driven behavioral evolution. We further propose the Temporal Causal Memory (TCM) benchmark to evaluate temporal consistency and long-range causal narrative coherence. DREAM achieves state-of-the-art performance across CoSER, LIFECHOICE, and TCM, outperforming multiple strong baselines. Our approach demonstrates the effectiveness of structured memory in enhancing the interpretability and consistency of role-playing agents.
papers.comment: Accepted at KDD 2026. Camera-ready version to appear. 16 pages, 5 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DREAM，一个面向大语言模型角色扮演代理的结构化记忆框架，受 ABC（Activating Event-Belief-Consequence）认知模型启发。DREAM 将非结构化文学文本转换为事件感知记忆图（Event-aware Memory Graph, EMG），把角色经历组织成时间有序、因果关联的事件图，并据此构建动态的双粒度（dual-granularity）角色档案。作者还提出 Temporal Causal Memory (TCM) 基准来评估时序一致性与长程因果叙事连贯性；摘要称 DREAM 在 CoSER、LIFECHOICE 和 TCM 上超越多个强基线，达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 现有角色扮演代理主要依赖静态角色描述和非结构化记忆，难以维持长篇叙事中的时间一致性与人格连贯性，也缺乏基于因果关系的行为推理能力。
Method: 提出 DREAM 框架：基于 ABC 认知模型将非结构化文学文本转化为事件感知记忆图（EMG），构建时间有序且因果关联的事件图表示；进一步构造动态双粒度角色档案，同时刻画稳定的性格特质与事件驱动的行为演化，并设计 TCM 基准用于评测。
Result: 摘要报告 DREAM 在 CoSER、LIFECHOICE 以及新提出的 TCM 基准上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，优于多个强基线；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结构化记忆能够增强角色扮演代理的可解释性与一致性，说明事件级结构化表示对长程角色模拟的有效性。

papers.title: Woodpecker Distillation: Weak Models Diagnose Reasoning Bugs in Strong Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models often fail on reasoning tasks despite possessing the capability to solve them. We argue that many such failures arise from localized reasoning bugs in intermediate steps rather than from global incompetence. We show that these bugs are frequently repairable: inserting a short patch generated by a weak probe model after the same strong-model reasoning prefix can redirect the trajectory toward a correct solution. However, this corrective effect is not reliably internalized by directly fine-tuning on weak patches or repaired trajectories, suggesting that the useful signal lies not in the intervention text itself, but in how it reshapes the model's future reasoning distribution. We therefore propose Woodpecker Distillation, a weak-to-strong training framework that learns from contrastive local interventions. Our method contrasts successful and unsuccessful weak-model patches at the same prefix, constructs a corrective teacher distribution from their induced future token predictions, and distills this signal into the strong model. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that Woodpecker Distillation consistently improves strong-model performance and outperforms direct imitation baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文认为大语言模型在推理任务上的许多失败源于中间步骤的局部推理错误，而非整体能力不足。作者发现用弱探针模型在相同推理前缀后插入短补丁可以纠正轨迹，但直接微调弱补丁或修复轨迹无法可靠内化该信号，因此提出 Woodpecker Distillation，一种从对比局部干预中学习的弱到强训练框架。实验表明该方法在数学推理基准上稳定提升强模型性能，并优于直接模仿基线。
Motivation: 大语言模型虽具备求解推理任务的能力，却仍频繁失败；已有方法未充分区分局部推理错误与全局能力不足，且弱模型补丁的纠正信号难以通过直接微调被强模型内化。
Method: Woodpecker Distillation 在相同推理前缀下对比成功与不成功的弱模型补丁，利用它们诱导出的未来 token 预测构造纠正性教师分布，并将该信号蒸馏到强模型中。
Result: 在数学推理基准上的实验显示，该方法一致地提升强模型性能，并优于直接模仿基线。
Conclusion: 作者强调有价值的信息不在于干预文本本身，而在于干预如何重塑模型未来的推理分布，这为弱到强推理蒸馏提供了新视角。

papers.title: Conditional Cognitive Biases in LLMs: How Biased User Turns Modulate In-Context Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We present an evaluation of cognitive bias expression in state-of-the-art instruction-tuned LLMs under realistic multi-turn interaction settings. Our work introduces a novel three-condition experimental framework that disentangles the effect of exposure to a biased user turn from the effect of the turn's semantic content, alongside a benchmark of 24,300 jury-validated user prompts spanning all 81 cells of a 9x9 target-human bias interaction matrix. Across eight frontier LLMs, we find that biased conversational context systematically increases bias expression relative to zero-shot baselines in 6 of 8 models. We identify two competing behavioral dynamics underlying this effect: conversational exposure to biased reasoning generally amplifies downstream bias tendencies, while explicitly stated bias cues often trigger alignment-related suppression behaviors that reduce overt bias expression. We release our framework, codebase, and dataset to support future research on context-conditioned cognitive biases and behavioral adaptation in LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估指令微调大语言模型（LLM）在真实多轮交互设定下的认知偏差表达，提出一个三条件实验框架，将“暴露于有偏差的用户轮次”与“该轮次的语义内容”的影响分离，并构建包含 24,300 条经陪审验证的用户提示的基准，覆盖 9x9 目标-人类偏差交互矩阵的全部 81 个单元。在 8 个前沿 LLM 上，6 个模型在偏差对话上下文中的偏差表达相对 zero-shot 基线系统性增加。作者识别出两种相互竞争的行为动态：暴露于偏差推理通常放大后续偏差倾向，而明确陈述的偏差线索常触发与对齐相关的抑制行为，减少外显偏差表达。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 认知偏差评估多局限于单轮或零样本设定，缺乏对真实多轮交互中用户话语如何调节偏差表达的系统研究；同时需要区分偏差暴露效应与语义内容效应。
Method: 提出三条件实验框架以解耦偏差暴露与语义内容，构建 9x9 目标-人类偏差交互矩阵，生成 24,300 条经陪审验证的用户提示，并在 8 个前沿指令微调 LLM 上开展多轮交互评估。
Result: 在 8 个模型中，6 个模型的偏差表达相对 zero-shot 基线系统性增加；进一步识别出两种动态：对偏差推理的对话暴露通常会放大后续偏差倾向，而明确偏差线索往往触发对齐相关的抑制现象，减少外显偏差表达。
Conclusion: 作者发布实验框架、代码库与数据集，以支持后续关于上下文条件认知偏差及 LLM 行为适应的研究。

papers.title: A Study of ASR Adaptation and Representation Dimensionality Reduction in Persian Speech Emotion Recognition Using Whisper
papers.abstract_en: Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) in low-resource languages remains a challenging problem due to limited labeled data. In this work, we study the use of Whisper for Persian SER with a particular focus on representation dimensionality reduction and language-specific model adaptation. We propose a SER framework in which frame-level embeddings extracted from the Whisper encoder are reduced in dimensionality using PCA, eliminating the need for learned projection layers and substantially reducing the number of trainable parameters. The reduced representations are aggregated using an attention-based pooling mechanism and classified with a lightweight prediction head. In addition, we investigate whether fine-tuning Whisper on a Persian automatic speech recognition (ASR) task improves downstream SER performance. Experiments conducted on the ShEMO dataset under a speaker-independent evaluation protocol show that PCA-based dimensionality reduction consistently improves emotion recognition performance while reducing training latency and memory usage. ASR fine-tuning yields only modest gains for SER, suggesting limited transfer from language adaptation to emotion-related representations under the evaluated conditions. These findings provide practical insights into the efficient use of large pretrained speech models for emotion recognition in low-resource languages.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在低资源语言波斯语的语音情感识别（SER）中高效使用 Whisper 的方法，重点考察表示降维和语言相关模型适配。作者提出以 PCA 对 Whisper 编码器输出的帧级嵌入降维，省去可学习投影层并大幅减少可训练参数，再用基于注意力的池化与轻量分类头完成情感识别。在 ShEMO 数据集、说话人无关评估协议下，PCA 降维持续提升情感识别性能并降低训练延迟和内存占用；在波斯语 ASR 任务上微调 Whisper 仅带来有限收益，提示语言适配对情感相关表示的迁移有限。
Motivation: 低资源语言的语音情感识别受限于标注数据稀缺，且直接使用大规模预训练语音模型（如 Whisper）在参数效率与训练成本上存在挑战。论文针对这一问题，探索表示降维与语言特定适配能否更高效地提升波斯语 SER 性能。
Method: 提出一个 SER 框架：从 Whisper 编码器提取帧级嵌入后用 PCA 进行降维，避免可学习的投影层，从而显著减少可训练参数；降维后的表示经基于注意力的池化聚合，由轻量预测头分类。此外比较了在波斯语 ASR 任务上微调 Whisper 对下游 SER 的影响。
Result: 在 ShEMO 数据集和说话人无关评估协议下，PCA 降维一致地提升情感识别性能，同时降低训练延迟和内存使用；而 ASR 微调只带来少量 SER 性能提升，表明该条件下语言适配对情感相关表示的迁移有限。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些发现为低资源语言中高效利用大型预训练语音模型进行情感识别提供了实用见解，强调 PCA 降维是有效的参数高效方案，而 ASR 微调对 SER 的收益有限。

papers.title: Cross-Architecture Steering Transfer in Language Models: A Systematic Empirical Study
papers.abstract_en: Independently trained large language models may develop shared internal representations of semantic concepts despite architectural differences -- but whether this geometric similarity has functional consequences for cross-model behavioural control remains untested. We present the first systematic evaluation of cross-model steering transfer and show that shared LLM geometry is functionally exploitable, conditionally: concept directions from one model can steer a different independently trained model when sufficient representational capacity exists. We study five open-weight models spanning three parameter scales (0.8B--8B) and two architectural lineages, training one Sparse Autoencoder per model across 15 semantic domains and testing alignment across all 20 directed model pairs. We observe a suggestive discontinuity near 1.7B parameters: at >= 1.7B scale, 47--49% of cross-model feature pairs validate (Pearson r >= 0.60, Procrustes cosines 0.895--0.956), while alignment degrades sharply below 0.8B. Cross-model steering vectors (B3-TI) achieve a 71.0% win rate across 15 supervised concepts versus 68.0% for same-model native vectors; a single universal vector achieves 67.3% in 4 of 5 models without any per-model supervision. Transfer degrades for models below 1.7B and for one model with generation instability, confirming that functional exploitability requires sufficient representational capacity. Our findings underscore the importance of scale thresholds in mechanistic interpretability: tools validated at 7B scale may not transfer to smaller models without revalidation. We provide the first functional complement to the Platonic Representation Hypothesis -- geometric convergence across independently trained LLMs supports cross-model behavioural control without fine-tuning, under the identified scale conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统评估跨模型控制向量迁移 (cross-model steering transfer)，检验独立训练且架构不同的大语言模型是否能把语义概念方向用于控制另一模型。作者在 5 个开源模型、3 个参数规模 (0.8B--8B)、15 个语义域上训练 Sparse Autoencoder (SAE)，测试全部 20 个有向模型对。结果显示约 1.7B 参数附近存在阈值：规模不低于 1.7B 时跨模型特征对齐与行为控制可迁移，低于 0.8B 时显著退化，为 Platonic Representation Hypothesis 提供了功能性证据。
Motivation: 独立训练的大语言模型可能发展出共享的内部语义表示，但几何相似性是否具有跨模型行为控制的功能后果此前未被检验；作者希望系统验证这种共享几何是否可被实际利用。
Method: 选取覆盖 0.8B--8B、两个架构谱系的 5 个开源模型，对每个模型在 15 个语义域上训练一个 Sparse Autoencoder，并在全部 20 个有向模型对上测试特征对齐 (Pearson r、Procrustes 余弦) 与控制向量迁移，包括跨模型 steering vectors (B3-TI) 与无需逐模型监督的 universal vector。

papers.title: Where Privacy Risk Lives in English-Source Multilingual RAG: A Stage-Decomposed Audit Across Five Query Languages
papers.abstract_en: A common assumption holds that switching to a non-English language makes a multilingual RAG system easier to attack for personal information. We test this on an English-source synthetic-PII corpus with five query languages and a two-stage defence (LLM input judge + regex output filter), in a pipeline whose translator, judge, back-translator, and generator are all Qwen2.5-7B -- so every finding below is pipeline-conditional, not a causal ranking of language-inherent risk. Under output-only filtering, English has the highest observed unstructured-PII leak rate; only English-vs-Swahili separates cleanly under document-level bootstrap intervals. Once the input judge is added, residual leaks remain on Arabic and Swahili, and back-translating the query does not close the gap (an ablation we report but cannot use as a causal diagnostic, since the back-translator is also Qwen). On a separate n=17 multilingual-prompted-judge residual corner, attaching the gold corpus document to the input judge blocks 15/17 residual cells. We frame this last result as a mechanism diagnostic, not a deployable defence: it uses oracle retrieval, BLOCK/ALLOW rates are measured on adversarial queries only, and we measure no benign-query false-positive rate and no answer-utility cost. The supplementary material contains code, corpora, queries, and per-trial JSONLs; the priority follow-up is an independent-MT plus non-Qwen-judge replication with a native-speaker query set, scoped in the Limitations section.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对英语源多语言 RAG 系统进行阶段性隐私风险审计，使用五个查询语言和两级防御（LLM 输入法官 + 正则表达式输出过滤器），检验“切换非英语语言更容易泄露个人信息”的常见假设。摘要报告在仅输出过滤下英语的非结构化 PII 泄露率最高，加入输入法官后阿拉伯语和斯瓦希里语仍有残余泄露，回译查询无法消除差距；所有结论均明确限定为特定流水线条件下的结果，而非语言固有风险的因果排序。
Motivation: 常见假设认为攻击者将查询换成非英语语言会使多语言 RAG 更容易泄露个人信息，作者希望系统化地检验这一假设在英语源数据上的真实性。
Method: 使用英语源合成 PII 语料，设置五个查询语言，评估两级防御流水线（LLM 输入法官 + 正则输出过滤器），其中翻译器、法官、回译器和生成器均为 Qwen2.5-7B；另做了回译消融，以及在附加金标准文档条件下用 n=17 多语言提示法官进行机制诊断。
Result: 仅用输出过滤时英语的非结构化 PII 泄露率最高，且只有英语与斯瓦希里语在文档级 bootstrap 区间上干净分离；加入输入法官后阿拉伯语和斯瓦希里语仍存在残余泄露；在附加金标准文档的机制诊断中，15/17 个残余泄露单元被阻断。
Conclusion: 作者强调所有发现都是流水线条件性的，不能视为语言固有风险的因果排名；附加文档结果仅为机制诊断而非可部署防御，因为其使用 oracle 检索、只在对抗性查询上测量 BLOCK/ALLOW，且未测良性查询假阳性率或答案效用成本；后续优先事项是使用独立机器翻译、非 Qwen 法官和母语者查询集进行复现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PoolBench: A Benchmark for Pooling Strategies in Concept Representation Evaluation for Decoder-Only LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Pooling is a consequential but under-examined design choice in decoder-only concept representation work: practitioners must collapse token-level hidden states into a passage-level vector, yet no shared protocol exists for comparing this choice across concepts, models, and tasks. Reported gains are confounded by simultaneous changes in dataset, layer, construction method, and pooling rule, making principled decisions impossible. We introduce PoolBench, a benchmark that isolates pooling as the experimental variable under a fixed evaluation protocol. PoolBench covers 17 concepts, 19 pooling strategies, and 3 open-weight decoder-only models (Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-2-9B, Mistral-7B), evaluated on a single audited corpus of 37,693 real-text passages. The primary axis is linear separability (D1/AUROC); steered concept prevalence (D2/SCP) and output-level disentanglement (D3) serve as diagnostic axes. The primary finding is decisive: W4_hierarchical reaches a cross-model mean AUROC of 0.7799, while the widely adopted P1_last_token baseline reaches only 0.7640 and is statistically significantly worse (Friedman+Nemenyi, p = 2.0e-36; 77 significant pairs among 18 effective strategies). Rankings are stable across layers (rho = 0.961--0.990). A key negative result: strong detection does not imply strong steering -- D2 and D3 are substantially weaker than D1 for most concepts, indicating a fundamental representational limit rather than a pooling failure. On mid-difficulty concepts, W4_hierarchical outperforms P1_last_token by 0.042--0.113 AUROC; construction method choice (DiffMean vs. REPE) has a larger effect (delta AUROC 0.15) than pooling (delta AUROC 0.016), establishing the correct practical hierarchy. We release the corpus, pre-extracted activations, scorer models, steering vectors, and evaluation code as a reusable protocol for pooling research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PoolBench，一个专门用于评估 decoder-only LLM 中概念表征池化 (pooling) 策略的基准。它在固定评估协议下隔离池化这一变量，覆盖 17 个概念、19 种池化策略和 3 个开源模型。核心发现是 W4_hierarchical 的跨模型平均 AUROC 为 0.7799，显著优于常用的 P1_last_token 基线 (0.7640)，且排名在层间稳定；同时指出强检测能力并不意味强引导能力，后者存在根本性表征局限。
Motivation: 在 decoder-only 概念表征研究中，池化策略是重要但未被充分审视的设计选择，缺乏统一协议来跨概念、模型和任务比较。已有收益常与数据集、层、构造方法和池化规则的同步改动相混淆，导致无法做出有原则的决策。
Method: 引入 PoolBench 基准，将池化作为唯一实验变量，在 37,693 条真实文本的单一审计语料上评估 17 个概念、19 种池化策略和 3 个开源模型 (Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-2-9B、Mistral-7B)；以线性可分性 (D1/AUROC) 为主轴，以引导概念流行度 (D2/SCP) 和输出级解耦 (D3) 为诊断轴。
Result: W4_hierarchical 达到跨模型平均 AUROC 0.7799，广泛使用的 P1_last_token 基线仅为 0.7640，且差异统计显著 (Friedman+Nemenyi, p=2.0e-36；18 个有效策略中有 77 个显著配对)。跨层排名稳定 (rho=0.961--0.990)；对中难度概念，W4_hierarchical 比 P1_last_token 高 0.042--0.113 AUROC，而构造方法选择 (DiffMean vs. REPE) 的效果 (delta AUROC 0.15) 大于池化选择 (delta AUROC 0.016)。
Conclusion: 摘要强调强检测并不等于强引导，D2 和 D3 大多弱于 D1，说明存在根本性表征局限而非池化失败；同时确立了构造方法优先于池化的实际层级。作者发布语料、预提取激活、评分模型、引导向量和评估代码，作为池化研究的可复用协议。

papers.title: SemiAdapt-Instruct: Extensible Instruction Tuning via Latent Domain-Specialised Adapters
papers.abstract_en: Instruction-tuned LLMs are deployed into environments where domains evolve, yet extending a fine-tuned model's capabilities without full retraining remains an unsolved practical challenge. We present SemiAdapt-Instruct, a modular framework that discovers latent instruction domains, trains per-domain LoRA adapters in parallel, and performs parameter-free routing, incorporating new domains via single-adapter training without modifying existing components. SemiAdapt-Instruct outperforms full model fine-tuning across all configurations on both ROUGE-L and LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, while matching single LoRA fine-tuning and delivering extensibility that monolithic approaches cannot provide. We empirically demonstrate this extensibility by showing that updating a single adapter with new domain data outperforms all monolithic baselines. Our study also finds that independent discovery methods converge on the same specialisation-friendly domains. These findings demonstrate that decomposing heterogeneous instruction data into latent domains enables extensible NLP systems where evolving domains require only targeted single-adapter updates, eliminating the need for full model retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SemiAdapt-Instruct，一个模块化指令微调框架，通过隐式发现指令域、并行训练每个域的 LoRA 适配器，并采用无参数路由，使新增域只需训练单个适配器而无需修改现有组件或完整重训模型。摘要报告其在 ROUGE-L 和 LLM-as-a-judge 评估上全面优于全模型微调，匹配单 LoRA 微调，并展现出单适配器更新的可扩展性。
Motivation: 指令微调后的 LLM 部署到领域不断变化的环境中，但扩展微调模型能力而不进行完整重训仍是一个未解决的实际挑战。
Method: 提出模块化框架 SemiAdapt-Instruct：发现隐式指令域，并行训练每个域的 LoRA 适配器（per-domain LoRA adapters），并通过参数自由路由（parameter-free routing）进行推断；新领域只需训练单个适配器即可加入，无需改动已有组件。
Result: SemiAdapt-Instruct 在所有配置下于 ROUGE-L 和 LLM-as-a-judge 评估上均优于全模型微调，同时匹配单 LoRA 微调；用新领域数据更新单个适配器的表现超过所有单块（monolithic）基线，且独立发现方法收敛到同样适合专业化的领域。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将异构指令数据分解为隐式域可实现可扩展的 NLP 系统，领域演变只需针对单个适配器的更新，无需完整模型重训。

papers.title: The Ignition Index: Measuring Global Workspace Dynamics in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Ignition Index (I), a validated scalar metric that operationalizes Global Workspace Theory's (GWT) all-or-none ignition prediction in transformer language models. The metric fits a four-parameter sigmoid to per-layer linear probe accuracy as a function of input signal strength, extracting steepness parameter beta-hat: high values indicate abrupt, ignition-like transitions; low values indicate graded build-up. Across 11 models spanning five architecture families, shuffled-label controls demonstrate 9.6-fold selectivity for genuine linguistic structure over spurious probe capacity (p < 0.001, Mann-Whitney U-test). We find: (1) Feedforward transformers exceed SSMs by 89% in aggregate beta-hat (p < 1e-13, Cohen's d = 0.52), with Mamba exhibiting near-linear profiles consistent with absent global broadcast. (2) Huginn-3.5B exhibits 2.12-fold higher ignition along its iteration axis than its depth axis, demonstrating that recurrent architectures manifest workspace-like transitions along the recurrence dimension. (3) Pythia-410M shows a PELT-detected phase transition at training step 256 (+67%), preceding induction-head formation. (4) Hypotheses linking ignition to model scale and signal strength were not confirmed, suggesting transformer architectures may saturate available ignition mechanisms. The Ignition Index provides the first validated quantitative bridge between GWT's dynamical predictions and mechanistic interpretability, with 9.6-fold measurement selectivity and architecture-level discriminability not previously characterized in the scaling literature. Code: https://github.com/saman-rahbar/ignition-index
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Ignition Index（I），一个将全局工作空间理论（Global Workspace Theory, GWT）的全有或全无点火预测操作化的标量指标。该指标对逐层线性探针（linear probe）准确率随输入信号强度的变化拟合四参数 sigmoid，提取陡峭参数 beta-hat；高值表示突变的点火式转变，低值表示渐变积累。在覆盖五个架构家族的 11 个模型上，shuffled-label 对照显示其对真实语言结构具有 9.6 倍选择性，并在模型规模与架构之间表现出可区分的动态模式。
Motivation: GWT 关于神经信息处理出现全有或全无点火的动态预测，此前缺少在 Transformer 语言模型中被验证的定量度量方法，机制可解释性研究中也没有可直接比较的架构级动态指标。
Method: 对每个 Transformer 层的线性探针准确率随输入信号强度的变化拟合四参数 sigmoid，提取陡峭参数 beta-hat 作为点火指数；使用 shuffled-label 对照测量对真实语言结构的选择性，并跨 11 个模型、五个架构家族进行验证。
Result: 摘要报告 shuffled-label 对照下指标具有 9.6 倍选择性（p < 0.001）；前馈 Transformer 的聚合 beta-hat 比 SSM 高 89%（p < 1e-13, Cohen's d = 0.52），Mamba 呈现接近线性的剖面，表明缺乏全局广播；Huginn-3.5B 沿迭代轴的点火程度是深度轴的 2.12 倍；Pythia-410M 在训练步 256 处出现 PELT 检测到的相变（+67%），早于 induction head 形成；点火与模型规模和信号强度的假设未获证实。
Conclusion: 作者称 Ignition Index 提供了 GWT 动态预测与机制可解释性之间首个经过验证的定量桥梁，具备 9.6 倍测量选择性和此前缩放文献未表征的架构级区分能力；同时指出模型规模与信号强度相关假设未得到支持，提示 Transformer 架构可能已饱和可用的点火机制。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Agentic Nesting: A New Methodology for Existing Enterprise Application Integration and Services
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise operations extensively rely on multiple heterogeneous business systems and information applications, which also result in severe data silos and process fragmentation. Enterprises have invested considerable financial and material resources in building these applications, however, effectively leveraging and orchestrating them remains a formidable challenge. Conventional approaches to enterprise application integration, encompassing middleware architectures such as Enterprise Service Bus (ESB), API gateway infrastructures, and Robotic Process Automation (RPA), suffer from inherent limitations like high architectural coupling, escalating operation and maintenance costs, and limited intelligence capabilities. This paper proposes Agentic Nesting, a multi-agent collaboration framework in which existing enterprise applications are encapsulated as autonomous AI agents within a hierarchically nested structure. Rather than flat interconnection, agents are organized into layered stewardship topologies that mirror the compositional complexity of enterprise ecosystems. The framework extracts a digital agent proxy from each legacy application to enable natural-language interaction and autonomous manipulation, coordinates multiple agents through a central orchestrator for task decomposition and dynamic dispatching, and exposes a unified conversational interface for cross-application querying and process orchestration. The main contributions of this paper are the proposition of the "Application-as-Agent" integration paradigm and the "Conversation-as-Integration" interaction philosophy, together with an exploration of the generalization potential of this methodology in scenarios encompassing heterogeneous system coordination, and large-scale data applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Agentic Nesting，一个将现有企业应用封装为自主 AI 代理并按分层嵌套结构组织的多代理协作框架。框架为每个遗留应用提取数字代理代理层以支持自然语言交互与自主操作，通过中央协调器进行任务分解与动态调度，并提供统一会话式接口实现跨应用查询与流程编排。主要贡献包括'Application-as-Agent'集成范式与'Conversation-as-Integration'交互理念，并探讨该方法的泛化潜力。
Motivation: 企业依赖多种异构业务系统与信息应用，导致数据孤岛和流程碎片化；传统的 ESB、API 网关和 RPA 等集成方案存在架构耦合度高、运维成本高、智能能力有限等固有缺陷。
Method: 将现有企业应用封装为自治 AI 代理，构建反映企业生态组合复杂性的分层监护拓扑；通过中央协调器对多代理进行任务分解与动态调度，并暴露统一会话式接口以支持跨应用查询与流程编排。
Result: 摘要未报告量化实验数据；核心贡献为提出 Application-as-Agent 与 Conversation-as-Integration 两种理念，并探索其在异构系统协调及大规模数据应用场景中的泛化潜力。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法能克服传统企业应用集成方式的局限，并具备向复杂企业生态和更大规模应用场景推广的潜力。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Safe Evolution with Circuit Anchors
papers.abstract_en: In biological evolution, unconstrained mutation can lead to catastrophic outcomes: organisms may evolve enhanced capabilities while losing essential functions for survival. Nature's solution is \textit{developmental constraints}, where core regulatory genes remain anchored while peripheral genes adapt freely. We observe that current self-evolution algorithms for large language models lack analogous constraints. They optimize purely for capability, implicitly assuming safety will be preserved. Our experiments reveal this assumption to be dangerously wrong: models can \textit{misevolve} into powerful yet dangerous entities. Inspired by how Hox genes anchor body structure across $500$ million years of evolution, we propose \textbf{Circuit-Anchored Evolution (CAE)}. Using mechanistic interpretability, we identify a tiny \textit{safety circuit}, comprising less than $2$\% of model features, that causally mediates safety behaviors. We anchor this circuit during evolution, constraining it within a small displacement bound while allowing the remaining features to evolve freely. This mirrors the biological principle of \textit{evolvability with constraint}: preserving what is essential while adapting what is peripheral. Experiments across $3$ model families and two evolution algorithms demonstrate that CAE achieves superior safety preservation with minimal capability loss, substantially outperforming explicit reward-based constraints in both effectiveness and efficiency. Just as developmental constraints prevent biological evolution from producing nonviable organisms, circuit anchoring prevents model evolution from producing capable but dangerous systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出当前大语言模型的自我进化算法缺少类似生物发育约束的机制，只优化能力而隐含假设安全性会被保留，实验表明这一假设不成立，模型可能“误进化”(misevolve) 为强大但危险的实体。作者提出 Circuit-Anchored Evolution (CAE)，利用机械可解释性识别占不到 2% 模型特征的安全回路 (safety circuit)，在进化中将其锚定在小的位移界内，同时允许其余特征自由演化。实验在 3 个模型族和两种进化算法上显示，CAE 在安全保持与最小能力损失方面明显优于基于显式奖励的约束方法。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 自我进化算法缺乏约束，可能让模型在提升能力的同时丢失安全行为，甚至进化为危险系统；作者类比生物发育约束 (developmental constraints) 中核心调控基因被锚定、外围基因自由适应的机制，指出需要在模型进化中加入类似的安全锚定。
Method: 提出 CAE，使用机械可解释性识别因果介导安全行为的安全回路，将这部分特征在进化过程中约束于很小的位移范围，其余特征自由演化，体现“受约束的可进化性”(evolvability with constraint)。
Result: 在 3 个模型族和两种进化算法上的实验表明，CAE 能显著保持安全性且能力损失很小，在有效性和效率上都大幅优于显式奖励约束方法。
Conclusion: 作者类比 Hox 基因在 5 亿年进化中锚定身体结构，认为电路锚定可以防止模型进化产生有能力但危险的系统，并强调这种发育约束式机制比显式奖励约束更有效。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Large Language Models Threaten Double-blind Review
papers.abstract_en: Double blind peer review serves as the scientific community primary defense against status and affiliation bias. Its effectiveness rests on the assumption that anonymized manuscripts convey scientific merit without revealing their authors. While authorship can often be recovered using citation networks or stylistic markers, we show that this assumption is increasingly fragile in the presence of large language models (LLMs). Using only titles and abstracts from papers published after model training, we find that LLMs collapse anonymity more efficiently than humans, with belief concentrating onto a small subset of plausible authors drawn from pools of five domain expert candidates. This vulnerability persists even when stylistic and bibliographic cues are excluded, indicating that stable patterns in problem framing and research focus function as latent conceptual signatures of authorship. Together, these findings indicate that double blind review is vulnerable to automated semantic inference, necessitating a revaluation of how anonymity and fairness are maintained in an AI augmented research ecosystem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）对双盲同行评审匿名性的威胁。作者仅利用论文标题和摘要，发现LLM能以比人类更高的效率推断作者身份，置信度集中到少量候选作者上；即使排除文体和文献计量线索，问题框架与研究焦点中的稳定模式仍可作为潜在的概念性作者签名。作者据此认为双盲评审在AI增强的研究生态下需要重新审视匿名性与公平性的维持方式。
Motivation: 双盲评审依赖匿名手稿不泄露作者身份的假设，但作者身份可通过引用网络或文体标记恢复；本文旨在检验LLM是否使这一假设更加脆弱，从而威胁评审的公平性。
Method: 使用模型训练后发表的论文标题和摘要，构建五名领域专家候选作者池，测试LLM仅基于这些文本特征进行作者推断的能力；同时排除文体和书目线索，以检验概念性模式的影响。
Result: 摘要报告LLM比人类更高效地破坏匿名性，其置信度集中到一小部分合理作者上；且该脆弱性在排除文体和文献计量线索后依然存在，表明问题框架和研究焦点构成潜在的概念作者签名。
Conclusion: 作者认为双盲评审容易受到自动化语义推断的攻击，有必要重新评估AI增强研究生态中匿名性与公平性的维护方式。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Beyond Sentiment: Comparing Traditional NLP and LLM-Based Multi-Dimensional Analysis for Political News Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Traditional sentiment analysis (SA) models, while effective for polarity classification, provide limited insight into the rhetorical, ideological, and framing dimensions of political discourse -- dimensions that are central to research in the social sciences and humanities (SSH). In this paper, we present a comparative study of RoBERTa-based sentiment analysis and an LLM-based multi-dimensional framing analysis platform applied to a corpus of 50 political news articles from 17 international media outlets. The results reveal a critical limitation we term neutral collapse: RoBERTa classifies 70% of articles as neutral, effectively flattening substantively rich political content into an analytically uninformative category. We find that 23% of neutral-classified articles exhibit negative probability scores above 0.30. By contrast, the LLM-based approach captures political bias direction and intensity, sensationalism, emotional appeal, and political framing -- yielding multi-dimensional analytical outputs aligned with SSH epistemologies. We argue that for political media analysis, traditional SA alone is insufficient, and that LLM-based multi-dimensional frameworks offer a more epistemologically adequate computational lens for SSH research needs.
papers.comment: Accepted at PoliticalNLP 2026, the 3rd Workshop on Natural Language Processing for Political Sciences, co-located with LREC 2026. 10 pages, 3 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对 RoBERTa 情感分析 (sentiment analysis) 与基于 LLM 的多维框架分析 (multi-dimensional framing analysis) 在政治新闻评估上做比较研究，语料为 17 家国际媒体的 50 篇政治新闻。研究发现 RoBERTa 将 70% 的文章判为中性，作者称之为 neutral collapse（中性塌缩），并指出其中 23% 的中性文章负面概率得分高于 0.30。相比之下，LLM 方法能捕捉政治偏向方向与强度、煽情程度、情感诉求和政治框架，产出与社会科学与人文学科 (SSH) 认识论对齐的多维分析结果。作者据此主张传统情感分析不足以支撑政治媒体分析。
Motivation: 传统情感分析虽能处理极性分类，但对政治话语中的修辞、意识形态和框架维度提供的信息有限，而这些维度是社会科学与人文学科研究的核心，因此需要检验更充分的计算分析范式。
Method: 开展比较研究：将基于 RoBERTa 的情感分析与一个 LLM 驱动的多维框架分析平台同时应用于 50 篇来自 17 家国际媒体的政治新闻文章，对比两者输出的分析维度与信息量。
Result: RoBERTa 将 70% 的文章归类为中性，且 23% 的中性文章其负面概率得分超过 0.30，说明传统模型严重扁平化内容；而 LLM 方法能输出政治偏向、煽情性、情感诉求和政治框架等多维结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为对政治媒体分析而言，传统情感分析单独使用是不够的，基于 LLM 的多维框架为 SSH 研究需求提供了更具认识论充分性的计算视角。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 开展比较研究：将基于 RoBERTa 的情感分析与一个 LLM 驱动的多维框架分析平台同时应用于 50 篇来自 17 家国际媒体的政治新闻文章，对比两者输出的分析维度与信息量。
summary_sections.result: RoBERTa 将 70% 的文章归类为中性，且 23% 的中性文章其负面概率得分超过 0.30，说明传统模型严重扁平化内容；而 LLM 方法能输出政治偏向、煽情性、情感诉求和政治框架等多维结果。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为对政治媒体分析而言，传统情感分析单独使用是不够的，基于 LLM 的多维框架为 SSH 研究需求提供了更具认识论充分性的计算视角。

papers.title: RIG-RoPE: Relation- and Instance-Gated Rotary Positional Encoding with Duration-Aware Temporal Coordinates
papers.abstract_en: Rotary positional encoding (RoPE) is a core component of modern language models and has been extended to multimodal LLMs through multidimensional variants such as multimodal RoPE (M-RoPE), which split positional channels into temporal, height, and width subspaces. This report identifies two limitations of static multidimensional position assignment in interleaved multimodal contexts. First, height/width rotations may be applied to token pairs whose spatial displacement is not a well-defined geometric object, producing cross-modal and inter-instance spatial interference. Second, temporal coordinates are often treated as equal-step counters, so a text token, an image block, and a video segment can advance the temporal phase by comparable amounts despite different information density. We propose RIG-RoPE, a relation- and instance-gated RoPE mechanism with duration-aware temporal coordinates. RIG-RoPE augments each token with a modality indicator, a visual instance identifier, and a scalar information-duration coordinate. It enables H/W rotations only for query-key pairs from the same visual instance; otherwise the unknown spatial displacement is marginalized rather than set to zero. Temporal rotations use interpolated cumulative block durations: text tokens consume unit duration, images use a dimension-aware logarithmic spatial scale, and videos further apply a logarithmic temporal extension over effective frames. We provide a gauge-invariance argument for avoiding ordinary cross-instance spatial rotation, an impossibility result for static IDs under shared H/W subspaces, and a duration-consistency argument against equal-step multimodal time. RIG-RoPE adds no learned parameters and can be implemented inside tiled attention kernels with constant additional metadata per token. This preliminary report establishes the formulation and validation path without claiming empirical superiority.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一份初步技术报告，针对多模态大语言模型中静态多维位置编码的局限，提出 RIG-RoPE（relation- and instance-gated RoPE with duration-aware temporal coordinates）。该方法为每个 token 附加模态指示符、视觉实例标识符和标量信息时长坐标，仅对同一视觉实例内的 query-key 对启用 H/W 旋转，并用插值累计块时长进行时间旋转。报告给出了规范不变性论证、静态 ID 的不可行性结果和时长一致性论证，并说明该方法不增加可学习参数，可在分块注意力核内实现。作者明确表示该报告建立公式与验证路径，不声称经验优越性。
Motivation: 现有 RoPE 的多维扩展（如 M-RoPE）在交错多模态上下文中采用静态位置分配，存在两个问题：一是对空间位移不是良定义几何对象的跨模态/跨实例 token 对仍可能施加 H/W 旋转，造成空间干扰；二是把时间坐标当作等步长计数器，忽略了文本、图像块和视频片段之间信息密度的差异。
Method: 提出 RIG-RoPE：为每个 token 增加模态指示符、视觉实例标识符和标量信息-时长坐标；仅对同一视觉实例内的 query-key 对启用 H/W 旋转，未知空间位移被边缘化而非置零；时间旋转使用插值的累计块时长，其中文本消耗单位时长、图像采用维度感知的对数空间尺度、视频在有效帧上应用对数时间扩展。方法无需可学习参数，可在分块注意力核内以每 token 常数附加元数据实现。
Result: 摘要未报告实验数值，仅提供理论论证：避免跨实例空间旋转的规范不变性论证、共享 H/W 子空间下静态 ID 的不可行性结果，以及反对等步长多模态时间的时长一致性论证。
Conclusion: 本文是初步技术报告，确立了 RIG-RoPE 的公式表述和验证路径，但明确不声称经验优越性；作者强调该方法可在分块注意力高效实现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Universal Pathologies, Conditional Consequences: A Triple-Robustness Analysis of RAG for Multi-Hop Traceability
papers.abstract_en: GraphRAG underperforms vector RAG on citation precision in many reports, but where and why have remained corpus-bound. We present a triple-robustness analysis that holds the retrieval architecture fixed and varies three orthogonal axes embedder (local e5-small -> Azure text-embedding-3-small), corpus (DO-178C typed-edge requirements -> Wikipedia paragraph chains via MuSiQue), and judge (paired GPT-5.4 x GPT-4.1) across 4,440 main-matrix runs, 600 cross-corpus runs, and 1,200 paired faithfulness judgments. (C2a) Over-citation is architecturally universal: GraphRAG emits 11-15 IDs per answer at citation precision 0.12-0.23 and retrieval recall 0.68-0.87 across all three settings. (C2b) Its faithfulness consequence is corpus-conditional: in typed-edge DO-178C, GraphRAG faithfulness collapses 74%->40% across hops; on Wikipedia chains the same pipeline rises 42%->58% because over-cited paragraphs remain topically supporting. (C1) Stratum-conditional winners are corpus-conditional but embedder-robust: vanilla wins 2-hop on DO-178C, GraphRAG wins 2-hop on MuSiQue, identical under either embedder. (C3) Single-judge LLM faithfulness is fragile to retrieval state: same-judge self-kappa across embedders is 0.137 for GPT-5.4 (verdict change on 41% of items). A learned router on dense embeddings alone reaches macro-F1 0.86 on hop classification (C4). We argue triple-robustness is the minimum bar for trustworthy RAG architecture claims.

papers.title: Mean-Field Dynamics of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) with chain-of-thought reasoning have been widely applied in recent years, and theoretical explanations of their behavior may help deepen our understanding and guide model optimization. In this study, we introduce a framework that seeks statistical regularities and theoretical interpretations in LLM reasoning without simplifying the model architecture or making analogies to existing physical systems. We formulate LLM reasoning as a guided discovery process on a clue graph, and derive a one-dimensional ordinary differential equation for the fraction of discovered clues using the mean-field approximation. Experimentally, clue tokens are identified using the normalized surprisal of a student LLM on the outputs of a teacher LLM, and statistical regularities are obtained by averaging over many reasoning chains of thought. Our experiments show that the resulting statistical regularities are reproducible within the same dataset and can be fitted by the solving the proposed theoretical equation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个平均场动力学框架，将大语言模型的思维链推理表述为线索图上的引导发现过程，在不简化模型架构、也不类比现有物理系统的前提下推导已发现线索比例的一维常微分方程。实验用学生 LLM 在教师 LLM 输出上的归一化 surprisal 识别线索 token，并通过多条思维链平均获得统计规律。结果显示同一数据集内的统计规律可复现，且能用所提出的理论方程拟合。
Motivation: 思维链推理已被广泛应用，但缺乏既不完全简化模型架构、又不借助物理类比的理论解释，作者希望为理解推理行为并指导模型优化提供理论框架。
Method: 将 LLM 推理形式化为线索图上的引导发现过程，利用平均场近似推导关于已发现线索比例的一维常微分方程；实验中使用学生 LLM 在教师 LLM 输出的归一化 surprisal 标记线索 token，并对多条思维链取平均以得到统计规律。
Result: 实验表明该方法得到的统计规律在同一数据集内可复现，并可由推导的理论方程较好拟合。
Conclusion: 论文提供了一种保留模型架构、不依赖物理类比的思维链推理统计规律理论描述方法；摘要未提及明确局限。

papers.title: Simulator-Grounded Large Language Models for Industrial Causal Reasoning: Tool-Use, Structured Injection, and Plant-Portable Retrieval for Wastewater Treatment Decision Support
papers.abstract_en: Wastewater operators need answers grounded in how their plant's variables interact and how fast effects propagate, not in generic pretraining text, when asking causal questions such as "why is N2O rising?" or "what happens if I cut aeration by 20%?". We compare three concrete ways to ground a frozen Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct model in an architecturally interpretable wastewater simulator (CCSS-IX): a live simulator oracle (Method 1), structured parameter injection (Method 2), and a Decoupled Recall-Reasoning (DRR) retriever (Method 3). On a 198-question causal benchmark the three reach 99.5%, 79%, and 75.8%, forming a deployment ladder above the strongest retrieval-augmented baseline at 48%. The DRR retriever has 110M parameters and trains per plant in ~17 seconds; after cross-plant transfer to a biologically distinct plant it still reaches 88%, while Method 2's static table cannot transfer. On a 60-question counterfactual benchmark only Method 3 handles queries about what happens after an intervention: +16.3 pp over Method 2, paired 95% CI [+7.1, +26.4] pp, with 100% on the timescale and operating-regime categories. On the AI2 Reasoning Challenge (ARC) with an OpenBookQA fact corpus, the same selective-retrieval mechanism reaches 79% versus unconstrained Llama-3.1-8B 76% and full-injection 74%, a +3 pp out-of-domain replication that argues against a result specific to wastewater treatment. We provide the first single-simulator comparison of live tool-use, static parameter injection, and learned numerical-parameter retrieval for industrial causal question answering.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables. Preprint submitted to Elsevier
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较三种将冻结的 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 模型锚定在可解释污水处理模拟器 (CCSS-IX) 的方法：实时模拟器 oracle、结构化参数注入、以及解耦检索-推理 (Decoupled Recall-Reasoning, DRR) 检索器。在 198 题因果基准上，三种方法分别达到 99.5%、79% 和 75.8%，超过最强检索增强基线 (RAG) 的 48%；DRR 可跨厂迁移，并在 60 题反事实基准上独能处理干预类查询。作者称这是首个对工业因果问答中实时工具使用、静态参数注入与学习型数值参数检索进行单模拟器比较的工作。
Motivation: 污水处理操作员在提出因果问题时需要基于本厂变量如何交互以及效应传播速度的答案，而非通用预训练文本；现有方法缺少在可解释模拟器约束下对不同 grounding 方式的系统比较。
Method: 提出三种 grounding 途径：Method 1 以实时模拟器作为 oracle 工具调用，Method 2 将结构化参数注入上下文，Method 3 训练约 110M 参数的 DRR 检索器，单厂训练约 17 秒且支持跨厂迁移；另用 AI2 Reasoning Challenge (ARC) 与 OpenBookQA 事实语料做域外检验。
Result: 198 题因果基准上三方法分别达到 99.5%、79%、75.8%，强于 48% 的 RAG 基线；DRR 跨厂迁移后仍达 88%，而 Method 2 的静态表不可迁移。60 题反事实基准上 Method 3 较 Method 2 高 +16.3 个百分点 (配对 95% CI [+7.1, +26.4] pp)，时间尺度与运行工况类别上为 100%。在 ARC+OpenBookQA 上 DRR 达 79%，高于无约束 Llama-3.1-8B 的 76% 与全注入的 74%，即 +3 pp 的域外复现。
Conclusion: 作者强调这是首次在单一模拟器下比较实时工具使用、静态参数注入与学习型数值参数检索，且 DRR 的选择式检索机制在领域外也带来稳定提升，说明结果并非污水处理特有问题。

papers.title: FlowAdam: Implicit Regularization via Geometry-Aware Soft Momentum Injection
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive moment methods such as Adam use a diagonal, coordinate-wise preconditioner based on exponential moving averages of squared gradients. This diagonal scaling is coordinate-system dependent and can struggle with dense or rotated parameter couplings, including those in matrix factorization, tensor decomposition, and graph neural networks, because it treats each parameter independently. We introduce FlowAdam, a hybrid optimizer that augments Adam with continuous gradient-flow integration via an ordinary differential equation (ODE). When EMA-based statistics detect landscape difficulty, FlowAdam switches to clipped ODE integration. Our central contribution is Soft Momentum Injection, which blends ODE velocity with Adam's momentum during mode transitions. This prevents the training collapse observed with naive hybrid approaches. Across coupled optimization benchmarks, the ODE integration provides implicit regularization, reducing held-out error by 10-22% on low-rank matrix/tensor recovery and 6% on Jester (real-world collaborative filtering), also surpassing tuned Lion and AdaBelief, while matching Adam on well-conditioned workloads (CIFAR-10). MovieLens-100K confirms benefits arise specifically from coupled parameter interactions rather than bias estimation. Ablation studies show that soft injection is essential, as hard replacement reduces accuracy from 100% to 82.5%.
papers.comment: Accepted at IJCNN 2026 (IEEE WCCI). 8 pages, 4 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FlowAdam，一种将 Adam 与基于常微分方程 (ODE) 的连续梯度流集成相结合的混合优化器。当基于指数移动平均 (EMA) 的统计量检测到损失景观存在困难时，FlowAdam 切换到裁剪后的 ODE 积分，并通过 Soft Momentum Injection 在模式转换时混合 ODE 速度与 Adam 动量，以避免训练崩溃。实验表明，在低秩矩阵/张量恢复和 Jester 协同过滤等耦合优化任务上，该方法通过隐式正则化降低了泛化误差，同时在与 Adam 相同的良好条件化任务 (CIFAR-10) 上保持匹配。
Motivation: Adam 等自适应矩方法使用基于平方梯度指数移动平均的对角、逐坐标预条件器，这种对角缩放依赖坐标系，在密集或旋转的参数耦合场景（如矩阵分解、张量分解、图神经网络）中表现不佳，因为每个参数被独立处理。
Method: 引入 FlowAdam 混合优化器，在 EMA 统计量检测到景观困难时切换到裁剪的 ODE 积分，并核心提出 Soft Momentum Injection，在模式转换期间将 ODE 速度与 Adam 动量混合，取代了朴素混合方法中的硬替换以避免训练崩溃。
Result: 在低秩矩阵/张量恢复上，held-out 误差降低 10-22%；在 Jester 真实协同过滤上降低 6%，同时超越调优后的 Lion 和 AdaBelief；在 CIFAR-10 良好条件化任务上与 Adam 匹配。MovieLens-100K 表明收益来自耦合参数交互而非偏差估计；消融显示软注入至关重要，硬替换将准确率从 100% 降至 82.5%。
Conclusion: 作者认为 ODE 积分提供的隐式正则化在耦合优化场景中带来泛化收益，而 Soft Momentum Injection 是混合策略成功的关键；论文强调收益源于参数耦合交互，而非偏差估计。
Relevance: 0
